verses.text: Now therefore come you, let us make a covenant, I and you; and let it be for a witness between me and you.

verses.raw: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
verses.text: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

verses.raw: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.
verses.text: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.

verses.raw: And Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.
verses.text: And Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.

verses.raw: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and you this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;
verses.text: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and you this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;

verses.raw: And Mizpah; for he said, Yahuah (LORD) watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.
verses.text: And Mizpah; for he said, Yahuah watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.

verses.raw: If you shall afflict my daughters, or if you shall take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, Elohim (God) is witness betwixt me and you.
verses.text: If you shall afflict my daughters, or if you shall take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, Elohim is witness betwixt me and you.

verses.raw: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and you;
verses.text: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and you;

verses.raw: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you shall not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.
verses.text: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you shall not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.

verses.raw: The Elohim (God) of Abraham, and the Elohim (God) of Nahor, the Elohim (God) of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.
verses.text: The Elohim of Abraham, and the Elohim of Nahor, the Elohim of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.

verses.raw: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.
verses.text: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.

verses.raw: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.
verses.text: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.

verses.raw: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of Elohim (God) met him.
verses.text: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of Elohim met him.

verses.raw: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is Elohim's (God’s) host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
verses.text: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is Elohim's (God’s) host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

verses.raw: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
verses.text: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

verses.raw: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall you speak unto my lord Esau; Your servant Jacob says thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:
verses.text: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall you speak unto my lord Esau; Your servant Jacob says thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:

verses.raw: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in your sight.
verses.text: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in your sight.

verses.raw: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to your brother Esau, and also he comes to meet you, and four hundred men with him.
verses.text: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to your brother Esau, and also he comes to meet you, and four hundred men with him.

verses.raw: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;
verses.text: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;

verses.raw: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.
verses.text: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.

verses.raw: And Jacob said, O Elohim (God) of my father Abraham, and Elohim (God) of my father Isaac, Yahuah (LORD) which saidst unto me, Return unto your country, and to your kindred, and I will deal well with you:
verses.text: And Jacob said, O Elohim of my father Abraham, and Elohim of my father Isaac, Yahuah which saidst unto me, Return unto your country, and to your kindred, and I will deal well with you:

verses.raw: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which you have shewed unto your servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.
verses.text: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which you have shewed unto your servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.

verses.raw: Deliver me, I pray you, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.
verses.text: Deliver me, I pray you, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.

verses.raw: And you saidst, I will surely do you good, and make your seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
verses.text: And you saidst, I will surely do you good, and make your seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.

verses.raw: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;
verses.text: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;

verses.raw: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,
verses.text: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,

verses.raw: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.
verses.text: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.

verses.raw: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.
verses.text: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.

verses.raw: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth you, and asks you, saying, Whose are you? and whither go you? and whose are these before you?
verses.text: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth you, and asks you, saying, Whose are you? and whither go you? and whose are these before you?

verses.raw: Then you shall say, They be your servant Jacob’s; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.
verses.text: Then you shall say, They be your servant Jacob’s; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.

verses.raw: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall you speak unto Esau, when you find him.
verses.text: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall you speak unto Esau, when you find him.

verses.raw: And say you moreover, Behold, your servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.
verses.text: And say you moreover, Behold, your servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.

verses.raw: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.
verses.text: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.

verses.raw: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.
verses.text: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.

verses.raw: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.
verses.text: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.

verses.raw: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.
verses.text: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.

verses.raw: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.
verses.text: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.

verses.raw: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaks. And he said, I will not let you go, except you bless me.
verses.text: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaks. And he said, I will not let you go, except you bless me.

verses.raw: And he said unto him, What is your name? And he said, Jacob.
verses.text: And he said unto him, What is your name? And he said, Jacob.

verses.raw: And he said, Your name shall be called no more Jacob, but Yashar'el (Israel): for as a prince have you power with Elohim (God) and with men, and have prevailed.
verses.text: And he said, Your name shall be called no more Jacob, but Yashar'el: for as a prince have you power with Elohim and with men, and have prevailed.

verses.raw: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray you, your name. And he said, Wherefore is it that you do ask after my name? And he blessed him there.
verses.text: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray you, your name. And he said, Wherefore is it that you do ask after my name? And he blessed him there.

verses.raw: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen Elohim (God) face to face, and my life is preserved.
verses.text: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen Elohim face to face, and my life is preserved.

verses.raw: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.
verses.text: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.

verses.raw: Therefore the children of Yashar'el (Israel) eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew that shrank.
verses.text: Therefore the children of Yashar'el eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew that shrank.

verses.raw: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.
verses.text: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.

verses.raw: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.
verses.text: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.

verses.raw: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
verses.text: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

verses.raw: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
verses.text: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.

verses.raw: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with you? And he said, The children which Elohim (God) has graciously given your servant.
verses.text: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with you? And he said, The children which Elohim has graciously given your servant.

verses.raw: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
verses.text: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.

verses.raw: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
verses.text: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

verses.raw: And he said, What meanest you by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.
verses.text: And he said, What meanest you by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.

verses.raw: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that you have unto thyself.
verses.text: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that you have unto thyself.

verses.raw: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray you, if now I have found grace in your sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen your face, as though I had seen the face of Elohim (God), and you were pleased with me.
verses.text: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray you, if now I have found grace in your sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen your face, as though I had seen the face of Elohim, and you were pleased with me.

verses.raw: Take, I pray you, my blessing that is brought to you; because Elohim (God) has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.
verses.text: Take, I pray you, my blessing that is brought to you; because Elohim has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.

verses.raw: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before you.
verses.text: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before you.

verses.raw: And he said unto him, My lord knows that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.
verses.text: And he said unto him, My lord knows that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.

verses.raw: Let my lord, I pray you, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goes before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.
verses.text: Let my lord, I pray you, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goes before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.

verses.raw: And Esau said, Let me now leave with you some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.
verses.text: And Esau said, Let me now leave with you some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.

verses.raw: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
verses.text: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.

verses.raw: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
verses.text: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

verses.raw: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan-aram; and pitched his tent before the city.
verses.text: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan-aram; and pitched his tent before the city.

verses.raw: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for an hundred pieces of money.
verses.text: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for an hundred pieces of money.

verses.raw: And he erected there an altar, and called it El-elohe-Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And he erected there an altar, and called it El-elohe-Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
verses.text: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

verses.raw: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.
verses.text: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.

verses.raw: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.
verses.text: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.

verses.raw: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.
verses.text: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.

verses.raw: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.
verses.text: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.

verses.raw: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.
verses.text: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.

verses.raw: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Yashar'el (Israel) in lying with Jacob’s daughter; which thing ought not to be done.
verses.text: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Yashar'el in lying with Jacob’s daughter; which thing ought not to be done.

verses.raw: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.
verses.text: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.

verses.raw: And make you marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
verses.text: And make you marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.

verses.raw: And you shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade you therein, and get you possessions therein.
verses.text: And you shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade you therein, and get you possessions therein.

verses.raw: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what you shall say unto me I will give.
verses.text: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what you shall say unto me I will give.

verses.raw: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as you shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.
verses.text: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as you shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.

verses.raw: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:
verses.text: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:

verses.raw: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:
verses.text: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:

verses.raw: But in this will we consent unto you: If you will be as we be, that every male of you be circumcised;
verses.text: But in this will we consent unto you: If you will be as we be, that every male of you be circumcised;

verses.raw: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
verses.text: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

verses.raw: But if you will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.
verses.text: But if you will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.

verses.raw: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor’s son.
verses.text: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor’s son.

verses.raw: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter: and he was more honourable than all the house of his father.
verses.text: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter: and he was more honourable than all the house of his father.

verses.raw: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,
verses.text: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,

verses.raw: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.
verses.text: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.

verses.raw: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.
verses.text: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.

verses.raw: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.
verses.text: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.

verses.raw: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.
verses.text: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.
verses.text: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.

verses.raw: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went out.
verses.text: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went out.

verses.raw: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.
verses.text: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.

verses.raw: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,
verses.text: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,

verses.raw: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.
verses.text: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.

verses.raw: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, You have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.
verses.text: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, You have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.

verses.raw: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?
verses.text: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Beth-el, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto Elohim (God), that appeared unto you when you fleddest from the face of Esau your brother.
verses.text: And Elohim said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Beth-el, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto Elohim, that appeared unto you when you fleddest from the face of Esau your brother.

verses.text: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:

verses.raw: And let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto Elohim (God), who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
verses.text: And let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto Elohim, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.

verses.raw: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
verses.text: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

verses.raw: And they journeyed: and the terror of Elohim (God) was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
verses.text: And they journeyed: and the terror of Elohim was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.

verses.raw: Now Yashar'el (Israel) loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.

verses.raw: And his brethren said to him, Shall you indeed reign over us? or shall you indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.

verses.raw: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
verses.text: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:

verses.raw: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.
verses.text: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.

verses.raw: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: Elohim (God) has shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.
verses.text: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: Elohim has shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.

verses.raw: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.
verses.text: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.

verses.raw: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.
verses.text: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.

verses.raw: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What Elohim (God) is about to do he shows unto Pharaoh.
verses.text: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What Elohim is about to do he shows unto Pharaoh.

verses.raw: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:
verses.text: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:

verses.raw: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;
verses.text: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;

verses.raw: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.
verses.text: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.

verses.raw: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by Elohim (God), and Elohim (God) will shortly bring it to pass.
verses.text: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by Elohim, and Elohim will shortly bring it to pass.

verses.raw: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
verses.text: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.
verses.text: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.

verses.raw: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.
verses.text: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.

verses.raw: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
verses.text: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.

verses.raw: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
verses.text: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of Elohim (God) is?
verses.text: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of Elohim is?

verses.raw: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as Elohim (God) has shewed you all this, there is none so discreet and wise as you are:
verses.text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as Elohim has shewed you all this, there is none so discreet and wise as you are:

verses.raw: You shall be over my house, and according unto your word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than you.
verses.text: You shall be over my house, and according unto your word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than you.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
verses.text: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;

verses.raw: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without you shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without you shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphnath-paaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphnath-paaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
verses.text: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.

verses.raw: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.
verses.text: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.

verses.raw: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.
verses.text: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.

verses.raw: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.
verses.text: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.

verses.raw: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For Elohim (God), said he, has made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.
verses.text: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For Elohim, said he, has made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.

verses.raw: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For Elohim (God) has caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.
verses.text: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For Elohim has caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

verses.raw: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.
verses.text: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.

verses.raw: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
verses.text: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

verses.raw: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he says to you, do.
verses.text: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he says to you, do.

verses.raw: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: and Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: and Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.
verses.text: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.

verses.raw: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do you look one upon another?
verses.text: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do you look one upon another?

verses.raw: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.
verses.text: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.

verses.raw: And Joseph’s ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.
verses.text: And Joseph’s ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.

verses.raw: But Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.
verses.text: But Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.

verses.raw: And the sons of Yashar'el (Israel) came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And the sons of Yashar'el came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: And Joseph was the governor over the land, and he it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph’s brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.
verses.text: And Joseph was the governor over the land, and he it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph’s brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.

verses.raw: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come you? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.
verses.text: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come you? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.

verses.raw: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.
verses.text: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.

verses.raw: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, You are spies; to see the nakedness of the land you are come.
verses.text: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, You are spies; to see the nakedness of the land you are come.

verses.raw: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are your servants come.
verses.text: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are your servants come.

verses.raw: We are all one man’s sons; we are true men, your servants are no spies.
verses.text: We are all one man’s sons; we are true men, your servants are no spies.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land you are come.
verses.text: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land you are come.

verses.raw: And they said, Your servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.
verses.text: And they said, Your servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.

verses.raw: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, You are spies:
verses.text: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, You are spies:

verses.raw: Hereby you shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh you shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.
verses.text: Hereby you shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh you shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.

verses.raw: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and you shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely you are spies.
verses.text: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and you shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely you are spies.

verses.raw: And he put them all together into ward three days.
verses.text: And he put them all together into ward three days.

verses.raw: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear Elohim (God):
verses.text: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear Elohim:

verses.raw: If you be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go you, carry corn for the famine of your houses:
verses.text: If you be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go you, carry corn for the famine of your houses:

verses.raw: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and you shall not die. And they did so.
verses.text: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and you shall not die. And they did so.

verses.raw: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.
verses.text: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.

verses.raw: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and you would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.
verses.text: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and you would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.

verses.raw: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.
verses.text: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.

verses.raw: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.
verses.text: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.

verses.raw: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man’s money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.
verses.text: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man’s money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.

verses.raw: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.
verses.text: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.

verses.raw: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack’s mouth.
verses.text: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack’s mouth.

verses.raw: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that Elohim (God) has done unto us?
verses.text: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that Elohim has done unto us?

verses.raw: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,
verses.text: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,

verses.raw: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.
verses.text: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.

verses.raw: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:
verses.text: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:

verses.raw: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.
verses.text: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that you are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:
verses.text: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that you are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:

verses.raw: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that you are no spies, but that you are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and you shall traffick in the land.
verses.text: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that you are no spies, but that you are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and you shall traffick in the land.

verses.raw: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man’s bundle of money was in his sack: and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.
verses.text: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man’s bundle of money was in his sack: and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.

verses.raw: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have you bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and you will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.
verses.text: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have you bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and you will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.

verses.raw: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to you: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to you again.
verses.text: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to you: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to you again.

verses.raw: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which you go, then shall you bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
verses.text: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which you go, then shall you bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

verses.raw: And the famine was sore in the land.
verses.text: And the famine was sore in the land.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, You shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
verses.text: And Yahudah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, You shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

verses.raw: If you will send our brother with us, we will go down and buy you food:
verses.text: If you will send our brother with us, we will go down and buy you food:

verses.raw: But if you will not send him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, You shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
verses.text: But if you will not send him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, You shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

verses.raw: And Yashar'el (Israel) said, Wherefore dealt you so ill with me, as to tell the man whether you had yet a brother?
verses.text: And Yashar'el said, Wherefore dealt you so ill with me, as to tell the man whether you had yet a brother?

verses.raw: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have you another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?
verses.text: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have you another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) said unto Yashar'el (Israel) his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and you, and also our little ones.
verses.text: And Yahudah said unto Yashar'el his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and you, and also our little ones.

verses.raw: I will be surety for him; of my hand shall you require him: if I bring him not unto you, and set him before you, then let me bear the blame for ever:
verses.text: I will be surety for him; of my hand shall you require him: if I bring him not unto you, and set him before you, then let me bear the blame for ever:

verses.raw: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.
verses.text: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.

verses.raw: And their father Yashar'el (Israel) said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:
verses.text: And their father Yashar'el said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:

verses.raw: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:
verses.text: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:

verses.raw: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:
verses.text: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:

verses.raw: And El Shaddai (God Almighty) give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.
verses.text: And El Shaddai give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.

verses.raw: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.
verses.text: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

verses.raw: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.
verses.text: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.

verses.raw: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph’s house.
verses.text: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph’s house.

verses.raw: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph’s house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.
verses.text: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph’s house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.

verses.text: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.

verses.raw: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your Elohim (God), and the Elohim (God) of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.

verses.raw: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom you spake? Is he yet alive?
verses.text: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom you spake? Is he yet alive?

verses.text: And they answered, Your servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.

verses.raw: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother’s son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom you spake unto me? And he said, Elohim (God) be gracious unto you, my son.
verses.text: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother’s son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom you spake unto me? And he said, Elohim be gracious unto you, my son.

verses.raw: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.
verses.text: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.

verses.raw: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.
verses.text: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.

verses.raw: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
verses.text: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

verses.raw: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.
verses.text: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.

verses.raw: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin’s mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.
verses.text: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin’s mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.

verses.raw: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man’s money in his sack’s mouth.
verses.text: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man’s money in his sack’s mouth.

verses.raw: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
verses.text: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

verses.raw: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.
verses.text: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.

verses.raw: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when you do overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have you rewarded evil for good?
verses.text: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when you do overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have you rewarded evil for good?

verses.raw: Is not this it in which my lord drinks, and whereby indeed he divineth? you have done evil in so doing.
verses.text: Is not this it in which my lord drinks, and whereby indeed he divineth? you have done evil in so doing.

verses.raw: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.
verses.text: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.

verses.raw: And they said unto him, Wherefore says my lord these words? Elohim (God) forbid that your servants should do according to this thing:
verses.text: And they said unto him, Wherefore says my lord these words? Elohim forbid that your servants should do according to this thing:

verses.raw: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again unto you out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of your lord’s house silver or gold?
verses.text: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again unto you out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of your lord’s house silver or gold?

verses.raw: With whomsoever of your servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord’s bondmen.
verses.text: With whomsoever of your servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord’s bondmen.

verses.raw: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and you shall be blameless.
verses.text: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and you shall be blameless.

verses.raw: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.
verses.text: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.

verses.raw: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
verses.text: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

verses.raw: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.
verses.text: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) and his brethren came to Joseph’s house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.
verses.text: And Yahudah and his brethren came to Joseph’s house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.

verses.raw: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that you have done? wot you not that such a man as I can certainly divine?
verses.text: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that you have done? wot you not that such a man as I can certainly divine?

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? Elohim (God) has found out the iniquity of your servants: behold, we are my lord’s servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.
verses.text: And Yahudah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? Elohim has found out the iniquity of your servants: behold, we are my lord’s servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.

verses.raw: And he said, Elohim (God) forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.
verses.text: And he said, Elohim forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.

verses.raw: Then Yahudah (Judah) came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let your servant, I pray you, speak a word in my lord’s ears, and let not your anger burn against your servant: for you are even as Pharaoh.
verses.text: Then Yahudah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let your servant, I pray you, speak a word in my lord’s ears, and let not your anger burn against your servant: for you are even as Pharaoh.

verses.raw: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have you a father, or a brother?
verses.text: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have you a father, or a brother?

verses.raw: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loves him.
verses.text: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loves him.

verses.raw: And you saidst unto your servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set my eyes upon him.
verses.text: And you saidst unto your servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set my eyes upon him.

verses.raw: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.
verses.text: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.

verses.raw: And you saidst unto your servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, you shall see my face no more.
verses.text: And you saidst unto your servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, you shall see my face no more.

verses.raw: And it came to pass when we came up unto your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
verses.text: And it came to pass when we came up unto your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

verses.raw: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.
verses.text: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.

verses.raw: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man’s face, except our youngest brother be with us.
verses.text: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man’s face, except our youngest brother be with us.

verses.raw: And your servant my father said unto us, You know that my wife bare me two sons:
verses.text: And your servant my father said unto us, You know that my wife bare me two sons:

verses.raw: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:
verses.text: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:

verses.raw: And if you take this also from me, and mischief befall him, you shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
verses.text: And if you take this also from me, and mischief befall him, you shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

verses.raw: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad’s life;
verses.text: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad’s life;

verses.raw: It shall come to pass, when he sees that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and your servants shall bring down the gray hairs of your servant our father with sorrow to the grave.
verses.text: It shall come to pass, when he sees that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and your servants shall bring down the gray hairs of your servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

verses.raw: For your servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto you, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.
verses.text: For your servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto you, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.

verses.raw: Now therefore, I pray you, let your servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.
verses.text: Now therefore, I pray you, let your servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.

verses.raw: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.
verses.text: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.

verses.raw: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.
verses.text: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.

verses.raw: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.
verses.text: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.

verses.raw: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; does my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.
verses.text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; does my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.

verses.raw: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.
verses.text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.

verses.raw: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me hither: for Elohim (God) did send me before you to preserve life.
verses.text: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me hither: for Elohim did send me before you to preserve life.

verses.raw: For these two years has the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.
verses.text: For these two years has the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
verses.text: And Elohim sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

verses.raw: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but Elohim (God): and he has made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.text: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but Elohim: and he has made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: Haste you, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus says your son Joseph, Elohim (God) has made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:
verses.text: Haste you, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus says your son Joseph, Elohim has made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:

verses.raw: And you shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you shall be near unto me, you, and your children, and your children’s children, and your flocks, and your herds, and all that you have:
verses.text: And you shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you shall be near unto me, you, and your children, and your children’s children, and your flocks, and your herds, and all that you have:

verses.raw: And there will I nourish you; for yet there are five years of famine; lest you, and your household, and all that you have, come to poverty.
verses.text: And there will I nourish you; for yet there are five years of famine; lest you, and your household, and all that you have, come to poverty.

verses.raw: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks unto you.
verses.text: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks unto you.

verses.raw: And you shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen; and you shall haste and bring down my father hither.
verses.text: And you shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen; and you shall haste and bring down my father hither.

verses.raw: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
verses.text: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

verses.raw: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.
verses.text: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.

verses.raw: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, Joseph’s brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
verses.text: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, Joseph’s brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto your brethren, This do you; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
verses.text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto your brethren, This do you; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;

verses.raw: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you shall eat the fat of the land.
verses.text: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you shall eat the fat of the land.

verses.raw: Now you are commanded, this do you; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
verses.text: Now you are commanded, this do you; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

verses.raw: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.
verses.text: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

verses.raw: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.
verses.text: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.

verses.raw: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.
verses.text: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.

verses.raw: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that you fall not out by the way.
verses.text: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that you fall not out by the way.

verses.raw: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,
verses.text: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,

verses.raw: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob’s heart fainted, for he believed them not.
verses.text: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob’s heart fainted, for he believed them not.

verses.raw: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:
verses.text: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:

verses.raw: And Yashar'el (Israel) said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.
verses.text: And Yashar'el said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.

verses.raw: And Yashar'el (Israel) took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the Elohim (God) of his father Isaac.
verses.text: And Yashar'el took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the Elohim of his father Isaac.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) spake unto Yashar'el (Israel) in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.
verses.text: And Elohim spake unto Yashar'el in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.

verses.raw: And he said, I am Elohim (God), the Elohim (God) of your father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of you a great nation:
verses.text: And he said, I am Elohim, the Elohim of your father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of you a great nation:

verses.text: I will go down with you into Egypt; and I will also surely bring you up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon your eyes.

verses.text: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba: and the sons of Yashar'el carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
