verses.raw: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Yashar'el (Israel) journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Yashar'el (Israel) pitched their tents.
verses.text: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Yashar'el journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Yashar'el pitched their tents.

verses.raw: At the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) the children of Yashar'el (Israel) journeyed, and at the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.
verses.text: At the commandment of Yahuah the children of Yashar'el journeyed, and at the commandment of Yahuah they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.

verses.raw: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Yashar'el (Israel) kept the charge of Yahuah (LORD), and journeyed not.
verses.text: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Yashar'el kept the charge of Yahuah, and journeyed not.

verses.raw: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) they journeyed.
verses.text: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of Yahuah they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of Yahuah they journeyed.

verses.raw: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
verses.text: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.

verses.raw: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Yashar'el (Israel) abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.
verses.text: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Yashar'el abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.

verses.raw: At the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) they journeyed: they kept the charge of Yahuah (LORD), at the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) by the hand of Moses.
verses.text: At the commandment of Yahuah they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of Yahuah they journeyed: they kept the charge of Yahuah, at the commandment of Yahuah by the hand of Moses.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Make you two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shall you make them: that you may use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.
verses.text: Make you two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shall you make them: that you may use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.

verses.raw: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to you at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to you at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.raw: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Yashar'el (Israel), shall gather themselves unto you.
verses.text: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Yashar'el, shall gather themselves unto you.

verses.raw: When you blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.
verses.text: When you blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.

verses.raw: When you blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
verses.text: When you blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

verses.raw: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.
verses.text: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.

verses.raw: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.
verses.text: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.

verses.raw: And if you go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresses you, then you shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and you shall be remembered before Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and you shall be saved from your enemies.
verses.text: And if you go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresses you, then you shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and you shall be remembered before Yahuah Elohaychem, and you shall be saved from your enemies.

verses.raw: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your Elohim (God): I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your Elohim: I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.text: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.

verses.raw: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) by the hand of Moses.
verses.text: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of Yahuah by the hand of Moses.

verses.raw: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Yahudah (Judah) according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.text: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Yahudah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

verses.raw: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
verses.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

verses.raw: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.

verses.raw: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.
verses.text: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.

verses.raw: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.text: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.

verses.raw: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.raw: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

verses.raw: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.
verses.text: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.

verses.raw: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.text: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.

verses.raw: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

verses.raw: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.

verses.raw: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.text: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

verses.raw: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.

verses.raw: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.

verses.raw: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) according to their armies, when they set forward.
verses.text: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Yashar'el according to their armies, when they set forward.

verses.raw: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses’ father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which Yahuah (LORD) said, I will give it you: come you with us, and we will do you good: for Yahuah (LORD) has spoken good concerning Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses’ father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which Yahuah said, I will give it you: come you with us, and we will do you good: for Yahuah has spoken good concerning Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my kindred.
verses.text: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my kindred.

verses.raw: And he said, Leave us not, I pray you; forasmuch as you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you may be to us instead of eyes.
verses.text: And he said, Leave us not, I pray you; forasmuch as you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you may be to us instead of eyes.

verses.raw: And it shall be, if you go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness Yahuah (LORD) shall do unto us, the same will we do unto you.
verses.text: And it shall be, if you go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness Yahuah shall do unto us, the same will we do unto you.

verses.raw: And they departed from the mount of Yahuah (LORD) three days’ journey: and the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) went before them in the three days’ journey, to search out a resting place for them.
verses.text: And they departed from the mount of Yahuah three days’ journey: and the ark of the covenant of Yahuah went before them in the three days’ journey, to search out a resting place for them.

verses.raw: And the cloud of Yahuah (LORD) was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.
verses.text: And the cloud of Yahuah was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, Yahuah (LORD), and let your enemies be scattered; and let them that hate you flee before you.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, Yahuah, and let your enemies be scattered; and let them that hate you flee before you.

verses.raw: And when it rested, he said, Return, O Yahuah (LORD), unto the many thousands of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And when it rested, he said, Return, O Yahuah, unto the many thousands of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And when the people complained, it displeased Yahuah (LORD): and Yahuah (LORD) heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of Yahuah (LORD) burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.
verses.text: And when the people complained, it displeased Yahuah: and Yahuah heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of Yahuah burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.

verses.raw: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto Yahuah (LORD), the fire was quenched.
verses.text: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto Yahuah, the fire was quenched.

verses.raw: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of Yahuah (LORD) burnt among them.
verses.text: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of Yahuah burnt among them.

verses.raw: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
verses.text: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Yashar'el also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?

verses.raw: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:
verses.text: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:

verses.raw: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.
verses.text: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.

verses.raw: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
verses.text: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.

verses.raw: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.
verses.text: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.

verses.raw: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
verses.text: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.

verses.raw: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.
verses.text: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of Yahuah was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.

verses.raw: And Moses said unto Yahuah (LORD), Wherefore have you afflicted your servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in your sight, that you layest the burden of all this people upon me?
verses.text: And Moses said unto Yahuah, Wherefore have you afflicted your servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in your sight, that you layest the burden of all this people upon me?

verses.raw: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that you should say unto me, Carry them in your bosom, as a nursing father bears the sucking child, unto the land which you swore unto their fathers?
verses.text: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that you should say unto me, Carry them in your bosom, as a nursing father bears the sucking child, unto the land which you swore unto their fathers?

verses.raw: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
verses.text: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.

verses.raw: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
verses.text: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

verses.raw: And if you deal thus with me, kill me, I pray you, out of hand, if I have found favour in your sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
verses.text: And if you deal thus with me, kill me, I pray you, out of hand, if I have found favour in your sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), whom you know to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with you.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Yashar'el, whom you know to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with you.

verses.raw: And I will come down and talk with you there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon you, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you bear it not thyself alone.
verses.text: And I will come down and talk with you there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon you, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you bear it not thyself alone.

verses.raw: And say you unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and you shall eat flesh: for you have wept in the ears of Yahuah (LORD), saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore Yahuah (LORD) will give you flesh, and you shall eat.
verses.text: And say you unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and you shall eat flesh: for you have wept in the ears of Yahuah, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore Yahuah will give you flesh, and you shall eat.

verses.raw: You shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;
verses.text: You shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;

verses.raw: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that you have despised Yahuah (LORD) which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
verses.text: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that you have despised Yahuah which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?

verses.raw: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and you have said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.
verses.text: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and you have said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.

verses.raw: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
verses.text: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Is the LORD’S hand waxed short? you shall see now whether my word shall come to pass unto you or not.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Is the LORD’S hand waxed short? you shall see now whether my word shall come to pass unto you or not.

verses.raw: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of Yahuah (LORD), and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.
verses.text: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of Yahuah, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.
verses.text: And Yahuah came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.

verses.raw: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.text: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.

verses.raw: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
verses.text: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.

verses.raw: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.
verses.text: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.

verses.raw: And Moses said unto him, Enviest you for my sake? would Elohim (God) that all the LORD’S people were prophets, and that Yahuah (LORD) would put his spirit upon them!
verses.text: And Moses said unto him, Enviest you for my sake? would Elohim that all the LORD’S people were prophets, and that Yahuah would put his spirit upon them!

verses.raw: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And there went forth a wind from Yahuah (LORD), and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day’s journey on this side, and as it were a day’s journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.
verses.text: And there went forth a wind from Yahuah, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day’s journey on this side, and as it were a day’s journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.

verses.raw: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
verses.text: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.

verses.raw: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of Yahuah (LORD) was kindled against the people, and Yahuah (LORD) smote the people with a very great plague.
verses.text: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of Yahuah was kindled against the people, and Yahuah smote the people with a very great plague.

verses.raw: And he called the name of that place Kibroth-hattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.
verses.text: And he called the name of that place Kibroth-hattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.

verses.raw: And the people journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.
verses.text: And the people journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.

verses.raw: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.
verses.text: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.

verses.raw: And they said, Has Yahuah (LORD) indeed spoken only by Moses? has he not spoken also by us? And Yahuah (LORD) heard it.
verses.text: And they said, Has Yahuah indeed spoken only by Moses? has he not spoken also by us? And Yahuah heard it.

verses.raw: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)
verses.text: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out you three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.
verses.text: And Yahuah spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out you three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.
verses.text: And Yahuah came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.

verses.raw: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I Yahuah (LORD) will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.
verses.text: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I Yahuah will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.

verses.raw: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all my house.
verses.text: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all my house.

verses.raw: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of Yahuah (LORD) shall he behold: wherefore then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?
verses.text: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of Yahuah shall he behold: wherefore then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?

verses.raw: And the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was kindled against them; and he departed.
verses.text: And the anger of Yahuah was kindled against them; and he departed.

verses.raw: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.
verses.text: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.

verses.raw: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech you, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.
verses.text: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech you, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.

verses.raw: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.
verses.text: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.

verses.raw: And Moses cried unto Yahuah (LORD), saying, Heal her now, O Elohim (God), I beseech you.
verses.text: And Moses cried unto Yahuah, saying, Heal her now, O Elohim, I beseech you.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.

verses.raw: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.
verses.text: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.

verses.raw: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.text: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Send you men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel): of every tribe of their fathers shall you send a man, every one a ruler among them.
verses.text: Send you men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Yashar'el: of every tribe of their fathers shall you send a man, every one a ruler among them.

verses.raw: And Moses by the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Moses by the commandment of Yahuah sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
verses.text: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

verses.raw: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
verses.text: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

verses.raw: Of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah), Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.text: Of the tribe of Yahudah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

verses.raw: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
verses.text: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

verses.raw: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.
verses.text: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.

verses.raw: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
verses.text: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

verses.raw: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
verses.text: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

verses.raw: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
verses.text: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

verses.raw: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
verses.text: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

verses.raw: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
verses.text: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

verses.raw: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
verses.text: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

verses.raw: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
verses.text: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

verses.raw: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.
verses.text: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.

verses.raw: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:
verses.text: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:

verses.raw: And see the land, what it is; and the people that dwells therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;
verses.text: And see the land, what it is; and the people that dwells therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;

verses.raw: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
verses.text: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;

verses.raw: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be you of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.
verses.text: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be you of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.

verses.raw: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.
verses.text: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.

verses.raw: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
verses.text: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

verses.raw: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
verses.text: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

verses.raw: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Yashar'el (Israel) cut down from thence.
verses.text: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Yashar'el cut down from thence.

verses.raw: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.
verses.text: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.

verses.raw: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.
verses.text: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.

verses.raw: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither you sentest us, and surely it flows with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.
verses.text: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither you sentest us, and surely it flows with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.

verses.raw: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
verses.text: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

verses.raw: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.
verses.text: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.

verses.raw: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
verses.text: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

verses.raw: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.
verses.text: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.

verses.raw: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eats up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.
verses.text: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Yashar'el, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eats up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.

verses.raw: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
verses.text: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.

verses.raw: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
verses.text: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

verses.raw: And all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would Elohim (God) that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would Elohim (God) we had died in this wilderness!
verses.text: And all the children of Yashar'el murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would Elohim that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would Elohim we had died in this wilderness!

verses.raw: And wherefore has Yahuah (LORD) brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
verses.text: And wherefore has Yahuah brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?

verses.raw: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.
verses.text: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.

verses.raw: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:
verses.text: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:

verses.raw: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.
verses.text: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Yashar'el, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.

verses.raw: If Yahuah (LORD) delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which flows with milk and honey.
verses.text: If Yahuah delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which flows with milk and honey.

verses.raw: Only rebel not you against Yahuah (LORD), neither fear you the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and Yahuah (LORD) is with us: fear them not.
verses.text: Only rebel not you against Yahuah, neither fear you the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and Yahuah is with us: fear them not.

verses.raw: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of Yahuah (LORD) appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of Yahuah appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?

verses.raw: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a greater nation and mightier than they.
verses.text: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a greater nation and mightier than they.

verses.raw: And Moses said unto Yahuah (LORD), Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for you brought up this people in your might from among them;)
verses.text: And Moses said unto Yahuah, Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for you brought up this people in your might from among them;)

verses.raw: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that you Yahuah (LORD) are among this people, that you Yahuah (LORD) are seen face to face, and that your cloud stands over them, and that you go before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.text: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that you Yahuah are among this people, that you Yahuah are seen face to face, and that your cloud stands over them, and that you go before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.

verses.raw: Now if you shall kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,
verses.text: Now if you shall kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,

verses.raw: Because Yahuah (LORD) was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.
verses.text: Because Yahuah was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.

verses.raw: And now, I beseech you, let the power of my Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,
verses.text: And now, I beseech you, let the power of my Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
verses.text: Yahuah is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.

verses.raw: Pardon, I beseech you, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of your mercy, and as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.
verses.text: Pardon, I beseech you, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of your mercy, and as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said, I have pardoned according to your word:
verses.text: And Yahuah said, I have pardoned according to your word:

verses.raw: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;
verses.text: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;

verses.raw: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:
verses.text: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:

verses.raw: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
verses.text: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.

verses.raw: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.text: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

verses.raw: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which they murmur against me.
verses.text: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Yashar'el, which they murmur against me.

verses.raw: Say unto them, As truly as I live, says Yahuah (LORD), as you have spoken in my ears, so will I do to you:
verses.text: Say unto them, As truly as I live, says Yahuah, as you have spoken in my ears, so will I do to you:

verses.raw: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,
verses.text: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,

verses.raw: Doubtless you shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.text: Doubtless you shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.raw: But your little ones, which you said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which you have despised.
verses.text: But your little ones, which you said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which you have despised.

verses.raw: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.
verses.text: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.

verses.raw: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.
verses.text: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.

verses.raw: After the number of the days in which you searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall you bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you shall know my breach of promise.
verses.text: After the number of the days in which you searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall you bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you shall know my breach of promise.

verses.raw: I Yahuah (LORD) have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
verses.text: I Yahuah have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.

verses.raw: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,
verses.text: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,

verses.raw: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before Yahuah.

verses.raw: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.
verses.text: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.

verses.raw: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Yashar'el (Israel): and the people mourned greatly.
verses.text: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Yashar'el: and the people mourned greatly.

verses.raw: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which Yahuah (LORD) has promised: for we have sinned.
verses.text: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which Yahuah has promised: for we have sinned.

verses.raw: And Moses said, Wherefore now do you transgress the commandment of Yahuah (LORD)? but it shall not prosper.
verses.text: And Moses said, Wherefore now do you transgress the commandment of Yahuah? but it shall not prosper.

verses.raw: Go not up, for Yahuah (LORD) is not among you; that you be not smitten before your enemies.
verses.text: Go not up, for Yahuah is not among you; that you be not smitten before your enemies.

verses.raw: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and you shall fall by the sword: because you are turned away from Yahuah (LORD), therefore Yahuah (LORD) will not be with you.
verses.text: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and you shall fall by the sword: because you are turned away from Yahuah, therefore Yahuah will not be with you.

verses.raw: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD), and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
verses.text: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of Yahuah, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.

verses.raw: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.
verses.text: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, When you be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el, and say unto them, When you be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,

verses.raw: And will make an offering by fire unto Yahuah (LORD), a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD), of the herd, or of the flock:
verses.text: And will make an offering by fire unto Yahuah, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto Yahuah, of the herd, or of the flock:

verses.raw: Then shall he that offers his offering unto Yahuah (LORD) bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.
verses.text: Then shall he that offers his offering unto Yahuah bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.

verses.raw: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shall you prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.
verses.text: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shall you prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.

verses.raw: Or for a ram, you shall prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.
verses.text: Or for a ram, you shall prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.

verses.raw: And for a drink offering you shall offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And for a drink offering you shall offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And when you preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: And when you preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto Yahuah:

verses.raw: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.
verses.text: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.

verses.raw: And you shall bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And you shall bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.
verses.text: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.

verses.raw: According to the number that you shall prepare, so shall you do to every one according to their number.
verses.text: According to the number that you shall prepare, so shall you do to every one according to their number.

verses.raw: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD); as you do, so he shall do.
verses.text: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto Yahuah; as you do, so he shall do.

verses.raw: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourns with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as you are, so shall the stranger be before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourns with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as you are, so shall the stranger be before Yahuah.

verses.raw: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourns with you.
verses.text: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourns with you.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, When you come into the land whither I bring you,
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el, and say unto them, When you come into the land whither I bring you,

verses.raw: Then it shall be, that, when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up an heave offering unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Then it shall be, that, when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up an heave offering unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: You shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as you do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall you heave it.
verses.text: You shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as you do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall you heave it.

verses.raw: Of the first of your dough you shall give unto Yahuah (LORD) an heave offering in your generations.
verses.text: Of the first of your dough you shall give unto Yahuah an heave offering in your generations.

verses.raw: And if you have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which Yahuah (LORD) has spoken unto Moses,
verses.text: And if you have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which Yahuah has spoken unto Moses,

verses.raw: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD), with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.

verses.raw: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD), and their sin offering before Yahuah (LORD), for their ignorance:

verses.text: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el, and the stranger that sojourns among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.

verses.raw: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.
verses.text: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.

verses.raw: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sins ignorantly, when he sins by ignorance before Yahuah (LORD), to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.

verses.raw: You shall have one law for him that sins through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and for the stranger that sojourns among them.

verses.raw: But the soul that does ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth Yahuah (LORD); and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.text: But the soul that does ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth Yahuah; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.raw: Because he has despised the word of Yahuah (LORD), and has broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.

verses.raw: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.

verses.raw: That you may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your Elohim (God).

verses.raw: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your Elohim (God): I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: I am Yahuah Elohaychem, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your Elohim: I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, You take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and Yahuah (LORD) is among them: wherefore then lift you up yourselves above the congregation of Yahuah (LORD)?

verses.raw: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:
verses.text: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:

verses.raw: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow Yahuah (LORD) will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he has chosen will he cause to come near unto him.
verses.text: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow Yahuah will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he has chosen will he cause to come near unto him.

verses.raw: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before Yahuah (LORD) to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom Yahuah (LORD) does choose, he shall be holy: you take too much upon you, you sons of Levi.
verses.text: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before Yahuah to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom Yahuah does choose, he shall be holy: you take too much upon you, you sons of Levi.

verses.raw: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, you sons of Levi:
verses.text: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, you sons of Levi:

verses.raw: Seems it but a small thing unto you, that the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) has separated you from the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel), to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of Yahuah (LORD), and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?
verses.text: Seems it but a small thing unto you, that the Elohim of Yashar'el has separated you from the congregation of Yashar'el, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of Yahuah, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?

verses.raw: And he has brought you near to him, and all your brethren the sons of Levi with you: and seek you the priesthood also?
verses.text: And he has brought you near to him, and all your brethren the sons of Levi with you: and seek you the priesthood also?

verses.raw: For which cause both you and all your company are gathered together against Yahuah (LORD): and what is Aaron, that you murmur against him?
verses.text: For which cause both you and all your company are gathered together against Yahuah: and what is Aaron, that you murmur against him?

verses.raw: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:
verses.text: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:

verses.raw: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land that flows with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except you make thyself altogether a prince over us?
verses.text: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land that flows with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except you make thyself altogether a prince over us?

verses.raw: Moreover you have not brought us into a land that flows with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: will you put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
verses.text: Moreover you have not brought us into a land that flows with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: will you put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.

verses.raw: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto Yahuah (LORD), Respect not you their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.
verses.text: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto Yahuah, Respect not you their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.

verses.raw: And Moses said unto Korah, Be you and all your company before Yahuah (LORD), you, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:
verses.text: And Moses said unto Korah, Be you and all your company before Yahuah, you, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:

verses.raw: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring you before Yahuah (LORD) every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.
verses.text: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring you before Yahuah every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.

verses.raw: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.
verses.text: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.

verses.raw: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto all the congregation.
verses.text: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of Yahuah appeared unto all the congregation.

verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

verses.raw: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.
verses.text: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.

verses.raw: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O Elohim (God), the Elohim (God) of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be wroth with all the congregation?
verses.text: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O Elohim, the Elohim of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be wroth with all the congregation?

verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
verses.text: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

verses.text: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Yashar'el followed him.

verses.raw: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins.
verses.text: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins.

verses.raw: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.

verses.raw: And Moses said, Hereby you shall know that Yahuah (LORD) has sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of my own mind.
verses.text: And Moses said, Hereby you shall know that Yahuah has sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of my own mind.

verses.raw: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then Yahuah (LORD) has not sent me.
verses.text: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then Yahuah has not sent me.

verses.raw: But if Yahuah (LORD) make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then you shall understand that these men have provoked Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But if Yahuah make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then you shall understand that these men have provoked Yahuah.

verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter you the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.
verses.text: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter you the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.

verses.text: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before Yahuah, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Yashar'el.

verses.text: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of Yahuah appeared.

verses.raw: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.

verses.raw: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from Yahuah (LORD); the plague is begun.

verses.text: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.

verses.raw: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write you every man’s name upon his rod.
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write you every man’s name upon his rod.
