verses.raw: You shall not be afraid of them: but shall well remember what Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;
verses.text: You shall not be afraid of them: but shall well remember what Yahuah Elohayka did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;

verses.raw: The great temptations which your eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) brought you out: so shall Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) do unto all the people of whom you are afraid.
verses.text: The great temptations which your eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby Yahuah Elohayka brought you out: so shall Yahuah Elohayka do unto all the people of whom you are afraid.

verses.raw: Moreover Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from you, be destroyed.
verses.text: Moreover Yahuah Elohayka will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from you, be destroyed.

verses.raw: You shall not be affrighted at them: for Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) is among you, a mighty Elohim (God) and terrible.
verses.text: You shall not be affrighted at them: for Yahuah Elohayka is among you, a mighty Elohim and terrible.

verses.raw: And Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will put out those nations before you by little and little: you may not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon you.
verses.text: And Yahuah Elohayka will put out those nations before you by little and little: you may not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon you.

verses.raw: But Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall deliver them unto you, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.
verses.text: But Yahuah Elohayka shall deliver them unto you, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.

verses.raw: And he shall deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before you, until you have destroyed them.
verses.text: And he shall deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before you, until you have destroyed them.

verses.raw: The graven images of their gods shall you burn with fire: you shall not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto you, lest you be snared therein: for it is an abomination to Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God).
verses.text: The graven images of their gods shall you burn with fire: you shall not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto you, lest you be snared therein: for it is an abomination to Yahuah Elohayka.

verses.raw: Neither shall you bring an abomination into your house, lest you be a cursed thing like it: but you shall utterly detest it, and you shall utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.
verses.text: Neither shall you bring an abomination into your house, lest you be a cursed thing like it: but you shall utterly detest it, and you shall utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.

verses.raw: All the commandments which I command you this day shall you observe to do, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto your fathers.
verses.text: All the commandments which I command you this day shall you observe to do, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which Yahuah sware unto your fathers.

verses.raw: And you shall remember all the way which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) led you these forty years in the wilderness, to humble you, and to prove you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments, or no.
verses.text: And you shall remember all the way which Yahuah Elohayka led you these forty years in the wilderness, to humble you, and to prove you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments, or no.

verses.raw: And he humbled you, and suffered you to hunger, and fed you with manna, which you knew not, neither did your fathers know; that he might make you know that man does not live by bread only, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of Yahuah (LORD) does man live.
verses.text: And he humbled you, and suffered you to hunger, and fed you with manna, which you knew not, neither did your fathers know; that he might make you know that man does not live by bread only, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of Yahuah does man live.

verses.raw: Your raiment waxed not old upon you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.
verses.text: Your raiment waxed not old upon you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.

verses.raw: You shall also consider in your heart, that, as a man chastens his son, so Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) chastens you.
verses.text: You shall also consider in your heart, that, as a man chastens his son, so Yahuah Elohayka chastens you.

verses.raw: Therefore you shall keep the commandments of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
verses.text: Therefore you shall keep the commandments of Yahuah Elohayka, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

verses.raw: For Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;
verses.text: For Yahuah Elohayka brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;

verses.raw: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;
verses.text: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;

verses.raw: A land wherein you shall eat bread without scarceness, you shall not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig brass.
verses.text: A land wherein you shall eat bread without scarceness, you shall not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig brass.

verses.raw: When you have eaten and are full, then you shall bless Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) for the good land which he has given you.
verses.text: When you have eaten and are full, then you shall bless Yahuah Elohayka for the good land which he has given you.

verses.raw: Beware that you forget not Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command you this day:
verses.text: Beware that you forget not Yahuah Elohayka, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command you this day:

verses.raw: Lest when you have eaten and are full, and have built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;
verses.text: Lest when you have eaten and are full, and have built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;

verses.raw: And when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;
verses.text: And when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;

verses.raw: Then your heart be lifted up, and you forget Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;
verses.text: Then your heart be lifted up, and you forget Yahuah Elohayka, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;

verses.raw: Who led you through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought you forth water out of the rock of flint;
verses.text: Who led you through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought you forth water out of the rock of flint;

verses.raw: Who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers knew not, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;
verses.text: Who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers knew not, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;

verses.raw: And you say in your heart, My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.
verses.text: And you say in your heart, My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.

verses.raw: But you shall remember Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): for it is he that gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto your fathers, as it is this day.
verses.text: But you shall remember Yahuah Elohayka: for it is he that gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto your fathers, as it is this day.

verses.raw: And it shall be, if you do at all forget Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that you shall surely perish.
verses.text: And it shall be, if you do at all forget Yahuah Elohayka, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that you shall surely perish.

verses.raw: As the nations which Yahuah (LORD) destroys before your face, so shall you perish; because you would not be obedient unto the voice of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: As the nations which Yahuah destroys before your face, so shall you perish; because you would not be obedient unto the voice of Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: Hear, O Yashar'el (Israel): You are to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,
verses.text: Hear, O Yashar'el: You are to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,

verses.raw: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, Who can stand before the children of Anak!
verses.text: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, Who can stand before the children of Anak!

verses.raw: Understand therefore this day, that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) is he which goes over before you; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before your face: so shall you drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as Yahuah (LORD) has said unto you.
verses.text: Understand therefore this day, that Yahuah Elohayka is he which goes over before you; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before your face: so shall you drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as Yahuah has said unto you.

verses.raw: Speak not you in your heart, after that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has cast them out from before you, saying, For my righteousness Yahuah (LORD) has brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations Yahuah (LORD) does drive them out from before you.
verses.text: Speak not you in your heart, after that Yahuah Elohayka has cast them out from before you, saying, For my righteousness Yahuah has brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations Yahuah does drive them out from before you.

verses.raw: Not for your righteousness, or for the uprightness of your heart, do you go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) does drive them out from before you, and that he may perform the word which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.text: Not for your righteousness, or for the uprightness of your heart, do you go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations Yahuah Elohayka does drive them out from before you, and that he may perform the word which Yahuah sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

verses.raw: Understand therefore, that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gives you not this good land to possess it for your righteousness; for you are a stiffnecked people.
verses.text: Understand therefore, that Yahuah Elohayka gives you not this good land to possess it for your righteousness; for you are a stiffnecked people.

verses.raw: Remember, and forget not, how you provokedst Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that you did depart out of the land of Egypt, until you came unto this place, you have been rebellious against Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Remember, and forget not, how you provokedst Yahuah Elohayka to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that you did depart out of the land of Egypt, until you came unto this place, you have been rebellious against Yahuah.

verses.raw: Also in Horeb you provoked Yahuah (LORD) to wrath, so that Yahuah (LORD) was angry with you to have destroyed you.
verses.text: Also in Horeb you provoked Yahuah to wrath, so that Yahuah was angry with you to have destroyed you.

verses.raw: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which Yahuah (LORD) made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:
verses.text: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which Yahuah made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of Elohim (God); and on them was written according to all the words, which Yahuah (LORD) spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.
verses.text: And Yahuah delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of Elohim; and on them was written according to all the words, which Yahuah spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.

verses.raw: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that Yahuah (LORD) gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.
verses.text: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that Yahuah gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Arise, get you down quickly from hence; for your people which you have brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto me, Arise, get you down quickly from hence; for your people which you have brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.

verses.raw: Furthermore Yahuah (LORD) spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
verses.text: Furthermore Yahuah spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:

verses.raw: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.
verses.text: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.

verses.raw: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.
verses.text: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.

verses.raw: And I looked, and, behold, you had sinned against Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and had made you a molten calf: you had turned aside quickly out of the way which Yahuah (LORD) had commanded you.
verses.text: And I looked, and, behold, you had sinned against Yahuah Elohaychem, and had made you a molten calf: you had turned aside quickly out of the way which Yahuah had commanded you.

verses.raw: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.
verses.text: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.

verses.raw: And I fell down before Yahuah (LORD), as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which you sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), to provoke him to anger.
verses.text: And I fell down before Yahuah, as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which you sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of Yahuah, to provoke him to anger.

verses.raw: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith Yahuah (LORD) was wroth against you to destroy you. But Yahuah (LORD) hearkened unto me at that time also.
verses.text: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith Yahuah was wroth against you to destroy you. But Yahuah hearkened unto me at that time also.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.
verses.text: And Yahuah was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.

verses.raw: And I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, and ground it very small, even until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.
verses.text: And I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, and ground it very small, even until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.

verses.raw: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah, you provoked Yahuah (LORD) to wrath.
verses.text: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah, you provoked Yahuah to wrath.

verses.raw: Likewise when Yahuah (LORD) sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then you rebelled against the commandment of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and you believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.
verses.text: Likewise when Yahuah sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then you rebelled against the commandment of Yahuah Elohaychem, and you believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.

verses.raw: You have been rebellious against Yahuah (LORD) from the day that I knew you.
verses.text: You have been rebellious against Yahuah from the day that I knew you.

verses.raw: Thus I fell down before Yahuah (LORD) forty days and forty nights, as I fell down at the first; because Yahuah (LORD) had said he would destroy you.
verses.text: Thus I fell down before Yahuah forty days and forty nights, as I fell down at the first; because Yahuah had said he would destroy you.

verses.raw: I prayed therefore unto Yahuah (LORD), and said, O Adonai (Lord) GOD, destroy not your people and your inheritance, which you have redeemed through your greatness, which you have brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.text: I prayed therefore unto Yahuah, and said, O Adonai GOD, destroy not your people and your inheritance, which you have redeemed through your greatness, which you have brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

verses.raw: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:
verses.text: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:

verses.raw: Lest the land whence you brought us out say, Because Yahuah (LORD) was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he has brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.
verses.text: Lest the land whence you brought us out say, Because Yahuah was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he has brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.

verses.raw: Yet they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out by your mighty power and by your stretched out arm.
verses.text: Yet they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out by your mighty power and by your stretched out arm.

verses.raw: At that time Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Hew you two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make you an ark of wood.
verses.text: At that time Yahuah said unto me, Hew you two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make you an ark of wood.

verses.raw: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which you brakest, and you shall put them in the ark.
verses.text: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which you brakest, and you shall put them in the ark.

verses.raw: And I made an ark of shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in my hand.
verses.text: And I made an ark of shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in my hand.

verses.raw: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which Yahuah (LORD) spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and Yahuah (LORD) gave them unto me.
verses.text: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which Yahuah spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and Yahuah gave them unto me.

verses.raw: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as Yahuah (LORD) commanded me.
verses.text: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as Yahuah commanded me.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his stead.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his stead.

verses.raw: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.
verses.text: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.

verses.raw: At that time Yahuah (LORD) separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD), to stand before Yahuah (LORD) to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.
verses.text: At that time Yahuah separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of Yahuah, to stand before Yahuah to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.

verses.raw: Wherefore Levi has no part nor inheritance with his brethren; Yahuah (LORD) is his inheritance, according as Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) promised him.
verses.text: Wherefore Levi has no part nor inheritance with his brethren; Yahuah is his inheritance, according as Yahuah Elohayka promised him.

verses.raw: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and Yahuah (LORD) hearkened unto me at that time also, and Yahuah (LORD) would not destroy you.
verses.text: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and Yahuah hearkened unto me at that time also, and Yahuah would not destroy you.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Arise, take your journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto me, Arise, take your journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.

verses.raw: And now, Yashar'el (Israel), what does Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) require of you, but to fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.text: And now, Yashar'el, what does Yahuah Elohayka require of you, but to fear Yahuah Elohayka, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve Yahuah Elohayka with all your heart and with all your soul,

verses.raw: To keep the commandments of Yahuah (LORD), and his statutes, which I command you this day for your good?
verses.text: To keep the commandments of Yahuah, and his statutes, which I command you this day for your good?

verses.raw: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the LORD’S your Elohim (God), the earth also, with all that therein is.
verses.text: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the LORD’S your Elohim, the earth also, with all that therein is.

verses.raw: Only Yahuah (LORD) had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all people, as it is this day.
verses.text: Only Yahuah had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all people, as it is this day.

verses.raw: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.
verses.text: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.

verses.raw: For Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) is Elohim (God) of gods, and Adonai (Lord) of lords, a great Elohim (God), a mighty, and a terrible, which regards not persons, nor takes reward:
verses.text: For Yahuah Elohaychem is Elohim of gods, and Adonai of lords, a great Elohim, a mighty, and a terrible, which regards not persons, nor takes reward:

verses.raw: He does execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loves the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.
verses.text: He does execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loves the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.

verses.raw: Love you therefore the stranger: for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.text: Love you therefore the stranger: for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: You shall fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God); him shall you serve, and to him shall you cleave, and swear by his name.
verses.text: You shall fear Yahuah Elohayka; him shall you serve, and to him shall you cleave, and swear by his name.

verses.raw: He is your praise, and he is your Elohim (God), that has done for you these great and terrible things, which your eyes have seen.
verses.text: He is your praise, and he is your Elohim, that has done for you these great and terrible things, which your eyes have seen.

verses.raw: Your fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has made you as the stars of heaven for multitude.
verses.text: Your fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now Yahuah Elohayka has made you as the stars of heaven for multitude.

verses.raw: Therefore you shall love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, alway.
verses.text: Therefore you shall love Yahuah Elohayka, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, alway.

verses.raw: And know you this day: for I speak not with your children which have not known, and which have not seen the chastisement of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), his greatness, his mighty hand, and his stretched out arm,
verses.text: And know you this day: for I speak not with your children which have not known, and which have not seen the chastisement of Yahuah Elohaychem, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his stretched out arm,

verses.raw: And his miracles, and his acts, which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and unto all his land;
verses.text: And his miracles, and his acts, which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and unto all his land;

verses.raw: And what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and how Yahuah (LORD) has destroyed them unto this day;
verses.text: And what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and how Yahuah has destroyed them unto this day;

verses.raw: And what he did unto you in the wilderness, until you came into this place;
verses.text: And what he did unto you in the wilderness, until you came into this place;

verses.raw: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance that was in their possession, in the midst of all Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance that was in their possession, in the midst of all Yashar'el:

verses.raw: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of Yahuah (LORD) which he did.
verses.text: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of Yahuah which he did.

verses.raw: Therefore shall you keep all the commandments which I command you this day, that you may be strong, and go in and possess the land, whither you go to possess it;
verses.text: Therefore shall you keep all the commandments which I command you this day, that you may be strong, and go in and possess the land, whither you go to possess it;

verses.raw: And that you may prolong your days in the land, which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed, a land that flows with milk and honey.
verses.text: And that you may prolong your days in the land, which Yahuah sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed, a land that flows with milk and honey.

verses.raw: For the land, whither you go in to possess it, is not as the land of Egypt, from whence you came out, where you sowedst your seed, and wateredst it with your foot, as a garden of herbs:
verses.text: For the land, whither you go in to possess it, is not as the land of Egypt, from whence you came out, where you sowedst your seed, and wateredst it with your foot, as a garden of herbs:

verses.raw: But the land, whither you go to possess it, is a land of hills and valleys, and drinks water of the rain of heaven:
verses.text: But the land, whither you go to possess it, is a land of hills and valleys, and drinks water of the rain of heaven:

verses.raw: A land which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) careth for: the eyes of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.
verses.text: A land which Yahuah Elohayka careth for: the eyes of Yahuah Elohayka are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, if you shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, if you shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love Yahuah Elohaychem, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

verses.raw: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your corn, and your wine, and your oil.
verses.text: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your corn, and your wine, and your oil.

verses.raw: And I will send grass in your fields for your cattle, that you may eat and be full.
verses.text: And I will send grass in your fields for your cattle, that you may eat and be full.

verses.raw: Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and you turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;
verses.text: Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and you turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;

verses.raw: And then the LORD’S wrath be kindled against you, and he shut up the heaven, that there be no rain, and that the land yield not her fruit; and lest you perish quickly from off the good land which Yahuah (LORD) gives you.
verses.text: And then the LORD’S wrath be kindled against you, and he shut up the heaven, that there be no rain, and that the land yield not her fruit; and lest you perish quickly from off the good land which Yahuah gives you.

verses.raw: Therefore shall you lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.
verses.text: Therefore shall you lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.

verses.raw: And you shall teach them your children, speaking of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you risest up.
verses.text: And you shall teach them your children, speaking of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you risest up.

verses.raw: And you shall write them upon the door posts of your house, and upon your gates:
verses.text: And you shall write them upon the door posts of your house, and upon your gates:

verses.raw: That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.
verses.text: That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which Yahuah sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.

verses.raw: For if you shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you, to do them, to love Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), to walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him;
verses.text: For if you shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you, to do them, to love Yahuah Elohaychem, to walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him;

verses.raw: Then will Yahuah (LORD) drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.
verses.text: Then will Yahuah drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.

verses.raw: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be.
verses.text: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be.

verses.raw: There shall no man be able to stand before you: for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that you shall tread upon, as he has said unto you.
verses.text: There shall no man be able to stand before you: for Yahuah Elohaychem shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that you shall tread upon, as he has said unto you.

verses.raw: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse;
verses.text: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse;

verses.raw: A blessing, if you obey the commandments of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), which I command you this day:
verses.text: A blessing, if you obey the commandments of Yahuah Elohaychem, which I command you this day:

verses.raw: And a curse, if you will not obey the commandments of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which you have not known.
verses.text: And a curse, if you will not obey the commandments of Yahuah Elohaychem, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which you have not known.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, when Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has brought you in unto the land whither you go to possess it, that you shall put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, when Yahuah Elohayka has brought you in unto the land whither you go to possess it, that you shall put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.

verses.raw: Are they not on the other side Jordan, by the way where the sun goes down, in the land of the Canaanites, which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh?
verses.text: Are they not on the other side Jordan, by the way where the sun goes down, in the land of the Canaanites, which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh?

verses.raw: For you shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) gives you, and you shall possess it, and dwell therein.
verses.text: For you shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which Yahuah Elohaychem gives you, and you shall possess it, and dwell therein.

verses.raw: And you shall observe to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you this day.
verses.text: And you shall observe to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you this day.

verses.raw: These are the statutes and judgments, which you shall observe to do in the land, which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of your fathers gives you to possess it, all the days that you live upon the earth.
verses.text: These are the statutes and judgments, which you shall observe to do in the land, which Yahuah Elohim of your fathers gives you to possess it, all the days that you live upon the earth.

verses.raw: You shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which you shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:
verses.text: You shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which you shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:

verses.raw: And you shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and you shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place.
verses.text: And you shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and you shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place.

verses.raw: You shall not do so unto Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: You shall not do so unto Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: But unto the place which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there, even unto his habitation shall you seek, and thither you shall come:
verses.text: But unto the place which Yahuah Elohaychem shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there, even unto his habitation shall you seek, and thither you shall come:

verses.raw: And thither you shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:
verses.text: And thither you shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:

verses.raw: And there you shall eat before Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and you shall rejoice in all that you put your hand unto, you and your households, wherein Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has blessed you.
verses.text: And there you shall eat before Yahuah Elohaychem, and you shall rejoice in all that you put your hand unto, you and your households, wherein Yahuah Elohayka has blessed you.

verses.raw: You shall not do after all the things that we do here this day, every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes.
verses.text: You shall not do after all the things that we do here this day, every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes.

verses.raw: For you are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) gives you.
verses.text: For you are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which Yahuah Elohaychem gives you.

verses.raw: But when you go over Jordan, and dwell in the land which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) gives you to inherit, and when he gives you rest from all your enemies round about, so that you dwell in safety;
verses.text: But when you go over Jordan, and dwell in the land which Yahuah Elohaychem gives you to inherit, and when he gives you rest from all your enemies round about, so that you dwell in safety;

verses.raw: Then there shall be a place which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) shall choose to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall you bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which you vow unto Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: Then there shall be a place which Yahuah Elohaychem shall choose to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall you bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which you vow unto Yahuah:

verses.raw: And you shall rejoice before Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), you, and your sons, and your daughters, and your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite that is within your gates; forasmuch as he has no part nor inheritance with you.
verses.text: And you shall rejoice before Yahuah Elohaychem, you, and your sons, and your daughters, and your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite that is within your gates; forasmuch as he has no part nor inheritance with you.

verses.raw: Take heed to thyself that you offer not your burnt offerings in every place that you see:
verses.text: Take heed to thyself that you offer not your burnt offerings in every place that you see:

verses.raw: But in the place which Yahuah (LORD) shall choose in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.
verses.text: But in the place which Yahuah shall choose in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding you may kill and eat flesh in all your gates, whatsoever your soul lusteth after, according to the blessing of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) which he has given you: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the roebuck, and as of the hart.
verses.text: Notwithstanding you may kill and eat flesh in all your gates, whatsoever your soul lusteth after, according to the blessing of Yahuah Elohayka which he has given you: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the roebuck, and as of the hart.

verses.raw: Only you shall not eat the blood; you shall pour it upon the earth as water.
verses.text: Only you shall not eat the blood; you shall pour it upon the earth as water.

verses.raw: You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your corn, or of your wine, or of your oil, or the firstlings of your herds or of your flock, nor any of your vows which you vowest, nor your freewill offerings, or heave offering of your hand:
verses.text: You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your corn, or of your wine, or of your oil, or the firstlings of your herds or of your flock, nor any of your vows which you vowest, nor your freewill offerings, or heave offering of your hand:

verses.raw: But you must eat them before Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) in the place which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall choose, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your manservant, and your maidservant, and the Levite that is within your gates: and you shall rejoice before Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) in all that you put your hands unto.
verses.text: But you must eat them before Yahuah Elohayka in the place which Yahuah Elohayka shall choose, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your manservant, and your maidservant, and the Levite that is within your gates: and you shall rejoice before Yahuah Elohayka in all that you put your hands unto.

verses.raw: Take heed to thyself that you forsake not the Levite as long as you livest upon the earth.
verses.text: Take heed to thyself that you forsake not the Levite as long as you livest upon the earth.

verses.raw: When Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall enlarge your border, as he has promised you, and you shall say, I will eat flesh, because your soul longeth to eat flesh; you may eat flesh, whatsoever your soul lusteth after.
verses.text: When Yahuah Elohayka shall enlarge your border, as he has promised you, and you shall say, I will eat flesh, because your soul longeth to eat flesh; you may eat flesh, whatsoever your soul lusteth after.

verses.raw: If the place which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has chosen to put his name there be too far from you, then you shall kill of your herd and of your flock, which Yahuah (LORD) has given you, as I have commanded you, and you shall eat in your gates whatsoever your soul lusteth after.
verses.text: If the place which Yahuah Elohayka has chosen to put his name there be too far from you, then you shall kill of your herd and of your flock, which Yahuah has given you, as I have commanded you, and you shall eat in your gates whatsoever your soul lusteth after.

verses.raw: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so you shall eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike.
verses.text: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so you shall eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike.

verses.raw: Only be sure that you eat not the blood: for the blood is the life; and you may not eat the life with the flesh.
verses.text: Only be sure that you eat not the blood: for the blood is the life; and you may not eat the life with the flesh.

verses.raw: You shall not eat it; you shall pour it upon the earth as water.
verses.text: You shall not eat it; you shall pour it upon the earth as water.

verses.raw: You shall not eat it; that it may go well with you, and with your children after you, when you shall do that which is right in the sight of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: You shall not eat it; that it may go well with you, and with your children after you, when you shall do that which is right in the sight of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Only your holy things which you have, and your vows, you shall take, and go unto the place which Yahuah (LORD) shall choose:
verses.text: Only your holy things which you have, and your vows, you shall take, and go unto the place which Yahuah shall choose:

verses.raw: And you shall offer your burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): and the blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and you shall eat the flesh.
verses.text: And you shall offer your burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of Yahuah Elohayka: and the blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of Yahuah Elohayka, and you shall eat the flesh.

verses.raw: Observe and hear all these words which I command you, that it may go well with you, and with your children after you for ever, when you do that which is good and right in the sight of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God).
verses.text: Observe and hear all these words which I command you, that it may go well with you, and with your children after you for ever, when you do that which is good and right in the sight of Yahuah Elohayka.

verses.raw: When Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall cut off the nations from before you, whither you go to possess them, and you succeedest them, and dwell in their land;
verses.text: When Yahuah Elohayka shall cut off the nations from before you, whither you go to possess them, and you succeedest them, and dwell in their land;

verses.raw: Take heed to thyself that you be not snared by following them, after that they be destroyed from before you; and that you enquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.
verses.text: Take heed to thyself that you be not snared by following them, after that they be destroyed from before you; and that you enquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.

verses.raw: You shall not do so unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): for every abomination to Yahuah (LORD), which he hates, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.
verses.text: You shall not do so unto Yahuah Elohayka: for every abomination to Yahuah, which he hates, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.

verses.raw: What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: you shall not add thereto, nor diminish from it.
verses.text: What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: you shall not add thereto, nor diminish from it.

verses.raw: If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and gives you a sign or a wonder,
verses.text: If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and gives you a sign or a wonder,

verses.raw: And the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spake unto you, saying, Let us go after other gods, which you have not known, and let us serve them;
verses.text: And the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spake unto you, saying, Let us go after other gods, which you have not known, and let us serve them;

verses.raw: You shall not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) proves you, to know whether you love Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.text: You shall not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for Yahuah Elohaychem proves you, to know whether you love Yahuah Elohaychem with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.raw: You shall walk after Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and you shall serve him, and cleave unto him.
verses.text: You shall walk after Yahuah Elohaychem, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and you shall serve him, and cleave unto him.

verses.raw: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he has spoken to turn you away from Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), which brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to thrust you out of the way which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) commanded you to walk in. So shall you put the evil away from the midst of you.
verses.text: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he has spoken to turn you away from Yahuah Elohaychem, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to thrust you out of the way which Yahuah Elohayka commanded you to walk in. So shall you put the evil away from the midst of you.

verses.raw: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend, which is as your own soul, entice you secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which you have not known, you, nor your fathers;
verses.text: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend, which is as your own soul, entice you secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which you have not known, you, nor your fathers;

verses.raw: Namely, of the gods of the people which are round about you, nigh unto you, or far off from you, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth;
verses.text: Namely, of the gods of the people which are round about you, nigh unto you, or far off from you, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth;

verses.raw: You shall not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall your eye pity him, neither shall you spare, neither shall you conceal him:
verses.text: You shall not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall your eye pity him, neither shall you spare, neither shall you conceal him:

verses.raw: But you shall surely kill him; your hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.
verses.text: But you shall surely kill him; your hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.

verses.raw: And you shall stone him with stones, that he die; because he has sought to thrust you away from Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), which brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.text: And you shall stone him with stones, that he die; because he has sought to thrust you away from Yahuah Elohayka, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

verses.raw: And all Yashar'el (Israel) shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you.
verses.text: And all Yashar'el shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you.

verses.raw: If you shall hear say in one of your cities, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has given you to dwell there, saying,
verses.text: If you shall hear say in one of your cities, which Yahuah Elohayka has given you to dwell there, saying,

verses.raw: Certain men, the children of Belial, are gone out from among you, and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which you have not known;
verses.text: Certain men, the children of Belial, are gone out from among you, and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which you have not known;

verses.raw: Then shall you enquire, and make search, and ask diligently; and, behold, if it be truth, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought among you;
verses.text: Then shall you enquire, and make search, and ask diligently; and, behold, if it be truth, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought among you;

verses.raw: You shall surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, and all that is therein, and the cattle thereof, with the edge of the sword.
verses.text: You shall surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, and all that is therein, and the cattle thereof, with the edge of the sword.

verses.raw: And you shall gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof, and shall burn with fire the city, and all the spoil thereof every whit, for Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): and it shall be an heap for ever; it shall not be built again.
verses.text: And you shall gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof, and shall burn with fire the city, and all the spoil thereof every whit, for Yahuah Elohayka: and it shall be an heap for ever; it shall not be built again.

verses.raw: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to your hand: that Yahuah (LORD) may turn from the fierceness of his anger, and shew you mercy, and have compassion upon you, and multiply you, as he has sworn unto your fathers;
verses.text: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to your hand: that Yahuah may turn from the fierceness of his anger, and shew you mercy, and have compassion upon you, and multiply you, as he has sworn unto your fathers;

verses.raw: When you shall hearken to the voice of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to keep all his commandments which I command you this day, to do that which is right in the eyes of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God).
verses.text: When you shall hearken to the voice of Yahuah Elohayka, to keep all his commandments which I command you this day, to do that which is right in the eyes of Yahuah Elohayka.

verses.raw: You are the children of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God): you shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.
verses.text: You are the children of Yahuah Elohaychem: you shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

verses.raw: For you are an holy people unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and Yahuah (LORD) has chosen you to be a peculiar people unto himself, above all the nations that are upon the earth.
verses.text: For you are an holy people unto Yahuah Elohayka, and Yahuah has chosen you to be a peculiar people unto himself, above all the nations that are upon the earth.

verses.raw: You shall not eat any abominable thing.
verses.text: You shall not eat any abominable thing.

verses.raw: These are the beasts which you shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,
verses.text: These are the beasts which you shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,

verses.raw: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.
verses.text: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.

verses.raw: And every beast that parteth the hoof, and cleaves the cleft into two claws, and cheweth the cud among the beasts, that you shall eat.
verses.text: And every beast that parteth the hoof, and cleaves the cleft into two claws, and cheweth the cud among the beasts, that you shall eat.

verses.raw: Nevertheless these you shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the cloven hoof; as the camel, and the hare, and the coney: for they chew the cud, but divide not the hoof; therefore they are unclean unto you.
verses.text: Nevertheless these you shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the cloven hoof; as the camel, and the hare, and the coney: for they chew the cud, but divide not the hoof; therefore they are unclean unto you.

verses.raw: And the swine, because it divides the hoof, yet cheweth not the cud, it is unclean unto you: you shall not eat of their flesh, nor touch their dead carcase.
verses.text: And the swine, because it divides the hoof, yet cheweth not the cud, it is unclean unto you: you shall not eat of their flesh, nor touch their dead carcase.

verses.raw: These you shall eat of all that are in the waters: all that have fins and scales shall you eat:
verses.text: These you shall eat of all that are in the waters: all that have fins and scales shall you eat:

verses.raw: And whatsoever has not fins and scales you may not eat; it is unclean unto you.
verses.text: And whatsoever has not fins and scales you may not eat; it is unclean unto you.

verses.raw: Of all clean birds you shall eat.
verses.text: Of all clean birds you shall eat.

verses.raw: But these are they of which you shall not eat: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
verses.text: But these are they of which you shall not eat: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,

verses.raw: And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind,
verses.text: And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind,

verses.raw: And every raven after his kind,
verses.text: And every raven after his kind,

verses.raw: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
verses.text: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

verses.raw: The little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,
verses.text: The little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,

verses.raw: And the pelican, and the gier eagle, and the cormorant,
verses.text: And the pelican, and the gier eagle, and the cormorant,

verses.raw: And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
verses.text: And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

verses.raw: And every creeping thing that flieth is unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.
verses.text: And every creeping thing that flieth is unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.

verses.raw: But of all clean fowls you may eat.
verses.text: But of all clean fowls you may eat.

verses.raw: You shall not eat of any thing that dies of itself: you shall give it unto the stranger that is in your gates, that he may eat it; or you may sell it unto an alien: for you are an holy people unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God). You shall not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
verses.text: You shall not eat of any thing that dies of itself: you shall give it unto the stranger that is in your gates, that he may eat it; or you may sell it unto an alien: for you are an holy people unto Yahuah Elohayka. You shall not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.

verses.raw: You shall truly tithe all the increase of your seed, that the field brings forth year by year.
verses.text: You shall truly tithe all the increase of your seed, that the field brings forth year by year.

verses.raw: And you shall eat before Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), in the place which he shall choose to place his name there, the tithe of your corn, of your wine, and of your oil, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks; that you may learn to fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) always.
verses.text: And you shall eat before Yahuah Elohayka, in the place which he shall choose to place his name there, the tithe of your corn, of your wine, and of your oil, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks; that you may learn to fear Yahuah Elohayka always.

verses.raw: And if the way be too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it; or if the place be too far from you, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall choose to set his name there, when Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has blessed you:
verses.text: And if the way be too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it; or if the place be too far from you, which Yahuah Elohayka shall choose to set his name there, when Yahuah Elohayka has blessed you:

verses.raw: Then shall you turn it into money, and bind up the money in your hand, and shall go unto the place which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall choose:
verses.text: Then shall you turn it into money, and bind up the money in your hand, and shall go unto the place which Yahuah Elohayka shall choose:

verses.raw: And you shall bestow that money for whatsoever your soul lusteth after, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatsoever your soul desires: and you shall eat there before Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and you shall rejoice, you, and your household,
verses.text: And you shall bestow that money for whatsoever your soul lusteth after, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatsoever your soul desires: and you shall eat there before Yahuah Elohayka, and you shall rejoice, you, and your household,

verses.raw: And the Levite that is within your gates; you shall not forsake him; for he has no part nor inheritance with you.
verses.text: And the Levite that is within your gates; you shall not forsake him; for he has no part nor inheritance with you.

verses.raw: At the end of three years you shall bring forth all the tithe of your increase the same year, and shall lay it up within your gates:
verses.text: At the end of three years you shall bring forth all the tithe of your increase the same year, and shall lay it up within your gates:

verses.raw: And the Levite, (because he has no part nor inheritance with you,) and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, which are within your gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.
verses.text: And the Levite, (because he has no part nor inheritance with you,) and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, which are within your gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that Yahuah Elohayka may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.

verses.raw: At the end of every seven years you shall make a release.
verses.text: At the end of every seven years you shall make a release.

verses.raw: And this is the manner of the release: Every creditor that lendeth ought unto his neighbour shall release it; he shall not exact it of his neighbour, or of his brother; because it is called the LORD’S release.
verses.text: And this is the manner of the release: Every creditor that lendeth ought unto his neighbour shall release it; he shall not exact it of his neighbour, or of his brother; because it is called the LORD’S release.

verses.raw: Of a foreigner you may exact it again: but that which is yours with your brother your hand shall release;
verses.text: Of a foreigner you may exact it again: but that which is yours with your brother your hand shall release;

verses.raw: Save when there shall be no poor among you; for Yahuah (LORD) shall greatly bless you in the land which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gives you for an inheritance to possess it:
verses.text: Save when there shall be no poor among you; for Yahuah shall greatly bless you in the land which Yahuah Elohayka gives you for an inheritance to possess it:

verses.raw: Only if you carefully hearken unto the voice of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to observe to do all these commandments which I command you this day.
verses.text: Only if you carefully hearken unto the voice of Yahuah Elohayka, to observe to do all these commandments which I command you this day.

verses.raw: For Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) blesses you, as he promised you: and you shall lend unto many nations, but you shall not borrow; and you shall reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over you.
verses.text: For Yahuah Elohayka blesses you, as he promised you: and you shall lend unto many nations, but you shall not borrow; and you shall reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over you.

verses.raw: If there be among you a poor man of one of your brethren within any of your gates in your land which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gives you, you shall not harden your heart, nor shut your hand from your poor brother:
verses.text: If there be among you a poor man of one of your brethren within any of your gates in your land which Yahuah Elohayka gives you, you shall not harden your heart, nor shut your hand from your poor brother:

verses.raw: But you shall open your hand wide unto him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, in that which he wanteth.
verses.text: But you shall open your hand wide unto him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, in that which he wanteth.

verses.raw: Beware that there be not a thought in your wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and your eye be evil against your poor brother, and you give him nought; and he cry unto Yahuah (LORD) against you, and it be sin unto you.
verses.text: Beware that there be not a thought in your wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and your eye be evil against your poor brother, and you give him nought; and he cry unto Yahuah against you, and it be sin unto you.

verses.raw: You shall surely give him, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give unto him: because that for this thing Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall bless you in all your works, and in all that you put your hand unto.
verses.text: You shall surely give him, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give unto him: because that for this thing Yahuah Elohayka shall bless you in all your works, and in all that you put your hand unto.

verses.raw: For the poor shall never cease out of the land: therefore I command you, saying, You shall open your hand wide unto your brother, to your poor, and to your needy, in your land.
verses.text: For the poor shall never cease out of the land: therefore I command you, saying, You shall open your hand wide unto your brother, to your poor, and to your needy, in your land.

verses.raw: And if your brother, an Hebrew man, or an Hebrew woman, be sold unto you, and serve you six years; then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.
verses.text: And if your brother, an Hebrew man, or an Hebrew woman, be sold unto you, and serve you six years; then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.

verses.raw: And when you send him out free from you, you shall not let him go away empty:
verses.text: And when you send him out free from you, you shall not let him go away empty:

verses.raw: You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, and out of your floor, and out of your winepress: of that wherewith Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has blessed you you shall give unto him.
verses.text: You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, and out of your floor, and out of your winepress: of that wherewith Yahuah Elohayka has blessed you you shall give unto him.

verses.raw: And you shall remember that you were a bondman in the land of Egypt, and Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) redeemed you: therefore I command you this thing to day.
verses.text: And you shall remember that you were a bondman in the land of Egypt, and Yahuah Elohayka redeemed you: therefore I command you this thing to day.

verses.raw: And it shall be, if he say unto you, I will not go away from you; because he loves you and your house, because he is well with you;
verses.text: And it shall be, if he say unto you, I will not go away from you; because he loves you and your house, because he is well with you;

verses.raw: Then you shall take an aul, and thrust it through his ear unto the door, and he shall be your servant for ever. And also unto your maidservant you shall do likewise.
verses.text: Then you shall take an aul, and thrust it through his ear unto the door, and he shall be your servant for ever. And also unto your maidservant you shall do likewise.

verses.raw: It shall not seem hard unto you, when you send him away free from you; for he has been worth a double hired servant to you, in serving you six years: and Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall bless you in all that you do.
verses.text: It shall not seem hard unto you, when you send him away free from you; for he has been worth a double hired servant to you, in serving you six years: and Yahuah Elohayka shall bless you in all that you do.

verses.raw: All the firstling males that come of your herd and of your flock you shall sanctify unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): you shall do no work with the firstling of your bullock, nor shear the firstling of your sheep.
verses.text: All the firstling males that come of your herd and of your flock you shall sanctify unto Yahuah Elohayka: you shall do no work with the firstling of your bullock, nor shear the firstling of your sheep.

verses.raw: You shall eat it before Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) year by year in the place which Yahuah (LORD) shall choose, you and your household.
verses.text: You shall eat it before Yahuah Elohayka year by year in the place which Yahuah shall choose, you and your household.

verses.raw: And if there be any blemish therein, as if it be lame, or blind, or have any ill blemish, you shall not sacrifice it unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God).
verses.text: And if there be any blemish therein, as if it be lame, or blind, or have any ill blemish, you shall not sacrifice it unto Yahuah Elohayka.

verses.raw: You shall eat it within your gates: the unclean and the clean person shall eat it alike, as the roebuck, and as the hart.
verses.text: You shall eat it within your gates: the unclean and the clean person shall eat it alike, as the roebuck, and as the hart.

verses.raw: Only you shall not eat the blood thereof; you shall pour it upon the ground as water.
verses.text: Only you shall not eat the blood thereof; you shall pour it upon the ground as water.

verses.raw: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the passover unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): for in the month of Abib Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) brought you forth out of Egypt by night.
verses.text: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the passover unto Yahuah Elohayka: for in the month of Abib Yahuah Elohayka brought you forth out of Egypt by night.

verses.raw: You shall therefore sacrifice the passover unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), of the flock and the herd, in the place which Yahuah (LORD) shall choose to place his name there.
verses.text: You shall therefore sacrifice the passover unto Yahuah Elohayka, of the flock and the herd, in the place which Yahuah shall choose to place his name there.

verses.raw: You shall eat no leavened bread with it; seven days shall you eat unleavened bread therewith, even the bread of affliction; for you came forth out of the land of Egypt in haste: that you may remember the day when you came forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.
verses.text: You shall eat no leavened bread with it; seven days shall you eat unleavened bread therewith, even the bread of affliction; for you came forth out of the land of Egypt in haste: that you may remember the day when you came forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

verses.raw: And there shall be no leavened bread seen with you in all your coast seven days; neither shall there any thing of the flesh, which you sacrificedst the first day at even, remain all night until the morning.
verses.text: And there shall be no leavened bread seen with you in all your coast seven days; neither shall there any thing of the flesh, which you sacrificedst the first day at even, remain all night until the morning.

verses.raw: You may not sacrifice the passover within any of your gates, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gives you:
verses.text: You may not sacrifice the passover within any of your gates, which Yahuah Elohayka gives you:

verses.raw: But at the place which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall choose to place his name in, there you shall sacrifice the passover at even, at the going down of the sun, at the season that you came forth out of Egypt.
verses.text: But at the place which Yahuah Elohayka shall choose to place his name in, there you shall sacrifice the passover at even, at the going down of the sun, at the season that you came forth out of Egypt.

verses.raw: And you shall roast and eat it in the place which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall choose: and you shall turn in the morning, and go unto your tents.
verses.text: And you shall roast and eat it in the place which Yahuah Elohayka shall choose: and you shall turn in the morning, and go unto your tents.

verses.raw: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread: and on the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): you shall do no work therein.
verses.text: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread: and on the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to Yahuah Elohayka: you shall do no work therein.

verses.raw: Seven weeks shall you number unto you: begin to number the seven weeks from such time as you beginnest to put the sickle to the corn.
verses.text: Seven weeks shall you number unto you: begin to number the seven weeks from such time as you beginnest to put the sickle to the corn.

verses.raw: And you shall keep the feast of weeks unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with a tribute of a freewill offering of your hand, which you shall give unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), according as Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has blessed you:
verses.text: And you shall keep the feast of weeks unto Yahuah Elohayka with a tribute of a freewill offering of your hand, which you shall give unto Yahuah Elohayka, according as Yahuah Elohayka has blessed you:

verses.raw: And you shall rejoice before Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), you, and your son, and your daughter, and your manservant, and your maidservant, and the Levite that is within your gates, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are among you, in the place which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has chosen to place his name there.
verses.text: And you shall rejoice before Yahuah Elohayka, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your manservant, and your maidservant, and the Levite that is within your gates, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are among you, in the place which Yahuah Elohayka has chosen to place his name there.

verses.raw: And you shall remember that you were a bondman in Egypt: and you shall observe and do these statutes.
verses.text: And you shall remember that you were a bondman in Egypt: and you shall observe and do these statutes.

verses.raw: You shall observe the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that you have gathered in your corn and your wine:
verses.text: You shall observe the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that you have gathered in your corn and your wine:

verses.raw: And you shall rejoice in your feast, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your manservant, and your maidservant, and the Levite, the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are within your gates.
verses.text: And you shall rejoice in your feast, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your manservant, and your maidservant, and the Levite, the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are within your gates.

verses.raw: Seven days shall you keep a solemn feast unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) in the place which Yahuah (LORD) shall choose: because Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall bless you in all your increase, and in all the works of your hands, therefore you shall surely rejoice.
verses.text: Seven days shall you keep a solemn feast unto Yahuah Elohayka in the place which Yahuah shall choose: because Yahuah Elohayka shall bless you in all your increase, and in all the works of your hands, therefore you shall surely rejoice.
