verses.text: And of Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad: he dwells as a lion, and tears the arm with the crown of the head.

verses.raw: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, in a portion of the lawgiver, was he seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of Yahuah (LORD), and his judgments with Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, in a portion of the lawgiver, was he seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of Yahuah, and his judgments with Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion’s whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.
verses.text: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion’s whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.

verses.raw: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of Yahuah (LORD): possess you the west and the south.
verses.text: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of Yahuah: possess you the west and the south.

verses.raw: And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.
verses.text: And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.

verses.raw: Your shoes shall be iron and brass; and as your days, so shall your strength be.
verses.text: Your shoes shall be iron and brass; and as your days, so shall your strength be.

verses.raw: There is none like unto the Elohim (God) of Jeshurun, who rides upon the heaven in your help, and in his excellency on the sky.
verses.text: There is none like unto the Elohim of Jeshurun, who rides upon the heaven in your help, and in his excellency on the sky.

verses.raw: The eternal Elohim (God) is your refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before you; and shall say, Destroy them.
verses.text: The eternal Elohim is your refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before you; and shall say, Destroy them.

verses.raw: Yashar'el (Israel) then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.
verses.text: Yashar'el then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.

verses.raw: Happy are you, O Yashar'el (Israel): who is like unto you, O people saved by Yahuah (LORD), the shield of your help, and who is the sword of your excellency! and your enemies shall be found liars unto you; and you shall tread upon their high places.
verses.text: Happy are you, O Yashar'el: who is like unto you, O people saved by Yahuah, the shield of your help, and who is the sword of your excellency! and your enemies shall be found liars unto you; and you shall tread upon their high places.

verses.raw: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And Yahuah (LORD) shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,
verses.text: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And Yahuah shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,

verses.raw: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Yahudah (Judah), unto the utmost sea,
verses.text: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Yahudah, unto the utmost sea,

verses.raw: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.
verses.text: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, This is the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto your seed: I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over thither.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto him, This is the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto your seed: I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over thither.

verses.raw: So Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: So Moses the servant of Yahuah died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Beth-peor: but no man knows of his sepulchre unto this day.
verses.text: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Beth-peor: but no man knows of his sepulchre unto this day.

verses.raw: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.
verses.text: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.

verses.raw: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) hearkened unto him, and did as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Yashar'el hearkened unto him, and did as Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And there arose not a prophet since in Yashar'el (Israel) like unto Moses, whom Yahuah (LORD) knew face to face,
verses.text: And there arose not a prophet since in Yashar'el like unto Moses, whom Yahuah knew face to face,

verses.raw: In all the signs and the wonders, which Yahuah (LORD) sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
verses.text: In all the signs and the wonders, which Yahuah sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

verses.raw: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Now after the death of Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) it came to pass, that Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying,
verses.text: Now after the death of Moses the servant of Yahuah it came to pass, that Yahuah spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying,

verses.raw: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, you, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, you, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.
verses.text: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.

verses.raw: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.
verses.text: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.

verses.raw: There shall not any man be able to stand before you all the days of your life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with you: I will not fail you, nor forsake you.
verses.text: There shall not any man be able to stand before you all the days of your life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with you: I will not fail you, nor forsake you.

verses.raw: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shall you divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.
verses.text: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shall you divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.

verses.raw: Only be you strong and very courageous, that you may observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded you: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may prosper whithersoever you go.
verses.text: Only be you strong and very courageous, that you may observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded you: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may prosper whithersoever you go.

verses.raw: This book of the law shall not depart out of your mouth; but you shall meditate therein day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.
verses.text: This book of the law shall not depart out of your mouth; but you shall meditate therein day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.

verses.raw: Have not I commanded you? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be you dismayed: for Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) is with you whithersoever you go.
verses.text: Have not I commanded you? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be you dismayed: for Yahuah Elohayka is with you whithersoever you go.

verses.raw: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,
verses.text: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

verses.raw: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days you shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) gives you to possess it.
verses.text: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days you shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which Yahuah Elohaychem gives you to possess it.

verses.raw: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,
verses.text: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,

verses.raw: Remember the word which Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) commanded you, saying, Yahuah Elohaychem (The LORD your God) has given you rest, and has given you this land.
verses.text: Remember the word which Moses the servant of Yahuah commanded you, saying, Yahuah Elohaychem (The LORD your God) has given you rest, and has given you this land.

verses.raw: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but you shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them;
verses.text: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but you shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them;

verses.raw: Until Yahuah (LORD) have given your brethren rest, as he has given you, and they also have possessed the land which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) gives them: then you shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the LORD’S servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.
verses.text: Until Yahuah have given your brethren rest, as he has given you, and they also have possessed the land which Yahuah Elohaychem gives them: then you shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the LORD’S servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.

verses.raw: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that you commandest us we will do, and whithersoever you send us, we will go.
verses.text: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that you commandest us we will do, and whithersoever you send us, we will go.

verses.raw: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto you: only Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) be with you, as he was with Moses.
verses.text: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto you: only Yahuah Elohayka be with you, as he was with Moses.

verses.raw: Whosoever he be that does rebel against your commandment, and will not hearken unto your words in all that you commandest him, he shall be put to death: only be strong and of a good courage.
verses.text: Whosoever he be that does rebel against your commandment, and will not hearken unto your words in all that you commandest him, he shall be put to death: only be strong and of a good courage.

verses.raw: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot’s house, named Rahab, and lodged there.
verses.text: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot’s house, named Rahab, and lodged there.

verses.raw: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) to search out the country.
verses.text: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Yashar'el to search out the country.

verses.raw: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to you, which are entered into your house: for they be come to search out all the country.
verses.text: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to you, which are entered into your house: for they be come to search out all the country.

verses.raw: And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they were:
verses.text: And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they were:

verses.raw: And it came to pass about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for you shall overtake them.
verses.text: And it came to pass about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for you shall overtake them.

verses.raw: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.
verses.text: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.

verses.raw: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.
verses.text: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.

verses.raw: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;
verses.text: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;

verses.raw: And she said unto the men, I know that Yahuah (LORD) has given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.
verses.text: And she said unto the men, I know that Yahuah has given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.

verses.raw: For we have heard how Yahuah (LORD) dried up the water of the Red sea for you, when you came out of Egypt; and what you did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that were on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom you utterly destroyed.
verses.text: For we have heard how Yahuah dried up the water of the Red sea for you, when you came out of Egypt; and what you did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that were on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom you utterly destroyed.

verses.raw: And as soon as we had heard these things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), he is Elohim (God) in heaven above, and in earth beneath.
verses.text: And as soon as we had heard these things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for Yahuah Elohaychem, he is Elohim in heaven above, and in earth beneath.

verses.raw: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by Yahuah (LORD), since I have shewed you kindness, that you will also shew kindness unto my father’s house, and give me a true token:
verses.text: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by Yahuah, since I have shewed you kindness, that you will also shew kindness unto my father’s house, and give me a true token:

verses.raw: And that you will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.
verses.text: And that you will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.

verses.raw: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if you utter not this our business. And it shall be, when Yahuah (LORD) has given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with you.
verses.text: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if you utter not this our business. And it shall be, when Yahuah has given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with you.

verses.raw: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.
verses.text: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.

verses.raw: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may you go your way.
verses.text: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may you go your way.

verses.raw: And the men said unto her, We will be blameless of this your oath which you have made us swear.
verses.text: And the men said unto her, We will be blameless of this your oath which you have made us swear.

verses.raw: Behold, when we come into the land, you shall bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which you did let us down by: and you shall bring your father, and your mother, and your brethren, and all your father’s household, home unto you.
verses.text: Behold, when we come into the land, you shall bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which you did let us down by: and you shall bring your father, and your mother, and your brethren, and all your father’s household, home unto you.

verses.raw: And it shall be, that whosoever shall go out of the doors of your house into the street, his blood shall be upon his head, and we will be guiltless: and whosoever shall be with you in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand be upon him.
verses.text: And it shall be, that whosoever shall go out of the doors of your house into the street, his blood shall be upon his head, and we will be guiltless: and whosoever shall be with you in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand be upon him.

verses.raw: And if you utter this our business, then we will be quit of your oath which you have made us to swear.
verses.text: And if you utter this our business, then we will be quit of your oath which you have made us to swear.

verses.raw: And she said, According unto your words, so be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.
verses.text: And she said, According unto your words, so be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.

verses.raw: And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought them throughout all the way, but found them not.
verses.text: And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought them throughout all the way, but found them not.

verses.raw: So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all things that befell them:
verses.text: So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all things that befell them:

verses.raw: And they said unto Joshua, Truly Yahuah (LORD) has delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.
verses.text: And they said unto Joshua, Truly Yahuah has delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.

verses.raw: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and lodged there before they passed over.
verses.text: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Yashar'el, and lodged there before they passed over.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the host;
verses.text: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the host;

verses.raw: And they commanded the people, saying, When you see the ark of the covenant of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and the priests the Levites bearing it, then you shall remove from your place, and go after it.
verses.text: And they commanded the people, saying, When you see the ark of the covenant of Yahuah Elohaychem, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then you shall remove from your place, and go after it.

verses.raw: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that you may know the way by which you must go: for you have not passed this way heretofore.
verses.text: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that you may know the way by which you must go: for you have not passed this way heretofore.

verses.raw: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow Yahuah (LORD) will do wonders among you.
verses.text: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow Yahuah will do wonders among you.

verses.raw: And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.
verses.text: And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify you in the sight of all Yashar'el (Israel), that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify you in the sight of all Yashar'el, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.

verses.raw: And you shall command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When you are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, you shall stand still in Jordan.
verses.text: And you shall command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When you are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, you shall stand still in Jordan.

verses.raw: And Joshua said unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), Come hither, and hear the words of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: And Joshua said unto the children of Yashar'el, Come hither, and hear the words of Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: And Joshua said, Hereby you shall know that the living Elohim (God) is among you, and that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.
verses.text: And Joshua said, Hereby you shall know that the living Elohim is among you, and that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.

verses.raw: Behold, the ark of the covenant of Adonai (Lord) of all the earth passes over before you into Jordan.
verses.text: Behold, the ark of the covenant of Adonai of all the earth passes over before you into Jordan.

verses.raw: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), out of every tribe a man.
verses.text: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Yashar'el, out of every tribe a man.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of Yahuah (LORD), Adonai (Lord) of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan, that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above; and they shall stand upon an heap.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of Yahuah, Adonai of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan, that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above; and they shall stand upon an heap.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;

verses.raw: And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water, (for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest,)
verses.text: And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water, (for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest,)

verses.raw: That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that is beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, failed, and were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.
verses.text: That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that is beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, failed, and were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.

verses.raw: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.
verses.text: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of Yahuah stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over Jordan, that Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Joshua, saying,
verses.text: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over Jordan, that Yahuah spake unto Joshua, saying,

verses.raw: Take you twelve men out of the people, out of every tribe a man,
verses.text: Take you twelve men out of the people, out of every tribe a man,

verses.raw: And command you them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, and you shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where you shall lodge this night.
verses.text: And command you them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, and you shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where you shall lodge this night.

verses.raw: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), out of every tribe a man:
verses.text: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Yashar'el, out of every tribe a man:

verses.raw: And Joshua said unto them, Pass over before the ark of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) into the midst of Jordan, and take you up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: And Joshua said unto them, Pass over before the ark of Yahuah Elohaychem into the midst of Jordan, and take you up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Yashar'el:

verses.raw: That this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean you by these stones?
verses.text: That this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean you by these stones?

verses.raw: Then you shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD); when it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel) for ever.
verses.text: Then you shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of Yahuah; when it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Yashar'el for ever.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as Yahuah spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Yashar'el, and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.

verses.raw: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this day.
verses.text: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this day.

verses.raw: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan, until every thing was finished that Yahuah (LORD) commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.
verses.text: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan, until every thing was finished that Yahuah commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of Yahuah (LORD) passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of Yahuah passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.

verses.raw: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before the children of Yashar'el (Israel), as Moses spake unto them:
verses.text: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before the children of Yashar'el, as Moses spake unto them:

verses.raw: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before Yahuah (LORD) unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.
verses.text: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before Yahuah unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.

verses.raw: On that day Yahuah (LORD) magnified Joshua in the sight of all Yashar'el (Israel); and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.
verses.text: On that day Yahuah magnified Joshua in the sight of all Yashar'el; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Joshua, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Joshua, saying,

verses.raw: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of Jordan.
verses.text: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of Jordan.

verses.raw: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come you up out of Jordan.
verses.text: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come you up out of Jordan.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) were come up out of the midst of Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet were lifted up unto the dry land, that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place, and flowed over all his banks, as they did before.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of Yahuah were come up out of the midst of Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet were lifted up unto the dry land, that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place, and flowed over all his banks, as they did before.

verses.raw: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.
verses.text: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.

verses.raw: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.
verses.text: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.

verses.raw: And he spake unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?
verses.text: And he spake unto the children of Yashar'el, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?

verses.raw: Then you shall let your children know, saying, Yashar'el (Israel) came over this Jordan on dry land.
verses.text: Then you shall let your children know, saying, Yashar'el came over this Jordan on dry land.

verses.raw: For Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) dried up the waters of Jordan from before you, until you were passed over, as Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) did to the Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone over:
verses.text: For Yahuah Elohaychem dried up the waters of Jordan from before you, until you were passed over, as Yahuah Elohaychem did to the Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone over:

verses.raw: That all the people of the earth might know the hand of Yahuah (LORD), that it is mighty: that you might fear Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) for ever.
verses.text: That all the people of the earth might know the hand of Yahuah, that it is mighty: that you might fear Yahuah Elohaychem for ever.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorites, which were on the side of Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, which were by the sea, heard that Yahuah (LORD) had dried up the waters of Jordan from before the children of Yashar'el (Israel), until we were passed over, that their heart melted, neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorites, which were on the side of Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, which were by the sea, heard that Yahuah had dried up the waters of Jordan from before the children of Yashar'el, until we were passed over, that their heart melted, neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: At that time Yahuah (LORD) said unto Joshua, Make you sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Yashar'el (Israel) the second time.
verses.text: At that time Yahuah said unto Joshua, Make you sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Yashar'el the second time.

verses.raw: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Yashar'el (Israel) at the hill of the foreskins.
verses.text: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Yashar'el at the hill of the foreskins.

verses.raw: And this is the cause why Joshua did circumcise: All the people that came out of Egypt, that were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the way, after they came out of Egypt.
verses.text: And this is the cause why Joshua did circumcise: All the people that came out of Egypt, that were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the way, after they came out of Egypt.

verses.raw: Now all the people that came out were circumcised: but all the people that were born in the wilderness by the way as they came forth out of Egypt, them they had not circumcised.
verses.text: Now all the people that came out were circumcised: but all the people that were born in the wilderness by the way as they came forth out of Egypt, them they had not circumcised.

verses.raw: For the children of Yashar'el (Israel) walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the people that were men of war, which came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they obeyed not the voice of Yahuah (LORD): unto whom Yahuah (LORD) sware that he would not shew them the land, which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto their fathers that he would give us, a land that flows with milk and honey.
verses.text: For the children of Yashar'el walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the people that were men of war, which came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they obeyed not the voice of Yahuah: unto whom Yahuah sware that he would not shew them the land, which Yahuah sware unto their fathers that he would give us, a land that flows with milk and honey.

verses.raw: And their children, whom he raised up in their stead, them Joshua circumcised: for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them by the way.
verses.text: And their children, whom he raised up in their stead, them Joshua circumcised: for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them by the way.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the people, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the people, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Joshua, This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you. Wherefore the name of the place is called Gilgal unto this day.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Joshua, This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you. Wherefore the name of the place is called Gilgal unto this day.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) encamped in Gilgal, and kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at even in the plains of Jericho.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el encamped in Gilgal, and kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at even in the plains of Jericho.

verses.raw: And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched corn in the selfsame day.
verses.text: And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched corn in the selfsame day.

verses.raw: And the manna ceased on the morrow after they had eaten of the old corn of the land; neither had the children of Yashar'el (Israel) manna any more; but they did eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.
verses.text: And the manna ceased on the morrow after they had eaten of the old corn of the land; neither had the children of Yashar'el manna any more; but they did eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, there stood a man over against him with his sword drawn in his hand: and Joshua went unto him, and said unto him, Are you for us, or for our adversaries?
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, there stood a man over against him with his sword drawn in his hand: and Joshua went unto him, and said unto him, Are you for us, or for our adversaries?

verses.raw: And he said, Nay; but as captain of the host of Yahuah (LORD) am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What says my lord unto his servant?
verses.text: And he said, Nay; but as captain of the host of Yahuah am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What says my lord unto his servant?

verses.raw: And the captain of the LORD’S host said unto Joshua, Loose your shoe from off your foot; for the place whereon you stand is holy. And Joshua did so.
verses.text: And the captain of the LORD’S host said unto Joshua, Loose your shoe from off your foot; for the place whereon you stand is holy. And Joshua did so.

verses.raw: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Yashar'el (Israel): none went out, and none came in.
verses.text: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Yashar'el: none went out, and none came in.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Joshua, See, I have given into your hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Joshua, See, I have given into your hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.

verses.raw: And you shall compass the city, all you men of war, and go round about the city once. Thus shall you do six days.
verses.text: And you shall compass the city, all you men of war, and go round about the city once. Thus shall you do six days.

verses.raw: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams’ horns: and the seventh day you shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.
verses.text: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams’ horns: and the seventh day you shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.

verses.raw: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said unto them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said unto them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he said unto the people, Pass on, and compass the city, and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And he said unto the people, Pass on, and compass the city, and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns passed on before Yahuah (LORD), and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) followed them.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns passed on before Yahuah, and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of Yahuah followed them.

verses.raw: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rereward came after the ark, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.
verses.text: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rereward came after the ark, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

verses.raw: And Joshua had commanded the people, saying, You shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout; then shall you shout.
verses.text: And Joshua had commanded the people, saying, You shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout; then shall you shout.

verses.raw: So the ark of Yahuah (LORD) compassed the city, going about it once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.
verses.text: So the ark of Yahuah compassed the city, going about it once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.

verses.raw: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of Yahuah (LORD) went on continually, and blew with the trumpets: and the armed men went before them; but the rereward came after the ark of Yahuah (LORD), the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.
verses.text: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of Yahuah went on continually, and blew with the trumpets: and the armed men went before them; but the rereward came after the ark of Yahuah, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

verses.raw: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.
verses.text: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.
verses.text: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.

verses.raw: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for Yahuah (LORD) has given you the city.
verses.text: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for Yahuah has given you the city.

verses.raw: And the city shall be accursed, even it, and all that are therein, to Yahuah (LORD): only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all that are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.
verses.text: And the city shall be accursed, even it, and all that are therein, to Yahuah: only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all that are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.

verses.raw: And you, in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest you make yourselves accursed, when you take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Yashar'el (Israel) a curse, and trouble it.
verses.text: And you, in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest you make yourselves accursed, when you take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Yashar'el a curse, and trouble it.

verses.raw: But all the silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron, are consecrated unto Yahuah (LORD): they shall come into the treasury of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But all the silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron, are consecrated unto Yahuah: they shall come into the treasury of Yahuah.

verses.raw: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.
verses.text: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.

verses.raw: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.
verses.text: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.

verses.raw: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country, Go into the harlot’s house, and bring out thence the woman, and all that she has, as you sware unto her.
verses.text: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country, Go into the harlot’s house, and bring out thence the woman, and all that she has, as you sware unto her.

verses.raw: And the young men that were spies went in, and brought out Rahab, and her father, and her mother, and her brethren, and all that she had; and they brought out all her kindred, and left them without the camp of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the young men that were spies went in, and brought out Rahab, and her father, and her mother, and her brethren, and all that she had; and they brought out all her kindred, and left them without the camp of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And they burnt the city with fire, and all that was therein: only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And they burnt the city with fire, and all that was therein: only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father’s household, and all that she had; and she dwells in Yashar'el (Israel) even unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
verses.text: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father’s household, and all that she had; and she dwells in Yashar'el even unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

verses.raw: And Joshua adjured them at that time, saying, Cursed be the man before Yahuah (LORD), that rises up and builds this city Jericho: he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn, and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it.
verses.text: And Joshua adjured them at that time, saying, Cursed be the man before Yahuah, that rises up and builds this city Jericho: he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn, and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it.

verses.raw: So Yahuah (LORD) was with Joshua; and his fame was noised throughout all the country.
verses.text: So Yahuah was with Joshua; and his fame was noised throughout all the country.

verses.raw: But the children of Yashar'el (Israel) committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah), took of the accursed thing: and the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was kindled against the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But the children of Yashar'el committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Yahudah, took of the accursed thing: and the anger of Yahuah was kindled against the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth-aven, on the east side of Beth-el, and spake unto them, saying, Go up and view the country. And the men went up and viewed Ai.
verses.text: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth-aven, on the east side of Beth-el, and spake unto them, saying, Go up and view the country. And the men went up and viewed Ai.

verses.raw: And they returned to Joshua, and said unto him, Let not all the people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai; and make not all the people to labour thither; for they are but few.
verses.text: And they returned to Joshua, and said unto him, Let not all the people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai; and make not all the people to labour thither; for they are but few.

verses.raw: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.
verses.text: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.

verses.raw: And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men: for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down: wherefore the hearts of the people melted, and became as water.
verses.text: And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men: for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down: wherefore the hearts of the people melted, and became as water.

verses.raw: And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of Yahuah (LORD) until the eventide, he and the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), and put dust upon their heads.
verses.text: And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of Yahuah until the eventide, he and the elders of Yashar'el, and put dust upon their heads.

verses.raw: And Joshua said, Alas, O Adonai (Lord) GOD, wherefore have you at all brought this people over Jordan, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? would to Elohim (God) we had been content, and dwelt on the other side Jordan!
verses.text: And Joshua said, Alas, O Adonai GOD, wherefore have you at all brought this people over Jordan, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? would to Elohim we had been content, and dwelt on the other side Jordan!

verses.raw: O Adonai (Lord), what shall I say, when Yashar'el (Israel) turns their backs before their enemies!
verses.text: O Adonai, what shall I say, when Yashar'el turns their backs before their enemies!

verses.raw: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it, and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth: and what will you do unto your great name?
verses.text: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it, and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth: and what will you do unto your great name?

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Joshua, Get you up; wherefore lie you thus upon your face?
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Joshua, Get you up; wherefore lie you thus upon your face?

verses.raw: Yashar'el (Israel) has sinned, and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them: for they have even taken of the accursed thing, and have also stolen, and dissembled also, and they have put it even among their own stuff.
verses.text: Yashar'el has sinned, and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them: for they have even taken of the accursed thing, and have also stolen, and dissembled also, and they have put it even among their own stuff.

verses.raw: Therefore the children of Yashar'el (Israel) could not stand before their enemies, but turned their backs before their enemies, because they were accursed: neither will I be with you any more, except you destroy the accursed from among you.
verses.text: Therefore the children of Yashar'el could not stand before their enemies, but turned their backs before their enemies, because they were accursed: neither will I be with you any more, except you destroy the accursed from among you.

verses.raw: Up, sanctify the people, and say, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow: for thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), There is an accursed thing in the midst of you, O Yashar'el (Israel): you can not stand before your enemies, until you take away the accursed thing from among you.
verses.text: Up, sanctify the people, and say, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow: for thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, There is an accursed thing in the midst of you, O Yashar'el: you can not stand before your enemies, until you take away the accursed thing from among you.

verses.raw: In the morning therefore you shall be brought according to your tribes: and it shall be, that the tribe which Yahuah (LORD) takes shall come according to the families thereof; and the family which Yahuah (LORD) shall take shall come by households; and the household which Yahuah (LORD) shall take shall come man by man.
verses.text: In the morning therefore you shall be brought according to your tribes: and it shall be, that the tribe which Yahuah takes shall come according to the families thereof; and the family which Yahuah shall take shall come by households; and the household which Yahuah shall take shall come man by man.

verses.raw: And it shall be, that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he has: because he has transgressed the covenant of Yahuah (LORD), and because he has wrought folly in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And it shall be, that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he has: because he has transgressed the covenant of Yahuah, and because he has wrought folly in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Yashar'el (Israel) by their tribes; and the tribe of Yahudah (Judah) was taken:
verses.text: So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Yashar'el by their tribes; and the tribe of Yahudah was taken:

verses.raw: And he brought the family of Yahudah (Judah); and he took the family of the Zarhites: and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man; and Zabdi was taken:
verses.text: And he brought the family of Yahudah; and he took the family of the Zarhites: and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man; and Zabdi was taken:

verses.raw: And he brought his household man by man; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah), was taken.
verses.text: And he brought his household man by man; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Yahudah, was taken.

verses.raw: And Joshua said unto Achan, My son, give, I pray you, glory to Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), and make confession unto him; and tell me now what you have done; hide it not from me.
verses.text: And Joshua said unto Achan, My son, give, I pray you, glory to Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, and make confession unto him; and tell me now what you have done; hide it not from me.

verses.raw: And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), and thus and thus have I done:
verses.text: And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, and thus and thus have I done:

verses.raw: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.
verses.text: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.

verses.raw: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran unto the tent; and, behold, it was hid in his tent, and the silver under it.
verses.text: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran unto the tent; and, behold, it was hid in his tent, and the silver under it.

verses.raw: And they took them out of the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and laid them out before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And they took them out of the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Yashar'el, and laid them out before Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Joshua, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.
verses.text: And Joshua, and all Yashar'el with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.

verses.raw: And Joshua said, Why have you troubled us? Yahuah (LORD) shall trouble you this day. And all Yashar'el (Israel) stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.
verses.text: And Joshua said, Why have you troubled us? Yahuah shall trouble you this day. And all Yashar'el stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.

verses.raw: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day. So Yahuah (LORD) turned from the fierceness of his anger. Wherefore the name of that place was called, The valley of Achor, unto this day.
verses.text: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day. So Yahuah turned from the fierceness of his anger. Wherefore the name of that place was called, The valley of Achor, unto this day.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be you dismayed: take all the people of war with you, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be you dismayed: take all the people of war with you, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:

verses.raw: And you shall do to Ai and her king as you did unto Jericho and her king: only the spoil thereof, and the cattle thereof, shall you take for a prey unto yourselves: lay you an ambush for the city behind it.
verses.text: And you shall do to Ai and her king as you did unto Jericho and her king: only the spoil thereof, and the cattle thereof, shall you take for a prey unto yourselves: lay you an ambush for the city behind it.

verses.raw: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai: and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, and sent them away by night.
verses.text: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai: and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, and sent them away by night.

verses.raw: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, you shall lie in wait against the city, even behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be you all ready:
verses.text: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, you shall lie in wait against the city, even behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be you all ready:

verses.raw: And I, and all the people that are with me, will approach unto the city: and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them,
verses.text: And I, and all the people that are with me, will approach unto the city: and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them,

verses.raw: (For they will come out after us) till we have drawn them from the city; for they will say, They flee before us, as at the first: therefore we will flee before them.
verses.text: (For they will come out after us) till we have drawn them from the city; for they will say, They flee before us, as at the first: therefore we will flee before them.

verses.raw: Then you shall rise up from the ambush, and seize upon the city: for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) will deliver it into your hand.
verses.text: Then you shall rise up from the ambush, and seize upon the city: for Yahuah Elohaychem will deliver it into your hand.

verses.raw: And it shall be, when you have taken the city, that you shall set the city on fire: according to the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) shall you do. See, I have commanded you.
verses.text: And it shall be, when you have taken the city, that you shall set the city on fire: according to the commandment of Yahuah shall you do. See, I have commanded you.

verses.raw: Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.
verses.text: Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.

verses.raw: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), before the people to Ai.
verses.text: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Yashar'el, before the people to Ai.

verses.raw: And all the people, even the people of war that were with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now there was a valley between them and Ai.
verses.text: And all the people, even the people of war that were with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now there was a valley between them and Ai.

verses.raw: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of the city.
verses.text: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of the city.

verses.raw: And when they had set the people, even all the host that was on the north of the city, and their liers in wait on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.
verses.text: And when they had set the people, even all the host that was on the north of the city, and their liers in wait on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw it, that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Yashar'el (Israel) to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he wist not that there were liers in ambush against him behind the city.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw it, that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Yashar'el to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he wist not that there were liers in ambush against him behind the city.

verses.raw: And Joshua and all Yashar'el (Israel) made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.
verses.text: And Joshua and all Yashar'el made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

verses.raw: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.
verses.text: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

verses.raw: And there was not a man left in Ai or Beth-el, that went not out after Yashar'el (Israel): and they left the city open, and pursued after Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And there was not a man left in Ai or Beth-el, that went not out after Yashar'el: and they left the city open, and pursued after Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Joshua, Stretch out the spear that is in your hand toward Ai; for I will give it into your hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Joshua, Stretch out the spear that is in your hand toward Ai; for I will give it into your hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city.

verses.raw: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.
verses.text: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.

verses.raw: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.
verses.text: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.

verses.raw: And when Joshua and all Yashar'el (Israel) saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.
verses.text: And when Joshua and all Yashar'el saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.

verses.raw: And the other issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Yashar'el (Israel), some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.
verses.text: And the other issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Yashar'el, some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.

verses.raw: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.
verses.text: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Yashar'el (Israel) had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Yashar'el had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.

verses.raw: And so it was, that all that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the men of Ai.
verses.text: And so it was, that all that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the men of Ai.

verses.raw: For Joshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.
verses.text: For Joshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.

verses.raw: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Yashar'el (Israel) took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of Yahuah (LORD) which he commanded Joshua.
verses.text: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Yashar'el took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of Yahuah which he commanded Joshua.

verses.raw: And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever, even a desolation unto this day.
verses.text: And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever, even a desolation unto this day.

verses.raw: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones, that remains unto this day.
verses.text: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones, that remains unto this day.

verses.raw: Then Joshua built an altar unto Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) in mount Ebal,
verses.text: Then Joshua built an altar unto Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el in mount Ebal,

verses.raw: As Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) commanded the children of Yashar'el (Israel), as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, over which no man has lift up any iron: and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto Yahuah (LORD), and sacrificed peace offerings.
verses.text: As Moses the servant of Yahuah commanded the children of Yashar'el, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, over which no man has lift up any iron: and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto Yahuah, and sacrificed peace offerings.

verses.raw: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And all Yashar'el (Israel), and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD), as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And all Yashar'el, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of Yahuah, as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of Yahuah had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.
verses.text: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.

verses.raw: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel), with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.
verses.text: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Yashar'el, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when all the kings which were on this side Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard thereof;
verses.text: And it came to pass, when all the kings which were on this side Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard thereof;

verses.raw: That they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Yashar'el (Israel), with one accord.
verses.text: That they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Yashar'el, with one accord.

verses.raw: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,
verses.text: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,

verses.raw: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;
verses.text: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;

verses.raw: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy.
verses.text: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy.

verses.raw: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Yashar'el (Israel), We be come from a far country: now therefore make you a league with us.
verses.text: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Yashar'el, We be come from a far country: now therefore make you a league with us.

verses.raw: And the men of Yashar'el (Israel) said unto the Hivites, Peradventure you dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?
verses.text: And the men of Yashar'el said unto the Hivites, Peradventure you dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?

verses.raw: And they said unto Joshua, We are your servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who are you? and from whence come you?
verses.text: And they said unto Joshua, We are your servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who are you? and from whence come you?

verses.raw: And they said unto him, From a very far country your servants are come because of the name of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,
verses.text: And they said unto him, From a very far country your servants are come because of the name of Yahuah Elohayka: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,
