verses.raw: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that were beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which was at Ashtaroth.
verses.text: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that were beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which was at Ashtaroth.

verses.raw: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We are your servants: therefore now make you a league with us.
verses.text: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We are your servants: therefore now make you a league with us.

verses.raw: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:
verses.text: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:

verses.raw: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.
verses.text: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.

verses.raw: And the men took of their victuals, and asked not counsel at the mouth of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the men took of their victuals, and asked not counsel at the mouth of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.
verses.text: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.

verses.raw: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they were their neighbours, and that they dwelt among them.
verses.text: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they were their neighbours, and that they dwelt among them.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel). And all the congregation murmured against the princes.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el. And all the congregation murmured against the princes.

verses.raw: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel): now therefore we may not touch them.
verses.text: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el: now therefore we may not touch them.

verses.raw: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.
verses.text: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.

verses.raw: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.
verses.text: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.

verses.raw: And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have you beguiled us, saying, We are very far from you; when you dwell among us?
verses.text: And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have you beguiled us, saying, We are very far from you; when you dwell among us?

verses.raw: Now therefore you are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my Elohim (God).
verses.text: Now therefore you are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my Elohim.

verses.raw: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told your servants, how that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.
verses.text: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told your servants, how that Yahuah Elohayka commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.

verses.raw: And now, behold, we are in your hand: as it seems good and right unto you to do unto us, do.
verses.text: And now, behold, we are in your hand: as it seems good and right unto you to do unto us, do.

verses.raw: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they slew them not.
verses.text: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Yashar'el, that they slew them not.

verses.raw: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of Yahuah (LORD), even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.
verses.text: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of Yahuah, even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Yashar'el (Israel), and were among them;
verses.text: Now it came to pass, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Yashar'el, and were among them;

verses.raw: That they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof were mighty.
verses.text: That they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof were mighty.

verses.raw: Wherefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,
verses.text: Wherefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,

verses.raw: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it has made peace with Joshua and with the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it has made peace with Joshua and with the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.
verses.text: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.

verses.raw: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not your hand from your servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.
verses.text: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not your hand from your servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.

verses.raw: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.
verses.text: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into your hand; there shall not a man of them stand before you.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into your hand; there shall not a man of them stand before you.

verses.raw: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly, and went up from Gilgal all night.
verses.text: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly, and went up from Gilgal all night.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) discomfited them before Yashar'el (Israel), and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goes up to Beth-horon, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.
verses.text: And Yahuah discomfited them before Yashar'el, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goes up to Beth-horon, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Yashar'el (Israel), and were in the going down to Beth-horon, that Yahuah (LORD) cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Yashar'el (Israel) slew with the sword.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Yashar'el, and were in the going down to Beth-horon, that Yahuah cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Yashar'el slew with the sword.

verses.raw: Then spake Joshua to Yahuah (LORD) in the day when Yahuah (LORD) delivered up the Amorites before the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and he said in the sight of Yashar'el (Israel), Sun, stand you still upon Gibeon; and you, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.
verses.text: Then spake Joshua to Yahuah in the day when Yahuah delivered up the Amorites before the children of Yashar'el, and he said in the sight of Yashar'el, Sun, stand you still upon Gibeon; and you, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.

verses.raw: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.
verses.text: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.

verses.raw: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that Yahuah (LORD) hearkened unto the voice of a man: for Yahuah (LORD) fought for Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that Yahuah hearkened unto the voice of a man: for Yahuah fought for Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Joshua returned, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
verses.text: And Joshua returned, and all Yashar'el with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.

verses.raw: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.
verses.text: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.

verses.raw: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.
verses.text: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.

verses.raw: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:
verses.text: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:

verses.raw: And stay you not, but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has delivered them into your hand.
verses.text: And stay you not, but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for Yahuah Elohaychem has delivered them into your hand.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Yashar'el had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.

verses.raw: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.
verses.text: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.

verses.raw: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
verses.text: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Yashar'el (Israel), and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Yashar'el, and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.

verses.raw: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall Yahuah (LORD) do to all your enemies against whom you fight.
verses.text: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall Yahuah do to all your enemies against whom you fight.

verses.raw: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.
verses.text: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.

verses.raw: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave’s mouth, which remain until this very day.
verses.text: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave’s mouth, which remain until this very day.

verses.raw: And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho.
verses.text: And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho.

verses.raw: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:
verses.text: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Yashar'el with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Yashar'el (Israel); and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.
verses.text: And Yahuah delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Yashar'el; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.

verses.raw: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:
verses.text: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Yashar'el with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) delivered Lachish into the hand of Yashar'el (Israel), which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
verses.text: And Yahuah delivered Lachish into the hand of Yashar'el, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

verses.raw: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.
verses.text: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.

verses.raw: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:
verses.text: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Yashar'el with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:

verses.raw: And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
verses.text: And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.

verses.raw: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:
verses.text: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Yashar'el with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:

verses.raw: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that were therein.
verses.text: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that were therein.

verses.raw: And Joshua returned, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, to Debir; and fought against it:
verses.text: And Joshua returned, and all Yashar'el with him, to Debir; and fought against it:

verses.raw: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.
verses.text: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.

verses.raw: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) commanded.
verses.text: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el commanded.

verses.raw: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh-barnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.
verses.text: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh-barnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.

verses.raw: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) fought for Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el fought for Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Joshua returned, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
verses.text: And Joshua returned, and all Yashar'el with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,

verses.raw: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,
verses.text: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,

verses.raw: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.
verses.text: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.

verses.raw: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.
verses.text: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.

verses.raw: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Yashar'el (Israel): you shall hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Yashar'el: you shall hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.

verses.raw: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.
verses.text: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) delivered them into the hand of Yashar'el (Israel), who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephoth-maim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.
verses.text: And Yahuah delivered them into the hand of Yashar'el, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephoth-maim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.

verses.raw: And Joshua did unto them as Yahuah (LORD) bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.
verses.text: And Joshua did unto them as Yahuah bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.

verses.raw: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.
verses.text: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.

verses.raw: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.
verses.text: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.

verses.raw: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) commanded.
verses.text: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of Yahuah commanded.

verses.raw: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Yashar'el (Israel) burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.
verses.text: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Yashar'el burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.

verses.raw: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Yashar'el (Israel) took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.
verses.text: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Yashar'el took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.

verses.raw: As Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: As Yahuah commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Yashar'el (Israel), and the valley of the same;
verses.text: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Yashar'el, and the valley of the same;

verses.raw: Even from the mount Halak, that goes up to Seir, even unto Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.
verses.text: Even from the mount Halak, that goes up to Seir, even unto Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.

verses.raw: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
verses.text: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

verses.raw: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Yashar'el (Israel), save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all other they took in battle.
verses.text: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Yashar'el, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all other they took in battle.

verses.raw: For it was of Yahuah (LORD) to harden their hearts, that they should come against Yashar'el (Israel) in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: For it was of Yahuah to harden their hearts, that they should come against Yashar'el in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Yahudah (Judah), and from all the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel): Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.
verses.text: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Yahudah, and from all the mountains of Yashar'el: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.

verses.raw: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Yashar'el (Israel): only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.
verses.text: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Yashar'el: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.

verses.raw: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Yashar'el (Israel) according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.
verses.text: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that Yahuah said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Yashar'el according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.

verses.raw: Now these are the kings of the land, which the children of Yashar'el (Israel) smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:
verses.text: Now these are the kings of the land, which the children of Yashar'el smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:

verses.raw: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

verses.raw: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea on the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdoth-pisgah:
verses.text: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea on the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdoth-pisgah:

verses.raw: And the coast of Og king of Bashan, which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
verses.text: And the coast of Og king of Bashan, which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

verses.raw: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
verses.text: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

verses.raw: Them did Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) smite: and Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.
verses.text: Them did Moses the servant of Yahuah and the children of Yashar'el smite: and Moses the servant of Yahuah gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.

verses.raw: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goes up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) for a possession according to their divisions;
verses.text: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Yashar'el smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goes up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Yashar'el for a possession according to their divisions;

verses.raw: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
verses.text: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:

verses.raw: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Beth-el, one;

verses.raw: Then the children of Yahudah (Judah) came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, You know the thing that Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses the man of Elohim (God) concerning me and you in Kadesh-barnea.
verses.text: Then the children of Yahudah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, You know the thing that Yahuah said unto Moses the man of Elohim concerning me and you in Kadesh-barnea.

verses.raw: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) sent me from Kadesh-barnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in my heart.
verses.text: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of Yahuah sent me from Kadesh-barnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in my heart.

verses.raw: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God).
verses.text: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed Yahuah Elohai.

verses.raw: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon your feet have trodden shall be your inheritance, and your children’s for ever, because you have wholly followed Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God).
verses.text: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon your feet have trodden shall be your inheritance, and your children’s for ever, because you have wholly followed Yahuah Elohai.

verses.raw: And now, behold, Yahuah (LORD) has kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since Yahuah (LORD) spake this word unto Moses, while the children of Yashar'el (Israel) wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.
verses.text: And now, behold, Yahuah has kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since Yahuah spake this word unto Moses, while the children of Yashar'el wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.

verses.raw: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.
verses.text: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.

verses.raw: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof Yahuah (LORD) spake in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be Yahuah (LORD) will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as Yahuah (LORD) said.

verses.raw: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why have you given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as Yahuah (LORD) has blessed me hitherto?

verses.raw: And Joshua answered them, If you be a great people, then get you up to the wood country, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for you.

verses.text: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Yashar'el out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of Yahuah by the hand of Moses.

verses.raw: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.
verses.text: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And when the children of Yashar'el (Israel) heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.
verses.text: And when the children of Yashar'el heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Yashar'el gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,

verses.raw: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel); and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Yashar'el; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,
verses.text: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says the whole congregation of Yahuah (LORD), What trespass is this that you have committed against the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), to turn away this day from following Yahuah (LORD), in that you have builded you an altar, that you might rebel this day against Yahuah (LORD)?
verses.text: Thus says the whole congregation of Yahuah, What trespass is this that you have committed against the Elohim of Yashar'el, to turn away this day from following Yahuah, in that you have builded you an altar, that you might rebel this day against Yahuah?

verses.raw: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of Yahuah (LORD),
verses.text: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of Yahuah,

verses.raw: But that you must turn away this day from following Yahuah (LORD)? and it will be, seeing you rebel to day against Yahuah (LORD), that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But that you must turn away this day from following Yahuah? and it will be, seeing you rebel to day against Yahuah, that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass you over unto the land of the possession of Yahuah (LORD), wherein the LORD’S tabernacle dwells, and take possession among us: but rebel not against Yahuah (LORD), nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
verses.text: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass you over unto the land of the possession of Yahuah, wherein the LORD’S tabernacle dwells, and take possession among us: but rebel not against Yahuah, nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of Yahuah Eloheinu.

verses.raw: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel)? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.
verses.text: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Yashar'el? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.

verses.raw: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Yashar'el (Israel),
verses.text: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Yashar'el,

verses.raw: Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God) of gods, Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of gods, he knows, and Yashar'el (Israel) he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against Yahuah (LORD), (save us not this day,)
verses.text: Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God) of gods, Yahuah Elohim of gods, he knows, and Yashar'el he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against Yahuah, (save us not this day,)

verses.raw: That we have built us an altar to turn from following Yahuah (LORD), or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let Yahuah (LORD) himself require it;
verses.text: That we have built us an altar to turn from following Yahuah, or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let Yahuah himself require it;

verses.raw: And if we have not rather done it for fear of this thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have you to do with Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: And if we have not rather done it for fear of this thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have you to do with Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) has made Jordan a border between us and you, you children of Reuben and children of Gad; you have no part in Yahuah (LORD): so shall your children make our children cease from fearing Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: For Yahuah has made Jordan a border between us and you, you children of Reuben and children of Gad; you have no part in Yahuah: so shall your children make our children cease from fearing Yahuah.

verses.raw: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:
verses.text: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:

verses.raw: But that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of Yahuah (LORD) before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, You have no part in Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of Yahuah before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, You have no part in Yahuah.

verses.raw: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say again, Behold the pattern of the altar of Yahuah (LORD), which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a witness between us and you.
verses.text: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say again, Behold the pattern of the altar of Yahuah, which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a witness between us and you.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) forbid that we should rebel against Yahuah (LORD), and turn this day from following Yahuah (LORD), to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) that is before his tabernacle.
verses.text: Elohim forbid that we should rebel against Yahuah, and turn this day from following Yahuah, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of Yahuah Eloheinu that is before his tabernacle.

verses.raw: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Yashar'el (Israel) which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.
verses.text: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Yashar'el which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.

verses.raw: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that Yahuah (LORD) is among us, because you have not committed this trespass against Yahuah (LORD): now you have delivered the children of Yashar'el (Israel) out of the hand of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that Yahuah is among us, because you have not committed this trespass against Yahuah: now you have delivered the children of Yashar'el out of the hand of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and brought them word again.
verses.text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Yashar'el, and brought them word again.

verses.raw: And the thing pleased the children of Yashar'el (Israel); and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) blessed Elohim (God), and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.
verses.text: And the thing pleased the children of Yashar'el; and the children of Yashar'el blessed Elohim, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.

verses.raw: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that Yahuah (LORD) is Elohim (God).
verses.text: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that Yahuah is Elohim.

verses.raw: And it came to pass a long time after that Yahuah (LORD) had given rest unto Yashar'el (Israel) from all their enemies round about, that Joshua waxed old and stricken in age.
verses.text: And it came to pass a long time after that Yahuah had given rest unto Yashar'el from all their enemies round about, that Joshua waxed old and stricken in age.

verses.raw: And Joshua called for all Yashar'el (Israel), and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and stricken in age:
verses.text: And Joshua called for all Yashar'el, and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and stricken in age:

verses.raw: And you have seen all that Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has done unto all these nations because of you; for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) is he that has fought for you.
verses.text: And you have seen all that Yahuah Elohaychem has done unto all these nations because of you; for Yahuah Elohaychem is he that has fought for you.

verses.raw: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.
verses.text: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.

verses.raw: And Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and you shall possess their land, as Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has promised unto you.
verses.text: And Yahuah Elohaychem, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and you shall possess their land, as Yahuah Elohaychem has promised unto you.

verses.raw: Be you therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;
verses.text: Be you therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;

verses.raw: That you come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:
verses.text: That you come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:

verses.raw: But cleave unto Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), as you have done unto this day.
verses.text: But cleave unto Yahuah Elohaychem, as you have done unto this day.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) has driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man has been able to stand before you unto this day.
verses.text: For Yahuah has driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man has been able to stand before you unto this day.

verses.raw: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), he it is that fighteth for you, as he has promised you.
verses.text: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for Yahuah Elohaychem, he it is that fighteth for you, as he has promised you.

verses.raw: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that you love Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that you love Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: Else if you do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:
verses.text: Else if you do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:

verses.raw: Know for a certainty that Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has given you.
verses.text: Know for a certainty that Yahuah Elohaychem will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which Yahuah Elohaychem has given you.

verses.raw: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and you know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing has failed of all the good things which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, and not one thing has failed thereof.
verses.text: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and you know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing has failed of all the good things which Yahuah Elohaychem spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, and not one thing has failed thereof.

verses.raw: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come upon you, which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) promised you; so shall Yahuah (LORD) bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has given you.
verses.text: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come upon you, which Yahuah Elohaychem promised you; so shall Yahuah bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which Yahuah Elohaychem has given you.

verses.raw: When you have transgressed the covenant of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of Yahuah (LORD) be kindled against you, and you shall perish quickly from off the good land which he has given unto you.
verses.text: When you have transgressed the covenant of Yahuah Elohaychem, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of Yahuah be kindled against you, and you shall perish quickly from off the good land which he has given unto you.

verses.raw: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) to Shechem, and called for the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before Elohim (God).
verses.text: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Yashar'el to Shechem, and called for the elders of Yashar'el, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before Elohim.

verses.raw: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.
verses.text: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.

verses.raw: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.
verses.text: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.

verses.raw: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
verses.text: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

verses.raw: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
verses.text: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

verses.raw: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.
verses.text: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.

verses.raw: And when they cried unto Yahuah (LORD), he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and you dwelt in the wilderness a long season.
verses.text: And when they cried unto Yahuah, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and you dwelt in the wilderness a long season.

verses.raw: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that you might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.
verses.text: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that you might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.

verses.raw: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Yashar'el (Israel), and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:
verses.text: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Yashar'el, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:

verses.raw: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.
verses.text: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.

verses.raw: And you went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.
verses.text: And you went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.

verses.raw: And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with your sword, nor with your bow.
verses.text: And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with your sword, nor with your bow.

verses.raw: And I have given you a land for which you did not labour, and cities which you built not, and you dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which you planted not do you eat.
verses.text: And I have given you a land for which you did not labour, and cities which you built not, and you dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which you planted not do you eat.

verses.raw: Now therefore fear Yahuah (LORD), and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve you Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Now therefore fear Yahuah, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve you Yahuah.

verses.raw: And if it seem evil unto you to serve Yahuah (LORD), choose you this day whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And if it seem evil unto you to serve Yahuah, choose you this day whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the people answered and said, Elohim (God) forbid that we should forsake Yahuah (LORD), to serve other gods;
verses.text: And the people answered and said, Elohim forbid that we should forsake Yahuah, to serve other gods;

verses.raw: For Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:
verses.text: For Yahuah Eloheinu, he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: therefore will we also serve Yahuah (LORD); for he is our Elohim (God).
verses.text: And Yahuah drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: therefore will we also serve Yahuah; for he is our Elohim.

verses.raw: And Joshua said unto the people, You cannot serve Yahuah (LORD): for he is an holy Elohim (God); he is a jealous Elohim (God); he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.
verses.text: And Joshua said unto the people, You cannot serve Yahuah: for he is an holy Elohim; he is a jealous Elohim; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.

verses.raw: If you forsake Yahuah (LORD), and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he has done you good.
verses.text: If you forsake Yahuah, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he has done you good.

verses.raw: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Joshua said unto the people, You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen you Yahuah (LORD), to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.
verses.text: And Joshua said unto the people, You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen you Yahuah, to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.

verses.raw: Now therefore put away, said he, the strange gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Now therefore put away, said he, the strange gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And the people said unto Joshua, Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) will we serve, and his voice will we obey.
verses.text: And the people said unto Joshua, Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) will we serve, and his voice will we obey.

verses.raw: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
verses.text: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

verses.raw: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of Elohim (God), and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of Elohim, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it has heard all the words of Yahuah (LORD) which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest you deny your Elohim (God).
verses.text: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it has heard all the words of Yahuah which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest you deny your Elohim.

verses.raw: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.
verses.text: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahuah (LORD), died, being an hundred and ten years old.
verses.text: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahuah, died, being an hundred and ten years old.

verses.raw: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.
verses.text: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.

verses.raw: And Yashar'el (Israel) served Yahuah (LORD) all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of Yahuah (LORD), that he had done for Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Yashar'el served Yahuah all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of Yahuah, that he had done for Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Yashar'el (Israel) brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
verses.text: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Yashar'el brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

verses.raw: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.
verses.text: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.

verses.raw: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Yashar'el (Israel) asked Yahuah (LORD), saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?
verses.text: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Yashar'el asked Yahuah, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said, Yahudah (Judah) shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.
verses.text: And Yahuah said, Yahudah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with you into your lot. So Simeon went with him.
verses.text: And Yahudah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with you into your lot. So Simeon went with him.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) went up; and Yahuah (LORD) delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.
verses.text: And Yahudah went up; and Yahuah delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.

verses.raw: And they found Adoni-bezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
verses.text: And they found Adoni-bezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

verses.raw: But Adoni-bezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.
verses.text: But Adoni-bezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.

verses.raw: And Adoni-bezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table: as I have done, so Elohim (God) has requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.
verses.text: And Adoni-bezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table: as I have done, so Elohim has requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.

verses.raw: Now the children of Yahudah (Judah) had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
verses.text: Now the children of Yahudah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

verses.raw: And afterward the children of Yahudah (Judah) went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.
verses.text: And afterward the children of Yahudah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before was Kirjath-arba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.
verses.text: And Yahudah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before was Kirjath-arba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.

verses.raw: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher:
verses.text: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher:

verses.raw: And Caleb said, He that smites Kirjath-sepher, and takes it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
verses.text: And Caleb said, He that smites Kirjath-sepher, and takes it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

verses.raw: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
verses.text: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when she came to him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What will you?
verses.text: And it came to pass, when she came to him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What will you?

verses.raw: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for you have given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.
verses.text: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for you have given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.

verses.raw: And the children of the Kenite, Moses’ father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Yahudah (Judah) into the wilderness of Yahudah (Judah), which lies in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.
