verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.
verses.text: And Yahudah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.

verses.raw: Also Yahudah (Judah) took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.
verses.text: Also Yahudah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) was with Yahudah (Judah); and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
verses.text: And Yahuah was with Yahudah; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

verses.raw: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.
verses.text: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.

verses.raw: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.
verses.text: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.

verses.raw: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Beth-el: and Yahuah (LORD) was with them.
verses.text: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Beth-el: and Yahuah was with them.

verses.raw: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Beth-el. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)
verses.text: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Beth-el. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)

verses.raw: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray you, the entrance into the city, and we will shew you mercy.
verses.text: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray you, the entrance into the city, and we will shew you mercy.

verses.raw: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.
verses.text: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.

verses.raw: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof unto this day.
verses.text: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof unto this day.

verses.raw: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
verses.text: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Yashar'el (Israel) was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Yashar'el was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.

verses.raw: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.
verses.text: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.

verses.raw: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.
verses.text: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.

verses.raw: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:
verses.text: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:

verses.raw: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.
verses.text: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.

verses.raw: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth-anath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and of Beth-anath became tributaries unto them.
verses.text: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth-anath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and of Beth-anath became tributaries unto them.

verses.raw: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:
verses.text: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:

verses.raw: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.
verses.text: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.

verses.raw: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
verses.text: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.

verses.raw: And an angel of Yahuah (LORD) came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.
verses.text: And an angel of Yahuah came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.

verses.raw: And you shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; you shall throw down their altars: but you have not obeyed my voice: why have you done this?
verses.text: And you shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; you shall throw down their altars: but you have not obeyed my voice: why have you done this?

verses.raw: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.
verses.text: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the angel of Yahuah (LORD) spake these words unto all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the angel of Yahuah spake these words unto all the children of Yashar'el, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.

verses.raw: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.
verses.text: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Yashar'el went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.

verses.raw: And the people served Yahuah (LORD) all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of Yahuah (LORD), that he did for Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the people served Yahuah all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of Yahuah, that he did for Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahuah (LORD), died, being an hundred and ten years old.
verses.text: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahuah, died, being an hundred and ten years old.

verses.raw: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-heres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.
verses.text: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-heres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.

verses.raw: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, which knew not Yahuah (LORD), nor yet the works which he had done for Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, which knew not Yahuah, nor yet the works which he had done for Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and served Baalim:
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el did evil in the sight of Yahuah, and served Baalim:

verses.raw: And they forsook Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked Yahuah (LORD) to anger.
verses.text: And they forsook Yahuah Elohim of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked Yahuah to anger.

verses.raw: And they forsook Yahuah (LORD), and served Baal and Ashtaroth.
verses.text: And they forsook Yahuah, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.

verses.raw: And the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was hot against Yashar'el (Israel), and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.
verses.text: And the anger of Yahuah was hot against Yashar'el, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.

verses.raw: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of Yahuah (LORD) was against them for evil, as Yahuah (LORD) had said, and as Yahuah (LORD) had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.
verses.text: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of Yahuah was against them for evil, as Yahuah had said, and as Yahuah had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.

verses.raw: Nevertheless Yahuah (LORD) raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.
verses.text: Nevertheless Yahuah raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.

verses.raw: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of Yahuah (LORD); but they did not so.
verses.text: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of Yahuah; but they did not so.

verses.raw: And when Yahuah (LORD) raised them up judges, then Yahuah (LORD) was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented Yahuah (LORD) because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.
verses.text: And when Yahuah raised them up judges, then Yahuah was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented Yahuah because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.

verses.raw: And the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was hot against Yashar'el (Israel); and he said, Because that this people has transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;
verses.text: And the anger of Yahuah was hot against Yashar'el; and he said, Because that this people has transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;

verses.raw: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:
verses.text: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:

verses.raw: That through them I may prove Yashar'el (Israel), whether they will keep the way of Yahuah (LORD) to walk therein, as their fathers did keep it, or not.
verses.text: That through them I may prove Yashar'el, whether they will keep the way of Yahuah to walk therein, as their fathers did keep it, or not.

verses.raw: Therefore Yahuah (LORD) left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.
verses.text: Therefore Yahuah left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.

verses.raw: Now these are the nations which Yahuah (LORD) left, to prove Yashar'el (Israel) by them, even as many of Yashar'el (Israel) as had not known all the wars of Canaan;
verses.text: Now these are the nations which Yahuah left, to prove Yashar'el by them, even as many of Yashar'el as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

verses.raw: Only that the generations of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;
verses.text: Only that the generations of the children of Yashar'el might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;

verses.raw: Namely, five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baal-hermon unto the entering in of Hamath.
verses.text: Namely, five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baal-hermon unto the entering in of Hamath.

verses.raw: And they were to prove Yashar'el (Israel) by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of Yahuah (LORD), which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.
verses.text: And they were to prove Yashar'el by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of Yahuah, which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:

verses.raw: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
verses.text: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and forgat Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), and served Baalim and the groves.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el did evil in the sight of Yahuah, and forgat Yahuah their Elohim, and served Baalim and the groves.

verses.raw: Therefore the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was hot against Yashar'el (Israel), and he sold them into the hand of Chushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) served Chushan-rishathaim eight years.
verses.text: Therefore the anger of Yahuah was hot against Yashar'el, and he sold them into the hand of Chushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Yashar'el served Chushan-rishathaim eight years.

verses.raw: And when the children of Yashar'el (Israel) cried unto Yahuah (LORD), Yahuah (LORD) raised up a deliverer to the children of Yashar'el (Israel), who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.
verses.text: And when the children of Yashar'el cried unto Yahuah, Yahuah raised up a deliverer to the children of Yashar'el, who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.

verses.raw: And the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) came upon him, and he judged Yashar'el (Israel), and went out to war: and Yahuah (LORD) delivered Chushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushan-rishathaim.
verses.text: And the Spirit of Yahuah came upon him, and he judged Yashar'el, and went out to war: and Yahuah delivered Chushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushan-rishathaim.

verses.raw: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
verses.text: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did evil again in the sight of Yahuah (LORD): and Yahuah (LORD) strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Yashar'el (Israel), because they had done evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el did evil again in the sight of Yahuah: and Yahuah strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Yashar'el, because they had done evil in the sight of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Yashar'el (Israel), and possessed the city of palm trees.
verses.text: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Yashar'el, and possessed the city of palm trees.

verses.raw: So the children of Yashar'el (Israel) served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.
verses.text: So the children of Yashar'el served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

verses.raw: But when the children of Yashar'el (Israel) cried unto Yahuah (LORD), Yahuah (LORD) raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Yashar'el (Israel) sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.
verses.text: But when the children of Yashar'el cried unto Yahuah, Yahuah raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Yashar'el sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.

verses.raw: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.

verses.raw: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon was a very fat man.
verses.text: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon was a very fat man.

verses.raw: And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent away the people that bare the present.

verses.raw: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto you, O king: who said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.
verses.text: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto you, O king: who said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.

verses.raw: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting in a summer parlour, which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from Elohim (God) unto you. And he arose out of his seat.
verses.text: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting in a summer parlour, which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from Elohim unto you. And he arose out of his seat.

verses.raw: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:
verses.text: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:

verses.raw: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.
verses.text: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.

verses.raw: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.
verses.text: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.

verses.raw: When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour were locked, they said, Surely he covers his feet in his summer chamber.
verses.text: When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour were locked, they said, Surely he covers his feet in his summer chamber.

verses.raw: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened them: and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.
verses.text: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened them: and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.

verses.raw: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirath.
verses.text: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirath.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went down with him from the mount, and he before them.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Yashar'el went down with him from the mount, and he before them.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Follow after me: for Yahuah (LORD) has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and suffered not a man to pass over.
verses.text: And he said unto them, Follow after me: for Yahuah has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and suffered not a man to pass over.

verses.raw: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.
verses.text: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.

verses.raw: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Yashar'el (Israel). And the land had rest fourscore years.
verses.text: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Yashar'el. And the land had rest fourscore years.

verses.raw: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) again did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), when Ehud was dead.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el again did evil in the sight of Yahuah, when Ehud was dead.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.
verses.text: And Yahuah sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) cried unto Yahuah (LORD): for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el cried unto Yahuah: for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Yashar'el (Israel) at that time.
verses.text: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Yashar'el at that time.

verses.raw: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth-el in mount Ephraim: and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) came up to her for judgment.
verses.text: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth-el in mount Ephraim: and the children of Yashar'el came up to her for judgment.

verses.raw: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh-naphtali, and said unto him, Has not Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) commanded, saying, Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?
verses.text: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh-naphtali, and said unto him, Has not Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el commanded, saying, Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

verses.raw: And I will draw unto you to the river Kishon Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into your hand.
verses.text: And I will draw unto you to the river Kishon Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into your hand.

verses.raw: And Barak said unto her, If you will go with me, then I will go: but if you will not go with me, then I will not go.
verses.text: And Barak said unto her, If you will go with me, then I will go: but if you will not go with me, then I will not go.

verses.raw: And she said, I will surely go with you: notwithstanding the journey that you take shall not be for your honour; for Yahuah (LORD) shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.
verses.text: And she said, I will surely go with you: notwithstanding the journey that you take shall not be for your honour; for Yahuah shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

verses.raw: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.
verses.text: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.

verses.raw: Now Heber the Kenite, which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanaim, which is by Kedesh.
verses.text: Now Heber the Kenite, which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanaim, which is by Kedesh.

verses.raw: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.
verses.text: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.

verses.raw: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles unto the river of Kishon.
verses.text: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles unto the river of Kishon.

verses.raw: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which Yahuah (LORD) has delivered Sisera into your hand: is not Yahuah (LORD) gone out before you? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.
verses.text: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which Yahuah has delivered Sisera into your hand: is not Yahuah gone out before you? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) discomfited Sisera, and all his chariots, and all his host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot, and fled away on his feet.
verses.text: And Yahuah discomfited Sisera, and all his chariots, and all his host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot, and fled away on his feet.

verses.raw: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; and there was not a man left.
verses.text: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; and there was not a man left.

verses.raw: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
verses.text: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

verses.raw: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And when he had turned in unto her into the tent, she covered him with a mantle.
verses.text: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And when he had turned in unto her into the tent, she covered him with a mantle.

verses.raw: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray you, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.
verses.text: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray you, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.

verses.raw: Again he said unto her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man does come and enquire of you, and say, Is there any man here? that you shall say, No.
verses.text: Again he said unto her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man does come and enquire of you, and say, Is there any man here? that you shall say, No.

verses.raw: Then Jael Heber’s wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.
verses.text: Then Jael Heber’s wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.

verses.raw: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will shew you the man whom you seek. And when he came into her tent, behold, Sisera lay dead, and the nail was in his temples.
verses.text: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will shew you the man whom you seek. And when he came into her tent, behold, Sisera lay dead, and the nail was in his temples.

verses.raw: So Elohim (God) subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: So Elohim subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And the hand of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) prospered, and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
verses.text: And the hand of the children of Yashar'el prospered, and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.

verses.raw: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,
verses.text: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,

verses.raw: Praise you Yahuah (LORD) for the avenging of Yashar'el (Israel), when the people willingly offered themselves.
verses.text: Praise you Yahuah for the avenging of Yashar'el, when the people willingly offered themselves.

verses.raw: Hear, O you kings; give ear, O you princes; I, even I, will sing unto Yahuah (LORD); I will sing praise to Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Hear, O you kings; give ear, O you princes; I, even I, will sing unto Yahuah; I will sing praise to Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), when you went out of Seir, when you marchedst out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, and the heavens dropped, the clouds also dropped water.
verses.text: Yahuah, when you went out of Seir, when you marchedst out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, and the heavens dropped, the clouds also dropped water.

verses.raw: The mountains melted from before Yahuah (LORD), even that Sinai from before Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: The mountains melted from before Yahuah, even that Sinai from before Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, and the travellers walked through byways.
verses.text: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, and the travellers walked through byways.

verses.raw: The inhabitants of the villages ceased, they ceased in Yashar'el (Israel), until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: The inhabitants of the villages ceased, they ceased in Yashar'el, until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: They chose new gods; then was war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: They chose new gods; then was war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Yashar'el?

verses.raw: My heart is toward the governors of Yashar'el (Israel), that offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless you Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: My heart is toward the governors of Yashar'el, that offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless you Yahuah.

verses.raw: Speak, you that ride on white asses, you that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.
verses.text: Speak, you that ride on white asses, you that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.

verses.raw: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of Yahuah (LORD), even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Yashar'el (Israel): then shall the people of Yahuah (LORD) go down to the gates.
verses.text: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of Yahuah, even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Yashar'el: then shall the people of Yahuah go down to the gates.

verses.raw: Awake, awake, Deborah: awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barak, and lead your captivity captive, you son of Abinoam.
verses.text: Awake, awake, Deborah: awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barak, and lead your captivity captive, you son of Abinoam.

verses.raw: Then he made him that remains have dominion over the nobles among the people: Yahuah (LORD) made me have dominion over the mighty.
verses.text: Then he made him that remains have dominion over the nobles among the people: Yahuah made me have dominion over the mighty.

verses.raw: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek; after you, Benjamin, among your people; out of Machir came down governors, and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.
verses.text: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek; after you, Benjamin, among your people; out of Machir came down governors, and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.

verses.raw: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; even Issachar, and also Barak: he was sent on foot into the valley. For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart.
verses.text: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; even Issachar, and also Barak: he was sent on foot into the valley. For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart.

verses.raw: Why abodest you among the sheepfolds, to hear the bleatings of the flocks? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.
verses.text: Why abodest you among the sheepfolds, to hear the bleatings of the flocks? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.

verses.raw: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: and why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the sea shore, and abode in his breaches.
verses.text: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: and why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the sea shore, and abode in his breaches.

verses.raw: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field.
verses.text: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field.

verses.raw: The kings came and fought, then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; they took no gain of money.
verses.text: The kings came and fought, then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; they took no gain of money.

verses.raw: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.
verses.text: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.

verses.raw: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, you have trodden down strength.
verses.text: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, you have trodden down strength.

verses.raw: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings, the pransings of their mighty ones.
verses.text: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings, the pransings of their mighty ones.

verses.raw: Curse you Meroz, said the angel of Yahuah (LORD), curse you bitterly the inhabitants thereof; because they came not to the help of Yahuah (LORD), to the help of Yahuah (LORD) against the mighty.
verses.text: Curse you Meroz, said the angel of Yahuah, curse you bitterly the inhabitants thereof; because they came not to the help of Yahuah, to the help of Yahuah against the mighty.

verses.raw: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be, blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
verses.text: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be, blessed shall she be above women in the tent.

verses.raw: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.
verses.text: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.

verses.raw: She put her hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workmen’s hammer; and with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote off his head, when she had pierced and stricken through his temples.
verses.text: She put her hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workmen’s hammer; and with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote off his head, when she had pierced and stricken through his temples.

verses.raw: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: at her feet he bowed, he fell: where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
verses.text: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: at her feet he bowed, he fell: where he bowed, there he fell down dead.

verses.raw: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?
verses.text: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?

verses.raw: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,
verses.text: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,

verses.raw: Have they not sped? have they not divided the prey; to every man a damsel or two; to Sisera a prey of divers colours, a prey of divers colours of needlework, of divers colours of needlework on both sides, meet for the necks of them that take the spoil?
verses.text: Have they not sped? have they not divided the prey; to every man a damsel or two; to Sisera a prey of divers colours, a prey of divers colours of needlework, of divers colours of needlework on both sides, meet for the necks of them that take the spoil?

verses.raw: So let all your enemies perish, O Yahuah (LORD): but let them that love him be as the sun when he goes forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.
verses.text: So let all your enemies perish, O Yahuah: but let them that love him be as the sun when he goes forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD): and Yahuah (LORD) delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el did evil in the sight of Yahuah: and Yahuah delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.

verses.raw: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Yashar'el (Israel): and because of the Midianites the children of Yashar'el (Israel) made them the dens which are in the mountains, and caves, and strong holds.
verses.text: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Yashar'el: and because of the Midianites the children of Yashar'el made them the dens which are in the mountains, and caves, and strong holds.

verses.raw: And so it was, when Yashar'el (Israel) had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up against them;
verses.text: And so it was, when Yashar'el had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up against them;

verses.raw: And they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till you come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance for Yashar'el (Israel), neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.
verses.text: And they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till you come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance for Yashar'el, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.

verses.raw: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as grasshoppers for multitude; for both they and their camels were without number: and they entered into the land to destroy it.
verses.text: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as grasshoppers for multitude; for both they and their camels were without number: and they entered into the land to destroy it.

verses.raw: And Yashar'el (Israel) was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) cried unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Yashar'el was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Yashar'el cried unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the children of Yashar'el (Israel) cried unto Yahuah (LORD) because of the Midianites,
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the children of Yashar'el cried unto Yahuah because of the Midianites,

verses.raw: That Yahuah (LORD) sent a prophet unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which said unto them, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;
verses.text: That Yahuah sent a prophet unto the children of Yashar'el, which said unto them, Thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;

verses.raw: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drave them out from before you, and gave you their land;
verses.text: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drave them out from before you, and gave you their land;

verses.raw: And I said unto you, I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God); fear not the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell: but you have not obeyed my voice.
verses.text: And I said unto you, I am Yahuah Elohaychem; fear not the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell: but you have not obeyed my voice.

verses.raw: And there came an angel of Yahuah (LORD), and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abi-ezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.
verses.text: And there came an angel of Yahuah, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abi-ezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.

verses.raw: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto him, and said unto him, Yahuah (LORD) is with you, you mighty man of valour.
verses.text: And the angel of Yahuah appeared unto him, and said unto him, Yahuah is with you, you mighty man of valour.

verses.raw: And Gideon said unto him, Oh my Lord, if Yahuah (LORD) be with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not Yahuah (LORD) bring us up from Egypt? but now Yahuah (LORD) has forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.
verses.text: And Gideon said unto him, Oh my Lord, if Yahuah be with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not Yahuah bring us up from Egypt? but now Yahuah has forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) looked upon him, and said, Go in this your might, and you shall save Yashar'el (Israel) from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent you?
verses.text: And Yahuah looked upon him, and said, Go in this your might, and you shall save Yashar'el from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent you?

verses.raw: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Yashar'el (Israel)? behold, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father’s house.
verses.text: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Yashar'el? behold, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father’s house.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Surely I will be with you, and you shall smite the Midianites as one man.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto him, Surely I will be with you, and you shall smite the Midianites as one man.

verses.raw: And he said unto him, If now I have found grace in your sight, then shew me a sign that you talkest with me.
verses.text: And he said unto him, If now I have found grace in your sight, then shew me a sign that you talkest with me.

verses.raw: Depart not hence, I pray you, until I come unto you, and bring forth my present, and set it before you. And he said, I will tarry until you come again.
verses.text: Depart not hence, I pray you, until I come unto you, and bring forth my present, and set it before you. And he said, I will tarry until you come again.

verses.raw: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out unto him under the oak, and presented it.
verses.text: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out unto him under the oak, and presented it.

verses.raw: And the angel of Elohim (God) said unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.
verses.text: And the angel of Elohim said unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.

verses.raw: Then the angel of Yahuah (LORD) put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of Yahuah (LORD) departed out of his sight.
verses.text: Then the angel of Yahuah put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of Yahuah departed out of his sight.

verses.raw: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of Yahuah (LORD), Gideon said, Alas, O Adonai (Lord) GOD! for because I have seen an angel of Yahuah (LORD) face to face.
verses.text: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of Yahuah, Gideon said, Alas, O Adonai GOD! for because I have seen an angel of Yahuah face to face.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Peace be unto you; fear not: you shall not die.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto him, Peace be unto you; fear not: you shall not die.

verses.raw: Then Gideon built an altar there unto Yahuah (LORD), and called it Yahuah Shalom (Jehovah-shalom): unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abi-ezrites.
verses.text: Then Gideon built an altar there unto Yahuah, and called it Yahuah Shalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abi-ezrites.

verses.raw: And it came to pass the same night, that Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Take your father’s young bullock, even the second bullock of seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that your father has, and cut down the grove that is by it:

verses.raw: And build an altar unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which you shall cut down.
verses.text: And build an altar unto Yahuah Elohayka upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which you shall cut down.

verses.raw: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as Yahuah (LORD) had said unto him: and so it was, because he feared his father’s household, and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.
verses.text: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as Yahuah had said unto him: and so it was, because he feared his father’s household, and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.

verses.raw: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that was by it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built.
verses.text: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that was by it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built.

verses.raw: And they said one to another, Who has done this thing? And when they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash has done this thing.
verses.text: And they said one to another, Who has done this thing? And when they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash has done this thing.

verses.raw: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out your son, that he may die: because he has cast down the altar of Baal, and because he has cut down the grove that was by it.
verses.text: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out your son, that he may die: because he has cast down the altar of Baal, and because he has cut down the grove that was by it.

verses.raw: And Joash said unto all that stood against him, Will you plead for Baal? will you save him? he that will plead for him, let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning: if he be a god, let him plead for himself, because one has cast down his altar.

verses.raw: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal plead against him, because he has thrown down his altar.

verses.raw: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together, and went over, and pitched in the valley of Jezreel.

verses.raw: But the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) came upon Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abi-ezer was gathered after him.

verses.raw: And Gideon said unto Elohim (God), If you will save Yashar'el (Israel) by my hand, as you have said,

verses.raw: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that you will save Yashar'el (Israel) by my hand, as you have said.

verses.raw: And it was so: for he rose up early on the morrow, and thrust the fleece together, and wringed the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.
verses.text: And it was so: for he rose up early on the morrow, and thrust the fleece together, and wringed the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.

verses.raw: And Gideon said unto Elohim (God), Let not your anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once: let me prove, I pray you, but this once with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.
verses.text: And Elohim did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.

verses.raw: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people that were with him, rose up early, and pitched beside the well of Harod: so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Gideon, The people that are with you are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Yashar'el (Israel) vaunt themselves against me, saying, My own hand has saved me.

verses.raw: Now therefore go to, proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, Whosoever is fearful and afraid, let him return and depart early from mount Gilead. And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand; and there remained ten thousand.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Gideon, The people are yet too many; bring them down unto the water, and I will try them for you there: and it shall be, that of whom I say unto you, This shall go with you, the same shall go with you; and of whomsoever I say unto you, This shall not go with you, the same shall not go.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Gideon, The people are yet too many; bring them down unto the water, and I will try them for you there: and it shall be, that of whom I say unto you, This shall go with you, the same shall go with you; and of whomsoever I say unto you, This shall not go with you, the same shall not go.

verses.raw: So he brought down the people unto the water: and Yahuah (LORD) said unto Gideon, Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue, as a dog lappeth, him shall you set by himself; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink.
verses.text: So he brought down the people unto the water: and Yahuah said unto Gideon, Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue, as a dog lappeth, him shall you set by himself; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink.

verses.raw: And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.
verses.text: And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into your hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.

verses.raw: So the people took victuals in their hand, and their trumpets: and he sent all the rest of Yashar'el (Israel) every man unto his tent, and retained those three hundred men: and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley.

verses.raw: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand by the sea side for multitude.

verses.raw: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.

verses.raw: And his fellow answered and said, This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Yashar'el (Israel): for into his hand has Elohim (God) delivered Midian, and all the host.
verses.text: And his fellow answered and said, This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Yashar'el: for into his hand has Elohim delivered Midian, and all the host.

verses.raw: And it was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation thereof, that he worshipped, and returned into the host of Yashar'el (Israel), and said, Arise; for Yahuah (LORD) has delivered into your hand the host of Midian.
verses.text: And it was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation thereof, that he worshipped, and returned into the host of Yashar'el, and said, Arise; for Yahuah has delivered into your hand the host of Midian.

verses.raw: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man’s hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.
verses.text: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man’s hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold, when I come to the outside of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so shall you do.
verses.text: And he said unto them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold, when I come to the outside of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so shall you do.

verses.raw: When I blow with a trumpet, I and all that are with me, then blow you the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and say, The sword of Yahuah (LORD), and of Gideon.
verses.text: When I blow with a trumpet, I and all that are with me, then blow you the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and say, The sword of Yahuah, and of Gideon.

verses.raw: So Gideon, and the hundred men that were with him, came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch; and they had but newly set the watch: and they blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers that were in their hands.

verses.raw: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of Yahuah (LORD), and of Gideon.
verses.text: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of Yahuah, and of Gideon.

verses.raw: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp: and all the host ran, and cried, and fled.

verses.raw: And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and Yahuah (LORD) set every man’s sword against his fellow, even throughout all the host: and the host fled to Beth-shittah in Zererath, and to the border of Abel-meholah, unto Tabbath.

verses.raw: And the men of Yashar'el (Israel) gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after the Midianites.
verses.text: And the men of Yashar'el gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after the Midianites.

verses.raw: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, Come down against the Midianites, and take before them the waters unto Beth-barah and Jordan. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and took the waters unto Beth-barah and Jordan.

verses.raw: And they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb, and pursued Midian, and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan.

verses.raw: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why have you served us thus, that you called us not, when you went to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.
verses.text: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why have you served us thus, that you called us not, when you went to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abi-ezer?
verses.text: And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abi-ezer?

verses.raw: Elohim (God) has delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.

verses.raw: And Gideon came to Jordan, and passed over, he, and the three hundred men that were with him, faint, yet pursuing them.

verses.raw: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they be faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.
verses.text: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they be faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.

verses.text: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men were they whom you slew at Tabor? And they answered, As you are, so were they; each one resembled the children of a king.
