verses.raw: And they turned thitherward, and came to the house of the young man the Levite, even unto the house of Micah, and saluted him.
verses.text: And they turned thitherward, and came to the house of the young man the Levite, even unto the house of Micah, and saluted him.

verses.raw: And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war, which were of the children of Dan, stood by the entering of the gate.
verses.text: And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war, which were of the children of Dan, stood by the entering of the gate.

verses.raw: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up, and came in thither, and took the graven image, and the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image: and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men that were appointed with weapons of war.
verses.text: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up, and came in thither, and took the graven image, and the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image: and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men that were appointed with weapons of war.

verses.raw: And these went into Micah’s house, and fetched the carved image, the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image. Then said the priest unto them, What do you?
verses.text: And these went into Micah’s house, and fetched the carved image, the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image. Then said the priest unto them, What do you?

verses.raw: And they said unto him, Hold your peace, lay your hand upon your mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest: is it better for you to be a priest unto the house of one man, or that you be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: And they said unto him, Hold your peace, lay your hand upon your mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest: is it better for you to be a priest unto the house of one man, or that you be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Yashar'el?

verses.raw: And the priest’s heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the teraphim, and the graven image, and went in the midst of the people.
verses.text: And the priest’s heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the teraphim, and the graven image, and went in the midst of the people.

verses.raw: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them.
verses.text: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them.

verses.raw: And when they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men that were in the houses near to Micah’s house were gathered together, and overtook the children of Dan.
verses.text: And when they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men that were in the houses near to Micah’s house were gathered together, and overtook the children of Dan.

verses.raw: And they cried unto the children of Dan. And they turned their faces, and said unto Micah, What aileth you, that you come with such a company?
verses.text: And they cried unto the children of Dan. And they turned their faces, and said unto Micah, What aileth you, that you come with such a company?

verses.raw: And he said, You have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and you are gone away: and what have I more? and what is this that you say unto me, What aileth you?
verses.text: And he said, You have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and you are gone away: and what have I more? and what is this that you say unto me, What aileth you?

verses.raw: And the children of Dan said unto him, Let not your voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows run upon you, and you lose your life, with the lives of your household.
verses.text: And the children of Dan said unto him, Let not your voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows run upon you, and you lose your life, with the lives of your household.

verses.raw: And the children of Dan went their way: and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back unto his house.
verses.text: And the children of Dan went their way: and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back unto his house.

verses.raw: And they took the things which Micah had made, and the priest which he had, and came unto Laish, unto a people that were at quiet and secure: and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the city with fire.
verses.text: And they took the things which Micah had made, and the priest which he had, and came unto Laish, unto a people that were at quiet and secure: and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the city with fire.

verses.raw: And there was no deliverer, because it was far from Zidon, and they had no business with any man; and it was in the valley that lies by Beth-rehob. And they built a city, and dwelt therein.
verses.text: And there was no deliverer, because it was far from Zidon, and they had no business with any man; and it was in the valley that lies by Beth-rehob. And they built a city, and dwelt therein.

verses.raw: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born unto Yashar'el (Israel): howbeit the name of the city was Laish at the first.
verses.text: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born unto Yashar'el: howbeit the name of the city was Laish at the first.

verses.raw: And the children of Dan set up the graven image: and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.
verses.text: And the children of Dan set up the graven image: and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.

verses.raw: And they set them up Micah’s graven image, which he made, all the time that the house of Elohim (God) was in Shiloh.
verses.text: And they set them up Micah’s graven image, which he made, all the time that the house of Elohim was in Shiloh.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in those days, when there was no king in Yashar'el (Israel), that there was a certain Levite sojourning on the side of mount Ephraim, who took to him a concubine out of Beth-lehem-judah.
verses.text: And it came to pass in those days, when there was no king in Yashar'el, that there was a certain Levite sojourning on the side of mount Ephraim, who took to him a concubine out of Beth-lehem-judah.

verses.raw: And his concubine played the whore against him, and went away from him unto her father’s house to Beth-lehem-judah, and was there four whole months.
verses.text: And his concubine played the whore against him, and went away from him unto her father’s house to Beth-lehem-judah, and was there four whole months.

verses.raw: And her husband arose, and went after her, to speak friendly unto her, and to bring her again, having his servant with him, and a couple of asses: and she brought him into her father’s house: and when the father of the damsel saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.
verses.text: And her husband arose, and went after her, to speak friendly unto her, and to bring her again, having his servant with him, and a couple of asses: and she brought him into her father’s house: and when the father of the damsel saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.

verses.raw: And his father in law, the damsel’s father, retained him; and he abode with him three days: so they did eat and drink, and lodged there.
verses.text: And his father in law, the damsel’s father, retained him; and he abode with him three days: so they did eat and drink, and lodged there.

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the fourth day, when they arose early in the morning, that he rose up to depart: and the damsel’s father said unto his son in law, Comfort your heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward go your way.
verses.text: And it came to pass on the fourth day, when they arose early in the morning, that he rose up to depart: and the damsel’s father said unto his son in law, Comfort your heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward go your way.

verses.raw: And they sat down, and did eat and drink both of them together: for the damsel’s father had said unto the man, Be content, I pray you, and tarry all night, and let your heart be merry.
verses.text: And they sat down, and did eat and drink both of them together: for the damsel’s father had said unto the man, Be content, I pray you, and tarry all night, and let your heart be merry.

verses.raw: And when the man rose up to depart, his father in law urged him: therefore he lodged there again.
verses.text: And when the man rose up to depart, his father in law urged him: therefore he lodged there again.

verses.raw: And he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart: and the damsel’s father said, Comfort your heart, I pray you. And they tarried until afternoon, and they did eat both of them.
verses.text: And he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart: and the damsel’s father said, Comfort your heart, I pray you. And they tarried until afternoon, and they did eat both of them.

verses.raw: And when the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father in law, the damsel’s father, said unto him, Behold, now the day draws toward evening, I pray you tarry all night: behold, the day grows to an end, lodge here, that your heart may be merry; and to morrow get you early on your way, that you may go home.
verses.text: And when the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father in law, the damsel’s father, said unto him, Behold, now the day draws toward evening, I pray you tarry all night: behold, the day grows to an end, lodge here, that your heart may be merry; and to morrow get you early on your way, that you may go home.

verses.raw: But the man would not tarry that night, but he rose up and departed, and came over against Jebus, which is Jerusalem; and there were with him two asses saddled, his concubine also was with him.
verses.text: But the man would not tarry that night, but he rose up and departed, and came over against Jebus, which is Jerusalem; and there were with him two asses saddled, his concubine also was with him.

verses.raw: And when they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said unto his master, Come, I pray you, and let us turn in into this city of the Jebusites, and lodge in it.
verses.text: And when they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said unto his master, Come, I pray you, and let us turn in into this city of the Jebusites, and lodge in it.

verses.raw: And his master said unto him, We will not turn aside hither into the city of a stranger, that is not of the children of Yashar'el (Israel); we will pass over to Gibeah.
verses.text: And his master said unto him, We will not turn aside hither into the city of a stranger, that is not of the children of Yashar'el; we will pass over to Gibeah.

verses.raw: And he said unto his servant, Come, and let us draw near to one of these places to lodge all night, in Gibeah, or in Ramah.
verses.text: And he said unto his servant, Come, and let us draw near to one of these places to lodge all night, in Gibeah, or in Ramah.

verses.raw: And they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down upon them when they were by Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin.
verses.text: And they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down upon them when they were by Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin.

verses.raw: And they turned aside thither, to go in and to lodge in Gibeah: and when he went in, he sat him down in a street of the city: for there was no man that took them into his house to lodging.
verses.text: And they turned aside thither, to go in and to lodge in Gibeah: and when he went in, he sat him down in a street of the city: for there was no man that took them into his house to lodging.

verses.raw: And, behold, there came an old man from his work out of the field at even, which was also of mount Ephraim; and he sojourned in Gibeah: but the men of the place were Benjamites.
verses.text: And, behold, there came an old man from his work out of the field at even, which was also of mount Ephraim; and he sojourned in Gibeah: but the men of the place were Benjamites.

verses.raw: And when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city: and the old man said, Whither go you? and whence come you?
verses.text: And when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city: and the old man said, Whither go you? and whence come you?

verses.raw: And he said unto him, We are passing from Beth-lehem-judah toward the side of mount Ephraim; from thence am I: and I went to Beth-lehem-judah, but I am now going to the house of Yahuah (LORD); and there is no man that receives me to house.
verses.text: And he said unto him, We are passing from Beth-lehem-judah toward the side of mount Ephraim; from thence am I: and I went to Beth-lehem-judah, but I am now going to the house of Yahuah; and there is no man that receives me to house.

verses.raw: Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for your handmaid, and for the young man which is with your servants: there is no want of any thing.
verses.text: Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for your handmaid, and for the young man which is with your servants: there is no want of any thing.

verses.raw: And the old man said, Peace be with you; howsoever let all your wants lie upon me; only lodge not in the street.
verses.text: And the old man said, Peace be with you; howsoever let all your wants lie upon me; only lodge not in the street.

verses.raw: So he brought him into his house, and gave provender unto the asses: and they washed their feet, and did eat and drink.
verses.text: So he brought him into his house, and gave provender unto the asses: and they washed their feet, and did eat and drink.

verses.raw: Now as they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain sons of Belial, beset the house round about, and beat at the door, and spake to the master of the house, the old man, saying, Bring forth the man that came into your house, that we may know him.
verses.text: Now as they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain sons of Belial, beset the house round about, and beat at the door, and spake to the master of the house, the old man, saying, Bring forth the man that came into your house, that we may know him.

verses.raw: And the man, the master of the house, went out unto them, and said unto them, Nay, my brethren, nay, I pray you, do not so wickedly; seeing that this man is come into my house, do not this folly.
verses.text: And the man, the master of the house, went out unto them, and said unto them, Nay, my brethren, nay, I pray you, do not so wickedly; seeing that this man is come into my house, do not this folly.

verses.raw: Behold, here is my daughter a maiden, and his concubine; them I will bring out now, and humble you them, and do with them what seems good unto you: but unto this man do not so vile a thing.
verses.text: Behold, here is my daughter a maiden, and his concubine; them I will bring out now, and humble you them, and do with them what seems good unto you: but unto this man do not so vile a thing.

verses.raw: But the men would not hearken to him: so the man took his concubine, and brought her forth unto them; and they knew her, and abused her all the night until the morning: and when the day began to spring, they let her go.
verses.text: But the men would not hearken to him: so the man took his concubine, and brought her forth unto them; and they knew her, and abused her all the night until the morning: and when the day began to spring, they let her go.

verses.raw: Then came the woman in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her lord was, till it was light.
verses.text: Then came the woman in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her lord was, till it was light.

verses.raw: And her lord rose up in the morning, and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way: and, behold, the woman his concubine was fallen down at the door of the house, and her hands were upon the threshold.
verses.text: And her lord rose up in the morning, and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way: and, behold, the woman his concubine was fallen down at the door of the house, and her hands were upon the threshold.

verses.raw: And he said unto her, Up, and let us be going. But none answered. Then the man took her up upon an ass, and the man rose up, and gat him unto his place.
verses.text: And he said unto her, Up, and let us be going. But none answered. Then the man took her up upon an ass, and the man rose up, and gat him unto his place.

verses.raw: And when he was come into his house, he took a knife, and laid hold on his concubine, and divided her, together with her bones, into twelve pieces, and sent her into all the coasts of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And when he was come into his house, he took a knife, and laid hold on his concubine, and divided her, together with her bones, into twelve pieces, and sent her into all the coasts of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And it was so, that all that saw it said, There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Yashar'el (Israel) came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day: consider of it, take advice, and speak your minds.
verses.text: And it was so, that all that saw it said, There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Yashar'el came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day: consider of it, take advice, and speak your minds.

verses.raw: Then all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went out, and the congregation was gathered together as one man, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, with the land of Gilead, unto Yahuah (LORD) in Mizpeh.
verses.text: Then all the children of Yashar'el went out, and the congregation was gathered together as one man, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, with the land of Gilead, unto Yahuah in Mizpeh.

verses.raw: And the chief of all the people, even of all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), presented themselves in the assembly of the people of Elohim (God), four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.
verses.text: And the chief of all the people, even of all the tribes of Yashar'el, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of Elohim, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.

verses.raw: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were gone up to Mizpeh.) Then said the children of Yashar'el (Israel), Tell us, how was this wickedness?
verses.text: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Yashar'el were gone up to Mizpeh.) Then said the children of Yashar'el, Tell us, how was this wickedness?

verses.raw: And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was slain, answered and said, I came into Gibeah that belongs to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to lodge.
verses.text: And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was slain, answered and said, I came into Gibeah that belongs to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to lodge.

verses.raw: And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and beset the house round about upon me by night, and thought to have slain me: and my concubine have they forced, that she is dead.
verses.text: And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and beset the house round about upon me by night, and thought to have slain me: and my concubine have they forced, that she is dead.

verses.raw: And I took my concubine, and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Yashar'el (Israel): for they have committed lewdness and folly in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And I took my concubine, and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Yashar'el: for they have committed lewdness and folly in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Behold, you are all children of Yashar'el (Israel); give here your advice and counsel.
verses.text: Behold, you are all children of Yashar'el; give here your advice and counsel.

verses.raw: And all the people arose as one man, saying, We will not any of us go to his tent, neither will we any of us turn into his house.
verses.text: And all the people arose as one man, saying, We will not any of us go to his tent, neither will we any of us turn into his house.

verses.raw: But now this shall be the thing which we will do to Gibeah; we will go up by lot against it;
verses.text: But now this shall be the thing which we will do to Gibeah; we will go up by lot against it;

verses.raw: And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), and an hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to fetch victual for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that they have wrought in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Yashar'el, and an hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to fetch victual for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that they have wrought in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: So all the men of Yashar'el (Israel) were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.
verses.text: So all the men of Yashar'el were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.

verses.raw: And the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, What wickedness is this that is done among you?
verses.text: And the tribes of Yashar'el sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, What wickedness is this that is done among you?

verses.raw: Now therefore deliver us the men, the children of Belial, which are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death, and put away evil from Yashar'el (Israel). But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: Now therefore deliver us the men, the children of Belial, which are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death, and put away evil from Yashar'el. But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Yashar'el:

verses.raw: But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Yashar'el.

verses.text: And the children of Benjamin were numbered at that time out of the cities twenty and six thousand men that drew sword, beside the inhabitants of Gibeah, which were numbered seven hundred chosen men.

verses.text: And the men of Yashar'el, beside Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword: all these were men of war.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) arose, and went up to the house of Elohim (God), and asked counsel of Elohim (God), and said, Which of us shall go up first to the battle against the children of Benjamin? And Yahuah (LORD) said, Yahudah (Judah) shall go up first.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.

verses.raw: And the men of Yashar'el (Israel) went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Yashar'el (Israel) put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah.
verses.text: And the men of Yashar'el went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Yashar'el put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah.

verses.raw: And the children of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah, and destroyed down to the ground of the Israelites that day twenty and two thousand men.

verses.raw: And the people the men of Yashar'el (Israel) encouraged themselves, and set their battle again in array in the place where they put themselves in array the first day.
verses.text: And the people the men of Yashar'el encouraged themselves, and set their battle again in array in the place where they put themselves in array the first day.

verses.raw: (And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went up and wept before Yahuah (LORD) until even, and asked counsel of Yahuah (LORD), saying, Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother? And Yahuah (LORD) said, Go up against him.)
verses.text: (And the children of Yashar'el went up and wept before Yahuah until even, and asked counsel of Yahuah, saying, Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother? And Yahuah said, Go up against him.)

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.

verses.raw: And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) again eighteen thousand men; all these drew the sword.
verses.text: And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Yashar'el again eighteen thousand men; all these drew the sword.

verses.raw: Then all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and all the people, went up, and came unto the house of Elohim (God), and wept, and sat there before Yahuah (LORD), and fasted that day until even, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Then all the children of Yashar'el, and all the people, went up, and came unto the house of Elohim, and wept, and sat there before Yahuah, and fasted that day until even, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) enquired of Yahuah (LORD), (for the ark of the covenant of Elohim (God) was there in those days,
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el enquired of Yahuah, (for the ark of the covenant of Elohim was there in those days,

verses.raw: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days,) saying, Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? And Yahuah (LORD) said, Go up; for to morrow I will deliver them into your hand.
verses.text: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days,) saying, Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? And Yahuah said, Go up; for to morrow I will deliver them into your hand.

verses.raw: And Yashar'el (Israel) set liers in wait round about Gibeah.
verses.text: And Yashar'el set liers in wait round about Gibeah.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.

verses.raw: And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to smite of the people, and kill, as at other times, in the highways, of which one goes up to the house of Elohim (God), and the other to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to smite of the people, and kill, as at other times, in the highways, of which one goes up to the house of Elohim, and the other to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And the children of Benjamin said, They are smitten down before us, as at the first. But the children of Yashar'el (Israel) said, Let us flee, and draw them from the city unto the highways.
verses.text: And the children of Benjamin said, They are smitten down before us, as at the first. But the children of Yashar'el said, Let us flee, and draw them from the city unto the highways.

verses.raw: And all the men of Yashar'el (Israel) rose up out of their place, and put themselves in array at Baal-tamar: and the liers in wait of Yashar'el (Israel) came forth out of their places, even out of the meadows of Gibeah.
verses.text: And all the men of Yashar'el rose up out of their place, and put themselves in array at Baal-tamar: and the liers in wait of Yashar'el came forth out of their places, even out of the meadows of Gibeah.

verses.raw: And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Yashar'el (Israel), and the battle was sore: but they knew not that evil was near them.
verses.text: And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Yashar'el, and the battle was sore: but they knew not that evil was near them.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) smote Benjamin before Yashar'el (Israel): and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men: all these drew the sword.
verses.text: And Yahuah smote Benjamin before Yashar'el: and the children of Yashar'el destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men: all these drew the sword.

verses.raw: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten: for the men of Yashar'el (Israel) gave place to the Benjamites, because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah.
verses.text: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten: for the men of Yashar'el gave place to the Benjamites, because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah.

verses.raw: And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers in wait drew themselves along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.
verses.text: And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers in wait drew themselves along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.

verses.raw: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Yashar'el (Israel) and the liers in wait, that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up out of the city.
verses.text: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Yashar'el and the liers in wait, that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up out of the city.

verses.raw: And when the men of Yashar'el (Israel) retired in the battle, Benjamin began to smite and kill of the men of Yashar'el (Israel) about thirty persons: for they said, Surely they are smitten down before us, as in the first battle.
verses.text: And when the men of Yashar'el retired in the battle, Benjamin began to smite and kill of the men of Yashar'el about thirty persons: for they said, Surely they are smitten down before us, as in the first battle.

verses.raw: But when the flame began to arise up out of the city with a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them, and, behold, the flame of the city ascended up to heaven.
verses.text: But when the flame began to arise up out of the city with a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them, and, behold, the flame of the city ascended up to heaven.

verses.raw: And when the men of Yashar'el (Israel) turned again, the men of Benjamin were amazed: for they saw that evil was come upon them.
verses.text: And when the men of Yashar'el turned again, the men of Benjamin were amazed: for they saw that evil was come upon them.

verses.raw: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Yashar'el (Israel) unto the way of the wilderness; but the battle overtook them; and them which came out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them.
verses.text: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Yashar'el unto the way of the wilderness; but the battle overtook them; and them which came out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them.

verses.raw: Thus they inclosed the Benjamites round about, and chased them, and trode them down with ease over against Gibeah toward the sunrising.
verses.text: Thus they inclosed the Benjamites round about, and chased them, and trode them down with ease over against Gibeah toward the sunrising.

verses.raw: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all these were men of valour.
verses.text: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all these were men of valour.

verses.raw: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon: and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom, and slew two thousand men of them.
verses.text: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon: and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom, and slew two thousand men of them.

verses.raw: So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword; all these were men of valour.
verses.text: So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword; all these were men of valour.

verses.raw: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon, and abode in the rock Rimmon four months.
verses.text: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon, and abode in the rock Rimmon four months.

verses.raw: And the men of Yashar'el (Israel) turned again upon the children of Benjamin, and smote them with the edge of the sword, as well the men of every city, as the beast, and all that came to hand: also they set on fire all the cities that they came to.
verses.text: And the men of Yashar'el turned again upon the children of Benjamin, and smote them with the edge of the sword, as well the men of every city, as the beast, and all that came to hand: also they set on fire all the cities that they came to.

verses.raw: Now the men of Yashar'el (Israel) had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.
verses.text: Now the men of Yashar'el had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.

verses.raw: And the people came to the house of Elohim (God), and abode there till even before Elohim (God), and lifted up their voices, and wept sore;
verses.text: And the people came to the house of Elohim, and abode there till even before Elohim, and lifted up their voices, and wept sore;

verses.raw: And said, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), why is this come to pass in Yashar'el (Israel), that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: And said, O Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, why is this come to pass in Yashar'el, that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Yashar'el?

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
verses.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) said, Who is there among all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) that came not up with the congregation unto Yahuah (LORD)? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to Yahuah (LORD) to Mizpeh, saying, He shall surely be put to death.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el said, Who is there among all the tribes of Yashar'el that came not up with the congregation unto Yahuah? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to Yahuah to Mizpeh, saying, He shall surely be put to death.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Yashar'el (Israel) this day.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Yashar'el this day.

verses.raw: How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing we have sworn by Yahuah (LORD) that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?
verses.text: How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing we have sworn by Yahuah that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?

verses.raw: And they said, What one is there of the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) that came not up to Mizpeh to Yahuah (LORD)? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly.
verses.text: And they said, What one is there of the tribes of Yashar'el that came not up to Mizpeh to Yahuah? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly.

verses.raw: For the people were numbered, and, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead there.
verses.text: For the people were numbered, and, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead there.

verses.raw: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest, and commanded them, saying, Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the children.
verses.text: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest, and commanded them, saying, Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the children.

verses.raw: And this is the thing that you shall do, You shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that has lain by man.
verses.text: And this is the thing that you shall do, You shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that has lain by man.

verses.raw: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins, that had known no man by lying with any male: and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins, that had known no man by lying with any male: and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: And the whole congregation sent some to speak to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably unto them.
verses.text: And the whole congregation sent some to speak to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably unto them.

verses.raw: And Benjamin came again at that time; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh-gilead: and yet so they sufficed them not.
verses.text: And Benjamin came again at that time; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh-gilead: and yet so they sufficed them not.

verses.raw: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that Yahuah (LORD) had made a breach in the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that Yahuah had made a breach in the tribes of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Then the elders of the congregation said, How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?
verses.text: Then the elders of the congregation said, How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?

verses.raw: And they said, There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not destroyed out of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And they said, There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not destroyed out of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters: for the children of Yashar'el (Israel) have sworn, saying, Cursed be he that gives a wife to Benjamin.
verses.text: Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters: for the children of Yashar'el have sworn, saying, Cursed be he that gives a wife to Benjamin.

verses.raw: Then they said, Behold, there is a feast of Yahuah (LORD) in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on the north side of Beth-el, on the east side of the highway that goes up from Beth-el to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.
verses.text: Then they said, Behold, there is a feast of Yahuah in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on the north side of Beth-el, on the east side of the highway that goes up from Beth-el to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.

verses.raw: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;
verses.text: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;

verses.raw: And see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come you out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.
verses.text: And see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come you out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

verses.raw: And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain, that we will say unto them, Be favourable unto them for our sakes: because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war: for you did not give unto them at this time, that you should be guilty.
verses.text: And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain, that we will say unto them, Be favourable unto them for our sakes: because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war: for you did not give unto them at this time, that you should be guilty.

verses.raw: And the children of Benjamin did so, and took them wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they caught: and they went and returned unto their inheritance, and repaired the cities, and dwelt in them.
verses.text: And the children of Benjamin did so, and took them wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they caught: and they went and returned unto their inheritance, and repaired the cities, and dwelt in them.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.

verses.raw: In those days there was no king in Yashar'el (Israel): every man did that which was right in his own eyes.
verses.text: In those days there was no king in Yashar'el: every man did that which was right in his own eyes.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass in the days when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Beth-lehem-judah went to sojourn in the country of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.
verses.text: Now it came to pass in the days when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Beth-lehem-judah went to sojourn in the country of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.

verses.raw: And the name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Beth-lehem-judah. And they came into the country of Moab, and continued there.
verses.text: And the name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Beth-lehem-judah. And they came into the country of Moab, and continued there.

verses.raw: And Elimelech Naomi’s husband died; and she was left, and her two sons.
verses.text: And Elimelech Naomi’s husband died; and she was left, and her two sons.

verses.raw: And they took them wives of the women of Moab; the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth: and they dwelled there about ten years.
verses.text: And they took them wives of the women of Moab; the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth: and they dwelled there about ten years.

verses.raw: And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband.
verses.text: And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband.

verses.raw: Then she arose with her daughters in law, that she might return from the country of Moab: for she had heard in the country of Moab how that Yahuah (LORD) had visited his people in giving them bread.
verses.text: Then she arose with her daughters in law, that she might return from the country of Moab: for she had heard in the country of Moab how that Yahuah had visited his people in giving them bread.

verses.raw: Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters in law with her; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters in law with her; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Yahudah.

verses.raw: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law, Go, return each to her mother’s house: Yahuah (LORD) deal kindly with you, as you have dealt with the dead, and with me.
verses.text: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law, Go, return each to her mother’s house: Yahuah deal kindly with you, as you have dealt with the dead, and with me.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) grant you that you may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband. Then she kissed them; and they lifted up their voice, and wept.
verses.text: Yahuah grant you that you may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband. Then she kissed them; and they lifted up their voice, and wept.

verses.raw: And they said unto her, Surely we will return with you unto your people.
verses.text: And they said unto her, Surely we will return with you unto your people.

verses.raw: And Naomi said, Turn again, my daughters: why will you go with me? are there yet any more sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?
verses.text: And Naomi said, Turn again, my daughters: why will you go with me? are there yet any more sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?

verses.raw: Turn again, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have an husband. If I should say, I have hope, if I should have an husband also to night, and should also bear sons;
verses.text: Turn again, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have an husband. If I should say, I have hope, if I should have an husband also to night, and should also bear sons;

verses.raw: Would you tarry for them till they were grown? would you stay for them from having husbands? nay, my daughters; for it grieves me much for your sakes that the hand of Yahuah (LORD) is gone out against me.
verses.text: Would you tarry for them till they were grown? would you stay for them from having husbands? nay, my daughters; for it grieves me much for your sakes that the hand of Yahuah is gone out against me.

verses.raw: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth clave unto her.
verses.text: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth clave unto her.

verses.raw: And she said, Behold, your sister in law is gone back unto her people, and unto her gods: return you after your sister in law.
verses.text: And she said, Behold, your sister in law is gone back unto her people, and unto her gods: return you after your sister in law.

verses.raw: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave you, or to return from following after you: for whither you go, I will go; and where you lodgest, I will lodge: your people shall be my people, and your Elohim (God) my Elohim (God):
verses.text: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave you, or to return from following after you: for whither you go, I will go; and where you lodgest, I will lodge: your people shall be my people, and your Elohim my Elohim:

verses.raw: Where you diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: Yahuah (LORD) do so to me, and more also, if ought but death part you and me.
verses.text: Where you diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: Yahuah do so to me, and more also, if ought but death part you and me.

verses.raw: When she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her, then she left speaking unto her.
verses.text: When she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her, then she left speaking unto her.

verses.raw: So they two went until they came to Beth-lehem. And it came to pass, when they were come to Beth-lehem, that all the city was moved about them, and they said, Is this Naomi?
verses.text: So they two went until they came to Beth-lehem. And it came to pass, when they were come to Beth-lehem, that all the city was moved about them, and they said, Is this Naomi?

verses.raw: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.
verses.text: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.

verses.raw: I went out full, and Yahuah (LORD) has brought me home again empty: why then call you me Naomi, seeing Yahuah (LORD) has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me?
verses.text: I went out full, and Yahuah has brought me home again empty: why then call you me Naomi, seeing Yahuah has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me?

verses.raw: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Beth-lehem in the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.text: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Beth-lehem in the beginning of barley harvest.

verses.raw: And Naomi had a kinsman of her husband’s, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech; and his name was Boaz.
verses.text: And Naomi had a kinsman of her husband’s, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech; and his name was Boaz.

verses.raw: And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi, Let me now go to the field, and glean ears of corn after him in whose sight I shall find grace. And she said unto her, Go, my daughter.
verses.text: And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi, Let me now go to the field, and glean ears of corn after him in whose sight I shall find grace. And she said unto her, Go, my daughter.

verses.raw: And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz, who was of the kindred of Elimelech.
verses.text: And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz, who was of the kindred of Elimelech.

verses.raw: And, behold, Boaz came from Beth-lehem, and said unto the reapers, Yahuah (LORD) be with you. And they answered him, Yahuah (LORD) bless you.
verses.text: And, behold, Boaz came from Beth-lehem, and said unto the reapers, Yahuah be with you. And they answered him, Yahuah bless you.

verses.raw: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers, Whose damsel is this?
verses.text: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers, Whose damsel is this?

verses.raw: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said, It is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab:
verses.text: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said, It is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab:

verses.raw: And she said, I pray you, let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves: so she came, and has continued even from the morning until now, that she tarried a little in the house.
verses.text: And she said, I pray you, let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves: so she came, and has continued even from the morning until now, that she tarried a little in the house.

verses.raw: Then said Boaz unto Ruth, Hear you not, my daughter? Go not to glean in another field, neither go from hence, but abide here fast by my maidens:
verses.text: Then said Boaz unto Ruth, Hear you not, my daughter? Go not to glean in another field, neither go from hence, but abide here fast by my maidens:

verses.raw: Let your eyes be on the field that they do reap, and go you after them: have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch you? and when you are athirst, go unto the vessels, and drink of that which the young men have drawn.
verses.text: Let your eyes be on the field that they do reap, and go you after them: have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch you? and when you are athirst, go unto the vessels, and drink of that which the young men have drawn.

verses.raw: Then she fell on her face, and bowed herself to the ground, and said unto him, Why have I found grace in your eyes, that you should take knowledge of me, seeing I am a stranger?
verses.text: Then she fell on her face, and bowed herself to the ground, and said unto him, Why have I found grace in your eyes, that you should take knowledge of me, seeing I am a stranger?

verses.raw: And Boaz answered and said unto her, It has fully been shewed me, all that you have done unto your mother in law since the death of your husband: and how you have left your father and your mother, and the land of your nativity, and are come unto a people which you knew not heretofore.
verses.text: And Boaz answered and said unto her, It has fully been shewed me, all that you have done unto your mother in law since the death of your husband: and how you have left your father and your mother, and the land of your nativity, and are come unto a people which you knew not heretofore.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) recompense your work, and a full reward be given you of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), under whose wings you are come to trust.
verses.text: Yahuah recompense your work, and a full reward be given you of Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, under whose wings you are come to trust.

verses.raw: Then she said, Let me find favour in your sight, my lord; for that you have comforted me, and for that you have spoken friendly unto your handmaid, though I be not like unto one of your handmaidens.
verses.text: Then she said, Let me find favour in your sight, my lord; for that you have comforted me, and for that you have spoken friendly unto your handmaid, though I be not like unto one of your handmaidens.

verses.raw: And Boaz said unto her, At mealtime come you hither, and eat of the bread, and dip your morsel in the vinegar. And she sat beside the reapers: and he reached her parched corn, and she did eat, and was sufficed, and left.
verses.text: And Boaz said unto her, At mealtime come you hither, and eat of the bread, and dip your morsel in the vinegar. And she sat beside the reapers: and he reached her parched corn, and she did eat, and was sufficed, and left.

verses.raw: And when she was risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, Let her glean even among the sheaves, and reproach her not:
verses.text: And when she was risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, Let her glean even among the sheaves, and reproach her not:

verses.raw: And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her, and leave them, that she may glean them, and rebuke her not.
verses.text: And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her, and leave them, that she may glean them, and rebuke her not.

verses.raw: So she gleaned in the field until even, and beat out that she had gleaned: and it was about an ephah of barley.
verses.text: So she gleaned in the field until even, and beat out that she had gleaned: and it was about an ephah of barley.

verses.raw: And she took it up, and went into the city: and her mother in law saw what she had gleaned: and she brought forth, and gave to her that she had reserved after she was sufficed.
verses.text: And she took it up, and went into the city: and her mother in law saw what she had gleaned: and she brought forth, and gave to her that she had reserved after she was sufficed.

verses.raw: And her mother in law said unto her, Where have you gleaned to day? and where wrought you? blessed be he that did take knowledge of you. And she shewed her mother in law with whom she had wrought, and said, The man’s name with whom I wrought to day is Boaz.
verses.text: And her mother in law said unto her, Where have you gleaned to day? and where wrought you? blessed be he that did take knowledge of you. And she shewed her mother in law with whom she had wrought, and said, The man’s name with whom I wrought to day is Boaz.

verses.raw: And Naomi said unto her daughter in law, Blessed be he of Yahuah (LORD), who has not left off his kindness to the living and to the dead. And Naomi said unto her, The man is near of kin unto us, one of our next kinsmen.
verses.text: And Naomi said unto her daughter in law, Blessed be he of Yahuah, who has not left off his kindness to the living and to the dead. And Naomi said unto her, The man is near of kin unto us, one of our next kinsmen.

verses.raw: And Ruth the Moabitess said, He said unto me also, You shall keep fast by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.
verses.text: And Ruth the Moabitess said, He said unto me also, You shall keep fast by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.

verses.raw: And Naomi said unto Ruth her daughter in law, It is good, my daughter, that you go out with his maidens, that they meet you not in any other field.
verses.text: And Naomi said unto Ruth her daughter in law, It is good, my daughter, that you go out with his maidens, that they meet you not in any other field.

verses.raw: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and dwelt with her mother in law.
verses.text: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and dwelt with her mother in law.

verses.raw: Then Naomi her mother in law said unto her, My daughter, shall I not seek rest for you, that it may be well with you?
verses.text: Then Naomi her mother in law said unto her, My daughter, shall I not seek rest for you, that it may be well with you?

verses.raw: And now is not Boaz of our kindred, with whose maidens you were? Behold, he winnoweth barley to night in the threshingfloor.
verses.text: And now is not Boaz of our kindred, with whose maidens you were? Behold, he winnoweth barley to night in the threshingfloor.

verses.raw: Wash thyself therefore, and anoint you, and put your raiment upon you, and get you down to the floor: but make not thyself known unto the man, until he shall have done eating and drinking.
verses.text: Wash thyself therefore, and anoint you, and put your raiment upon you, and get you down to the floor: but make not thyself known unto the man, until he shall have done eating and drinking.

verses.raw: And it shall be, when he lies down, that you shall mark the place where he shall lie, and you shall go in, and uncover his feet, and lay you down; and he will tell you what you shall do.
verses.text: And it shall be, when he lies down, that you shall mark the place where he shall lie, and you shall go in, and uncover his feet, and lay you down; and he will tell you what you shall do.

verses.raw: And she said unto her, All that you say unto me I will do.
verses.text: And she said unto her, All that you say unto me I will do.

verses.raw: And she went down unto the floor, and did according to all that her mother in law bade her.
verses.text: And she went down unto the floor, and did according to all that her mother in law bade her.

verses.raw: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of corn: and she came softly, and uncovered his feet, and laid her down.
verses.text: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of corn: and she came softly, and uncovered his feet, and laid her down.

verses.raw: And it came to pass at midnight, that the man was afraid, and turned himself: and, behold, a woman lay at his feet.
verses.text: And it came to pass at midnight, that the man was afraid, and turned himself: and, behold, a woman lay at his feet.

verses.raw: And he said, Who are you? And she answered, I am Ruth your handmaid: spread therefore your skirt over your handmaid; for you are a near kinsman.
verses.text: And he said, Who are you? And she answered, I am Ruth your handmaid: spread therefore your skirt over your handmaid; for you are a near kinsman.

verses.raw: And he said, Blessed be you of Yahuah (LORD), my daughter: for you have shewed more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, inasmuch as you followedst not young men, whether poor or rich.
verses.text: And he said, Blessed be you of Yahuah, my daughter: for you have shewed more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, inasmuch as you followedst not young men, whether poor or rich.

verses.raw: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to you all that you require: for all the city of my people does know that you are a virtuous woman.
verses.text: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to you all that you require: for all the city of my people does know that you are a virtuous woman.

verses.raw: And now it is true that I am your near kinsman: howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I.
verses.text: And now it is true that I am your near kinsman: howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I.

verses.raw: Tarry this night, and it shall be in the morning, that if he will perform unto you the part of a kinsman, well; let him do the kinsman’s part: but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to you, then will I do the part of a kinsman to you, as Yahuah (LORD) lives: lie down until the morning.
verses.text: Tarry this night, and it shall be in the morning, that if he will perform unto you the part of a kinsman, well; let him do the kinsman’s part: but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to you, then will I do the part of a kinsman to you, as Yahuah lives: lie down until the morning.

verses.raw: And she lay at his feet until the morning: and she rose up before one could know another. And he said, Let it not be known that a woman came into the floor.
verses.text: And she lay at his feet until the morning: and she rose up before one could know another. And he said, Let it not be known that a woman came into the floor.

verses.raw: Also he said, Bring the vail that you have upon you, and hold it. And when she held it, he measured six measures of barley, and laid it on her: and she went into the city.
verses.text: Also he said, Bring the vail that you have upon you, and hold it. And when she held it, he measured six measures of barley, and laid it on her: and she went into the city.

verses.raw: And when she came to her mother in law, she said, Who are you, my daughter? And she told her all that the man had done to her.
verses.text: And when she came to her mother in law, she said, Who are you, my daughter? And she told her all that the man had done to her.

verses.raw: And she said, These six measures of barley gave he me; for he said to me, Go not empty unto your mother in law.
verses.text: And she said, These six measures of barley gave he me; for he said to me, Go not empty unto your mother in law.

verses.raw: Then said she, Sit still, my daughter, until you know how the matter will fall: for the man will not be in rest, until he have finished the thing this day.
verses.text: Then said she, Sit still, my daughter, until you know how the matter will fall: for the man will not be in rest, until he have finished the thing this day.

verses.raw: Then went Boaz up to the gate, and sat him down there: and, behold, the kinsman of whom Boaz spake came by; unto whom he said, Ho, such a one! turn aside, sit down here. And he turned aside, and sat down.
verses.text: Then went Boaz up to the gate, and sat him down there: and, behold, the kinsman of whom Boaz spake came by; unto whom he said, Ho, such a one! turn aside, sit down here. And he turned aside, and sat down.

verses.raw: And he took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, Sit you down here. And they sat down.
verses.text: And he took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, Sit you down here. And they sat down.

verses.raw: And he said unto the kinsman, Naomi, that is come again out of the country of Moab, selleth a parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech’s:
verses.text: And he said unto the kinsman, Naomi, that is come again out of the country of Moab, selleth a parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech’s:

verses.raw: And I thought to advertise you, saying, Buy it before the inhabitants, and before the elders of my people. If you will redeem it, redeem it: but if you will not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know: for there is none to redeem it beside you; and I am after you. And he said, I will redeem it.
verses.text: And I thought to advertise you, saying, Buy it before the inhabitants, and before the elders of my people. If you will redeem it, redeem it: but if you will not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know: for there is none to redeem it beside you; and I am after you. And he said, I will redeem it.

verses.raw: Then said Boaz, What day you buyest the field of the hand of Naomi, you must buy it also of Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance.
verses.text: Then said Boaz, What day you buyest the field of the hand of Naomi, you must buy it also of Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance.

verses.raw: And the kinsman said, I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I mar my own inheritance: redeem you my right to thyself; for I cannot redeem it.
verses.text: And the kinsman said, I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I mar my own inheritance: redeem you my right to thyself; for I cannot redeem it.

verses.raw: Now this was the manner in former time in Yashar'el (Israel) concerning redeeming and concerning changing, for to confirm all things; a man plucked off his shoe, and gave it to his neighbour: and this was a testimony in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Now this was the manner in former time in Yashar'el concerning redeeming and concerning changing, for to confirm all things; a man plucked off his shoe, and gave it to his neighbour: and this was a testimony in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Therefore the kinsman said unto Boaz, Buy it for you. So he drew off his shoe.
verses.text: Therefore the kinsman said unto Boaz, Buy it for you. So he drew off his shoe.

verses.raw: And Boaz said unto the elders, and unto all the people, You are witnesses this day, that I have bought all that was Elimelech’s, and all that was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s, of the hand of Naomi.
verses.text: And Boaz said unto the elders, and unto all the people, You are witnesses this day, that I have bought all that was Elimelech’s, and all that was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s, of the hand of Naomi.

verses.raw: Moreover Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, have I purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, that the name of the dead be not cut off from among his brethren, and from the gate of his place: you are witnesses this day.
verses.text: Moreover Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, have I purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, that the name of the dead be not cut off from among his brethren, and from the gate of his place: you are witnesses this day.

verses.raw: And all the people that were in the gate, and the elders, said, We are witnesses. Yahuah (LORD) make the woman that is come into your house like Rachel and like Leah, which two did build the house of Yashar'el (Israel): and do you worthily in Ephratah, and be famous in Beth-lehem:
verses.text: And all the people that were in the gate, and the elders, said, We are witnesses. Yahuah make the woman that is come into your house like Rachel and like Leah, which two did build the house of Yashar'el: and do you worthily in Ephratah, and be famous in Beth-lehem:

verses.raw: And let your house be like the house of Pharez, whom Tamar bare unto Yahudah (Judah), of the seed which Yahuah (LORD) shall give you of this young woman.
verses.text: And let your house be like the house of Pharez, whom Tamar bare unto Yahudah, of the seed which Yahuah shall give you of this young woman.

verses.raw: So Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife: and when he went in unto her, Yahuah (LORD) gave her conception, and she bare a son.
verses.text: So Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife: and when he went in unto her, Yahuah gave her conception, and she bare a son.

verses.raw: And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be Yahuah (LORD), which has not left you this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be Yahuah, which has not left you this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he shall be unto you a restorer of your life, and a nourisher of your old age: for your daughter in law, which loves you, which is better to you than seven sons, has born him.
verses.text: And he shall be unto you a restorer of your life, and a nourisher of your old age: for your daughter in law, which loves you, which is better to you than seven sons, has born him.

verses.raw: And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it.
verses.text: And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it.

verses.raw: And the women her neighbours gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
verses.text: And the women her neighbours gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.

verses.raw: Now these are the generations of Pharez: Pharez begat Hezron,
verses.text: Now these are the generations of Pharez: Pharez begat Hezron,

verses.raw: And Hezron begat Ram, and Ram begat Amminadab,
verses.text: And Hezron begat Ram, and Ram begat Amminadab,

verses.raw: And Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon,
verses.text: And Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon,

verses.raw: And Salmon begat Boaz, and Boaz begat Obed,
verses.text: And Salmon begat Boaz, and Boaz begat Obed,

verses.raw: And Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.
verses.text: And Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.

verses.raw: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim-zophim, of mount Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephrathite:
verses.text: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim-zophim, of mount Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephrathite:

verses.raw: And he had two wives; the name of the one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah: and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
verses.text: And he had two wives; the name of the one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah: and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.

verses.raw: And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of Yahuah (LORD), were there.
verses.text: And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto Yahuah Tseva'ot in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of Yahuah, were there.

verses.raw: And when the time was that Elkanah offered, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions:
verses.text: And when the time was that Elkanah offered, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions:

verses.raw: But unto Hannah he gave a worthy portion; for he loved Hannah: but Yahuah (LORD) had shut up her womb.
verses.text: But unto Hannah he gave a worthy portion; for he loved Hannah: but Yahuah had shut up her womb.

verses.raw: And her adversary also provoked her sore, for to make her fret, because Yahuah (LORD) had shut up her womb.
verses.text: And her adversary also provoked her sore, for to make her fret, because Yahuah had shut up her womb.

verses.raw: And as he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of Yahuah (LORD), so she provoked her; therefore she wept, and did not eat.
verses.text: And as he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of Yahuah, so she provoked her; therefore she wept, and did not eat.

verses.raw: Then said Elkanah her husband to her, Hannah, why weepest you? and why eat you not? and why is your heart grieved? am not I better to you than ten sons?
verses.text: Then said Elkanah her husband to her, Hannah, why weepest you? and why eat you not? and why is your heart grieved? am not I better to you than ten sons?

verses.raw: So Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh, and after they had drunk. Now Eli the priest sat upon a seat by a post of the temple of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: So Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh, and after they had drunk. Now Eli the priest sat upon a seat by a post of the temple of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto Yahuah (LORD), and wept sore.
verses.text: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto Yahuah, and wept sore.

verses.raw: And she vowed a vow, and said, O Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), if you will indeed look on the affliction of your handmaid, and remember me, and not forget your handmaid, but will give unto your handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto Yahuah (LORD) all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.
verses.text: And she vowed a vow, and said, O Yahuah Tseva'ot, if you will indeed look on the affliction of your handmaid, and remember me, and not forget your handmaid, but will give unto your handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto Yahuah all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as she continued praying before Yahuah (LORD), that Eli marked her mouth.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as she continued praying before Yahuah, that Eli marked her mouth.

verses.raw: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.
verses.text: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.

verses.raw: And Eli said unto her, How long will you be drunken? put away your wine from you.
verses.text: And Eli said unto her, How long will you be drunken? put away your wine from you.

verses.raw: And Hannah answered and said, No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Hannah answered and said, No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before Yahuah.

verses.raw: Count not your handmaid for a daughter of Belial: for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto.
verses.text: Count not your handmaid for a daughter of Belial: for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto.

verses.raw: Then Eli answered and said, Go in peace: and the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) grant you your petition that you have asked of him.
verses.text: Then Eli answered and said, Go in peace: and the Elohim of Yashar'el grant you your petition that you have asked of him.

verses.raw: And she said, Let your handmaid find grace in your sight. So the woman went her way, and did eat, and her countenance was no more sad.
verses.text: And she said, Let your handmaid find grace in your sight. So the woman went her way, and did eat, and her countenance was no more sad.

verses.raw: And they rose up in the morning early, and worshipped before Yahuah (LORD), and returned, and came to their house to Ramah: and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and Yahuah (LORD) remembered her.
verses.text: And they rose up in the morning early, and worshipped before Yahuah, and returned, and came to their house to Ramah: and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and Yahuah remembered her.

verses.raw: Wherefore it came to pass, when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived, that she bare a son, and called his name Samuel, saying, Because I have asked him of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Wherefore it came to pass, when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived, that she bare a son, and called his name Samuel, saying, Because I have asked him of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto Yahuah (LORD) the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.
verses.text: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto Yahuah the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.

verses.raw: But Hannah went not up; for she said unto her husband, I will not go up until the child be weaned, and then I will bring him, that he may appear before Yahuah (LORD), and there abide for ever.
verses.text: But Hannah went not up; for she said unto her husband, I will not go up until the child be weaned, and then I will bring him, that he may appear before Yahuah, and there abide for ever.

verses.raw: And Elkanah her husband said unto her, Do what seems you good; tarry until you have weaned him; only Yahuah (LORD) establish his word. So the woman abode, and gave her son suck until she weaned him.
verses.text: And Elkanah her husband said unto her, Do what seems you good; tarry until you have weaned him; only Yahuah establish his word. So the woman abode, and gave her son suck until she weaned him.

verses.raw: And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bullocks, and one ephah of flour, and a bottle of wine, and brought him unto the house of Yahuah (LORD) in Shiloh: and the child was young.
verses.text: And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bullocks, and one ephah of flour, and a bottle of wine, and brought him unto the house of Yahuah in Shiloh: and the child was young.

verses.raw: And they slew a bullock, and brought the child to Eli.
verses.text: And they slew a bullock, and brought the child to Eli.

verses.raw: And she said, Oh my lord, as your soul lives, my lord, I am the woman that stood by you here, praying unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And she said, Oh my lord, as your soul lives, my lord, I am the woman that stood by you here, praying unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: For this child I prayed; and Yahuah (LORD) has given me my petition which I asked of him:
verses.text: For this child I prayed; and Yahuah has given me my petition which I asked of him:
