verses.raw: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides himself, and come you again to me with the certainty, and I will go with you: and it shall come to pass, if he be in the land, that I will search him out throughout all the thousands of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides himself, and come you again to me with the certainty, and I will go with you: and it shall come to pass, if he be in the land, that I will search him out throughout all the thousands of Yahudah.

verses.raw: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.
verses.text: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.

verses.raw: Saul also and his men went to seek him. And they told David: wherefore he came down into a rock, and abode in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard that, he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.
verses.text: Saul also and his men went to seek him. And they told David: wherefore he came down into a rock, and abode in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard that, he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.

verses.raw: And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them.
verses.text: And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them.

verses.raw: But there came a messenger unto Saul, saying, Haste you, and come; for the Philistines have invaded the land.
verses.text: But there came a messenger unto Saul, saying, Haste you, and come; for the Philistines have invaded the land.

verses.raw: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Sela-hammahlekoth.
verses.text: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Sela-hammahlekoth.

verses.raw: And David went up from thence, and dwelt in strong holds at En-gedi.
verses.text: And David went up from thence, and dwelt in strong holds at En-gedi.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of En-gedi.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of En-gedi.

verses.raw: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Yashar'el (Israel), and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.
verses.text: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Yashar'el, and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.

verses.raw: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet: and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave.
verses.text: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet: and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave.

verses.raw: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which Yahuah (LORD) said unto you, Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, that you may do to him as it shall seem good unto you. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe privily.
verses.text: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which Yahuah said unto you, Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, that you may do to him as it shall seem good unto you. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe privily.

verses.raw: And it came to pass afterward, that David’s heart smote him, because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.
verses.text: And it came to pass afterward, that David’s heart smote him, because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.

verses.raw: And he said unto his men, Yahuah (LORD) forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the LORD’S anointed, to stretch forth my hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And he said unto his men, Yahuah forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the LORD’S anointed, to stretch forth my hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of Yahuah.

verses.raw: So David stayed his servants with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. But Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.
verses.text: So David stayed his servants with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. But Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.

verses.raw: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king. And when Saul looked behind him, David stooped with his face to the earth, and bowed himself.
verses.text: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king. And when Saul looked behind him, David stooped with his face to the earth, and bowed himself.

verses.raw: And David said to Saul, Wherefore hear you men’s words, saying, Behold, David seeks your hurt?
verses.text: And David said to Saul, Wherefore hear you men’s words, saying, Behold, David seeks your hurt?

verses.raw: Behold, this day your eyes have seen how that Yahuah (LORD) had delivered you to day into my hand in the cave: and some bade me kill you: but my eye spared you; and I said, I will not put forth my hand against my lord; for he is the LORD’S anointed.
verses.text: Behold, this day your eyes have seen how that Yahuah had delivered you to day into my hand in the cave: and some bade me kill you: but my eye spared you; and I said, I will not put forth my hand against my lord; for he is the LORD’S anointed.

verses.raw: Moreover, my father, see, yea, see the skirt of your robe in my hand: for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe, and killed you not, know you and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in my hand, and I have not sinned against you; yet you huntest my soul to take it.
verses.text: Moreover, my father, see, yea, see the skirt of your robe in my hand: for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe, and killed you not, know you and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in my hand, and I have not sinned against you; yet you huntest my soul to take it.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) judge between me and you, and Yahuah (LORD) avenge me of you: but my hand shall not be upon you.
verses.text: Yahuah judge between me and you, and Yahuah avenge me of you: but my hand shall not be upon you.

verses.raw: As says the proverb of the ancients, Wickedness proceeds from the wicked: but my hand shall not be upon you.
verses.text: As says the proverb of the ancients, Wickedness proceeds from the wicked: but my hand shall not be upon you.

verses.raw: After whom is the king of Yashar'el (Israel) come out? after whom do you pursue? after a dead dog, after a flea.
verses.text: After whom is the king of Yashar'el come out? after whom do you pursue? after a dead dog, after a flea.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) therefore be judge, and judge between me and you, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of your hand.
verses.text: Yahuah therefore be judge, and judge between me and you, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of your hand.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul, that Saul said, Is this your voice, my son David? And Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul, that Saul said, Is this your voice, my son David? And Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.

verses.raw: And he said to David, You are more righteous than I: for you have rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded you evil.
verses.text: And he said to David, You are more righteous than I: for you have rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded you evil.

verses.raw: And you have shewed this day how that you have dealt well with me: forasmuch as when Yahuah (LORD) had delivered me into your hand, you killedst me not.
verses.text: And you have shewed this day how that you have dealt well with me: forasmuch as when Yahuah had delivered me into your hand, you killedst me not.

verses.raw: For if a man find his enemy, will he let him go well away? wherefore Yahuah (LORD) reward you good for that you have done unto me this day.
verses.text: For if a man find his enemy, will he let him go well away? wherefore Yahuah reward you good for that you have done unto me this day.

verses.raw: And now, behold, I know well that you shall surely be king, and that the kingdom of Yashar'el (Israel) shall be established in your hand.
verses.text: And now, behold, I know well that you shall surely be king, and that the kingdom of Yashar'el shall be established in your hand.

verses.raw: Swear now therefore unto me by Yahuah (LORD), that you will not cut off my seed after me, and that you will not destroy my name out of my father’s house.
verses.text: Swear now therefore unto me by Yahuah, that you will not cut off my seed after me, and that you will not destroy my name out of my father’s house.

verses.raw: And David sware unto Saul. And Saul went home; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold.
verses.text: And David sware unto Saul. And Saul went home; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold.

verses.raw: And Samuel died; and all the Israelites were gathered together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran.
verses.text: And Samuel died; and all the Israelites were gathered together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran.

verses.raw: And there was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats: and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.
verses.text: And there was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats: and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

verses.raw: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man was churlish and evil in his doings; and he was of the house of Caleb.
verses.text: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man was churlish and evil in his doings; and he was of the house of Caleb.

verses.raw: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep.
verses.text: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep.

verses.raw: And David sent out ten young men, and David said unto the young men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:
verses.text: And David sent out ten young men, and David said unto the young men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:

verses.raw: And thus shall you say to him that lives in prosperity, Peace be both to you, and peace be to your house, and peace be unto all that you have.
verses.text: And thus shall you say to him that lives in prosperity, Peace be both to you, and peace be to your house, and peace be unto all that you have.

verses.raw: And now I have heard that you have shearers: now your shepherds which were with us, we hurt them not, neither was there ought missing unto them, all the while they were in Carmel.
verses.text: And now I have heard that you have shearers: now your shepherds which were with us, we hurt them not, neither was there ought missing unto them, all the while they were in Carmel.

verses.raw: Ask your young men, and they will shew you. Wherefore let the young men find favour in your eyes: for we come in a good day: give, I pray you, whatsoever comes to your hand unto your servants, and to your son David.
verses.text: Ask your young men, and they will shew you. Wherefore let the young men find favour in your eyes: for we come in a good day: give, I pray you, whatsoever comes to your hand unto your servants, and to your son David.

verses.raw: And when David’s young men came, they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David, and ceased.
verses.text: And when David’s young men came, they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David, and ceased.

verses.raw: And Nabal answered David’s servants, and said, Who is David? and who is the son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master.
verses.text: And Nabal answered David’s servants, and said, Who is David? and who is the son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master.

verses.raw: Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers, and give it unto men, whom I know not whence they be?
verses.text: Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers, and give it unto men, whom I know not whence they be?

verses.raw: So David’s young men turned their way, and went again, and came and told him all those sayings.
verses.text: So David’s young men turned their way, and went again, and came and told him all those sayings.

verses.raw: And David said unto his men, Gird you on every man his sword. And they girded on every man his sword; and David also girded on his sword: and there went up after David about four hundred men; and two hundred abode by the stuff.
verses.text: And David said unto his men, Gird you on every man his sword. And they girded on every man his sword; and David also girded on his sword: and there went up after David about four hundred men; and two hundred abode by the stuff.

verses.raw: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master; and he railed on them.
verses.text: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master; and he railed on them.

verses.raw: But the men were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant with them, when we were in the fields:
verses.text: But the men were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant with them, when we were in the fields:

verses.raw: They were a wall unto us both by night and day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.
verses.text: They were a wall unto us both by night and day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.

verses.raw: Now therefore know and consider what you will do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his household: for he is such a son of Belial, that a man cannot speak to him.
verses.text: Now therefore know and consider what you will do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his household: for he is such a son of Belial, that a man cannot speak to him.

verses.raw: Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn, and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.
verses.text: Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn, and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.

verses.raw: And she said unto her servants, Go on before me; behold, I come after you. But she told not her husband Nabal.
verses.text: And she said unto her servants, Go on before me; behold, I come after you. But she told not her husband Nabal.

verses.raw: And it was so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the covert of the hill, and, behold, David and his men came down against her; and she met them.
verses.text: And it was so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the covert of the hill, and, behold, David and his men came down against her; and she met them.

verses.raw: Now David had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained unto him: and he has requited me evil for good.
verses.text: Now David had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained unto him: and he has requited me evil for good.

verses.raw: So and more also do Elohim (God) unto the enemies of David, if I leave of all that pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.
verses.text: So and more also do Elohim unto the enemies of David, if I leave of all that pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.

verses.raw: And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and lighted off the ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground,
verses.text: And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and lighted off the ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground,

verses.raw: And fell at his feet, and said, Upon me, my lord, upon me let this iniquity be: and let your handmaid, I pray you, speak in your audience, and hear the words of your handmaid.
verses.text: And fell at his feet, and said, Upon me, my lord, upon me let this iniquity be: and let your handmaid, I pray you, speak in your audience, and hear the words of your handmaid.

verses.raw: Let not my lord, I pray you, regard this man of Belial, even Nabal: for as his name is, so is he; Nabal is his name, and folly is with him: but I your handmaid saw not the young men of my lord, whom you did send.
verses.text: Let not my lord, I pray you, regard this man of Belial, even Nabal: for as his name is, so is he; Nabal is his name, and folly is with him: but I your handmaid saw not the young men of my lord, whom you did send.

verses.raw: Now therefore, my lord, as Yahuah (LORD) lives, and as your soul lives, seeing Yahuah (LORD) has withholden you from coming to shed blood, and from avenging thyself with your own hand, now let your enemies, and they that seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.
verses.text: Now therefore, my lord, as Yahuah lives, and as your soul lives, seeing Yahuah has withholden you from coming to shed blood, and from avenging thyself with your own hand, now let your enemies, and they that seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.

verses.raw: And now this blessing which your handmaid has brought unto my lord, let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord.
verses.text: And now this blessing which your handmaid has brought unto my lord, let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord.

verses.raw: I pray you, forgive the trespass of your handmaid: for Yahuah (LORD) will certainly make my lord a sure house; because my lord fighteth the battles of Yahuah (LORD), and evil has not been found in you all your days.
verses.text: I pray you, forgive the trespass of your handmaid: for Yahuah will certainly make my lord a sure house; because my lord fighteth the battles of Yahuah, and evil has not been found in you all your days.

verses.raw: Yet a man is risen to pursue you, and to seek your soul: but the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God); and the souls of your enemies, them shall he sling out, as out of the middle of a sling.
verses.text: Yet a man is risen to pursue you, and to seek your soul: but the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with Yahuah Elohayka; and the souls of your enemies, them shall he sling out, as out of the middle of a sling.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, when Yahuah (LORD) shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he has spoken concerning you, and shall have appointed you ruler over Yashar'el (Israel);
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, when Yahuah shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he has spoken concerning you, and shall have appointed you ruler over Yashar'el;

verses.raw: That this shall be no grief unto you, nor offence of heart unto my lord, either that you have shed blood causeless, or that my lord has avenged himself: but when Yahuah (LORD) shall have dealt well with my lord, then remember your handmaid.
verses.text: That this shall be no grief unto you, nor offence of heart unto my lord, either that you have shed blood causeless, or that my lord has avenged himself: but when Yahuah shall have dealt well with my lord, then remember your handmaid.

verses.raw: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), which sent you this day to meet me:
verses.text: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, which sent you this day to meet me:

verses.raw: And blessed be your advice, and blessed be you, which have kept me this day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself with my own hand.
verses.text: And blessed be your advice, and blessed be you, which have kept me this day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself with my own hand.

verses.raw: For in very deed, as Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) lives, which has kept me back from hurting you, except you had hasted and come to meet me, surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.
verses.text: For in very deed, as Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el lives, which has kept me back from hurting you, except you had hasted and come to meet me, surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.

verses.raw: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him, and said unto her, Go up in peace to your house; see, I have hearkened to your voice, and have accepted your person.
verses.text: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him, and said unto her, Go up in peace to your house; see, I have hearkened to your voice, and have accepted your person.

verses.raw: And Abigail came to Nabal; and, behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king; and Nabal’s heart was merry within him, for he was very drunken: wherefore she told him nothing, less or more, until the morning light.
verses.text: And Abigail came to Nabal; and, behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king; and Nabal’s heart was merry within him, for he was very drunken: wherefore she told him nothing, less or more, until the morning light.

verses.raw: But it came to pass in the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.
verses.text: But it came to pass in the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.

verses.raw: And it came to pass about ten days after, that Yahuah (LORD) smote Nabal, that he died.
verses.text: And it came to pass about ten days after, that Yahuah smote Nabal, that he died.

verses.raw: And when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be Yahuah (LORD), that has pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and has kept his servant from evil: for Yahuah (LORD) has returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head. And David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife.
verses.text: And when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be Yahuah, that has pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and has kept his servant from evil: for Yahuah has returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head. And David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife.

verses.raw: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto you, to take you to him to wife.
verses.text: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto you, to take you to him to wife.

verses.raw: And she arose, and bowed herself on her face to the earth, and said, Behold, let your handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.
verses.text: And she arose, and bowed herself on her face to the earth, and said, Behold, let your handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.

verses.raw: And Abigail hasted, and arose, and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.
verses.text: And Abigail hasted, and arose, and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.

verses.raw: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they were also both of them his wives.
verses.text: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they were also both of them his wives.

verses.raw: But Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Phalti the son of Laish, which was of Gallim.
verses.text: But Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Phalti the son of Laish, which was of Gallim.

verses.raw: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, Does not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon?
verses.text: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, Does not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon?

verses.raw: Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Yashar'el (Israel) with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.
verses.text: Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Yashar'el with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.

verses.raw: And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon, by the way. But David abode in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.
verses.text: And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon, by the way. But David abode in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.

verses.raw: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul was come in very deed.
verses.text: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul was come in very deed.

verses.raw: And David arose, and came to the place where Saul had pitched: and David beheld the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his host: and Saul lay in the trench, and the people pitched round about him.
verses.text: And David arose, and came to the place where Saul had pitched: and David beheld the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his host: and Saul lay in the trench, and the people pitched round about him.

verses.raw: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Joab, saying, Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp? And Abishai said, I will go down with you.
verses.text: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Joab, saying, Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp? And Abishai said, I will go down with you.

verses.raw: So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the trench, and his spear stuck in the ground at his bolster: but Abner and the people lay round about him.
verses.text: So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the trench, and his spear stuck in the ground at his bolster: but Abner and the people lay round about him.

verses.raw: Then said Abishai to David, Elohim (God) has delivered your enemy into your hand this day: now therefore let me smite him, I pray you, with the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not smite him the second time.
verses.text: Then said Abishai to David, Elohim has delivered your enemy into your hand this day: now therefore let me smite him, I pray you, with the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not smite him the second time.

verses.raw: And David said to Abishai, Destroy him not: for who can stretch forth his hand against the LORD’S anointed, and be guiltless?
verses.text: And David said to Abishai, Destroy him not: for who can stretch forth his hand against the LORD’S anointed, and be guiltless?

verses.raw: David said furthermore, As Yahuah (LORD) lives, Yahuah (LORD) shall smite him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall descend into battle, and perish.
verses.text: David said furthermore, As Yahuah lives, Yahuah shall smite him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall descend into battle, and perish.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) forbid that I should stretch forth my hand against the LORD’S anointed: but, I pray you, take you now the spear that is at his bolster, and the cruse of water, and let us go.
verses.text: Yahuah forbid that I should stretch forth my hand against the LORD’S anointed: but, I pray you, take you now the spear that is at his bolster, and the cruse of water, and let us go.

verses.raw: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul’s bolster; and they gat them away, and no man saw it, nor knew it, neither awaked: for they were all asleep; because a deep sleep from Yahuah (LORD) was fallen upon them.
verses.text: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul’s bolster; and they gat them away, and no man saw it, nor knew it, neither awaked: for they were all asleep; because a deep sleep from Yahuah was fallen upon them.

verses.raw: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of an hill afar off; a great space being between them:
verses.text: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of an hill afar off; a great space being between them:

verses.raw: And David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, Answerest you not, Abner? Then Abner answered and said, Who are you that cry to the king?
verses.text: And David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, Answerest you not, Abner? Then Abner answered and said, Who are you that cry to the king?

verses.raw: And David said to Abner, Are not you a valiant man? and who is like to you in Yashar'el (Israel)? wherefore then have you not kept your lord the king? for there came one of the people in to destroy the king your lord.
verses.text: And David said to Abner, Are not you a valiant man? and who is like to you in Yashar'el? wherefore then have you not kept your lord the king? for there came one of the people in to destroy the king your lord.

verses.raw: This thing is not good that you have done. As Yahuah (LORD) lives, you are worthy to die, because you have not kept your master, the LORD’S anointed. And now see where the king’s spear is, and the cruse of water that was at his bolster.
verses.text: This thing is not good that you have done. As Yahuah lives, you are worthy to die, because you have not kept your master, the LORD’S anointed. And now see where the king’s spear is, and the cruse of water that was at his bolster.

verses.raw: And Saul knew David’s voice, and said, Is this your voice, my son David? And David said, It is my voice, my lord, O king.
verses.text: And Saul knew David’s voice, and said, Is this your voice, my son David? And David said, It is my voice, my lord, O king.

verses.raw: And he said, Wherefore does my lord thus pursue after his servant? for what have I done? or what evil is in my hand?
verses.text: And he said, Wherefore does my lord thus pursue after his servant? for what have I done? or what evil is in my hand?

verses.raw: Now therefore, I pray you, let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If Yahuah (LORD) have stirred you up against me, let him accept an offering: but if they be the children of men, cursed be they before Yahuah (LORD); for they have driven me out this day from abiding in the inheritance of Yahuah (LORD), saying, Go, serve other gods.
verses.text: Now therefore, I pray you, let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If Yahuah have stirred you up against me, let him accept an offering: but if they be the children of men, cursed be they before Yahuah; for they have driven me out this day from abiding in the inheritance of Yahuah, saying, Go, serve other gods.

verses.raw: Now therefore, let not my blood fall to the earth before the face of Yahuah (LORD): for the king of Yashar'el (Israel) is come out to seek a flea, as when one does hunt a partridge in the mountains.
verses.text: Now therefore, let not my blood fall to the earth before the face of Yahuah: for the king of Yashar'el is come out to seek a flea, as when one does hunt a partridge in the mountains.

verses.raw: Then said Saul, I have sinned: return, my son David: for I will no more do you harm, because my soul was precious in your eyes this day: behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.
verses.text: Then said Saul, I have sinned: return, my son David: for I will no more do you harm, because my soul was precious in your eyes this day: behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.

verses.raw: And David answered and said, Behold the king’s spear! and let one of the young men come over and fetch it.
verses.text: And David answered and said, Behold the king’s spear! and let one of the young men come over and fetch it.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness: for Yahuah (LORD) delivered you into my hand to day, but I would not stretch forth my hand against the LORD’S anointed.
verses.text: Yahuah render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness: for Yahuah delivered you into my hand to day, but I would not stretch forth my hand against the LORD’S anointed.

verses.raw: And, behold, as your life was much set by this day in my eyes, so let my life be much set by in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD), and let him deliver me out of all tribulation.
verses.text: And, behold, as your life was much set by this day in my eyes, so let my life be much set by in the eyes of Yahuah, and let him deliver me out of all tribulation.

verses.raw: Then Saul said to David, Blessed be you, my son David: you shall both do great things, and also shall still prevail. So David went on his way, and Saul returned to his place.
verses.text: Then Saul said to David, Blessed be you, my son David: you shall both do great things, and also shall still prevail. So David went on his way, and Saul returned to his place.

verses.raw: And David said in his heart, I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul: there is nothing better for me than that I should speedily escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul shall despair of me, to seek me any more in any coast of Yashar'el (Israel): so shall I escape out of his hand.
verses.text: And David said in his heart, I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul: there is nothing better for me than that I should speedily escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul shall despair of me, to seek me any more in any coast of Yashar'el: so shall I escape out of his hand.

verses.raw: And David arose, and he passed over with the six hundred men that were with him unto Achish, the son of Maoch, king of Gath.
verses.text: And David arose, and he passed over with the six hundred men that were with him unto Achish, the son of Maoch, king of Gath.

verses.raw: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal’s wife.
verses.text: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal’s wife.

verses.raw: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath: and he sought no more again for him.
verses.text: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath: and he sought no more again for him.

verses.raw: And David said unto Achish, If I have now found grace in your eyes, let them give me a place in some town in the country, that I may dwell there: for why should your servant dwell in the royal city with you?
verses.text: And David said unto Achish, If I have now found grace in your eyes, let them give me a place in some town in the country, that I may dwell there: for why should your servant dwell in the royal city with you?

verses.raw: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Yahudah (Judah) unto this day.
verses.text: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Yahudah unto this day.

verses.raw: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.
verses.text: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.

verses.raw: And David and his men went up, and invaded the Geshurites, and the Gezrites, and the Amalekites: for those nations were of old the inhabitants of the land, as you go to Shur, even unto the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And David and his men went up, and invaded the Geshurites, and the Gezrites, and the Amalekites: for those nations were of old the inhabitants of the land, as you go to Shur, even unto the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And David smote the land, and left neither man nor woman alive, and took away the sheep, and the oxen, and the asses, and the camels, and the apparel, and returned, and came to Achish.
verses.text: And David smote the land, and left neither man nor woman alive, and took away the sheep, and the oxen, and the asses, and the camels, and the apparel, and returned, and came to Achish.

verses.raw: And Achish said, Whither have you made a road to day? And David said, Against the south of Yahudah (Judah), and against the south of the Jerahmeelites, and against the south of the Kenites.
verses.text: And Achish said, Whither have you made a road to day? And David said, Against the south of Yahudah, and against the south of the Jerahmeelites, and against the south of the Kenites.

verses.raw: And David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring tidings to Gath, saying, Lest they should tell on us, saying, So did David, and so will be his manner all the while he dwells in the country of the Philistines.
verses.text: And David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring tidings to Gath, saying, Lest they should tell on us, saying, So did David, and so will be his manner all the while he dwells in the country of the Philistines.

verses.raw: And Achish believed David, saying, He has made his people Yashar'el (Israel) utterly to abhor him; therefore he shall be my servant for ever.
verses.text: And Achish believed David, saying, He has made his people Yashar'el utterly to abhor him; therefore he shall be my servant for ever.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in those days, that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Yashar'el (Israel). And Achish said unto David, Know you assuredly, that you shall go out with me to battle, you and your men.
verses.text: And it came to pass in those days, that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Yashar'el. And Achish said unto David, Know you assuredly, that you shall go out with me to battle, you and your men.

verses.raw: And David said to Achish, Surely you shall know what your servant can do. And Achish said to David, Therefore will I make you keeper of my head for ever.
verses.text: And David said to Achish, Surely you shall know what your servant can do. And Achish said to David, Therefore will I make you keeper of my head for ever.

verses.raw: Now Samuel was dead, and all Yashar'el (Israel) had lamented him, and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land.
verses.text: Now Samuel was dead, and all Yashar'el had lamented him, and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land.

verses.raw: And the Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and pitched in Shunem: and Saul gathered all Yashar'el (Israel) together, and they pitched in Gilboa.
verses.text: And the Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and pitched in Shunem: and Saul gathered all Yashar'el together, and they pitched in Gilboa.

verses.raw: And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart greatly trembled.
verses.text: And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart greatly trembled.

verses.raw: And when Saul enquired of Yahuah (LORD), Yahuah (LORD) answered him not, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets.
verses.text: And when Saul enquired of Yahuah, Yahuah answered him not, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets.

verses.raw: Then said Saul unto his servants, Seek me a woman that has a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and enquire of her. And his servants said to him, Behold, there is a woman that has a familiar spirit at Endor.
verses.text: Then said Saul unto his servants, Seek me a woman that has a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and enquire of her. And his servants said to him, Behold, there is a woman that has a familiar spirit at Endor.

verses.raw: And Saul disguised himself, and put on other raiment, and he went, and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night: and he said, I pray you, divine unto me by the familiar spirit, and bring me him up, whom I shall name unto you.
verses.text: And Saul disguised himself, and put on other raiment, and he went, and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night: and he said, I pray you, divine unto me by the familiar spirit, and bring me him up, whom I shall name unto you.

verses.raw: And the woman said unto him, Behold, you know what Saul has done, how he has cut off those that have familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land: wherefore then layest you a snare for my life, to cause me to die?
verses.text: And the woman said unto him, Behold, you know what Saul has done, how he has cut off those that have familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land: wherefore then layest you a snare for my life, to cause me to die?

verses.raw: And Saul sware to her by Yahuah (LORD), saying, As Yahuah (LORD) lives, there shall no punishment happen to you for this thing.
verses.text: And Saul sware to her by Yahuah, saying, As Yahuah lives, there shall no punishment happen to you for this thing.

verses.raw: Then said the woman, Whom shall I bring up unto you? And he said, Bring me up Samuel.
verses.text: Then said the woman, Whom shall I bring up unto you? And he said, Bring me up Samuel.

verses.raw: And when the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice: and the woman spake to Saul, saying, Why have you deceived me? for you are Saul.
verses.text: And when the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice: and the woman spake to Saul, saying, Why have you deceived me? for you are Saul.

verses.raw: And the king said unto her, Be not afraid: for what saw you? And the woman said unto Saul, I saw gods ascending out of the earth.
verses.text: And the king said unto her, Be not afraid: for what saw you? And the woman said unto Saul, I saw gods ascending out of the earth.

verses.raw: And he said unto her, What form is he of? And she said, An old man comes up; and he is covered with a mantle. And Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he stooped with his face to the ground, and bowed himself.
verses.text: And he said unto her, What form is he of? And she said, An old man comes up; and he is covered with a mantle. And Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he stooped with his face to the ground, and bowed himself.

verses.raw: And Samuel said to Saul, Why have you disquieted me, to bring me up? And Saul answered, I am sore distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and Elohim (God) is departed from me, and answers me no more, neither by prophets, nor by dreams: therefore I have called you, that you may make known unto me what I shall do.
verses.text: And Samuel said to Saul, Why have you disquieted me, to bring me up? And Saul answered, I am sore distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and Elohim is departed from me, and answers me no more, neither by prophets, nor by dreams: therefore I have called you, that you may make known unto me what I shall do.

verses.raw: Then said Samuel, Wherefore then do you ask of me, seeing Yahuah (LORD) is departed from you, and is become your enemy?
verses.text: Then said Samuel, Wherefore then do you ask of me, seeing Yahuah is departed from you, and is become your enemy?

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) has done to him, as he spake by me: for Yahuah (LORD) has rent the kingdom out of your hand, and given it to your neighbour, even to David:
verses.text: And Yahuah has done to him, as he spake by me: for Yahuah has rent the kingdom out of your hand, and given it to your neighbour, even to David:

verses.raw: Because you obeyedst not the voice of Yahuah (LORD), nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore has Yahuah (LORD) done this thing unto you this day.
verses.text: Because you obeyedst not the voice of Yahuah, nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore has Yahuah done this thing unto you this day.

verses.raw: Moreover Yahuah (LORD) will also deliver Yashar'el (Israel) with you into the hand of the Philistines: and to morrow shall you and your sons be with me: Yahuah (LORD) also shall deliver the host of Yashar'el (Israel) into the hand of the Philistines.
verses.text: Moreover Yahuah will also deliver Yashar'el with you into the hand of the Philistines: and to morrow shall you and your sons be with me: Yahuah also shall deliver the host of Yashar'el into the hand of the Philistines.

verses.raw: Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth, and was sore afraid, because of the words of Samuel: and there was no strength in him; for he had eaten no bread all the day, nor all the night.
verses.text: Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth, and was sore afraid, because of the words of Samuel: and there was no strength in him; for he had eaten no bread all the day, nor all the night.

verses.raw: And the woman came unto Saul, and saw that he was sore troubled, and said unto him, Behold, your handmaid has obeyed your voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have hearkened unto your words which you spoke unto me.
verses.text: And the woman came unto Saul, and saw that he was sore troubled, and said unto him, Behold, your handmaid has obeyed your voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have hearkened unto your words which you spoke unto me.

verses.raw: Now therefore, I pray you, hearken you also unto the voice of your handmaid, and let me set a morsel of bread before you; and eat, that you may have strength, when you go on your way.
verses.text: Now therefore, I pray you, hearken you also unto the voice of your handmaid, and let me set a morsel of bread before you; and eat, that you may have strength, when you go on your way.

verses.raw: But he refused, and said, I will not eat. But his servants, together with the woman, compelled him; and he hearkened unto their voice. So he arose from the earth, and sat upon the bed.
verses.text: But he refused, and said, I will not eat. But his servants, together with the woman, compelled him; and he hearkened unto their voice. So he arose from the earth, and sat upon the bed.

verses.raw: And the woman had a fat calf in the house; and she hasted, and killed it, and took flour, and kneaded it, and did bake unleavened bread thereof:
verses.text: And the woman had a fat calf in the house; and she hasted, and killed it, and took flour, and kneaded it, and did bake unleavened bread thereof:

verses.raw: And she brought it before Saul, and before his servants; and they did eat. Then they rose up, and went away that night.
verses.text: And she brought it before Saul, and before his servants; and they did eat. Then they rose up, and went away that night.

verses.raw: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek: and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel.
verses.text: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek: and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel.

verses.raw: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds, and by thousands: but David and his men passed on in the rereward with Achish.
verses.text: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds, and by thousands: but David and his men passed on in the rereward with Achish.

verses.raw: Then said the princes of the Philistines, What do these Hebrews here? And Achish said unto the princes of the Philistines, Is not this David, the servant of Saul the king of Yashar'el (Israel), which has been with me these days, or these years, and I have found no fault in him since he fell unto me unto this day?
verses.text: Then said the princes of the Philistines, What do these Hebrews here? And Achish said unto the princes of the Philistines, Is not this David, the servant of Saul the king of Yashar'el, which has been with me these days, or these years, and I have found no fault in him since he fell unto me unto this day?

verses.raw: And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him, Make this fellow return, that he may go again to his place which you have appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he be an adversary to us: for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master? should it not be with the heads of these men?
verses.text: And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him, Make this fellow return, that he may go again to his place which you have appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he be an adversary to us: for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master? should it not be with the heads of these men?

verses.raw: Is not this David, of whom they sang one to another in dances, saying, Saul slew his thousands, and David his ten thousands?
verses.text: Is not this David, of whom they sang one to another in dances, saying, Saul slew his thousands, and David his ten thousands?

verses.raw: Then Achish called David, and said unto him, Surely, as Yahuah (LORD) lives, you have been upright, and your going out and your coming in with me in the host is good in my sight: for I have not found evil in you since the day of your coming unto me unto this day: nevertheless the lords favour you not.
verses.text: Then Achish called David, and said unto him, Surely, as Yahuah lives, you have been upright, and your going out and your coming in with me in the host is good in my sight: for I have not found evil in you since the day of your coming unto me unto this day: nevertheless the lords favour you not.

verses.raw: Wherefore now return, and go in peace, that you displease not the lords of the Philistines.
verses.text: Wherefore now return, and go in peace, that you displease not the lords of the Philistines.

verses.raw: And David said unto Achish, But what have I done? and what have you found in your servant so long as I have been with you unto this day, that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king?
verses.text: And David said unto Achish, But what have I done? and what have you found in your servant so long as I have been with you unto this day, that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king?

verses.raw: And Achish answered and said to David, I know that you are good in my sight, as an angel of Elohim (God): notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said, He shall not go up with us to the battle.
verses.text: And Achish answered and said to David, I know that you are good in my sight, as an angel of Elohim: notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said, He shall not go up with us to the battle.

verses.raw: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with your master’s servants that are come with you: and as soon as you be up early in the morning, and have light, depart.
verses.text: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with your master’s servants that are come with you: and as soon as you be up early in the morning, and have light, depart.

verses.raw: So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.
verses.text: So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had invaded the south, and Ziklag, and smitten Ziklag, and burned it with fire;
verses.text: And it came to pass, when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had invaded the south, and Ziklag, and smitten Ziklag, and burned it with fire;

verses.raw: And had taken the women captives, that were therein: they slew not any, either great or small, but carried them away, and went on their way.
verses.text: And had taken the women captives, that were therein: they slew not any, either great or small, but carried them away, and went on their way.

verses.raw: So David and his men came to the city, and, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, were taken captives.
verses.text: So David and his men came to the city, and, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, were taken captives.

verses.raw: Then David and the people that were with him lifted up their voice and wept, until they had no more power to weep.
verses.text: Then David and the people that were with him lifted up their voice and wept, until they had no more power to weep.

verses.raw: And David’s two wives were taken captives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
verses.text: And David’s two wives were taken captives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

verses.raw: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God).
verses.text: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in Yahuah Elohav.

verses.raw: And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech’s son, I pray you, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David.
verses.text: And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech’s son, I pray you, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David.

verses.raw: And David enquired at Yahuah (LORD), saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for you shall surely overtake them, and without fail recover all.
verses.text: And David enquired at Yahuah, saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for you shall surely overtake them, and without fail recover all.

verses.raw: So David went, he and the six hundred men that were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those that were left behind stayed.
verses.text: So David went, he and the six hundred men that were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those that were left behind stayed.

verses.raw: But David pursued, he and four hundred men: for two hundred abode behind, which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor.
verses.text: But David pursued, he and four hundred men: for two hundred abode behind, which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor.

verses.raw: And they found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he did eat; and they made him drink water;
verses.text: And they found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he did eat; and they made him drink water;

verses.raw: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins: and when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him: for he had eaten no bread, nor drunk any water, three days and three nights.
verses.text: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins: and when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him: for he had eaten no bread, nor drunk any water, three days and three nights.

verses.raw: And David said unto him, To whom belongest you? and whence are you? And he said, I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days agone I fell sick.
verses.text: And David said unto him, To whom belongest you? and whence are you? And he said, I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days agone I fell sick.

verses.raw: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites, and upon the coast which belongs to Yahudah (Judah), and upon the south of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.
verses.text: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites, and upon the coast which belongs to Yahudah, and upon the south of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.

verses.raw: And David said to him, Can you bring me down to this company? And he said, Swear unto me by Elohim (God), that you will neither kill me, nor deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will bring you down to this company.
verses.text: And David said to him, Can you bring me down to this company? And he said, Swear unto me by Elohim, that you will neither kill me, nor deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will bring you down to this company.

verses.raw: And when he had brought him down, behold, they were spread abroad upon all the earth, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And when he had brought him down, behold, they were spread abroad upon all the earth, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Yahudah.

verses.raw: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day: and there escaped not a man of them, save four hundred young men, which rode upon camels, and fled.
verses.text: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day: and there escaped not a man of them, save four hundred young men, which rode upon camels, and fled.

verses.raw: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.
verses.text: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.

verses.raw: And there was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor any thing that they had taken to them: David recovered all.
verses.text: And there was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor any thing that they had taken to them: David recovered all.

verses.raw: And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drave before those other cattle, and said, This is David’s spoil.
verses.text: And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drave before those other cattle, and said, This is David’s spoil.

verses.raw: And David came to the two hundred men, which were so faint that they could not follow David, whom they had made also to abide at the brook Besor: and they went forth to meet David, and to meet the people that were with him: and when David came near to the people, he saluted them.
verses.text: And David came to the two hundred men, which were so faint that they could not follow David, whom they had made also to abide at the brook Besor: and they went forth to meet David, and to meet the people that were with him: and when David came near to the people, he saluted them.

verses.raw: Then answered all the wicked men and men of Belial, of those that went with David, and said, Because they went not with us, we will not give them ought of the spoil that we have recovered, save to every man his wife and his children, that they may lead them away, and depart.
verses.text: Then answered all the wicked men and men of Belial, of those that went with David, and said, Because they went not with us, we will not give them ought of the spoil that we have recovered, save to every man his wife and his children, that they may lead them away, and depart.

verses.raw: Then said David, You shall not do so, my brethren, with that which Yahuah (LORD) has given us, who has preserved us, and delivered the company that came against us into our hand.
verses.text: Then said David, You shall not do so, my brethren, with that which Yahuah has given us, who has preserved us, and delivered the company that came against us into our hand.

verses.raw: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part is that goes down to the battle, so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff: they shall part alike.
verses.text: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part is that goes down to the battle, so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff: they shall part alike.

verses.raw: And it was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Yashar'el (Israel) unto this day.
verses.text: And it was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Yashar'el unto this day.

verses.raw: And when David came to Ziklag, he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Yahudah (Judah), even to his friends, saying, Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of Yahuah (LORD);
verses.text: And when David came to Ziklag, he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Yahudah, even to his friends, saying, Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of Yahuah;

verses.raw: To them which were in Beth-el, and to them which were in south Ramoth, and to them which were in Jattir,
verses.text: To them which were in Beth-el, and to them which were in south Ramoth, and to them which were in Jattir,

verses.raw: And to them which were in Aroer, and to them which were in Siphmoth, and to them which were in Eshtemoa,
verses.text: And to them which were in Aroer, and to them which were in Siphmoth, and to them which were in Eshtemoa,

verses.raw: And to them which were in Rachal, and to them which were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to them which were in the cities of the Kenites,
verses.text: And to them which were in Rachal, and to them which were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to them which were in the cities of the Kenites,

verses.raw: And to them which were in Hormah, and to them which were in Chor-ashan, and to them which were in Athach,
verses.text: And to them which were in Hormah, and to them which were in Chor-ashan, and to them which were in Athach,

verses.raw: And to them which were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men were wont to haunt.
verses.text: And to them which were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men were wont to haunt.

verses.raw: Now the Philistines fought against Yashar'el (Israel): and the men of Yashar'el (Israel) fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
verses.text: Now the Philistines fought against Yashar'el: and the men of Yashar'el fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.

verses.raw: And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, Saul’s sons.
verses.text: And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, Saul’s sons.

verses.raw: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him; and he was sore wounded of the archers.
verses.text: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him; and he was sore wounded of the archers.

verses.raw: Then said Saul unto his armourbearer, Draw your sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through, and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
verses.text: Then said Saul unto his armourbearer, Draw your sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through, and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

verses.raw: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise upon his sword, and died with him.
verses.text: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise upon his sword, and died with him.

verses.raw: So Saul died, and his three sons, and his armourbearer, and all his men, that same day together.
verses.text: So Saul died, and his three sons, and his armourbearer, and all his men, that same day together.

verses.raw: And when the men of Yashar'el (Israel) that were on the other side of the valley, and they that were on the other side Jordan, saw that the men of Yashar'el (Israel) fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook the cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
verses.text: And when the men of Yashar'el that were on the other side of the valley, and they that were on the other side Jordan, saw that the men of Yashar'el fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook the cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
verses.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

verses.raw: And they cut off his head, and stripped off his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to publish it in the house of their idols, and among the people.
verses.text: And they cut off his head, and stripped off his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to publish it in the house of their idols, and among the people.

verses.raw: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtaroth: and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth-shan.
verses.text: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtaroth: and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth-shan.

verses.raw: And when the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead heard of that which the Philistines had done to Saul;
verses.text: And when the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead heard of that which the Philistines had done to Saul;

verses.raw: All the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth-shan, and came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.
verses.text: All the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth-shan, and came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.

verses.raw: And they took their bones, and buried them under a tree at Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.text: And they took their bones, and buried them under a tree at Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;
verses.text: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;

verses.raw: It came even to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent, and earth upon his head: and so it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.
verses.text: It came even to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent, and earth upon his head: and so it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.

verses.raw: And David said unto him, From whence come you? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Yashar'el (Israel) am I escaped.
verses.text: And David said unto him, From whence come you? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Yashar'el am I escaped.

verses.raw: And David said unto him, How went the matter? I pray you, tell me. And he answered, That the people are fled from the battle, and many of the people also are fallen and dead; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.
verses.text: And David said unto him, How went the matter? I pray you, tell me. And he answered, That the people are fled from the battle, and many of the people also are fallen and dead; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.

verses.raw: And David said unto the young man that told him, How know you that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead?
verses.text: And David said unto the young man that told him, How know you that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead?

verses.raw: And the young man that told him said, As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa, behold, Saul leaned upon his spear; and, lo, the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him.
verses.text: And the young man that told him said, As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa, behold, Saul leaned upon his spear; and, lo, the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him.

verses.raw: And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called unto me. And I answered, Here am I.
verses.text: And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called unto me. And I answered, Here am I.

verses.raw: And he said unto me, Who are you? And I answered him, I am an Amalekite.
verses.text: And he said unto me, Who are you? And I answered him, I am an Amalekite.

verses.raw: He said unto me again, Stand, I pray you, upon me, and slay me: for anguish is come upon me, because my life is yet whole in me.
verses.text: He said unto me again, Stand, I pray you, upon me, and slay me: for anguish is come upon me, because my life is yet whole in me.

verses.raw: So I stood upon him, and slew him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that was upon his head, and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them hither unto my lord.
verses.text: So I stood upon him, and slew him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that was upon his head, and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them hither unto my lord.

verses.raw: Then David took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that were with him:
verses.text: Then David took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that were with him:

verses.raw: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of Yahuah (LORD), and for the house of Yashar'el (Israel); because they were fallen by the sword.
verses.text: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of Yahuah, and for the house of Yashar'el; because they were fallen by the sword.

verses.raw: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence are you? And he answered, I am the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.
verses.text: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence are you? And he answered, I am the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.

verses.raw: And David said unto him, How were you not afraid to stretch forth your hand to destroy the LORD’S anointed?
verses.text: And David said unto him, How were you not afraid to stretch forth your hand to destroy the LORD’S anointed?

verses.raw: And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near, and fall upon him. And he smote him that he died.
verses.text: And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near, and fall upon him. And he smote him that he died.

verses.raw: And David said unto him, Your blood be upon your head; for your mouth has testified against you, saying, I have slain the LORD’S anointed.
verses.text: And David said unto him, Your blood be upon your head; for your mouth has testified against you, saying, I have slain the LORD’S anointed.

verses.raw: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son:
verses.text: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son:

verses.raw: (Also he bade them teach the children of Yahudah (Judah) the use of the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jasher.)
verses.text: (Also he bade them teach the children of Yahudah the use of the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jasher.)

verses.raw: The beauty of Yashar'el (Israel) is slain upon your high places: how are the mighty fallen!
verses.text: The beauty of Yashar'el is slain upon your high places: how are the mighty fallen!

verses.raw: Tell it not in Gath, publish it not in the streets of Askelon; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.
verses.text: Tell it not in Gath, publish it not in the streets of Askelon; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.

verses.raw: You mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew, neither let there be rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul, as though he had not been anointed with oil.
verses.text: You mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew, neither let there be rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul, as though he had not been anointed with oil.

verses.raw: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.
verses.text: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.

verses.raw: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.
verses.text: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.

verses.raw: You daughters of Yashar'el (Israel), weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.
verses.text: You daughters of Yashar'el, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.

verses.raw: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, you were slain in your high places.
verses.text: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, you were slain in your high places.

verses.raw: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant have you been unto me: your love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.
verses.text: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant have you been unto me: your love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.

verses.raw: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!
verses.text: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!

verses.raw: And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of Yahuah (LORD), saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Yahudah (Judah)? And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.
verses.text: And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of Yahuah, saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Yahudah? And Yahuah said unto him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.

verses.raw: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal’s wife the Carmelite.
verses.text: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal’s wife the Carmelite.

verses.raw: And his men that were with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.
verses.text: And his men that were with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.

verses.raw: And the men of Yahudah (Judah) came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Yahudah (Judah). And they told David, saying, That the men of Jabesh-gilead were they that buried Saul.
verses.text: And the men of Yahudah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Yahudah. And they told David, saying, That the men of Jabesh-gilead were they that buried Saul.

verses.raw: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabesh-gilead, and said unto them, Blessed be you of Yahuah (LORD), that you have shewed this kindness unto your lord, even unto Saul, and have buried him.
verses.text: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabesh-gilead, and said unto them, Blessed be you of Yahuah, that you have shewed this kindness unto your lord, even unto Saul, and have buried him.

verses.raw: And now Yahuah (LORD) shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because you have done this thing.
verses.text: And now Yahuah shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because you have done this thing.

verses.raw: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be you valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Yahudah (Judah) have anointed me king over them.
verses.text: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be you valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Yahudah have anointed me king over them.

verses.raw: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s host, took Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;
verses.text: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s host, took Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;

verses.raw: And made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Ish-bosheth Saul’s son was forty years old when he began to reign over Yashar'el (Israel), and reigned two years. But the house of Yahudah (Judah) followed David.
