verses.raw: But the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!
verses.text: But the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!

verses.raw: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, You have shamed this day the faces of all your servants, which this day have saved your life, and the lives of your sons and of your daughters, and the lives of your wives, and the lives of your concubines;
verses.text: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, You have shamed this day the faces of all your servants, which this day have saved your life, and the lives of your sons and of your daughters, and the lives of your wives, and the lives of your concubines;

verses.raw: In that you love your enemies, and hate your friends. For you have declared this day, that you regard neither princes nor servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we had died this day, then it had pleased you well.
verses.text: In that you love your enemies, and hate your friends. For you have declared this day, that you regard neither princes nor servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we had died this day, then it had pleased you well.

verses.raw: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably unto your servants: for I swear by Yahuah (LORD), if you go not forth, there will not tarry one with you this night: and that will be worse unto you than all the evil that befell you from your youth until now.
verses.text: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably unto your servants: for I swear by Yahuah, if you go not forth, there will not tarry one with you this night: and that will be worse unto you than all the evil that befell you from your youth until now.

verses.raw: Then the king arose, and sat in the gate. And they told unto all the people, saying, Behold, the king does sit in the gate. And all the people came before the king: for Yashar'el (Israel) had fled every man to his tent.
verses.text: Then the king arose, and sat in the gate. And they told unto all the people, saying, Behold, the king does sit in the gate. And all the people came before the king: for Yashar'el had fled every man to his tent.

verses.raw: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies, and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom.
verses.text: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Yashar'el, saying, The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies, and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom.

verses.raw: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak you not a word of bringing the king back?
verses.text: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak you not a word of bringing the king back?

verses.raw: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Yahudah (Judah), saying, Why are you the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Yashar'el (Israel) is come to the king, even to his house.
verses.text: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Yahudah, saying, Why are you the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Yashar'el is come to the king, even to his house.

verses.raw: You are my brethren, you are my bones and my flesh: wherefore then are you the last to bring back the king?
verses.text: You are my brethren, you are my bones and my flesh: wherefore then are you the last to bring back the king?

verses.raw: And say you to Amasa, Are you not of my bone, and of my flesh? Elohim (God) do so to me, and more also, if you be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.
verses.text: And say you to Amasa, Are you not of my bone, and of my flesh? Elohim do so to me, and more also, if you be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.

verses.raw: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Yahudah (Judah), even as the heart of one man; so that they sent this word unto the king, Return you, and all your servants.
verses.text: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Yahudah, even as the heart of one man; so that they sent this word unto the king, Return you, and all your servants.

verses.raw: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Yahudah (Judah) came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.
verses.text: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Yahudah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.

verses.raw: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Yahudah (Judah) to meet king David.
verses.text: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Yahudah to meet king David.

verses.raw: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.
verses.text: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.

verses.raw: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan;
verses.text: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan;

verses.raw: And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do you remember that which your servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.
verses.text: And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do you remember that which your servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

verses.raw: For your servant does know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.
verses.text: For your servant does know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.

verses.raw: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD’S anointed?
verses.text: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD’S anointed?

verses.raw: And David said, What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah, that you should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Yashar'el (Israel)? for do not I know that I am this day king over Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: And David said, What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah, that you should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Yashar'el? for do not I know that I am this day king over Yashar'el?

verses.raw: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, You shall not die. And the king sware unto him.
verses.text: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, You shall not die. And the king sware unto him.

verses.raw: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace.
verses.text: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore went not you with me, Mephibosheth?
verses.text: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore went not you with me, Mephibosheth?

verses.raw: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for your servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because your servant is lame.
verses.text: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for your servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because your servant is lame.

verses.raw: And he has slandered your servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of Elohim (God): do therefore what is good in your eyes.
verses.text: And he has slandered your servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of Elohim: do therefore what is good in your eyes.

verses.raw: For all of my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet did you set your servant among them that did eat at your own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king?
verses.text: For all of my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet did you set your servant among them that did eat at your own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king?

verses.raw: And the king said unto him, Why speak you any more of your matters? I have said, You and Ziba divide the land.
verses.text: And the king said unto him, Why speak you any more of your matters? I have said, You and Ziba divide the land.

verses.raw: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.
verses.text: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.

verses.raw: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.
verses.text: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.

verses.raw: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.
verses.text: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.

verses.raw: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come you over with me, and I will feed you with me in Jerusalem.
verses.text: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come you over with me, and I will feed you with me in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And Barzillai said unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?
verses.text: And Barzillai said unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?

verses.raw: I am this day fourscore years old: and can I discern between good and evil? can your servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should your servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?
verses.text: I am this day fourscore years old: and can I discern between good and evil? can your servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should your servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?

verses.raw: Your servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?
verses.text: Your servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?

verses.raw: Let your servant, I pray you, turn back again, that I may die in my own city, and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother. But behold your servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto you.
verses.text: Let your servant, I pray you, turn back again, that I may die in my own city, and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother. But behold your servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto you.

verses.raw: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto you: and whatsoever you shall require of me, that will I do for you.
verses.text: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto you: and whatsoever you shall require of me, that will I do for you.

verses.raw: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.
verses.text: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.

verses.raw: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Yahudah (Judah) conducted the king, and also half the people of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Yahudah conducted the king, and also half the people of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And, behold, all the men of Yashar'el (Israel) came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Yahudah (Judah) stolen you away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all David’s men with him, over Jordan?
verses.text: And, behold, all the men of Yashar'el came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Yahudah stolen you away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all David’s men with him, over Jordan?

verses.raw: And all the men of Yahudah (Judah) answered the men of Yashar'el (Israel), Because the king is near of kin to us: wherefore then be you angry for this matter? have we eaten at all of the king’s cost? or has he given us any gift?
verses.text: And all the men of Yahudah answered the men of Yashar'el, Because the king is near of kin to us: wherefore then be you angry for this matter? have we eaten at all of the king’s cost? or has he given us any gift?

verses.raw: And the men of Yashar'el (Israel) answered the men of Yahudah (Judah), and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more right in David than you: why then did you despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Yahudah (Judah) were fiercer than the words of the men of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the men of Yashar'el answered the men of Yahudah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more right in David than you: why then did you despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Yahudah were fiercer than the words of the men of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Yashar'el.

verses.raw: So every man of Yashar'el (Israel) went up from after David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Yahudah (Judah) clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.
verses.text: So every man of Yashar'el went up from after David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Yahudah clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.
verses.text: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.

verses.raw: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Yahudah (Judah) within three days, and be you here present.
verses.text: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Yahudah within three days, and be you here present.

verses.raw: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Yahudah (Judah): but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.
verses.text: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Yahudah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.

verses.raw: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take you your lord’s servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.
verses.text: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take you your lord’s servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.

verses.raw: And there went out after him Joab’s men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.text: And there went out after him Joab’s men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

verses.raw: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab’s garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.
verses.text: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab’s garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.

verses.raw: And Joab said to Amasa, Are you in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.
verses.text: And Joab said to Amasa, Are you in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.

verses.raw: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.text: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.

verses.raw: And one of Joab’s men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that is for David, let him go after Joab.
verses.text: And one of Joab’s men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that is for David, let him go after Joab.

verses.raw: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.
verses.text: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.

verses.raw: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
verses.text: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

verses.raw: And he went through all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) unto Abel, and to Beth-maachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.
verses.text: And he went through all the tribes of Yashar'el unto Abel, and to Beth-maachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.

verses.raw: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth-maachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.
verses.text: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth-maachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.

verses.raw: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with you.
verses.text: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with you.

verses.raw: And when he was come near unto her, the woman said, Are you Joab? And he answered, I am he. Then she said unto him, Hear the words of your handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.
verses.text: And when he was come near unto her, the woman said, Are you Joab? And he answered, I am he. Then she said unto him, Hear the words of your handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.

verses.raw: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask counsel at Abel: and so they ended the matter.
verses.text: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask counsel at Abel: and so they ended the matter.

verses.raw: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Yashar'el (Israel): you seek to destroy a city and a mother in Yashar'el (Israel): why will you swallow up the inheritance of Yahuah (LORD)?
verses.text: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Yashar'el: you seek to destroy a city and a mother in Yashar'el: why will you swallow up the inheritance of Yahuah?

verses.raw: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.
verses.text: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

verses.raw: The matter is not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has lifted up his hand against the king, even against David: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to you over the wall.
verses.text: The matter is not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has lifted up his hand against the king, even against David: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to you over the wall.

verses.raw: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast it out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.
verses.text: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast it out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.

verses.raw: Now Joab was over all the host of Yashar'el (Israel): and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:
verses.text: Now Joab was over all the host of Yashar'el: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:

verses.raw: And Adoram was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder:
verses.text: And Adoram was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder:

verses.raw: And Sheva was scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:
verses.text: And Sheva was scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:

verses.raw: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.
verses.text: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.

verses.raw: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David enquired of Yahuah (LORD). And Yahuah (LORD) answered, It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.
verses.text: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David enquired of Yahuah. And Yahuah answered, It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.

verses.raw: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Yashar'el (Israel) and Yahudah (Judah).)
verses.text: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Yashar'el, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Yashar'el had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Yashar'el and Yahudah.)

verses.raw: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that you may bless the inheritance of Yahuah (LORD)?
verses.text: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that you may bless the inheritance of Yahuah?

verses.raw: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shall you kill any man in Yashar'el (Israel). And he said, What you shall say, that will I do for you.
verses.text: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shall you kill any man in Yashar'el. And he said, What you shall say, that will I do for you.

verses.raw: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Yashar'el (Israel),
verses.text: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Yashar'el,

verses.raw: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto Yahuah (LORD) in Gibeah of Saul, whom Yahuah (LORD) did choose. And the king said, I will give them.
verses.text: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto Yahuah in Gibeah of Saul, whom Yahuah did choose. And the king said, I will give them.

verses.raw: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD’S oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
verses.text: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD’S oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

verses.raw: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:
verses.text: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:

verses.raw: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before Yahuah (LORD): and they fell all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, in the beginning of barley harvest.
verses.text: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before Yahuah: and they fell all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, in the beginning of barley harvest.

verses.raw: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.
verses.text: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.

verses.raw: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.
verses.text: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.

verses.raw: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh-gilead, which had stolen them from the street of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:
verses.text: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh-gilead, which had stolen them from the street of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:

verses.raw: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.
verses.text: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.

verses.raw: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that Elohim (God) was intreated for the land.
verses.text: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that Elohim was intreated for the land.

verses.raw: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Yashar'el (Israel); and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.
verses.text: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Yashar'el; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.

verses.raw: And Ishbi-benob, which was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new sword, thought to have slain David.
verses.text: And Ishbi-benob, which was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new sword, thought to have slain David.

verses.raw: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, You shall go no more out with us to battle, that you quench not the light of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, You shall go no more out with us to battle, that you quench not the light of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant.
verses.text: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant.

verses.raw: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaare-oregim, a Beth-lehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
verses.text: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaare-oregim, a Beth-lehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

verses.raw: And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.
verses.text: And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.

verses.raw: And when he defied Yashar'el (Israel), Jonathan the son of Shimea the brother of David slew him.
verses.text: And when he defied Yashar'el, Jonathan the son of Shimea the brother of David slew him.

verses.raw: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
verses.text: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

verses.raw: And David spake unto Yahuah (LORD) the words of this song in the day that Yahuah (LORD) had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:
verses.text: And David spake unto Yahuah the words of this song in the day that Yahuah had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:

verses.raw: And he said, Yahuah (LORD) is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;
verses.text: And he said, Yahuah is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;

verses.raw: The Elohim (God) of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; you savest me from violence.
verses.text: The Elohim of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; you savest me from violence.

verses.raw: I will call on Yahuah (LORD), who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from my enemies.
verses.text: I will call on Yahuah, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from my enemies.

verses.raw: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;
verses.text: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;

verses.raw: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;
verses.text: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;

verses.raw: In my distress I called upon Yahuah (LORD), and cried to my Elohim (God): and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears.
verses.text: In my distress I called upon Yahuah, and cried to my Elohim: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears.

verses.raw: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.
verses.text: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.

verses.raw: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
verses.text: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

verses.raw: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet.
verses.text: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet.

verses.raw: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.
verses.text: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.

verses.raw: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
verses.text: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.

verses.raw: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.
verses.text: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) thundered from heaven, and the El Elyon (most High) uttered his voice.
verses.text: Yahuah thundered from heaven, and the El Elyon uttered his voice.

verses.raw: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.
verses.text: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.

verses.raw: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of Yahuah (LORD), at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
verses.text: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of Yahuah, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

verses.raw: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;
verses.text: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;

verses.raw: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.
verses.text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.

verses.raw: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but Yahuah (LORD) was my stay.
verses.text: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but Yahuah was my stay.

verses.raw: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.text: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands has he recompensed me.
verses.text: Yahuah rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands has he recompensed me.

verses.raw: For I have kept the ways of Yahuah (LORD), and have not wickedly departed from my Elohim (God).
verses.text: For I have kept the ways of Yahuah, and have not wickedly departed from my Elohim.

verses.raw: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.
verses.text: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.

verses.raw: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from my iniquity.
verses.text: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from my iniquity.

verses.raw: Therefore Yahuah (LORD) has recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.
verses.text: Therefore Yahuah has recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.

verses.raw: With the merciful you will shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man you will shew thyself upright.
verses.text: With the merciful you will shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man you will shew thyself upright.

verses.raw: With the pure you will shew thyself pure; and with the froward you will shew thyself unsavoury.
verses.text: With the pure you will shew thyself pure; and with the froward you will shew thyself unsavoury.

verses.raw: And the afflicted people you will save: but your eyes are upon the haughty, that you may bring them down.
verses.text: And the afflicted people you will save: but your eyes are upon the haughty, that you may bring them down.

verses.raw: For you are my lamp, O Yahuah (LORD): and Yahuah (LORD) will lighten my darkness.
verses.text: For you are my lamp, O Yahuah: and Yahuah will lighten my darkness.

verses.raw: For by you I have run through a troop: by my Elohim (God) have I leaped over a wall.
verses.text: For by you I have run through a troop: by my Elohim have I leaped over a wall.

verses.raw: As for Elohim (God), his way is perfect; the word of Yahuah (LORD) is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.
verses.text: As for Elohim, his way is perfect; the word of Yahuah is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.

verses.raw: For who is Elohim (God), save Yahuah (LORD)? and who is a rock, save our Elohim (God)?
verses.text: For who is Elohim, save Yahuah? and who is a rock, save our Elohim?

verses.raw: Elohim (God) is my strength and power: and he makes my way perfect.
verses.text: Elohim is my strength and power: and he makes my way perfect.

verses.raw: He makes my feet like hinds’ feet: and sets me upon my high places.
verses.text: He makes my feet like hinds’ feet: and sets me upon my high places.

verses.raw: He teaches my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by my arms.
verses.text: He teaches my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by my arms.

verses.raw: You have also given me the shield of your salvation: and your gentleness has made me great.
verses.text: You have also given me the shield of your salvation: and your gentleness has made me great.

verses.raw: You have enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.
verses.text: You have enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.

verses.raw: I have pursued my enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.
verses.text: I have pursued my enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.

verses.raw: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.
verses.text: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.

verses.raw: For you have girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me have you subdued under me.
verses.text: For you have girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me have you subdued under me.

verses.raw: You have also given me the necks of my enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.
verses.text: You have also given me the necks of my enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.

verses.raw: They looked, but there was none to save; even unto Yahuah (LORD), but he answered them not.
verses.text: They looked, but there was none to save; even unto Yahuah, but he answered them not.

verses.raw: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad.
verses.text: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad.

verses.raw: You also have delivered me from the strivings of my people, you have kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me.
verses.text: You also have delivered me from the strivings of my people, you have kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me.

verses.raw: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.
verses.text: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.

verses.raw: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.
verses.text: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) lives; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the Elohim (God) of the rock of my salvation.
verses.text: Yahuah lives; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the Elohim of the rock of my salvation.

verses.raw: It is Elohim (God) that avenges me, and that brings down the people under me,
verses.text: It is Elohim that avenges me, and that brings down the people under me,

verses.raw: And that brings me forth from my enemies: you also have lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: you have delivered me from the violent man.
verses.text: And that brings me forth from my enemies: you also have lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: you have delivered me from the violent man.

verses.raw: Therefore I will give thanks unto you, O Yahuah (LORD), among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto your name.
verses.text: Therefore I will give thanks unto you, O Yahuah, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto your name.

verses.raw: He is the tower of salvation for his king: and shows mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.
verses.text: He is the tower of salvation for his king: and shows mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.

verses.raw: Now these be the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of the Elohim (God) of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Yashar'el (Israel), said,
verses.text: Now these be the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of the Elohim of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Yashar'el, said,

verses.raw: The Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) spake by me, and his word was in my tongue.
verses.text: The Spirit of Yahuah spake by me, and his word was in my tongue.

verses.raw: The Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) said, the Rock of Yashar'el (Israel) spake to me, He that rules over men must be just, ruling in the fear of Elohim (God).
verses.text: The Elohim of Yashar'el said, the Rock of Yashar'el spake to me, He that rules over men must be just, ruling in the fear of Elohim.

verses.raw: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun rises, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.
verses.text: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun rises, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.

verses.raw: Although my house be not so with Elohim (God); yet he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure: for this is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he make it not to grow.
verses.text: Although my house be not so with Elohim; yet he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure: for this is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he make it not to grow.

verses.raw: But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:
verses.text: But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:

verses.raw: But the man that shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the same place.
verses.text: But the man that shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the same place.

verses.raw: These be the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite: he lift up his spear against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.
verses.text: These be the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite: he lift up his spear against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.

verses.raw: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Yashar'el (Israel) were gone away:
verses.text: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Yashar'el were gone away:

verses.raw: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and Yahuah (LORD) wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.
verses.text: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and Yahuah wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.

verses.raw: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.
verses.text: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.

verses.raw: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and Yahuah (LORD) wrought a great victory.
verses.text: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and Yahuah wrought a great victory.

verses.raw: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.text: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.raw: And David was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Beth-lehem.
verses.text: And David was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Beth-lehem.

verses.raw: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem, which is by the gate!
verses.text: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem, which is by the gate!

verses.raw: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he said, Be it far from me, O Yahuah (LORD), that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.
verses.text: And he said, Be it far from me, O Yahuah, that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.

verses.raw: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, and slew them, and had the name among three.
verses.text: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, and slew them, and had the name among three.

verses.raw: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first three.
verses.text: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first three.

verses.raw: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:

verses.raw: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.
