verses.raw: And again the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was kindled against Yashar'el (Israel), and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Yashar'el (Israel) and Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And again the anger of Yahuah was kindled against Yashar'el, and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Yashar'el and Yahudah.

verses.raw: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which was with him, Go now through all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), from Dan even to Beer-sheba, and number you the people, that I may know the number of the people.
verses.text: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which was with him, Go now through all the tribes of Yashar'el, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, and number you the people, that I may know the number of the people.

verses.raw: And Joab said unto the king, Now Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see it: but why does my lord the king delight in this thing?
verses.text: And Joab said unto the king, Now Yahuah Elohayka add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see it: but why does my lord the king delight in this thing?

verses.raw: Notwithstanding the king’s word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Notwithstanding the king’s word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that lies in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer:
verses.text: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that lies in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer:

verses.raw: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtim-hodshi; and they came to Dan-jaan, and about to Zidon,
verses.text: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtim-hodshi; and they came to Dan-jaan, and about to Zidon,

verses.raw: And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Yahudah (Judah), even to Beer-sheba.
verses.text: And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Yahudah, even to Beer-sheba.

verses.raw: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
verses.text: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

verses.raw: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king: and there were in Yashar'el (Israel) eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Yahudah (Judah) were five hundred thousand men.
verses.text: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king: and there were in Yashar'el eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Yahudah were five hundred thousand men.

verses.raw: And David’s heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto Yahuah (LORD), I have sinned greatly in that I have done: and now, I beseech you, O Yahuah (LORD), take away the iniquity of your servant; for I have done very foolishly.
verses.text: And David’s heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto Yahuah, I have sinned greatly in that I have done: and now, I beseech you, O Yahuah, take away the iniquity of your servant; for I have done very foolishly.

verses.raw: For when David was up in the morning, the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,
verses.text: For when David was up in the morning, the word of Yahuah came unto the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,

verses.raw: Go and say unto David, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), I offer you three things; choose you one of them, that I may do it unto you.
verses.text: Go and say unto David, Thus says Yahuah, I offer you three things; choose you one of them, that I may do it unto you.

verses.raw: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto you in your land? or will you flee three months before your enemies, while they pursue you? or that there be three days’ pestilence in your land? now advise, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.
verses.text: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto you in your land? or will you flee three months before your enemies, while they pursue you? or that there be three days’ pestilence in your land? now advise, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.

verses.raw: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of Yahuah (LORD); for his mercies are great: and let me not fall into the hand of man.
verses.text: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of Yahuah; for his mercies are great: and let me not fall into the hand of man.

verses.raw: So Yahuah (LORD) sent a pestilence upon Yashar'el (Israel) from the morning even to the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to Beer-sheba seventy thousand men.
verses.text: So Yahuah sent a pestilence upon Yashar'el from the morning even to the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to Beer-sheba seventy thousand men.

verses.raw: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, Yahuah (LORD) repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now your hand. And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.text: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, Yahuah repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now your hand. And the angel of Yahuah was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite.

verses.raw: And David spake unto Yahuah (LORD) when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let your hand, I pray you, be against me, and against my father’s house.
verses.text: And David spake unto Yahuah when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let your hand, I pray you, be against me, and against my father’s house.

verses.raw: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto Yahuah (LORD) in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite.
verses.text: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto Yahuah in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite.

verses.raw: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as Yahuah (LORD) commanded.
verses.text: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as Yahuah commanded.

verses.raw: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.
verses.text: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.

verses.raw: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of you, to build an altar unto Yahuah (LORD), that the plague may be stayed from the people.
verses.text: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of you, to build an altar unto Yahuah, that the plague may be stayed from the people.

verses.raw: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what seems good unto him: behold, here be oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood.
verses.text: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what seems good unto him: behold, here be oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood.

verses.raw: All these things did Araunah, as a king, give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, Yahuah Elohayka (The LORD thy God) accept you.
verses.text: All these things did Araunah, as a king, give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, Yahuah Elohayka (The LORD thy God) accept you.

verses.raw: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of you at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God) of that which does cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
verses.text: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of you at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto Yahuah Elohai of that which does cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

verses.raw: And David built there an altar unto Yahuah (LORD), and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So Yahuah (LORD) was intreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And David built there an altar unto Yahuah, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So Yahuah was intreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.
verses.text: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.

verses.raw: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in your bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.
verses.text: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in your bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.

verses.raw: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
verses.text: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Yashar'el, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

verses.raw: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.
verses.text: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.

verses.raw: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.text: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

verses.raw: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why have you done so? and he also was a very goodly man; and his mother bare him after Absalom.
verses.text: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why have you done so? and he also was a very goodly man; and his mother bare him after Absalom.

verses.raw: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him.
verses.text: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him.

verses.raw: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
verses.text: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

verses.raw: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by En-rogel, and called all his brethren the king’s sons, and all the men of Yahudah (Judah) the king’s servants:
verses.text: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by En-rogel, and called all his brethren the king’s sons, and all the men of Yahudah the king’s servants:

verses.raw: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.
verses.text: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.

verses.raw: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Have you not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith does reign, and David our lord knows it not?
verses.text: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Have you not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith does reign, and David our lord knows it not?

verses.raw: Now therefore come, let me, I pray you, give you counsel, that you may save your own life, and the life of your son Solomon.
verses.text: Now therefore come, let me, I pray you, give you counsel, that you may save your own life, and the life of your son Solomon.

verses.raw: Go and get you in unto king David, and say unto him, Did not you, my lord, O king, swear unto your handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then does Adonijah reign?
verses.text: Go and get you in unto king David, and say unto him, Did not you, my lord, O king, swear unto your handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then does Adonijah reign?

verses.raw: Behold, while you yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after you, and confirm your words.
verses.text: Behold, while you yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after you, and confirm your words.

verses.raw: And Bath-sheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.
verses.text: And Bath-sheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.

verses.raw: And Bath-sheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What would you?
verses.text: And Bath-sheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What would you?

verses.raw: And she said unto him, My lord, you swore by Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) unto your handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.
verses.text: And she said unto him, My lord, you swore by Yahuah Elohayka unto your handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.

verses.raw: And now, behold, Adonijah reigns; and now, my lord the king, you know it not:
verses.text: And now, behold, Adonijah reigns; and now, my lord the king, you know it not:

verses.raw: And he has slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and has called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon your servant has he not called.
verses.text: And he has slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and has called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon your servant has he not called.

verses.raw: And you, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Yashar'el (Israel) are upon you, that you should tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
verses.text: And you, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Yashar'el are upon you, that you should tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

verses.raw: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.
verses.text: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.

verses.raw: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.
verses.text: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.

verses.raw: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
verses.text: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

verses.raw: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, have you said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?
verses.text: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, have you said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?

verses.raw: For he is gone down this day, and has slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king’s sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, Elohim (God) save king Adonijah.
verses.text: For he is gone down this day, and has slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king’s sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, Elohim save king Adonijah.

verses.raw: But me, even me your servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon, has he not called.
verses.text: But me, even me your servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon, has he not called.

verses.raw: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and you have not shewed it unto your servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?
verses.text: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and you have not shewed it unto your servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?

verses.raw: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bath-sheba. And she came into the king’s presence, and stood before the king.
verses.text: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bath-sheba. And she came into the king’s presence, and stood before the king.

verses.raw: And the king sware, and said, As Yahuah (LORD) lives, that has redeemed my soul out of all distress,
verses.text: And the king sware, and said, As Yahuah lives, that has redeemed my soul out of all distress,

verses.raw: Even as I sware unto you by Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.
verses.text: Even as I sware unto you by Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, saying, Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.

verses.raw: Then Bath-sheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.
verses.text: Then Bath-sheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.

verses.raw: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.
verses.text: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.

verses.raw: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:
verses.text: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:

verses.raw: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Yashar'el (Israel): and blow you with the trumpet, and say, Elohim (God) save king Solomon.
verses.text: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Yashar'el: and blow you with the trumpet, and say, Elohim save king Solomon.

verses.raw: Then you shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Yashar'el (Israel) and over Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: Then you shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Yashar'el and over Yahudah.

verses.raw: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of my lord the king say so too.
verses.text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: Yahuah Elohim of my lord the king say so too.

verses.raw: As Yahuah (LORD) has been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.
verses.text: As Yahuah has been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.

verses.raw: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.
verses.text: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.

verses.raw: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, Elohim (God) save king Solomon.
verses.text: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, Elohim save king Solomon.

verses.raw: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.
verses.text: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.

verses.raw: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?
verses.text: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?

verses.raw: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for you are a valiant man, and bring good tidings.
verses.text: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for you are a valiant man, and bring good tidings.

verses.raw: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David has made Solomon king.
verses.text: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David has made Solomon king.

verses.raw: And the king has sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king’s mule:
verses.text: And the king has sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king’s mule:

verses.raw: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that you have heard.
verses.text: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that you have heard.

verses.raw: And also Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom.
verses.text: And also Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom.

verses.raw: And moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, Elohim (God) make the name of Solomon better than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.
verses.text: And moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, Elohim make the name of Solomon better than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.

verses.raw: And also thus said the king, Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), which has given one to sit on my throne this day, my eyes even seeing it.
verses.text: And also thus said the king, Blessed be Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, which has given one to sit on my throne this day, my eyes even seeing it.

verses.raw: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.
verses.text: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.

verses.raw: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.text: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

verses.raw: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah fears king Solomon: for, lo, he has caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword.
verses.text: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah fears king Solomon: for, lo, he has caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword.

verses.raw: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.
verses.text: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.

verses.raw: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to your house.
verses.text: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to your house.

verses.raw: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,
verses.text: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,

verses.raw: I go the way of all the earth: be you strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;
verses.text: I go the way of all the earth: be you strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;

verses.raw: And keep the charge of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that you may prosper in all that you do, and whithersoever you turn thyself:
verses.text: And keep the charge of Yahuah Elohayka, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that you may prosper in all that you do, and whithersoever you turn thyself:

verses.raw: That Yahuah (LORD) may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If your children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail you (said he) a man on the throne of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: That Yahuah may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If your children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail you (said he) a man on the throne of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Moreover you know also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Yashar'el (Israel), unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.
verses.text: Moreover you know also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Yashar'el, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.

verses.raw: Do therefore according to your wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.
verses.text: Do therefore according to your wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.

verses.raw: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at your table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom your brother.
verses.text: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at your table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom your brother.

verses.raw: And, behold, you have with you Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by Yahuah (LORD), saying, I will not put you to death with the sword.
verses.text: And, behold, you have with you Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by Yahuah, saying, I will not put you to death with the sword.

verses.raw: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for you are a wise man, and know what you oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring you down to the grave with blood.
verses.text: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for you are a wise man, and know what you oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring you down to the grave with blood.

verses.raw: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.
verses.text: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.

verses.raw: And the days that David reigned over Yashar'el (Israel) were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
verses.text: And the days that David reigned over Yashar'el were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.
verses.text: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.

verses.raw: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Come you peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.
verses.text: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Come you peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.

verses.raw: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto you. And she said, Say on.
verses.text: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto you. And she said, Say on.

verses.raw: And he said, You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Yashar'el (Israel) set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother’s: for it was his from Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And he said, You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Yashar'el set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother’s: for it was his from Yahuah.

verses.raw: And now I ask one petition of you, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.
verses.text: And now I ask one petition of you, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.

verses.raw: And he said, Speak, I pray you, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say you nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.
verses.text: And he said, Speak, I pray you, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say you nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.

verses.raw: And Bath-sheba said, Well; I will speak for you unto the king.
verses.text: And Bath-sheba said, Well; I will speak for you unto the king.

verses.raw: Bath-sheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.
verses.text: Bath-sheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.

verses.raw: Then she said, I desire one small petition of you; I pray you, say me not nay. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say you nay.
verses.text: Then she said, I desire one small petition of you; I pray you, say me not nay. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say you nay.

verses.raw: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother to wife.
verses.text: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother to wife.

verses.raw: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.
verses.text: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.

verses.raw: Then king Solomon sware by Yahuah (LORD), saying, Elohim (God) do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.
verses.text: Then king Solomon sware by Yahuah, saying, Elohim do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.

verses.raw: Now therefore, as Yahuah (LORD) lives, which has established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who has made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.
verses.text: Now therefore, as Yahuah lives, which has established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who has made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.

verses.raw: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.
verses.text: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.

verses.raw: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get you to Anathoth, unto your own fields; for you are worthy of death: but I will not at this time put you to death, because you barest the ark of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) before David my father, and because you have been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.
verses.text: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get you to Anathoth, unto your own fields; for you are worthy of death: but I will not at this time put you to death, because you barest the ark of Adonai Yahuah before David my father, and because you have been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.

verses.raw: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto Yahuah (LORD); that he might fulfil the word of Yahuah (LORD), which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
verses.text: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto Yahuah; that he might fulfil the word of Yahuah, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

verses.raw: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of Yahuah (LORD), and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.text: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of Yahuah, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

verses.raw: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of Yahuah (LORD); and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.
verses.text: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of Yahuah; and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.

verses.raw: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of Yahuah (LORD), and said unto him, Thus says the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.
verses.text: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of Yahuah, and said unto him, Thus says the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.

verses.raw: And the king said unto him, Do as he has said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that you may take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.
verses.text: And the king said unto him, Do as he has said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that you may take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Yashar'el (Israel), and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And Yahuah shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Yashar'el, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Yahudah.

verses.raw: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from Yahuah.

verses.raw: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
verses.text: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.

verses.raw: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.
verses.text: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.

verses.raw: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build you an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.
verses.text: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build you an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.

verses.raw: For it shall be, that on the day you go out, and passest over the brook Kidron, you shall know for certain that you shall surely die: your blood shall be upon your own head.
verses.text: For it shall be, that on the day you go out, and passest over the brook Kidron, you shall know for certain that you shall surely die: your blood shall be upon your own head.

verses.raw: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king has said, so will your servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.
verses.text: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king has said, so will your servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.

verses.raw: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, your servants be in Gath.
verses.text: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, your servants be in Gath.

verses.raw: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.
verses.text: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.

verses.raw: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.
verses.text: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.

verses.raw: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make you to swear by Yahuah (LORD), and protested unto you, saying, Know for a certain, on the day you go out, and walk abroad any whither, that you shall surely die? and you saidst unto me, The word that I have heard is good.
verses.text: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make you to swear by Yahuah, and protested unto you, saying, Know for a certain, on the day you go out, and walk abroad any whither, that you shall surely die? and you saidst unto me, The word that I have heard is good.

verses.raw: Why then have you not kept the oath of Yahuah (LORD), and the commandment that I have charged you with?
verses.text: Why then have you not kept the oath of Yahuah, and the commandment that I have charged you with?

verses.raw: The king said moreover to Shimei, You know all the wickedness which your heart is privy to, that you did to David my father: therefore Yahuah (LORD) shall return your wickedness upon your own head;
verses.text: The king said moreover to Shimei, You know all the wickedness which your heart is privy to, that you did to David my father: therefore Yahuah shall return your wickedness upon your own head;

verses.raw: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before Yahuah (LORD) for ever.
verses.text: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before Yahuah for ever.

verses.raw: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
verses.text: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.

verses.raw: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh’s daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the wall of Jerusalem round about.
verses.text: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh’s daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of Yahuah, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.

verses.raw: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of Yahuah (LORD), until those days.
verses.text: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of Yahuah, until those days.

verses.raw: And Solomon loved Yahuah (LORD), walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.
verses.text: And Solomon loved Yahuah, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.

verses.raw: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.
verses.text: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.

verses.raw: In Gibeon Yahuah (LORD) appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and Elohim (God) said, Ask what I shall give you.
verses.text: In Gibeon Yahuah appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and Elohim said, Ask what I shall give you.

verses.raw: And Solomon said, You have shewed unto your servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before you in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with you; and you have kept for him this great kindness, that you have given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.
verses.text: And Solomon said, You have shewed unto your servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before you in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with you; and you have kept for him this great kindness, that you have given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.

verses.raw: And now, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), you have made your servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child: I know not how to go out or come in.
verses.text: And now, O Yahuah my Elohim, you have made your servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child: I know not how to go out or come in.

verses.raw: And your servant is in the midst of your people which you have chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.
verses.text: And your servant is in the midst of your people which you have chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.

verses.raw: Give therefore your servant an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this your so great a people?
verses.text: Give therefore your servant an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this your so great a people?

verses.raw: And the speech pleased Adonai (Lord), that Solomon had asked this thing.
verses.text: And the speech pleased Adonai, that Solomon had asked this thing.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) said unto him, Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for thyself long life; neither have asked riches for thyself, nor have asked the life of your enemies; but have asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;
verses.text: And Elohim said unto him, Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for thyself long life; neither have asked riches for thyself, nor have asked the life of your enemies; but have asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;

verses.raw: Behold, I have done according to your words: lo, I have given you a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like you before you, neither after you shall any arise like unto you.
verses.text: Behold, I have done according to your words: lo, I have given you a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like you before you, neither after you shall any arise like unto you.

verses.raw: And I have also given you that which you have not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto you all your days.
verses.text: And I have also given you that which you have not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto you all your days.

verses.raw: And if you will walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as your father David did walk, then I will lengthen your days.
verses.text: And if you will walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as your father David did walk, then I will lengthen your days.

verses.raw: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD), and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.
verses.text: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of Yahuah, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.

verses.raw: Then came there two women, that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.
verses.text: Then came there two women, that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.

verses.raw: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.
verses.text: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.

verses.raw: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.
verses.text: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.

verses.raw: And this woman’s child died in the night; because she overlaid it.
verses.text: And this woman’s child died in the night; because she overlaid it.

verses.raw: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while your handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
verses.text: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while your handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

verses.raw: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.
verses.text: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.

verses.raw: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is your son. And this said, No; but the dead is your son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.
verses.text: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is your son. And this said, No; but the dead is your son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.

verses.raw: Then said the king, The one says, This is my son that lives, and your son is the dead: and the other says, Nay; but your son is the dead, and my son is the living.
verses.text: Then said the king, The one says, This is my son that lives, and your son is the dead: and the other says, Nay; but your son is the dead, and my son is the living.

verses.raw: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.
verses.text: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.

verses.raw: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
verses.text: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.

verses.raw: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither my nor yours, but divide it.
verses.text: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither my nor yours, but divide it.

verses.raw: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.
verses.text: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.

verses.raw: And all Yashar'el (Israel) heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of Elohim (God) was in him, to do judgment.
verses.text: And all Yashar'el heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of Elohim was in him, to do judgment.

verses.raw: So king Solomon was king over all Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: So king Solomon was king over all Yashar'el.

verses.text: And these were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,

verses.raw: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.
verses.text: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.

verses.text: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.

verses.raw: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Yashar'el (Israel), which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.
verses.text: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Yashar'el, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.

verses.raw: Yahudah (Judah) and Yashar'el (Israel) were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.
verses.text: Yahudah and Yashar'el were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.

verses.raw: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.
verses.text: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.

verses.raw: And Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,
verses.text: And Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,

verses.raw: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.
verses.text: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.

verses.raw: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
verses.text: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) and Yashar'el (Israel) dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, all the days of Solomon.
verses.text: And Yahudah and Yashar'el dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, all the days of Solomon.

verses.raw: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
verses.text: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

verses.raw: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon’s table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.
verses.text: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon’s table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.

verses.raw: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.
verses.text: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.
verses.text: And Elohim gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.

verses.raw: And Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.
verses.text: And Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.

verses.raw: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.
verses.text: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.

verses.raw: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.
verses.text: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.

verses.raw: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
verses.text: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.

verses.raw: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.
verses.text: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.

verses.raw: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.
verses.text: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.

verses.raw: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
verses.text: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

verses.raw: You know how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God) for the wars which were about him on every side, until Yahuah (LORD) put them under the soles of his feet.
verses.text: You know how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of Yahuah Elohav for the wars which were about him on every side, until Yahuah put them under the soles of his feet.

verses.raw: But now Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God) has given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.
verses.text: But now Yahuah Elohai has given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.

verses.raw: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God), as Yahuah (LORD) spake unto David my father, saying, Your son, whom I will set upon your throne in your room, he shall build an house unto my name.
verses.text: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of Yahuah Elohai, as Yahuah spake unto David my father, saying, Your son, whom I will set upon your throne in your room, he shall build an house unto my name.

verses.raw: Now therefore command you that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with your servants: and unto you will I give hire for your servants according to all that you shall appoint: for you know that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.
verses.text: Now therefore command you that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with your servants: and unto you will I give hire for your servants according to all that you shall appoint: for you know that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be Yahuah (LORD) this day, which has given unto David a wise son over this great people.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be Yahuah this day, which has given unto David a wise son over this great people.

verses.raw: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which you sentest to me for: and I will do all your desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.
verses.text: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which you sentest to me for: and I will do all your desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.

verses.raw: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that you shall appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and you shall receive them: and you shall accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.
verses.text: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that you shall appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and you shall receive them: and you shall accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.

verses.raw: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.
verses.text: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.

verses.raw: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.
verses.text: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.
verses.text: And Yahuah gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.

verses.raw: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Yashar'el (Israel); and the levy was thirty thousand men.
verses.text: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Yashar'el; and the levy was thirty thousand men.

verses.raw: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.
verses.text: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.

verses.raw: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;
verses.text: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;

verses.raw: Beside the chief of Solomon’s officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.
verses.text: Beside the chief of Solomon’s officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.

verses.raw: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.
verses.text: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.

verses.raw: And Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders did hew them, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.
verses.text: And Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders did hew them, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Yashar'el (Israel), in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Yashar'el were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Yashar'el, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the house which king Solomon built for Yahuah (LORD), the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits.
verses.text: And the house which king Solomon built for Yahuah, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits.

verses.raw: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.
verses.text: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.

verses.raw: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.
verses.text: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.

verses.raw: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:

verses.raw: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.
verses.text: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.

verses.raw: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
verses.text: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.

verses.raw: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.

verses.raw: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.

verses.raw: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Solomon, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came to Solomon, saying,

verses.raw: Concerning this house which you are in building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with you, which I spake unto David your father:
verses.text: Concerning this house which you are in building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with you, which I spake unto David your father:

verses.raw: And I will dwell among the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and will not forsake my people Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And I will dwell among the children of Yashar'el, and will not forsake my people Yashar'el.

verses.raw: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.
verses.text: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.

verses.raw: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the cieling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.
verses.text: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the cieling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.

verses.raw: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.
verses.text: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.

verses.raw: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.
verses.text: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.

verses.raw: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.
verses.text: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.

verses.raw: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.
verses.text: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.

verses.raw: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.

verses.text: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.

verses.raw: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.
verses.text: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.

verses.raw: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.

verses.raw: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.
verses.text: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.

verses.raw: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.
verses.text: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.

verses.raw: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of Yahuah (LORD) laid, in the month Zif:
verses.text: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of Yahuah laid, in the month Zif:

verses.raw: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
verses.text: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.

verses.raw: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
verses.text: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

verses.raw: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.
verses.text: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.

verses.raw: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.
verses.text: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.

verses.raw: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.
verses.text: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.

verses.raw: And all the doors and posts were square, with the windows: and light was against light in three ranks.
verses.text: And all the doors and posts were square, with the windows: and light was against light in three ranks.

verses.raw: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.
verses.text: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.

verses.raw: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.
verses.text: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.

verses.raw: And his house where he dwelt had another court within the porch, which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had taken to wife, like unto this porch.
verses.text: And his house where he dwelt had another court within the porch, which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had taken to wife, like unto this porch.

verses.raw: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.
verses.text: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.

verses.raw: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.
verses.text: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.

verses.raw: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.
verses.text: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.

verses.raw: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and for the porch of the house.
verses.text: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of Yahuah, and for the porch of the house.

verses.raw: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.
verses.text: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.

verses.raw: He was a widow’s son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.
verses.text: He was a widow’s son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.

verses.raw: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.
verses.text: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.

verses.raw: And he made two chapiters of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:
verses.text: And he made two chapiters of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:

verses.raw: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.
verses.text: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.

verses.raw: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.
verses.text: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.

verses.raw: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.
verses.text: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.

verses.raw: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.
verses.text: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.

verses.raw: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.
verses.text: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.

verses.raw: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.
verses.text: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.

verses.raw: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
