verses.text: And the king arose in the night, and said unto his servants, I will now shew you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we be hungry; therefore are they gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, When they come out of the city, we shall catch them alive, and get into the city.

verses.raw: And one of his servants answered and said, Let some take, I pray you, five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city, (behold, they are as all the multitude of Yashar'el (Israel) that are left in it: behold, I say, they are even as all the multitude of the Israelites that are consumed:) and let us send and see.
verses.text: And one of his servants answered and said, Let some take, I pray you, five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city, (behold, they are as all the multitude of Yashar'el that are left in it: behold, I say, they are even as all the multitude of the Israelites that are consumed:) and let us send and see.

verses.raw: They took therefore two chariot horses; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians, saying, Go and see.
verses.text: They took therefore two chariot horses; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians, saying, Go and see.

verses.raw: And they went after them unto Jordan: and, lo, all the way was full of garments and vessels, which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. And the messengers returned, and told the king.
verses.text: And they went after them unto Jordan: and, lo, all the way was full of garments and vessels, which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. And the messengers returned, and told the king.

verses.raw: And the people went out, and spoiled the tents of the Syrians. So a measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the people went out, and spoiled the tents of the Syrians. So a measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the word of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the king appointed the lord on whose hand he leaned to have the charge of the gate: and the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died, as the man of Elohim (God) had said, who spake when the king came down to him.
verses.text: And the king appointed the lord on whose hand he leaned to have the charge of the gate: and the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died, as the man of Elohim had said, who spake when the king came down to him.

verses.raw: And it came to pass as the man of Elohim (God) had spoken to the king, saying, Two measures of barley for a shekel, and a measure of fine flour for a shekel, shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria:
verses.text: And it came to pass as the man of Elohim had spoken to the king, saying, Two measures of barley for a shekel, and a measure of fine flour for a shekel, shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria:

verses.raw: And that lord answered the man of Elohim (God), and said, Now, behold, if Yahuah (LORD) should make windows in heaven, might such a thing be? And he said, Behold, you shall see it with your eyes, but shall not eat thereof.
verses.text: And that lord answered the man of Elohim, and said, Now, behold, if Yahuah should make windows in heaven, might such a thing be? And he said, Behold, you shall see it with your eyes, but shall not eat thereof.

verses.raw: And so it fell out unto him: for the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died.
verses.text: And so it fell out unto him: for the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died.

verses.raw: Then spake Elisha unto the woman, whose son he had restored to life, saying, Arise, and go you and your household, and sojourn wheresoever you can sojourn: for Yahuah (LORD) has called for a famine; and it shall also come upon the land seven years.
verses.text: Then spake Elisha unto the woman, whose son he had restored to life, saying, Arise, and go you and your household, and sojourn wheresoever you can sojourn: for Yahuah has called for a famine; and it shall also come upon the land seven years.

verses.raw: And the woman arose, and did after the saying of the man of Elohim (God): and she went with her household, and sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years.
verses.text: And the woman arose, and did after the saying of the man of Elohim: and she went with her household, and sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years.

verses.raw: And it came to pass at the seven years’ end, that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines: and she went forth to cry unto the king for her house and for her land.
verses.text: And it came to pass at the seven years’ end, that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines: and she went forth to cry unto the king for her house and for her land.

verses.raw: And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of Elohim (God), saying, Tell me, I pray you, all the great things that Elisha has done.
verses.text: And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of Elohim, saying, Tell me, I pray you, all the great things that Elisha has done.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life, that, behold, the woman, whose son he had restored to life, cried to the king for her house and for her land. And Gehazi said, My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life, that, behold, the woman, whose son he had restored to life, cried to the king for her house and for her land. And Gehazi said, My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.

verses.raw: And when the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed unto her a certain officer, saying, Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.
verses.text: And when the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed unto her a certain officer, saying, Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.

verses.raw: And Elisha came to Damascus; and Ben-hadad the king of Syria was sick; and it was told him, saying, The man of Elohim (God) is come hither.
verses.text: And Elisha came to Damascus; and Ben-hadad the king of Syria was sick; and it was told him, saying, The man of Elohim is come hither.

verses.raw: And the king said unto Hazael, Take a present in your hand, and go, meet the man of Elohim (God), and enquire of Yahuah (LORD) by him, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?
verses.text: And the king said unto Hazael, Take a present in your hand, and go, meet the man of Elohim, and enquire of Yahuah by him, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?

verses.raw: So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden, and came and stood before him, and said, Your son Ben-hadad king of Syria has sent me to you, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?
verses.text: So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden, and came and stood before him, and said, Your son Ben-hadad king of Syria has sent me to you, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?

verses.raw: And Elisha said unto him, Go, say unto him, You may certainly recover: howbeit Yahuah (LORD) has shewed me that he shall surely die.
verses.text: And Elisha said unto him, Go, say unto him, You may certainly recover: howbeit Yahuah has shewed me that he shall surely die.

verses.raw: And he settled his countenance stedfastly, until he was ashamed: and the man of Elohim (God) wept.
verses.text: And he settled his countenance stedfastly, until he was ashamed: and the man of Elohim wept.

verses.raw: And Hazael said, Why weeps my lord? And he answered, Because I know the evil that you will do unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel): their strong holds will you set on fire, and their young men will you slay with the sword, and will dash their children, and rip up their women with child.
verses.text: And Hazael said, Why weeps my lord? And he answered, Because I know the evil that you will do unto the children of Yashar'el: their strong holds will you set on fire, and their young men will you slay with the sword, and will dash their children, and rip up their women with child.

verses.raw: And Hazael said, But what, is your servant a dog, that he should do this great thing? And Elisha answered, Yahuah (LORD) has shewed me that you shall be king over Syria.
verses.text: And Hazael said, But what, is your servant a dog, that he should do this great thing? And Elisha answered, Yahuah has shewed me that you shall be king over Syria.

verses.raw: So he departed from Elisha, and came to his master; who said to him, What said Elisha to you? And he answered, He told me that you should surely recover.
verses.text: So he departed from Elisha, and came to his master; who said to him, What said Elisha to you? And he answered, He told me that you should surely recover.

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the morrow, that he took a thick cloth, and dipped it in water, and spread it on his face, so that he died: and Hazael reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that he took a thick cloth, and dipped it in water, and spread it on his face, so that he died: and Hazael reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And in the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Yashar'el (Israel), Jehoshaphat being then king of Yahudah (Judah), Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Yahudah (Judah) began to reign.
verses.text: And in the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Yashar'el, Jehoshaphat being then king of Yahudah, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Yahudah began to reign.

verses.raw: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
verses.text: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And he walked in the way of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel), as did the house of Ahab: for the daughter of Ahab was his wife: and he did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And he walked in the way of the kings of Yashar'el, as did the house of Ahab: for the daughter of Ahab was his wife: and he did evil in the sight of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Yet Yahuah (LORD) would not destroy Yahudah (Judah) for David his servant’s sake, as he promised him to give him alway a light, and to his children.
verses.text: Yet Yahuah would not destroy Yahudah for David his servant’s sake, as he promised him to give him alway a light, and to his children.

verses.raw: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Yahudah (Judah), and made a king over themselves.
verses.text: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Yahudah, and made a king over themselves.

verses.raw: So Joram went over to Zair, and all the chariots with him: and he rose by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him about, and the captains of the chariots: and the people fled into their tents.
verses.text: So Joram went over to Zair, and all the chariots with him: and he rose by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him about, and the captains of the chariots: and the people fled into their tents.

verses.raw: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Yahudah (Judah) unto this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.
verses.text: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Yahudah unto this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.

verses.raw: And the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)?
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah?

verses.raw: And Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Yashar'el (Israel) did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Yahudah (Judah) begin to reign.
verses.text: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Yashar'el did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Yahudah begin to reign.

verses.raw: Two and twenty years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Athaliah, the daughter of Omri king of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Two and twenty years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Athaliah, the daughter of Omri king of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), as did the house of Ahab: for he was the son in law of the house of Ahab.
verses.text: And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of Yahuah, as did the house of Ahab: for he was the son in law of the house of Ahab.

verses.raw: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramoth-gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.
verses.text: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramoth-gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.

verses.raw: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Yahudah (Judah) went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
verses.text: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Yahudah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

verses.raw: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets, and said unto him, Gird up your loins, and take this box of oil in your hand, and go to Ramoth-gilead:
verses.text: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets, and said unto him, Gird up your loins, and take this box of oil in your hand, and go to Ramoth-gilead:

verses.raw: And when you come thither, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber;
verses.text: And when you come thither, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber;

verses.raw: Then take the box of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), I have anointed you king over Yashar'el (Israel). Then open the door, and flee, and tarry not.
verses.text: Then take the box of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, Thus says Yahuah, I have anointed you king over Yashar'el. Then open the door, and flee, and tarry not.

verses.raw: So the young man, even the young man the prophet, went to Ramoth-gilead.
verses.text: So the young man, even the young man the prophet, went to Ramoth-gilead.

verses.raw: And when he came, behold, the captains of the host were sitting; and he said, I have an errand to you, O captain. And Jehu said, Unto which of all us? And he said, To you, O captain.
verses.text: And when he came, behold, the captains of the host were sitting; and he said, I have an errand to you, O captain. And Jehu said, Unto which of all us? And he said, To you, O captain.

verses.raw: And he arose, and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said unto him, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), I have anointed you king over the people of Yahuah (LORD), even over Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And he arose, and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said unto him, Thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, I have anointed you king over the people of Yahuah, even over Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And you shall smite the house of Ahab your master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of Yahuah (LORD), at the hand of Jezebel.
verses.text: And you shall smite the house of Ahab your master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of Yahuah, at the hand of Jezebel.

verses.raw: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Yashar'el:

verses.raw: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah:
verses.text: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah:

verses.raw: And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her. And he opened the door, and fled.
verses.text: And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her. And he opened the door, and fled.

verses.raw: Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord: and one said unto him, Is all well? wherefore came this mad fellow to you? And he said unto them, You know the man, and his communication.
verses.text: Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord: and one said unto him, Is all well? wherefore came this mad fellow to you? And he said unto them, You know the man, and his communication.

verses.raw: And they said, It is false; tell us now. And he said, Thus and thus spake he to me, saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), I have anointed you king over Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And they said, It is false; tell us now. And he said, Thus and thus spake he to me, saying, Thus says Yahuah, I have anointed you king over Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Then they hasted, and took every man his garment, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with trumpets, saying, Jehu is king.
verses.text: Then they hasted, and took every man his garment, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with trumpets, saying, Jehu is king.

verses.raw: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram had kept Ramoth-gilead, he and all Yashar'el (Israel), because of Hazael king of Syria.
verses.text: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram had kept Ramoth-gilead, he and all Yashar'el, because of Hazael king of Syria.

verses.raw: But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) And Jehu said, If it be your minds, then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.
verses.text: But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) And Jehu said, If it be your minds, then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.

verses.raw: So Jehu rode in a chariot, and went to Jezreel; for Joram lay there. And Ahaziah king of Yahudah (Judah) was come down to see Joram.
verses.text: So Jehu rode in a chariot, and went to Jezreel; for Joram lay there. And Ahaziah king of Yahudah was come down to see Joram.

verses.raw: And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, I see a company. And Joram said, Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Is it peace?
verses.text: And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, I see a company. And Joram said, Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Is it peace?

verses.raw: So there went one on horseback to meet him, and said, Thus says the king, Is it peace? And Jehu said, What have you to do with peace? turn you behind me. And the watchman told, saying, The messenger came to them, but he comes not again.
verses.text: So there went one on horseback to meet him, and said, Thus says the king, Is it peace? And Jehu said, What have you to do with peace? turn you behind me. And the watchman told, saying, The messenger came to them, but he comes not again.

verses.raw: Then he sent out a second on horseback, which came to them, and said, Thus says the king, Is it peace? And Jehu answered, What have you to do with peace? turn you behind me.
verses.text: Then he sent out a second on horseback, which came to them, and said, Thus says the king, Is it peace? And Jehu answered, What have you to do with peace? turn you behind me.

verses.raw: And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and comes not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he drives furiously.
verses.text: And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and comes not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he drives furiously.

verses.raw: And Joram said, Make ready. And his chariot was made ready. And Joram king of Yashar'el (Israel) and Ahaziah king of Yahudah (Judah) went out, each in his chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.
verses.text: And Joram said, Make ready. And his chariot was made ready. And Joram king of Yashar'el and Ahaziah king of Yahudah went out, each in his chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Joram saw Jehu, that he said, Is it peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of your mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many?
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Joram saw Jehu, that he said, Is it peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of your mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many?

verses.raw: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, There is treachery, O Ahaziah.
verses.text: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, There is treachery, O Ahaziah.

verses.raw: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.
verses.text: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.

verses.raw: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain, Take up, and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and you rode together after Ahab his father, Yahuah (LORD) laid this burden upon him;
verses.text: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain, Take up, and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and you rode together after Ahab his father, Yahuah laid this burden upon him;

verses.raw: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, says Yahuah (LORD); and I will requite you in this plat, says Yahuah (LORD). Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, says Yahuah; and I will requite you in this plat, says Yahuah. Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground, according to the word of Yahuah.

verses.raw: But when Ahaziah the king of Yahudah (Judah) saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. And Jehu followed after him, and said, Smite him also in the chariot. And they did so at the going up to Gur, which is by Ibleam. And he fled to Megiddo, and died there.
verses.text: But when Ahaziah the king of Yahudah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. And Jehu followed after him, and said, Smite him also in the chariot. And they did so at the going up to Gur, which is by Ibleam. And he fled to Megiddo, and died there.

verses.raw: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.
verses.text: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.

verses.raw: And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Yahudah.

verses.raw: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.
verses.text: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.

verses.raw: And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, Had Zimri peace, who slew his master?
verses.text: And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, Had Zimri peace, who slew his master?

verses.raw: And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who is on my side? who? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs.
verses.text: And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who is on my side? who? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs.

verses.raw: And he said, Throw her down. So they threw her down: and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trode her under foot.
verses.text: And he said, Throw her down. So they threw her down: and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trode her under foot.

verses.raw: And when he was come in, he did eat and drink, and said, Go, see now this cursed woman, and bury her: for she is a king’s daughter.
verses.text: And when he was come in, he did eat and drink, and said, Go, see now this cursed woman, and bury her: for she is a king’s daughter.

verses.raw: And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.
verses.text: And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.

verses.raw: Wherefore they came again, and told him. And he said, This is the word of Yahuah (LORD), which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:
verses.text: Wherefore they came again, and told him. And he said, This is the word of Yahuah, which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:

verses.raw: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel; so that they shall not say, This is Jezebel.
verses.text: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel; so that they shall not say, This is Jezebel.

verses.raw: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, unto the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to them that brought up Ahab’s children, saying,
verses.text: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, unto the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to them that brought up Ahab’s children, saying,

verses.raw: Now as soon as this letter comes to you, seeing your master’s sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fenced city also, and armour;
verses.text: Now as soon as this letter comes to you, seeing your master’s sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fenced city also, and armour;

verses.raw: Look even out the best and meetest of your master’s sons, and set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.
verses.text: Look even out the best and meetest of your master’s sons, and set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.

verses.raw: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, two kings stood not before him: how then shall we stand?
verses.text: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, two kings stood not before him: how then shall we stand?

verses.raw: And he that was over the house, and he that was over the city, the elders also, and the bringers up of the children, sent to Jehu, saying, We are your servants, and will do all that you shall bid us; we will not make any king: do you that which is good in your eyes.
verses.text: And he that was over the house, and he that was over the city, the elders also, and the bringers up of the children, sent to Jehu, saying, We are your servants, and will do all that you shall bid us; we will not make any king: do you that which is good in your eyes.

verses.raw: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If you be mine, and if you will hearken unto my voice, take you the heads of the men your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time. Now the king’s sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, which brought them up.
verses.text: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If you be mine, and if you will hearken unto my voice, take you the heads of the men your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time. Now the king’s sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, which brought them up.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the letter came to them, that they took the king’s sons, and slew seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets, and sent him them to Jezreel.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the letter came to them, that they took the king’s sons, and slew seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets, and sent him them to Jezreel.

verses.raw: And there came a messenger, and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king’s sons. And he said, Lay you them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.
verses.text: And there came a messenger, and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king’s sons. And he said, Lay you them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the morning, that he went out, and stood, and said to all the people, You be righteous: behold, I conspired against my master, and slew him: but who slew all these?
verses.text: And it came to pass in the morning, that he went out, and stood, and said to all the people, You be righteous: behold, I conspired against my master, and slew him: but who slew all these?

verses.raw: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of Yahuah (LORD), which Yahuah (LORD) spake concerning the house of Ahab: for Yahuah (LORD) has done that which he spake by his servant Elijah.
verses.text: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of Yahuah, which Yahuah spake concerning the house of Ahab: for Yahuah has done that which he spake by his servant Elijah.

verses.raw: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his kinsfolks, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.
verses.text: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his kinsfolks, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.

verses.raw: And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria. And as he was at the shearing house in the way,
verses.text: And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria. And as he was at the shearing house in the way,

verses.raw: Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Yahudah (Judah), and said, Who are you? And they answered, We are the brethren of Ahaziah; and we go down to salute the children of the king and the children of the queen.
verses.text: Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Yahudah, and said, Who are you? And they answered, We are the brethren of Ahaziah; and we go down to salute the children of the king and the children of the queen.

verses.raw: And he said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew them at the pit of the shearing house, even two and forty men; neither left he any of them.
verses.text: And he said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew them at the pit of the shearing house, even two and forty men; neither left he any of them.

verses.raw: And when he was departed thence, he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him: and he saluted him, and said to him, Is your heart right, as my heart is with your heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it be, give me your hand. And he gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.
verses.text: And when he was departed thence, he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him: and he saluted him, and said to him, Is your heart right, as my heart is with your heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it be, give me your hand. And he gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.

verses.raw: And he said, Come with me, and see my zeal for Yahuah (LORD). So they made him ride in his chariot.
verses.text: And he said, Come with me, and see my zeal for Yahuah. So they made him ride in his chariot.

verses.raw: And when he came to Samaria, he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed him, according to the saying of Yahuah (LORD), which he spake to Elijah.
verses.text: And when he came to Samaria, he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed him, according to the saying of Yahuah, which he spake to Elijah.

verses.raw: And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said unto them, Ahab served Baal a little; but Jehu shall serve him much.
verses.text: And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said unto them, Ahab served Baal a little; but Jehu shall serve him much.

verses.raw: Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests; let none be wanting: for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal; whosoever shall be wanting, he shall not live. But Jehu did it in subtilty, to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal.
verses.text: Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests; let none be wanting: for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal; whosoever shall be wanting, he shall not live. But Jehu did it in subtilty, to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal.

verses.raw: And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed it.
verses.text: And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed it.

verses.raw: And Jehu sent through all Yashar'el (Israel): and all the worshippers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that came not. And they came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another.
verses.text: And Jehu sent through all Yashar'el: and all the worshippers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that came not. And they came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another.

verses.raw: And he said unto him that was over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.
verses.text: And he said unto him that was over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.

verses.raw: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal, and said unto the worshippers of Baal, Search, and look that there be here with you none of the servants of Yahuah (LORD), but the worshippers of Baal only.
verses.text: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal, and said unto the worshippers of Baal, Search, and look that there be here with you none of the servants of Yahuah, but the worshippers of Baal only.

verses.raw: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings, Jehu appointed fourscore men without, and said, If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape, he that letteth him go, his life shall be for the life of him.
verses.text: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings, Jehu appointed fourscore men without, and said, If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape, he that letteth him go, his life shall be for the life of him.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, Go in, and slay them; let none come forth. And they smote them with the edge of the sword; and the guard and the captains cast them out, and went to the city of the house of Baal.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, Go in, and slay them; let none come forth. And they smote them with the edge of the sword; and the guard and the captains cast them out, and went to the city of the house of Baal.

verses.raw: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal, and burned them.
verses.text: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal, and burned them.

verses.raw: And they brake down the image of Baal, and brake down the house of Baal, and made it a draught house unto this day.
verses.text: And they brake down the image of Baal, and brake down the house of Baal, and made it a draught house unto this day.

verses.raw: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, to wit, the golden calves that were in Beth-el, and that were in Dan.
verses.text: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, to wit, the golden calves that were in Beth-el, and that were in Dan.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Jehu, Because you have done well in executing that which is right in my eyes, and have done unto the house of Ahab according to all that was in my heart, your children of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Jehu, Because you have done well in executing that which is right in my eyes, and have done unto the house of Ahab according to all that was in my heart, your children of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) with all his heart: for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, which made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin.
verses.text: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el with all his heart: for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, which made Yashar'el to sin.

verses.raw: In those days Yahuah (LORD) began to cut Yashar'el (Israel) short: and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Yashar'el (Israel);
verses.text: In those days Yahuah began to cut Yashar'el short: and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Yashar'el;

verses.raw: From Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.
verses.text: From Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: And Jehu slept with his fathers: and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Jehu slept with his fathers: and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And the time that Jehu reigned over Yashar'el (Israel) in Samaria was twenty and eight years.
verses.text: And the time that Jehu reigned over Yashar'el in Samaria was twenty and eight years.

verses.raw: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal.
verses.text: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal.

verses.raw: But Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king’s sons which were slain; and they hid him, even him and his nurse, in the bedchamber from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.
verses.text: But Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king’s sons which were slain; and they hid him, even him and his nurse, in the bedchamber from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.

verses.raw: And he was with her hid in the house of Yahuah (LORD) six years. And Athaliah did reign over the land.
verses.text: And he was with her hid in the house of Yahuah six years. And Athaliah did reign over the land.

verses.raw: And the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the rulers over hundreds, with the captains and the guard, and brought them to him into the house of Yahuah (LORD), and made a covenant with them, and took an oath of them in the house of Yahuah (LORD), and shewed them the king’s son.
verses.text: And the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the rulers over hundreds, with the captains and the guard, and brought them to him into the house of Yahuah, and made a covenant with them, and took an oath of them in the house of Yahuah, and shewed them the king’s son.

verses.raw: And he commanded them, saying, This is the thing that you shall do; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king’s house;
verses.text: And he commanded them, saying, This is the thing that you shall do; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king’s house;

verses.raw: And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur; and a third part at the gate behind the guard: so shall you keep the watch of the house, that it be not broken down.
verses.text: And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur; and a third part at the gate behind the guard: so shall you keep the watch of the house, that it be not broken down.

verses.raw: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath, even they shall keep the watch of the house of Yahuah (LORD) about the king.
verses.text: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath, even they shall keep the watch of the house of Yahuah about the king.

verses.raw: And you shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand: and he that comes within the ranges, let him be slain: and be you with the king as he goes out and as he comes in.
verses.text: And you shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand: and he that comes within the ranges, let him be slain: and be you with the king as he goes out and as he comes in.

verses.raw: And the captains over the hundreds did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest commanded: and they took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that should go out on the sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.
verses.text: And the captains over the hundreds did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest commanded: and they took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that should go out on the sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

verses.raw: And to the captains over hundreds did the priest give king David’s spears and shields, that were in the temple of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And to the captains over hundreds did the priest give king David’s spears and shields, that were in the temple of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, round about the king, from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple, along by the altar and the temple.
verses.text: And the guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, round about the king, from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple, along by the altar and the temple.

verses.raw: And he brought forth the king’s son, and put the crown upon him, and gave him the testimony; and they made him king, and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, Elohim (God) save the king.
verses.text: And he brought forth the king’s son, and put the crown upon him, and gave him the testimony; and they made him king, and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, Elohim save the king.

verses.raw: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the temple of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the temple of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And when she looked, behold, the king stood by a pillar, as the manner was, and the princes and the trumpeters by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah rent her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.
verses.text: And when she looked, behold, the king stood by a pillar, as the manner was, and the princes and the trumpeters by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah rent her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.

verses.raw: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds, the officers of the host, and said unto them, Have her forth without the ranges: and him that follows her kill with the sword. For the priest had said, Let her not be slain in the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds, the officers of the host, and said unto them, Have her forth without the ranges: and him that follows her kill with the sword. For the priest had said, Let her not be slain in the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they laid hands on her; and she went by the way by the which the horses came into the king’s house: and there was she slain.
verses.text: And they laid hands on her; and she went by the way by the which the horses came into the king’s house: and there was she slain.

verses.raw: And Jehoiada made a covenant between Yahuah (LORD) and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD’S people; between the king also and the people.
verses.text: And Jehoiada made a covenant between Yahuah and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD’S people; between the king also and the people.

verses.raw: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and brake it down; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and brake it down; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he took the rulers over hundreds, and the captains, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the house of Yahuah (LORD), and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king’s house. And he sat on the throne of the kings.
verses.text: And he took the rulers over hundreds, and the captains, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the house of Yahuah, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king’s house. And he sat on the throne of the kings.

verses.raw: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was in quiet: and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king’s house.
verses.text: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was in quiet: and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king’s house.

verses.raw: Seven years old was Jehoash when he began to reign.
verses.text: Seven years old was Jehoash when he began to reign.

verses.raw: In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign; and forty years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.
verses.text: In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign; and forty years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.

verses.raw: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah (LORD) all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
verses.text: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

verses.raw: But the high places were not taken away: the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.
verses.text: But the high places were not taken away: the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.

verses.raw: And Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of Yahuah (LORD), even the money of every one that passes the account, the money that every man is set at, and all the money that comes into any man’s heart to bring into the house of Yahuah (LORD),
verses.text: And Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of Yahuah, even the money of every one that passes the account, the money that every man is set at, and all the money that comes into any man’s heart to bring into the house of Yahuah,

verses.raw: Let the priests take it to them, every man of his acquaintance: and let them repair the breaches of the house, wheresoever any breach shall be found.
verses.text: Let the priests take it to them, every man of his acquaintance: and let them repair the breaches of the house, wheresoever any breach shall be found.

verses.raw: But it was so, that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.
verses.text: But it was so, that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.

verses.raw: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the other priests, and said unto them, Why repair you not the breaches of the house? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.
verses.text: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the other priests, and said unto them, Why repair you not the breaches of the house? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.

verses.raw: And the priests consented to receive no more money of the people, neither to repair the breaches of the house.
verses.text: And the priests consented to receive no more money of the people, neither to repair the breaches of the house.

verses.raw: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into the house of Yahuah (LORD): and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into the house of Yahuah: and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And it was so, when they saw that there was much money in the chest, that the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put up in bags, and told the money that was found in the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And it was so, when they saw that there was much money in the chest, that the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put up in bags, and told the money that was found in the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they gave the money, being told, into the hands of them that did the work, that had the oversight of the house of Yahuah (LORD): and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders, that wrought upon the house of Yahuah (LORD),
verses.text: And they gave the money, being told, into the hands of them that did the work, that had the oversight of the house of Yahuah: and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders, that wrought upon the house of Yahuah,

verses.raw: And to masons, and hewers of stone, and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.
verses.text: And to masons, and hewers of stone, and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of Yahuah, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.

verses.raw: Howbeit there were not made for the house of Yahuah (LORD) bowls of silver, snuffers, basons, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the house of Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: Howbeit there were not made for the house of Yahuah bowls of silver, snuffers, basons, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the house of Yahuah:

verses.raw: But they gave that to the workmen, and repaired therewith the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But they gave that to the workmen, and repaired therewith the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen: for they dealt faithfully.
verses.text: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen: for they dealt faithfully.

verses.raw: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of Yahuah (LORD): it was the priests’.
verses.text: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of Yahuah: it was the priests’.

verses.raw: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it: and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.text: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it: and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And Jehoash king of Yahudah (Judah) took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat, and Jehoram, and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Yahudah (Judah), had dedicated, and his own hallowed things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and in the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria: and he went away from Jerusalem.
verses.text: And Jehoash king of Yahudah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat, and Jehoram, and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Yahudah, had dedicated, and his own hallowed things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of Yahuah, and in the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria: and he went away from Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)?
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah?

verses.raw: And his servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and slew Joash in the house of Millo, which goes down to Silla.
verses.text: And his servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and slew Joash in the house of Millo, which goes down to Silla.

verses.raw: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Yahudah (Judah) Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Yashar'el (Israel) in Samaria, and reigned seventeen years.
verses.text: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Yahudah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Yashar'el in Samaria, and reigned seventeen years.

verses.raw: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin; he departed not therefrom.
verses.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Yashar'el to sin; he departed not therefrom.

verses.raw: And the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was kindled against Yashar'el (Israel), and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael, all their days.
verses.text: And the anger of Yahuah was kindled against Yashar'el, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael, all their days.

verses.raw: And Jehoahaz besought Yahuah (LORD), and Yahuah (LORD) hearkened unto him: for he saw the oppression of Yashar'el (Israel), because the king of Syria oppressed them.
verses.text: And Jehoahaz besought Yahuah, and Yahuah hearkened unto him: for he saw the oppression of Yashar'el, because the king of Syria oppressed them.

verses.raw: (And Yahuah (LORD) gave Yashar'el (Israel) a saviour, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians: and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) dwelt in their tents, as beforetime.
verses.text: (And Yahuah gave Yashar'el a saviour, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians: and the children of Yashar'el dwelt in their tents, as beforetime.

verses.raw: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who made Yashar'el (Israel) sin, but walked therein: and there remained the grove also in Samaria.)
verses.text: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who made Yashar'el sin, but walked therein: and there remained the grove also in Samaria.)

verses.raw: Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria had destroyed them, and had made them like the dust by threshing.
verses.text: Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria had destroyed them, and had made them like the dust by threshing.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joash his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joash his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Yahudah (Judah) began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Yashar'el (Israel) in Samaria, and reigned sixteen years.
verses.text: In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Yahudah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Yashar'el in Samaria, and reigned sixteen years.

verses.raw: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD); he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el (Israel) sin: but he walked therein.
verses.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el sin: but he walked therein.

verses.raw: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Yahudah (Judah), are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Yahudah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: And Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne: and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne: and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died. And Joash the king of Yashar'el (Israel) came down unto him, and wept over his face, and said, O my father, my father, the chariot of Yashar'el (Israel), and the horsemen thereof.
verses.text: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died. And Joash the king of Yashar'el came down unto him, and wept over his face, and said, O my father, my father, the chariot of Yashar'el, and the horsemen thereof.

verses.raw: And Elisha said unto him, Take bow and arrows. And he took unto him bow and arrows.
verses.text: And Elisha said unto him, Take bow and arrows. And he took unto him bow and arrows.

verses.raw: And he said to the king of Yashar'el (Israel), Put your hand upon the bow. And he put his hand upon it: and Elisha put his hands upon the king’s hands.
verses.text: And he said to the king of Yashar'el, Put your hand upon the bow. And he put his hand upon it: and Elisha put his hands upon the king’s hands.

verses.raw: And he said, Open the window eastward. And he opened it. Then Elisha said, Shoot. And he shot. And he said, The arrow of the LORD’S deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria: for you shall smite the Syrians in Aphek, till you have consumed them.
verses.text: And he said, Open the window eastward. And he opened it. Then Elisha said, Shoot. And he shot. And he said, The arrow of the LORD’S deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria: for you shall smite the Syrians in Aphek, till you have consumed them.

verses.raw: And he said, Take the arrows. And he took them. And he said unto the king of Yashar'el (Israel), Smite upon the ground. And he smote thrice, and stayed.
verses.text: And he said, Take the arrows. And he took them. And he said unto the king of Yashar'el, Smite upon the ground. And he smote thrice, and stayed.

verses.raw: And the man of Elohim (God) was wroth with him, and said, You should have smitten five or six times; then had you smitten Syria till you had consumed it: whereas now you shall smite Syria but thrice.
verses.text: And the man of Elohim was wroth with him, and said, You should have smitten five or six times; then had you smitten Syria till you had consumed it: whereas now you shall smite Syria but thrice.

verses.raw: And Elisha died, and they buried him. And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.
verses.text: And Elisha died, and they buried him. And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.

verses.raw: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Yashar'el (Israel) all the days of Jehoahaz.
verses.text: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Yashar'el all the days of Jehoahaz.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast he them from his presence as yet.
verses.text: And Yahuah was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast he them from his presence as yet.

verses.raw: So Hazael king of Syria died; and Ben-hadad his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: So Hazael king of Syria died; and Ben-hadad his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael the cities, which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Joash beat him, and recovered the cities of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael the cities, which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Joash beat him, and recovered the cities of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Yashar'el (Israel) reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Yashar'el reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Yahudah.

verses.raw: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
verses.text: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), yet not like David his father: he did according to all things as Joash his father did.
verses.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah, yet not like David his father: he did according to all things as Joash his father did.

verses.raw: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: as yet the people did sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places.
verses.text: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: as yet the people did sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand, that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand, that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father.

verses.raw: But the children of the murderers he slew not: according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, wherein Yahuah (LORD) commanded, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin.
verses.text: But the children of the murderers he slew not: according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, wherein Yahuah commanded, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

verses.raw: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand, and took Selah by war, and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day.
verses.text: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand, and took Selah by war, and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day.

verses.raw: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.
verses.text: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Yashar'el, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.

verses.raw: And Jehoash the king of Yashar'el (Israel) sent to Amaziah king of Yahudah (Judah), saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.
verses.text: And Jehoash the king of Yashar'el sent to Amaziah king of Yahudah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.

verses.raw: You have indeed smitten Edom, and your heart has lifted you up: glory of this, and tarry at home: for why should you meddle to your hurt, that you should fall, even you, and Yahudah (Judah) with you?
verses.text: You have indeed smitten Edom, and your heart has lifted you up: glory of this, and tarry at home: for why should you meddle to your hurt, that you should fall, even you, and Yahudah with you?

verses.raw: But Amaziah would not hear. Therefore Jehoash king of Yashar'el (Israel) went up; and he and Amaziah king of Yahudah (Judah) looked one another in the face at Beth-shemesh, which belongs to Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: But Amaziah would not hear. Therefore Jehoash king of Yashar'el went up; and he and Amaziah king of Yahudah looked one another in the face at Beth-shemesh, which belongs to Yahudah.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) was put to the worse before Yashar'el (Israel); and they fled every man to their tents.
verses.text: And Yahudah was put to the worse before Yashar'el; and they fled every man to their tents.

verses.raw: And Jehoash king of Yashar'el (Israel) took Amaziah king of Yahudah (Judah), the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth-shemesh, and came to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
verses.text: And Jehoash king of Yashar'el took Amaziah king of Yahudah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth-shemesh, and came to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

verses.raw: And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of Yahuah (LORD), and in the treasures of the king’s house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.
verses.text: And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of Yahuah, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Yahudah (Judah), are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Yahudah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: And Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Yashar'el (Israel); and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Yashar'el; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Yahudah (Judah) lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Yashar'el (Israel) fifteen years.
verses.text: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Yahudah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Yashar'el fifteen years.

verses.raw: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)?
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah?

verses.raw: Now they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem: and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish, and slew him there.
verses.text: Now they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem: and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish, and slew him there.

verses.raw: And they brought him on horses: and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.
verses.text: And they brought him on horses: and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.

verses.raw: And all the people of Yahudah (Judah) took Azariah, which was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.
verses.text: And all the people of Yahudah took Azariah, which was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.

verses.raw: He built Elath, and restored it to Yahudah (Judah), after that the king slept with his fathers.
verses.text: He built Elath, and restored it to Yahudah, after that the king slept with his fathers.

verses.raw: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Yahudah (Judah) Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Yashar'el (Israel) began to reign in Samaria, and reigned forty and one years.
verses.text: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Yahudah Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Yashar'el began to reign in Samaria, and reigned forty and one years.

verses.raw: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD): he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin.
verses.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el to sin.

verses.raw: He restored the coast of Yashar'el (Israel) from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain, according to the word of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, which was of Gath-hepher.
verses.text: He restored the coast of Yashar'el from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain, according to the word of Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, which was of Gath-hepher.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) saw the affliction of Yashar'el (Israel), that it was very bitter: for there was not any shut up, nor any left, nor any helper for Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: For Yahuah saw the affliction of Yashar'el, that it was very bitter: for there was not any shut up, nor any left, nor any helper for Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said not that he would blot out the name of Yashar'el (Israel) from under heaven: but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.
verses.text: And Yahuah said not that he would blot out the name of Yashar'el from under heaven: but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he warred, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which belonged to Yahudah (Judah), for Yashar'el (Israel), are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he warred, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which belonged to Yahudah, for Yashar'el, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Yashar'el (Israel); and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Yashar'el; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Yashar'el (Israel) began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Yahudah (Judah) to reign.
verses.text: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Yashar'el began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Yahudah to reign.

verses.raw: Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned two and fifty years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jecholiah of Jerusalem.
verses.text: Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned two and fifty years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jecholiah of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), according to all that his father Amaziah had done;
verses.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah, according to all that his father Amaziah had done;

verses.raw: Save that the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places.
verses.text: Save that the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) smote the king, so that he was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house. And Jotham the king’s son was over the house, judging the people of the land.
verses.text: And Yahuah smote the king, so that he was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house. And Jotham the king’s son was over the house, judging the people of the land.

verses.raw: And the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)?
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah?

verses.raw: So Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: So Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Yahudah (Judah) did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Yashar'el (Israel) in Samaria six months.
verses.text: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Yahudah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Yashar'el in Samaria six months.

verses.raw: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), as his fathers had done: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin.
verses.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah, as his fathers had done: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el to sin.

verses.raw: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And the rest of the acts of Zachariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Zachariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: This was the word of Yahuah (LORD) which he spake unto Jehu, saying, Your sons shall sit on the throne of Yashar'el (Israel) unto the fourth generation. And so it came to pass.
verses.text: This was the word of Yahuah which he spake unto Jehu, saying, Your sons shall sit on the throne of Yashar'el unto the fourth generation. And so it came to pass.
