verses.raw: And she said unto them, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Tell the man that sent you to me,
verses.text: And she said unto them, Thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, Tell the man that sent you to me,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the words of the book which the king of Yahudah (Judah) has read:
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the words of the book which the king of Yahudah has read:

verses.raw: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.
verses.text: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.

verses.raw: But to the king of Yahudah (Judah) which sent you to enquire of Yahuah (LORD), thus shall you say to him, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), As touching the words which you have heard;
verses.text: But to the king of Yahudah which sent you to enquire of Yahuah, thus shall you say to him, Thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, As touching the words which you have heard;

verses.raw: Because your heart was tender, and you have humbled thyself before Yahuah (LORD), when you heard what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and have rent your clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard you, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Because your heart was tender, and you have humbled thyself before Yahuah, when you heard what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and have rent your clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard you, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Behold therefore, I will gather you unto your fathers, and you shall be gathered into your grave in peace; and your eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.
verses.text: Behold therefore, I will gather you unto your fathers, and you shall be gathered into your grave in peace; and your eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.

verses.raw: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Yahudah (Judah) and of Jerusalem.
verses.text: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Yahudah and of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And the king went up into the house of Yahuah (LORD), and all the men of Yahudah (Judah) and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the king went up into the house of Yahuah, and all the men of Yahudah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before Yahuah (LORD), to walk after Yahuah (LORD), and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.
verses.text: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before Yahuah, to walk after Yahuah, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.

verses.raw: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of Yahuah (LORD) all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Beth-el.
verses.text: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of Yahuah all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Beth-el.

verses.raw: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Yahudah (Judah) had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.
verses.text: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Yahudah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Yahudah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.

verses.raw: And he brought out the grove from the house of Yahuah (LORD), without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and stamped it small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people.
verses.text: And he brought out the grove from the house of Yahuah, without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and stamped it small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people.

verses.raw: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that were by the house of Yahuah (LORD), where the women wove hangings for the grove.
verses.text: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that were by the house of Yahuah, where the women wove hangings for the grove.

verses.raw: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beer-sheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.
verses.text: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Yahudah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beer-sheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.

verses.raw: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of Yahuah (LORD) in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.
verses.text: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of Yahuah in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.

verses.raw: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.
verses.text: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.

verses.raw: And he took away the horses that the kings of Yahudah (Judah) had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of Yahuah (LORD), by the chamber of Nathan-melech the chamberlain, which was in the suburbs, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
verses.text: And he took away the horses that the kings of Yahudah had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of Yahuah, by the chamber of Nathan-melech the chamberlain, which was in the suburbs, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

verses.raw: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Yahudah (Judah) had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of Yahuah (LORD), did the king beat down, and brake them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.
verses.text: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Yahudah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of Yahuah, did the king beat down, and brake them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.

verses.raw: And the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Yashar'el (Israel) had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.
verses.text: And the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Yashar'el had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.

verses.raw: And he brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.
verses.text: And he brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.

verses.raw: Moreover the altar that was at Beth-el, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place, and stamped it small to powder, and burned the grove.
verses.text: Moreover the altar that was at Beth-el, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place, and stamped it small to powder, and burned the grove.

verses.raw: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned them upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD) which the man of Elohim (God) proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.
verses.text: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned them upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of Yahuah which the man of Elohim proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.

verses.raw: Then he said, What title is that that I see? And the men of the city told him, It is the sepulchre of the man of Elohim (God), which came from Yahudah (Judah), and proclaimed these things that you have done against the altar of Beth-el.
verses.text: Then he said, What title is that that I see? And the men of the city told him, It is the sepulchre of the man of Elohim, which came from Yahudah, and proclaimed these things that you have done against the altar of Beth-el.

verses.raw: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.
verses.text: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.

verses.raw: And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Yashar'el (Israel) had made to provoke Yahuah (LORD) to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Beth-el.
verses.text: And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Yashar'el had made to provoke Yahuah to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Beth-el.

verses.raw: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars, and burned men’s bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.text: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars, and burned men’s bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), as it is written in the book of this covenant.
verses.text: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto Yahuah Elohaychem, as it is written in the book of this covenant.

verses.raw: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Yashar'el (Israel), nor in all the days of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel), nor of the kings of Yahudah (Judah);
verses.text: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Yashar'el, nor in all the days of the kings of Yashar'el, nor of the kings of Yahudah;

verses.raw: But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, wherein this passover was holden to Yahuah (LORD) in Jerusalem.
verses.text: But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, wherein this passover was holden to Yahuah in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Moreover the workers with familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Yahudah (Judah) and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Moreover the workers with familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Yahudah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to Yahuah (LORD) with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.
verses.text: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to Yahuah with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding Yahuah (LORD) turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Yahudah (Judah), because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal.
verses.text: Notwithstanding Yahuah turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Yahudah, because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said, I will remove Yahudah (Judah) also out of my sight, as I have removed Yashar'el (Israel), and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.
verses.text: And Yahuah said, I will remove Yahudah also out of my sight, as I have removed Yashar'el, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah?

verses.raw: In his days Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.
verses.text: In his days Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.

verses.raw: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s stead.
verses.text: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s stead.

verses.raw: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.text: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

verses.raw: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), according to all that his fathers had done.
verses.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah, according to all that his fathers had done.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh-nechoh put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.
verses.text: And Pharaoh-nechoh put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh-nechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.
verses.text: And Pharaoh-nechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.

verses.raw: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give it unto Pharaoh-nechoh.
verses.text: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give it unto Pharaoh-nechoh.

verses.raw: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
verses.text: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

verses.raw: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), according to all that his fathers had done.
verses.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah, according to all that his fathers had done.

verses.raw: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.
verses.text: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) sent against him bands of the Chaldees, and bands of the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Yahudah (Judah) to destroy it, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), which he spake by his servants the prophets.
verses.text: And Yahuah sent against him bands of the Chaldees, and bands of the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Yahudah to destroy it, according to the word of Yahuah, which he spake by his servants the prophets.

verses.raw: Surely at the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) came this upon Yahudah (Judah), to remove them out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did;
verses.text: Surely at the commandment of Yahuah came this upon Yahudah, to remove them out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did;

verses.raw: And also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which Yahuah (LORD) would not pardon.
verses.text: And also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which Yahuah would not pardon.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah?

verses.raw: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.
verses.text: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.

verses.raw: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother’s name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
verses.text: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother’s name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), according to all that his father had done.
verses.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah, according to all that his father had done.

verses.raw: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.
verses.text: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

verses.raw: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.
verses.text: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.

verses.raw: And Jehoiachin the king of Yahudah (Judah) went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.
verses.text: And Jehoiachin the king of Yahudah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.

verses.raw: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Yashar'el (Israel) had made in the temple of Yahuah (LORD), as Yahuah (LORD) had said.
verses.text: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of Yahuah, and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Yashar'el had made in the temple of Yahuah, as Yahuah had said.

verses.raw: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.
verses.text: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.

verses.raw: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king’s mother, and the king’s wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, those carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.
verses.text: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king’s mother, and the king’s wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, those carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

verses.raw: And all the men of might, even seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all that were strong and apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.
verses.text: And all the men of might, even seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all that were strong and apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

verses.raw: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father’s brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
verses.text: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father’s brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

verses.raw: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.text: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

verses.raw: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

verses.raw: For through the anger of Yahuah (LORD) it came to pass in Jerusalem and Yahudah (Judah), until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.text: For through the anger of Yahuah it came to pass in Jerusalem and Yahudah, until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.
verses.text: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.

verses.raw: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
verses.text: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

verses.raw: And on the ninth day of the fourth month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.
verses.text: And on the ninth day of the fourth month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.

verses.raw: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which is by the king’s garden: (now the Chaldees were against the city round about:) and the king went the way toward the plain.
verses.text: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which is by the king’s garden: (now the Chaldees were against the city round about:) and the king went the way toward the plain.

verses.raw: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.
verses.text: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.

verses.raw: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.
verses.text: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.

verses.raw: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.
verses.text: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.

verses.raw: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which is the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem:
verses.text: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which is the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem:

verses.raw: And he burnt the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great man’s house burnt he with fire.
verses.text: And he burnt the house of Yahuah, and the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great man’s house burnt he with fire.

verses.raw: And all the army of the Chaldees, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.
verses.text: And all the army of the Chaldees, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the people that were left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carry away.
verses.text: Now the rest of the people that were left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carry away.

verses.raw: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.
verses.text: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.

verses.raw: And the pillars of brass that were in the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of Yahuah (LORD), did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.
verses.text: And the pillars of brass that were in the house of Yahuah, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of Yahuah, did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.

verses.raw: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
verses.text: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

verses.raw: And the firepans, and the bowls, and such things as were of gold, in gold, and of silver, in silver, the captain of the guard took away.
verses.text: And the firepans, and the bowls, and such things as were of gold, in gold, and of silver, in silver, the captain of the guard took away.

verses.raw: The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of Yahuah (LORD); the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
verses.text: The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of Yahuah; the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

verses.raw: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it was brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.
verses.text: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it was brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.

verses.raw: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:
verses.text: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

verses.raw: And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king’s presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land that were found in the city:
verses.text: And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king’s presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land that were found in the city:

verses.raw: And Nebuzar-adan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:
verses.text: And Nebuzar-adan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:

verses.raw: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Yahudah (Judah) was carried away out of their land.
verses.text: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Yahudah was carried away out of their land.

verses.raw: And as for the people that remained in the land of Yahudah (Judah), whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.
verses.text: And as for the people that remained in the land of Yahudah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.

verses.raw: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.
verses.text: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.

verses.raw: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.
verses.text: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.

verses.raw: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Yahudim (Jews) and the Chaldees that were with him at Mizpah.
verses.text: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Yahudim and the Chaldees that were with him at Mizpah.

verses.raw: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.
verses.text: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Yahudah (Judah), in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Yahudah (Judah) out of prison;
verses.text: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Yahudah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Yahudah out of prison;

verses.raw: And he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon;
verses.text: And he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon;

verses.raw: And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.
verses.text: And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.

verses.raw: And his allowance was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.
verses.text: And his allowance was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.

verses.text: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.

verses.text: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.

verses.text: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

verses.raw: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.text: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother’s name was Joktan.

verses.raw: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.

verses.raw: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
verses.text: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.

verses.raw: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.
verses.text: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.

verses.raw: And they lodged round about the house of Elohim (God), because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.

verses.raw: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.
verses.text: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.

verses.raw: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
verses.text: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.

verses.text: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.

verses.raw: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.

verses.raw: Now the Philistines fought against Yashar'el (Israel); and the men of Yashar'el (Israel) fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.

verses.raw: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.
verses.text: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.

verses.raw: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.
verses.text: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.

verses.raw: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw your sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
verses.text: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw your sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

verses.raw: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.
verses.text: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.

verses.raw: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
verses.text: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.

verses.raw: And when all the men of Yashar'el (Israel) that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
verses.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

verses.raw: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.
verses.text: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.

verses.raw: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
verses.text: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.

verses.raw: And when all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.text: And when all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

verses.raw: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.text: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

verses.raw: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against Yahuah (LORD), even against the word of Yahuah (LORD), which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;
verses.text: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against Yahuah, even against the word of Yahuah, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;

verses.raw: And enquired not of Yahuah (LORD): therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.
verses.text: And enquired not of Yahuah: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.

verses.raw: Then all Yashar'el (Israel) gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
verses.text: Then all Yashar'el gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

verses.raw: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, you were he that leddest out and brought in Yashar'el (Israel): and Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) said unto you, You shall feed my people Yashar'el (Israel), and you shall be ruler over my people Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, you were he that leddest out and brought in Yashar'el: and Yahuah Elohayka said unto you, You shall feed my people Yashar'el, and you shall be ruler over my people Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Therefore came all the elders of Yashar'el (Israel) to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahuah (LORD); and they anointed David king over Yashar'el (Israel), according to the word of Yahuah (LORD) by Samuel.
verses.text: Therefore came all the elders of Yashar'el to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahuah; and they anointed David king over Yashar'el, according to the word of Yahuah by Samuel.

verses.raw: And David and all Yashar'el (Israel) went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
verses.text: And David and all Yashar'el went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.

verses.raw: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, You shall not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.
verses.text: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, You shall not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.

verses.raw: And David said, Whosoever smites the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.
verses.text: And David said, Whosoever smites the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.

verses.raw: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.
verses.text: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.

verses.raw: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
verses.text: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

verses.raw: So David waxed greater and greater: for Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) was with him.
verses.text: So David waxed greater and greater: for Yahuah Tseva'ot was with him.

verses.raw: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Yashar'el (Israel), to make him king, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD) concerning Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Yashar'el, to make him king, according to the word of Yahuah concerning Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.

verses.raw: He was with David at Pas-dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

verses.raw: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and Yahuah (LORD) saved them by a great deliverance.
verses.text: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and Yahuah saved them by a great deliverance.

verses.raw: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.text: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines’ garrison was then at Beth-lehem.

verses.raw: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem, that is at the gate!
verses.text: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem, that is at the gate!

verses.raw: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to Yahuah (LORD),
verses.text: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to Yahuah,

verses.raw: And said, My Elohim (God) forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.

verses.raw: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.
verses.text: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.

verses.raw: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.
verses.text: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.

verses.raw: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.

verses.text: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;

verses.text: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
