verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.

verses.raw: But a prophet of Yahuah (LORD) was there, whose name was Oded: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of your fathers was wroth with Yahudah (Judah), he has delivered them into your hand, and you have slain them in a rage that reaches up unto heaven.
verses.text: But a prophet of Yahuah was there, whose name was Oded: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because Yahuah Elohim of your fathers was wroth with Yahudah, he has delivered them into your hand, and you have slain them in a rage that reaches up unto heaven.

verses.raw: And now you purpose to keep under the children of Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you: but are there not with you, even with you, sins against Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God)?
verses.text: And now you purpose to keep under the children of Yahudah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you: but are there not with you, even with you, sins against Yahuah Elohaychem?

verses.raw: Now hear me therefore, and deliver the captives again, which you have taken captive of your brethren: for the fierce wrath of Yahuah (LORD) is upon you.
verses.text: Now hear me therefore, and deliver the captives again, which you have taken captive of your brethren: for the fierce wrath of Yahuah is upon you.

verses.raw: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them that came from the war,
verses.text: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them that came from the war,

verses.raw: And said unto them, You shall not bring in the captives hither: for whereas we have offended against Yahuah (LORD) already, you intend to add more to our sins and to our trespass: for our trespass is great, and there is fierce wrath against Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And said unto them, You shall not bring in the captives hither: for whereas we have offended against Yahuah already, you intend to add more to our sins and to our trespass: for our trespass is great, and there is fierce wrath against Yashar'el.

verses.raw: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.
verses.text: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.

verses.raw: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.
verses.text: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.

verses.raw: At that time did king Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help him.
verses.text: At that time did king Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help him.

verses.raw: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Yahudah (Judah), and carried away captives.
verses.text: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Yahudah, and carried away captives.

verses.raw: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country, and of the south of Yahudah (Judah), and had taken Beth-shemesh, and Ajalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho with the villages thereof, and Timnah with the villages thereof, Gimzo also and the villages thereof: and they dwelt there.
verses.text: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country, and of the south of Yahudah, and had taken Beth-shemesh, and Ajalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho with the villages thereof, and Timnah with the villages thereof, Gimzo also and the villages thereof: and they dwelt there.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) brought Yahudah (Judah) low because of Ahaz king of Yashar'el (Israel); for he made Yahudah (Judah) naked, and transgressed sore against Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: For Yahuah brought Yahudah low because of Ahaz king of Yashar'el; for he made Yahudah naked, and transgressed sore against Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came unto him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.
verses.text: And Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came unto him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.

verses.raw: For Ahaz took away a portion out of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and out of the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave it unto the king of Assyria: but he helped him not.
verses.text: For Ahaz took away a portion out of the house of Yahuah, and out of the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave it unto the king of Assyria: but he helped him not.

verses.raw: And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against Yahuah (LORD): this is that king Ahaz.
verses.text: And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against Yahuah: this is that king Ahaz.

verses.raw: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus, which smote him: and he said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them, therefore will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him, and of all Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus, which smote him: and he said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them, therefore will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him, and of all Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of Elohim (God), and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of Elohim (God), and shut up the doors of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem.
verses.text: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of Elohim, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of Elohim, and shut up the doors of the house of Yahuah, and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And in every several city of Yahudah (Judah) he made high places to burn incense unto other gods, and provoked to anger Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of his fathers.
verses.text: And in every several city of Yahudah he made high places to burn incense unto other gods, and provoked to anger Yahuah Elohim of his fathers.

verses.raw: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Yahudah (Judah) and Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Yahudah and Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem: but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel): and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem: but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Yashar'el: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: Hezekiah began to reign when he was five and twenty years old, and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
verses.text: Hezekiah began to reign when he was five and twenty years old, and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

verses.raw: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), according to all that David his father had done.
verses.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah, according to all that David his father had done.

verses.raw: He in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and repaired them.
verses.text: He in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of Yahuah, and repaired them.

verses.raw: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the east street,
verses.text: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the east street,

verses.raw: And said unto them, Hear me, you Levites, sanctify now yourselves, and sanctify the house of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy place.
verses.text: And said unto them, Hear me, you Levites, sanctify now yourselves, and sanctify the house of Yahuah Elohim of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy place.

verses.raw: For our fathers have trespassed, and done that which was evil in the eyes of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of Yahuah (LORD), and turned their backs.
verses.text: For our fathers have trespassed, and done that which was evil in the eyes of Yahuah Eloheinu, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of Yahuah, and turned their backs.

verses.raw: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place unto the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place unto the Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Wherefore the wrath of Yahuah (LORD) was upon Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem, and he has delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as you see with your eyes.
verses.text: Wherefore the wrath of Yahuah was upon Yahudah and Jerusalem, and he has delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as you see with your eyes.

verses.raw: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.
verses.text: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.

verses.raw: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.
verses.text: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.

verses.raw: My sons, be not now negligent: for Yahuah (LORD) has chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that you should minister unto him, and burn incense.
verses.text: My sons, be not now negligent: for Yahuah has chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that you should minister unto him, and burn incense.

verses.raw: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:
verses.text: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:

verses.raw: And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:
verses.text: And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:

verses.raw: And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.
verses.text: And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.

verses.raw: And they gathered their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king, by the words of Yahuah (LORD), to cleanse the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And they gathered their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king, by the words of Yahuah, to cleanse the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of Yahuah (LORD), to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of Yahuah (LORD) into the court of the house of Yahuah (LORD). And the Levites took it, to carry it out abroad into the brook Kidron.
verses.text: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of Yahuah, to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of Yahuah into the court of the house of Yahuah. And the Levites took it, to carry it out abroad into the brook Kidron.

verses.raw: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of Yahuah (LORD): so they sanctified the house of Yahuah (LORD) in eight days; and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.
verses.text: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of Yahuah: so they sanctified the house of Yahuah in eight days; and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.

verses.raw: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king, and said, We have cleansed all the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the altar of burnt offering, with all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread table, with all the vessels thereof.
verses.text: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king, and said, We have cleansed all the house of Yahuah, and the altar of burnt offering, with all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread table, with all the vessels thereof.

verses.raw: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they are before the altar of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they are before the altar of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Yahudah (Judah). And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on the altar of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Yahudah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on the altar of Yahuah.

verses.raw: So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled it on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.
verses.text: So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled it on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.

verses.raw: And they brought forth the he goats for the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:
verses.text: And they brought forth the he goats for the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:

verses.raw: And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Yashar'el (Israel): for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Yashar'el: for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he set the Levites in the house of Yahuah (LORD) with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and of Gad the king’s seer, and Nathan the prophet: for so was the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) by his prophets.
verses.text: And he set the Levites in the house of Yahuah with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and of Gad the king’s seer, and Nathan the prophet: for so was the commandment of Yahuah by his prophets.

verses.raw: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.
verses.text: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.

verses.raw: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of Yahuah (LORD) began also with the trumpets, and with the instruments ordained by David king of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of Yahuah began also with the trumpets, and with the instruments ordained by David king of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded: and all this continued until the burnt offering was finished.
verses.text: And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded: and all this continued until the burnt offering was finished.

verses.raw: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.
verses.text: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.

verses.raw: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise unto Yahuah (LORD) with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.
verses.text: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise unto Yahuah with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.

verses.raw: Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now you have consecrated yourselves unto Yahuah (LORD), come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of Yahuah (LORD). And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart burnt offerings.
verses.text: Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now you have consecrated yourselves unto Yahuah, come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of Yahuah. And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart burnt offerings.

verses.raw: And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation brought, was threescore and ten bullocks, an hundred rams, and two hundred lambs: all these were for a burnt offering to Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation brought, was threescore and ten bullocks, an hundred rams, and two hundred lambs: all these were for a burnt offering to Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the consecrated things were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.
verses.text: And the consecrated things were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.

verses.raw: But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them, till the work was ended, and until the other priests had sanctified themselves: for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.
verses.text: But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them, till the work was ended, and until the other priests had sanctified themselves: for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.

verses.raw: And also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the house of Yahuah (LORD) was set in order.
verses.text: And also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the house of Yahuah was set in order.

verses.raw: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that Elohim (God) had prepared the people: for the thing was done suddenly.
verses.text: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that Elohim had prepared the people: for the thing was done suddenly.

verses.raw: And Hezekiah sent to all Yashar'el (Israel) and Yahudah (Judah), and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of Yahuah (LORD) at Jerusalem, to keep the passover unto Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Hezekiah sent to all Yashar'el and Yahudah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of Yahuah at Jerusalem, to keep the passover unto Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: For the king had taken counsel, and his princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, to keep the passover in the second month.
verses.text: For the king had taken counsel, and his princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, to keep the passover in the second month.

verses.raw: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves sufficiently, neither had the people gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.
verses.text: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves sufficiently, neither had the people gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation.
verses.text: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation.

verses.raw: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Yashar'el (Israel), from Beer-sheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the passover unto Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) at Jerusalem: for they had not done it of a long time in such sort as it was written.
verses.text: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Yashar'el, from Beer-sheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the passover unto Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el at Jerusalem: for they had not done it of a long time in such sort as it was written.

verses.raw: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Yashar'el (Israel) and Yahudah (Judah), and according to the commandment of the king, saying, You children of Yashar'el (Israel), turn again unto Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Abraham, Isaac, and Yashar'el (Israel), and he will return to the remnant of you, that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.
verses.text: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Yashar'el and Yahudah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, You children of Yashar'el, turn again unto Yahuah Elohim of Abraham, Isaac, and Yashar'el, and he will return to the remnant of you, that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.

verses.raw: And be not you like your fathers, and like your brethren, which trespassed against Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers, who therefore gave them up to desolation, as you see.
verses.text: And be not you like your fathers, and like your brethren, which trespassed against Yahuah Elohim of their fathers, who therefore gave them up to desolation, as you see.

verses.raw: Now be you not stiffnecked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves unto Yahuah (LORD), and enter into his sanctuary, which he has sanctified for ever: and serve Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you.
verses.text: Now be you not stiffnecked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves unto Yahuah, and enter into his sanctuary, which he has sanctified for ever: and serve Yahuah Elohaychem, that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you.

verses.raw: For if you turn again unto Yahuah (LORD), your brethren and your children shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you, if you return unto him.
verses.text: For if you turn again unto Yahuah, your brethren and your children shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for Yahuah Elohaychem is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you, if you return unto him.

verses.raw: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.
verses.text: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.

verses.raw: Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.text: Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Also in Yahudah (Judah) the hand of Elohim (God) was to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Also in Yahudah the hand of Elohim was to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And there assembled at Jerusalem much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.
verses.text: And there assembled at Jerusalem much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.

verses.raw: And they arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast them into the brook Kidron.
verses.text: And they arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast them into the brook Kidron.

verses.raw: Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the second month: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the second month: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they stood in their place after their manner, according to the law of Moses the man of Elohim (God): the priests sprinkled the blood, which they received of the hand of the Levites.
verses.text: And they stood in their place after their manner, according to the law of Moses the man of Elohim: the priests sprinkled the blood, which they received of the hand of the Levites.

verses.raw: For there were many in the congregation that were not sanctified: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one that was not clean, to sanctify them unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: For there were many in the congregation that were not sanctified: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one that was not clean, to sanctify them unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, and Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet did they eat the passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, The good Yahuah (LORD) pardon every one
verses.text: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, and Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet did they eat the passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, The good Yahuah pardon every one

verses.raw: That prepareth his heart to seek Elohim (God), Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of his fathers, though he be not cleansed according to the purification of the sanctuary.
verses.text: That prepareth his heart to seek Elohim, Yahuah Elohim of his fathers, though he be not cleansed according to the purification of the sanctuary.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.
verses.text: And Yahuah hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness: and the Levites and the priests praised Yahuah (LORD) day by day, singing with loud instruments unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el that were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness: and the Levites and the priests praised Yahuah day by day, singing with loud instruments unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Hezekiah spake comfortably unto all the Levites that taught the good knowledge of Yahuah (LORD): and they did eat throughout the feast seven days, offering peace offerings, and making confession to Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers.
verses.text: And Hezekiah spake comfortably unto all the Levites that taught the good knowledge of Yahuah: and they did eat throughout the feast seven days, offering peace offerings, and making confession to Yahuah Elohim of their fathers.

verses.raw: And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days: and they kept other seven days with gladness.
verses.text: And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days: and they kept other seven days with gladness.

verses.raw: For Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) did give to the congregation a thousand bullocks and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the congregation a thousand bullocks and ten thousand sheep: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.
verses.text: For Hezekiah king of Yahudah did give to the congregation a thousand bullocks and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the congregation a thousand bullocks and ten thousand sheep: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.

verses.raw: And all the congregation of Yahudah (Judah), with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Yashar'el (Israel), and the strangers that came out of the land of Yashar'el (Israel), and that dwelt in Yahudah (Judah), rejoiced.
verses.text: And all the congregation of Yahudah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Yashar'el, and the strangers that came out of the land of Yashar'el, and that dwelt in Yahudah, rejoiced.

verses.raw: So there was great joy in Jerusalem: for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Yashar'el (Israel) there was not the like in Jerusalem.
verses.text: So there was great joy in Jerusalem: for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Yashar'el there was not the like in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy dwelling place, even unto heaven.
verses.text: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy dwelling place, even unto heaven.

verses.raw: Now when all this was finished, all Yashar'el (Israel) that were present went out to the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Yahudah (Judah) and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.
verses.text: Now when all this was finished, all Yashar'el that were present went out to the cities of Yahudah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Yahudah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Yashar'el returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

verses.raw: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of Yahuah.

verses.raw: He appointed also the king’s portion of his substance for the burnt offerings, to wit, for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the law of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: He appointed also the king’s portion of his substance for the burnt offerings, to wit, for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the law of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Yashar'el (Israel) brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly.
verses.text: And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Yashar'el brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly.

verses.raw: And concerning the children of Yashar'el (Israel) and Yahudah (Judah), that dwelt in the cities of Yahudah (Judah), they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), and laid them by heaps.
verses.text: And concerning the children of Yashar'el and Yahudah, that dwelt in the cities of Yahudah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto Yahuah their Elohim, and laid them by heaps.

verses.raw: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.
verses.text: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.

verses.raw: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed Yahuah (LORD), and his people Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed Yahuah, and his people Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.
verses.text: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.

verses.raw: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of Yahuah (LORD), we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for Yahuah (LORD) has blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.
verses.text: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of Yahuah, we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for Yahuah has blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.

verses.raw: Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of Yahuah (LORD); and they prepared them,
verses.text: Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of Yahuah; and they prepared them,

verses.raw: And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler, and Shimei his brother was the next.
verses.text: And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler, and Shimei his brother was the next.

verses.raw: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of Elohim.

verses.raw: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east, was over the freewill offerings of Elohim (God), to distribute the oblations of Yahuah (LORD), and the most holy things.
verses.text: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east, was over the freewill offerings of Elohim, to distribute the oblations of Yahuah, and the most holy things.

verses.raw: And next him were Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small:
verses.text: And next him were Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small:

verses.raw: Beside their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even unto every one that enters into the house of Yahuah (LORD), his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;
verses.text: Beside their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even unto every one that enters into the house of Yahuah, his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;

verses.raw: Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges by their courses;
verses.text: Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges by their courses;

verses.raw: And to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness:
verses.text: And to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness:

verses.raw: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests, which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every several city, the men that were expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.
verses.text: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests, which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every several city, the men that were expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.

verses.raw: And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Yahudah (Judah), and wrought that which was good and right and truth before Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God).
verses.text: And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Yahudah, and wrought that which was good and right and truth before Yahuah Elohav.

verses.raw: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of Elohim (God), and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his Elohim (God), he did it with all his heart, and prospered.
verses.text: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of Elohim, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his Elohim, he did it with all his heart, and prospered.

verses.raw: After these things, and the establishment thereof, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, and entered into Yahudah (Judah), and encamped against the fenced cities, and thought to win them for himself.
verses.text: After these things, and the establishment thereof, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, and entered into Yahudah, and encamped against the fenced cities, and thought to win them for himself.

verses.raw: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was purposed to fight against Jerusalem,
verses.text: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was purposed to fight against Jerusalem,

verses.raw: He took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which were without the city: and they did help him.
verses.text: He took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which were without the city: and they did help him.

verses.raw: So there was gathered much people together, who stopped all the fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water?
verses.text: So there was gathered much people together, who stopped all the fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water?

verses.raw: Also he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised it up to the towers, and another wall without, and repaired Millo in the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance.
verses.text: Also he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised it up to the towers, and another wall without, and repaired Millo in the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance.

verses.raw: And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city, and spake comfortably to them, saying,
verses.text: And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city, and spake comfortably to them, saying,

verses.raw: Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him: for there be more with us than with him:
verses.text: Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him: for there be more with us than with him:

verses.raw: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is Yahuah Eloheinu to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Yahudah.

verses.raw: After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem, (but he himself laid siege against Lachish, and all his power with him,) unto Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), and unto all Yahudah (Judah) that were at Jerusalem, saying,
verses.text: After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem, (but he himself laid siege against Lachish, and all his power with him,) unto Hezekiah king of Yahudah, and unto all Yahudah that were at Jerusalem, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Sennacherib king of Assyria, Whereon do you trust, that you abide in the siege in Jerusalem?
verses.text: Thus says Sennacherib king of Assyria, Whereon do you trust, that you abide in the siege in Jerusalem?

verses.raw: Does not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst, saying, Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.text: Does not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst, saying, Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

verses.raw: Has not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem, saying, You shall worship before one altar, and burn incense upon it?
verses.text: Has not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Yahudah and Jerusalem, saying, You shall worship before one altar, and burn incense upon it?

verses.raw: Know you not what I and my fathers have done unto all the people of other lands? were the gods of the nations of those lands any ways able to deliver their lands out of my hand?
verses.text: Know you not what I and my fathers have done unto all the people of other lands? were the gods of the nations of those lands any ways able to deliver their lands out of my hand?

verses.raw: Who was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out of my hand, that your Elohim (God) should be able to deliver you out of my hand?
verses.text: Who was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out of my hand, that your Elohim should be able to deliver you out of my hand?

verses.raw: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you on this manner, neither yet believe him: for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of my hand, and out of the hand of my fathers: how much less shall your Elohim (God) deliver you out of my hand?
verses.text: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you on this manner, neither yet believe him: for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of my hand, and out of the hand of my fathers: how much less shall your Elohim deliver you out of my hand?

verses.raw: And his servants spake yet more against Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God), and against his servant Hezekiah.
verses.text: And his servants spake yet more against Yahuah Elohim, and against his servant Hezekiah.

verses.raw: He wrote also letters to rail on Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), and to speak against him, saying, As the gods of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of my hand, so shall not the Elohim (God) of Hezekiah deliver his people out of my hand.
verses.text: He wrote also letters to rail on Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, and to speak against him, saying, As the gods of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of my hand, so shall not the Elohim of Hezekiah deliver his people out of my hand.

verses.raw: Then they cried with a loud voice in the Yahudim's (Jews’) speech unto the people of Jerusalem that were on the wall, to affright them, and to trouble them; that they might take the city.
verses.text: Then they cried with a loud voice in the Yahudim's (Jews’) speech unto the people of Jerusalem that were on the wall, to affright them, and to trouble them; that they might take the city.

verses.raw: And they spake against the Elohim (God) of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the people of the earth, which were the work of the hands of man.
verses.text: And they spake against the Elohim of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the people of the earth, which were the work of the hands of man.

verses.raw: And for this cause Hezekiah the king, and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz, prayed and cried to heaven.
verses.text: And for this cause Hezekiah the king, and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz, prayed and cried to heaven.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) sent an angel, which cut off all the mighty men of valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. And when he was come into the house of his god, they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword.
verses.text: And Yahuah sent an angel, which cut off all the mighty men of valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. And when he was come into the house of his god, they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword.

verses.raw: Thus Yahuah (LORD) saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all other, and guided them on every side.
verses.text: Thus Yahuah saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all other, and guided them on every side.

verses.raw: And many brought gifts unto Yahuah (LORD) to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah): so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth.
verses.text: And many brought gifts unto Yahuah to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Yahudah: so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth.

verses.raw: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death, and prayed unto Yahuah (LORD): and he spake unto him, and he gave him a sign.
verses.text: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death, and prayed unto Yahuah: and he spake unto him, and he gave him a sign.

verses.raw: But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit done unto him; for his heart was lifted up: therefore there was wrath upon him, and upon Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem.
verses.text: But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit done unto him; for his heart was lifted up: therefore there was wrath upon him, and upon Yahudah and Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of Yahuah (LORD) came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah.
verses.text: Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of Yahuah came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah.

verses.raw: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour: and he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of pleasant jewels;
verses.text: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour: and he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of pleasant jewels;

verses.raw: Storehouses also for the increase of corn, and wine, and oil; and stalls for all manner of beasts, and cotes for flocks.
verses.text: Storehouses also for the increase of corn, and wine, and oil; and stalls for all manner of beasts, and cotes for flocks.

verses.raw: Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance: for Elohim (God) had given him substance very much.
verses.text: Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance: for Elohim had given him substance very much.

verses.raw: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah prospered in all his works.
verses.text: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah prospered in all his works.

verses.raw: Howbeit in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent unto him to enquire of the wonder that was done in the land, Elohim (God) left him, to try him, that he might know all that was in his heart.
verses.text: Howbeit in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent unto him to enquire of the wonder that was done in the land, Elohim left him, to try him, that he might know all that was in his heart.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, and in the book of the kings of Yahudah (Judah) and Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, and in the book of the kings of Yahudah and Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Yahudah (Judah) and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Yahudah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem:
verses.text: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem:

verses.raw: But did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), like unto the abominations of the heathen, whom Yahuah (LORD) had cast out before the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah, like unto the abominations of the heathen, whom Yahuah had cast out before the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.
verses.text: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

verses.raw: Also he built altars in the house of Yahuah (LORD), whereof Yahuah (LORD) had said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.
verses.text: Also he built altars in the house of Yahuah, whereof Yahuah had said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.

verses.raw: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom: also he observed times, and used enchantments, and used witchcraft, and dealt with a familiar spirit, and with wizards: he wrought much evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), to provoke him to anger.
verses.text: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom: also he observed times, and used enchantments, and used witchcraft, and dealt with a familiar spirit, and with wizards: he wrought much evil in the sight of Yahuah, to provoke him to anger.

verses.raw: And he set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of Elohim (God), of which Elohim (God) had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen before all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), will I put my name for ever:
verses.text: And he set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of Elohim, of which Elohim had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen before all the tribes of Yashar'el, will I put my name for ever:

verses.raw: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Yashar'el (Israel) from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.
verses.text: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Yashar'el from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.

verses.raw: So Manasseh made Yahudah (Judah) and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err, and to do worse than the heathen, whom Yahuah (LORD) had destroyed before the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: So Manasseh made Yahudah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err, and to do worse than the heathen, whom Yahuah had destroyed before the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake to Manasseh, and to his people: but they would not hearken.
verses.text: And Yahuah spake to Manasseh, and to his people: but they would not hearken.

verses.raw: Wherefore Yahuah (LORD) brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, which took Manasseh among the thorns, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.
verses.text: Wherefore Yahuah brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, which took Manasseh among the thorns, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

verses.raw: And when he was in affliction, he besought Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God), and humbled himself greatly before the Elohim (God) of his fathers,
verses.text: And when he was in affliction, he besought Yahuah Elohav, and humbled himself greatly before the Elohim of his fathers,

verses.raw: And prayed unto him: and he was intreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that Yahuah (LORD) he was Elohim (God).
verses.text: And prayed unto him: and he was intreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that Yahuah he was Elohim.

verses.raw: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entering in at the fish gate, and compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height, and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entering in at the fish gate, and compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height, and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Yahudah.

verses.raw: And he took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.
verses.text: And he took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of Yahuah, and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of Yahuah, and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.

verses.raw: And he repaired the altar of Yahuah (LORD), and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings, and commanded Yahudah (Judah) to serve Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And he repaired the altar of Yahuah, and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings, and commanded Yahudah to serve Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places, yet unto Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God) only.
verses.text: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places, yet unto Yahuah their Elohim only.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his Elohim (God), and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his Elohim, and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: His prayer also, and how Elohim (God) was intreated of him, and all his sin, and his trespass, and the places wherein he built high places, and set up groves and graven images, before he was humbled: behold, they are written among the sayings of the seers.
verses.text: His prayer also, and how Elohim was intreated of him, and all his sin, and his trespass, and the places wherein he built high places, and set up groves and graven images, before he was humbled: behold, they are written among the sayings of the seers.

verses.raw: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: Amon was two and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned two years in Jerusalem.
verses.text: Amon was two and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned two years in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: But he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), as did Manasseh his father: for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them;
verses.text: But he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah, as did Manasseh his father: for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them;

verses.raw: And humbled not himself before Yahuah (LORD), as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.
verses.text: And humbled not himself before Yahuah, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.

verses.raw: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.
verses.text: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.

verses.raw: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
verses.text: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

verses.raw: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years.
verses.text: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years.

verses.raw: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
verses.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined neither to the right hand, nor to the left.

verses.raw: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the Elohim (God) of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.
verses.text: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the Elohim of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Yahudah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.

verses.raw: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust of them, and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.
verses.text: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust of them, and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.

verses.raw: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem.
verses.text: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Yahudah and Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.
verses.text: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.

verses.raw: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Yashar'el (Israel), he returned to Jerusalem.
verses.text: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Yashar'el, he returned to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God).
verses.text: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of Yahuah Elohav.

verses.raw: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of Elohim (God), which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Yashar'el (Israel), and of all Yahudah (Judah) and Benjamin; and they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.text: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of Elohim, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Yashar'el, and of all Yahudah and Benjamin; and they returned to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of Yahuah (LORD), to repair and amend the house:
verses.text: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of Yahuah, and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of Yahuah, to repair and amend the house:

verses.raw: Even to the artificers and builders gave they it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Yahudah (Judah) had destroyed.
verses.text: Even to the artificers and builders gave they it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Yahudah had destroyed.

verses.raw: And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it forward; and other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.
verses.text: And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it forward; and other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.

verses.raw: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and were overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service: and of the Levites there were scribes, and officers, and porters.
verses.text: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and were overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service: and of the Levites there were scribes, and officers, and porters.

verses.raw: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of Yahuah (LORD), Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of Yahuah (LORD) given by Moses.
verses.text: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of Yahuah, Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of Yahuah given by Moses.

verses.raw: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of Yahuah (LORD). And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.
verses.text: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of Yahuah. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.

verses.raw: And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to your servants, they do it.
verses.text: And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to your servants, they do it.

verses.raw: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of Yahuah (LORD), and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.
verses.text: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of Yahuah, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.

verses.raw: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest has given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.
verses.text: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest has given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he rent his clothes.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he rent his clothes.

verses.raw: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king’s, saying,
verses.text: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king’s, saying,

verses.raw: Go, enquire of Yahuah (LORD) for me, and for them that are left in Yashar'el (Israel) and in Yahudah (Judah), concerning the words of the book that is found: for great is the wrath of Yahuah (LORD) that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of Yahuah (LORD), to do after all that is written in this book.
verses.text: Go, enquire of Yahuah for me, and for them that are left in Yashar'el and in Yahudah, concerning the words of the book that is found: for great is the wrath of Yahuah that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of Yahuah, to do after all that is written in this book.

verses.raw: And Hilkiah, and they that the king had appointed, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college:) and they spake to her to that effect.
verses.text: And Hilkiah, and they that the king had appointed, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college:) and they spake to her to that effect.

verses.raw: And she answered them, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Tell you the man that sent you to me,
verses.text: And she answered them, Thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, Tell you the man that sent you to me,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Yahudah (Judah):
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Yahudah:

verses.raw: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.
verses.text: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.

verses.raw: And as for the king of Yahudah (Judah), who sent you to enquire of Yahuah (LORD), so shall you say unto him, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) concerning the words which you have heard;
verses.text: And as for the king of Yahudah, who sent you to enquire of Yahuah, so shall you say unto him, Thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el concerning the words which you have heard;

verses.raw: Because your heart was tender, and you did humble thyself before Elohim (God), when you heard his words against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and did rend your clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard you also, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Because your heart was tender, and you did humble thyself before Elohim, when you heard his words against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and did rend your clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard you also, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace, neither shall your eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same. So they brought the king word again.
verses.text: Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace, neither shall your eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same. So they brought the king word again.

verses.raw: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem.
verses.text: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Yahudah and Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And the king went up into the house of Yahuah (LORD), and all the men of Yahudah (Judah), and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the king went up into the house of Yahuah, and all the men of Yahudah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before Yahuah (LORD), to walk after Yahuah (LORD), and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.
verses.text: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before Yahuah, to walk after Yahuah, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.

verses.raw: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of Elohim (God), the Elohim (God) of their fathers.
verses.text: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of Elohim, the Elohim of their fathers.

verses.raw: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and made all that were present in Yashar'el (Israel) to serve, even to serve Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God). And all his days they departed not from following Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of their fathers.
verses.text: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Yashar'el, and made all that were present in Yashar'el to serve, even to serve Yahuah their Elohim. And all his days they departed not from following Yahuah, the Elohim of their fathers.

verses.raw: Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto Yahuah (LORD) in Jerusalem: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.text: Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto Yahuah in Jerusalem: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

verses.raw: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of Yahuah (LORD),
verses.text: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of Yahuah,

verses.raw: And said unto the Levites that taught all Yashar'el (Israel), which were holy unto Yahuah (LORD), Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Yashar'el (Israel) did build; it shall not be a burden upon your shoulders: serve now Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and his people Yashar'el (Israel),
verses.text: And said unto the Levites that taught all Yashar'el, which were holy unto Yahuah, Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Yashar'el did build; it shall not be a burden upon your shoulders: serve now Yahuah Elohaychem, and his people Yashar'el,

verses.raw: And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers, after your courses, according to the writing of David king of Yashar'el (Israel), and according to the writing of Solomon his son.
verses.text: And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers, after your courses, according to the writing of David king of Yashar'el, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.

verses.raw: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and after the division of the families of the Levites.
verses.text: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and after the division of the families of the Levites.

verses.raw: So kill the passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your brethren, that they may do according to the word of Yahuah (LORD) by the hand of Moses.
verses.text: So kill the passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your brethren, that they may do according to the word of Yahuah by the hand of Moses.
