verses.raw: And Josiah gave to the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all for the passover offerings, for all that were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bullocks: these were of the king’s substance.
verses.text: And Josiah gave to the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all for the passover offerings, for all that were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bullocks: these were of the king’s substance.

verses.raw: And his princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of Elohim (God), gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small cattle, and three hundred oxen.
verses.text: And his princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of Elohim, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small cattle, and three hundred oxen.

verses.raw: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand small cattle, and five hundred oxen.
verses.text: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand small cattle, and five hundred oxen.

verses.raw: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their courses, according to the king’s commandment.
verses.text: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their courses, according to the king’s commandment.

verses.raw: And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands, and the Levites flayed them.
verses.text: And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands, and the Levites flayed them.

verses.raw: And they removed the burnt offerings, that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer unto Yahuah (LORD), as it is written in the book of Moses. And so did they with the oxen.
verses.text: And they removed the burnt offerings, that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer unto Yahuah, as it is written in the book of Moses. And so did they with the oxen.

verses.raw: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance: but the other holy offerings sod they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and divided them speedily among all the people.
verses.text: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance: but the other holy offerings sod they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and divided them speedily among all the people.

verses.raw: And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests: because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.
verses.text: And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests: because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.

verses.raw: And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place, according to the commandment of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer; and the porters waited at every gate; they might not depart from their service; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.
verses.text: And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place, according to the commandment of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer; and the porters waited at every gate; they might not depart from their service; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.

verses.raw: So all the service of Yahuah (LORD) was prepared the same day, to keep the passover, and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of Yahuah (LORD), according to the commandment of king Josiah.
verses.text: So all the service of Yahuah was prepared the same day, to keep the passover, and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of Yahuah, according to the commandment of king Josiah.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el that were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

verses.raw: And there was no passover like to that kept in Yashar'el (Israel) from the days of Samuel the prophet; neither did all the kings of Yashar'el (Israel) keep such a passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Yahudah (Judah) and Yashar'el (Israel) that were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.text: And there was no passover like to that kept in Yashar'el from the days of Samuel the prophet; neither did all the kings of Yashar'el keep such a passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Yahudah and Yashar'el that were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept.
verses.text: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept.

verses.raw: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho king of Egypt came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates: and Josiah went out against him.
verses.text: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho king of Egypt came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates: and Josiah went out against him.

verses.raw: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, What have I to do with you, you king of Yahudah (Judah)? I come not against you this day, but against the house wherewith I have war: for Elohim (God) commanded me to make haste: forbear you from meddling with Elohim (God), who is with me, that he destroy you not.
verses.text: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, What have I to do with you, you king of Yahudah? I come not against you this day, but against the house wherewith I have war: for Elohim commanded me to make haste: forbear you from meddling with Elohim, who is with me, that he destroy you not.

verses.raw: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and hearkened not unto the words of Necho from the mouth of Elohim (God), and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.
verses.text: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and hearkened not unto the words of Necho from the mouth of Elohim, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

verses.raw: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, Have me away; for I am sore wounded.
verses.text: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, Have me away; for I am sore wounded.

verses.raw: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had; and they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died, and was buried in one of the sepulchres of his fathers. And all Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.
verses.text: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had; and they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died, and was buried in one of the sepulchres of his fathers. And all Yahudah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

verses.raw: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah: and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day, and made them an ordinance in Yashar'el (Israel): and, behold, they are written in the lamentations.
verses.text: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah: and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day, and made them an ordinance in Yashar'el: and, behold, they are written in the lamentations.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his goodness, according to that which was written in the law of Yahuah (LORD),
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his goodness, according to that which was written in the law of Yahuah,

verses.raw: And his deeds, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel) and Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And his deeds, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Yashar'el and Yahudah.

verses.raw: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father’s stead in Jerusalem.
verses.text: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father’s stead in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.
verses.text: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem, and condemned the land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
verses.text: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem, and condemned the land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

verses.raw: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem, and turned his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.
verses.text: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Yahudah and Jerusalem, and turned his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.

verses.raw: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God).
verses.text: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah Elohav.

verses.raw: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.
verses.text: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.

verses.raw: Nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of Yahuah (LORD) to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.
verses.text: Nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of Yahuah to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel) and Yahudah (Judah): and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Yashar'el and Yahudah: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And when the year was expired, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and made Zedekiah his brother king over Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem.
verses.text: And when the year was expired, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of Yahuah, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Yahudah and Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.
verses.text: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God), and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah Elohav, and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by Elohim (God): but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning unto Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by Elohim: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning unto Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and polluted the house of Yahuah (LORD) which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.
verses.text: Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and polluted the house of Yahuah which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, rising up betimes, and sending; because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place:
verses.text: And Yahuah Elohim of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, rising up betimes, and sending; because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place:

verses.raw: But they mocked the messengers of Elohim (God), and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of Yahuah (LORD) arose against his people, till there was no remedy.
verses.text: But they mocked the messengers of Elohim, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of Yahuah arose against his people, till there was no remedy.

verses.raw: Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldees, who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion upon young man or maiden, old man, or him that stooped for age: he gave them all into his hand.
verses.text: Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldees, who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion upon young man or maiden, old man, or him that stooped for age: he gave them all into his hand.

verses.raw: And all the vessels of the house of Elohim (God), great and small, and the treasures of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all these he brought to Babylon.
verses.text: And all the vessels of the house of Elohim, great and small, and the treasures of the house of Yahuah, and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all these he brought to Babylon.

verses.raw: And they burnt the house of Elohim (God), and brake down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire, and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof.
verses.text: And they burnt the house of Elohim, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire, and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof.

verses.raw: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babylon; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia:
verses.text: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babylon; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia:

verses.raw: To fulfil the word of Yahuah (LORD) by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths: for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.
verses.text: To fulfil the word of Yahuah by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths: for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.

verses.raw: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, Yahuah (LORD) stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
verses.text: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of Yahuah spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, Yahuah stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth has Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of heaven given me; and he has charged me to build him an house in Jerusalem, which is in Yahudah (Judah). Who is there among you of all his people? Yahuah Elohav (The LORD his God) be with him, and let him go up.
verses.text: Thus says Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth has Yahuah Elohim of heaven given me; and he has charged me to build him an house in Jerusalem, which is in Yahudah. Who is there among you of all his people? Yahuah Elohav (The LORD his God) be with him, and let him go up.

verses.raw: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, Yahuah (LORD) stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
verses.text: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of Yahuah by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, Yahuah stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Cyrus king of Persia, Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God) of heaven has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: Thus says Cyrus king of Persia, Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God) of heaven has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Yahudah.

verses.raw: Who is there among you of all his people? his Elohim (God) be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Yahudah (Judah), and build the house of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), (he is the Elohim (God),) which is in Jerusalem.
verses.text: Who is there among you of all his people? his Elohim be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Yahudah, and build the house of Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, (he is the Elohim,) which is in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And whosoever remains in any place where he sojourns, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, beside the freewill offering for the house of Elohim (God) that is in Jerusalem.
verses.text: And whosoever remains in any place where he sojourns, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, beside the freewill offering for the house of Elohim that is in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Yahudah (Judah) and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit Elohim (God) had raised, to go up to build the house of Yahuah (LORD) which is in Jerusalem.
verses.text: Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Yahudah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit Elohim had raised, to go up to build the house of Yahuah which is in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And all they that were about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, beside all that was willingly offered.
verses.text: And all they that were about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, beside all that was willingly offered.

verses.raw: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of Yahuah (LORD), which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods;
verses.text: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of Yahuah, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods;

verses.raw: Even those did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar, the prince of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: Even those did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar, the prince of Yahudah.

verses.raw: And this is the number of them: thirty chargers of gold, a thousand chargers of silver, nine and twenty knives,
verses.text: And this is the number of them: thirty chargers of gold, a thousand chargers of silver, nine and twenty knives,

verses.raw: Thirty basons of gold, silver basons of a second sort four hundred and ten, and other vessels a thousand.
verses.text: Thirty basons of gold, silver basons of a second sort four hundred and ten, and other vessels a thousand.

verses.raw: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four hundred. All these did Sheshbazzar bring up with them of the captivity that were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem.
verses.text: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four hundred. All these did Sheshbazzar bring up with them of the captivity that were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Yahudah (Judah), every one unto his city;

verses.text: The children of Asnah, the children of Mehunim, the children of Nephusim,

verses.text: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

verses.text: The children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

verses.text: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Ami.

verses.raw: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety and two.
verses.text: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety and two.

verses.raw: And these were they which went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer: but they could not shew their father’s house, and their seed, whether they were of Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: And these were they which went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer: but they could not shew their father’s house, and their seed, whether they were of Yashar'el:

verses.raw: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty and two.
verses.text: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty and two.

verses.raw: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; which took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:
verses.text: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; which took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:

verses.raw: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
verses.text: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.

verses.raw: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.
verses.text: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.

verses.raw: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
verses.text: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,

verses.raw: Beside their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women.
verses.text: Beside their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women.

verses.raw: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred forty and five;
verses.text: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred forty and five;

verses.raw: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
verses.text: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.

verses.raw: And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house of Yahuah (LORD) which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of Elohim (God) to set it up in his place:
verses.text: And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house of Yahuah which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of Elohim to set it up in his place:

verses.raw: They gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work threescore and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pound of silver, and one hundred priests’ garments.
verses.text: They gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work threescore and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pound of silver, and one hundred priests’ garments.

verses.raw: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, dwelt in their cities, and all Yashar'el (Israel) in their cities.
verses.text: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, dwelt in their cities, and all Yashar'el in their cities.

verses.raw: And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.
verses.text: And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Yashar'el were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and builded the altar of the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), to offer burnt offerings thereon, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and builded the altar of the Elohim of Yashar'el, to offer burnt offerings thereon, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of Elohim.

verses.raw: And they set the altar upon his bases; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto Yahuah (LORD), even burnt offerings morning and evening.
verses.text: And they set the altar upon his bases; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto Yahuah, even burnt offerings morning and evening.

verses.raw: They kept also the feast of tabernacles, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the custom, as the duty of every day required;
verses.text: They kept also the feast of tabernacles, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the custom, as the duty of every day required;

verses.raw: And afterward offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of Yahuah (LORD) that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And afterward offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of Yahuah that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto Yahuah (LORD). But the foundation of the temple of Yahuah (LORD) was not yet laid.
verses.text: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto Yahuah. But the foundation of the temple of Yahuah was not yet laid.

verses.raw: They gave money also unto the masons, and to the carpenters; and meat, and drink, and oil, unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.
verses.text: They gave money also unto the masons, and to the carpenters; and meat, and drink, and oil, unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.

verses.raw: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of Elohim (God) at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of Elohim at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Yahudah (Judah), together, to set forward the workmen in the house of Elohim (God): the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brethren the Levites.
verses.text: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Yahudah, together, to set forward the workmen in the house of Elohim: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brethren the Levites.

verses.raw: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of Yahuah (LORD), they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise Yahuah (LORD), after the ordinance of David king of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of Yahuah, they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise Yahuah, after the ordinance of David king of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto Yahuah (LORD); because he is good, for his mercy endures for ever toward Yashar'el (Israel). And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised Yahuah (LORD), because the foundation of the house of Yahuah (LORD) was laid.
verses.text: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto Yahuah; because he is good, for his mercy endures for ever toward Yashar'el. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised Yahuah, because the foundation of the house of Yahuah was laid.

verses.raw: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy:
verses.text: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy:

verses.raw: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.
verses.text: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.

verses.raw: Now when the adversaries of Yahudah (Judah) and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel);
verses.text: Now when the adversaries of Yahudah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el;

verses.raw: Then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the chief of the fathers, and said unto them, Let us build with you: for we seek your Elohim (God), as you do; and we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esar-haddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither.
verses.text: Then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the chief of the fathers, and said unto them, Let us build with you: for we seek your Elohim, as you do; and we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esar-haddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither.

verses.raw: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Yashar'el (Israel), said unto them, You have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our Elohim (God); but we ourselves together will build unto Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), as king Cyrus the king of Persia has commanded us.
verses.text: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Yashar'el, said unto them, You have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our Elohim; but we ourselves together will build unto Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, as king Cyrus the king of Persia has commanded us.

verses.raw: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Yahudah (Judah), and troubled them in building,
verses.text: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Yahudah, and troubled them in building,

verses.raw: And hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.
verses.text: And hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.

verses.raw: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, wrote they unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem.
verses.text: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, wrote they unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Yahudah and Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions, unto Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue, and interpreted in the Syrian tongue.
verses.text: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions, unto Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue, and interpreted in the Syrian tongue.

verses.raw: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:
verses.text: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:

verses.raw: Then wrote Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinaites, the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Susanchites, the Dehavites, and the Elamites,
verses.text: Then wrote Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinaites, the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Susanchites, the Dehavites, and the Elamites,

verses.raw: And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnappar brought over, and set in the cities of Samaria, and the rest that are on this side the river, and at such a time.
verses.text: And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnappar brought over, and set in the cities of Samaria, and the rest that are on this side the river, and at such a time.

verses.raw: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him, even unto Artaxerxes the king; Your servants the men on this side the river, and at such a time.
verses.text: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him, even unto Artaxerxes the king; Your servants the men on this side the river, and at such a time.

verses.raw: Be it known unto the king, that the Yahudim (Jews) which came up from you to us are come unto Jerusalem, building the rebellious and the bad city, and have set up the walls thereof, and joined the foundations.
verses.text: Be it known unto the king, that the Yahudim which came up from you to us are come unto Jerusalem, building the rebellious and the bad city, and have set up the walls thereof, and joined the foundations.

verses.raw: Be it known now unto the king, that, if this city be builded, and the walls set up again, then will they not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and so you shall endamage the revenue of the kings.
verses.text: Be it known now unto the king, that, if this city be builded, and the walls set up again, then will they not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and so you shall endamage the revenue of the kings.

verses.raw: Now because we have maintenance from the king’s palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king’s dishonour, therefore have we sent and certified the king;
verses.text: Now because we have maintenance from the king’s palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king’s dishonour, therefore have we sent and certified the king;

verses.raw: That search may be made in the book of the records of your fathers: so shall you find in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful unto kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time: for which cause was this city destroyed.
verses.text: That search may be made in the book of the records of your fathers: so shall you find in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful unto kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time: for which cause was this city destroyed.

verses.raw: We certify the king that, if this city be builded again, and the walls thereof set up, by this means you shall have no portion on this side the river.
verses.text: We certify the king that, if this city be builded again, and the walls thereof set up, by this means you shall have no portion on this side the river.

verses.raw: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and unto the rest beyond the river, Peace, and at such a time.
verses.text: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and unto the rest beyond the river, Peace, and at such a time.

verses.raw: The letter which you sent unto us has been plainly read before me.
verses.text: The letter which you sent unto us has been plainly read before me.

verses.raw: And I commanded, and search has been made, and it is found that this city of old time has made insurrection against kings, and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein.
verses.text: And I commanded, and search has been made, and it is found that this city of old time has made insurrection against kings, and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein.

verses.raw: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid unto them.
verses.text: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid unto them.

verses.raw: Give you now commandment to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not builded, until another commandment shall be given from me.
verses.text: Give you now commandment to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not builded, until another commandment shall be given from me.

verses.raw: Take heed now that you fail not to do this: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?
verses.text: Take heed now that you fail not to do this: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?

verses.raw: Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes’ letter was read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went up in haste to Jerusalem unto the Yahudim (Jews), and made them to cease by force and power.
verses.text: Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes’ letter was read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went up in haste to Jerusalem unto the Yahudim, and made them to cease by force and power.

verses.raw: Then ceased the work of the house of Elohim (God) which is at Jerusalem. So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
verses.text: Then ceased the work of the house of Elohim which is at Jerusalem. So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

verses.raw: Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied unto the Yahudim (Jews) that were in Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem in the name of the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), even unto them.
verses.text: Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied unto the Yahudim that were in Yahudah and Jerusalem in the name of the Elohim of Yashar'el, even unto them.

verses.raw: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of Elohim (God) which is at Jerusalem: and with them were the prophets of Elohim (God) helping them.
verses.text: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of Elohim which is at Jerusalem: and with them were the prophets of Elohim helping them.

verses.raw: At the same time came to them Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar-boznai, and their companions, and said thus unto them, Who has commanded you to build this house, and to make up this wall?
verses.text: At the same time came to them Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar-boznai, and their companions, and said thus unto them, Who has commanded you to build this house, and to make up this wall?

verses.raw: Then said we unto them after this manner, What are the names of the men that make this building?
verses.text: Then said we unto them after this manner, What are the names of the men that make this building?

verses.raw: But the eye of their Elohim (God) was upon the elders of the Yahudim (Jews), that they could not cause them to cease, till the matter came to Darius: and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter.
verses.text: But the eye of their Elohim was upon the elders of the Yahudim, that they could not cause them to cease, till the matter came to Darius: and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter.

verses.raw: The copy of the letter that Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar-boznai, and his companions the Apharsachites, which were on this side the river, sent unto Darius the king:
verses.text: The copy of the letter that Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar-boznai, and his companions the Apharsachites, which were on this side the river, sent unto Darius the king:

verses.raw: They sent a letter unto him, wherein was written thus; Unto Darius the king, all peace.
verses.text: They sent a letter unto him, wherein was written thus; Unto Darius the king, all peace.

verses.raw: Be it known unto the king, that we went into the province of Judea, to the house of the great Elohim (God), which is builded with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work goes fast on, and prospereth in their hands.
verses.text: Be it known unto the king, that we went into the province of Judea, to the house of the great Elohim, which is builded with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work goes fast on, and prospereth in their hands.

verses.raw: Then asked we those elders, and said unto them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?
verses.text: Then asked we those elders, and said unto them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?

verses.raw: We asked their names also, to certify you, that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them.
verses.text: We asked their names also, to certify you, that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them.

verses.raw: And thus they returned us answer, saying, We are the servants of the Elohim (God) of heaven and earth, and build the house that was builded these many years ago, which a great king of Yashar'el (Israel) builded and set up.
verses.text: And thus they returned us answer, saying, We are the servants of the Elohim of heaven and earth, and build the house that was builded these many years ago, which a great king of Yashar'el builded and set up.

verses.raw: But after that our fathers had provoked the Elohim (God) of heaven unto wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house, and carried the people away into Babylon.
verses.text: But after that our fathers had provoked the Elohim of heaven unto wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house, and carried the people away into Babylon.

verses.raw: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of Elohim (God).
verses.text: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of Elohim.

verses.raw: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of Elohim (God), which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem, and brought them into the temple of Babylon, those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered unto one, whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor;
verses.text: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of Elohim, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem, and brought them into the temple of Babylon, those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered unto one, whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor;

verses.raw: And said unto him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of Elohim (God) be builded in his place.
verses.text: And said unto him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of Elohim be builded in his place.

verses.raw: Then came the same Sheshbazzar, and laid the foundation of the house of Elohim (God) which is in Jerusalem: and since that time even until now has it been in building, and yet it is not finished.
verses.text: Then came the same Sheshbazzar, and laid the foundation of the house of Elohim which is in Jerusalem: and since that time even until now has it been in building, and yet it is not finished.

verses.raw: Now therefore, if it seem good to the king, let there be search made in the king’s treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it be so, that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of Elohim (God) at Jerusalem, and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.
verses.text: Now therefore, if it seem good to the king, let there be search made in the king’s treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it be so, that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of Elohim at Jerusalem, and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.

verses.raw: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the rolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.
verses.text: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the rolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.

verses.raw: And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a roll, and therein was a record thus written:
verses.text: And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a roll, and therein was a record thus written:

verses.raw: In the first year of Cyrus the king the same Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of Elohim (God) at Jerusalem, Let the house be builded, the place where they offered sacrifices, and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid; the height thereof threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof threescore cubits;
verses.text: In the first year of Cyrus the king the same Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of Elohim at Jerusalem, Let the house be builded, the place where they offered sacrifices, and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid; the height thereof threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof threescore cubits;

verses.raw: With three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expenses be given out of the king’s house:
verses.text: With three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expenses be given out of the king’s house:

verses.raw: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of Elohim (God), which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem, and brought unto Babylon, be restored, and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem, every one to his place, and place them in the house of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of Elohim, which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem, and brought unto Babylon, be restored, and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem, every one to his place, and place them in the house of Elohim.

verses.raw: Now therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shethar-boznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which are beyond the river, be you far from thence:
verses.text: Now therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shethar-boznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which are beyond the river, be you far from thence:

verses.raw: Let the work of this house of Elohim (God) alone; let the governor of the Yahudim (Jews) and the elders of the Yahudim (Jews) build this house of Elohim (God) in his place.
verses.text: Let the work of this house of Elohim alone; let the governor of the Yahudim and the elders of the Yahudim build this house of Elohim in his place.

verses.raw: Moreover I make a decree what you shall do to the elders of these Yahudim (Jews) for the building of this house of Elohim (God): that of the king’s goods, even of the tribute beyond the river, forthwith expenses be given unto these men, that they be not hindered.
verses.text: Moreover I make a decree what you shall do to the elders of these Yahudim for the building of this house of Elohim: that of the king’s goods, even of the tribute beyond the river, forthwith expenses be given unto these men, that they be not hindered.

verses.raw: And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the Elohim (God) of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail:
verses.text: And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the Elohim of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail:

verses.raw: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the Elohim (God) of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.
verses.text: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the Elohim of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.

verses.raw: Also I have made a decree, that whosoever shall alter this word, let timber be pulled down from his house, and being set up, let him be hanged thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.
verses.text: Also I have made a decree, that whosoever shall alter this word, let timber be pulled down from his house, and being set up, let him be hanged thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.

verses.raw: And the Elohim (God) that has caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people, that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of Elohim (God) which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with speed.
verses.text: And the Elohim that has caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people, that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of Elohim which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with speed.

verses.raw: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shethar-boznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.
verses.text: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shethar-boznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.

verses.raw: And the elders of the Yahudim (Jews) builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they builded, and finished it, according to the commandment of the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
verses.text: And the elders of the Yahudim builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they builded, and finished it, according to the commandment of the Elohim of Yashar'el, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.

verses.raw: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
verses.text: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel), the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of Elohim (God) with joy,
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of Elohim with joy,

verses.raw: And offered at the dedication of this house of Elohim (God) an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Yashar'el (Israel), twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And offered at the dedication of this house of Elohim an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Yashar'el, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of Elohim (God), which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.
verses.text: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of Elohim, which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.

verses.raw: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.text: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month.

verses.raw: For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them were pure, and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.
verses.text: For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them were pure, and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which were come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), did eat,
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el, which were come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, did eat,

verses.raw: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for Yahuah (LORD) had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of Elohim (God), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for Yahuah had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of Elohim, the Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.text: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

verses.raw: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,
verses.text: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

verses.raw: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,
verses.text: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

verses.raw: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
verses.text: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

verses.raw: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:
verses.text: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:

verses.raw: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God) upon him.
verses.text: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of Yahuah Elohav upon him.

verses.raw: And there went up some of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, unto Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.
verses.text: And there went up some of the children of Yashar'el, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, unto Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.

verses.raw: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.
verses.text: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.

verses.raw: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his Elohim (God) upon him.
verses.text: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his Elohim upon him.

verses.raw: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of Yahuah (LORD), and to do it, and to teach in Yashar'el (Israel) statutes and judgments.
verses.text: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of Yahuah, and to do it, and to teach in Yashar'el statutes and judgments.

verses.raw: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest, the scribe, even a scribe of the words of the commandments of Yahuah (LORD), and of his statutes to Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest, the scribe, even a scribe of the words of the commandments of Yahuah, and of his statutes to Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Artaxerxes, king of kings, unto Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the Elohim (God) of heaven, perfect peace, and at such a time.
verses.text: Artaxerxes, king of kings, unto Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the Elohim of heaven, perfect peace, and at such a time.

verses.raw: I make a decree, that all they of the people of Yashar'el (Israel), and of his priests and Levites, in my realm, which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem, go with you.
verses.text: I make a decree, that all they of the people of Yashar'el, and of his priests and Levites, in my realm, which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem, go with you.

verses.raw: Forasmuch as you are sent of the king, and of his seven counsellors, to enquire concerning Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem, according to the law of your Elohim (God) which is in your hand;
verses.text: Forasmuch as you are sent of the king, and of his seven counsellors, to enquire concerning Yahudah and Jerusalem, according to the law of your Elohim which is in your hand;

verses.raw: And to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), whose habitation is in Jerusalem,
verses.text: And to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the Elohim of Yashar'el, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,

verses.raw: And all the silver and gold that you can find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their Elohim (God) which is in Jerusalem:
verses.text: And all the silver and gold that you can find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their Elohim which is in Jerusalem:

verses.raw: That you may buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your Elohim (God) which is in Jerusalem.
verses.text: That you may buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your Elohim which is in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And whatsoever shall seem good to you, and to your brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your Elohim (God).
verses.text: And whatsoever shall seem good to you, and to your brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your Elohim.

verses.raw: The vessels also that are given you for the service of the house of your Elohim (God), those deliver you before the Elohim (God) of Jerusalem.
verses.text: The vessels also that are given you for the service of the house of your Elohim, those deliver you before the Elohim of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of your Elohim (God), which you shall have occasion to bestow, bestow it out of the king’s treasure house.
verses.text: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of your Elohim, which you shall have occasion to bestow, bestow it out of the king’s treasure house.

verses.raw: And I, even I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river, that whatsoever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the Elohim (God) of heaven, shall require of you, it be done speedily,
verses.text: And I, even I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river, that whatsoever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the Elohim of heaven, shall require of you, it be done speedily,

verses.raw: Unto an hundred talents of silver, and to an hundred measures of wheat, and to an hundred baths of wine, and to an hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.
verses.text: Unto an hundred talents of silver, and to an hundred measures of wheat, and to an hundred baths of wine, and to an hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.

verses.raw: Whatsoever is commanded by the Elohim (God) of heaven, let it be diligently done for the house of the Elohim (God) of heaven: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?
verses.text: Whatsoever is commanded by the Elohim of heaven, let it be diligently done for the house of the Elohim of heaven: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?

verses.raw: Also we certify you, that touching any of the priests and Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of this house of Elohim (God), it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.
verses.text: Also we certify you, that touching any of the priests and Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of this house of Elohim, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.

verses.raw: And you, Ezra, after the wisdom of your Elohim (God), that is in your hand, set magistrates and judges, which may judge all the people that are beyond the river, all such as know the laws of your Elohim (God); and teach you them that know them not.
verses.text: And you, Ezra, after the wisdom of your Elohim, that is in your hand, set magistrates and judges, which may judge all the people that are beyond the river, all such as know the laws of your Elohim; and teach you them that know them not.

verses.raw: And whosoever will not do the law of your Elohim (God), and the law of the king, let judgment be executed speedily upon him, whether it be unto death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.
verses.text: And whosoever will not do the law of your Elohim, and the law of the king, let judgment be executed speedily upon him, whether it be unto death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.

verses.raw: Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of our fathers, which has put such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify the house of Yahuah (LORD) which is in Jerusalem:
verses.text: Blessed be Yahuah Elohim of our fathers, which has put such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify the house of Yahuah which is in Jerusalem:

verses.raw: And has extended mercy unto me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king’s mighty princes. And I was strengthened as the hand of Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God) was upon me, and I gathered together out of Yashar'el (Israel) chief men to go up with me.
verses.text: And has extended mercy unto me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king’s mighty princes. And I was strengthened as the hand of Yahuah Elohai was upon me, and I gathered together out of Yashar'el chief men to go up with me.

verses.raw: These are now the chief of their fathers, and this is the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.
verses.text: These are now the chief of their fathers, and this is the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.

verses.raw: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.
verses.text: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.

verses.raw: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.
verses.text: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.

verses.raw: Of the sons of Pahath-moab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.
verses.text: Of the sons of Pahath-moab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.

verses.raw: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.
verses.text: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.

verses.raw: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.
verses.text: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.
verses.text: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.
verses.text: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.

verses.raw: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
verses.text: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males.
verses.text: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.
verses.text: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.
verses.text: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.

verses.raw: And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names are these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them threescore males.
verses.text: And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names are these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them threescore males.

verses.raw: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.
verses.text: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.

verses.raw: And I gathered them together to the river that runs to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.
verses.text: And I gathered them together to the river that runs to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.

verses.raw: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.
verses.text: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.

verses.raw: And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say unto Iddo, and to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our Elohim (God).
verses.text: And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say unto Iddo, and to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our Elohim.

verses.raw: And by the good hand of our Elohim (God) upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Yashar'el (Israel); and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;
verses.text: And by the good hand of our Elohim upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Yashar'el; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;

verses.raw: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;
verses.text: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;

verses.raw: Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name.
verses.text: Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name.

verses.raw: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our Elohim (God), to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.
verses.text: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our Elohim, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.

verses.raw: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our Elohim (God) is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
verses.text: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our Elohim is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.

verses.raw: So we fasted and besought our Elohim (God) for this: and he was intreated of us.
verses.text: So we fasted and besought our Elohim for this: and he was intreated of us.

verses.raw: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,
verses.text: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,

verses.raw: And weighed unto them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, even the offering of the house of our Elohim (God), which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Yashar'el (Israel) there present, had offered:
verses.text: And weighed unto them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, even the offering of the house of our Elohim, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Yashar'el there present, had offered:

verses.raw: I even weighed unto their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels an hundred talents, and of gold an hundred talents;
verses.text: I even weighed unto their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels an hundred talents, and of gold an hundred talents;

verses.raw: Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.
verses.text: Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.

verses.raw: And I said unto them, You are holy unto Yahuah (LORD); the vessels are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering unto Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of your fathers.
verses.text: And I said unto them, You are holy unto Yahuah; the vessels are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering unto Yahuah Elohim of your fathers.

verses.raw: Watch you, and keep them, until you weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Yashar'el (Israel), at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Watch you, and keep them, until you weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Yashar'el, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem unto the house of our Elohim (God).
verses.text: So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem unto the house of our Elohim.

verses.raw: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem: and the hand of our Elohim (God) was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.
verses.text: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem: and the hand of our Elohim was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.

verses.raw: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.
verses.text: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.

verses.raw: Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our Elohim (God) by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites;
verses.text: Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our Elohim by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites;

verses.raw: By number and by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.
verses.text: By number and by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.

verses.raw: Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), twelve bullocks for all Yashar'el (Israel), ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the Elohim of Yashar'el, twelve bullocks for all Yashar'el, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they delivered the king’s commissions unto the king’s lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And they delivered the king’s commissions unto the king’s lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of Elohim.
