verses.raw: Now when these things were done, the princes came to me, saying, The people of Yashar'el (Israel), and the priests, and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the people of the lands, doing according to their abominations, even of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
verses.text: Now when these things were done, the princes came to me, saying, The people of Yashar'el, and the priests, and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the people of the lands, doing according to their abominations, even of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.

verses.raw: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the people of those lands: yea, the hand of the princes and rulers has been chief in this trespass.
verses.text: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the people of those lands: yea, the hand of the princes and rulers has been chief in this trespass.

verses.raw: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down astonied.
verses.text: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down astonied.

verses.raw: Then were assembled unto me every one that trembled at the words of the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), because of the transgression of those that had been carried away; and I sat astonied until the evening sacrifice.
verses.text: Then were assembled unto me every one that trembled at the words of the Elohim of Yashar'el, because of the transgression of those that had been carried away; and I sat astonied until the evening sacrifice.

verses.raw: And at the evening sacrifice I arose up from my heaviness; and having rent my garment and my mantle, I fell upon my knees, and spread out my hands unto Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God),
verses.text: And at the evening sacrifice I arose up from my heaviness; and having rent my garment and my mantle, I fell upon my knees, and spread out my hands unto Yahuah Elohai,

verses.raw: And said, O my Elohim (God), I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to you, my Elohim (God): for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.
verses.text: And said, O my Elohim, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to you, my Elohim: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.

verses.raw: Since the days of our fathers have we been in a great trespass unto this day; and for our iniquities have we, our kings, and our priests, been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to a spoil, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.
verses.text: Since the days of our fathers have we been in a great trespass unto this day; and for our iniquities have we, our kings, and our priests, been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to a spoil, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.

verses.raw: And now for a little space grace has been shewed from Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our Elohim (God) may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.
verses.text: And now for a little space grace has been shewed from Yahuah Eloheinu, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our Elohim may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.

verses.raw: For we were bondmen; yet our Elohim (God) has not forsaken us in our bondage, but has extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our Elohim (God), and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Yahudah (Judah) and in Jerusalem.
verses.text: For we were bondmen; yet our Elohim has not forsaken us in our bondage, but has extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our Elohim, and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Yahudah and in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And now, O our Elohim (God), what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken your commandments,
verses.text: And now, O our Elohim, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken your commandments,

verses.raw: Which you have commanded by your servants the prophets, saying, The land, unto which you go to possess it, is an unclean land with the filthiness of the people of the lands, with their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness.
verses.text: Which you have commanded by your servants the prophets, saying, The land, unto which you go to possess it, is an unclean land with the filthiness of the people of the lands, with their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness.

verses.raw: Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters unto your sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever: that you may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever.
verses.text: Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters unto your sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever: that you may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever.

verses.raw: And after all that is come upon us for our evil deeds, and for our great trespass, seeing that you our Elohim (God) have punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and have given us such deliverance as this;
verses.text: And after all that is come upon us for our evil deeds, and for our great trespass, seeing that you our Elohim have punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and have given us such deliverance as this;

verses.raw: Should we again break your commandments, and join in affinity with the people of these abominations? would not you be angry with us till you had consumed us, so that there should be no remnant nor escaping?
verses.text: Should we again break your commandments, and join in affinity with the people of these abominations? would not you be angry with us till you had consumed us, so that there should be no remnant nor escaping?

verses.raw: O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), you are righteous: for we remain yet escaped, as it is this day: behold, we are before you in our trespasses: for we cannot stand before you because of this.
verses.text: O Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, you are righteous: for we remain yet escaped, as it is this day: behold, we are before you in our trespasses: for we cannot stand before you because of this.

verses.raw: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of Elohim (God), there assembled unto him out of Yashar'el (Israel) a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very sore.
verses.text: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of Elohim, there assembled unto him out of Yashar'el a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very sore.

verses.raw: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our Elohim (God), and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Yashar'el (Israel) concerning this thing.
verses.text: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our Elohim, and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Yashar'el concerning this thing.

verses.raw: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our Elohim (God) to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our Elohim (God); and let it be done according to the law.
verses.text: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our Elohim to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our Elohim; and let it be done according to the law.

verses.raw: Arise; for this matter belongs unto you: we also will be with you: be of good courage, and do it.
verses.text: Arise; for this matter belongs unto you: we also will be with you: be of good courage, and do it.

verses.raw: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Yashar'el (Israel), to swear that they should do according to this word. And they sware.
verses.text: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Yashar'el, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they sware.

verses.raw: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of Elohim (God), and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib: and when he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.
verses.text: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of Elohim, and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib: and when he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.

verses.raw: And they made proclamation throughout Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;
verses.text: And they made proclamation throughout Yahudah and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;

verses.raw: And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.
verses.text: And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.

verses.raw: Then all the men of Yahudah (Judah) and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of Elohim (God), trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain.
verses.text: Then all the men of Yahudah and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of Elohim, trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain.

verses.raw: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, You have transgressed, and have taken strange wives, to increase the trespass of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, You have transgressed, and have taken strange wives, to increase the trespass of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Now therefore make confession unto Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the strange wives.
verses.text: Now therefore make confession unto Yahuah Elohim of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the strange wives.

verses.raw: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As you have said, so must we do.
verses.text: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As you have said, so must we do.

verses.raw: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.
verses.text: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.

verses.raw: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our Elohim (God) for this matter be turned from us.
verses.text: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our Elohim for this matter be turned from us.

verses.raw: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
verses.text: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

verses.raw: And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain chief of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated, and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.
verses.text: And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain chief of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated, and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

verses.raw: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.
verses.text: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.

verses.raw: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely, of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.
verses.text: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely, of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.

verses.raw: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.
verses.text: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Immer; Hanani, and Zebadiah.
verses.text: And of the sons of Immer; Hanani, and Zebadiah.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Harim; Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.
verses.text: And of the sons of Harim; Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
verses.text: And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

verses.raw: Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, (the same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Yahudah (Judah), and Eliezer.
verses.text: Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, (the same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Yahudah, and Eliezer.

verses.raw: Of the singers also; Eliashib: and of the porters; Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.
verses.text: Of the singers also; Eliashib: and of the porters; Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.

verses.raw: Moreover of Yashar'el (Israel): of the sons of Parosh; Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.
verses.text: Moreover of Yashar'el: of the sons of Parosh; Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Eliah.
verses.text: And of the sons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Eliah.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Zattu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.
verses.text: And of the sons of Zattu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.

verses.raw: Of the sons also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.
verses.text: Of the sons also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.
verses.text: And of the sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Pahath-moab; Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.
verses.text: And of the sons of Pahath-moab; Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
verses.text: And of the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

verses.raw: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.
verses.text: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.

verses.raw: Of the sons of Hashum; Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
verses.text: Of the sons of Hashum; Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

verses.raw: Of the sons of Bani; Maadai, Amram, and Uel,
verses.text: Of the sons of Bani; Maadai, Amram, and Uel,

verses.raw: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,
verses.text: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,

verses.raw: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
verses.text: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

verses.raw: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasau,
verses.text: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasau,

verses.raw: And Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,
verses.text: And Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,

verses.raw: And Shelemiah, and Nathan, and Adaiah,
verses.text: And Shelemiah, and Nathan, and Adaiah,

verses.raw: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
verses.text: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

verses.raw: Azareel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah,
verses.text: Azareel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah,

verses.raw: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.
verses.text: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.

verses.raw: Of the sons of Nebo; Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jadau, and Joel, Benaiah.
verses.text: Of the sons of Nebo; Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jadau, and Joel, Benaiah.

verses.raw: All these had taken strange wives: and some of them had wives by whom they had children.
verses.text: All these had taken strange wives: and some of them had wives by whom they had children.

verses.raw: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,
verses.text: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,

verses.raw: That Hanani, one of my brethren, came, he and certain men of Yahudah (Judah); and I asked them concerning the Yahudim (Jews) that had escaped, which were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.
verses.text: That Hanani, one of my brethren, came, he and certain men of Yahudah; and I asked them concerning the Yahudim that had escaped, which were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And they said unto me, The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach: the wall of Jerusalem also is broken down, and the gates thereof are burned with fire.
verses.text: And they said unto me, The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach: the wall of Jerusalem also is broken down, and the gates thereof are burned with fire.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned certain days, and fasted, and prayed before the Elohim (God) of heaven,
verses.text: And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned certain days, and fasted, and prayed before the Elohim of heaven,

verses.raw: And said, I beseech you, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of heaven, the great and terrible Elohim (God), that keeps covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments:
verses.text: And said, I beseech you, O Yahuah Elohim of heaven, the great and terrible Elohim, that keeps covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments:

verses.raw: Let your ear now be attentive, and your eyes open, that you may hear the prayer of your servant, which I pray before you now, day and night, for the children of Yashar'el (Israel) your servants, and confess the sins of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which we have sinned against you: both I and my father’s house have sinned.
verses.text: Let your ear now be attentive, and your eyes open, that you may hear the prayer of your servant, which I pray before you now, day and night, for the children of Yashar'el your servants, and confess the sins of the children of Yashar'el, which we have sinned against you: both I and my father’s house have sinned.

verses.raw: We have dealt very corruptly against you, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the judgments, which you commanded your servant Moses.
verses.text: We have dealt very corruptly against you, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the judgments, which you commanded your servant Moses.

verses.raw: Remember, I beseech you, the word that you commanded your servant Moses, saying, If you transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations:
verses.text: Remember, I beseech you, the word that you commanded your servant Moses, saying, If you transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations:

verses.raw: But if you turn unto me, and keep my commandments, and do them; though there were of you cast out unto the uttermost part of the heaven, yet will I gather them from thence, and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set my name there.
verses.text: But if you turn unto me, and keep my commandments, and do them; though there were of you cast out unto the uttermost part of the heaven, yet will I gather them from thence, and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set my name there.

verses.raw: Now these are your servants and your people, whom you have redeemed by your great power, and by your strong hand.
verses.text: Now these are your servants and your people, whom you have redeemed by your great power, and by your strong hand.

verses.raw: O Adonai (Lord), I beseech you, let now your ear be attentive to the prayer of your servant, and to the prayer of your servants, who desire to fear your name: and prosper, I pray you, your servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king’s cupbearer.
verses.text: O Adonai, I beseech you, let now your ear be attentive to the prayer of your servant, and to the prayer of your servants, who desire to fear your name: and prosper, I pray you, your servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king’s cupbearer.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that wine was before him: and I took up the wine, and gave it unto the king. Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence.
verses.text: And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that wine was before him: and I took up the wine, and gave it unto the king. Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence.

verses.raw: Wherefore the king said unto me, Why is your countenance sad, seeing you are not sick? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart. Then I was very sore afraid,
verses.text: Wherefore the king said unto me, Why is your countenance sad, seeing you are not sick? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart. Then I was very sore afraid,

verses.raw: And said unto the king, Let the king live for ever: why should not my countenance be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’ sepulchres, lies waste, and the gates thereof are consumed with fire?
verses.text: And said unto the king, Let the king live for ever: why should not my countenance be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’ sepulchres, lies waste, and the gates thereof are consumed with fire?

verses.raw: Then the king said unto me, For what do you make request? So I prayed to the Elohim (God) of heaven.
verses.text: Then the king said unto me, For what do you make request? So I prayed to the Elohim of heaven.

verses.raw: And I said unto the king, If it please the king, and if your servant have found favour in your sight, that you would send me unto Yahudah (Judah), unto the city of my fathers’ sepulchres, that I may build it.
verses.text: And I said unto the king, If it please the king, and if your servant have found favour in your sight, that you would send me unto Yahudah, unto the city of my fathers’ sepulchres, that I may build it.

verses.raw: And the king said unto me, (the queen also sitting by him,) For how long shall your journey be? and when will you return? So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.
verses.text: And the king said unto me, (the queen also sitting by him,) For how long shall your journey be? and when will you return? So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.

verses.raw: Moreover I said unto the king, If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may convey me over till I come into Yahudah (Judah);
verses.text: Moreover I said unto the king, If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may convey me over till I come into Yahudah;

verses.raw: And a letter unto Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which appertained to the house, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into. And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my Elohim (God) upon me.
verses.text: And a letter unto Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which appertained to the house, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into. And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my Elohim upon me.

verses.raw: Then I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.
verses.text: Then I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.

verses.raw: When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.
verses.text: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

verses.raw: And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me; neither told I any man what my Elohim (God) had put in my heart to do at Jerusalem: neither was there any beast with me, save the beast that I rode upon.
verses.text: And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me; neither told I any man what my Elohim had put in my heart to do at Jerusalem: neither was there any beast with me, save the beast that I rode upon.

verses.raw: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon well, and to the dung port, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and the gates thereof were consumed with fire.
verses.text: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon well, and to the dung port, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and the gates thereof were consumed with fire.

verses.raw: Then I went on to the gate of the fountain, and to the king’s pool: but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass.
verses.text: Then I went on to the gate of the fountain, and to the king’s pool: but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass.

verses.raw: Then went I up in the night by the brook, and viewed the wall, and turned back, and entered by the gate of the valley, and so returned.
verses.text: Then went I up in the night by the brook, and viewed the wall, and turned back, and entered by the gate of the valley, and so returned.

verses.raw: And the rulers knew not whither I went, or what I did; neither had I as yet told it to the Yahudim (Jews), nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest that did the work.
verses.text: And the rulers knew not whither I went, or what I did; neither had I as yet told it to the Yahudim, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest that did the work.

verses.raw: Then said I unto them, You see the distress that we are in, how Jerusalem lies waste, and the gates thereof are burned with fire: come, and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we be no more a reproach.
verses.text: Then said I unto them, You see the distress that we are in, how Jerusalem lies waste, and the gates thereof are burned with fire: come, and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we be no more a reproach.

verses.raw: Then I told them of the hand of my Elohim (God) which was good upon me; as also the king’s words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for this good work.
verses.text: Then I told them of the hand of my Elohim which was good upon me; as also the king’s words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for this good work.

verses.raw: But when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they laughed us to scorn, and despised us, and said, What is this thing that you do? will you rebel against the king?
verses.text: But when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they laughed us to scorn, and despised us, and said, What is this thing that you do? will you rebel against the king?

verses.raw: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The Elohim (God) of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but you have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.
verses.text: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The Elohim of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but you have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests, and they builded the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up the doors of it; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it, unto the tower of Hananeel.
verses.text: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests, and they builded the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up the doors of it; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it, unto the tower of Hananeel.

verses.raw: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho. And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri.
verses.text: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho. And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri.

verses.raw: But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build, who also laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
verses.text: But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build, who also laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

verses.raw: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel. And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.
verses.text: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel. And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.

verses.raw: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord.
verses.text: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord.

verses.raw: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
verses.text: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

verses.raw: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, unto the throne of the governor on this side the river.
verses.text: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, unto the throne of the governor on this side the river.

verses.raw: Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths. Next unto him also repaired Hananiah the son of one of the apothecaries, and they fortified Jerusalem unto the broad wall.
verses.text: Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths. Next unto him also repaired Hananiah the son of one of the apothecaries, and they fortified Jerusalem unto the broad wall.

verses.raw: And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem.
verses.text: And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah.
verses.text: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah.

verses.raw: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hashub the son of Pahath-moab, repaired the other piece, and the tower of the furnaces.
verses.text: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hashub the son of Pahath-moab, repaired the other piece, and the tower of the furnaces.

verses.raw: And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Halohesh, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.
verses.text: And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Halohesh, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.

verses.raw: The valley gate repaired Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate.
verses.text: The valley gate repaired Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate.

verses.raw: But the dung gate repaired Malchiah the son of Rechab, the ruler of part of Beth-haccerem; he built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
verses.text: But the dung gate repaired Malchiah the son of Rechab, the ruler of part of Beth-haccerem; he built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

verses.raw: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Col-hozeh, the ruler of part of Mizpah; he built it, and covered it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king’s garden, and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David.
verses.text: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Col-hozeh, the ruler of part of Mizpah; he built it, and covered it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king’s garden, and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David.

verses.raw: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of the half part of Beth-zur, unto the place over against the sepulchres of David, and to the pool that was made, and unto the house of the mighty.
verses.text: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of the half part of Beth-zur, unto the place over against the sepulchres of David, and to the pool that was made, and unto the house of the mighty.

verses.raw: After him repaired the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani. Next unto him repaired Hashabiah, the ruler of the half part of Keilah, in his part.
verses.text: After him repaired the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani. Next unto him repaired Hashabiah, the ruler of the half part of Keilah, in his part.

verses.raw: After him repaired their brethren, Bavai the son of Henadad, the ruler of the half part of Keilah.
verses.text: After him repaired their brethren, Bavai the son of Henadad, the ruler of the half part of Keilah.

verses.raw: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning of the wall.
verses.text: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning of the wall.

verses.raw: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece, from the turning of the wall unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
verses.text: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece, from the turning of the wall unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

verses.raw: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah the son of Koz another piece, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.
verses.text: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah the son of Koz another piece, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.

verses.raw: And after him repaired the priests, the men of the plain.
verses.text: And after him repaired the priests, the men of the plain.

verses.raw: After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub over against their house. After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house.
verses.text: After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub over against their house. After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house.

verses.raw: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece, from the house of Azariah unto the turning of the wall, even unto the corner.
verses.text: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece, from the house of Azariah unto the turning of the wall, even unto the corner.

verses.raw: Palal the son of Uzai, over against the turning of the wall, and the tower which lies out from the king’s high house, that was by the court of the prison. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh.
verses.text: Palal the son of Uzai, over against the turning of the wall, and the tower which lies out from the king’s high house, that was by the court of the prison. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh.

verses.raw: Moreover the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel, unto the place over against the water gate toward the east, and the tower that lies out.
verses.text: Moreover the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel, unto the place over against the water gate toward the east, and the tower that lies out.

verses.raw: After them the Tekoites repaired another piece, over against the great tower that lies out, even unto the wall of Ophel.
verses.text: After them the Tekoites repaired another piece, over against the great tower that lies out, even unto the wall of Ophel.

verses.raw: From above the horse gate repaired the priests, every one over against his house.
verses.text: From above the horse gate repaired the priests, every one over against his house.

verses.raw: After them repaired Zadok the son of Immer over against his house. After him repaired also Shemaiah the son of Shechaniah, the keeper of the east gate.
verses.text: After them repaired Zadok the son of Immer over against his house. After him repaired also Shemaiah the son of Shechaniah, the keeper of the east gate.

verses.raw: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, another piece. After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber.
verses.text: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, another piece. After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber.

verses.raw: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith’s son unto the place of the Nethinims, and of the merchants, over against the gate Miphkad, and to the going up of the corner.
verses.text: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith’s son unto the place of the Nethinims, and of the merchants, over against the gate Miphkad, and to the going up of the corner.

verses.raw: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants.
verses.text: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants.

verses.raw: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Yahudim (Jews).
verses.text: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Yahudim.

verses.raw: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Yahudim (Jews)? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?
verses.text: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Yahudim? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?

verses.raw: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.
verses.text: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.

verses.raw: Hear, O our Elohim (God); for we are despised: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity:
verses.text: Hear, O our Elohim; for we are despised: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity:

verses.raw: And cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before you: for they have provoked you to anger before the builders.
verses.text: And cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before you: for they have provoked you to anger before the builders.

verses.raw: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.
verses.text: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.

verses.raw: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up, and that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth,
verses.text: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up, and that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth,

verses.raw: And conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.
verses.text: And conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.

verses.raw: Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our Elohim (God), and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.
verses.text: Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our Elohim, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) said, The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.
verses.text: And Yahudah said, The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.

verses.raw: And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.
verses.text: And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that when the Yahudim (Jews) which dwelt by them came, they said unto us ten times, From all places whence you shall return unto us they will be upon you.
verses.text: And it came to pass, that when the Yahudim which dwelt by them came, they said unto us ten times, From all places whence you shall return unto us they will be upon you.

verses.raw: Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall, and on the higher places, I even set the people after their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
verses.text: Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall, and on the higher places, I even set the people after their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

verses.raw: And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not you afraid of them: remember Adonai (Lord), which is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.
verses.text: And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not you afraid of them: remember Adonai, which is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was known unto us, and Elohim (God) had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, every one unto his work.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was known unto us, and Elohim had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, every one unto his work.

verses.raw: And it came to pass from that time forth, that the half of my servants wrought in the work, and the other half of them held both the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the habergeons; and the rulers were behind all the house of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And it came to pass from that time forth, that the half of my servants wrought in the work, and the other half of them held both the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the habergeons; and the rulers were behind all the house of Yahudah.

verses.raw: They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other hand held a weapon.
verses.text: They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other hand held a weapon.

verses.raw: For the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and so builded. And he that sounded the trumpet was by me.
verses.text: For the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and so builded. And he that sounded the trumpet was by me.

verses.raw: And I said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work is great and large, and we are separated upon the wall, one far from another.
verses.text: And I said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work is great and large, and we are separated upon the wall, one far from another.

verses.raw: In what place therefore you hear the sound of the trumpet, resort you thither unto us: our Elohim (God) shall fight for us.
verses.text: In what place therefore you hear the sound of the trumpet, resort you thither unto us: our Elohim shall fight for us.

verses.raw: So we laboured in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.
verses.text: So we laboured in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.

verses.raw: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people, Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and labour on the day.
verses.text: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people, Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and labour on the day.

verses.raw: So neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard which followed me, none of us put off our clothes, saving that every one put them off for washing.
verses.text: So neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard which followed me, none of us put off our clothes, saving that every one put them off for washing.

verses.raw: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Yahudim (Jews).
verses.text: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Yahudim.

verses.raw: For there were that said, We, our sons, and our daughters, are many: therefore we take up corn for them, that we may eat, and live.
verses.text: For there were that said, We, our sons, and our daughters, are many: therefore we take up corn for them, that we may eat, and live.

verses.raw: Some also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.
verses.text: Some also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.

verses.raw: There were also that said, We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute, and that upon our lands and vineyards.
verses.text: There were also that said, We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute, and that upon our lands and vineyards.

verses.raw: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren, our children as their children: and, lo, we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants, and some of our daughters are brought unto bondage already: neither is it in our power to redeem them; for other men have our lands and vineyards.
verses.text: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren, our children as their children: and, lo, we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants, and some of our daughters are brought unto bondage already: neither is it in our power to redeem them; for other men have our lands and vineyards.

verses.raw: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.
verses.text: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.

verses.raw: Then I consulted with myself, and I rebuked the nobles, and the rulers, and said unto them, You exact usury, every one of his brother. And I set a great assembly against them.
verses.text: Then I consulted with myself, and I rebuked the nobles, and the rulers, and said unto them, You exact usury, every one of his brother. And I set a great assembly against them.

verses.raw: And I said unto them, We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Yahudim (Jews), which were sold unto the heathen; and will you even sell your brethren? or shall they be sold unto us? Then held they their peace, and found nothing to answer.
verses.text: And I said unto them, We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Yahudim, which were sold unto the heathen; and will you even sell your brethren? or shall they be sold unto us? Then held they their peace, and found nothing to answer.

verses.raw: Also I said, It is not good that you do: ought you not to walk in the fear of our Elohim (God) because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies?
verses.text: Also I said, It is not good that you do: ought you not to walk in the fear of our Elohim because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies?

verses.raw: I likewise, and my brethren, and my servants, might exact of them money and corn: I pray you, let us leave off this usury.
verses.text: I likewise, and my brethren, and my servants, might exact of them money and corn: I pray you, let us leave off this usury.

verses.raw: Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, that you exact of them.
verses.text: Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, that you exact of them.

verses.raw: Then said they, We will restore them, and will require nothing of them; so will we do as you say. Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.
verses.text: Then said they, We will restore them, and will require nothing of them; so will we do as you say. Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.

verses.raw: Also I shook my lap, and said, So Elohim (God) shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, that performs not this promise, even thus be he shaken out, and emptied. And all the congregation said, Amen, and praised Yahuah (LORD). And the people did according to this promise.
verses.text: Also I shook my lap, and said, So Elohim shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, that performs not this promise, even thus be he shaken out, and emptied. And all the congregation said, Amen, and praised Yahuah. And the people did according to this promise.

verses.raw: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Yahudah (Judah), from the twentieth year even unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.
verses.text: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Yahudah, from the twentieth year even unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.

verses.raw: But the former governors that had been before me were chargeable unto the people, and had taken of them bread and wine, beside forty shekels of silver; yea, even their servants bare rule over the people: but so did not I, because of the fear of Elohim (God).
verses.text: But the former governors that had been before me were chargeable unto the people, and had taken of them bread and wine, beside forty shekels of silver; yea, even their servants bare rule over the people: but so did not I, because of the fear of Elohim.

verses.raw: Yea, also I continued in the work of this wall, neither bought we any land: and all my servants were gathered thither unto the work.
verses.text: Yea, also I continued in the work of this wall, neither bought we any land: and all my servants were gathered thither unto the work.

verses.raw: Moreover there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Yahudim (Jews) and rulers, beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that are about us.
verses.text: Moreover there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Yahudim and rulers, beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that are about us.

verses.raw: Now that which was prepared for me daily was one ox and six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.
verses.text: Now that which was prepared for me daily was one ox and six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.

verses.raw: Think upon me, my Elohim (God), for good, according to all that I have done for this people.
verses.text: Think upon me, my Elohim, for good, according to all that I have done for this people.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had builded the wall, and that there was no breach left therein; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)
verses.text: Now it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had builded the wall, and that there was no breach left therein; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)

verses.raw: That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me, saying, Come, let us meet together in some one of the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.
verses.text: That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me, saying, Come, let us meet together in some one of the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.

verses.raw: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?
verses.text: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?

verses.raw: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.
verses.text: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.

verses.raw: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;
verses.text: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;

verses.raw: Wherein was written, It is reported among the heathen, and Gashmu says it, that you and the Yahudim (Jews) think to rebel: for which cause you buildest the wall, that you may be their king, according to these words.

verses.raw: And you have also appointed prophets to preach of you at Jerusalem, saying, There is a king in Yahudah (Judah): and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.

verses.raw: Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as you say, but you feignest them out of your own heart.

verses.raw: For they all made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done. Now therefore, O Elohim (God), strengthen my hands.

verses.raw: Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who was shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of Elohim (God), within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay you; yea, in the night will they come to slay you.
verses.text: Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who was shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of Elohim, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay you; yea, in the night will they come to slay you.

verses.raw: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who is there, that, being as I am, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.
verses.text: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who is there, that, being as I am, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.

verses.raw: And, lo, I perceived that Elohim (God) had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
verses.text: And, lo, I perceived that Elohim had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

verses.raw: Therefore was he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and that they might have matter for an evil report, that they might reproach me.
verses.text: Therefore was he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and that they might have matter for an evil report, that they might reproach me.

verses.raw: My Elohim (God), think you upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.

verses.raw: So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty and two days.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that when all our enemies heard thereof, and all the heathen that were about us saw these things, they were much cast down in their own eyes: for they perceived that this work was wrought of our Elohim (God).

verses.raw: For there were many in Yahudah (Judah) sworn unto him, because he was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.

verses.raw: Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

verses.raw: That I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he was a faithful man, and feared Elohim (God) above many.

verses.raw: And I said unto them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun be hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors, and bar them: and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one to be over against his house.

verses.raw: And my Elohim (God) put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, and found written therein,

verses.raw: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Yashar'el (Israel), dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were in their cities.

verses.raw: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which Yahuah (LORD) had commanded to Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which Yahuah had commanded to Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.
verses.text: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.

verses.raw: And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law.
verses.text: And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law.

verses.raw: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
verses.text: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

verses.raw: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:
verses.text: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:

verses.raw: And Ezra blessed Yahuah (LORD), the great Elohim (God). And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped Yahuah (LORD) with their faces to the ground.
verses.text: And Ezra blessed Yahuah, the great Elohim. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped Yahuah with their faces to the ground.

verses.raw: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people stood in their place.
verses.text: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people stood in their place.

verses.raw: So they read in the book in the law of Elohim (God) distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.
verses.text: So they read in the book in the law of Elohim distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.

verses.raw: And Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day is holy unto Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God); mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.
verses.text: And Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day is holy unto Yahuah Elohaychem; mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.

verses.raw: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be you sorry; for the joy of Yahuah (LORD) is your strength.
verses.text: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be you sorry; for the joy of Yahuah is your strength.

verses.raw: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day is holy; neither be you grieved.
verses.text: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day is holy; neither be you grieved.

verses.raw: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.
verses.text: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.

verses.raw: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, unto Ezra the scribe, even to understand the words of the law.

verses.raw: And they found written in the law which Yahuah (LORD) had commanded by Moses, that the children of Yashar'el (Israel) should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month:
verses.text: And they found written in the law which Yahuah had commanded by Moses, that the children of Yashar'el should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month:

verses.raw: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written.
verses.text: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written.

verses.raw: So the people went forth, and brought them, and made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of Elohim (God), and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.
verses.text: So the people went forth, and brought them, and made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of Elohim, and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.

verses.raw: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths, and sat under the booths: for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Yashar'el (Israel) done so. And there was very great gladness.
verses.text: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths, and sat under the booths: for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Yashar'el done so. And there was very great gladness.

verses.raw: Also day by day, from the first day unto the last day, he read in the book of the law of Elohim (God). And they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according unto the manner.
verses.text: Also day by day, from the first day unto the last day, he read in the book of the law of Elohim. And they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according unto the manner.

verses.raw: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.
verses.text: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Yashar'el were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.

verses.raw: And the seed of Yashar'el (Israel) separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.
verses.text: And the seed of Yashar'el separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.

verses.raw: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God) one fourth part of the day; and another fourth part they confessed, and worshipped Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God).
verses.text: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of Yahuah their Elohim one fourth part of the day; and another fourth part they confessed, and worshipped Yahuah their Elohim.

verses.raw: Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God).
verses.text: Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto Yahuah their Elohim.

verses.raw: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, Stand up and bless Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) for ever and ever: and blessed be your glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.
verses.text: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, Stand up and bless Yahuah Elohaychem for ever and ever: and blessed be your glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.

verses.raw: You, even you, are Yahuah (LORD) alone; you have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all things that are therein, the seas, and all that is therein, and you preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth you.
verses.text: You, even you, are Yahuah alone; you have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all things that are therein, the seas, and all that is therein, and you preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth you.

verses.raw: You are Yahuah (LORD) the Elohim (God), who did choose Abram, and brought him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gave him the name of Abraham;
verses.text: You are Yahuah the Elohim, who did choose Abram, and brought him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gave him the name of Abraham;

verses.raw: And foundest his heart faithful before you, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give it, I say, to his seed, and have performed your words; for you are righteous:
verses.text: And foundest his heart faithful before you, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give it, I say, to his seed, and have performed your words; for you are righteous:

verses.raw: And did see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red sea;
verses.text: And did see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red sea;

verses.raw: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for you knew that they dealt proudly against them. So did you get you a name, as it is this day.
verses.text: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for you knew that they dealt proudly against them. So did you get you a name, as it is this day.

verses.raw: And you did divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their persecutors you threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.
verses.text: And you did divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their persecutors you threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.

verses.raw: Moreover you leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.
verses.text: Moreover you leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.

verses.raw: You came down also upon mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:
verses.text: You came down also upon mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:

verses.raw: And made known unto them your holy sabbath, and commanded them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses your servant:
verses.text: And made known unto them your holy sabbath, and commanded them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses your servant:

verses.raw: And gave them bread from heaven for their hunger, and brought forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which you had sworn to give them.
verses.text: And gave them bread from heaven for their hunger, and brought forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which you had sworn to give them.

verses.raw: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to your commandments,
verses.text: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to your commandments,

verses.raw: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of your wonders that you did among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but you are a Elohim (God) ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.
verses.text: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of your wonders that you did among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but you are a Elohim ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.

verses.raw: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This is your Elohim (God) that brought you up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;
verses.text: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This is your Elohim that brought you up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;

verses.raw: Yet you in your manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.
verses.text: Yet you in your manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.

verses.raw: You gave also your good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not your manna from their mouth, and gave them water for their thirst.
verses.text: You gave also your good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not your manna from their mouth, and gave them water for their thirst.

verses.raw: Yea, forty years did you sustain them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.
verses.text: Yea, forty years did you sustain them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.

verses.raw: Moreover you gave them kingdoms and nations, and did divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
verses.text: Moreover you gave them kingdoms and nations, and did divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

verses.raw: Their children also multipliedst you as the stars of heaven, and brought them into the land, concerning which you had promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.
verses.text: Their children also multipliedst you as the stars of heaven, and brought them into the land, concerning which you had promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.
