verses.raw: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.
verses.text: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.

verses.raw: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:
verses.text: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:

verses.raw: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that you will not hold me innocent.
verses.text: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that you will not hold me innocent.

verses.raw: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?
verses.text: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?

verses.raw: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;
verses.text: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;

verses.raw: Yet shall you plunge me in the ditch, and my own clothes shall abhor me.
verses.text: Yet shall you plunge me in the ditch, and my own clothes shall abhor me.

verses.raw: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment.
verses.text: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment.

verses.raw: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.
verses.text: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.

verses.raw: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:
verses.text: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:

verses.raw: Then would I speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.
verses.text: Then would I speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.

verses.raw: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.text: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.raw: I will say unto Elohim (God), Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore you contendest with me.
verses.text: I will say unto Elohim, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore you contendest with me.

verses.raw: Is it good unto you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?
verses.text: Is it good unto you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?

verses.raw: Have you eyes of flesh? or see you as man sees?
verses.text: Have you eyes of flesh? or see you as man sees?

verses.raw: Are your days as the days of man? are your years as man’s days,
verses.text: Are your days as the days of man? are your years as man’s days,

verses.raw: That you enquirest after my iniquity, and search after my sin?
verses.text: That you enquirest after my iniquity, and search after my sin?

verses.raw: You know that I am not wicked; and there is none that can deliver out of your hand.
verses.text: You know that I am not wicked; and there is none that can deliver out of your hand.

verses.raw: Your hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet you do destroy me.
verses.text: Your hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet you do destroy me.

verses.raw: Remember, I beseech you, that you have made me as the clay; and will you bring me into dust again?
verses.text: Remember, I beseech you, that you have made me as the clay; and will you bring me into dust again?

verses.raw: Have you not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?
verses.text: Have you not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?

verses.raw: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and have fenced me with bones and sinews.
verses.text: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and have fenced me with bones and sinews.

verses.raw: You have granted me life and favour, and your visitation has preserved my spirit.
verses.text: You have granted me life and favour, and your visitation has preserved my spirit.

verses.raw: And these things have you hid in your heart: I know that this is with you.
verses.text: And these things have you hid in your heart: I know that this is with you.

verses.raw: If I sin, then you markest me, and you will not acquit me from my iniquity.
verses.text: If I sin, then you markest me, and you will not acquit me from my iniquity.

verses.raw: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see you my affliction;
verses.text: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see you my affliction;

verses.raw: For it increases. You huntest me as a fierce lion: and again you shewest thyself marvellous upon me.
verses.text: For it increases. You huntest me as a fierce lion: and again you shewest thyself marvellous upon me.

verses.raw: You renewest your witnesses against me, and increasest your indignation upon me; changes and war are against me.
verses.text: You renewest your witnesses against me, and increasest your indignation upon me; changes and war are against me.

verses.raw: Wherefore then have you brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!
verses.text: Wherefore then have you brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!

verses.raw: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
verses.text: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

verses.raw: Are not my days few? cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,
verses.text: Are not my days few? cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,

verses.raw: Before I go whence I shall not return, even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;
verses.text: Before I go whence I shall not return, even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;

verses.raw: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.
verses.text: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.

verses.raw: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
verses.text: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

verses.raw: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be justified?
verses.text: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be justified?

verses.raw: Should your lies make men hold their peace? and when you mockest, shall no man make you ashamed?
verses.text: Should your lies make men hold their peace? and when you mockest, shall no man make you ashamed?

verses.raw: For you have said, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in your eyes.
verses.text: For you have said, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in your eyes.

verses.raw: But oh that Elohim (God) would speak, and open his lips against you;
verses.text: But oh that Elohim would speak, and open his lips against you;

verses.raw: And that he would shew you the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is! Know therefore that Elohim (God) exacteth of you less than your iniquity deserveth.
verses.text: And that he would shew you the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is! Know therefore that Elohim exacteth of you less than your iniquity deserveth.

verses.raw: Can you by searching find out Elohim (God)? can you find out the Almighty unto perfection?
verses.text: Can you by searching find out Elohim? can you find out the Almighty unto perfection?

verses.raw: It is as high as heaven; what can you do? deeper than hell; what can you know?
verses.text: It is as high as heaven; what can you do? deeper than hell; what can you know?

verses.raw: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
verses.text: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

verses.raw: If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him?
verses.text: If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him?

verses.raw: For he knows vain men: he sees wickedness also; will he not then consider it?
verses.text: For he knows vain men: he sees wickedness also; will he not then consider it?

verses.raw: For vain man would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass’s colt.
verses.text: For vain man would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass’s colt.

verses.raw: If you prepare your heart, and stretch out your hands toward him;
verses.text: If you prepare your heart, and stretch out your hands toward him;

verses.raw: If iniquity be in your hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in your tabernacles.
verses.text: If iniquity be in your hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in your tabernacles.

verses.raw: For then shall you lift up your face without spot; yea, you shall be stedfast, and shall not fear:
verses.text: For then shall you lift up your face without spot; yea, you shall be stedfast, and shall not fear:

verses.raw: Because you shall forget your misery, and remember it as waters that pass away:
verses.text: Because you shall forget your misery, and remember it as waters that pass away:

verses.raw: And your age shall be clearer than the noonday; you shall shine forth, you shall be as the morning.
verses.text: And your age shall be clearer than the noonday; you shall shine forth, you shall be as the morning.

verses.raw: And you shall be secure, because there is hope; yea, you shall dig about you, and you shall take your rest in safety.
verses.text: And you shall be secure, because there is hope; yea, you shall dig about you, and you shall take your rest in safety.

verses.raw: Also you shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto you.
verses.text: Also you shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto you.

verses.raw: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.
verses.text: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.

verses.raw: And Job answered and said,
verses.text: And Job answered and said,

verses.raw: No doubt but you are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
verses.text: No doubt but you are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.

verses.raw: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knows not such things as these?
verses.text: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knows not such things as these?

verses.raw: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calls upon Elohim (God), and he answers him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.
verses.text: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calls upon Elohim, and he answers him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.

verses.raw: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.
verses.text: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.

verses.raw: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke Elohim (God) are secure; into whose hand Elohim (God) brings abundantly.
verses.text: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke Elohim are secure; into whose hand Elohim brings abundantly.

verses.raw: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach you; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell you:
verses.text: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach you; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell you:

verses.raw: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach you: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto you.
verses.text: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach you: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto you.

verses.raw: Who knows not in all these that the hand of Yahuah (LORD) has wrought this?
verses.text: Who knows not in all these that the hand of Yahuah has wrought this?

verses.raw: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
verses.text: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.

verses.raw: Does not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?
verses.text: Does not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?

verses.raw: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.
verses.text: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.

verses.raw: With him is wisdom and strength, he has counsel and understanding.
verses.text: With him is wisdom and strength, he has counsel and understanding.

verses.raw: Behold, he breaks down, and it cannot be built again: he shuts up a man, and there can be no opening.
verses.text: Behold, he breaks down, and it cannot be built again: he shuts up a man, and there can be no opening.

verses.raw: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.
verses.text: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.

verses.raw: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.
verses.text: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.

verses.raw: He leads counsellors away spoiled, and makes the judges fools.
verses.text: He leads counsellors away spoiled, and makes the judges fools.

verses.raw: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.
verses.text: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.

verses.raw: He leads princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.
verses.text: He leads princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.

verses.raw: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and takes away the understanding of the aged.
verses.text: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and takes away the understanding of the aged.

verses.raw: He pours contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.
verses.text: He pours contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.

verses.raw: He discovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.
verses.text: He discovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.

verses.raw: He increases the nations, and destroys them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.
verses.text: He increases the nations, and destroys them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.

verses.raw: He takes away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
verses.text: He takes away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

verses.raw: They grope in the dark without light, and he makes them to stagger like a drunken man.
verses.text: They grope in the dark without light, and he makes them to stagger like a drunken man.

verses.raw: Lo, my eye has seen all this, my ear has heard and understood it.
verses.text: Lo, my eye has seen all this, my ear has heard and understood it.

verses.raw: What you know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.
verses.text: What you know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.

verses.raw: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with Elohim (God).
verses.text: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with Elohim.

verses.raw: But you are forgers of lies, you are all physicians of no value.
verses.text: But you are forgers of lies, you are all physicians of no value.

verses.raw: O that you would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.
verses.text: O that you would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.

verses.raw: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.
verses.text: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.

verses.raw: Will you speak wickedly for Elohim (God)? and talk deceitfully for him?
verses.text: Will you speak wickedly for Elohim? and talk deceitfully for him?

verses.raw: Will you accept his person? will you contend for Elohim (God)?
verses.text: Will you accept his person? will you contend for Elohim?

verses.raw: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocks another, do you so mock him?
verses.text: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocks another, do you so mock him?

verses.raw: He will surely reprove you, if you do secretly accept persons.
verses.text: He will surely reprove you, if you do secretly accept persons.

verses.raw: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?
verses.text: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?

verses.raw: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.
verses.text: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.

verses.raw: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.
verses.text: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.

verses.raw: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?
verses.text: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?

verses.raw: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain my own ways before him.
verses.text: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain my own ways before him.

verses.raw: He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.
verses.text: He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.

verses.raw: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.
verses.text: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.

verses.raw: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.
verses.text: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.

verses.raw: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.
verses.text: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.

verses.raw: Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from you.
verses.text: Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from you.

verses.raw: Withdraw your hand far from me: and let not your dread make me afraid.
verses.text: Withdraw your hand far from me: and let not your dread make me afraid.

verses.raw: Then call you, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer you me.
verses.text: Then call you, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer you me.

verses.raw: How many are my iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.
verses.text: How many are my iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.

verses.raw: Wherefore hide you your face, and hold me for your enemy?
verses.text: Wherefore hide you your face, and hold me for your enemy?

verses.raw: Will you break a leaf driven to and fro? and will you pursue the dry stubble?
verses.text: Will you break a leaf driven to and fro? and will you pursue the dry stubble?

verses.raw: For you writest bitter things against me, and make me to possess the iniquities of my youth.
verses.text: For you writest bitter things against me, and make me to possess the iniquities of my youth.

verses.raw: You put my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; you set a print upon the heels of my feet.
verses.text: You put my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; you set a print upon the heels of my feet.

verses.raw: And he, as a rotten thing, consumes, as a garment that is moth eaten.
verses.text: And he, as a rotten thing, consumes, as a garment that is moth eaten.

verses.raw: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.
verses.text: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.

verses.raw: He comes forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continues not.
verses.text: He comes forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continues not.

verses.raw: And do you open your eyes upon such an one, and bring me into judgment with you?
verses.text: And do you open your eyes upon such an one, and bring me into judgment with you?

verses.raw: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.
verses.text: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.

verses.raw: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with you, you have appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;
verses.text: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with you, you have appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;

verses.raw: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.
verses.text: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.

verses.raw: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
verses.text: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.

verses.raw: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;
verses.text: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;

verses.raw: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.
verses.text: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.

verses.raw: But man dies, and wasteth away: yea, man gives up the ghost, and where is he?
verses.text: But man dies, and wasteth away: yea, man gives up the ghost, and where is he?

verses.raw: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and dries up:
verses.text: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and dries up:

verses.raw: So man lies down, and rises not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.
verses.text: So man lies down, and rises not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.

verses.raw: O that you would hide me in the grave, that you would keep me secret, until your wrath be past, that you would appoint me a set time, and remember me!
verses.text: O that you would hide me in the grave, that you would keep me secret, until your wrath be past, that you would appoint me a set time, and remember me!

verses.raw: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.
verses.text: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.

verses.raw: You shall call, and I will answer you: you will have a desire to the work of your hands.
verses.text: You shall call, and I will answer you: you will have a desire to the work of your hands.

verses.raw: For now you numberest my steps: do you not watch over my sin?
verses.text: For now you numberest my steps: do you not watch over my sin?

verses.raw: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and you sewest up my iniquity.
verses.text: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and you sewest up my iniquity.

verses.raw: And surely the mountain falling comes to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.
verses.text: And surely the mountain falling comes to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.

verses.raw: The waters wear the stones: you washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and you destroyest the hope of man.
verses.text: The waters wear the stones: you washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and you destroyest the hope of man.

verses.raw: You prevailest for ever against him, and he passes: you changest his countenance, and send him away.
verses.text: You prevailest for ever against him, and he passes: you changest his countenance, and send him away.

verses.raw: His sons come to honour, and he knows it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.
verses.text: His sons come to honour, and he knows it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.

verses.raw: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.
verses.text: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.

verses.raw: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,
verses.text: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

verses.raw: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?
verses.text: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?

verses.raw: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?
verses.text: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?

verses.raw: Yea, you cast off fear, and restrainest prayer before Elohim (God).
verses.text: Yea, you cast off fear, and restrainest prayer before Elohim.

verses.raw: For your mouth utters your iniquity, and you choosest the tongue of the crafty.
verses.text: For your mouth utters your iniquity, and you choosest the tongue of the crafty.

verses.raw: Your own mouth condemneth you, and not I: yea, your own lips testify against you.
verses.text: Your own mouth condemneth you, and not I: yea, your own lips testify against you.

verses.raw: Are you the first man that was born? or were you made before the hills?
verses.text: Are you the first man that was born? or were you made before the hills?

verses.raw: Have you heard the secret of Elohim (God)? and do you restrain wisdom to thyself?
verses.text: Have you heard the secret of Elohim? and do you restrain wisdom to thyself?

verses.raw: What know you, that we know not? what understand you, which is not in us?
verses.text: What know you, that we know not? what understand you, which is not in us?

verses.raw: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than your father.
verses.text: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than your father.

verses.raw: Are the consolations of Elohim (God) small with you? is there any secret thing with you?
verses.text: Are the consolations of Elohim small with you? is there any secret thing with you?

verses.raw: Why does your heart carry you away? and what do your eyes wink at,
verses.text: Why does your heart carry you away? and what do your eyes wink at,

verses.raw: That you turn your spirit against Elohim (God), and lettest such words go out of your mouth?
verses.text: That you turn your spirit against Elohim, and lettest such words go out of your mouth?

verses.raw: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
verses.text: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

verses.raw: Behold, he puts no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.
verses.text: Behold, he puts no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.

verses.raw: How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinks iniquity like water?
verses.text: How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinks iniquity like water?

verses.raw: I will shew you, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;
verses.text: I will shew you, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;

verses.raw: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:
verses.text: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:

verses.raw: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.
verses.text: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.

verses.raw: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.
verses.text: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.

verses.raw: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.
verses.text: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.

verses.raw: He believes not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.
verses.text: He believes not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.

verses.raw: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
verses.text: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

verses.raw: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
verses.text: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

verses.raw: For he stretcheth out his hand against Elohim (God), and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.
verses.text: For he stretcheth out his hand against Elohim, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.

verses.raw: He runs upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:
verses.text: He runs upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:

verses.raw: Because he covers his face with his fatness, and makes collops of fat on his flanks.
verses.text: Because he covers his face with his fatness, and makes collops of fat on his flanks.

verses.raw: And he dwells in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.
verses.text: And he dwells in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.

verses.raw: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.
verses.text: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.

verses.raw: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.
verses.text: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.

verses.raw: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.
verses.text: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.

verses.raw: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.
verses.text: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.

verses.raw: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.
verses.text: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.

verses.raw: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.
verses.text: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.

verses.raw: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.
verses.text: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.

verses.raw: Then Job answered and said,
verses.text: Then Job answered and said,

verses.raw: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are you all.
verses.text: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are you all.

verses.raw: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth you that you answerest?
verses.text: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth you that you answerest?

verses.raw: I also could speak as you do: if your soul were in my soul’s stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake my head at you.
verses.text: I also could speak as you do: if your soul were in my soul’s stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake my head at you.

verses.raw: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.
verses.text: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.

verses.raw: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?
verses.text: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?

verses.raw: But now he has made me weary: you have made desolate all my company.
verses.text: But now he has made me weary: you have made desolate all my company.

verses.raw: And you have filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me bears witness to my face.
verses.text: And you have filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me bears witness to my face.

verses.raw: He tears me in his wrath, who hates me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; my enemy sharpens his eyes upon me.
verses.text: He tears me in his wrath, who hates me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; my enemy sharpens his eyes upon me.

verses.raw: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.
verses.text: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) has delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.
verses.text: Elohim has delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.

verses.raw: I was at ease, but he has broken me asunder: he has also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.
verses.text: I was at ease, but he has broken me asunder: he has also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.

verses.raw: His archers compass me round about, he cleaves my reins asunder, and does not spare; he pours out my gall upon the ground.
verses.text: His archers compass me round about, he cleaves my reins asunder, and does not spare; he pours out my gall upon the ground.

verses.raw: He breaks me with breach upon breach, he runs upon me like a giant.
verses.text: He breaks me with breach upon breach, he runs upon me like a giant.

verses.raw: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.
verses.text: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.

verses.raw: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;
verses.text: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;

verses.raw: Not for any injustice in my hands: also my prayer is pure.
verses.text: Not for any injustice in my hands: also my prayer is pure.

verses.raw: O earth, cover not you my blood, and let my cry have no place.
verses.text: O earth, cover not you my blood, and let my cry have no place.

verses.raw: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.
verses.text: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.

verses.raw: My friends scorn me: but my eye pours out tears unto Elohim (God).
verses.text: My friends scorn me: but my eye pours out tears unto Elohim.

verses.raw: O that one might plead for a man with Elohim (God), as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!
verses.text: O that one might plead for a man with Elohim, as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!

verses.raw: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.
verses.text: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.

verses.raw: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.
verses.text: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.

verses.raw: Are there not mockers with me? and does not my eye continue in their provocation?
verses.text: Are there not mockers with me? and does not my eye continue in their provocation?

verses.raw: Lay down now, put me in a surety with you; who is he that will strike hands with me?
verses.text: Lay down now, put me in a surety with you; who is he that will strike hands with me?

verses.raw: For you have hid their heart from understanding: therefore shall you not exalt them.
verses.text: For you have hid their heart from understanding: therefore shall you not exalt them.

verses.raw: He that speaks flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.
verses.text: He that speaks flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.

verses.raw: He has made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.
verses.text: He has made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.

verses.raw: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.
verses.text: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.

verses.raw: Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.
verses.text: Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.

verses.raw: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that has clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.
verses.text: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that has clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.

verses.raw: But as for you all, do you return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.
verses.text: But as for you all, do you return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.

verses.raw: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.
verses.text: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.

verses.raw: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.
verses.text: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.

verses.raw: If I wait, the grave is my house: I have made my bed in the darkness.
verses.text: If I wait, the grave is my house: I have made my bed in the darkness.

verses.raw: I have said to corruption, You are my father: to the worm, You are my mother, and my sister.
verses.text: I have said to corruption, You are my father: to the worm, You are my mother, and my sister.

verses.raw: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?
verses.text: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?

verses.raw: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.
verses.text: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.

verses.raw: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.text: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

verses.raw: How long will it be ere you make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.
verses.text: How long will it be ere you make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.

verses.raw: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?
verses.text: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?

verses.raw: He tears himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for you? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?
verses.text: He tears himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for you? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?

verses.raw: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.
verses.text: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.

verses.raw: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.
verses.text: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.

verses.raw: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.
verses.text: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.

verses.raw: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walks upon a snare.
verses.text: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walks upon a snare.

verses.raw: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.
verses.text: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.

verses.raw: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.
verses.text: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.

verses.raw: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.
verses.text: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.

verses.raw: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.
verses.text: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.

verses.raw: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.
verses.text: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.

verses.raw: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.
verses.text: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.

verses.raw: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
verses.text: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.

verses.raw: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.
verses.text: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.

verses.raw: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.
verses.text: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.

verses.raw: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
verses.text: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

verses.raw: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.
verses.text: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.

verses.raw: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.
verses.text: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.

verses.raw: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knows not Elohim (God).
verses.text: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knows not Elohim.

verses.raw: Then Job answered and said,
verses.text: Then Job answered and said,

verses.raw: How long will you vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?
verses.text: How long will you vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?

verses.raw: These ten times have you reproached me: you are not ashamed that you make yourselves strange to me.
verses.text: These ten times have you reproached me: you are not ashamed that you make yourselves strange to me.

verses.raw: And be it indeed that I have erred, my error remains with myself.
verses.text: And be it indeed that I have erred, my error remains with myself.

verses.raw: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:
verses.text: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:

verses.raw: Know now that Elohim (God) has overthrown me, and has compassed me with his net.
verses.text: Know now that Elohim has overthrown me, and has compassed me with his net.

verses.raw: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.
verses.text: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.

verses.raw: He has fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he has set darkness in my paths.
verses.text: He has fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he has set darkness in my paths.

verses.raw: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
verses.text: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

verses.raw: He has destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and my hope has he removed like a tree.
verses.text: He has destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and my hope has he removed like a tree.

verses.raw: He has also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.
verses.text: He has also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.

verses.raw: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.
verses.text: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.

verses.raw: He has put my brethren far from me, and my acquaintance are verily estranged from me.
verses.text: He has put my brethren far from me, and my acquaintance are verily estranged from me.

verses.raw: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.
verses.text: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.

verses.raw: They that dwell in my house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.
verses.text: They that dwell in my house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.

verses.raw: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.
verses.text: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.

verses.raw: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children’s sake of my own body.
verses.text: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children’s sake of my own body.

verses.raw: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.
verses.text: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.

verses.raw: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.
verses.text: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.

verses.raw: My bone cleaves to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.
verses.text: My bone cleaves to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.

verses.raw: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O you my friends; for the hand of Elohim (God) has touched me.
verses.text: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O you my friends; for the hand of Elohim has touched me.

verses.raw: Why do you persecute me as Elohim (God), and are not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.text: Why do you persecute me as Elohim, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

verses.raw: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!
verses.text: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!

verses.raw: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!
verses.text: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!

verses.raw: For I know that my redeemer lives, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
verses.text: For I know that my redeemer lives, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

verses.raw: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see Elohim (God):
verses.text: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see Elohim:

verses.raw: Whom I shall see for myself, and my eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.
verses.text: Whom I shall see for myself, and my eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.

verses.raw: But you should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?
verses.text: But you should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?

verses.raw: Be you afraid of the sword: for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.
verses.text: Be you afraid of the sword: for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.

verses.raw: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
verses.text: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

verses.raw: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.
verses.text: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.

verses.raw: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causes me to answer.
verses.text: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causes me to answer.

verses.raw: Know you not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,
verses.text: Know you not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,

verses.raw: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?
verses.text: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?

verses.raw: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;
verses.text: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;

verses.raw: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?
verses.text: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?

verses.raw: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
verses.text: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.

verses.raw: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.
verses.text: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.

verses.raw: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.
verses.text: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.

verses.raw: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
verses.text: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.

verses.raw: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;
verses.text: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;

verses.raw: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:
verses.text: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:

verses.raw: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.
verses.text: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.

verses.raw: He has swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: Elohim (God) shall cast them out of his belly.
verses.text: He has swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: Elohim shall cast them out of his belly.

verses.raw: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper’s tongue shall slay him.
verses.text: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper’s tongue shall slay him.

verses.raw: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.
verses.text: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.

verses.raw: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.
verses.text: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.

verses.raw: Because he has oppressed and has forsaken the poor; because he has violently taken away an house which he builded not;
verses.text: Because he has oppressed and has forsaken the poor; because he has violently taken away an house which he builded not;

verses.raw: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.
verses.text: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.

verses.raw: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.
verses.text: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.

verses.raw: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.
verses.text: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.

verses.raw: When he is about to fill his belly, Elohim (God) shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.
verses.text: When he is about to fill his belly, Elohim shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.

verses.raw: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.
verses.text: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.

verses.raw: It is drawn, and comes out of the body; yea, the glittering sword comes out of his gall: terrors are upon him.
verses.text: It is drawn, and comes out of the body; yea, the glittering sword comes out of his gall: terrors are upon him.

verses.raw: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.
verses.text: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.

verses.raw: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.
verses.text: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.

verses.raw: The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
verses.text: The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.

verses.raw: This is the portion of a wicked man from Elohim (God), and the heritage appointed unto him by Elohim (God).
verses.text: This is the portion of a wicked man from Elohim, and the heritage appointed unto him by Elohim.

verses.raw: But Job answered and said,
verses.text: But Job answered and said,

verses.raw: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.
verses.text: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.

verses.raw: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.
verses.text: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.

verses.raw: As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?
verses.text: As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?

verses.raw: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.
verses.text: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.

verses.raw: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling takes hold on my flesh.
verses.text: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling takes hold on my flesh.

verses.raw: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?
verses.text: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?

verses.raw: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.
verses.text: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.

verses.raw: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of Elohim (God) upon them.
verses.text: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of Elohim upon them.

verses.raw: Their bull gendereth, and fails not; their cow calveth, and casts not her calf.
verses.text: Their bull gendereth, and fails not; their cow calveth, and casts not her calf.

verses.raw: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.
verses.text: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.

verses.raw: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.
verses.text: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.

verses.raw: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.
verses.text: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.

verses.raw: Therefore they say unto Elohim (God), Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of your ways.
verses.text: Therefore they say unto Elohim, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of your ways.

verses.raw: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?
verses.text: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?

verses.raw: Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.text: Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

verses.raw: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft comes their destruction upon them! Elohim (God) distributeth sorrows in his anger.
verses.text: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft comes their destruction upon them! Elohim distributeth sorrows in his anger.

verses.raw: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.
verses.text: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) lays up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know it.
verses.text: Elohim lays up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know it.

verses.raw: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
verses.text: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

verses.raw: For what pleasure has he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?
verses.text: For what pleasure has he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?

verses.raw: Shall any teach Elohim (God) knowledge? seeing he judges those that are high.
verses.text: Shall any teach Elohim knowledge? seeing he judges those that are high.

verses.raw: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
verses.text: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

verses.raw: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.
verses.text: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.

verses.raw: And another dies in the bitterness of his soul, and never eats with pleasure.
verses.text: And another dies in the bitterness of his soul, and never eats with pleasure.

verses.raw: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.
verses.text: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.

verses.raw: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which you wrongfully imagine against me.
verses.text: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which you wrongfully imagine against me.

verses.raw: For you say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked?
verses.text: For you say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked?

verses.raw: Have you not asked them that go by the way? and do you not know their tokens,
verses.text: Have you not asked them that go by the way? and do you not know their tokens,

verses.raw: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.
verses.text: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.

verses.raw: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he has done?
verses.text: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he has done?

verses.raw: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.
verses.text: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.

verses.raw: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.
verses.text: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.

verses.raw: How then comfort you me in vain, seeing in your answers there remains falsehood?
verses.text: How then comfort you me in vain, seeing in your answers there remains falsehood?

verses.raw: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
verses.text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

verses.raw: Can a man be profitable unto Elohim (God), as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?
verses.text: Can a man be profitable unto Elohim, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?

verses.raw: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that you are righteous? or is it gain to him, that you make your ways perfect?
verses.text: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that you are righteous? or is it gain to him, that you make your ways perfect?

verses.raw: Will he reprove you for fear of you? will he enter with you into judgment?
verses.text: Will he reprove you for fear of you? will he enter with you into judgment?

verses.raw: Is not your wickedness great? and your iniquities infinite?
verses.text: Is not your wickedness great? and your iniquities infinite?

verses.raw: For you have taken a pledge from your brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
verses.text: For you have taken a pledge from your brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

verses.raw: You have not given water to the weary to drink, and you have withholden bread from the hungry.
verses.text: You have not given water to the weary to drink, and you have withholden bread from the hungry.

verses.raw: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.
verses.text: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.

verses.raw: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
verses.text: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

verses.raw: Therefore snares are round about you, and sudden fear troubles you;
verses.text: Therefore snares are round about you, and sudden fear troubles you;

verses.raw: Or darkness, that you can not see; and abundance of waters cover you.
verses.text: Or darkness, that you can not see; and abundance of waters cover you.

verses.raw: Is not Elohim (God) in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!
verses.text: Is not Elohim in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!

verses.raw: And you say, How does Elohim (God) know? can he judge through the dark cloud?
verses.text: And you say, How does Elohim know? can he judge through the dark cloud?

verses.raw: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he sees not; and he walks in the circuit of heaven.
verses.text: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he sees not; and he walks in the circuit of heaven.

verses.raw: Have you marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?
verses.text: Have you marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?

verses.raw: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:
verses.text: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:

verses.raw: Which said unto Elohim (God), Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?
verses.text: Which said unto Elohim, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?

verses.raw: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.text: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

verses.raw: The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.
verses.text: The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.

verses.raw: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumes.
verses.text: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumes.

verses.raw: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto you.
verses.text: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto you.

verses.raw: Receive, I pray you, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.
verses.text: Receive, I pray you, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

verses.raw: If you return to the Almighty, you shall be built up, you shall put away iniquity far from your tabernacles.
verses.text: If you return to the Almighty, you shall be built up, you shall put away iniquity far from your tabernacles.

verses.raw: Then shall you lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.
verses.text: Then shall you lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.

verses.raw: Yea, the Almighty shall be your defence, and you shall have plenty of silver.
verses.text: Yea, the Almighty shall be your defence, and you shall have plenty of silver.

verses.raw: For then shall you have your delight in the Almighty, and shall lift up your face unto Elohim (God).
verses.text: For then shall you have your delight in the Almighty, and shall lift up your face unto Elohim.

verses.raw: You shall make your prayer unto him, and he shall hear you, and you shall pay your vows.
verses.text: You shall make your prayer unto him, and he shall hear you, and you shall pay your vows.

verses.raw: You shall also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto you: and the light shall shine upon your ways.
verses.text: You shall also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto you: and the light shall shine upon your ways.

verses.raw: When men are cast down, then you shall say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.
verses.text: When men are cast down, then you shall say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.

verses.raw: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of your hands.
verses.text: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of your hands.

verses.raw: Then Job answered and said,
verses.text: Then Job answered and said,

verses.raw: Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.
verses.text: Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.

verses.raw: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!
verses.text: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!

verses.raw: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
verses.text: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

verses.raw: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.
verses.text: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.

verses.raw: Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.
verses.text: Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.

verses.raw: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.
verses.text: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.

verses.raw: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:
verses.text: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:

verses.raw: On the left hand, where he does work, but I cannot behold him: he hides himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:
verses.text: On the left hand, where he does work, but I cannot behold him: he hides himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:

verses.raw: But he knows the way that I take: when he has tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
verses.text: But he knows the way that I take: when he has tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

verses.raw: My foot has held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.
verses.text: My foot has held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.

verses.raw: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
verses.text: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

verses.raw: But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? and what his soul desires, even that he does.
verses.text: But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? and what his soul desires, even that he does.

verses.raw: For he performs the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.
verses.text: For he performs the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.

verses.raw: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.
verses.text: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) makes my heart soft, and the Almighty troubles me:
verses.text: For Elohim makes my heart soft, and the Almighty troubles me:

verses.raw: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither has he covered the darkness from my face.
verses.text: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither has he covered the darkness from my face.

verses.raw: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?
verses.text: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?

verses.raw: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.
verses.text: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.

verses.raw: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.
verses.text: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.

verses.raw: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.
verses.text: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.

verses.raw: Behold, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.
verses.text: Behold, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.

verses.raw: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.
verses.text: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.

verses.raw: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no covering in the cold.
verses.text: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no covering in the cold.

verses.raw: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.
verses.text: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.

verses.raw: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.
verses.text: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.

verses.raw: They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;
verses.text: They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;

verses.raw: Which make oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.
verses.text: Which make oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.

verses.raw: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded cries out: yet Elohim (God) lays not folly to them.
verses.text: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded cries out: yet Elohim lays not folly to them.

verses.raw: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.
verses.text: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.

verses.raw: The murderer rising with the light kills the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.
verses.text: The murderer rising with the light kills the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.

verses.raw: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.
verses.text: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.

verses.raw: In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.
verses.text: In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.

verses.raw: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.
verses.text: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.

verses.raw: He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholds not the way of the vineyards.
verses.text: He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholds not the way of the vineyards.

verses.raw: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so does the grave those which have sinned.
verses.text: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so does the grave those which have sinned.

verses.raw: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.
verses.text: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.

verses.raw: He evil entreateth the barren that bears not: and does not good to the widow.
verses.text: He evil entreateth the barren that bears not: and does not good to the widow.

verses.raw: He draws also the mighty with his power: he rises up, and no man is sure of life.
verses.text: He draws also the mighty with his power: he rises up, and no man is sure of life.

verses.raw: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.
verses.text: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.

verses.raw: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.
verses.text: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.

verses.raw: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?
verses.text: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?

verses.raw: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.text: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

verses.raw: Dominion and fear are with him, he makes peace in his high places.
verses.text: Dominion and fear are with him, he makes peace in his high places.

verses.raw: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom does not his light arise?
verses.text: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom does not his light arise?

verses.raw: How then can man be justified with Elohim (God)? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?
verses.text: How then can man be justified with Elohim? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?

verses.raw: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.
verses.text: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.

verses.raw: How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of Adam, which is a worm?
verses.text: How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of Adam, which is a worm?

verses.raw: But Job answered and said,
verses.text: But Job answered and said,

verses.raw: How have you helped him that is without power? how savest you the arm that has no strength?
verses.text: How have you helped him that is without power? how savest you the arm that has no strength?

verses.raw: How have you counselled him that has no wisdom? and how have you plentifully declared the thing as it is?
verses.text: How have you counselled him that has no wisdom? and how have you plentifully declared the thing as it is?

verses.raw: To whom have you uttered words? and whose spirit came from you?
verses.text: To whom have you uttered words? and whose spirit came from you?

verses.raw: Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.text: Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.

verses.raw: Hell is naked before him, and destruction has no covering.
verses.text: Hell is naked before him, and destruction has no covering.

verses.raw: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.
verses.text: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.

verses.raw: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.
verses.text: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.

verses.raw: He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud upon it.
verses.text: He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud upon it.

verses.raw: He has compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.
verses.text: He has compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.

verses.raw: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.
verses.text: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.

verses.raw: He divides the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smites through the proud.
verses.text: He divides the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smites through the proud.

verses.raw: By his spirit he has garnished the heavens; his hand has formed the crooked serpent.
verses.text: By his spirit he has garnished the heavens; his hand has formed the crooked serpent.

verses.raw: Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?
verses.text: Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?

verses.raw: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
verses.text: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
