verses.raw: As Elohim (God) lives, who has taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, who has vexed my soul;
verses.text: As Elohim lives, who has taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, who has vexed my soul;

verses.raw: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of Elohim (God) is in my nostrils;
verses.text: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of Elohim is in my nostrils;

verses.raw: My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.
verses.text: My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove my integrity from me.
verses.text: Elohim forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove my integrity from me.

verses.raw: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.
verses.text: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.

verses.raw: Let my enemy be as the wicked, and he that rises up against me as the unrighteous.
verses.text: Let my enemy be as the wicked, and he that rises up against me as the unrighteous.

verses.raw: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he has gained, when Elohim (God) takes away his soul?
verses.text: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he has gained, when Elohim takes away his soul?

verses.raw: Will Elohim (God) hear his cry when trouble comes upon him?
verses.text: Will Elohim hear his cry when trouble comes upon him?

verses.raw: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon Elohim (God)?
verses.text: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon Elohim?

verses.raw: I will teach you by the hand of Elohim (God): that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
verses.text: I will teach you by the hand of Elohim: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

verses.raw: Behold, all you yourselves have seen it; why then are you thus altogether vain?
verses.text: Behold, all you yourselves have seen it; why then are you thus altogether vain?

verses.raw: This is the portion of a wicked man with Elohim (God), and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.
verses.text: This is the portion of a wicked man with Elohim, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.

verses.raw: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
verses.text: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

verses.raw: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.
verses.text: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.

verses.raw: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;
verses.text: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;

verses.raw: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.
verses.text: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.

verses.raw: He builds his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper makes.
verses.text: He builds his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper makes.

verses.raw: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he opens his eyes, and he is not.
verses.text: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he opens his eyes, and he is not.

verses.raw: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.
verses.text: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.

verses.raw: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departs: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.
verses.text: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departs: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.
verses.text: For Elohim shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.

verses.raw: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
verses.text: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.

verses.raw: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.
verses.text: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.

verses.raw: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.
verses.text: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.

verses.raw: He sets an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.
verses.text: He sets an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.

verses.raw: The flood breaks out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.
verses.text: The flood breaks out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.

verses.raw: As for the earth, out of it comes bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.
verses.text: As for the earth, out of it comes bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.

verses.raw: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it has dust of gold.
verses.text: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it has dust of gold.

verses.raw: There is a path which no fowl knows, and which the vulture’s eye has not seen:
verses.text: There is a path which no fowl knows, and which the vulture’s eye has not seen:

verses.raw: The lion’s whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.
verses.text: The lion’s whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.

verses.raw: He puts forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.
verses.text: He puts forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.

verses.raw: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye sees every precious thing.
verses.text: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye sees every precious thing.

verses.raw: He binds the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid brings he forth to light.
verses.text: He binds the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid brings he forth to light.

verses.raw: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?
verses.text: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?

verses.raw: Man knows not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.
verses.text: Man knows not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.

verses.raw: The depth says, It is not in me: and the sea says, It is not with me.
verses.text: The depth says, It is not in me: and the sea says, It is not with me.

verses.raw: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.
verses.text: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.

verses.raw: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
verses.text: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

verses.raw: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.
verses.text: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.

verses.raw: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.
verses.text: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.

verses.raw: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
verses.text: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

verses.raw: Whence then comes wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?
verses.text: Whence then comes wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?

verses.raw: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.
verses.text: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.

verses.raw: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.
verses.text: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) understands the way thereof, and he knows the place thereof.
verses.text: Elohim understands the way thereof, and he knows the place thereof.

verses.raw: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole heaven;
verses.text: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole heaven;

verses.raw: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.
verses.text: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.

verses.raw: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:
verses.text: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:

verses.raw: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.
verses.text: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.

verses.raw: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of Adonai (Lord), that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.
verses.text: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of Adonai, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.

verses.raw: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
verses.text: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,

verses.raw: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when Elohim (God) preserved me;
verses.text: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when Elohim preserved me;

verses.raw: When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;
verses.text: When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;

verses.raw: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of Elohim (God) was upon my tabernacle;
verses.text: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of Elohim was upon my tabernacle;

verses.raw: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;
verses.text: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;

verses.raw: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;
verses.text: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;

verses.raw: When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!
verses.text: When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!

verses.raw: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.
verses.text: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.

verses.raw: The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
verses.text: The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

verses.raw: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.
verses.text: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.

verses.raw: When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me:
verses.text: When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me:

verses.raw: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.
verses.text: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.

verses.raw: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
verses.text: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

verses.raw: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.
verses.text: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.

verses.raw: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.
verses.text: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.

verses.raw: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.
verses.text: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.

verses.raw: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.
verses.text: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.

verses.raw: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.
verses.text: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.

verses.raw: My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.
verses.text: My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.

verses.raw: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.
verses.text: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.

verses.raw: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.
verses.text: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.

verses.raw: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.
verses.text: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.

verses.raw: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.
verses.text: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.

verses.raw: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.
verses.text: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.

verses.raw: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.
verses.text: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.

verses.raw: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.
verses.text: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.

verses.raw: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?
verses.text: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?

verses.raw: For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.
verses.text: For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.

verses.raw: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.
verses.text: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.

verses.raw: They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;)
verses.text: They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;)

verses.raw: To dwell in the clifts of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.
verses.text: To dwell in the clifts of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.

verses.raw: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.
verses.text: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.

verses.raw: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.
verses.text: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.

verses.raw: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.
verses.text: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.

verses.raw: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.
verses.text: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.

verses.raw: Because he has loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.
verses.text: Because he has loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.

verses.raw: Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.
verses.text: Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.

verses.raw: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.
verses.text: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.

verses.raw: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me.
verses.text: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me.

verses.raw: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passes away as a cloud.
verses.text: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passes away as a cloud.

verses.raw: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
verses.text: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.

verses.raw: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.
verses.text: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.

verses.raw: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it binds me about as the collar of my coat.
verses.text: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it binds me about as the collar of my coat.

verses.raw: He has cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.
verses.text: He has cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.

verses.raw: I cry unto you, and you do not hear me: I stand up, and you regard me not.
verses.text: I cry unto you, and you do not hear me: I stand up, and you regard me not.

verses.raw: You are become cruel to me: with your strong hand you opposest thyself against me.
verses.text: You are become cruel to me: with your strong hand you opposest thyself against me.

verses.raw: You liftest me up to the wind; you cause me to ride upon it, and dissolvest my substance.
verses.text: You liftest me up to the wind; you cause me to ride upon it, and dissolvest my substance.

verses.raw: For I know that you will bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.
verses.text: For I know that you will bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.

verses.raw: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.
verses.text: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.

verses.raw: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul grieved for the poor?
verses.text: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul grieved for the poor?

verses.raw: When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.
verses.text: When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.

verses.raw: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.
verses.text: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.

verses.raw: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.
verses.text: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.

verses.raw: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.
verses.text: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.

verses.raw: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.
verses.text: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.

verses.raw: My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.
verses.text: My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.

verses.raw: I made a covenant with my eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
verses.text: I made a covenant with my eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?

verses.raw: For what portion of Elohim (God) is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
verses.text: For what portion of Elohim is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?

verses.raw: Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?
verses.text: Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?

verses.raw: Does not he see my ways, and count all my steps?
verses.text: Does not he see my ways, and count all my steps?

verses.raw: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot has hasted to deceit;
verses.text: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot has hasted to deceit;

verses.raw: Let me be weighed in an even balance, that Elohim (God) may know my integrity.
verses.text: Let me be weighed in an even balance, that Elohim may know my integrity.

verses.raw: If my step has turned out of the way, and my heart walked after my eyes, and if any blot has cleaved to my hands;
verses.text: If my step has turned out of the way, and my heart walked after my eyes, and if any blot has cleaved to my hands;

verses.raw: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
verses.text: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.

verses.raw: If my heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour’s door;
verses.text: If my heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour’s door;

verses.raw: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.
verses.text: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.

verses.raw: For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.
verses.text: For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.

verses.raw: For it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.
verses.text: For it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.

verses.raw: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;
verses.text: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;

verses.raw: What then shall I do when Elohim (God) rises up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?
verses.text: What then shall I do when Elohim rises up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?

verses.raw: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?
verses.text: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?

verses.raw: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;
verses.text: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;

verses.raw: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless has not eaten thereof;
verses.text: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless has not eaten thereof;

verses.raw: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother’s womb;)
verses.text: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother’s womb;)

verses.raw: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;
verses.text: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;

verses.raw: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
verses.text: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;

verses.raw: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:
verses.text: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:

verses.raw: Then let my arm fall from my shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.
verses.text: Then let my arm fall from my shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.

verses.raw: For destruction from Elohim (God) was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.
verses.text: For destruction from Elohim was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.

verses.raw: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, You are my confidence;
verses.text: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, You are my confidence;

verses.raw: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;
verses.text: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;

verses.raw: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;
verses.text: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;

verses.raw: And my heart has been secretly enticed, or my mouth has kissed my hand:
verses.text: And my heart has been secretly enticed, or my mouth has kissed my hand:

verses.raw: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the Elohim (God) that is above.
verses.text: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the Elohim that is above.

verses.raw: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:
verses.text: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:

verses.raw: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.
verses.text: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.

verses.raw: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.
verses.text: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.

verses.raw: The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.
verses.text: The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.

verses.raw: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding my iniquity in my bosom:
verses.text: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding my iniquity in my bosom:

verses.raw: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?
verses.text: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?

verses.raw: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that my adversary had written a book.
verses.text: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that my adversary had written a book.

verses.raw: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to me.
verses.text: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to me.

verses.raw: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.
verses.text: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.

verses.raw: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;
verses.text: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;

verses.raw: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:
verses.text: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:

verses.raw: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.
verses.text: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.

verses.raw: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
verses.text: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

verses.raw: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than Elohim (God).
verses.text: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than Elohim.

verses.raw: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
verses.text: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

verses.raw: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.
verses.text: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.

verses.raw: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.
verses.text: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.

verses.raw: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and you are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you my opinion.
verses.text: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and you are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you my opinion.

verses.raw: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.
verses.text: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.

verses.raw: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty gives them understanding.
verses.text: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty gives them understanding.

verses.raw: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.
verses.text: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.

verses.raw: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew my opinion.
verses.text: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew my opinion.

verses.raw: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst you searched out what to say.
verses.text: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst you searched out what to say.

verses.raw: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:
verses.text: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:

verses.raw: Lest you should say, We have found out wisdom: Elohim (God) thrusteth him down, not man.
verses.text: Lest you should say, We have found out wisdom: Elohim thrusteth him down, not man.

verses.raw: Now he has not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.
verses.text: Now he has not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.

verses.raw: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.
verses.text: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.

verses.raw: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)
verses.text: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)

verses.raw: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew my opinion.
verses.text: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew my opinion.

verses.raw: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.
verses.text: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.

verses.raw: Behold, my belly is as wine which has no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.
verses.text: Behold, my belly is as wine which has no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.

verses.raw: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.
verses.text: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.

verses.raw: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man’s person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.
verses.text: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man’s person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.

verses.raw: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.
verses.text: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.

verses.raw: Wherefore, Job, I pray you, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.
verses.text: Wherefore, Job, I pray you, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.

verses.raw: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue has spoken in my mouth.
verses.text: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue has spoken in my mouth.

verses.raw: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.
verses.text: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.

verses.raw: The Spirit of Elohim (God) has made me, and the breath of the Almighty has given me life.
verses.text: The Spirit of Elohim has made me, and the breath of the Almighty has given me life.

verses.raw: If you can answer me, set your words in order before me, stand up.
verses.text: If you can answer me, set your words in order before me, stand up.

verses.raw: Behold, I am according to your wish in Elohim's (God’s) stead: I also am formed out of the clay.
verses.text: Behold, I am according to your wish in Elohim's (God’s) stead: I also am formed out of the clay.

verses.raw: Behold, my terror shall not make you afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon you.
verses.text: Behold, my terror shall not make you afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon you.

verses.raw: Surely you have spoken in my hearing, and I have heard the voice of your words, saying,
verses.text: Surely you have spoken in my hearing, and I have heard the voice of your words, saying,

verses.raw: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.
verses.text: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.

verses.raw: Behold, he finds occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,
verses.text: Behold, he finds occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,

verses.raw: He puts my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.
verses.text: He puts my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.

verses.raw: Behold, in this you are not just: I will answer you, that Elohim (God) is greater than man.
verses.text: Behold, in this you are not just: I will answer you, that Elohim is greater than man.

verses.raw: Why do you strive against him? for he gives not account of any of his matters.
verses.text: Why do you strive against him? for he gives not account of any of his matters.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) speaks once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.
verses.text: For Elohim speaks once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.

verses.raw: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;
verses.text: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;

verses.raw: Then he opens the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,
verses.text: Then he opens the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,

verses.raw: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
verses.text: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

verses.raw: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
verses.text: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

verses.raw: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:
verses.text: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:

verses.raw: So that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty meat.
verses.text: So that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty meat.

verses.raw: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.
verses.text: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.

verses.raw: Yea, his soul draws near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.
verses.text: Yea, his soul draws near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.

verses.raw: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:
verses.text: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:

verses.raw: Then he is gracious unto him, and says, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.
verses.text: Then he is gracious unto him, and says, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.

verses.raw: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s: he shall return to the days of his youth:
verses.text: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s: he shall return to the days of his youth:

verses.raw: He shall pray unto Elohim (God), and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.
verses.text: He shall pray unto Elohim, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.

verses.raw: He looks upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;
verses.text: He looks upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;

verses.raw: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.
verses.text: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.

verses.raw: Lo, all these things works Elohim (God) oftentimes with man,
verses.text: Lo, all these things works Elohim oftentimes with man,

verses.raw: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.
verses.text: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.

verses.raw: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold your peace, and I will speak.
verses.text: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold your peace, and I will speak.

verses.raw: If you have any thing to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify you.
verses.text: If you have any thing to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify you.

verses.raw: If not, hearken unto me: hold your peace, and I shall teach you wisdom.
verses.text: If not, hearken unto me: hold your peace, and I shall teach you wisdom.

verses.raw: Furthermore Elihu answered and said,
verses.text: Furthermore Elihu answered and said,

verses.raw: Hear my words, O you wise men; and give ear unto me, you that have knowledge.
verses.text: Hear my words, O you wise men; and give ear unto me, you that have knowledge.

verses.raw: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.
verses.text: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.

verses.raw: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good.
verses.text: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good.

verses.raw: For Job has said, I am righteous: and Elohim (God) has taken away my judgment.
verses.text: For Job has said, I am righteous: and Elohim has taken away my judgment.

verses.raw: Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.
verses.text: Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.

verses.raw: What man is like Job, who drinks up scorning like water?
verses.text: What man is like Job, who drinks up scorning like water?

verses.raw: Which goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men.
verses.text: Which goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men.

verses.raw: For he has said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with Elohim (God).
verses.text: For he has said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with Elohim.

verses.raw: Therefore hearken unto me, you men of understanding: far be it from Elohim (God), that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
verses.text: Therefore hearken unto me, you men of understanding: far be it from Elohim, that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

verses.raw: For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
verses.text: For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

verses.raw: Yea, surely Elohim (God) will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.
verses.text: Yea, surely Elohim will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.

verses.raw: Who has given him a charge over the earth? or who has disposed the whole world?
verses.text: Who has given him a charge over the earth? or who has disposed the whole world?

verses.raw: If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;
verses.text: If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;

verses.raw: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.
verses.text: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.

verses.raw: If now you have understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.
verses.text: If now you have understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.

verses.raw: Shall even he that hates right govern? and will you condemn him that is most just?
verses.text: Shall even he that hates right govern? and will you condemn him that is most just?

verses.raw: Is it fit to say to a king, You are wicked? and to princes, You are ungodly?
verses.text: Is it fit to say to a king, You are wicked? and to princes, You are ungodly?

verses.raw: How much less to him that accepts not the persons of princes, nor regards the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.
verses.text: How much less to him that accepts not the persons of princes, nor regards the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.

verses.raw: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.
verses.text: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.

verses.raw: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, and he sees all his goings.
verses.text: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, and he sees all his goings.

verses.raw: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
verses.text: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

verses.raw: For he will not lay upon man more than right; that he should enter into judgment with Elohim (God).
verses.text: For he will not lay upon man more than right; that he should enter into judgment with Elohim.

verses.raw: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their stead.
verses.text: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their stead.

verses.raw: Therefore he knows their works, and he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
verses.text: Therefore he knows their works, and he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

verses.raw: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;
verses.text: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

verses.raw: Because they turned back from him, and would not consider any of his ways:
verses.text: Because they turned back from him, and would not consider any of his ways:

verses.raw: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he hears the cry of the afflicted.
verses.text: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he hears the cry of the afflicted.

verses.raw: When he gives quietness, who then can make trouble? and when he hides his face, who then can behold him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man only:
verses.text: When he gives quietness, who then can make trouble? and when he hides his face, who then can behold him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man only:

verses.raw: That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.
verses.text: That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.

verses.raw: Surely it is meet to be said unto Elohim (God), I have borne chastisement, I will not offend any more:
verses.text: Surely it is meet to be said unto Elohim, I have borne chastisement, I will not offend any more:

verses.raw: That which I see not teach you me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.
verses.text: That which I see not teach you me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.

verses.raw: Should it be according to your mind? he will recompense it, whether you refuse, or whether you choose; and not I: therefore speak what you know.
verses.text: Should it be according to your mind? he will recompense it, whether you refuse, or whether you choose; and not I: therefore speak what you know.

verses.raw: Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me.
verses.text: Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me.

verses.raw: Job has spoken without knowledge, and his words were without wisdom.
verses.text: Job has spoken without knowledge, and his words were without wisdom.

verses.raw: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of his answers for wicked men.
verses.text: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of his answers for wicked men.

verses.raw: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against Elohim (God).
verses.text: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against Elohim.

verses.raw: Elihu spake moreover, and said,
verses.text: Elihu spake moreover, and said,

verses.raw: Thinkest you this to be right, that you saidst, My righteousness is more than Elohim's (God’s)?
verses.text: Thinkest you this to be right, that you saidst, My righteousness is more than Elohim's (God’s)?

verses.raw: For you saidst, What advantage will it be unto you? and, What profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin?
verses.text: For you saidst, What advantage will it be unto you? and, What profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin?

verses.raw: I will answer you, and your companions with you.
verses.text: I will answer you, and your companions with you.

verses.raw: Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds which are higher than you.
verses.text: Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds which are higher than you.

verses.raw: If you sinnest, what do you against him? or if your transgressions be multiplied, what do you unto him?
verses.text: If you sinnest, what do you against him? or if your transgressions be multiplied, what do you unto him?

verses.raw: If you be righteous, what give you him? or what receives he of your hand?
verses.text: If you be righteous, what give you him? or what receives he of your hand?

verses.raw: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are; and your righteousness may profit the son of Adam.
verses.text: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are; and your righteousness may profit the son of Adam.

verses.raw: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.
verses.text: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.

verses.raw: But none says, Where is Elohim (God) my maker, who gives songs in the night;
verses.text: But none says, Where is Elohim my maker, who gives songs in the night;

verses.raw: Who teaches us more than the beasts of the earth, and makes us wiser than the fowls of heaven?
verses.text: Who teaches us more than the beasts of the earth, and makes us wiser than the fowls of heaven?

verses.raw: There they cry, but none gives answer, because of the pride of evil men.
verses.text: There they cry, but none gives answer, because of the pride of evil men.

verses.raw: Surely Elohim (God) will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.
verses.text: Surely Elohim will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.

verses.raw: Although you say you shall not see him, yet judgment is before him; therefore trust you in him.
verses.text: Although you say you shall not see him, yet judgment is before him; therefore trust you in him.

verses.raw: But now, because it is not so, he has visited in his anger; yet he knows it not in great extremity:
verses.text: But now, because it is not so, he has visited in his anger; yet he knows it not in great extremity:

verses.raw: Therefore does Job open his mouth in vain; he multiplieth words without knowledge.
verses.text: Therefore does Job open his mouth in vain; he multiplieth words without knowledge.

verses.raw: Elihu also proceeded, and said,
verses.text: Elihu also proceeded, and said,

verses.raw: Suffer me a little, and I will shew you that I have yet to speak on Elohim's (God’s) behalf.
verses.text: Suffer me a little, and I will shew you that I have yet to speak on Elohim's (God’s) behalf.

verses.raw: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
verses.text: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

verses.raw: For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with you.
verses.text: For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with you.

verses.raw: Behold, Elohim (God) is mighty, and despises not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.
verses.text: Behold, Elohim is mighty, and despises not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.

verses.raw: He preserves not the life of the wicked: but gives right to the poor.
verses.text: He preserves not the life of the wicked: but gives right to the poor.

verses.raw: He withdraws not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he does establish them for ever, and they are exalted.
verses.text: He withdraws not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he does establish them for ever, and they are exalted.

verses.raw: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;
verses.text: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;

verses.raw: Then he shows them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.
verses.text: Then he shows them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.

verses.raw: He opens also their ear to discipline, and commands that they return from iniquity.
verses.text: He opens also their ear to discipline, and commands that they return from iniquity.

verses.raw: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
verses.text: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

verses.raw: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.
verses.text: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.

verses.raw: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he binds them.
verses.text: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he binds them.

verses.raw: They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.
verses.text: They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.

verses.raw: He delivers the poor in his affliction, and opens their ears in oppression.
verses.text: He delivers the poor in his affliction, and opens their ears in oppression.

verses.raw: Even so would he have removed you out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on your table should be full of fatness.
verses.text: Even so would he have removed you out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on your table should be full of fatness.

verses.raw: But you have fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on you.
verses.text: But you have fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on you.

verses.raw: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take you away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver you.
verses.text: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take you away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver you.

verses.raw: Will he esteem your riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.
verses.text: Will he esteem your riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.

verses.raw: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.
verses.text: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.

verses.raw: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this have you chosen rather than affliction.
verses.text: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this have you chosen rather than affliction.

verses.raw: Behold, Elohim (God) exalteth by his power: who teaches like him?
verses.text: Behold, Elohim exalteth by his power: who teaches like him?

verses.raw: Who has enjoined him his way? or who can say, You have wrought iniquity?
verses.text: Who has enjoined him his way? or who can say, You have wrought iniquity?

verses.raw: Remember that you magnify his work, which men behold.
verses.text: Remember that you magnify his work, which men behold.

verses.raw: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.
verses.text: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.

verses.raw: Behold, Elohim (God) is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.
verses.text: Behold, Elohim is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.

verses.raw: For he makes small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:
verses.text: For he makes small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:

verses.raw: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.
verses.text: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.

verses.raw: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?
verses.text: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?

verses.raw: Behold, he spreads his light upon it, and covers the bottom of the sea.
verses.text: Behold, he spreads his light upon it, and covers the bottom of the sea.

verses.raw: For by them judges he the people; he gives meat in abundance.
verses.text: For by them judges he the people; he gives meat in abundance.

verses.raw: With clouds he covers the light; and commands it not to shine by the cloud that comes betwixt.
verses.text: With clouds he covers the light; and commands it not to shine by the cloud that comes betwixt.

verses.raw: The noise thereof shows concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.
verses.text: The noise thereof shows concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.

verses.raw: At this also my heart trembles, and is moved out of his place.
verses.text: At this also my heart trembles, and is moved out of his place.

verses.raw: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound that goes out of his mouth.
verses.text: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound that goes out of his mouth.

verses.raw: He directeth it under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth.
verses.text: He directeth it under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth.

verses.raw: After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard.
verses.text: After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things does he, which we cannot comprehend.
verses.text: Elohim thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things does he, which we cannot comprehend.

verses.raw: For he says to the snow, Be you on the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.
verses.text: For he says to the snow, Be you on the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.

verses.raw: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.
verses.text: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.

verses.raw: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.
verses.text: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.

verses.raw: Out of the south comes the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.
verses.text: Out of the south comes the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.

verses.raw: By the breath of Elohim (God) frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.
verses.text: By the breath of Elohim frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.

verses.raw: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scatters his bright cloud:
verses.text: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scatters his bright cloud:

verses.raw: And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commands them upon the face of the world in the earth.
verses.text: And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commands them upon the face of the world in the earth.

verses.raw: He causes it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy.
verses.text: He causes it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy.

verses.raw: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of Elohim.

verses.raw: Do you know when Elohim (God) disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?
verses.text: Do you know when Elohim disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?

verses.raw: Do you know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?
verses.text: Do you know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?

verses.raw: How your garments are warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south wind?
verses.text: How your garments are warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south wind?

verses.raw: Have you with him spread out the sky, which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?
verses.text: Have you with him spread out the sky, which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?

verses.raw: Teach us what we shall say unto him; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.
verses.text: Teach us what we shall say unto him; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.

verses.raw: Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.
verses.text: Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.

verses.raw: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds: but the wind passes, and cleanses them.
verses.text: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds: but the wind passes, and cleanses them.

verses.raw: Fair weather comes out of the north: with Elohim (God) is terrible majesty.
verses.text: Fair weather comes out of the north: with Elohim is terrible majesty.

verses.raw: Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out: he is excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.
verses.text: Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out: he is excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.

verses.raw: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart.
verses.text: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart.

verses.raw: Then Yahuah (LORD) answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
verses.text: Then Yahuah answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

verses.raw: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?
verses.text: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?

verses.raw: Gird up now your loins like a man; for I will demand of you, and answer you me.
verses.text: Gird up now your loins like a man; for I will demand of you, and answer you me.

verses.raw: Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if you have understanding.
verses.text: Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if you have understanding.

verses.raw: Who has laid the measures thereof, if you know? or who has stretched the line upon it?
verses.text: Who has laid the measures thereof, if you know? or who has stretched the line upon it?

verses.raw: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;
verses.text: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;

verses.raw: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of Elohim (God) shouted for joy?
verses.text: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of Elohim shouted for joy?

verses.raw: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?
verses.text: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?

verses.raw: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,
verses.text: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,

verses.raw: And brake up for it my decreed place, and set bars and doors,
verses.text: And brake up for it my decreed place, and set bars and doors,

verses.raw: And said, Hitherto shall you come, but no further: and here shall your proud waves be stayed?
verses.text: And said, Hitherto shall you come, but no further: and here shall your proud waves be stayed?

verses.raw: Have you commanded the morning since your days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;
verses.text: Have you commanded the morning since your days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;

verses.raw: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?
verses.text: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?

verses.raw: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.
verses.text: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.

verses.raw: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.
verses.text: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.

verses.raw: Have you entered into the springs of the sea? or have you walked in the search of the depth?
verses.text: Have you entered into the springs of the sea? or have you walked in the search of the depth?

verses.raw: Have the gates of death been opened unto you? or have you seen the doors of the shadow of death?
verses.text: Have the gates of death been opened unto you? or have you seen the doors of the shadow of death?

verses.raw: Have you perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if you know it all.
verses.text: Have you perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if you know it all.

verses.raw: Where is the way where light dwells? and as for darkness, where is the place thereof,
verses.text: Where is the way where light dwells? and as for darkness, where is the place thereof,

verses.raw: That you should take it to the bound thereof, and that you should know the paths to the house thereof?
verses.text: That you should take it to the bound thereof, and that you should know the paths to the house thereof?

verses.raw: Know you it, because you were then born? or because the number of your days is great?
verses.text: Know you it, because you were then born? or because the number of your days is great?

verses.raw: Have you entered into the treasures of the snow? or have you seen the treasures of the hail,
verses.text: Have you entered into the treasures of the snow? or have you seen the treasures of the hail,

verses.raw: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
verses.text: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

verses.raw: By what way is the light parted, which scatters the east wind upon the earth?
verses.text: By what way is the light parted, which scatters the east wind upon the earth?

verses.raw: Who has divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;
verses.text: Who has divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;

verses.raw: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;
verses.text: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;

verses.raw: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
verses.text: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?

verses.raw: Has the rain a father? or who has begotten the drops of dew?
verses.text: Has the rain a father? or who has begotten the drops of dew?

verses.raw: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who has gendered it?
verses.text: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who has gendered it?

verses.raw: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.
verses.text: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.

verses.raw: Can you bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?
verses.text: Can you bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?

verses.raw: Can you bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or can you guide Arcturus with his sons?
verses.text: Can you bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or can you guide Arcturus with his sons?

verses.raw: Know you the ordinances of heaven? can you set the dominion thereof in the earth?
verses.text: Know you the ordinances of heaven? can you set the dominion thereof in the earth?

verses.raw: Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?
verses.text: Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?

verses.raw: Can you send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto you, Here we are?
verses.text: Can you send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto you, Here we are?

verses.raw: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? or who has given understanding to the heart?
verses.text: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? or who has given understanding to the heart?

verses.raw: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,
verses.text: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,

verses.raw: When the dust grows into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?
verses.text: When the dust grows into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?

verses.raw: Will you hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,
verses.text: Will you hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,

verses.raw: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?
verses.text: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?

verses.raw: Who provides for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto Elohim (God), they wander for lack of meat.
verses.text: Who provides for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto Elohim, they wander for lack of meat.

verses.raw: Know you the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or can you mark when the hinds do calve?
verses.text: Know you the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or can you mark when the hinds do calve?

verses.raw: Can you number the months that they fulfil? or know you the time when they bring forth?
verses.text: Can you number the months that they fulfil? or know you the time when they bring forth?

verses.raw: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.
verses.text: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.

verses.raw: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.
verses.text: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.

verses.raw: Who has sent out the wild ass free? or who has loosed the bands of the wild ass?
verses.text: Who has sent out the wild ass free? or who has loosed the bands of the wild ass?

verses.raw: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.
verses.text: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.

verses.raw: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regards he the crying of the driver.
verses.text: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regards he the crying of the driver.

verses.raw: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.
verses.text: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.

verses.raw: Will the unicorn be willing to serve you, or abide by your crib?
verses.text: Will the unicorn be willing to serve you, or abide by your crib?

verses.raw: Can you bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after you?
verses.text: Can you bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after you?

verses.raw: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? or will you leave your labour to him?
verses.text: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? or will you leave your labour to him?

verses.raw: Will you believe him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather it into your barn?
verses.text: Will you believe him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather it into your barn?

verses.raw: Gave you the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?
verses.text: Gave you the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?

verses.raw: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,
verses.text: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,

verses.raw: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.
verses.text: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.

verses.raw: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not hers: her labour is in vain without fear;
verses.text: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not hers: her labour is in vain without fear;

verses.raw: Because Elohim (God) has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.
verses.text: Because Elohim has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.

verses.raw: What time she lifts up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.
verses.text: What time she lifts up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.

verses.raw: Have you given the horse strength? have you clothed his neck with thunder?
verses.text: Have you given the horse strength? have you clothed his neck with thunder?

verses.raw: Can you make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.
verses.text: Can you make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.

verses.raw: He paweth in the valley, and rejoices in his strength: he goes on to meet the armed men.
verses.text: He paweth in the valley, and rejoices in his strength: he goes on to meet the armed men.

verses.raw: He mocks at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turns he back from the sword.
verses.text: He mocks at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turns he back from the sword.

verses.raw: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.
verses.text: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.

verses.raw: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believes he that it is the sound of the trumpet.
verses.text: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believes he that it is the sound of the trumpet.

verses.raw: He says among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
verses.text: He says among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

verses.raw: Does the hawk fly by your wisdom, and stretch her wings toward the south?
verses.text: Does the hawk fly by your wisdom, and stretch her wings toward the south?

verses.raw: Does the eagle mount up at your command, and make her nest on high?
verses.text: Does the eagle mount up at your command, and make her nest on high?

verses.raw: She dwells and abides on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.
verses.text: She dwells and abides on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.

verses.raw: From thence she seeks the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.
verses.text: From thence she seeks the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.

verses.raw: Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain are, there is she.
verses.text: Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain are, there is she.

verses.raw: Moreover Yahuah (LORD) answered Job, and said,
verses.text: Moreover Yahuah answered Job, and said,

verses.raw: Shall he that contends with the Almighty instruct him? he that reproveth Elohim (God), let him answer it.
verses.text: Shall he that contends with the Almighty instruct him? he that reproveth Elohim, let him answer it.

verses.raw: Then Job answered Yahuah (LORD), and said,
verses.text: Then Job answered Yahuah, and said,

verses.raw: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer you? I will lay my hand upon my mouth.
verses.text: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer you? I will lay my hand upon my mouth.

verses.raw: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.
verses.text: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.

verses.raw: Then answered Yahuah (LORD) unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
verses.text: Then answered Yahuah unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

verses.raw: Gird up your loins now like a man: I will demand of you, and declare you unto me.
verses.text: Gird up your loins now like a man: I will demand of you, and declare you unto me.

verses.raw: Will you also disannul my judgment? will you condemn me, that you may be righteous?
verses.text: Will you also disannul my judgment? will you condemn me, that you may be righteous?

verses.raw: Have you an arm like Elohim (God)? or can you thunder with a voice like him?
verses.text: Have you an arm like Elohim? or can you thunder with a voice like him?

verses.raw: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.
verses.text: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.

verses.raw: Cast abroad the rage of your wrath: and behold every one that is proud, and abase him.
verses.text: Cast abroad the rage of your wrath: and behold every one that is proud, and abase him.

verses.raw: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.
verses.text: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.

verses.raw: Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.
verses.text: Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.

verses.raw: Then will I also confess unto you that your own right hand can save you.
verses.text: Then will I also confess unto you that your own right hand can save you.

verses.raw: Behold now behemoth, which I made with you; he eats grass as an ox.
verses.text: Behold now behemoth, which I made with you; he eats grass as an ox.

verses.raw: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.
verses.text: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.

verses.raw: He moves his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.
verses.text: He moves his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.

verses.raw: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of iron.
verses.text: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of iron.

verses.raw: He is the chief of the ways of Elohim (God): he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.
verses.text: He is the chief of the ways of Elohim: he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.

verses.raw: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.
verses.text: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.

verses.raw: He lies under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.
verses.text: He lies under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.

verses.raw: The shady trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.
verses.text: The shady trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.

verses.raw: Behold, he drinks up a river, and hasteth not: he trusts that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.
verses.text: Behold, he drinks up a river, and hasteth not: he trusts that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.

verses.raw: He takes it with his eyes: his nose pierces through snares.
verses.text: He takes it with his eyes: his nose pierces through snares.

verses.raw: Can you draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which you lettest down?
verses.text: Can you draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which you lettest down?

verses.raw: Can you put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?
verses.text: Can you put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?

verses.raw: Will he make many supplications unto you? will he speak soft words unto you?
verses.text: Will he make many supplications unto you? will he speak soft words unto you?

verses.raw: Will he make a covenant with you? will you take him for a servant for ever?
verses.text: Will he make a covenant with you? will you take him for a servant for ever?

verses.raw: Will you play with him as with a bird? or will you bind him for your maidens?
