verses.raw: So shall the king greatly desire your beauty: for he is your Adonai (Lord); and worship you him.
verses.text: So shall the king greatly desire your beauty: for he is your Adonai; and worship you him.

verses.raw: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat your favour.
verses.text: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat your favour.

verses.raw: The king’s daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.
verses.text: The king’s daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.

verses.raw: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto you.
verses.text: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto you.

verses.raw: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king’s palace.
verses.text: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king’s palace.

verses.raw: Instead of your fathers shall be your children, whom you may make princes in all the earth.
verses.text: Instead of your fathers shall be your children, whom you may make princes in all the earth.

verses.raw: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise you for ever and ever.
verses.text: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise you for ever and ever.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.text: Elohim is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

verses.raw: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
verses.text: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;

verses.raw: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
verses.text: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.

verses.raw: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of Elohim (God), the holy place of the tabernacles of the El Elyon (most High).
verses.text: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of Elohim, the holy place of the tabernacles of the El Elyon.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: Elohim (God) shall help her, and that right early.
verses.text: Elohim is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: Elohim shall help her, and that right early.

verses.raw: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
verses.text: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

verses.raw: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is with us; the Elohim (God) of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.text: Yahuah Tseva'ot is with us; the Elohim of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

verses.raw: Come, behold the works of Yahuah (LORD), what desolations he has made in the earth.
verses.text: Come, behold the works of Yahuah, what desolations he has made in the earth.

verses.raw: He makes wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaks the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burns the chariot in the fire.
verses.text: He makes wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaks the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burns the chariot in the fire.

verses.raw: Be still, and know that I am Elohim (God): I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
verses.text: Be still, and know that I am Elohim: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

verses.raw: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is with us; the Elohim (God) of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
verses.text: Yahuah Tseva'ot is with us; the Elohim of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

verses.raw: O clap your hands, all you people; shout unto Elohim (God) with the voice of triumph.
verses.text: O clap your hands, all you people; shout unto Elohim with the voice of triumph.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.
verses.text: For Yahuah most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.

verses.raw: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.
verses.text: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.

verses.raw: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
verses.text: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) is gone up with a shout, Yahuah (LORD) with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.text: Elohim is gone up with a shout, Yahuah with the sound of a trumpet.

verses.raw: Sing praises to Elohim (God), sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
verses.text: Sing praises to Elohim, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) is the King of all the earth: sing you praises with understanding.
verses.text: For Elohim is the King of all the earth: sing you praises with understanding.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) reigns over the heathen: Elohim (God) sits upon the throne of his holiness.
verses.text: Elohim reigns over the heathen: Elohim sits upon the throne of his holiness.

verses.raw: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the Elohim (God) of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto Elohim (God): he is greatly exalted.
verses.text: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the Elohim of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto Elohim: he is greatly exalted.

verses.raw: Great is Yahuah (LORD), and greatly to be praised in the city of our Elohim (God), in the mountain of his holiness.
verses.text: Great is Yahuah, and greatly to be praised in the city of our Elohim, in the mountain of his holiness.

verses.raw: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
verses.text: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) is known in her palaces for a refuge.
verses.text: Elohim is known in her palaces for a refuge.

verses.raw: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
verses.text: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.

verses.raw: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.
verses.text: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.

verses.raw: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.text: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

verses.raw: You breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
verses.text: You breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

verses.raw: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), in the city of our Elohim (God): Elohim (God) will establish it for ever. Selah.
verses.text: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of Yahuah Tseva'ot, in the city of our Elohim: Elohim will establish it for ever. Selah.

verses.raw: We have thought of your lovingkindness, O Elohim (God), in the midst of your temple.
verses.text: We have thought of your lovingkindness, O Elohim, in the midst of your temple.

verses.raw: According to your name, O Elohim (God), so is your praise unto the ends of the earth: your right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.text: According to your name, O Elohim, so is your praise unto the ends of the earth: your right hand is full of righteousness.

verses.raw: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Yahudah (Judah) be glad, because of your judgments.
verses.text: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Yahudah be glad, because of your judgments.

verses.raw: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
verses.text: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.

verses.raw: Mark you well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that you may tell it to the generation following.
verses.text: Mark you well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that you may tell it to the generation following.

verses.raw: For this Elohim (God) is our Elohim (God) for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.
verses.text: For this Elohim is our Elohim for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.

verses.raw: Hear this, all you people; give ear, all you inhabitants of the world:
verses.text: Hear this, all you people; give ear, all you inhabitants of the world:

verses.raw: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
verses.text: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.

verses.raw: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
verses.text: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.

verses.raw: I will incline my ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
verses.text: I will incline my ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

verses.raw: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?
verses.text: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?

verses.raw: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
verses.text: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

verses.raw: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to Elohim (God) a ransom for him:
verses.text: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to Elohim a ransom for him:

verses.raw: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceases for ever:)
verses.text: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceases for ever:)

verses.raw: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.
verses.text: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.

verses.raw: For he sees that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.
verses.text: For he sees that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.

verses.raw: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.
verses.text: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.

verses.raw: Nevertheless man being in honour abides not: he is like the beasts that perish.
verses.text: Nevertheless man being in honour abides not: he is like the beasts that perish.

verses.raw: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.
verses.text: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.

verses.raw: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.
verses.text: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.
verses.text: But Elohim will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.

verses.raw: Be not you afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
verses.text: Be not you afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

verses.raw: For when he dies he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.
verses.text: For when he dies he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.

verses.raw: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise you, when you do well to thyself.
verses.text: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise you, when you do well to thyself.

verses.raw: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.
verses.text: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.

verses.raw: Man that is in honour, and understands not, is like the beasts that perish.
verses.text: Man that is in honour, and understands not, is like the beasts that perish.

verses.raw: El Gibbor (The mighty God), even Yahuah (LORD), has spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
verses.text: El Gibbor (The mighty God), even Yahuah, has spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

verses.raw: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, Elohim (God) has shined.
verses.text: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, Elohim has shined.

verses.raw: Our Elohim (God) shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.
verses.text: Our Elohim shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.

verses.raw: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.
verses.text: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.

verses.raw: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
verses.text: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

verses.raw: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for Elohim (God) is judge himself. Selah.
verses.text: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for Elohim is judge himself. Selah.

verses.raw: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Yashar'el (Israel), and I will testify against you: I am Elohim (God), even your Elohim (God).
verses.text: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Yashar'el, and I will testify against you: I am Elohim, even your Elohim.

verses.raw: I will not reprove you for your sacrifices or your burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.
verses.text: I will not reprove you for your sacrifices or your burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.

verses.raw: I will take no bullock out of your house, nor he goats out of your folds.
verses.text: I will take no bullock out of your house, nor he goats out of your folds.

verses.raw: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.
verses.text: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.

verses.raw: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.
verses.text: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.

verses.raw: If I were hungry, I would not tell you: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.
verses.text: If I were hungry, I would not tell you: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

verses.raw: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
verses.text: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

verses.raw: Offer unto Elohim (God) thanksgiving; and pay your vows unto the El Elyon (most High):
verses.text: Offer unto Elohim thanksgiving; and pay your vows unto the El Elyon:

verses.raw: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver you, and you shall glorify me.
verses.text: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver you, and you shall glorify me.

verses.raw: But unto the wicked Elohim (God) says, What have you to do to declare my statutes, or that you should take my covenant in your mouth?
verses.text: But unto the wicked Elohim says, What have you to do to declare my statutes, or that you should take my covenant in your mouth?

verses.raw: Seeing you hate instruction, and cast my words behind you.
verses.text: Seeing you hate instruction, and cast my words behind you.

verses.raw: When you saw a thief, then you consentedst with him, and have been partaker with adulterers.
verses.text: When you saw a thief, then you consentedst with him, and have been partaker with adulterers.

verses.raw: You give your mouth to evil, and your tongue frameth deceit.
verses.text: You give your mouth to evil, and your tongue frameth deceit.

verses.raw: You sit and speak against your brother; you slanderest your own mother’s son.
verses.text: You sit and speak against your brother; you slanderest your own mother’s son.

verses.raw: These things have you done, and I kept silence; you thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove you, and set them in order before your eyes.
verses.text: These things have you done, and I kept silence; you thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove you, and set them in order before your eyes.

verses.raw: Now consider this, you that forget Elohim (God), lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.
verses.text: Now consider this, you that forget Elohim, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.

verses.raw: Whoso offers praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Whoso offers praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of Elohim.

verses.raw: Have mercy upon me, O Elohim (God), according to your lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of your tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
verses.text: Have mercy upon me, O Elohim, according to your lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of your tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

verses.raw: Wash me throughly from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
verses.text: Wash me throughly from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.raw: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.
verses.text: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.

verses.raw: Against you, you only, have I sinned, and done this evil in your sight: that you might be justified when you speak, and be clear when you judge.
verses.text: Against you, you only, have I sinned, and done this evil in your sight: that you might be justified when you speak, and be clear when you judge.

verses.raw: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
verses.text: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.

verses.raw: Behold, you desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part you shall make me to know wisdom.
verses.text: Behold, you desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part you shall make me to know wisdom.

verses.raw: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
verses.text: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

verses.raw: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.
verses.text: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

verses.raw: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.
verses.text: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.

verses.raw: Create in me a clean heart, O Elohim (God); and renew a right spirit within me.
verses.text: Create in me a clean heart, O Elohim; and renew a right spirit within me.

verses.raw: Cast me not away from your presence; and take not your holy spirit from me.
verses.text: Cast me not away from your presence; and take not your holy spirit from me.

verses.raw: Restore unto me the joy of your salvation; and uphold me with your free spirit.
verses.text: Restore unto me the joy of your salvation; and uphold me with your free spirit.

verses.raw: Then will I teach transgressors your ways; and sinners shall be converted unto you.
verses.text: Then will I teach transgressors your ways; and sinners shall be converted unto you.

verses.raw: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O Elohim (God), you Elohim (God) of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of your righteousness.
verses.text: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O Elohim, you Elohim of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of your righteousness.

verses.raw: O Adonai (Lord), open you my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth your praise.
verses.text: O Adonai, open you my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth your praise.

verses.raw: For you desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: you delightest not in burnt offering.
verses.text: For you desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: you delightest not in burnt offering.

verses.raw: The sacrifices of Elohim (God) are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O Elohim (God), you will not despise.
verses.text: The sacrifices of Elohim are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O Elohim, you will not despise.

verses.raw: Do good in your good pleasure unto Zion: build you the walls of Jerusalem.
verses.text: Do good in your good pleasure unto Zion: build you the walls of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Then shall you be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon your altar.
verses.text: Then shall you be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon your altar.

verses.raw: Why boastest you thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of Elohim (God) endures continually.
verses.text: Why boastest you thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of Elohim endures continually.

verses.raw: Your tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
verses.text: Your tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

verses.raw: You love evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.
verses.text: You love evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.

verses.raw: You love all devouring words, O you deceitful tongue.
verses.text: You love all devouring words, O you deceitful tongue.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) shall likewise destroy you for ever, he shall take you away, and pluck you out of your dwelling place, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.
verses.text: Elohim shall likewise destroy you for ever, he shall take you away, and pluck you out of your dwelling place, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.

verses.raw: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:
verses.text: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:

verses.raw: Lo, this is the man that made not Elohim (God) his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.
verses.text: Lo, this is the man that made not Elohim his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.

verses.raw: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of Elohim (God): I trust in the mercy of Elohim (God) for ever and ever.
verses.text: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of Elohim: I trust in the mercy of Elohim for ever and ever.

verses.raw: I will praise you for ever, because you have done it: and I will wait on your name; for it is good before your saints.
verses.text: I will praise you for ever, because you have done it: and I will wait on your name; for it is good before your saints.

verses.raw: The fool has said in his heart, There is no Elohim (God). Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that does good.
verses.text: The fool has said in his heart, There is no Elohim. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that does good.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek Elohim (God).
verses.text: Elohim looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek Elohim.

verses.raw: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that does good, no, not one.
verses.text: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that does good, no, not one.

verses.raw: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon Elohim (God).
verses.text: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon Elohim.

verses.raw: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for Elohim (God) has scattered the bones of him that encampeth against you: you have put them to shame, because Elohim (God) has despised them.
verses.text: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for Elohim has scattered the bones of him that encampeth against you: you have put them to shame, because Elohim has despised them.

verses.raw: Oh that the salvation of Yashar'el (Israel) were come out of Zion! When Elohim (God) brings back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Yashar'el (Israel) shall be glad.
verses.text: Oh that the salvation of Yashar'el were come out of Zion! When Elohim brings back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Yashar'el shall be glad.

verses.raw: Save me, O Elohim (God), by your name, and judge me by your strength.
verses.text: Save me, O Elohim, by your name, and judge me by your strength.

verses.raw: Hear my prayer, O Elohim (God); give ear to the words of my mouth.
verses.text: Hear my prayer, O Elohim; give ear to the words of my mouth.

verses.raw: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set Elohim (God) before them. Selah.
verses.text: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set Elohim before them. Selah.

verses.raw: Behold, Elohim (God) is my helper: Adonai (Lord) is with them that uphold my soul.
verses.text: Behold, Elohim is my helper: Adonai is with them that uphold my soul.

verses.raw: He shall reward evil unto my enemies: cut them off in your truth.
verses.text: He shall reward evil unto my enemies: cut them off in your truth.

verses.raw: I will freely sacrifice unto you: I will praise your name, O Yahuah (LORD); for it is good.
verses.text: I will freely sacrifice unto you: I will praise your name, O Yahuah; for it is good.

verses.raw: For he has delivered me out of all trouble: and my eye has seen his desire upon my enemies.
verses.text: For he has delivered me out of all trouble: and my eye has seen his desire upon my enemies.

verses.raw: Give ear to my prayer, O Elohim (God); and hide not thyself from my supplication.
verses.text: Give ear to my prayer, O Elohim; and hide not thyself from my supplication.

verses.raw: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
verses.text: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

verses.raw: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
verses.text: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

verses.raw: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
verses.text: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

verses.raw: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror has overwhelmed me.
verses.text: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror has overwhelmed me.

verses.raw: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
verses.text: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.

verses.raw: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
verses.text: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.

verses.raw: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
verses.text: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.

verses.raw: Destroy, O Adonai (Lord), and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
verses.text: Destroy, O Adonai, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

verses.raw: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.
verses.text: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.

verses.raw: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
verses.text: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

verses.raw: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
verses.text: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

verses.raw: But it was you, a man my equal, my guide, and my acquaintance.
verses.text: But it was you, a man my equal, my guide, and my acquaintance.

verses.raw: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of Elohim (God) in company.
verses.text: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of Elohim in company.

verses.raw: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.
verses.text: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.

verses.raw: As for me, I will call upon Elohim (God); and Yahuah (LORD) shall save me.
verses.text: As for me, I will call upon Elohim; and Yahuah shall save me.

verses.raw: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
verses.text: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.

verses.raw: He has delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.
verses.text: He has delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abides of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not Elohim (God).
verses.text: Elohim shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abides of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not Elohim.

verses.raw: He has put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he has broken his covenant.
verses.text: He has put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he has broken his covenant.

verses.raw: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.
verses.text: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.

verses.raw: Cast your burden upon Yahuah (LORD), and he shall sustain you: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
verses.text: Cast your burden upon Yahuah, and he shall sustain you: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

verses.raw: But you, O Elohim (God), shall bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in you.
verses.text: But you, O Elohim, shall bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in you.

verses.raw: Be merciful unto me, O Elohim (God): for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresses me.
verses.text: Be merciful unto me, O Elohim: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresses me.

verses.raw: My enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O you El Elyon (most High).
verses.text: My enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O you El Elyon.

verses.raw: What time I am afraid, I will trust in you.
verses.text: What time I am afraid, I will trust in you.

verses.raw: In Elohim (God) I will praise his word, in Elohim (God) I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
verses.text: In Elohim I will praise his word, in Elohim I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.

verses.raw: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.
verses.text: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.

verses.raw: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
verses.text: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.

verses.raw: Shall they escape by iniquity? in your anger cast down the people, O Elohim (God).
verses.text: Shall they escape by iniquity? in your anger cast down the people, O Elohim.

verses.raw: You tell my wanderings: put you my tears into your bottle: are they not in your book?
verses.text: You tell my wanderings: put you my tears into your bottle: are they not in your book?

verses.raw: When I cry unto you, then shall my enemies turn back: this I know; for Elohim (God) is for me.
verses.text: When I cry unto you, then shall my enemies turn back: this I know; for Elohim is for me.

verses.raw: In Elohim (God) will I praise his word: in Yahuah (LORD) will I praise his word.
verses.text: In Elohim will I praise his word: in Yahuah will I praise his word.

verses.raw: In Elohim (God) have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
verses.text: In Elohim have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.

verses.raw: Your vows are upon me, O Elohim (God): I will render praises unto you.
verses.text: Your vows are upon me, O Elohim: I will render praises unto you.

verses.raw: For you have delivered my soul from death: will not you deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before Elohim (God) in the light of the living?
verses.text: For you have delivered my soul from death: will not you deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before Elohim in the light of the living?

verses.raw: Be merciful unto me, O Elohim (God), be merciful unto me: for my soul trusts in you: yea, in the shadow of your wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
verses.text: Be merciful unto me, O Elohim, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusts in you: yea, in the shadow of your wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.

verses.raw: I will cry unto Elohim (God) most high; unto Elohim (God) that performs all things for me.
verses.text: I will cry unto Elohim most high; unto Elohim that performs all things for me.

verses.raw: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. Elohim (God) shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
verses.text: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. Elohim shall send forth his mercy and his truth.

verses.raw: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
verses.text: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

verses.raw: Be you exalted, O Elohim (God), above the heavens; let your glory be above all the earth.
verses.text: Be you exalted, O Elohim, above the heavens; let your glory be above all the earth.

verses.raw: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.
verses.text: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.

verses.raw: My heart is fixed, O Elohim (God), my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
verses.text: My heart is fixed, O Elohim, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.

verses.raw: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
verses.text: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

verses.raw: I will praise you, O Adonai (Lord), among the people: I will sing unto you among the nations.
verses.text: I will praise you, O Adonai, among the people: I will sing unto you among the nations.

verses.raw: For your mercy is great unto the heavens, and your truth unto the clouds.
verses.text: For your mercy is great unto the heavens, and your truth unto the clouds.

verses.raw: Be you exalted, O Elohim (God), above the heavens: let your glory be above all the earth.
verses.text: Be you exalted, O Elohim, above the heavens: let your glory be above all the earth.

verses.raw: Do you indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do you judge uprightly, O you sons of men?
verses.text: Do you indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do you judge uprightly, O you sons of men?

verses.raw: Yea, in heart you work wickedness; you weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
verses.text: Yea, in heart you work wickedness; you weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.

verses.raw: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.
verses.text: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.

verses.raw: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;
verses.text: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;

verses.raw: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
verses.text: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.

verses.raw: Break their teeth, O Elohim (God), in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Break their teeth, O Elohim, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Yahuah.

verses.raw: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.
verses.text: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.

verses.raw: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.
verses.text: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.

verses.raw: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.
verses.text: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.

verses.raw: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
verses.text: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

verses.raw: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a Elohim (God) that judges in the earth.
verses.text: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a Elohim that judges in the earth.

verses.raw: Deliver me from my enemies, O my Elohim (God): defend me from them that rise up against me.
verses.text: Deliver me from my enemies, O my Elohim: defend me from them that rise up against me.

verses.raw: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
verses.text: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

verses.raw: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Yahuah.

verses.raw: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.
verses.text: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.

verses.raw: You therefore, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of hosts, the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
verses.text: You therefore, O Yahuah Elohim of hosts, the Elohim of Yashar'el, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

verses.raw: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.text: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

verses.raw: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, does hear?
verses.text: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, does hear?

verses.raw: But you, O Yahuah (LORD), shall laugh at them; you shall have all the heathen in derision.
verses.text: But you, O Yahuah, shall laugh at them; you shall have all the heathen in derision.

verses.raw: Because of his strength will I wait upon you: for Elohim (God) is my defence.
verses.text: Because of his strength will I wait upon you: for Elohim is my defence.

verses.raw: The Elohim (God) of my mercy shall prevent me: Elohim (God) shall let me see my desire upon my enemies.
verses.text: The Elohim of my mercy shall prevent me: Elohim shall let me see my desire upon my enemies.

verses.raw: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by your power; and bring them down, O Adonai (Lord) our shield.
verses.text: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by your power; and bring them down, O Adonai our shield.

verses.raw: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.
verses.text: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.

verses.raw: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that Elohim (God) rules in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
verses.text: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that Elohim rules in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

verses.raw: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.text: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

verses.raw: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.
verses.text: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.

verses.raw: But I will sing of your power; yea, I will sing aloud of your mercy in the morning: for you have been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
verses.text: But I will sing of your power; yea, I will sing aloud of your mercy in the morning: for you have been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.

verses.raw: Unto you, O my strength, will I sing: for Elohim (God) is my defence, and the Elohim (God) of my mercy.
verses.text: Unto you, O my strength, will I sing: for Elohim is my defence, and the Elohim of my mercy.

verses.raw: O Elohim (God), you have cast us off, you have scattered us, you have been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
verses.text: O Elohim, you have cast us off, you have scattered us, you have been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.

verses.raw: You have made the earth to tremble; you have broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
verses.text: You have made the earth to tremble; you have broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

verses.raw: You have shewed your people hard things: you have made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
verses.text: You have shewed your people hard things: you have made us to drink the wine of astonishment.

verses.raw: You have given a banner to them that fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
verses.text: You have given a banner to them that fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

verses.raw: That your beloved may be delivered; save with your right hand, and hear me.
verses.text: That your beloved may be delivered; save with your right hand, and hear me.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) has spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.text: Elohim has spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.raw: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of my head; Yahudah (Judah) is my lawgiver;
verses.text: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of my head; Yahudah is my lawgiver;

verses.raw: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph you because of me.
verses.text: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph you because of me.

verses.raw: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.text: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

verses.raw: Will not you, O Elohim (God), which had cast us off? and you, O Elohim (God), which did not go out with our armies?
verses.text: Will not you, O Elohim, which had cast us off? and you, O Elohim, which did not go out with our armies?

verses.raw: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.text: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

verses.raw: Through Elohim (God) we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
verses.text: Through Elohim we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

verses.raw: Hear my cry, O Elohim (God); attend unto my prayer.
verses.text: Hear my cry, O Elohim; attend unto my prayer.

verses.raw: From the end of the earth will I cry unto you, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
verses.text: From the end of the earth will I cry unto you, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

verses.raw: For you have been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
verses.text: For you have been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.

verses.raw: I will abide in your tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of your wings. Selah.
verses.text: I will abide in your tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of your wings. Selah.

verses.raw: For you, O Elohim (God), have heard my vows: you have given me the heritage of those that fear your name.
verses.text: For you, O Elohim, have heard my vows: you have given me the heritage of those that fear your name.

verses.raw: You will prolong the king’s life: and his years as many generations.
verses.text: You will prolong the king’s life: and his years as many generations.

verses.raw: He shall abide before Elohim (God) for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.
verses.text: He shall abide before Elohim for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.

verses.raw: So will I sing praise unto your name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
verses.text: So will I sing praise unto your name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

verses.raw: Truly my soul waits upon Elohim (God): from him comes my salvation.
verses.text: Truly my soul waits upon Elohim: from him comes my salvation.

verses.raw: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
verses.text: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.

verses.raw: How long will you imagine mischief against a man? you shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall you be, and as a tottering fence.
verses.text: How long will you imagine mischief against a man? you shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall you be, and as a tottering fence.

verses.raw: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
verses.text: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

verses.raw: My soul, wait you only upon Elohim (God); for my expectation is from him.
verses.text: My soul, wait you only upon Elohim; for my expectation is from him.

verses.raw: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
verses.text: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.

verses.raw: In Elohim (God) is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in Elohim (God).
verses.text: In Elohim is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in Elohim.

verses.raw: Trust in him at all times; you people, pour out your heart before him: Elohim (God) is a refuge for us. Selah.
verses.text: Trust in him at all times; you people, pour out your heart before him: Elohim is a refuge for us. Selah.

verses.raw: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.
verses.text: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.

verses.raw: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.
verses.text: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) has spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongs unto Elohim (God).
verses.text: Elohim has spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongs unto Elohim.

verses.raw: Also unto you, O Adonai (Lord), belongs mercy: for you renderest to every man according to his work.
verses.text: Also unto you, O Adonai, belongs mercy: for you renderest to every man according to his work.

verses.raw: O Elohim (God), you are my Elohim (God); early will I seek you: my soul thirsteth for you, my flesh longeth for you in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
verses.text: O Elohim, you are my Elohim; early will I seek you: my soul thirsteth for you, my flesh longeth for you in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

verses.raw: To see your power and your glory, so as I have seen you in the sanctuary.
verses.text: To see your power and your glory, so as I have seen you in the sanctuary.

verses.raw: Because your lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
verses.text: Because your lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

verses.raw: Thus will I bless you while I live: I will lift up my hands in your name.
verses.text: Thus will I bless you while I live: I will lift up my hands in your name.

verses.raw: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise you with joyful lips:
verses.text: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise you with joyful lips:

verses.raw: When I remember you upon my bed, and meditate on you in the night watches.
verses.text: When I remember you upon my bed, and meditate on you in the night watches.

verses.raw: Because you have been my help, therefore in the shadow of your wings will I rejoice.
verses.text: Because you have been my help, therefore in the shadow of your wings will I rejoice.

verses.raw: My soul follows hard after you: your right hand upholdeth me.
verses.text: My soul follows hard after you: your right hand upholdeth me.

verses.raw: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
verses.text: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

verses.raw: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
verses.text: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.

verses.raw: But the king shall rejoice in Elohim (God); every one that swears by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
verses.text: But the king shall rejoice in Elohim; every one that swears by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

verses.raw: Hear my voice, O Elohim (God), in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
verses.text: Hear my voice, O Elohim, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

verses.raw: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
verses.text: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:

verses.raw: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:
verses.text: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:

verses.raw: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
verses.text: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

verses.raw: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?
verses.text: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?

verses.raw: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.
verses.text: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.
verses.text: But Elohim shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.

verses.raw: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
verses.text: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.

verses.raw: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of Elohim (God); for they shall wisely consider of his doing.
verses.text: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of Elohim; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.

verses.raw: The righteous shall be glad in Yahuah (LORD), and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
verses.text: The righteous shall be glad in Yahuah, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

verses.raw: Praise waits for you, O Elohim (God), in Sion: and unto you shall the vow be performed.
verses.text: Praise waits for you, O Elohim, in Sion: and unto you shall the vow be performed.

verses.raw: O you that hear prayer, unto you shall all flesh come.
verses.text: O you that hear prayer, unto you shall all flesh come.

verses.raw: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, you shall purge them away.
verses.text: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, you shall purge them away.

verses.raw: Blessed is the man whom you choosest, and cause to approach unto you, that he may dwell in your courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of your house, even of your holy temple.
verses.text: Blessed is the man whom you choosest, and cause to approach unto you, that he may dwell in your courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of your house, even of your holy temple.

verses.raw: By terrible things in righteousness will you answer us, O Elohim (God) of our salvation; who are the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:
verses.text: By terrible things in righteousness will you answer us, O Elohim of our salvation; who are the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:

verses.raw: Which by his strength sets fast the mountains; being girded with power:
verses.text: Which by his strength sets fast the mountains; being girded with power:

verses.raw: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
verses.text: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

verses.raw: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at your tokens: you make the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
verses.text: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at your tokens: you make the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

verses.raw: You visit the earth, and waterest it: you greatly enrichest it with the river of Elohim (God), which is full of water: you preparest them corn, when you have so provided for it.
verses.text: You visit the earth, and waterest it: you greatly enrichest it with the river of Elohim, which is full of water: you preparest them corn, when you have so provided for it.

verses.raw: You waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: you settlest the furrows thereof: you make it soft with showers: you blessest the springing thereof.
verses.text: You waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: you settlest the furrows thereof: you make it soft with showers: you blessest the springing thereof.

verses.raw: You crownest the year with your goodness; and your paths drop fatness.
verses.text: You crownest the year with your goodness; and your paths drop fatness.

verses.raw: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
verses.text: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

verses.raw: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
verses.text: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

verses.raw: Make a joyful noise unto Elohim (God), all you lands:
verses.text: Make a joyful noise unto Elohim, all you lands:

verses.raw: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
verses.text: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.

verses.raw: Say unto Elohim (God), How terrible are you in your works! through the greatness of your power shall your enemies submit themselves unto you.
verses.text: Say unto Elohim, How terrible are you in your works! through the greatness of your power shall your enemies submit themselves unto you.

verses.raw: All the earth shall worship you, and shall sing unto you; they shall sing to your name. Selah.
verses.text: All the earth shall worship you, and shall sing unto you; they shall sing to your name. Selah.

verses.raw: Come and see the works of Elohim (God): he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
verses.text: Come and see the works of Elohim: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.

verses.raw: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
verses.text: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.

verses.raw: He rules by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.text: He rules by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

verses.raw: O bless our Elohim (God), you people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:
verses.text: O bless our Elohim, you people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:

verses.raw: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffers not our feet to be moved.
verses.text: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffers not our feet to be moved.

verses.raw: For you, O Elohim (God), have proved us: you have tried us, as silver is tried.
verses.text: For you, O Elohim, have proved us: you have tried us, as silver is tried.

verses.raw: You brought us into the net; you laidst affliction upon our loins.
verses.text: You brought us into the net; you laidst affliction upon our loins.

verses.raw: You have caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but you brought us out into a wealthy place.
verses.text: You have caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but you brought us out into a wealthy place.

verses.raw: I will go into your house with burnt offerings: I will pay you my vows,
verses.text: I will go into your house with burnt offerings: I will pay you my vows,

verses.raw: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth has spoken, when I was in trouble.
verses.text: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth has spoken, when I was in trouble.

verses.raw: I will offer unto you burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
verses.text: I will offer unto you burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.

verses.raw: Come and hear, all you that fear Elohim (God), and I will declare what he has done for my soul.
verses.text: Come and hear, all you that fear Elohim, and I will declare what he has done for my soul.

verses.raw: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
verses.text: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.

verses.raw: If I regard iniquity in my heart, Adonai (Lord) will not hear me:
verses.text: If I regard iniquity in my heart, Adonai will not hear me:

verses.raw: But verily Elohim (God) has heard me; he has attended to the voice of my prayer.
verses.text: But verily Elohim has heard me; he has attended to the voice of my prayer.

verses.raw: Blessed be Elohim (God), which has not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
verses.text: Blessed be Elohim, which has not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
verses.text: Elohim be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.

verses.raw: That your way may be known upon earth, your saving health among all nations.
verses.text: That your way may be known upon earth, your saving health among all nations.

verses.raw: Let the people praise you, O Elohim (God); let all the people praise you.
verses.text: Let the people praise you, O Elohim; let all the people praise you.

verses.raw: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for you shall judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
verses.text: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for you shall judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.

verses.raw: Let the people praise you, O Elohim (God); let all the people praise you.
verses.text: Let the people praise you, O Elohim; let all the people praise you.

verses.raw: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and Elohim (God), even our own Elohim (God), shall bless us.
verses.text: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and Elohim, even our own Elohim, shall bless us.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
verses.text: Elohim shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.

verses.raw: Let Elohim (God) arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.
verses.text: Let Elohim arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.

verses.raw: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of Elohim (God).
verses.text: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of Elohim.

verses.raw: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before Elohim (God): yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
verses.text: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before Elohim: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.

verses.raw: Sing unto Elohim (God), sing praises to his name: extol him that rides upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.
verses.text: Sing unto Elohim, sing praises to his name: extol him that rides upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.

verses.raw: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is Elohim (God) in his holy habitation.
verses.text: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is Elohim in his holy habitation.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) sets the solitary in families: he brings out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
verses.text: Elohim sets the solitary in families: he brings out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.

verses.raw: O Elohim (God), when you went forth before your people, when you did march through the wilderness; Selah:
verses.text: O Elohim, when you went forth before your people, when you did march through the wilderness; Selah:

verses.raw: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of Elohim (God): even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of Elohim (God), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of Elohim: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of Elohim, the Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: You, O Elohim (God), did send a plentiful rain, whereby you did confirm your inheritance, when it was weary.
verses.text: You, O Elohim, did send a plentiful rain, whereby you did confirm your inheritance, when it was weary.

verses.raw: Your congregation has dwelt therein: you, O Elohim (God), have prepared of your goodness for the poor.
verses.text: Your congregation has dwelt therein: you, O Elohim, have prepared of your goodness for the poor.

verses.raw: Adonai (Lord) gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.
verses.text: Adonai gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.

verses.raw: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.
verses.text: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.

verses.raw: Though you have lien among the pots, yet shall you be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
verses.text: Though you have lien among the pots, yet shall you be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.

verses.raw: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.
verses.text: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.

verses.raw: The hill of Elohim (God) is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.
verses.text: The hill of Elohim is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.

verses.raw: Why leap you, you high hills? this is the hill which Elohim (God) desires to dwell in; yea, Yahuah (LORD) will dwell in it for ever.
verses.text: Why leap you, you high hills? this is the hill which Elohim desires to dwell in; yea, Yahuah will dwell in it for ever.

verses.raw: The chariots of Elohim (God) are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: Adonai (Lord) is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.
verses.text: The chariots of Elohim are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: Adonai is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.

verses.raw: You have ascended on high, you have led captivity captive: you have received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) might dwell among them.
verses.text: You have ascended on high, you have led captivity captive: you have received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that Yahuah Elohim might dwell among them.

verses.raw: Blessed be Adonai (Lord), who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the Elohim (God) of our salvation. Selah.
verses.text: Blessed be Adonai, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the Elohim of our salvation. Selah.

verses.raw: He that is our Elohim (God) is the Elohim (God) of salvation; and unto GOD Adonai (Lord) belong the issues from death.
verses.text: He that is our Elohim is the Elohim of salvation; and unto GOD Adonai belong the issues from death.

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goes on still in his trespasses.
verses.text: But Elohim shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goes on still in his trespasses.

verses.raw: Adonai (Lord) said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:
verses.text: Adonai said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:

verses.raw: That your foot may be dipped in the blood of your enemies, and the tongue of your dogs in the same.
verses.text: That your foot may be dipped in the blood of your enemies, and the tongue of your dogs in the same.

verses.raw: They have seen your goings, O Elohim (God); even the goings of my Elohim (God), my King, in the sanctuary.
verses.text: They have seen your goings, O Elohim; even the goings of my Elohim, my King, in the sanctuary.

verses.raw: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.
verses.text: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.

verses.raw: Bless you Elohim (God) in the congregations, even Adonai (Lord), from the fountain of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Bless you Elohim in the congregations, even Adonai, from the fountain of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Yahudah (Judah) and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
verses.text: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Yahudah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

verses.raw: Your Elohim (God) has commanded your strength: strengthen, O Elohim (God), that which you have wrought for us.
verses.text: Your Elohim has commanded your strength: strengthen, O Elohim, that which you have wrought for us.

verses.raw: Because of your temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto you.
verses.text: Because of your temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto you.

verses.raw: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter you the people that delight in war.
verses.text: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter you the people that delight in war.

verses.raw: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto Elohim (God).
verses.text: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto Elohim.

verses.raw: Sing unto Elohim (God), you kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto Adonai (Lord); Selah:
verses.text: Sing unto Elohim, you kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto Adonai; Selah:

verses.raw: To him that rides upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he does send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.
verses.text: To him that rides upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he does send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.

verses.raw: Ascribe you strength unto Elohim (God): his excellency is over Yashar'el (Israel), and his strength is in the clouds.
verses.text: Ascribe you strength unto Elohim: his excellency is over Yashar'el, and his strength is in the clouds.

verses.raw: O Elohim (God), you are terrible out of your holy places: the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) is he that gives strength and power unto his people. Blessed be Elohim (God).
verses.text: O Elohim, you are terrible out of your holy places: the Elohim of Yashar'el is he that gives strength and power unto his people. Blessed be Elohim.

verses.raw: Save me, O Elohim (God); for the waters are come in unto my soul.
verses.text: Save me, O Elohim; for the waters are come in unto my soul.

verses.raw: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
verses.text: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

verses.raw: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: my eyes fail while I wait for my Elohim (God).
verses.text: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: my eyes fail while I wait for my Elohim.

verses.raw: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head: they that would destroy me, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.
verses.text: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head: they that would destroy me, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.

verses.raw: O Elohim (God), you know my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from you.
verses.text: O Elohim, you know my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from you.

verses.raw: Let not them that wait on you, O Adonai (Lord) GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek you be confounded for my sake, O Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Let not them that wait on you, O Adonai GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek you be confounded for my sake, O Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Because for your sake I have borne reproach; shame has covered my face.
verses.text: Because for your sake I have borne reproach; shame has covered my face.

verses.raw: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother’s children.
verses.text: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother’s children.

verses.raw: For the zeal of your house has eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached you are fallen upon me.
verses.text: For the zeal of your house has eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached you are fallen upon me.

verses.raw: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
verses.text: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.

verses.raw: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
verses.text: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

verses.raw: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.
verses.text: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.

verses.raw: But as for me, my prayer is unto you, O Yahuah (LORD), in an acceptable time: O Elohim (God), in the multitude of your mercy hear me, in the truth of your salvation.
verses.text: But as for me, my prayer is unto you, O Yahuah, in an acceptable time: O Elohim, in the multitude of your mercy hear me, in the truth of your salvation.

verses.raw: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
verses.text: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

verses.raw: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
verses.text: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

verses.raw: Hear me, O Yahuah (LORD); for your lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of your tender mercies.
verses.text: Hear me, O Yahuah; for your lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of your tender mercies.

verses.raw: And hide not your face from your servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
verses.text: And hide not your face from your servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.

verses.raw: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of my enemies.
verses.text: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of my enemies.

verses.raw: You have known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: my adversaries are all before you.
verses.text: You have known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: my adversaries are all before you.

verses.raw: Reproach has broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.
verses.text: Reproach has broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.

verses.raw: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.text: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

verses.raw: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.
verses.text: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.

verses.raw: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
verses.text: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

verses.raw: Pour out your indignation upon them, and let your wrathful anger take hold of them.
verses.text: Pour out your indignation upon them, and let your wrathful anger take hold of them.

verses.raw: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.
verses.text: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.

verses.raw: For they persecute him whom you have smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom you have wounded.
verses.text: For they persecute him whom you have smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom you have wounded.

verses.raw: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into your righteousness.
verses.text: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into your righteousness.

verses.raw: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
verses.text: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

verses.raw: But I am poor and sorrowful: let your salvation, O Elohim (God), set me up on high.
verses.text: But I am poor and sorrowful: let your salvation, O Elohim, set me up on high.

verses.raw: I will praise the name of Elohim (God) with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
