verses.text: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.

verses.raw: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?
verses.text: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?

verses.raw: The just man walks in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.
verses.text: The just man walks in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.

verses.raw: A king that sits in the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
verses.text: A king that sits in the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.

verses.raw: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
verses.text: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?

verses.raw: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to Yahuah.

verses.raw: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.
verses.text: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.

verses.raw: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahuah (LORD) has made even both of them.
verses.text: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahuah has made even both of them.

verses.raw: Love not sleep, lest you come to poverty; open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.
verses.text: Love not sleep, lest you come to poverty; open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.

verses.raw: It is naught, it is naught, says the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
verses.text: It is naught, it is naught, says the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.

verses.raw: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
verses.text: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.

verses.raw: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
verses.text: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.

verses.raw: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
verses.text: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.

verses.raw: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.
verses.text: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.

verses.raw: He that goes about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.
verses.text: He that goes about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.

verses.raw: Whoso curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.
verses.text: Whoso curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.

verses.raw: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
verses.text: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.

verses.raw: Say not you, I will recompense evil; but wait on Yahuah (LORD), and he shall save you.
verses.text: Say not you, I will recompense evil; but wait on Yahuah, and he shall save you.

verses.raw: Divers weights are an abomination unto Yahuah (LORD); and a false balance is not good.
verses.text: Divers weights are an abomination unto Yahuah; and a false balance is not good.

verses.raw: Man’s goings are of Yahuah (LORD); how can a man then understand his own way?
verses.text: Man’s goings are of Yahuah; how can a man then understand his own way?

verses.raw: It is a snare to the man who devours that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.
verses.text: It is a snare to the man who devours that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.

verses.raw: A wise king scatters the wicked, and brings the wheel over them.
verses.text: A wise king scatters the wicked, and brings the wheel over them.

verses.raw: The spirit of man is the candle of Yahuah (LORD), searching all the inward parts of the belly.
verses.text: The spirit of man is the candle of Yahuah, searching all the inward parts of the belly.

verses.raw: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.
verses.text: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.

verses.raw: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the gray head.
verses.text: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the gray head.

verses.raw: The blueness of a wound cleanses away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.
verses.text: The blueness of a wound cleanses away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.

verses.raw: The king’s heart is in the hand of Yahuah (LORD), as the rivers of water: he turns it whithersoever he will.
verses.text: The king’s heart is in the hand of Yahuah, as the rivers of water: he turns it whithersoever he will.

verses.raw: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but Yahuah (LORD) pondereth the hearts.
verses.text: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but Yahuah pondereth the hearts.

verses.raw: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to Yahuah (LORD) than sacrifice.
verses.text: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to Yahuah than sacrifice.

verses.raw: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.
verses.text: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.

verses.raw: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
verses.text: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.

verses.raw: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.
verses.text: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.

verses.raw: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.
verses.text: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.

verses.raw: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.
verses.text: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.

verses.raw: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
verses.text: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.

verses.raw: The soul of the wicked desires evil: his neighbour finds no favour in his eyes.
verses.text: The soul of the wicked desires evil: his neighbour finds no favour in his eyes.

verses.raw: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
verses.text: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

verses.raw: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but Elohim (God) overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.
verses.text: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but Elohim overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.

verses.raw: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
verses.text: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.

verses.raw: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.
verses.text: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.

verses.raw: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
verses.text: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

verses.raw: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.
verses.text: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.

verses.raw: He that loves pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loves wine and oil shall not be rich.
verses.text: He that loves pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loves wine and oil shall not be rich.

verses.raw: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.
verses.text: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.

verses.raw: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.
verses.text: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.

verses.raw: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.
verses.text: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.

verses.raw: He that follows after righteousness and mercy finds life, righteousness, and honour.
verses.text: He that follows after righteousness and mercy finds life, righteousness, and honour.

verses.raw: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casts down the strength of the confidence thereof.
verses.text: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casts down the strength of the confidence thereof.

verses.raw: Whoso keeps his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
verses.text: Whoso keeps his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

verses.raw: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who deals in proud wrath.
verses.text: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who deals in proud wrath.

verses.raw: The desire of the slothful kills him; for his hands refuse to labour.
verses.text: The desire of the slothful kills him; for his hands refuse to labour.

verses.raw: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous gives and spareth not.
verses.text: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous gives and spareth not.

verses.raw: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind?
verses.text: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind?

verses.raw: A false witness shall perish: but the man that hears speaks constantly.
verses.text: A false witness shall perish: but the man that hears speaks constantly.

verses.raw: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.
verses.text: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.

verses.raw: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahuah.

verses.raw: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of Yahuah.

verses.raw: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
verses.text: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.

verses.raw: The rich and poor meet together: Yahuah (LORD) is the maker of them all.
verses.text: The rich and poor meet together: Yahuah is the maker of them all.

verses.raw: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hides himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.
verses.text: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hides himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.

verses.raw: By humility and the fear of Yahuah (LORD) are riches, and honour, and life.
verses.text: By humility and the fear of Yahuah are riches, and honour, and life.

verses.raw: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that does keep his soul shall be far from them.
verses.text: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that does keep his soul shall be far from them.

verses.raw: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
verses.text: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

verses.raw: The rich rules over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
verses.text: The rich rules over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.

verses.raw: He that sows iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.
verses.text: He that sows iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.

verses.raw: He that has a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he gives of his bread to the poor.
verses.text: He that has a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he gives of his bread to the poor.

verses.raw: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.
verses.text: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.

verses.raw: He that loves pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.
verses.text: He that loves pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.

verses.raw: The eyes of Yahuah (LORD) preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.
verses.text: The eyes of Yahuah preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.

verses.raw: The slothful man says, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.
verses.text: The slothful man says, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.

verses.raw: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of Yahuah (LORD) shall fall therein.
verses.text: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of Yahuah shall fall therein.

verses.raw: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
verses.text: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.

verses.raw: He that oppresses the poor to increase his riches, and he that gives to the rich, shall surely come to want.
verses.text: He that oppresses the poor to increase his riches, and he that gives to the rich, shall surely come to want.

verses.raw: Bow down your ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply your heart unto my knowledge.
verses.text: Bow down your ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply your heart unto my knowledge.

verses.raw: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you; they shall withal be fitted in your lips.
verses.text: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you; they shall withal be fitted in your lips.

verses.raw: That your trust may be in Yahuah (LORD), I have made known to you this day, even to you.
verses.text: That your trust may be in Yahuah, I have made known to you this day, even to you.

verses.raw: Have not I written to you excellent things in counsels and knowledge,
verses.text: Have not I written to you excellent things in counsels and knowledge,

verses.raw: That I might make you know the certainty of the words of truth; that you might answer the words of truth to them that send unto you?
verses.text: That I might make you know the certainty of the words of truth; that you might answer the words of truth to them that send unto you?

verses.raw: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
verses.text: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.
verses.text: For Yahuah will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.

verses.raw: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man you shall not go:
verses.text: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man you shall not go:

verses.raw: Lest you learn his ways, and get a snare to your soul.
verses.text: Lest you learn his ways, and get a snare to your soul.

verses.raw: Be not you one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.
verses.text: Be not you one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.

verses.raw: If you have nothing to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
verses.text: If you have nothing to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?

verses.raw: Remove not the ancient landmark, which your fathers have set.
verses.text: Remove not the ancient landmark, which your fathers have set.

verses.raw: See you a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
verses.text: See you a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.

verses.raw: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you:
verses.text: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you:

verses.raw: And put a knife to your throat, if you be a man given to appetite.
verses.text: And put a knife to your throat, if you be a man given to appetite.

verses.raw: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.
verses.text: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.

verses.raw: Labour not to be rich: cease from your own wisdom.
verses.text: Labour not to be rich: cease from your own wisdom.

verses.raw: Will you set your eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.
verses.text: Will you set your eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.

verses.raw: Eat you not the bread of him that has an evil eye, neither desire you his dainty meats:
verses.text: Eat you not the bread of him that has an evil eye, neither desire you his dainty meats:

verses.raw: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, says he to you; but his heart is not with you.
verses.text: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, says he to you; but his heart is not with you.

verses.raw: The morsel which you have eaten shall you vomit up, and lose your sweet words.
verses.text: The morsel which you have eaten shall you vomit up, and lose your sweet words.

verses.raw: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
verses.text: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of your words.

verses.raw: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:
verses.text: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:

verses.raw: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with you.
verses.text: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with you.

verses.raw: Apply your heart unto instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.
verses.text: Apply your heart unto instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.

verses.raw: Withhold not correction from the child: for if you beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.
verses.text: Withhold not correction from the child: for if you beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.

verses.raw: You shall beat him with the rod, and shall deliver his soul from hell.
verses.text: You shall beat him with the rod, and shall deliver his soul from hell.

verses.raw: My son, if your heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.
verses.text: My son, if your heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.

verses.raw: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when your lips speak right things.
verses.text: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when your lips speak right things.

verses.raw: Let not your heart envy sinners: but be you in the fear of Yahuah (LORD) all the day long.
verses.text: Let not your heart envy sinners: but be you in the fear of Yahuah all the day long.

verses.raw: For surely there is an end; and your expectation shall not be cut off.
verses.text: For surely there is an end; and your expectation shall not be cut off.

verses.raw: Hear you, my son, and be wise, and guide your heart in the way.
verses.text: Hear you, my son, and be wise, and guide your heart in the way.

verses.raw: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
verses.text: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:

verses.raw: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.
verses.text: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.

verses.raw: Hearken unto your father that begat you, and despise not your mother when she is old.
verses.text: Hearken unto your father that begat you, and despise not your mother when she is old.

verses.raw: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
verses.text: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.

verses.raw: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.
verses.text: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.

verses.raw: Your father and your mother shall be glad, and she that bare you shall rejoice.
verses.text: Your father and your mother shall be glad, and she that bare you shall rejoice.

verses.raw: My son, give me your heart, and let your eyes observe my ways.
verses.text: My son, give me your heart, and let your eyes observe my ways.

verses.raw: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.
verses.text: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.

verses.raw: She also lies in wait as for a prey, and increases the transgressors among men.
verses.text: She also lies in wait as for a prey, and increases the transgressors among men.

verses.raw: Who has woe? who has sorrow? who has contentions? who has babbling? who has wounds without cause? who has redness of eyes?
verses.text: Who has woe? who has sorrow? who has contentions? who has babbling? who has wounds without cause? who has redness of eyes?

verses.raw: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.
verses.text: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.

verses.raw: Look not you upon the wine when it is red, when it gives his colour in the cup, when it moves itself aright.
verses.text: Look not you upon the wine when it is red, when it gives his colour in the cup, when it moves itself aright.

verses.raw: At the last it bites like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.
verses.text: At the last it bites like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.

verses.raw: Your eyes shall behold strange women, and your heart shall utter perverse things.
verses.text: Your eyes shall behold strange women, and your heart shall utter perverse things.

verses.raw: Yea, you shall be as he that lies down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lies upon the top of a mast.
verses.text: Yea, you shall be as he that lies down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lies upon the top of a mast.

verses.raw: They have stricken me, shall you say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.
verses.text: They have stricken me, shall you say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.

verses.raw: Be not you envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.
verses.text: Be not you envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.

verses.raw: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.
verses.text: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.

verses.raw: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:
verses.text: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:

verses.raw: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.
verses.text: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.

verses.raw: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increases strength.
verses.text: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increases strength.

verses.raw: For by wise counsel you shall make your war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.text: For by wise counsel you shall make your war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.

verses.raw: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he opens not his mouth in the gate.
verses.text: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he opens not his mouth in the gate.

verses.raw: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.
verses.text: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.

verses.raw: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.
verses.text: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.

verses.raw: If you faint in the day of adversity, your strength is small.
verses.text: If you faint in the day of adversity, your strength is small.

verses.raw: If you forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;
verses.text: If you forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;

verses.raw: If you say, Behold, we knew it not; does not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keeps your soul, does not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?
verses.text: If you say, Behold, we knew it not; does not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keeps your soul, does not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?

verses.raw: My son, eat you honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to your taste:
verses.text: My son, eat you honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to your taste:

verses.raw: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto your soul: when you have found it, then there shall be a reward, and your expectation shall not be cut off.
verses.text: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto your soul: when you have found it, then there shall be a reward, and your expectation shall not be cut off.

verses.raw: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:
verses.text: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:

verses.raw: For a righteous man falls seven times, and rises up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
verses.text: For a righteous man falls seven times, and rises up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.

verses.raw: Rejoice not when your enemy falls, and let not your heart be glad when he stumbleth:
verses.text: Rejoice not when your enemy falls, and let not your heart be glad when he stumbleth:

verses.raw: Lest Yahuah (LORD) see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
verses.text: Lest Yahuah see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.

verses.raw: Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be you envious at the wicked;
verses.text: Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be you envious at the wicked;

verses.raw: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.text: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.

verses.raw: My son, fear you Yahuah (LORD) and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:
verses.text: My son, fear you Yahuah and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:

verses.raw: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knows the ruin of them both?
verses.text: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knows the ruin of them both?

verses.raw: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.
verses.text: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.

verses.raw: He that says unto the wicked, You are righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:
verses.text: He that says unto the wicked, You are righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:

verses.raw: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.
verses.text: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.

verses.raw: Every man shall kiss his lips that gives a right answer.
verses.text: Every man shall kiss his lips that gives a right answer.

verses.raw: Prepare your work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build your house.
verses.text: Prepare your work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build your house.

verses.raw: Be not a witness against your neighbour without cause; and deceive not with your lips.
verses.text: Be not a witness against your neighbour without cause; and deceive not with your lips.

verses.raw: Say not, I will do so to him as he has done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.
verses.text: Say not, I will do so to him as he has done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.

verses.raw: I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
verses.text: I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;

verses.raw: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.
verses.text: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.

verses.raw: Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.
verses.text: Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.

verses.raw: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.text: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

verses.raw: So shall your poverty come as one that travelleth; and your want as an armed man.
verses.text: So shall your poverty come as one that travelleth; and your want as an armed man.

verses.raw: These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) copied out.
verses.text: These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Yahudah copied out.

verses.raw: It is the glory of Elohim (God) to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.
verses.text: It is the glory of Elohim to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.

verses.raw: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.
verses.text: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.

verses.raw: Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.
verses.text: Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.

verses.raw: Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.
verses.text: Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.

verses.raw: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men:
verses.text: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men:

verses.raw: For better it is that it be said unto you, Come up hither; than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince whom your eyes have seen.
verses.text: For better it is that it be said unto you, Come up hither; than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince whom your eyes have seen.

verses.raw: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest you know not what to do in the end thereof, when your neighbour has put you to shame.
verses.text: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest you know not what to do in the end thereof, when your neighbour has put you to shame.

verses.raw: Debate your cause with your neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:
verses.text: Debate your cause with your neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:

verses.raw: Lest he that hears it put you to shame, and your infamy turn not away.
verses.text: Lest he that hears it put you to shame, and your infamy turn not away.

verses.raw: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
verses.text: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.

verses.raw: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.
verses.text: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.

verses.raw: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to them that send him: for he refresheth the soul of his masters.
verses.text: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to them that send him: for he refresheth the soul of his masters.

verses.raw: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.
verses.text: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.

verses.raw: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaks the bone.
verses.text: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaks the bone.

verses.raw: Have you found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for you, lest you be filled therewith, and vomit it.
verses.text: Have you found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for you, lest you be filled therewith, and vomit it.

verses.raw: Withdraw your foot from your neighbour’s house; lest he be weary of you, and so hate you.
verses.text: Withdraw your foot from your neighbour’s house; lest he be weary of you, and so hate you.

verses.raw: A man that bears false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.
verses.text: A man that bears false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.

verses.raw: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.
verses.text: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.

verses.raw: As he that takes away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart.
verses.text: As he that takes away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart.

verses.raw: If your enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:
verses.text: If your enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:

verses.raw: For you shall heap coals of fire upon his head, and Yahuah (LORD) shall reward you.
verses.text: For you shall heap coals of fire upon his head, and Yahuah shall reward you.

verses.raw: The north wind drives away rain: so does an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.
verses.text: The north wind drives away rain: so does an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.

verses.raw: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman and in a wide house.
verses.text: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman and in a wide house.

verses.raw: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
verses.text: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

verses.raw: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.
verses.text: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.

verses.raw: It is not good to eat much honey: so for men to search their own glory is not glory.
verses.text: It is not good to eat much honey: so for men to search their own glory is not glory.

verses.raw: He that has no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.
verses.text: He that has no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.

verses.raw: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.
verses.text: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.

verses.raw: As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.
verses.text: As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.

verses.raw: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool’s back.
verses.text: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool’s back.

verses.raw: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like unto him.
verses.text: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like unto him.

verses.raw: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.
verses.text: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.

verses.raw: He that sends a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinks damage.
verses.text: He that sends a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinks damage.

verses.raw: The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.text: The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

verses.raw: As he that binds a stone in a sling, so is he that gives honour to a fool.
verses.text: As he that binds a stone in a sling, so is he that gives honour to a fool.

verses.raw: As a thorn goes up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.text: As a thorn goes up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

verses.raw: The great Elohim (God) that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.
verses.text: The great Elohim that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.

verses.raw: As a dog returns to his vomit, so a fool returns to his folly.
verses.text: As a dog returns to his vomit, so a fool returns to his folly.

verses.raw: See you a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
verses.text: See you a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

verses.raw: The slothful man says, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.
verses.text: The slothful man says, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.

verses.raw: As the door turns upon his hinges, so does the slothful upon his bed.
verses.text: As the door turns upon his hinges, so does the slothful upon his bed.

verses.raw: The slothful hides his hand in his bosom; it grieves him to bring it again to his mouth.
verses.text: The slothful hides his hand in his bosom; it grieves him to bring it again to his mouth.

verses.raw: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.
verses.text: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.

verses.raw: He that passes by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that takes a dog by the ears.
verses.text: He that passes by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that takes a dog by the ears.

verses.raw: As a mad man who casts firebrands, arrows, and death,
verses.text: As a mad man who casts firebrands, arrows, and death,

verses.raw: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, and says, Am not I in sport?
verses.text: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, and says, Am not I in sport?

verses.raw: Where no wood is, there the fire goes out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceases.
verses.text: Where no wood is, there the fire goes out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceases.

verses.raw: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.
verses.text: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.

verses.raw: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
verses.text: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

verses.raw: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.
verses.text: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.

verses.raw: He that hates dissembleth with his lips, and lays up deceit within him;
verses.text: He that hates dissembleth with his lips, and lays up deceit within him;

verses.raw: When he speaks fair, believe him not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.
verses.text: When he speaks fair, believe him not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.

verses.raw: Whose hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.
verses.text: Whose hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.

verses.raw: Whoso digs a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.
verses.text: Whoso digs a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.

verses.raw: A lying tongue hates those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth works ruin.
verses.text: A lying tongue hates those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth works ruin.

verses.raw: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for you know not what a day may bring forth.
verses.text: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for you know not what a day may bring forth.

verses.raw: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.
verses.text: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.

verses.raw: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool’s wrath is heavier than them both.
verses.text: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool’s wrath is heavier than them both.

verses.raw: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?
verses.text: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?

verses.raw: Open rebuke is better than secret love.
verses.text: Open rebuke is better than secret love.

verses.raw: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
verses.text: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.

verses.raw: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.
verses.text: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.

verses.raw: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.
verses.text: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.

verses.raw: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so does the sweetness of a man’s friend by hearty counsel.
verses.text: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so does the sweetness of a man’s friend by hearty counsel.

verses.raw: Your own friend, and your father’s friend, forsake not; neither go into your brother’s house in the day of your calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.
verses.text: Your own friend, and your father’s friend, forsake not; neither go into your brother’s house in the day of your calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.

verses.raw: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.
verses.text: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.

verses.raw: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.
verses.text: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.

verses.raw: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
verses.text: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.

verses.raw: He that blesses his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.
verses.text: He that blesses his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.

verses.raw: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.
verses.text: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.

verses.raw: Whosoever hides her hides the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself.
verses.text: Whosoever hides her hides the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself.

verses.raw: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens the countenance of his friend.
verses.text: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens the countenance of his friend.

verses.raw: Whoso keeps the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waits on his master shall be honoured.
verses.text: Whoso keeps the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waits on his master shall be honoured.

verses.raw: As in water face answers to face, so the heart of man to man.
verses.text: As in water face answers to face, so the heart of man to man.

verses.raw: Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.
verses.text: Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.

verses.raw: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.
verses.text: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.

verses.raw: Though you should bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.
verses.text: Though you should bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.

verses.raw: Be you diligent to know the state of your flocks, and look well to your herds.
verses.text: Be you diligent to know the state of your flocks, and look well to your herds.

verses.raw: For riches are not for ever: and does the crown endure to every generation?
verses.text: For riches are not for ever: and does the crown endure to every generation?

verses.raw: The hay appears, and the tender grass shows itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.
verses.text: The hay appears, and the tender grass shows itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.

verses.raw: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.
verses.text: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.

verses.raw: And you shall have goats’ milk enough for your food, for the food of your household, and for the maintenance for your maidens.
verses.text: And you shall have goats’ milk enough for your food, for the food of your household, and for the maintenance for your maidens.

verses.raw: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.
verses.text: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.

verses.raw: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.
verses.text: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.

verses.raw: A poor man that oppresses the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.
verses.text: A poor man that oppresses the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.

verses.raw: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.
verses.text: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.

verses.raw: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek Yahuah (LORD) understand all things.
verses.text: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek Yahuah understand all things.

verses.raw: Better is the poor that walks in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
verses.text: Better is the poor that walks in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.

verses.raw: Whoso keeps the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.
verses.text: Whoso keeps the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.

verses.raw: He that by usury and unjust gain increases his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.
verses.text: He that by usury and unjust gain increases his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.

verses.raw: He that turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.
verses.text: He that turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.

verses.raw: Whoso causes the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.
verses.text: Whoso causes the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.

verses.raw: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that has understanding searcheth him out.
verses.text: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that has understanding searcheth him out.

verses.raw: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.
verses.text: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.

verses.raw: He that covers his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
verses.text: He that covers his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.

verses.raw: Happy is the man that fears alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.
verses.text: Happy is the man that fears alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.

verses.raw: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.
verses.text: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.

verses.raw: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hates covetousness shall prolong his days.
verses.text: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hates covetousness shall prolong his days.

verses.raw: A man that does violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.
verses.text: A man that does violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.

verses.raw: Whoso walks uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
verses.text: Whoso walks uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.

verses.raw: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that follows after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
verses.text: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that follows after vain persons shall have poverty enough.

verses.raw: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that makes haste to be rich shall not be innocent.
verses.text: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that makes haste to be rich shall not be innocent.

verses.raw: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.
verses.text: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.

verses.raw: He that hasteth to be rich has an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.
verses.text: He that hasteth to be rich has an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.

verses.raw: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.
verses.text: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.

verses.raw: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and says, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.
verses.text: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and says, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.

verses.raw: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that puts his trust in Yahuah (LORD) shall be made fat.
verses.text: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that puts his trust in Yahuah shall be made fat.

verses.raw: He that trusts in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walks wisely, he shall be delivered.
verses.text: He that trusts in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walks wisely, he shall be delivered.

verses.raw: He that gives unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hides his eyes shall have many a curse.
verses.text: He that gives unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hides his eyes shall have many a curse.

verses.raw: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
verses.text: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.

verses.raw: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
verses.text: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.

verses.raw: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked bears rule, the people mourn.
verses.text: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked bears rule, the people mourn.

verses.raw: Whoso loves wisdom rejoices his father: but he that keeps company with harlots spendeth his substance.
verses.text: Whoso loves wisdom rejoices his father: but he that keeps company with harlots spendeth his substance.

verses.raw: The king by judgment establishes the land: but he that receives gifts overthroweth it.
verses.text: The king by judgment establishes the land: but he that receives gifts overthroweth it.

verses.raw: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreads a net for his feet.
verses.text: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreads a net for his feet.

verses.raw: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous does sing and rejoice.
verses.text: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous does sing and rejoice.

verses.raw: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regards not to know it.
verses.text: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regards not to know it.

verses.raw: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.
verses.text: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.

verses.raw: If a wise man contends with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.
verses.text: If a wise man contends with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.

verses.raw: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.
verses.text: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.

verses.raw: A fool utters all his mind: but a wise man keeps it in till afterwards.
verses.text: A fool utters all his mind: but a wise man keeps it in till afterwards.

verses.raw: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.
verses.text: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.

verses.raw: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: Yahuah (LORD) lighteneth both their eyes.
verses.text: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: Yahuah lighteneth both their eyes.

verses.raw: The king that faithfully judges the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.
verses.text: The king that faithfully judges the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.

verses.raw: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself brings his mother to shame.
verses.text: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself brings his mother to shame.

verses.raw: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increases: but the righteous shall see their fall.
verses.text: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increases: but the righteous shall see their fall.

verses.raw: Correct your son, and he shall give you rest; yea, he shall give delight unto your soul.
verses.text: Correct your son, and he shall give you rest; yea, he shall give delight unto your soul.

verses.raw: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keeps the law, happy is he.
verses.text: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keeps the law, happy is he.

verses.raw: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.
verses.text: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.

verses.raw: See you a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
verses.text: See you a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

verses.raw: He that delicately brings up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
verses.text: He that delicately brings up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.

verses.raw: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man abounds in transgression.
verses.text: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man abounds in transgression.

verses.raw: A man’s pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.
verses.text: A man’s pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.

verses.raw: Whoso is partner with a thief hates his own soul: he hears cursing, and bewrayeth it not.
verses.text: Whoso is partner with a thief hates his own soul: he hears cursing, and bewrayeth it not.

verses.raw: The fear of man brings a snare: but whoso puts his trust in Yahuah (LORD) shall be safe.
verses.text: The fear of man brings a snare: but whoso puts his trust in Yahuah shall be safe.

verses.raw: Many seek the ruler’s favour; but every man’s judgment comes from Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Many seek the ruler’s favour; but every man’s judgment comes from Yahuah.

verses.raw: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.
verses.text: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.

verses.raw: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,
verses.text: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,

verses.raw: Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.
verses.text: Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.

verses.raw: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.
verses.text: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.

verses.raw: Who has ascended up into heaven, or descended? who has gathered the wind in his fists? who has bound the waters in a garment? who has established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you can tell?
verses.text: Who has ascended up into heaven, or descended? who has gathered the wind in his fists? who has bound the waters in a garment? who has established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you can tell?

verses.raw: Every word of Elohim (God) is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
verses.text: Every word of Elohim is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.

verses.raw: Add you not unto his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.
verses.text: Add you not unto his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.

verses.raw: Two things have I required of you; deny me them not before I die:
verses.text: Two things have I required of you; deny me them not before I die:

verses.raw: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
verses.text: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:

verses.raw: Lest I be full, and deny you, and say, Who is Yahuah (LORD)? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my Elohim (God) in vain.
verses.text: Lest I be full, and deny you, and say, Who is Yahuah? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my Elohim in vain.

verses.raw: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse you, and you be found guilty.
verses.text: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse you, and you be found guilty.

verses.raw: There is a generation that curses their father, and does not bless their mother.
verses.text: There is a generation that curses their father, and does not bless their mother.

verses.raw: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.
verses.text: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.

verses.raw: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.
verses.text: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.

verses.raw: There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, and their jaw teeth as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.
verses.text: There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, and their jaw teeth as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.

verses.raw: The horseleach has two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, four things say not, It is enough:
verses.text: The horseleach has two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, four things say not, It is enough:

verses.raw: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that says not, It is enough.
verses.text: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that says not, It is enough.

verses.raw: The eye that mocks at his father, and despises to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.
verses.text: The eye that mocks at his father, and despises to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.

verses.raw: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:
verses.text: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:

verses.raw: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.
verses.text: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.

verses.raw: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eats, and wipeth her mouth, and says, I have done no wickedness.
verses.text: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eats, and wipeth her mouth, and says, I have done no wickedness.

verses.raw: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:
verses.text: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:

verses.raw: For a servant when he reigns; and a fool when he is filled with meat;
verses.text: For a servant when he reigns; and a fool when he is filled with meat;

verses.raw: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
verses.text: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.

verses.raw: There be four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:
verses.text: There be four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:

verses.raw: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
verses.text: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;

verses.raw: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;
verses.text: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;

verses.raw: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;
verses.text: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;

verses.raw: The spider takes hold with her hands, and is in kings’ palaces.
verses.text: The spider takes hold with her hands, and is in kings’ palaces.

verses.raw: There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:
verses.text: There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:

verses.raw: A lion which is strongest among beasts, and turns not away for any;
verses.text: A lion which is strongest among beasts, and turns not away for any;

verses.raw: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.
verses.text: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.

verses.raw: If you have done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if you have thought evil, lay your hand upon your mouth.
verses.text: If you have done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if you have thought evil, lay your hand upon your mouth.

verses.raw: Surely the churning of milk brings forth butter, and the wringing of the nose brings forth blood: so the forcing of wrath brings forth strife.
verses.text: Surely the churning of milk brings forth butter, and the wringing of the nose brings forth blood: so the forcing of wrath brings forth strife.

verses.raw: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
verses.text: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.

verses.raw: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?
verses.text: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?

verses.raw: Give not your strength unto women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
verses.text: Give not your strength unto women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.

verses.raw: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:
verses.text: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:

verses.raw: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.
verses.text: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.

verses.raw: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
verses.text: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.

verses.raw: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
verses.text: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

verses.raw: Open your mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.
verses.text: Open your mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.

verses.raw: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
verses.text: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.

verses.raw: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
verses.text: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.

verses.raw: The heart of her husband does safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
verses.text: The heart of her husband does safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.

verses.raw: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.
verses.text: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.

verses.raw: She seeks wool, and flax, and works willingly with her hands.
verses.text: She seeks wool, and flax, and works willingly with her hands.

verses.raw: She is like the merchants’ ships; she brings her food from afar.
verses.text: She is like the merchants’ ships; she brings her food from afar.

verses.raw: She rises also while it is yet night, and gives meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
verses.text: She rises also while it is yet night, and gives meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.

verses.raw: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
verses.text: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.

verses.raw: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.
verses.text: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.

verses.raw: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goes not out by night.
verses.text: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goes not out by night.

verses.raw: She lays her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.
verses.text: She lays her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.

verses.raw: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reaches forth her hands to the needy.
verses.text: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reaches forth her hands to the needy.

verses.raw: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
verses.text: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

verses.raw: She makes herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.
verses.text: She makes herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.

verses.raw: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.
verses.text: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.

verses.raw: She makes fine linen, and selleth it; and delivers girdles unto the merchant.
verses.text: She makes fine linen, and selleth it; and delivers girdles unto the merchant.

verses.raw: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
verses.text: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.

verses.raw: She opens her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.
verses.text: She opens her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.

verses.raw: She looks well to the ways of her household, and eats not the bread of idleness.
verses.text: She looks well to the ways of her household, and eats not the bread of idleness.

verses.raw: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praises her.
verses.text: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praises her.

verses.raw: Many daughters have done virtuously, but you excellest them all.
verses.text: Many daughters have done virtuously, but you excellest them all.

verses.raw: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that fears Yahuah (LORD), she shall be praised.
verses.text: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that fears Yahuah, she shall be praised.

verses.raw: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
verses.text: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.

verses.raw: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.
verses.text: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Vanity of vanities, says the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.
verses.text: Vanity of vanities, says the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.

verses.raw: What profit has a man of all his labour which he takes under the sun?
verses.text: What profit has a man of all his labour which he takes under the sun?

verses.raw: One generation passes away, and another generation comes: but the earth abides for ever.
verses.text: One generation passes away, and another generation comes: but the earth abides for ever.

verses.raw: The sun also arises, and the sun goes down, and hasteth to his place where he arose.
verses.text: The sun also arises, and the sun goes down, and hasteth to his place where he arose.

verses.raw: The wind goes toward the south, and turns about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returns again according to his circuits.
verses.text: The wind goes toward the south, and turns about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returns again according to his circuits.

verses.raw: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again.
verses.text: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again.

verses.raw: All things are full of labour; man cannot utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
verses.text: All things are full of labour; man cannot utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

verses.raw: The thing that has been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.
verses.text: The thing that has been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.

verses.raw: Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it has been already of old time, which was before us.
verses.text: Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it has been already of old time, which was before us.

verses.raw: There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.
verses.text: There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.

verses.raw: I the Preacher was king over Yashar'el (Israel) in Jerusalem.
verses.text: I the Preacher was king over Yashar'el in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven: this sore travail has Elohim (God) given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith.
verses.text: And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven: this sore travail has Elohim given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith.

verses.raw: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
verses.text: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.

verses.raw: That which is crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.
verses.text: That which is crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.

verses.raw: I communed with my own heart, saying, Lo, I am come to great estate, and have gotten more wisdom than all they that have been before me in Jerusalem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.
verses.text: I communed with my own heart, saying, Lo, I am come to great estate, and have gotten more wisdom than all they that have been before me in Jerusalem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.

verses.raw: And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.
verses.text: And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.

verses.raw: For in much wisdom is much grief: and he that increases knowledge increases sorrow.
verses.text: For in much wisdom is much grief: and he that increases knowledge increases sorrow.

verses.raw: I said in my heart, Go to now, I will prove you with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure: and, behold, this also is vanity.
verses.text: I said in my heart, Go to now, I will prove you with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure: and, behold, this also is vanity.

verses.raw: I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What does it?
verses.text: I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What does it?

verses.raw: I sought in my heart to give myself unto wine, yet acquainting my heart with wisdom; and to lay hold on folly, till I might see what was that good for the sons of men, which they should do under the heaven all the days of their life.
verses.text: I sought in my heart to give myself unto wine, yet acquainting my heart with wisdom; and to lay hold on folly, till I might see what was that good for the sons of men, which they should do under the heaven all the days of their life.

verses.raw: I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards:
verses.text: I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards:

verses.raw: I made me gardens and orchards, and I planted trees in them of all kind of fruits:
verses.text: I made me gardens and orchards, and I planted trees in them of all kind of fruits:

verses.raw: I made me pools of water, to water therewith the wood that brings forth trees:
verses.text: I made me pools of water, to water therewith the wood that brings forth trees:

verses.raw: I got me servants and maidens, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of great and small cattle above all that were in Jerusalem before me:
verses.text: I got me servants and maidens, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of great and small cattle above all that were in Jerusalem before me:

verses.raw: I gathered me also silver and gold, and the peculiar treasure of kings and of the provinces: I gat me men singers and women singers, and the delights of the sons of men, as musical instruments, and that of all sorts.
verses.text: I gathered me also silver and gold, and the peculiar treasure of kings and of the provinces: I gat me men singers and women singers, and the delights of the sons of men, as musical instruments, and that of all sorts.

verses.raw: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.
verses.text: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.

verses.raw: And whatsoever my eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour: and this was my portion of all my labour.
verses.text: And whatsoever my eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour: and this was my portion of all my labour.
