verses.text: I said, I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of the boughs thereof: now also your breasts shall be as clusters of the vine, and the smell of your nose like apples;

verses.raw: And the roof of your mouth like the best wine for my beloved, that goes down sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak.
verses.text: And the roof of your mouth like the best wine for my beloved, that goes down sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak.

verses.raw: I am my beloved’s, and his desire is toward me.
verses.text: I am my beloved’s, and his desire is toward me.

verses.raw: Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; let us lodge in the villages.
verses.text: Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; let us lodge in the villages.

verses.raw: Let us get up early to the vineyards; let us see if the vine flourish, whether the tender grape appear, and the pomegranates bud forth: there will I give you my loves.
verses.text: Let us get up early to the vineyards; let us see if the vine flourish, whether the tender grape appear, and the pomegranates bud forth: there will I give you my loves.

verses.raw: The mandrakes give a smell, and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits, new and old, which I have laid up for you, O my beloved.
verses.text: The mandrakes give a smell, and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits, new and old, which I have laid up for you, O my beloved.

verses.raw: O that you were as my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! when I should find you without, I would kiss you; yea, I should not be despised.
verses.text: O that you were as my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! when I should find you without, I would kiss you; yea, I should not be despised.

verses.raw: I would lead you, and bring you into my mother’s house, who would instruct me: I would cause you to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.
verses.text: I would lead you, and bring you into my mother’s house, who would instruct me: I would cause you to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.

verses.raw: His left hand should be under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.
verses.text: His left hand should be under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.

verses.raw: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that you stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please.
verses.text: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that you stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please.

verses.raw: Who is this that comes up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised you up under the apple tree: there your mother brought you forth: there she brought you forth that bare you.
verses.text: Who is this that comes up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised you up under the apple tree: there your mother brought you forth: there she brought you forth that bare you.

verses.raw: Set me as a seal upon your heart, as a seal upon your arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which has a most vehement flame.
verses.text: Set me as a seal upon your heart, as a seal upon your arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which has a most vehement flame.

verses.raw: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
verses.text: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.

verses.raw: We have a little sister, and she has no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?
verses.text: We have a little sister, and she has no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?

verses.raw: If she be a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver: and if she be a door, we will inclose her with boards of cedar.
verses.text: If she be a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver: and if she be a door, we will inclose her with boards of cedar.

verses.raw: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour.
verses.text: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour.

verses.raw: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand pieces of silver.
verses.text: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand pieces of silver.

verses.raw: My vineyard, which is mine, is before me: you, O Solomon, must have a thousand, and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.
verses.text: My vineyard, which is mine, is before me: you, O Solomon, must have a thousand, and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.

verses.raw: You that dwell in the gardens, the companions hearken to your voice: cause me to hear it.
verses.text: You that dwell in the gardens, the companions hearken to your voice: cause me to hear it.

verses.raw: Make haste, my beloved, and be you like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices.
verses.text: Make haste, my beloved, and be you like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices.

verses.raw: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Yahudah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Yahudah.

verses.raw: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for Yahuah (LORD) has spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
verses.text: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for Yahuah has spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.

verses.raw: The ox knows his owner, and the ass his master’s crib: but Yashar'el (Israel) does not know, my people does not consider.
verses.text: The ox knows his owner, and the ass his master’s crib: but Yashar'el does not know, my people does not consider.

verses.raw: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken Yahuah (LORD), they have provoked the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel) unto anger, they are gone away backward.
verses.text: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken Yahuah, they have provoked the Holy One of Yashar'el unto anger, they are gone away backward.

verses.raw: Why should you be stricken any more? you will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
verses.text: Why should you be stricken any more? you will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

verses.raw: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
verses.text: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.

verses.raw: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
verses.text: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.

verses.raw: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
verses.text: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.

verses.raw: Except Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.
verses.text: Except Yahuah Tseva'ot had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.

verses.raw: Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), you rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our Elohim (God), you people of Gomorrah.
verses.text: Hear the word of Yahuah, you rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our Elohim, you people of Gomorrah.

verses.raw: To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? says Yahuah (LORD): I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.
verses.text: To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? says Yahuah: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.

verses.raw: When you come to appear before me, who has required this at your hand, to tread my courts?
verses.text: When you come to appear before me, who has required this at your hand, to tread my courts?

verses.raw: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.
verses.text: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.

verses.raw: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hates: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear them.
verses.text: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hates: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear them.

verses.raw: And when you spread forth your hands, I will hide my eyes from you: yea, when you make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.
verses.text: And when you spread forth your hands, I will hide my eyes from you: yea, when you make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.

verses.raw: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes; cease to do evil;
verses.text: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes; cease to do evil;

verses.raw: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
verses.text: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.

verses.raw: Come now, and let us reason together, says Yahuah (LORD): though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
verses.text: Come now, and let us reason together, says Yahuah: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

verses.raw: If you be willing and obedient, you shall eat the good of the land:
verses.text: If you be willing and obedient, you shall eat the good of the land:

verses.raw: But if you refuse and rebel, you shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of Yahuah (LORD) has spoken it.
verses.text: But if you refuse and rebel, you shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of Yahuah has spoken it.

verses.raw: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.
verses.text: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.

verses.raw: Your silver is become dross, your wine mixed with water:
verses.text: Your silver is become dross, your wine mixed with water:

verses.raw: Your princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loves gifts, and follows after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither does the cause of the widow come unto them.
verses.text: Your princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loves gifts, and follows after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither does the cause of the widow come unto them.

verses.raw: Therefore says Adonai (Lord), Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the mighty One of Yashar'el (Israel), Ah, I will ease me of my adversaries, and avenge me of my enemies:
verses.text: Therefore says Adonai, Yahuah Tseva'ot, the mighty One of Yashar'el, Ah, I will ease me of my adversaries, and avenge me of my enemies:

verses.raw: And I will turn my hand upon you, and purely purge away your dross, and take away all your tin:
verses.text: And I will turn my hand upon you, and purely purge away your dross, and take away all your tin:

verses.raw: And I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counsellors as at the beginning: afterward you shall be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.
verses.text: And I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counsellors as at the beginning: afterward you shall be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.

verses.raw: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.
verses.text: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.

verses.raw: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake Yahuah (LORD) shall be consumed.
verses.text: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake Yahuah shall be consumed.

verses.raw: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.
verses.text: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.

verses.raw: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that has no water.
verses.text: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that has no water.

verses.raw: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
verses.text: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.

verses.raw: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem.
verses.text: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Yahudah and Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the LORD’S house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the LORD’S house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.

verses.raw: And many people shall go and say, Come you, and let us go up to the mountain of Yahuah (LORD), to the house of the Elohim (God) of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of Yahuah (LORD) from Jerusalem.
verses.text: And many people shall go and say, Come you, and let us go up to the mountain of Yahuah, to the house of the Elohim of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of Yahuah from Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.text: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

verses.raw: O house of Jacob, come you, and let us walk in the light of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: O house of Jacob, come you, and let us walk in the light of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Therefore you have forsaken your people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.
verses.text: Therefore you have forsaken your people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.

verses.raw: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:
verses.text: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:

verses.raw: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:
verses.text: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:

verses.raw: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.
verses.text: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.

verses.raw: Enter into the rock, and hide you in the dust, for fear of Yahuah (LORD), and for the glory of his majesty.
verses.text: Enter into the rock, and hide you in the dust, for fear of Yahuah, and for the glory of his majesty.

verses.raw: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and Yahuah (LORD) alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.text: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and Yahuah alone shall be exalted in that day.

verses.raw: For the day of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:
verses.text: For the day of Yahuah Tseva'ot shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:

verses.raw: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
verses.text: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,

verses.raw: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,
verses.text: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,

verses.raw: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,
verses.text: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,

verses.raw: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.
verses.text: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.

verses.raw: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and Yahuah (LORD) alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.text: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and Yahuah alone shall be exalted in that day.

verses.raw: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
verses.text: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.

verses.raw: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of Yahuah (LORD), and for the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake terribly the earth.
verses.text: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of Yahuah, and for the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake terribly the earth.

verses.raw: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
verses.text: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;

verses.raw: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of Yahuah (LORD), and for the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake terribly the earth.
verses.text: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of Yahuah, and for the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake terribly the earth.

verses.raw: Cease you from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?
verses.text: Cease you from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?

verses.raw: For, behold, Adonai (Lord), Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), does take away from Jerusalem and from Yahudah (Judah) the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water,
verses.text: For, behold, Adonai, Yahuah Tseva'ot, does take away from Jerusalem and from Yahudah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water,

verses.raw: The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,
verses.text: The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,

verses.raw: The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counsellor, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.
verses.text: The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counsellor, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.

verses.raw: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.
verses.text: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.

verses.raw: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.
verses.text: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.

verses.raw: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father, saying, You have clothing, be you our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand:
verses.text: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father, saying, You have clothing, be you our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand:

verses.raw: In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.
verses.text: In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.

verses.raw: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Yahudah (Judah) is fallen: because their tongue and their doings are against Yahuah (LORD), to provoke the eyes of his glory.
verses.text: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Yahudah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings are against Yahuah, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

verses.raw: The shew of their countenance does witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.
verses.text: The shew of their countenance does witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.

verses.raw: Say you to the righteous, that it shall be well with him: for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
verses.text: Say you to the righteous, that it shall be well with him: for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.

verses.raw: Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him: for the reward of his hands shall be given him.
verses.text: Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him: for the reward of his hands shall be given him.

verses.raw: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.
verses.text: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) stands up to plead, and stands to judge the people.
verses.text: Yahuah stands up to plead, and stands to judge the people.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for you have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.
verses.text: Yahuah will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for you have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.

verses.raw: What mean you that you beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts.
verses.text: What mean you that you beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? says Adonai Yahuah of hosts.

verses.raw: Moreover Yahuah (LORD) says, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:
verses.text: Moreover Yahuah says, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:

verses.raw: Therefore Adonai (Lord) will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and Yahuah (LORD) will discover their secret parts.
verses.text: Therefore Adonai will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and Yahuah will discover their secret parts.

verses.raw: In that day Adonai (Lord) will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,
verses.text: In that day Adonai will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,

verses.raw: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,
verses.text: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,

verses.raw: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,
verses.text: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,

verses.raw: The rings, and nose jewels,
verses.text: The rings, and nose jewels,

verses.raw: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,
verses.text: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,

verses.raw: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.
verses.text: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; and burning instead of beauty.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; and burning instead of beauty.

verses.raw: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.
verses.text: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.

verses.raw: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.
verses.text: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.

verses.raw: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by your name, to take away our reproach.
verses.text: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by your name, to take away our reproach.

verses.raw: In that day shall the branch of Yahuah (LORD) be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: In that day shall the branch of Yahuah be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remains in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem:
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remains in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem:

verses.raw: When Adonai (Lord) shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.
verses.text: When Adonai shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night: for upon all the glory shall be a defence.
verses.text: And Yahuah will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night: for upon all the glory shall be a defence.

verses.raw: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.
verses.text: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.

verses.raw: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved has a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:
verses.text: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved has a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:

verses.raw: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.
verses.text: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.

verses.raw: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Yahudah (Judah), judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
verses.text: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Yahudah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.

verses.raw: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?
verses.text: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?

verses.raw: And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:
verses.text: And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:

verses.raw: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
verses.text: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.

verses.raw: For the vineyard of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and the men of Yahudah (Judah) his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.
verses.text: For the vineyard of Yahuah Tseva'ot is the house of Yashar'el, and the men of Yahudah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.

verses.raw: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!
verses.text: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!

verses.raw: In my ears said Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.
verses.text: In my ears said Yahuah Tseva'ot, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.

verses.raw: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.
verses.text: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.

verses.raw: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!
verses.text: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!

verses.raw: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of Yahuah (LORD), neither consider the operation of his hands.
verses.text: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of Yahuah, neither consider the operation of his hands.

verses.raw: Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: and their honourable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.
verses.text: Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: and their honourable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.

verses.raw: Therefore hell has enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoices, shall descend into it.
verses.text: Therefore hell has enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoices, shall descend into it.

verses.raw: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:
verses.text: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:

verses.raw: But Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) shall be exalted in judgment, and Elohim (God) that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.
verses.text: But Yahuah Tseva'ot shall be exalted in judgment, and Elohim that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.

verses.raw: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.
verses.text: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.

verses.raw: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:
verses.text: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:

verses.raw: That say, Let him make speed, and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel) draw nigh and come, that we may know it!
verses.text: That say, Let him make speed, and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Yashar'el draw nigh and come, that we may know it!

verses.raw: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
verses.text: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

verses.raw: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
verses.text: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!

verses.raw: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:
verses.text: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:

verses.raw: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!
verses.text: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!

verses.raw: Therefore as the fire devours the stubble, and the flame consumes the chaff, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and despised the word of the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Therefore as the fire devours the stubble, and the flame consumes the chaff, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of Yahuah Tseva'ot, and despised the word of the Holy One of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Therefore is the anger of Yahuah (LORD) kindled against his people, and he has stretched forth his hand against them, and has smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.text: Therefore is the anger of Yahuah kindled against his people, and he has stretched forth his hand against them, and has smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

verses.raw: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:
verses.text: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:

verses.raw: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:
verses.text: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:

verses.raw: Whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses’ hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:
verses.text: Whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses’ hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:

verses.raw: Their roaring shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry it away safe, and none shall deliver it.
verses.text: Their roaring shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry it away safe, and none shall deliver it.

verses.raw: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.
verses.text: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.

verses.raw: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also Adonai (Lord) sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.
verses.text: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also Adonai sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.

verses.raw: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
verses.text: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.

verses.raw: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): the whole earth is full of his glory.
verses.text: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is Yahuah Tseva'ot: the whole earth is full of his glory.

verses.raw: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
verses.text: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.

verses.raw: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for my eyes have seen the King, Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for my eyes have seen the King, Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:
verses.text: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:

verses.raw: And he laid it upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin purged.
verses.text: And he laid it upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin purged.

verses.raw: Also I heard the voice of Adonai (Lord), saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
verses.text: Also I heard the voice of Adonai, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.

verses.raw: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear you indeed, but understand not; and see you indeed, but perceive not.
verses.text: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear you indeed, but understand not; and see you indeed, but perceive not.

verses.raw: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.
verses.text: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.

verses.raw: Then said I, Adonai (Lord), how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,
verses.text: Then said I, Adonai, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) have removed men far away, and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land.
verses.text: And Yahuah have removed men far away, and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land.

verses.raw: But yet in it shall be a tenth, and it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast their leaves: so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof.
verses.text: But yet in it shall be a tenth, and it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast their leaves: so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Yahudah (Judah), that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Yashar'el (Israel), went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
verses.text: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Yahudah, that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Yashar'el, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.

verses.raw: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind.
verses.text: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind.

verses.raw: Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shear-jashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller’s field;
verses.text: Then said Yahuah unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shear-jashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller’s field;

verses.raw: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
verses.text: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.

verses.raw: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against you, saying,
verses.text: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against you, saying,

verses.raw: Let us go up against Yahudah (Judah), and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal:
verses.text: Let us go up against Yahudah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal:

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.

verses.raw: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.
verses.text: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.

verses.raw: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.
verses.text: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.

verses.raw: Moreover Yahuah (LORD) spake again unto Ahaz, saying,
verses.text: Moreover Yahuah spake again unto Ahaz, saying,

verses.raw: Ask you a sign of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God); ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.
verses.text: Ask you a sign of Yahuah Elohayka; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.

verses.raw: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he said, Hear you now, O house of David; Is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will you weary my Elohim (God) also?
verses.text: And he said, Hear you now, O house of David; Is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will you weary my Elohim also?

verses.raw: Therefore Adonai (Lord) himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
verses.text: Therefore Adonai himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

verses.raw: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
verses.text: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.

verses.raw: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that you abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.
verses.text: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that you abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall bring upon you, and upon your people, and upon your father’s house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Yahudah (Judah); even the king of Assyria.
verses.text: Yahuah shall bring upon you, and upon your people, and upon your father’s house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Yahudah; even the king of Assyria.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (LORD) shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.

verses.raw: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.
verses.text: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.

verses.raw: In the same day shall Adonai (Lord) shave with a razor that is hired, namely, by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.
verses.text: In the same day shall Adonai shave with a razor that is hired, namely, by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall even be for briers and thorns.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall even be for briers and thorns.

verses.raw: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.
verses.text: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.

verses.raw: And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.
verses.text: And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.

verses.raw: Moreover Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Take you a great roll, and write in it with a man’s pen concerning Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
verses.text: Moreover Yahuah said unto me, Take you a great roll, and write in it with a man’s pen concerning Maher-shalal-hash-baz.

verses.raw: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.
verses.text: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.

verses.raw: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said Yahuah (LORD) to me, Call his name Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
verses.text: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said Yahuah to me, Call his name Maher-shalal-hash-baz.

verses.raw: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and my mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.
verses.text: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and my mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) spake also unto me again, saying,
verses.text: Yahuah spake also unto me again, saying,

verses.raw: Forasmuch as this people refuses the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;
verses.text: Forasmuch as this people refuses the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;

verses.raw: Now therefore, behold, Adonai (Lord) brings up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:
verses.text: Now therefore, behold, Adonai brings up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:

verses.raw: And he shall pass through Yahudah (Judah); he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of your land, O Immanuel.
verses.text: And he shall pass through Yahudah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of your land, O Immanuel.

verses.raw: Associate yourselves, O you people, and you shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all you of far countries: gird yourselves, and you shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and you shall be broken in pieces.
verses.text: Associate yourselves, O you people, and you shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all you of far countries: gird yourselves, and you shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and you shall be broken in pieces.

verses.raw: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for Elohim (God) is with us.
verses.text: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for Elohim is with us.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,
verses.text: For Yahuah spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,

verses.raw: Say you not, A confederacy, to all them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear you their fear, nor be afraid.
verses.text: Say you not, A confederacy, to all them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear you their fear, nor be afraid.

verses.raw: Sanctify Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.
verses.text: Sanctify Yahuah Tseva'ot himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.

verses.raw: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Yashar'el (Israel), for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.text: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Yashar'el, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.
verses.text: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.

verses.raw: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
verses.text: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.

verses.raw: And I will wait upon Yahuah (LORD), that hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
verses.text: And I will wait upon Yahuah, that hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

verses.raw: Behold, I and the children whom Yahuah (LORD) has given me are for signs and for wonders in Yashar'el (Israel) from Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), which dwells in mount Zion.
verses.text: Behold, I and the children whom Yahuah has given me are for signs and for wonders in Yashar'el from Yahuah Tseva'ot, which dwells in mount Zion.

verses.raw: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their Elohim (God)? for the living to the dead?
verses.text: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their Elohim? for the living to the dead?

verses.raw: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.
verses.text: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.

verses.raw: And they shall pass through it, hardly bestead and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse their king and their Elohim (God), and look upward.
verses.text: And they shall pass through it, hardly bestead and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse their king and their Elohim, and look upward.

verses.raw: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.
verses.text: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.

verses.raw: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.
verses.text: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.

verses.raw: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them has the light shined.
verses.text: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them has the light shined.

verses.raw: You have multiplied the nation, and not increased the joy: they joy before you according to the joy in harvest, and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.
verses.text: You have multiplied the nation, and not increased the joy: they joy before you according to the joy in harvest, and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.

verses.raw: For you have broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.
verses.text: For you have broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.

verses.raw: For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.
verses.text: For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.

verses.raw: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, El Gibbor (The mighty God), Avi-ad (The everlasting Father), Sar Shalom (The Prince of Peace).
verses.text: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, El Gibbor (The mighty God), Avi-ad (The everlasting Father), Sar Shalom (The Prince of Peace).

verses.raw: Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) will perform this.
verses.text: Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of Yahuah Tseva'ot will perform this.

verses.raw: Adonai (Lord) sent a word into Jacob, and it has lighted upon Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Adonai sent a word into Jacob, and it has lighted upon Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,
verses.text: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,

verses.raw: The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change them into cedars.
verses.text: The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change them into cedars.

verses.raw: Therefore Yahuah (LORD) shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him, and join his enemies together;
verses.text: Therefore Yahuah shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him, and join his enemies together;

verses.raw: The Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Yashar'el (Israel) with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.text: The Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Yashar'el with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

verses.raw: For the people turns not unto him that smites them, neither do they seek Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: For the people turns not unto him that smites them, neither do they seek Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: Therefore Yahuah (LORD) will cut off from Yashar'el (Israel) head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.
verses.text: Therefore Yahuah will cut off from Yashar'el head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.

verses.raw: The ancient and honourable, he is the head; and the prophet that teaches lies, he is the tail.
verses.text: The ancient and honourable, he is the head; and the prophet that teaches lies, he is the tail.

verses.raw: For the leaders of this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.
verses.text: For the leaders of this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.

verses.raw: Therefore Adonai (Lord) shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one is an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.text: Therefore Adonai shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one is an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

verses.raw: For wickedness burns as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up like the lifting up of smoke.
verses.text: For wickedness burns as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up like the lifting up of smoke.

verses.raw: Through the wrath of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.
verses.text: Through the wrath of Yahuah Tseva'ot is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.

verses.raw: And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:
verses.text: And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:

verses.raw: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh: and they together shall be against Yahudah (Judah). For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.text: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh: and they together shall be against Yahudah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

verses.raw: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness which they have prescribed;
verses.text: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness which they have prescribed;

verses.raw: To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!
verses.text: To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!

verses.raw: And what will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which shall come from far? to whom will you flee for help? and where will you leave your glory?
verses.text: And what will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which shall come from far? to whom will you flee for help? and where will you leave your glory?

verses.raw: Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.text: Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

verses.raw: O Assyrian, the rod of my anger, and the staff in their hand is my indignation.
verses.text: O Assyrian, the rod of my anger, and the staff in their hand is my indignation.

verses.raw: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
verses.text: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

verses.raw: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.
verses.text: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.

verses.raw: For he says, Are not my princes altogether kings?
verses.text: For he says, Are not my princes altogether kings?

verses.raw: Is not Calno as Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?
verses.text: Is not Calno as Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?

verses.raw: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;
verses.text: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;

verses.raw: Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
verses.text: Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?

verses.raw: Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when Adonai (Lord) has performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.
verses.text: Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when Adonai has performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.

verses.raw: For he says, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant man:
verses.text: For he says, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant man:

verses.raw: And my hand has found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathers eggs that are left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.
verses.text: And my hand has found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathers eggs that are left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.

verses.raw: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake itself against them that lift it up, or as if the staff should lift up itself, as if it were no wood.
verses.text: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake itself against them that lift it up, or as if the staff should lift up itself, as if it were no wood.

verses.raw: Therefore shall Adonai (Lord), Yahuah Tseva'ot (Lord of hosts), send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.
verses.text: Therefore shall Adonai, Yahuah Tseva'ot, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.

verses.raw: And the light of Yashar'el (Israel) shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;
verses.text: And the light of Yashar'el shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;

verses.raw: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standardbearer fainteth.
verses.text: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standardbearer fainteth.

verses.raw: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.
verses.text: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Yashar'el (Israel), and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon Yahuah (LORD), the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), in truth.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Yashar'el, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon Yahuah, the Holy One of Yashar'el, in truth.

verses.raw: The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto El Gibbor (the mighty God).
verses.text: The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto El Gibbor (the mighty God).

verses.raw: For though your people Yashar'el (Israel) be as the sand of the sea, yet a remnant of them shall return: the consumption decreed shall overflow with righteousness.
verses.text: For though your people Yashar'el be as the sand of the sea, yet a remnant of them shall return: the consumption decreed shall overflow with righteousness.

verses.raw: For Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.
verses.text: For Adonai Yahuah of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts, O my people that dwell in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite you with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against you, after the manner of Egypt.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah of hosts, O my people that dwell in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite you with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against you, after the manner of Egypt.

verses.raw: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and my anger in their destruction.
verses.text: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and my anger in their destruction.

verses.raw: And Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and as his rod was upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.
verses.text: And Yahuah Tseva'ot shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and as his rod was upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.

verses.raw: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he has laid up his carriages:
verses.text: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he has laid up his carriages:

verses.raw: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.
verses.text: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.

verses.raw: Lift up your voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard unto Laish, O poor Anathoth.
verses.text: Lift up your voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard unto Laish, O poor Anathoth.

verses.raw: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.
verses.text: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.

verses.raw: As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
verses.text: As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Behold, Adonai (Lord), Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.
verses.text: Behold, Adonai, Yahuah Tseva'ot, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.

verses.raw: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.
verses.text: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.

verses.raw: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:
verses.text: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:

verses.raw: And the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (LORD);
verses.text: And the spirit of Yahuah shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah;

verses.raw: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of Yahuah (LORD): and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:
verses.text: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of Yahuah: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:

verses.raw: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.
verses.text: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.

verses.raw: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.
verses.text: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.

verses.raw: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.
verses.text: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.

verses.raw: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
verses.text: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.

verses.raw: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice’ den.
verses.text: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice’ den.

verses.raw: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of Yahuah (LORD), as the waters cover the sea.
verses.text: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of Yahuah, as the waters cover the sea.

verses.raw: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.
verses.text: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Adonai (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
