verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Adonai shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

verses.raw: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth.
verses.text: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el, and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah from the four corners of the earth.

verses.raw: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Yahudah (Judah) shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Yahudah (Judah), and Yahudah (Judah) shall not vex Ephraim.
verses.text: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Yahudah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Yahudah, and Yahudah shall not vex Ephraim.

verses.raw: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.
verses.text: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make men go over dryshod.
verses.text: And Yahuah shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make men go over dryshod.

verses.raw: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Yashar'el (Israel) in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Yashar'el in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And in that day you shall say, O Yahuah (LORD), I will praise you: though you were angry with me, your anger is turned away, and you comfortedst me.
verses.text: And in that day you shall say, O Yahuah, I will praise you: though you were angry with me, your anger is turned away, and you comfortedst me.

verses.raw: Behold, Elohim (God) is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for Yahuah (LORD) JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
verses.text: Behold, Elohim is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for Yahuah JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.

verses.raw: Therefore with joy shall you draw water out of the wells of salvation.
verses.text: Therefore with joy shall you draw water out of the wells of salvation.

verses.raw: And in that day shall you say, Praise Yahuah (LORD), call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.
verses.text: And in that day shall you say, Praise Yahuah, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.

verses.raw: Sing unto Yahuah (LORD); for he has done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.
verses.text: Sing unto Yahuah; for he has done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.

verses.raw: Cry out and shout, you inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel) in the midst of you.
verses.text: Cry out and shout, you inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Yashar'el in the midst of you.

verses.raw: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.
verses.text: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.

verses.raw: Lift you up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
verses.text: Lift you up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

verses.raw: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for my anger, even them that rejoice in my highness.
verses.text: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for my anger, even them that rejoice in my highness.

verses.raw: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) mustereth the host of the battle.
verses.text: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: Yahuah Tseva'ot mustereth the host of the battle.

verses.raw: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even Yahuah (LORD), and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
verses.text: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even Yahuah, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.

verses.raw: Howl you; for the day of Yahuah (LORD) is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.
verses.text: Howl you; for the day of Yahuah is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.

verses.raw: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man’s heart shall melt:
verses.text: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man’s heart shall melt:

verses.raw: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.
verses.text: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.

verses.raw: Behold, the day of Yahuah (LORD) comes, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.
verses.text: Behold, the day of Yahuah comes, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.

verses.raw: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
verses.text: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.

verses.raw: And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.
verses.text: And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.

verses.raw: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.
verses.text: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.

verses.raw: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and in the day of his fierce anger.
verses.text: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of Yahuah Tseva'ot, and in the day of his fierce anger.

verses.raw: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man takes up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.
verses.text: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man takes up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.

verses.raw: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.
verses.text: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.

verses.raw: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.
verses.text: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.

verses.raw: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.
verses.text: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.

verses.raw: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.
verses.text: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.

verses.raw: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when Elohim (God) overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.text: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when Elohim overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

verses.raw: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.
verses.text: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.

verses.raw: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.
verses.text: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.

verses.raw: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.
verses.text: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Yashar'el (Israel), and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
verses.text: For Yahuah will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Yashar'el, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.

verses.raw: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Yashar'el (Israel) shall possess them in the land of Yahuah (LORD) for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
verses.text: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Yashar'el shall possess them in the land of Yahuah for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in the day that Yahuah (LORD) shall give you rest from your sorrow, and from your fear, and from the hard bondage wherein you were made to serve,
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in the day that Yahuah shall give you rest from your sorrow, and from your fear, and from the hard bondage wherein you were made to serve,

verses.raw: That you shall take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How has the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!
verses.text: That you shall take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How has the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.
verses.text: Yahuah has broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.

verses.raw: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.
verses.text: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.

verses.raw: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.
verses.text: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.

verses.raw: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at you, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since you are laid down, no feller is come up against us.
verses.text: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at you, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since you are laid down, no feller is come up against us.

verses.raw: Hell from beneath is moved for you to meet you at your coming: it stirreth up the dead for you, even all the chief ones of the earth; it has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
verses.text: Hell from beneath is moved for you to meet you at your coming: it stirreth up the dead for you, even all the chief ones of the earth; it has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

verses.raw: All they shall speak and say unto you, Are you also become weak as we? are you become like unto us?
verses.text: All they shall speak and say unto you, Are you also become weak as we? are you become like unto us?

verses.raw: Your pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of your viols: the worm is spread under you, and the worms cover you.
verses.text: Your pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of your viols: the worm is spread under you, and the worms cover you.

verses.raw: How are you fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how are you cut down to the ground, which did weaken the nations!
verses.text: How are you fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how are you cut down to the ground, which did weaken the nations!

verses.raw: For you have said in your heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of Elohim (God): I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:
verses.text: For you have said in your heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of Elohim: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:

verses.raw: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the El Elyon (most High).
verses.text: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the El Elyon.

verses.raw: Yet you shall be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.
verses.text: Yet you shall be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.

verses.raw: They that see you shall narrowly look upon you, and consider you, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;
verses.text: They that see you shall narrowly look upon you, and consider you, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;

verses.raw: That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners?
verses.text: That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners?

verses.raw: All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.
verses.text: All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.

verses.raw: But you are cast out of your grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.
verses.text: But you are cast out of your grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.

verses.raw: You shall not be joined with them in burial, because you have destroyed your land, and slain your people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.
verses.text: You shall not be joined with them in burial, because you have destroyed your land, and slain your people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.

verses.raw: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.
verses.text: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.

verses.raw: For I will rise up against them, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: For I will rise up against them, says Yahuah Tseva'ot, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
verses.text: Yahuah Tseva'ot has sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:

verses.raw: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.
verses.text: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.

verses.raw: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
verses.text: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.

verses.raw: For Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
verses.text: For Yahuah Tseva'ot has purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?

verses.raw: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.
verses.text: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.

verses.raw: Rejoice not you, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote you is broken: for out of the serpent’s root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.
verses.text: Rejoice not you, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote you is broken: for out of the serpent’s root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.

verses.raw: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill your root with famine, and he shall slay your remnant.
verses.text: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill your root with famine, and he shall slay your remnant.

verses.raw: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; you, whole Palestina, are dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none shall be alone in his appointed times.
verses.text: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; you, whole Palestina, are dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none shall be alone in his appointed times.

verses.raw: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That Yahuah (LORD) has founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.
verses.text: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That Yahuah has founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.

verses.raw: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence;
verses.text: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence;

verses.raw: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off.
verses.text: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off.

verses.raw: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly.
verses.text: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly.

verses.raw: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.
verses.text: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.

verses.raw: My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction.
verses.text: My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction.

verses.raw: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass fails, there is no green thing.
verses.text: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass fails, there is no green thing.

verses.raw: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.
verses.text: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.

verses.raw: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beer-elim.
verses.text: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beer-elim.

verses.raw: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land.
verses.text: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land.

verses.raw: Send you the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.
verses.text: Send you the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.

verses.raw: For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.
verses.text: For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.

verses.raw: Take counsel, execute judgment; make your shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.
verses.text: Take counsel, execute judgment; make your shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.

verses.raw: Let my outcasts dwell with you, Moab; be you a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceases, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.
verses.text: Let my outcasts dwell with you, Moab; be you a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceases, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.

verses.raw: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.
verses.text: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.

verses.raw: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.
verses.text: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.

verses.raw: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kir-hareseth shall you mourn; surely they are stricken.
verses.text: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kir-hareseth shall you mourn; surely they are stricken.

verses.raw: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.
verses.text: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.

verses.raw: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water you with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for your summer fruits and for your harvest is fallen.
verses.text: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water you with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for your summer fruits and for your harvest is fallen.

verses.raw: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.
verses.text: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.

verses.raw: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir-haresh.
verses.text: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir-haresh.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.

verses.raw: This is the word that Yahuah (LORD) has spoken concerning Moab since that time.
verses.text: This is the word that Yahuah has spoken concerning Moab since that time.

verses.raw: But now Yahuah (LORD) has spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble.
verses.text: But now Yahuah has spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble.

verses.raw: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.
verses.text: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.

verses.raw: The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.text: The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

verses.raw: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Yashar'el, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: And in that day it shall come to pass, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.
verses.text: And in that day it shall come to pass, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.

verses.raw: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathers the corn, and reaps the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathers ears in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.text: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathers the corn, and reaps the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathers ears in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.raw: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect that which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.
verses.text: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect that which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.

verses.raw: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Yashar'el (Israel): and there shall be desolation.
verses.text: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Yashar'el: and there shall be desolation.

verses.raw: Because you have forgotten the Elohim (God) of your salvation, and have not been mindful of the rock of your strength, therefore shall you plant pleasant plants, and shall set it with strange slips:
verses.text: Because you have forgotten the Elohim of your salvation, and have not been mindful of the rock of your strength, therefore shall you plant pleasant plants, and shall set it with strange slips:

verses.raw: In the day shall you make your plant to grow, and in the morning shall you make your seed to flourish: but the harvest shall be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.
verses.text: In the day shall you make your plant to grow, and in the morning shall you make your seed to flourish: but the harvest shall be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.

verses.raw: Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!
verses.text: Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!

verses.raw: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but Elohim (God) shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.
verses.text: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but Elohim shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.

verses.raw: And behold at eveningtide trouble; and before the morning he is not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.
verses.text: And behold at eveningtide trouble; and before the morning he is not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.

verses.raw: Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:
verses.text: Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:

verses.raw: That sends ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, saying, Go, you swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!
verses.text: That sends ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, saying, Go, you swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!

verses.raw: All you inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see you, when he lifts up an ensign on the mountains; and when he blows a trumpet, hear you.
verses.text: All you inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see you, when he lifts up an ensign on the mountains; and when he blows a trumpet, hear you.

verses.raw: For so Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs, and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.
verses.text: For so Yahuah said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs, and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.

verses.raw: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away and cut down the branches.
verses.text: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away and cut down the branches.

verses.raw: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.
verses.text: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.

verses.raw: In that time shall the present be brought unto Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) of a people scattered and peeled, and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the mount Zion.
verses.text: In that time shall the present be brought unto Yahuah Tseva'ot of a people scattered and peeled, and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of Yahuah Tseva'ot, the mount Zion.

verses.raw: The burden of Egypt. Behold, Yahuah (LORD) rides upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.
verses.text: The burden of Egypt. Behold, Yahuah rides upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.

verses.raw: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
verses.text: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.

verses.raw: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.
verses.text: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.

verses.raw: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, says Adonai (Lord), Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, says Adonai, Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.
verses.text: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.

verses.raw: And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.
verses.text: And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.

verses.raw: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.
verses.text: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.

verses.raw: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
verses.text: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.

verses.raw: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.
verses.text: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.

verses.raw: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices and ponds for fish.
verses.text: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices and ponds for fish.

verses.raw: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say you unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?
verses.text: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say you unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?

verses.raw: Where are they? where are your wise men? and let them tell you now, and let them know what Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has purposed upon Egypt.
verses.text: Where are they? where are your wise men? and let them tell you now, and let them know what Yahuah Tseva'ot has purposed upon Egypt.

verses.raw: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.
verses.text: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.
verses.text: Yahuah has mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.

verses.raw: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.
verses.text: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.

verses.raw: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), which he shaketh over it.
verses.text: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of Yahuah Tseva'ot, which he shaketh over it.

verses.raw: And the land of Yahudah (Judah) shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that makes mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), which he has determined against it.
verses.text: And the land of Yahudah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that makes mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of Yahuah Tseva'ot, which he has determined against it.

verses.raw: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); one shall be called, The city of destruction.
verses.text: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to Yahuah Tseva'ot; one shall be called, The city of destruction.

verses.raw: In that day shall there be an altar to Yahuah (LORD) in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: In that day shall there be an altar to Yahuah in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to Yahuah.

verses.raw: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto Yahuah (LORD) because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.
verses.text: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto Yahuah Tseva'ot in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto Yahuah because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know Yahuah (LORD) in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto Yahuah (LORD), and perform it.
verses.text: And Yahuah shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know Yahuah in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto Yahuah, and perform it.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it: and they shall return even to Yahuah (LORD), and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.
verses.text: And Yahuah shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it: and they shall return even to Yahuah, and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.

verses.raw: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.
verses.text: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.

verses.raw: In that day shall Yashar'el (Israel) be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, even a blessing in the midst of the land:
verses.text: In that day shall Yashar'el be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, even a blessing in the midst of the land:

verses.raw: Whom Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Yashar'el (Israel) my inheritance.
verses.text: Whom Yahuah Tseva'ot shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Yashar'el my inheritance.

verses.raw: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;
verses.text: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;

verses.raw: At the same time spake Yahuah (LORD) by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off your loins, and put off your shoe from your foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
verses.text: At the same time spake Yahuah by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off your loins, and put off your shoe from your foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said, Like as my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;
verses.text: And Yahuah said, Like as my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;

verses.raw: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
verses.text: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

verses.raw: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
verses.text: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

verses.raw: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?
verses.text: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?

verses.raw: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it comes from the desert, from a terrible land.
verses.text: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it comes from the desert, from a terrible land.

verses.raw: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer deals treacherously, and the spoiler spoils. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.
verses.text: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer deals treacherously, and the spoiler spoils. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.

verses.raw: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.
verses.text: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.

verses.raw: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure has he turned into fear unto me.
verses.text: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure has he turned into fear unto me.

verses.raw: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, you princes, and anoint the shield.
verses.text: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, you princes, and anoint the shield.

verses.raw: For thus has Adonai (Lord) said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he sees.
verses.text: For thus has Adonai said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he sees.

verses.raw: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:
verses.text: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:

verses.raw: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:
verses.text: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:

verses.raw: And, behold, here comes a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he has broken unto the ground.
verses.text: And, behold, here comes a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he has broken unto the ground.

verses.raw: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), have I declared unto you.
verses.text: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el, have I declared unto you.

verses.raw: The burden of Dumah. He calls to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
verses.text: The burden of Dumah. He calls to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?

verses.raw: The watchman said, The morning comes, and also the night: if you will enquire, enquire you: return, come.
verses.text: The watchman said, The morning comes, and also the night: if you will enquire, enquire you: return, come.

verses.raw: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall you lodge, O you travelling companies of Dedanim.
verses.text: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall you lodge, O you travelling companies of Dedanim.

verses.raw: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.
verses.text: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.

verses.raw: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.
verses.text: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.

verses.raw: For thus has Adonai (Lord) said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:
verses.text: For thus has Adonai said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:

verses.raw: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) has spoken it.
verses.text: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el has spoken it.

verses.raw: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth you now, that you are wholly gone up to the housetops?
verses.text: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth you now, that you are wholly gone up to the housetops?

verses.raw: You that are full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: your slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.
verses.text: You that are full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: your slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.

verses.raw: All your rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in you are bound together, which have fled from far.
verses.text: All your rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in you are bound together, which have fled from far.

verses.raw: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.
verses.text: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.

verses.raw: For it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.
verses.text: For it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by Adonai Yahuah of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.

verses.raw: And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.
verses.text: And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that your choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that your choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.

verses.raw: And he discovered the covering of Yahudah (Judah), and you did look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.
verses.text: And he discovered the covering of Yahudah, and you did look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.

verses.raw: You have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
verses.text: You have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.

verses.raw: And you have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have you broken down to fortify the wall.
verses.text: And you have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have you broken down to fortify the wall.

verses.raw: You made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but you have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.
verses.text: You made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but you have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.

verses.raw: And in that day did Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:
verses.text: And in that day did Adonai Yahuah of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:

verses.raw: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.
verses.text: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.

verses.raw: And it was revealed in my ears by Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till you die, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts.
verses.text: And it was revealed in my ears by Yahuah Tseva'ot, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till you die, says Adonai Yahuah of hosts.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts, Go, get you unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, which is over the house, and say,
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah of hosts, Go, get you unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, which is over the house, and say,

verses.raw: What have you here? and whom have you here, that you have hewed you out a sepulchre here, as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high, and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock?
verses.text: What have you here? and whom have you here, that you have hewed you out a sepulchre here, as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high, and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock?

verses.raw: Behold, Yahuah (LORD) will carry you away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover you.
verses.text: Behold, Yahuah will carry you away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover you.

verses.raw: He will surely violently turn and toss you like a ball into a large country: there shall you die, and there the chariots of your glory shall be the shame of your lord’s house.
verses.text: He will surely violently turn and toss you like a ball into a large country: there shall you die, and there the chariots of your glory shall be the shame of your lord’s house.

verses.raw: And I will drive you from your station, and from your state shall he pull you down.
verses.text: And I will drive you from your station, and from your state shall he pull you down.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:

verses.raw: And I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your girdle, and I will commit your government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your girdle, and I will commit your government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Yahudah.

verses.raw: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.
verses.text: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.

verses.raw: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father’s house.
verses.text: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father’s house.

verses.raw: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.
verses.text: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.

verses.raw: In that day, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off: for Yahuah (LORD) has spoken it.
verses.text: In that day, says Yahuah Tseva'ot, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off: for Yahuah has spoken it.

verses.raw: The burden of Tyre. Howl, you ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.
verses.text: The burden of Tyre. Howl, you ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.

verses.raw: Be still, you inhabitants of the isle; you whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.
verses.text: Be still, you inhabitants of the isle; you whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.

verses.raw: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.
verses.text: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.

verses.raw: Be you ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea has spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.
verses.text: Be you ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea has spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.

verses.raw: As at the report concerning Egypt, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
verses.text: As at the report concerning Egypt, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.

verses.raw: Pass you over to Tarshish; howl, you inhabitants of the isle.
verses.text: Pass you over to Tarshish; howl, you inhabitants of the isle.

verses.raw: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.
verses.text: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.

verses.raw: Who has taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth?
verses.text: Who has taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth?

verses.raw: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.
verses.text: Yahuah Tseva'ot has purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.

verses.raw: Pass through your land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.
verses.text: Pass through your land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.

verses.raw: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: Yahuah (LORD) has given a commandment against the merchant city, to destroy the strong holds thereof.
verses.text: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: Yahuah has given a commandment against the merchant city, to destroy the strong holds thereof.

verses.raw: And he said, You shall no more rejoice, O you oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shall you have no rest.
verses.text: And he said, You shall no more rejoice, O you oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shall you have no rest.

verses.raw: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, till the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.
verses.text: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, till the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.

verses.raw: Howl, you ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.
verses.text: Howl, you ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.

verses.raw: Take an harp, go about the city, you harlot that have been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that you may be remembered.
verses.text: Take an harp, go about the city, you harlot that have been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that you may be remembered.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that Yahuah (LORD) will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that Yahuah will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.

verses.raw: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to Yahuah (LORD): it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before Yahuah (LORD), to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
verses.text: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to Yahuah: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before Yahuah, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

verses.raw: Behold, Yahuah (LORD) makes the earth empty, and makes it waste, and turns it upside down, and scatters abroad the inhabitants thereof.
verses.text: Behold, Yahuah makes the earth empty, and makes it waste, and turns it upside down, and scatters abroad the inhabitants thereof.

verses.raw: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.
verses.text: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.

verses.raw: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for Yahuah (LORD) has spoken this word.
verses.text: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for Yahuah has spoken this word.

verses.raw: The earth mourns and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.
verses.text: The earth mourns and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.

verses.raw: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.
verses.text: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.

verses.raw: Therefore has the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
verses.text: Therefore has the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.

verses.raw: The new wine mourns, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.
verses.text: The new wine mourns, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.

verses.raw: The mirth of tabrets ceases, the noise of them that rejoice ends, the joy of the harp ceases.
verses.text: The mirth of tabrets ceases, the noise of them that rejoice ends, the joy of the harp ceases.

verses.raw: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
verses.text: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.

verses.raw: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
verses.text: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

verses.raw: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.
verses.text: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.

verses.raw: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.
verses.text: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.

verses.raw: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree, and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.
verses.text: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree, and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.

verses.raw: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of Yahuah (LORD), they shall cry aloud from the sea.
verses.text: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of Yahuah, they shall cry aloud from the sea.

verses.raw: Wherefore glorify you Yahuah (LORD) in the fires, even the name of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) in the isles of the sea.
verses.text: Wherefore glorify you Yahuah in the fires, even the name of Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el in the isles of the sea.

verses.raw: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, even glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.
verses.text: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, even glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.

verses.raw: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon you, O inhabitant of the earth.
verses.text: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon you, O inhabitant of the earth.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that comes up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that comes up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.

verses.raw: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.
verses.text: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.

verses.raw: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.
verses.text: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (LORD) shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.

verses.raw: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.
verses.text: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.

verses.raw: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.
verses.text: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when Yahuah Tseva'ot shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), you are my Elohim (God); I will exalt you, I will praise your name; for you have done wonderful things; your counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.
verses.text: O Yahuah, you are my Elohim; I will exalt you, I will praise your name; for you have done wonderful things; your counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.

verses.raw: For you have made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
verses.text: For you have made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.

verses.raw: Therefore shall the strong people glorify you, the city of the terrible nations shall fear you.
verses.text: Therefore shall the strong people glorify you, the city of the terrible nations shall fear you.

verses.raw: For you have been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.
verses.text: For you have been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.

verses.raw: You shall bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; even the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.
verses.text: You shall bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; even the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.

verses.raw: And in this mountain shall Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.
verses.text: And in this mountain shall Yahuah Tseva'ot make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.

verses.raw: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.
verses.text: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.

verses.raw: He will swallow up death in victory; and Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for Yahuah (LORD) has spoken it.
verses.text: He will swallow up death in victory; and Adonai Yahuah will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for Yahuah has spoken it.

verses.raw: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this is our Elohim (God); we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is Yahuah (LORD); we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.
verses.text: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this is our Elohim; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is Yahuah; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.

verses.raw: For in this mountain shall the hand of Yahuah (LORD) rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.
verses.text: For in this mountain shall the hand of Yahuah rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.

verses.raw: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreads forth his hands to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.
verses.text: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreads forth his hands to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.

verses.raw: And the fortress of the high fort of your walls shall he bring down, lay low, and bring to the ground, even to the dust.
verses.text: And the fortress of the high fort of your walls shall he bring down, lay low, and bring to the ground, even to the dust.

verses.raw: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Yahudah (Judah); We have a strong city; salvation will Elohim (God) appoint for walls and bulwarks.
verses.text: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Yahudah; We have a strong city; salvation will Elohim appoint for walls and bulwarks.

verses.raw: Open you the gates, that the righteous nation which keeps the truth may enter in.
verses.text: Open you the gates, that the righteous nation which keeps the truth may enter in.

verses.raw: You will keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on you: because he trusts in you.
verses.text: You will keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on you: because he trusts in you.

verses.raw: Trust you in Yahuah (LORD) for ever: for in Yahuah (LORD) JEHOVAH is everlasting strength:
verses.text: Trust you in Yahuah for ever: for in Yahuah JEHOVAH is everlasting strength:

verses.raw: For he brings down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he lays it low; he lays it low, even to the ground; he brings it even to the dust.
verses.text: For he brings down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he lays it low; he lays it low, even to the ground; he brings it even to the dust.

verses.raw: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.
verses.text: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.

verses.raw: The way of the just is uprightness: you, most upright, do weigh the path of the just.
verses.text: The way of the just is uprightness: you, most upright, do weigh the path of the just.

verses.raw: Yea, in the way of your judgments, O Yahuah (LORD), have we waited for you; the desire of our soul is to your name, and to the remembrance of you.
verses.text: Yea, in the way of your judgments, O Yahuah, have we waited for you; the desire of our soul is to your name, and to the remembrance of you.

verses.raw: With my soul have I desired you in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek you early: for when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
verses.text: With my soul have I desired you in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek you early: for when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.

verses.raw: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), when your hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; yea, the fire of your enemies shall devour them.
verses.text: Yahuah, when your hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; yea, the fire of your enemies shall devour them.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), you will ordain peace for us: for you also have wrought all our works in us.
verses.text: Yahuah, you will ordain peace for us: for you also have wrought all our works in us.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD) our Elohim (God), other lords beside you have had dominion over us: but by you only will we make mention of your name.
verses.text: O Yahuah our Elohim, other lords beside you have had dominion over us: but by you only will we make mention of your name.

verses.raw: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore have you visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
verses.text: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore have you visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.

verses.raw: You have increased the nation, O Yahuah (LORD), you have increased the nation: you are glorified: you had removed it far unto all the ends of the earth.
