verses.text: You have increased the nation, O Yahuah, you have increased the nation: you are glorified: you had removed it far unto all the ends of the earth.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), in trouble have they visited you, they poured out a prayer when your chastening was upon them.
verses.text: Yahuah, in trouble have they visited you, they poured out a prayer when your chastening was upon them.

verses.raw: Like as a woman with child, that draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and cries out in her pangs; so have we been in your sight, O Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Like as a woman with child, that draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and cries out in her pangs; so have we been in your sight, O Yahuah.

verses.raw: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
verses.text: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

verses.raw: Your dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, you that dwell in dust: for your dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.
verses.text: Your dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, you that dwell in dust: for your dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.

verses.raw: Come, my people, enter you into your chambers, and shut your doors about you: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
verses.text: Come, my people, enter you into your chambers, and shut your doors about you: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.

verses.raw: For, behold, Yahuah (LORD) comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
verses.text: For, behold, Yahuah comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.

verses.raw: In that day Yahuah (LORD) with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.
verses.text: In that day Yahuah with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.

verses.raw: In that day sing you unto her, A vineyard of red wine.
verses.text: In that day sing you unto her, A vineyard of red wine.

verses.raw: I Yahuah (LORD) do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
verses.text: I Yahuah do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.

verses.raw: Fury is not in me: who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.
verses.text: Fury is not in me: who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.

verses.raw: Or let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; and he shall make peace with me.
verses.text: Or let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; and he shall make peace with me.

verses.raw: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Yashar'el (Israel) shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.
verses.text: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Yashar'el shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.

verses.raw: Has he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?
verses.text: Has he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?

verses.raw: In measure, when it shooteth forth, you will debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.
verses.text: In measure, when it shooteth forth, you will debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.

verses.raw: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin; when he makes all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.
verses.text: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin; when he makes all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.

verses.raw: Yet the defenced city shall be desolate, and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.
verses.text: Yet the defenced city shall be desolate, and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.

verses.raw: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, and set them on fire: for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.
verses.text: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, and set them on fire: for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (LORD) shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and you shall be gathered one by one, O you children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and you shall be gathered one by one, O you children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship Yahuah (LORD) in the holy mount at Jerusalem.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship Yahuah in the holy mount at Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!
verses.text: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!

verses.raw: Behold, Adonai (Lord) has a mighty and strong one, which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.
verses.text: Behold, Adonai has a mighty and strong one, which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.

verses.raw: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:
verses.text: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:

verses.raw: And the glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, and as the hasty fruit before the summer; which when he that looks upon it sees, while it is yet in his hand he eats it up.
verses.text: And the glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, and as the hasty fruit before the summer; which when he that looks upon it sees, while it is yet in his hand he eats it up.

verses.raw: In that day shall Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,
verses.text: In that day shall Yahuah Tseva'ot be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,

verses.raw: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sits in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.
verses.text: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sits in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.

verses.raw: But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment.
verses.text: But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment.

verses.raw: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place clean.
verses.text: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place clean.

verses.raw: Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts.
verses.text: Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts.

verses.raw: For precept must be upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little:
verses.text: For precept must be upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little:

verses.raw: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.
verses.text: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.

verses.raw: To whom he said, This is the rest wherewith you may cause the weary to rest; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.
verses.text: To whom he said, This is the rest wherewith you may cause the weary to rest; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.

verses.raw: But the word of Yahuah (LORD) was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.
verses.text: But the word of Yahuah was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.

verses.raw: Wherefore hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), you scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.
verses.text: Wherefore hear the word of Yahuah, you scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Because you have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:
verses.text: Because you have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believes shall not make haste.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believes shall not make haste.

verses.raw: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.
verses.text: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.

verses.raw: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then you shall be trodden down by it.
verses.text: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then you shall be trodden down by it.

verses.raw: From the time that it goes forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.
verses.text: From the time that it goes forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.

verses.raw: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.
verses.text: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) shall rise up as in mount Perazim, he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon, that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act.
verses.text: For Yahuah shall rise up as in mount Perazim, he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon, that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act.

verses.raw: Now therefore be you not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts a consumption, even determined upon the whole earth.
verses.text: Now therefore be you not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from Adonai Yahuah of hosts a consumption, even determined upon the whole earth.

verses.raw: Give you ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.
verses.text: Give you ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.

verses.raw: Does the plowman plow all day to sow? does he open and break the clods of his ground?
verses.text: Does the plowman plow all day to sow? does he open and break the clods of his ground?

verses.raw: When he has made plain the face thereof, does he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and the rie in their place?
verses.text: When he has made plain the face thereof, does he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and the rie in their place?

verses.raw: For his Elohim (God) does instruct him to discretion, and does teach him.
verses.text: For his Elohim does instruct him to discretion, and does teach him.

verses.raw: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.
verses.text: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.

verses.raw: Bread corn is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it with his horsemen.
verses.text: Bread corn is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it with his horsemen.

verses.raw: This also comes forth from Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), which is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in working.
verses.text: This also comes forth from Yahuah Tseva'ot, which is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in working.

verses.raw: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city where David dwelt! add you year to year; let them kill sacrifices.
verses.text: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city where David dwelt! add you year to year; let them kill sacrifices.

verses.raw: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.
verses.text: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.

verses.raw: And I will camp against you round about, and will lay siege against you with a mount, and I will raise forts against you.
verses.text: And I will camp against you round about, and will lay siege against you with a mount, and I will raise forts against you.

verses.raw: And you shall be brought down, and shall speak out of the ground, and your speech shall be low out of the dust, and your voice shall be, as of one that has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech shall whisper out of the dust.
verses.text: And you shall be brought down, and shall speak out of the ground, and your speech shall be low out of the dust, and your voice shall be, as of one that has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech shall whisper out of the dust.

verses.raw: Moreover the multitude of your strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passes away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.
verses.text: Moreover the multitude of your strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passes away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.

verses.raw: You shall be visited of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.
verses.text: You shall be visited of Yahuah Tseva'ot with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.

verses.raw: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.
verses.text: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.

verses.raw: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth, and, behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinks; but he awakes, and, behold, he is faint, and his soul has appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.
verses.text: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth, and, behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinks; but he awakes, and, behold, he is faint, and his soul has appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.

verses.raw: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry you out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
verses.text: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry you out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) has poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers has he covered.
verses.text: For Yahuah has poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers has he covered.

verses.raw: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray you: and he says, I cannot; for it is sealed:
verses.text: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray you: and he says, I cannot; for it is sealed:

verses.raw: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray you: and he says, I am not learned.
verses.text: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray you: and he says, I am not learned.

verses.raw: Wherefore Adonai (Lord) said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:
verses.text: Wherefore Adonai said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:

verses.raw: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.
verses.text: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.

verses.raw: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from Yahuah (LORD), and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who sees us? and who knows us?
verses.text: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from Yahuah, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who sees us? and who knows us?

verses.raw: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter’s clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?
verses.text: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter’s clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?

verses.raw: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?
verses.text: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?

verses.raw: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.
verses.text: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.

verses.raw: The meek also shall increase their joy in Yahuah (LORD), and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: The meek also shall increase their joy in Yahuah, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:
verses.text: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:

verses.raw: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.
verses.text: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD), who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.

verses.raw: But when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.
verses.text: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.

verses.raw: Woe to the rebellious children, says Yahuah (LORD), that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:
verses.text: Woe to the rebellious children, says Yahuah, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:

verses.raw: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!
verses.text: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!

verses.raw: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.
verses.text: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.

verses.raw: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.
verses.text: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.

verses.raw: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.
verses.text: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.

verses.raw: The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from whence come the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people that shall not profit them.
verses.text: The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from whence come the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people that shall not profit them.

verses.raw: For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength is to sit still.
verses.text: For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength is to sit still.

verses.raw: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:
verses.text: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:

verses.raw: That this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: That this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of Yahuah:

verses.raw: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:
verses.text: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:

verses.raw: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel) to cease from before us.
verses.text: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Yashar'el to cease from before us.

verses.raw: Wherefore thus says the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), Because you despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon:
verses.text: Wherefore thus says the Holy One of Yashar'el, Because you despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon:

verses.raw: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly at an instant.
verses.text: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly at an instant.

verses.raw: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters’ vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water withal out of the pit.
verses.text: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters’ vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water withal out of the pit.

verses.raw: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel); In returning and rest shall you be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and you would not.
verses.text: For thus says Adonai Yahuah, the Holy One of Yashar'el; In returning and rest shall you be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and you would not.

verses.raw: But you said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall you flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.
verses.text: But you said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall you flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.

verses.raw: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall you flee: till you be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill.
verses.text: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall you flee: till you be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill.

verses.raw: And therefore will Yahuah (LORD) wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for Yahuah (LORD) is a Elohim (God) of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.
verses.text: And therefore will Yahuah wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for Yahuah is a Elohim of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.

verses.raw: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: you shall weep no more: he will be very gracious unto you at the voice of your cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer you.
verses.text: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: you shall weep no more: he will be very gracious unto you at the voice of your cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer you.

verses.raw: And though Adonai (Lord) give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not your teachers be removed into a corner any more, but your eyes shall see your teachers:
verses.text: And though Adonai give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not your teachers be removed into a corner any more, but your eyes shall see your teachers:

verses.raw: And your ears shall hear a word behind you, saying, This is the way, walk you in it, when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left.
verses.text: And your ears shall hear a word behind you, saying, This is the way, walk you in it, when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left.

verses.raw: You shall defile also the covering of your graven images of silver, and the ornament of your molten images of gold: you shall cast them away as a menstruous cloth; you shall say unto it, Get you hence.
verses.text: You shall defile also the covering of your graven images of silver, and the ornament of your molten images of gold: you shall cast them away as a menstruous cloth; you shall say unto it, Get you hence.

verses.raw: Then shall he give the rain of your seed, that you shall sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall your cattle feed in large pastures.
verses.text: Then shall he give the rain of your seed, that you shall sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall your cattle feed in large pastures.

verses.raw: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.
verses.text: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.

verses.raw: And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
verses.text: And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

verses.raw: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that Yahuah (LORD) binds up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.
verses.text: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that Yahuah binds up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.

verses.raw: Behold, the name of Yahuah (LORD) comes from far, burning with his anger, and the burden thereof is heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire:
verses.text: Behold, the name of Yahuah comes from far, burning with his anger, and the burden thereof is heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire:

verses.raw: And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing them to err.
verses.text: And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing them to err.

verses.raw: You shall have a song, as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goes with a pipe to come into the mountain of Yahuah (LORD), to the mighty One of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: You shall have a song, as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goes with a pipe to come into the mountain of Yahuah, to the mighty One of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and with the flame of a devouring fire, with scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.
verses.text: And Yahuah shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and with the flame of a devouring fire, with scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.

verses.raw: For through the voice of Yahuah (LORD) shall the Assyrian be beaten down, which smote with a rod.
verses.text: For through the voice of Yahuah shall the Assyrian be beaten down, which smote with a rod.

verses.raw: And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which Yahuah (LORD) shall lay upon him, it shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.
verses.text: And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which Yahuah shall lay upon him, it shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.

verses.raw: For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he has made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of Yahuah (LORD), like a stream of brimstone, does kindle it.
verses.text: For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he has made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of Yahuah, like a stream of brimstone, does kindle it.

verses.raw: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), neither seek Yahuah (LORD)!
verses.text: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Yashar'el, neither seek Yahuah!

verses.raw: Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.
verses.text: Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.

verses.raw: Now the Egyptians are men, and not Elohim (God); and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When Yahuah (LORD) shall stretch out his hand, both he that helps shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.
verses.text: Now the Egyptians are men, and not Elohim; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When Yahuah shall stretch out his hand, both he that helps shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.

verses.raw: For thus has Yahuah (LORD) spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.
verses.text: For thus has Yahuah spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall Yahuah Tseva'ot come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.

verses.raw: As birds flying, so will Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver it; and passing over he will preserve it.
verses.text: As birds flying, so will Yahuah Tseva'ot defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver it; and passing over he will preserve it.

verses.raw: Turn you unto him from whom the children of Yashar'el (Israel) have deeply revolted.
verses.text: Turn you unto him from whom the children of Yashar'el have deeply revolted.

verses.raw: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.
verses.text: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.

verses.raw: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.
verses.text: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.

verses.raw: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, says Yahuah (LORD), whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.
verses.text: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, says Yahuah, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
verses.text: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.

verses.raw: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
verses.text: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.

verses.raw: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.
verses.text: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.

verses.raw: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.
verses.text: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.

verses.raw: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.
verses.text: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.

verses.raw: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against Yahuah (LORD), to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
verses.text: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against Yahuah, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

verses.raw: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.
verses.text: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.

verses.raw: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.
verses.text: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.

verses.raw: Rise up, you women that are at ease; hear my voice, you careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.
verses.text: Rise up, you women that are at ease; hear my voice, you careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.

verses.raw: Many days and years shall you be troubled, you careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.
verses.text: Many days and years shall you be troubled, you careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.

verses.raw: Tremble, you women that are at ease; be troubled, you careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins.
verses.text: Tremble, you women that are at ease; be troubled, you careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins.

verses.raw: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
verses.text: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

verses.raw: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:
verses.text: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:

verses.raw: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;
verses.text: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;

verses.raw: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.
verses.text: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.

verses.raw: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.
verses.text: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.

verses.raw: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
verses.text: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.

verses.raw: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
verses.text: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;

verses.raw: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.
verses.text: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.

verses.raw: Blessed are you that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.
verses.text: Blessed are you that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.

verses.raw: Woe to you that spoilest, and you were not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with you! when you shall cease to spoil, you shall be spoiled; and when you shall make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with you.
verses.text: Woe to you that spoilest, and you were not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with you! when you shall cease to spoil, you shall be spoiled; and when you shall make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with you.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), be gracious unto us; we have waited for you: be you their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
verses.text: O Yahuah, be gracious unto us; we have waited for you: be you their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

verses.raw: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
verses.text: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.

verses.raw: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.
verses.text: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is exalted; for he dwells on high: he has filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
verses.text: Yahuah is exalted; for he dwells on high: he has filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.

verses.raw: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of your times, and strength of salvation: the fear of Yahuah (LORD) is his treasure.
verses.text: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of your times, and strength of salvation: the fear of Yahuah is his treasure.

verses.raw: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
verses.text: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.

verses.raw: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceases: he has broken the covenant, he has despised the cities, he regards no man.
verses.text: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceases: he has broken the covenant, he has despised the cities, he regards no man.

verses.raw: The earth mourns and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.
verses.text: The earth mourns and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.

verses.raw: Now will I rise, says Yahuah (LORD); now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
verses.text: Now will I rise, says Yahuah; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.

verses.raw: You shall conceive chaff, you shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.
verses.text: You shall conceive chaff, you shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.

verses.raw: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
verses.text: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.

verses.raw: Hear, you that are far off, what I have done; and, you that are near, acknowledge my might.
verses.text: Hear, you that are far off, what I have done; and, you that are near, acknowledge my might.

verses.raw: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness has surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
verses.text: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness has surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?

verses.raw: He that walks righteously, and speaks uprightly; he that despises the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shuts his eyes from seeing evil;
verses.text: He that walks righteously, and speaks uprightly; he that despises the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shuts his eyes from seeing evil;

verses.raw: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.
verses.text: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.

verses.raw: Your eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.
verses.text: Your eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.

verses.raw: Your heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?
verses.text: Your heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?

verses.raw: You shall not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than you can perceive; of a stammering tongue, that you can not understand.
verses.text: You shall not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than you can perceive; of a stammering tongue, that you can not understand.

verses.raw: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: your eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
verses.text: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: your eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.

verses.raw: But there the glorious Yahuah (LORD) will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.
verses.text: But there the glorious Yahuah will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) is our judge, Yahuah (LORD) is our lawgiver, Yahuah (LORD) is our king; he will save us.
verses.text: For Yahuah is our judge, Yahuah is our lawgiver, Yahuah is our king; he will save us.

verses.raw: Your tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.
verses.text: Your tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.

verses.raw: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.
verses.text: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.

verses.raw: Come near, you nations, to hear; and hearken, you people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.
verses.text: Come near, you nations, to hear; and hearken, you people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.

verses.raw: For the indignation of Yahuah (LORD) is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he has utterly destroyed them, he has delivered them to the slaughter.
verses.text: For the indignation of Yahuah is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he has utterly destroyed them, he has delivered them to the slaughter.

verses.raw: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
verses.text: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.

verses.raw: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falls off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.
verses.text: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falls off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.

verses.raw: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.
verses.text: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.

verses.raw: The sword of Yahuah (LORD) is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for Yahuah (LORD) has a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.
verses.text: The sword of Yahuah is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for Yahuah has a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.

verses.raw: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.
verses.text: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.

verses.raw: For it is the day of the LORD’S vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.
verses.text: For it is the day of the LORD’S vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.

verses.raw: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
verses.text: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.

verses.raw: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.
verses.text: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.

verses.raw: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.
verses.text: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.

verses.raw: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.
verses.text: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.

verses.raw: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.
verses.text: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.

verses.raw: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.
verses.text: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.

verses.raw: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.
verses.text: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.

verses.raw: Seek you out of the book of Yahuah (LORD), and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it has commanded, and his spirit it has gathered them.
verses.text: Seek you out of the book of Yahuah, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it has commanded, and his spirit it has gathered them.

verses.raw: And he has cast the lot for them, and his hand has divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
verses.text: And he has cast the lot for them, and his hand has divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.

verses.raw: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
verses.text: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.

verses.raw: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of Yahuah (LORD), and the excellency of our Elohim (God).
verses.text: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of Yahuah, and the excellency of our Elohim.

verses.raw: Strengthen you the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
verses.text: Strengthen you the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.

verses.raw: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your Elohim (God) will come with vengeance, even Elohim (God) with a recompence; he will come and save you.
verses.text: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your Elohim will come with vengeance, even Elohim with a recompence; he will come and save you.

verses.raw: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
verses.text: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.

verses.raw: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
verses.text: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.

verses.raw: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes.
verses.text: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes.

verses.raw: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.
verses.text: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.

verses.raw: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:
verses.text: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:

verses.raw: And the ransomed of Yahuah (LORD) shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
verses.text: And the ransomed of Yahuah shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Yahudah (Judah), and took them.
verses.text: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Yahudah, and took them.

verses.raw: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller’s field.
verses.text: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller’s field.

verses.raw: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah’s son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph’s son, the recorder.
verses.text: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah’s son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph’s son, the recorder.

verses.raw: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say you now to Hezekiah, Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein you trust?
verses.text: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say you now to Hezekiah, Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein you trust?

verses.raw: I say, say you, (but they are but vain words) I have counsel and strength for war: now on whom do you trust, that you rebellest against me?
verses.text: I say, say you, (but they are but vain words) I have counsel and strength for war: now on whom do you trust, that you rebellest against me?

verses.raw: Lo, you trust in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.
verses.text: Lo, you trust in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.

verses.raw: But if you say to me, We trust in Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God): is it not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and said to Yahudah (Judah) and to Jerusalem, You shall worship before this altar?
verses.text: But if you say to me, We trust in Yahuah Eloheinu: is it not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and said to Yahudah and to Jerusalem, You shall worship before this altar?

verses.raw: Now therefore give pledges, I pray you, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you be able on your part to set riders upon them.
verses.text: Now therefore give pledges, I pray you, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you be able on your part to set riders upon them.

verses.raw: How then will you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
verses.text: How then will you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

verses.raw: And am I now come up without Yahuah (LORD) against this land to destroy it? Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
verses.text: And am I now come up without Yahuah against this land to destroy it? Yahuah said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

verses.raw: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray you, unto your servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and speak not to us in the Yahudim's (Jews’) language, in the ears of the people that are on the wall.
verses.text: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray you, unto your servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and speak not to us in the Yahudim's (Jews’) language, in the ears of the people that are on the wall.

verses.raw: But Rabshakeh said, Has my master sent me to your master and to you to speak these words? has he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
verses.text: But Rabshakeh said, Has my master sent me to your master and to you to speak these words? has he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?

verses.raw: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Yahudim's (Jews’) language, and said, Hear you the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.
verses.text: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Yahudim's (Jews’) language, and said, Hear you the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.

verses.raw: Thus says the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.
verses.text: Thus says the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.

verses.raw: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in Yahuah (LORD), saying, Yahuah (LORD) will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.text: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in Yahuah, saying, Yahuah will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

verses.raw: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus says the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me: and eat you every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink you every one the waters of his own cistern;
verses.text: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus says the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me: and eat you every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink you every one the waters of his own cistern;

verses.raw: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
verses.text: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

verses.raw: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, Yahuah (LORD) will deliver us. Has any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.text: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, Yahuah will deliver us. Has any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

verses.raw: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
verses.text: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

verses.raw: Who are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that Yahuah (LORD) should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?
verses.text: Who are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that Yahuah should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?

verses.raw: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
verses.text: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

verses.raw: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
verses.text: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
verses.text: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

verses.raw: And they said unto him, Thus says Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
verses.text: And they said unto him, Thus says Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.

verses.raw: It may be Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to reproach the living Elohim (God), and will reprove the words which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has heard: wherefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.
verses.text: It may be Yahuah Elohayka will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to reproach the living Elohim, and will reprove the words which Yahuah Elohayka has heard: wherefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.

verses.raw: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.text: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

verses.raw: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall you say unto your master, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Be not afraid of the words that you have heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
verses.text: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall you say unto your master, Thus says Yahuah, Be not afraid of the words that you have heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

verses.raw: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.
verses.text: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

verses.raw: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
verses.text: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.

verses.raw: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with you. And when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.text: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with you. And when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

verses.raw: Thus shall you speak to Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), saying, Let not your Elohim (God), in whom you trust, deceive you, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.text: Thus shall you speak to Hezekiah king of Yahudah, saying, Let not your Elohim, in whom you trust, deceive you, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

verses.raw: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shall you be delivered?
verses.text: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shall you be delivered?

verses.raw: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Telassar?
verses.text: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Telassar?

verses.raw: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?
verses.text: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?

verses.raw: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of Yahuah (LORD), and spread it before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of Yahuah, and spread it before Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Hezekiah prayed unto Yahuah (LORD), saying,
verses.text: And Hezekiah prayed unto Yahuah, saying,

verses.raw: O Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), that dwell between the cherubims, you are the Elohim (God), even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: you have made heaven and earth.
verses.text: O Yahuah Tseva'ot, Elohim of Yashar'el, that dwell between the cherubims, you are the Elohim, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: you have made heaven and earth.

verses.raw: Incline your ear, O Yahuah (LORD), and hear; open your eyes, O Yahuah (LORD), and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which has sent to reproach the living Elohim (God).
verses.text: Incline your ear, O Yahuah, and hear; open your eyes, O Yahuah, and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which has sent to reproach the living Elohim.

verses.raw: Of a truth, Yahuah (LORD), the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,
verses.text: Of a truth, Yahuah, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,

verses.raw: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.
verses.text: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.

verses.raw: Now therefore, O Yahuah (LORD) our Elohim (God), save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are Yahuah (LORD), even you only.
verses.text: Now therefore, O Yahuah our Elohim, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are Yahuah, even you only.

verses.raw: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Whereas you have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:
verses.text: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, Whereas you have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:

verses.raw: This is the word which Yahuah (LORD) has spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, has despised you, and laughed you to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.
verses.text: This is the word which Yahuah has spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, has despised you, and laughed you to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.

verses.raw: Whom have you reproached and blasphemed? and against whom have you exalted your voice, and lifted up your eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Whom have you reproached and blasphemed? and against whom have you exalted your voice, and lifted up your eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: By your servants have you reproached Adonai (Lord), and have said, By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the height of his border, and the forest of his Carmel.
verses.text: By your servants have you reproached Adonai, and have said, By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the height of his border, and the forest of his Carmel.

verses.raw: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.
verses.text: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.

verses.raw: Have you not heard long ago, how I have done it; and of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that you should be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps.
verses.text: Have you not heard long ago, how I have done it; and of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that you should be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps.

verses.raw: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.
verses.text: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.

verses.raw: But I know your abode, and your going out, and your coming in, and your rage against me.
verses.text: But I know your abode, and your going out, and your coming in, and your rage against me.

verses.raw: Because your rage against me, and your tumult, is come up into my ears, therefore will I put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.
verses.text: Because your rage against me, and your tumult, is come up into my ears, therefore will I put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.

verses.raw: And this shall be a sign unto you, You shall eat this year such as grows of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow you, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.
verses.text: And this shall be a sign unto you, You shall eat this year such as grows of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow you, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.
