verses.raw: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Yahudah (Judah) shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:
verses.text: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Yahudah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:

verses.raw: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) shall do this.
verses.text: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of Yahuah Tseva'ot shall do this.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD) concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.

verses.raw: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: For I will defend this city to save it for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.
verses.text: For I will defend this city to save it for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.

verses.raw: Then the angel of Yahuah (LORD) went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.
verses.text: Then the angel of Yahuah went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.

verses.raw: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
verses.text: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Set your house in order: for you shall die, and not live.
verses.text: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus says Yahuah, Set your house in order: for you shall die, and not live.

verses.raw: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto Yahuah (LORD),
verses.text: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto Yahuah,

verses.raw: And said, Remember now, O Yahuah (LORD), I beseech you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
verses.text: And said, Remember now, O Yahuah, I beseech you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.

verses.raw: Then came the word of Yahuah (LORD) to Isaiah, saying,
verses.text: Then came the word of Yahuah to Isaiah, saying,

verses.raw: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of David your father, I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears: behold, I will add unto your days fifteen years.
verses.text: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus says Yahuah, the Elohim of David your father, I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears: behold, I will add unto your days fifteen years.

verses.raw: And I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.
verses.text: And I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.

verses.raw: And this shall be a sign unto you from Yahuah (LORD), that Yahuah (LORD) will do this thing that he has spoken;
verses.text: And this shall be a sign unto you from Yahuah, that Yahuah will do this thing that he has spoken;

verses.raw: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.
verses.text: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.

verses.raw: The writing of Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:
verses.text: The writing of Hezekiah king of Yahudah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:

verses.raw: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.
verses.text: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.

verses.raw: I said, I shall not see Yahuah (LORD), even Yahuah (LORD), in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
verses.text: I said, I shall not see Yahuah, even Yahuah, in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.

verses.raw: My age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd’s tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night will you make an end of me.
verses.text: My age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd’s tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night will you make an end of me.

verses.raw: I reckoned till morning, that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day even to night will you make an end of me.
verses.text: I reckoned till morning, that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day even to night will you make an end of me.

verses.raw: Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: my eyes fail with looking upward: O Yahuah (LORD), I am oppressed; undertake for me.
verses.text: Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: my eyes fail with looking upward: O Yahuah, I am oppressed; undertake for me.

verses.raw: What shall I say? he has both spoken unto me, and himself has done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.text: What shall I say? he has both spoken unto me, and himself has done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.raw: O Adonai (Lord), by these things men live, and in all these things is the life of my spirit: so will you recover me, and make me to live.
verses.text: O Adonai, by these things men live, and in all these things is the life of my spirit: so will you recover me, and make me to live.

verses.raw: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but you have in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for you have cast all my sins behind your back.
verses.text: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but you have in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for you have cast all my sins behind your back.

verses.raw: For the grave cannot praise you, death can not celebrate you: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for your truth.
verses.text: For the grave cannot praise you, death can not celebrate you: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for your truth.

verses.raw: The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do this day: the father to the children shall make known your truth.
verses.text: The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do this day: the father to the children shall make known your truth.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Yahuah was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.
verses.text: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.

verses.raw: Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of Yahuah (LORD)?
verses.text: Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of Yahuah?

verses.raw: At that time Merodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.
verses.text: At that time Merodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.

verses.raw: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.
verses.text: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.

verses.raw: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto you? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.
verses.text: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto you? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.

verses.raw: Then said he, What have they seen in your house? And Hezekiah answered, All that is in my house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
verses.text: Then said he, What have they seen in your house? And Hezekiah answered, All that is in my house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

verses.raw: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts):
verses.text: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of Yahuah Tseva'ot:

verses.raw: Behold, the days come, that all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Behold, the days come, that all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: And of your sons that shall issue from you, which you shall beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
verses.text: And of your sons that shall issue from you, which you shall beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

verses.raw: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the word of Yahuah (LORD) which you have spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.
verses.text: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the word of Yahuah which you have spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.

verses.raw: Comfort you, comfort you my people, says your Elohim (God).
verses.text: Comfort you, comfort you my people, says your Elohim.

verses.raw: Speak you comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she has received of the LORD’S hand double for all her sins.
verses.text: Speak you comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she has received of the LORD’S hand double for all her sins.

verses.raw: The voice of him that cries in the wilderness, Prepare you the way of Yahuah (LORD), make straight in the desert a highway for our Elohim (God).
verses.text: The voice of him that cries in the wilderness, Prepare you the way of Yahuah, make straight in the desert a highway for our Elohim.

verses.raw: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:
verses.text: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:

verses.raw: And the glory of Yahuah (LORD) shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together: for the mouth of Yahuah (LORD) has spoken it.
verses.text: And the glory of Yahuah shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together: for the mouth of Yahuah has spoken it.

verses.raw: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:
verses.text: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:

verses.raw: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) blows upon it: surely the people is grass.
verses.text: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of Yahuah blows upon it: surely the people is grass.

verses.raw: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our Elohim (God) shall stand for ever.
verses.text: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our Elohim shall stand for ever.

verses.raw: O Zion, that bring good tidings, get you up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bring good tidings, lift up your voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Yahudah (Judah), Behold your Elohim (God)!
verses.text: O Zion, that bring good tidings, get you up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bring good tidings, lift up your voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Yahudah, Behold your Elohim!

verses.raw: Behold, Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
verses.text: Behold, Adonai Yahuah will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.

verses.raw: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
verses.text: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.

verses.raw: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
verses.text: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

verses.raw: Who has directed the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD), or being his counsellor has taught him?
verses.text: Who has directed the Spirit of Yahuah, or being his counsellor has taught him?

verses.raw: With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?
verses.text: With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?

verses.raw: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he takes up the isles as a very little thing.
verses.text: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he takes up the isles as a very little thing.

verses.raw: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.
verses.text: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.

verses.raw: All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.
verses.text: All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.

verses.raw: To whom then will you liken Elohim (God)? or what likeness will you compare unto him?
verses.text: To whom then will you liken Elohim? or what likeness will you compare unto him?

verses.raw: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreads it over with gold, and casts silver chains.
verses.text: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreads it over with gold, and casts silver chains.

verses.raw: He that is so impoverished that he has no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeks unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, that shall not be moved.
verses.text: He that is so impoverished that he has no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeks unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, that shall not be moved.

verses.raw: Have you not known? have you not heard? has it not been told you from the beginning? have you not understood from the foundations of the earth?
verses.text: Have you not known? have you not heard? has it not been told you from the beginning? have you not understood from the foundations of the earth?

verses.raw: It is he that sits upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreads them out as a tent to dwell in:
verses.text: It is he that sits upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreads them out as a tent to dwell in:

verses.raw: That brings the princes to nothing; he makes the judges of the earth as vanity.
verses.text: That brings the princes to nothing; he makes the judges of the earth as vanity.

verses.raw: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.
verses.text: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.

verses.raw: To whom then will you liken me, or shall I be equal? says the Holy One.
verses.text: To whom then will you liken me, or shall I be equal? says the Holy One.

verses.raw: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who has created these things, that brings out their host by number: he calls them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one fails.
verses.text: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who has created these things, that brings out their host by number: he calls them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one fails.

verses.raw: Why say you, O Jacob, and speak, O Yashar'el (Israel), My way is hid from Yahuah (LORD), and my judgment is passed over from my Elohim (God)?
verses.text: Why say you, O Jacob, and speak, O Yashar'el, My way is hid from Yahuah, and my judgment is passed over from my Elohim?

verses.raw: Have you not known? have you not heard, that El Olam (the everlasting God), Yahuah (LORD), the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
verses.text: Have you not known? have you not heard, that El Olam, Yahuah, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.

verses.raw: He gives power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increases strength.
verses.text: He gives power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increases strength.

verses.raw: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:
verses.text: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:

verses.raw: But they that wait upon Yahuah (LORD) shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
verses.text: But they that wait upon Yahuah shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

verses.raw: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew their strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.
verses.text: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew their strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.

verses.raw: Who raised up the righteous man from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made him rule over kings? he gave them as the dust to his sword, and as driven stubble to his bow.
verses.text: Who raised up the righteous man from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made him rule over kings? he gave them as the dust to his sword, and as driven stubble to his bow.

verses.raw: He pursued them, and passed safely; even by the way that he had not gone with his feet.
verses.text: He pursued them, and passed safely; even by the way that he had not gone with his feet.

verses.raw: Who has wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I Yahuah (LORD), the first, and with the last; I am he.
verses.text: Who has wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I Yahuah, the first, and with the last; I am he.

verses.raw: The isles saw it, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.
verses.text: The isles saw it, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.

verses.raw: They helped every one his neighbour; and every one said to his brother, Be of good courage.
verses.text: They helped every one his neighbour; and every one said to his brother, Be of good courage.

verses.raw: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.
verses.text: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.

verses.raw: But you, Yashar'el (Israel), are my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.
verses.text: But you, Yashar'el, are my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.

verses.raw: You whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called you from the chief men thereof, and said unto you, You are my servant; I have chosen you, and not cast you away.
verses.text: You whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called you from the chief men thereof, and said unto you, You are my servant; I have chosen you, and not cast you away.

verses.raw: Fear you not; for I am with you: be not dismayed; for I am your Elohim (God): I will strengthen you; yea, I will help you; yea, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
verses.text: Fear you not; for I am with you: be not dismayed; for I am your Elohim: I will strengthen you; yea, I will help you; yea, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

verses.raw: Behold, all they that were incensed against you shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with you shall perish.
verses.text: Behold, all they that were incensed against you shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with you shall perish.

verses.raw: You shall seek them, and shall not find them, even them that contended with you: they that war against you shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.
verses.text: You shall seek them, and shall not find them, even them that contended with you: they that war against you shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.

verses.raw: For I Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will hold your right hand, saying unto you, Fear not; I will help you.
verses.text: For I Yahuah Elohayka will hold your right hand, saying unto you, Fear not; I will help you.

verses.raw: Fear not, you worm Jacob, and you men of Yashar'el (Israel); I will help you, says Yahuah (LORD), and your redeemer, the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Fear not, you worm Jacob, and you men of Yashar'el; I will help you, says Yahuah, and your redeemer, the Holy One of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Behold, I will make you a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: you shall thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shall make the hills as chaff.
verses.text: Behold, I will make you a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: you shall thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shall make the hills as chaff.

verses.raw: You shall fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and you shall rejoice in Yahuah (LORD), and shall glory in the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: You shall fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and you shall rejoice in Yahuah, and shall glory in the Holy One of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: When the poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue fails for thirst, I Yahuah (LORD) will hear them, I the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) will not forsake them.
verses.text: When the poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue fails for thirst, I Yahuah will hear them, I the Elohim of Yashar'el will not forsake them.

verses.raw: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
verses.text: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

verses.raw: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, and the pine, and the box tree together:
verses.text: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, and the pine, and the box tree together:

verses.raw: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of Yahuah (LORD) has done this, and the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel) has created it.
verses.text: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of Yahuah has done this, and the Holy One of Yashar'el has created it.

verses.raw: Produce your cause, says Yahuah (LORD); bring forth your strong reasons, says the King of Jacob.
verses.text: Produce your cause, says Yahuah; bring forth your strong reasons, says the King of Jacob.

verses.raw: Let them bring them forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they be, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.
verses.text: Let them bring them forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they be, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.

verses.raw: Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold it together.
verses.text: Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold it together.

verses.raw: Behold, you are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination is he that chooseth you.
verses.text: Behold, you are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination is he that chooseth you.

verses.raw: I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as upon morter, and as the potter treads clay.
verses.text: I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as upon morter, and as the potter treads clay.

verses.raw: Who has declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, He is righteous? yea, there is none that shows, yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that hears your words.
verses.text: Who has declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, He is righteous? yea, there is none that shows, yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that hears your words.

verses.raw: The first shall say to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that brings good tidings.
verses.text: The first shall say to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that brings good tidings.

verses.raw: For I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, and there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.
verses.text: For I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, and there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.

verses.raw: Behold, they are all vanity; their works are nothing: their molten images are wind and confusion.
verses.text: Behold, they are all vanity; their works are nothing: their molten images are wind and confusion.

verses.raw: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; my elect, in whom my soul delights; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.
verses.text: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; my elect, in whom my soul delights; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.

verses.raw: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.
verses.text: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.

verses.raw: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
verses.text: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.

verses.raw: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.
verses.text: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.

verses.raw: Thus says Elohim (God) Yahuah (LORD), he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which comes out of it; he that gives breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:
verses.text: Thus says Elohim Yahuah, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which comes out of it; he that gives breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:

verses.raw: I Yahuah (LORD) have called you in righteousness, and will hold your hand, and will keep you, and give you for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;
verses.text: I Yahuah have called you in righteousness, and will hold your hand, and will keep you, and give you for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;

verses.raw: To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.
verses.text: To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.

verses.raw: I am Yahuah (LORD): that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.
verses.text: I am Yahuah: that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.

verses.raw: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.
verses.text: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.

verses.raw: Sing unto Yahuah (LORD) a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.text: Sing unto Yahuah a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.

verses.raw: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar does inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.
verses.text: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar does inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.

verses.raw: Let them give glory unto Yahuah (LORD), and declare his praise in the islands.
verses.text: Let them give glory unto Yahuah, and declare his praise in the islands.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.
verses.text: Yahuah shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.

verses.raw: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself: now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.
verses.text: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself: now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.

verses.raw: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.
verses.text: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.

verses.raw: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.
verses.text: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.

verses.raw: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, You are our gods.
verses.text: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, You are our gods.

verses.raw: Hear, you deaf; and look, you blind, that you may see.
verses.text: Hear, you deaf; and look, you blind, that you may see.

verses.raw: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent? who is blind as he that is perfect, and blind as the LORD’S servant?
verses.text: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent? who is blind as he that is perfect, and blind as the LORD’S servant?

verses.raw: Seeing many things, but you observest not; opening the ears, but he hears not.
verses.text: Seeing many things, but you observest not; opening the ears, but he hears not.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is well pleased for his righteousness’ sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable.
verses.text: Yahuah is well pleased for his righteousness’ sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable.

verses.raw: But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivers; for a spoil, and none says, Restore.
verses.text: But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivers; for a spoil, and none says, Restore.

verses.raw: Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?
verses.text: Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?

verses.raw: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Yashar'el (Israel) to the robbers? did not Yahuah (LORD), he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.
verses.text: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Yashar'el to the robbers? did not Yahuah, he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.

verses.raw: Therefore he has poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it has set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.
verses.text: Therefore he has poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it has set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.

verses.raw: But now thus says Yahuah (LORD) that created you, O Jacob, and he that formed you, O Yashar'el (Israel), Fear not: for I have redeemed you, I have called you by your name; you are mine.
verses.text: But now thus says Yahuah that created you, O Jacob, and he that formed you, O Yashar'el, Fear not: for I have redeemed you, I have called you by your name; you are mine.

verses.raw: When you passest through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow you: when you walk through the fire, you shall not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon you.
verses.text: When you passest through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow you: when you walk through the fire, you shall not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon you.

verses.raw: For I am Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), your Saviour: I gave Egypt for your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for you.
verses.text: For I am Yahuah Elohayka, the Holy One of Yashar'el, your Saviour: I gave Egypt for your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for you.

verses.raw: Since you were precious in my sight, you have been honourable, and I have loved you: therefore will I give men for you, and people for your life.
verses.text: Since you were precious in my sight, you have been honourable, and I have loved you: therefore will I give men for you, and people for your life.

verses.raw: Fear not: for I am with you: I will bring your seed from the east, and gather you from the west;
verses.text: Fear not: for I am with you: I will bring your seed from the east, and gather you from the west;

verses.raw: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;
verses.text: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;

verses.raw: Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.
verses.text: Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.

verses.raw: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.
verses.text: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.

verses.raw: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, It is truth.
verses.text: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, It is truth.

verses.raw: You are my witnesses, says Yahuah (LORD), and my servant whom I have chosen: that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no Elohim (God) formed, neither shall there be after me.
verses.text: You are my witnesses, says Yahuah, and my servant whom I have chosen: that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no Elohim formed, neither shall there be after me.

verses.raw: I, even I, am Yahuah (LORD); and beside me there is no saviour.
verses.text: I, even I, am Yahuah; and beside me there is no saviour.

verses.raw: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you: therefore you are my witnesses, says Yahuah (LORD), that I am Elohim (God).
verses.text: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you: therefore you are my witnesses, says Yahuah, that I am Elohim.

verses.raw: Yea, before the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?
verses.text: Yea, before the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), your redeemer, the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel); For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, your redeemer, the Holy One of Yashar'el; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships.

verses.raw: I am Yahuah (LORD), your Holy One, the creator of Yashar'el (Israel), your King.
verses.text: I am Yahuah, your Holy One, the creator of Yashar'el, your King.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), which makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, which makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;

verses.raw: Which brings forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.
verses.text: Which brings forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.

verses.raw: Remember you not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
verses.text: Remember you not the former things, neither consider the things of old.

verses.raw: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall you not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verses.text: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall you not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

verses.raw: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.
verses.text: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.

verses.raw: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.
verses.text: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.

verses.raw: But you have not called upon me, O Jacob; but you have been weary of me, O Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But you have not called upon me, O Jacob; but you have been weary of me, O Yashar'el.

verses.raw: You have not brought me the small cattle of your burnt offerings; neither have you honoured me with your sacrifices. I have not caused you to serve with an offering, nor wearied you with incense.
verses.text: You have not brought me the small cattle of your burnt offerings; neither have you honoured me with your sacrifices. I have not caused you to serve with an offering, nor wearied you with incense.

verses.raw: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, neither have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices: but you have made me to serve with your sins, you have wearied me with your iniquities.
verses.text: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, neither have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices: but you have made me to serve with your sins, you have wearied me with your iniquities.

verses.raw: I, even I, am he that blotteth out your transgressions for my own sake, and will not remember your sins.
verses.text: I, even I, am he that blotteth out your transgressions for my own sake, and will not remember your sins.

verses.raw: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare you, that you may be justified.
verses.text: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare you, that you may be justified.

verses.raw: Your first father has sinned, and your teachers have transgressed against me.
verses.text: Your first father has sinned, and your teachers have transgressed against me.

verses.raw: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Yashar'el (Israel) to reproaches.
verses.text: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Yashar'el to reproaches.

verses.raw: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Yashar'el (Israel), whom I have chosen:
verses.text: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Yashar'el, whom I have chosen:

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) that made you, and formed you from the womb, which will help you; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and you, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah that made you, and formed you from the womb, which will help you; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and you, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.

verses.raw: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon your seed, and my blessing upon your offspring:
verses.text: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon your seed, and my blessing upon your offspring:

verses.raw: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.
verses.text: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.

verses.raw: One shall say, I am the LORD’S; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto Yahuah (LORD), and surname himself by the name of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: One shall say, I am the LORD’S; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto Yahuah, and surname himself by the name of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) the King of Yashar'el (Israel), and his redeemer Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no Elohim (God).
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah the King of Yashar'el, and his redeemer Yahuah Tseva'ot; I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no Elohim.

verses.raw: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.
verses.text: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.

verses.raw: Fear you not, neither be afraid: have not I told you from that time, and have declared it? you are even my witnesses. Is there a Elohim (God) beside me? yea, there is no Elohim (God); I know not any.
verses.text: Fear you not, neither be afraid: have not I told you from that time, and have declared it? you are even my witnesses. Is there a Elohim beside me? yea, there is no Elohim; I know not any.

verses.raw: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.
verses.text: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.

verses.raw: Who has formed a god, or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing?
verses.text: Who has formed a god, or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing?

verses.raw: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.
verses.text: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.

verses.raw: The smith with the tongs both works in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and works it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength fails: he drinks no water, and is faint.
verses.text: The smith with the tongs both works in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and works it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength fails: he drinks no water, and is faint.

verses.raw: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and makes it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.
verses.text: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and makes it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.

verses.raw: He heweth him down cedars, and takes the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain does nourish it.
verses.text: He heweth him down cedars, and takes the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain does nourish it.

verses.raw: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he makes a god, and worshippeth it; he makes it a graven image, and falls down thereto.
verses.text: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he makes a god, and worshippeth it; he makes it a graven image, and falls down thereto.

verses.raw: He burns part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eats flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, and says, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:
verses.text: He burns part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eats flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, and says, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:

verses.raw: And the residue thereof he makes a god, even his graven image: he falls down unto it, and worshippeth it, and prayeth unto it, and says, Deliver me; for you are my god.
verses.text: And the residue thereof he makes a god, even his graven image: he falls down unto it, and worshippeth it, and prayeth unto it, and says, Deliver me; for you are my god.

verses.raw: They have not known nor understood: for he has shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.
verses.text: They have not known nor understood: for he has shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.

verses.raw: And none considereth in his heart, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?
verses.text: And none considereth in his heart, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?

verses.raw: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart has turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?
verses.text: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart has turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?

verses.raw: Remember these, O Jacob and Yashar'el (Israel); for you are my servant: I have formed you; you are my servant: O Yashar'el (Israel), you shall not be forgotten of me.
verses.text: Remember these, O Jacob and Yashar'el; for you are my servant: I have formed you; you are my servant: O Yashar'el, you shall not be forgotten of me.

verses.raw: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed you.
verses.text: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed you.

verses.raw: Sing, O you heavens; for Yahuah (LORD) has done it: shout, you lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, you mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for Yahuah (LORD) has redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Sing, O you heavens; for Yahuah has done it: shout, you lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, you mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for Yahuah has redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), your redeemer, and he that formed you from the womb, I am Yahuah (LORD) that makes all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreads abroad the earth by myself;
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, your redeemer, and he that formed you from the womb, I am Yahuah that makes all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreads abroad the earth by myself;

verses.raw: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and makes diviners mad; that turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge foolish;
verses.text: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and makes diviners mad; that turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge foolish;

verses.raw: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performs the counsel of his messengers; that says to Jerusalem, You shall be inhabited; and to the cities of Yahudah (Judah), You shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:
verses.text: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performs the counsel of his messengers; that says to Jerusalem, You shall be inhabited; and to the cities of Yahudah, You shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:

verses.raw: That says to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up your rivers:
verses.text: That says to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up your rivers:

verses.raw: That says of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, You shall be built; and to the temple, Your foundation shall be laid.
verses.text: That says of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, You shall be built; and to the temple, Your foundation shall be laid.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;

verses.raw: I will go before you, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:
verses.text: I will go before you, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:

verses.raw: And I will give you the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that I, Yahuah (LORD), which call you by your name, am the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And I will give you the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that I, Yahuah, which call you by your name, am the Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Yashar'el (Israel) my elect, I have even called you by your name: I have surnamed you, though you have not known me.
verses.text: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Yashar'el my elect, I have even called you by your name: I have surnamed you, though you have not known me.

verses.raw: I am Yahuah (LORD), and there is none else, there is no Elohim (God) beside me: I girded you, though you have not known me:
verses.text: I am Yahuah, and there is none else, there is no Elohim beside me: I girded you, though you have not known me:

verses.raw: That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none beside me. I am Yahuah (LORD), and there is none else.
verses.text: That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none beside me. I am Yahuah, and there is none else.

verses.raw: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I Yahuah (LORD) do all these things.
verses.text: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I Yahuah do all these things.

verses.raw: Drop down, you heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I Yahuah (LORD) have created it.
verses.text: Drop down, you heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I Yahuah have created it.

verses.raw: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What make you? or your work, He has no hands?
verses.text: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What make you? or your work, He has no hands?

verses.raw: Woe unto him that says unto his father, What begettest you? or to the woman, What have you brought forth?
verses.text: Woe unto him that says unto his father, What begettest you? or to the woman, What have you brought forth?

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command you me.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, the Holy One of Yashar'el, and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command you me.

verses.raw: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.
verses.text: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.

verses.raw: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto you, and they shall be yours: they shall come after you; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto you, they shall make supplication unto you, saying, Surely Elohim (God) is in you; and there is none else, there is no Elohim (God).
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto you, and they shall be yours: they shall come after you; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto you, they shall make supplication unto you, saying, Surely Elohim is in you; and there is none else, there is no Elohim.

verses.raw: Verily you are a Elohim (God) that hide thyself, O Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), the Saviour.
verses.text: Verily you are a Elohim that hide thyself, O Elohim of Yashar'el, the Saviour.

verses.raw: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.
verses.text: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.

verses.raw: But Yashar'el (Israel) shall be saved in Yahuah (LORD) with an everlasting salvation: you shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.
verses.text: But Yashar'el shall be saved in Yahuah with an everlasting salvation: you shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD) that created the heavens; Elohim (God) himself that formed the earth and made it; he has established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am Yahuah (LORD); and there is none else.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah that created the heavens; Elohim himself that formed the earth and made it; he has established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am Yahuah; and there is none else.

verses.raw: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek you me in vain: I Yahuah (LORD) speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.
verses.text: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek you me in vain: I Yahuah speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.

verses.raw: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, you that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.
verses.text: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, you that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.

verses.raw: Tell you, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who has declared this from ancient time? who has told it from that time? have not I Yahuah (LORD)? and there is no Elohim (God) else beside me; a just Elohim (God) and a Saviour; there is none beside me.
verses.text: Tell you, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who has declared this from ancient time? who has told it from that time? have not I Yahuah? and there is no Elohim else beside me; a just Elohim and a Saviour; there is none beside me.

verses.raw: Look unto me, and be you saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am Elohim (God), and there is none else.
verses.text: Look unto me, and be you saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am Elohim, and there is none else.

verses.raw: I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.
verses.text: I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.

verses.raw: Surely, shall one say, in Yahuah (LORD) have I righteousness and strength: even to him shall men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.
verses.text: Surely, shall one say, in Yahuah have I righteousness and strength: even to him shall men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.

verses.raw: In Yahuah (LORD) shall all the seed of Yashar'el (Israel) be justified, and shall glory.
verses.text: In Yahuah shall all the seed of Yashar'el be justified, and shall glory.

verses.raw: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: your carriages were heavy loaden; they are a burden to the weary beast.
verses.text: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: your carriages were heavy loaden; they are a burden to the weary beast.

verses.raw: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.
verses.text: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.

verses.raw: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb:
verses.text: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Yashar'el, which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb:

verses.raw: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.
verses.text: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.

verses.raw: To whom will you liken me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?
verses.text: To whom will you liken me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?

verses.raw: They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, and hire a goldsmith; and he makes it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.
verses.text: They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, and hire a goldsmith; and he makes it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.

verses.raw: They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, and he stands; from his place shall he not remove: yea, one shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.
verses.text: They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, and he stands; from his place shall he not remove: yea, one shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.

verses.raw: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O you transgressors.
verses.text: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O you transgressors.

verses.raw: Remember the former things of old: for I am Elohim (God), and there is none else; I am Elohim (God), and there is none like me,
verses.text: Remember the former things of old: for I am Elohim, and there is none else; I am Elohim, and there is none like me,

verses.raw: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure:
verses.text: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure:

verses.raw: Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken it, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed it, I will also do it.
verses.text: Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken it, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed it, I will also do it.

verses.raw: Hearken unto me, you stouthearted, that are far from righteousness:
verses.text: Hearken unto me, you stouthearted, that are far from righteousness:

verses.raw: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Yashar'el (Israel) my glory.
verses.text: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Yashar'el my glory.

verses.raw: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for you shall no more be called tender and delicate.
verses.text: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for you shall no more be called tender and delicate.

verses.raw: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover your locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.
verses.text: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover your locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.

verses.raw: Your nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, your shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet you as a man.
verses.text: Your nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, your shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet you as a man.

verses.raw: As for our redeemer, Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name, the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: As for our redeemer, Yahuah Tseva'ot is his name, the Holy One of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Sit you silent, and get you into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for you shall no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.
verses.text: Sit you silent, and get you into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for you shall no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.

verses.raw: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted my inheritance, and given them into your hand: you did shew them no mercy; upon the ancient have you very heavily laid your yoke.
verses.text: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted my inheritance, and given them into your hand: you did shew them no mercy; upon the ancient have you very heavily laid your yoke.

verses.raw: And you saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that you did not lay these things to your heart, neither did remember the latter end of it.
verses.text: And you saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that you did not lay these things to your heart, neither did remember the latter end of it.

verses.raw: Therefore hear now this, you that are given to pleasures, that dwell carelessly, that say in your heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:
verses.text: Therefore hear now this, you that are given to pleasures, that dwell carelessly, that say in your heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:

verses.raw: But these two things shall come to you in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon you in their perfection for the multitude of your sorceries, and for the great abundance of your enchantments.
verses.text: But these two things shall come to you in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon you in their perfection for the multitude of your sorceries, and for the great abundance of your enchantments.

verses.raw: For you have trusted in your wickedness: you have said, None sees me. Your wisdom and your knowledge, it has perverted you; and you have said in your heart, I am, and none else beside me.
verses.text: For you have trusted in your wickedness: you have said, None sees me. Your wisdom and your knowledge, it has perverted you; and you have said in your heart, I am, and none else beside me.

verses.raw: Therefore shall evil come upon you; you shall not know from whence it rises: and mischief shall fall upon you; you shall not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon you suddenly, which you shall not know.
verses.text: Therefore shall evil come upon you; you shall not know from whence it rises: and mischief shall fall upon you; you shall not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon you suddenly, which you shall not know.

verses.raw: Stand now with your enchantments, and with the multitude of your sorceries, wherein you have laboured from your youth; if so be you shall be able to profit, if so be you may prevail.
verses.text: Stand now with your enchantments, and with the multitude of your sorceries, wherein you have laboured from your youth; if so be you shall be able to profit, if so be you may prevail.

verses.raw: You are wearied in the multitude of your counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save you from these things that shall come upon you.
verses.text: You are wearied in the multitude of your counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save you from these things that shall come upon you.

verses.raw: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it.
verses.text: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it.

verses.raw: Thus shall they be unto you with whom you have laboured, even your merchants, from your youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save you.
verses.text: Thus shall they be unto you with whom you have laboured, even your merchants, from your youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save you.

verses.raw: Hear you this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Yashar'el (Israel), and are come forth out of the waters of Yahudah (Judah), which swear by the name of Yahuah (LORD), and make mention of the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), but not in truth, nor in righteousness.
verses.text: Hear you this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Yashar'el, and are come forth out of the waters of Yahudah, which swear by the name of Yahuah, and make mention of the Elohim of Yashar'el, but not in truth, nor in righteousness.

verses.raw: For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name.
verses.text: For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the Elohim of Yashar'el; Yahuah Tseva'ot is his name.

verses.raw: I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did them suddenly, and they came to pass.
verses.text: I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did them suddenly, and they came to pass.

verses.raw: Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow brass;
verses.text: Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow brass;

verses.raw: I have even from the beginning declared it to you; before it came to pass I shewed it you: lest you should say, My idol has done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, has commanded them.
verses.text: I have even from the beginning declared it to you; before it came to pass I shewed it you: lest you should say, My idol has done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, has commanded them.

verses.raw: You have heard, see all this; and will not you declare it? I have shewed you new things from this time, even hidden things, and you did not know them.
verses.text: You have heard, see all this; and will not you declare it? I have shewed you new things from this time, even hidden things, and you did not know them.

verses.raw: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when you heard them not; lest you should say, Behold, I knew them.
verses.text: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when you heard them not; lest you should say, Behold, I knew them.

verses.raw: Yea, you heard not; yea, you knew not; yea, from that time that your ear was not opened: for I knew that you would deal very treacherously, and were called a transgressor from the womb.
verses.text: Yea, you heard not; yea, you knew not; yea, from that time that your ear was not opened: for I knew that you would deal very treacherously, and were called a transgressor from the womb.

verses.raw: For my name’s sake will I defer my anger, and for my praise will I refrain for you, that I cut you not off.
verses.text: For my name’s sake will I defer my anger, and for my praise will I refrain for you, that I cut you not off.

verses.raw: Behold, I have refined you, but not with silver; I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.
verses.text: Behold, I have refined you, but not with silver; I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.

verses.raw: For my own sake, even for my own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.
verses.text: For my own sake, even for my own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.

verses.raw: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Yashar'el (Israel), my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.
verses.text: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Yashar'el, my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.

verses.raw: My hand also has laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand has spanned the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.
verses.text: My hand also has laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand has spanned the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.

verses.raw: All you, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them has declared these things? Yahuah (LORD) has loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.
verses.text: All you, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them has declared these things? Yahuah has loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.

verses.raw: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
verses.text: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.

verses.raw: Come you near unto me, hear you this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), and his Spirit, has sent me.
verses.text: Come you near unto me, hear you this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now Adonai Yahuah, and his Spirit, has sent me.
