verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), your Redeemer, the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel); I am Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) which teaches you to profit, which leads you by the way that you should go.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Yashar'el; I am Yahuah Elohayka which teaches you to profit, which leads you by the way that you should go.

verses.raw: O that you had hearkened to my commandments! then had your peace been as a river, and your righteousness as the waves of the sea:
verses.text: O that you had hearkened to my commandments! then had your peace been as a river, and your righteousness as the waves of the sea:

verses.raw: Your seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of your bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.
verses.text: Your seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of your bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.

verses.raw: Go you forth of Babylon, flee you from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare you, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth; say you, Yahuah (LORD) has redeemed his servant Jacob.
verses.text: Go you forth of Babylon, flee you from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare you, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth; say you, Yahuah has redeemed his servant Jacob.

verses.raw: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.
verses.text: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.

verses.raw: There is no peace, says Yahuah (LORD), unto the wicked.
verses.text: There is no peace, says Yahuah, unto the wicked.

verses.raw: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, you people, from far; Yahuah (LORD) has called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother has he made mention of my name.
verses.text: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, you people, from far; Yahuah has called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother has he made mention of my name.

verses.raw: And he has made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand has he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver has he hid me;
verses.text: And he has made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand has he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver has he hid me;

verses.raw: And said unto me, You are my servant, O Yashar'el (Israel), in whom I will be glorified.
verses.text: And said unto me, You are my servant, O Yashar'el, in whom I will be glorified.

verses.raw: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain: yet surely my judgment is with Yahuah (LORD), and my work with my Elohim (God).
verses.text: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain: yet surely my judgment is with Yahuah, and my work with my Elohim.

verses.raw: And now, says Yahuah (LORD) that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Yashar'el (Israel) be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD), and my Elohim (God) shall be my strength.
verses.text: And now, says Yahuah that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Yashar'el be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of Yahuah, and my Elohim shall be my strength.

verses.raw: And he said, It is a light thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel): I will also give you for a light to the Gentiles, that you may be my salvation unto the end of the earth.
verses.text: And he said, It is a light thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Yashar'el: I will also give you for a light to the Gentiles, that you may be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Redeemer of Yashar'el (Israel), and his Holy One, to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of Yahuah (LORD) that is faithful, and the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), and he shall choose you.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, the Redeemer of Yashar'el, and his Holy One, to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of Yahuah that is faithful, and the Holy One of Yashar'el, and he shall choose you.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), In an acceptable time have I heard you, and in a day of salvation have I helped you: and I will preserve you, and give you for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, In an acceptable time have I heard you, and in a day of salvation have I helped you: and I will preserve you, and give you for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;

verses.raw: That you may say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in all high places.
verses.text: That you may say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in all high places.

verses.raw: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that has mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.
verses.text: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that has mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.

verses.raw: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.
verses.text: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.

verses.raw: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.
verses.text: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.

verses.raw: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for Yahuah (LORD) has comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.
verses.text: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for Yahuah has comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.

verses.raw: But Zion said, Yahuah (LORD) has forsaken me, and my Lord has forgotten me.
verses.text: But Zion said, Yahuah has forsaken me, and my Lord has forgotten me.

verses.raw: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget you.
verses.text: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget you.

verses.raw: Behold, I have graven you upon the palms of my hands; your walls are continually before me.
verses.text: Behold, I have graven you upon the palms of my hands; your walls are continually before me.

verses.raw: Your children shall make haste; your destroyers and they that made you waste shall go forth of you.
verses.text: Your children shall make haste; your destroyers and they that made you waste shall go forth of you.

verses.raw: Lift up your eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to you. As I live, says Yahuah (LORD), you shall surely clothe you with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them on you, as a bride does.
verses.text: Lift up your eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to you. As I live, says Yahuah, you shall surely clothe you with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them on you, as a bride does.

verses.raw: For your waste and your desolate places, and the land of your destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed you up shall be far away.
verses.text: For your waste and your desolate places, and the land of your destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed you up shall be far away.

verses.raw: The children which you shall have, after you have lost the other, shall say again in your ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.
verses.text: The children which you shall have, after you have lost the other, shall say again in your ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.

verses.raw: Then shall you say in your heart, Who has begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who has brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where had they been?
verses.text: Then shall you say in your heart, Who has begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who has brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where had they been?

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), Behold, I will lift up my hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring your sons in their arms, and your daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah, Behold, I will lift up my hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring your sons in their arms, and your daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.

verses.raw: And kings shall be your nursing fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers: they shall bow down to you with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of your feet; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD): for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.
verses.text: And kings shall be your nursing fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers: they shall bow down to you with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of your feet; and you shall know that I am Yahuah: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.

verses.raw: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?
verses.text: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?

verses.raw: But thus says Yahuah (LORD), Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contends with you, and I will save your children.
verses.text: But thus says Yahuah, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contends with you, and I will save your children.

verses.raw: And I will feed them that oppress you with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I Yahuah (LORD) am your Saviour and your Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
verses.text: And I will feed them that oppress you with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I Yahuah am your Saviour and your Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Where is the bill of your mother’s divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have you sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, Where is the bill of your mother’s divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have you sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.

verses.raw: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, and dies for thirst.
verses.text: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, and dies for thirst.

verses.raw: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.
verses.text: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.

verses.raw: Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) has given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth my ear to hear as the learned.
verses.text: Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) has given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth my ear to hear as the learned.

verses.raw: Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) has opened my ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.
verses.text: Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) has opened my ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.

verses.raw: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
verses.text: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.

verses.raw: For Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
verses.text: For Adonai Yahuah will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.

verses.raw: He is near that justifies me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who is my adversary? let him come near to me.
verses.text: He is near that justifies me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who is my adversary? let him come near to me.

verses.raw: Behold, Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.
verses.text: Behold, Adonai Yahuah will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.

verses.raw: Who is among you that fears Yahuah (LORD), that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walks in darkness, and has no light? let him trust in the name of Yahuah (LORD), and stay upon his Elohim (God).
verses.text: Who is among you that fears Yahuah, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walks in darkness, and has no light? let him trust in the name of Yahuah, and stay upon his Elohim.

verses.raw: Behold, all you that kindle a fire, that compass yourselves about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks that you have kindled. This shall you have of my hand; you shall lie down in sorrow.
verses.text: Behold, all you that kindle a fire, that compass yourselves about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks that you have kindled. This shall you have of my hand; you shall lie down in sorrow.

verses.raw: Hearken to me, you that follow after righteousness, you that seek Yahuah (LORD): look unto the rock whence you are hewn, and to the hole of the pit whence you are digged.
verses.text: Hearken to me, you that follow after righteousness, you that seek Yahuah: look unto the rock whence you are hewn, and to the hole of the pit whence you are digged.

verses.raw: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.
verses.text: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of Yahuah (LORD); joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.
verses.text: For Yahuah shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of Yahuah; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

verses.raw: Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.
verses.text: Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.

verses.raw: My righteousness is near; my salvation is gone forth, and my arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on my arm shall they trust.
verses.text: My righteousness is near; my salvation is gone forth, and my arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on my arm shall they trust.

verses.raw: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.
verses.text: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.

verses.raw: Hearken unto me, you that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear you not the reproach of men, neither be you afraid of their revilings.
verses.text: Hearken unto me, you that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear you not the reproach of men, neither be you afraid of their revilings.

verses.raw: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.
verses.text: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.

verses.raw: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of Yahuah (LORD); awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. Are you not it that has cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?
verses.text: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of Yahuah; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. Are you not it that has cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?

verses.raw: Are you not it which has dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that has made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?
verses.text: Are you not it which has dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that has made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?

verses.raw: Therefore the redeemed of Yahuah (LORD) shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away.
verses.text: Therefore the redeemed of Yahuah shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away.

verses.raw: I, even I, am he that comforteth you: who are you, that you should be afraid of a man that shall die, and of the son of Adam which shall be made as grass;
verses.text: I, even I, am he that comforteth you: who are you, that you should be afraid of a man that shall die, and of the son of Adam which shall be made as grass;

verses.raw: And forgettest Yahuah (LORD) your maker, that has stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and have feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?
verses.text: And forgettest Yahuah your maker, that has stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and have feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?

verses.raw: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.
verses.text: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.

verses.raw: But I am Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), that divided the sea, whose waves roared: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name.
verses.text: But I am Yahuah Elohayka, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: Yahuah Tseva'ot is his name.

verses.raw: And I have put my words in your mouth, and I have covered you in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, You are my people.
verses.text: And I have put my words in your mouth, and I have covered you in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, You are my people.

verses.raw: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which have drunk at the hand of Yahuah (LORD) the cup of his fury; you have drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, and wrung them out.
verses.text: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which have drunk at the hand of Yahuah the cup of his fury; you have drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, and wrung them out.

verses.raw: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she has brought forth; neither is there any that takes her by the hand of all the sons that she has brought up.
verses.text: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she has brought forth; neither is there any that takes her by the hand of all the sons that she has brought up.

verses.raw: These two things are come unto you; who shall be sorry for you? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort you?
verses.text: These two things are come unto you; who shall be sorry for you? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort you?

verses.raw: Your sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of Yahuah (LORD), the rebuke of your Elohim (God).
verses.text: Your sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of Yahuah, the rebuke of your Elohim.

verses.raw: Therefore hear now this, you afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:
verses.text: Therefore hear now this, you afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:

verses.raw: Thus says your Adonai (Lord) Yahuah (LORD), and your Elohim (God) that pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of your hand the cup of trembling, even the dregs of the cup of my fury; you shall no more drink it again:
verses.text: Thus says your Adonai Yahuah, and your Elohim that pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of your hand the cup of trembling, even the dregs of the cup of my fury; you shall no more drink it again:

verses.raw: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict you; which have said to your soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and you have laid your body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.
verses.text: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict you; which have said to your soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and you have laid your body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.

verses.raw: Awake, awake; put on your strength, O Zion; put on your beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into you the uncircumcised and the unclean.
verses.text: Awake, awake; put on your strength, O Zion; put on your beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into you the uncircumcised and the unclean.

verses.raw: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, and sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of your neck, O captive daughter of Zion.
verses.text: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, and sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of your neck, O captive daughter of Zion.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD), You have sold yourselves for nought; and you shall be redeemed without money.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah, You have sold yourselves for nought; and you shall be redeemed without money.

verses.raw: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.
verses.text: For thus says Adonai Yahuah, My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.

verses.raw: Now therefore, what have I here, says Yahuah (LORD), that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, says Yahuah (LORD); and my name continually every day is blasphemed.
verses.text: Now therefore, what have I here, says Yahuah, that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, says Yahuah; and my name continually every day is blasphemed.

verses.raw: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore they shall know in that day that I am he that does speak: behold, it is I.
verses.text: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore they shall know in that day that I am he that does speak: behold, it is I.

verses.raw: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that brings good tidings, that publisheth peace; that brings good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that says unto Zion, Your Elohim (God) reigns!
verses.text: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that brings good tidings, that publisheth peace; that brings good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that says unto Zion, Your Elohim reigns!

verses.raw: Your watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when Yahuah (LORD) shall bring again Zion.
verses.text: Your watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when Yahuah shall bring again Zion.

verses.raw: Break forth into joy, sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem: for Yahuah (LORD) has comforted his people, he has redeemed Jerusalem.
verses.text: Break forth into joy, sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem: for Yahuah has comforted his people, he has redeemed Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our Elohim (God).
verses.text: Yahuah has made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our Elohim.

verses.raw: Depart you, depart you, go you out from thence, touch no unclean thing; go you out of the midst of her; be you clean, that bear the vessels of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Depart you, depart you, go you out from thence, touch no unclean thing; go you out of the midst of her; be you clean, that bear the vessels of Yahuah.

verses.raw: For you shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for Yahuah (LORD) will go before you; and the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) will be your rereward.
verses.text: For you shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for Yahuah will go before you; and the Elohim of Yashar'el will be your rereward.

verses.raw: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.
verses.text: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.

verses.raw: As many were astonied at you; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:
verses.text: As many were astonied at you; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:

verses.raw: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for that which had not been told them shall they see; and that which they had not heard shall they consider.
verses.text: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for that which had not been told them shall they see; and that which they had not heard shall they consider.

verses.raw: Who has believed our report? and to whom is the arm of Yahuah (LORD) revealed?
verses.text: Who has believed our report? and to whom is the arm of Yahuah revealed?

verses.raw: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he has no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
verses.text: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he has no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.

verses.raw: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.
verses.text: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.

verses.raw: Surely he has borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of Elohim (God), and afflicted.
verses.text: Surely he has borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of Elohim, and afflicted.

verses.raw: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
verses.text: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

verses.raw: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and Yahuah (LORD) has laid on him the iniquity of us all.
verses.text: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and Yahuah has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

verses.raw: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he opens not his mouth.
verses.text: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he opens not his mouth.

verses.raw: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.
verses.text: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.

verses.raw: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth.
verses.text: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth.

verses.raw: Yet it pleased Yahuah (LORD) to bruise him; he has put him to grief: when you shall make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of Yahuah (LORD) shall prosper in his hand.
verses.text: Yet it pleased Yahuah to bruise him; he has put him to grief: when you shall make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of Yahuah shall prosper in his hand.

verses.raw: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
verses.text: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.

verses.raw: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he has poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
verses.text: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he has poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.

verses.raw: Sing, O barren, you that did not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, you that did not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Sing, O barren, you that did not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, you that did not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of your habitations: spare not, lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes;
verses.text: Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of your habitations: spare not, lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes;

verses.raw: For you shall break forth on the right hand and on the left; and your seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.
verses.text: For you shall break forth on the right hand and on the left; and your seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.

verses.raw: Fear not; for you shall not be ashamed: neither be you confounded; for you shall not be put to shame: for you shall forget the shame of your youth, and shall not remember the reproach of your widowhood any more.
verses.text: Fear not; for you shall not be ashamed: neither be you confounded; for you shall not be put to shame: for you shall forget the shame of your youth, and shall not remember the reproach of your widowhood any more.

verses.raw: For your Maker is your husband; Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name; and your Redeemer the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel); The Elohim (God) of the whole earth shall he be called.
verses.text: For your Maker is your husband; Yahuah Tseva'ot is his name; and your Redeemer the Holy One of Yashar'el; The Elohim of the whole earth shall he be called.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) has called you as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when you were refused, says your Elohim (God).
verses.text: For Yahuah has called you as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when you were refused, says your Elohim.

verses.raw: For a small moment have I forsaken you; but with great mercies will I gather you.
verses.text: For a small moment have I forsaken you; but with great mercies will I gather you.

verses.raw: In a little wrath I hid my face from you for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on you, says Yahuah (LORD) your Redeemer.
verses.text: In a little wrath I hid my face from you for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on you, says Yahuah your Redeemer.

verses.raw: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with you, nor rebuke you.
verses.text: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with you, nor rebuke you.

verses.raw: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from you, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, says Yahuah (LORD) that has mercy on you.
verses.text: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from you, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, says Yahuah that has mercy on you.

verses.raw: O you afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will lay your stones with fair colours, and lay your foundations with sapphires.
verses.text: O you afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will lay your stones with fair colours, and lay your foundations with sapphires.

verses.raw: And I will make your windows of agates, and your gates of carbuncles, and all your borders of pleasant stones.
verses.text: And I will make your windows of agates, and your gates of carbuncles, and all your borders of pleasant stones.

verses.raw: And all your children shall be taught of Yahuah (LORD); and great shall be the peace of your children.
verses.text: And all your children shall be taught of Yahuah; and great shall be the peace of your children.

verses.raw: In righteousness shall you be established: you shall be far from oppression; for you shall not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near you.
verses.text: In righteousness shall you be established: you shall be far from oppression; for you shall not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near you.

verses.raw: Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against you shall fall for your sake.
verses.text: Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against you shall fall for your sake.

verses.raw: Behold, I have created the smith that blows the coals in the fire, and that brings forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.
verses.text: Behold, I have created the smith that blows the coals in the fire, and that brings forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.

verses.raw: No weapon that is formed against you shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against you in judgment you shall condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of Yahuah (LORD), and their righteousness is of me, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: No weapon that is formed against you shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against you in judgment you shall condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of Yahuah, and their righteousness is of me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come you to the waters, and he that has no money; come you, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
verses.text: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come you to the waters, and he that has no money; come you, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

verses.raw: Wherefore do you spend money for that which is not bread? and your labour for that which satisfies not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat you that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.
verses.text: Wherefore do you spend money for that which is not bread? and your labour for that which satisfies not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat you that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.

verses.raw: Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.
verses.text: Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.

verses.raw: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.
verses.text: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.

verses.raw: Behold, you shall call a nation that you know not, and nations that knew not you shall run unto you because of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and for the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel); for he has glorified you.
verses.text: Behold, you shall call a nation that you know not, and nations that knew not you shall run unto you because of Yahuah Elohayka, and for the Holy One of Yashar'el; for he has glorified you.

verses.raw: Seek you Yahuah (LORD) while he may be found, call you upon him while he is near:
verses.text: Seek you Yahuah while he may be found, call you upon him while he is near:

verses.raw: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto Yahuah (LORD), and he will have mercy upon him; and to our Elohim (God), for he will abundantly pardon.
verses.text: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto Yahuah, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our Elohim, for he will abundantly pardon.

verses.raw: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
verses.text: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

verses.raw: For as the rain comes down, and the snow from heaven, and returns not thither, but watereth the earth, and makes it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:
verses.text: For as the rain comes down, and the snow from heaven, and returns not thither, but watereth the earth, and makes it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:

verses.raw: So shall my word be that goes forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
verses.text: So shall my word be that goes forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.

verses.raw: For you shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
verses.text: For you shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.

verses.raw: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to Yahuah (LORD) for a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.
verses.text: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to Yahuah for a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Keep you judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, Keep you judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.

verses.raw: Blessed is the man that does this, and the son of Adam that lays hold on it; that keeps the sabbath from polluting it, and keeps his hand from doing any evil.
verses.text: Blessed is the man that does this, and the son of Adam that lays hold on it; that keeps the sabbath from polluting it, and keeps his hand from doing any evil.

verses.raw: Neither let the son of the stranger, that has joined himself to Yahuah (LORD), speak, saying, Yahuah (LORD) has utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.
verses.text: Neither let the son of the stranger, that has joined himself to Yahuah, speak, saying, Yahuah has utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD) unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose the things that please me, and take hold of my covenant;
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose the things that please me, and take hold of my covenant;

verses.raw: Even unto them will I give in my house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.
verses.text: Even unto them will I give in my house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.

verses.raw: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to Yahuah (LORD), to serve him, and to love the name of Yahuah (LORD), to be his servants, every one that keeps the sabbath from polluting it, and takes hold of my covenant;
verses.text: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to Yahuah, to serve him, and to love the name of Yahuah, to be his servants, every one that keeps the sabbath from polluting it, and takes hold of my covenant;

verses.raw: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon my altar; for my house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.
verses.text: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon my altar; for my house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.

verses.raw: Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) which gathers the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel) says, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.
verses.text: Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) which gathers the outcasts of Yashar'el says, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.

verses.raw: All you beasts of the field, come to devour, yea, all you beasts in the forest.
verses.text: All you beasts of the field, come to devour, yea, all you beasts in the forest.

verses.raw: His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.
verses.text: His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.

verses.raw: Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.
verses.text: Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.

verses.raw: Come you, say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, and much more abundant.
verses.text: Come you, say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, and much more abundant.

verses.raw: The righteous perishes, and no man lays it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.
verses.text: The righteous perishes, and no man lays it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.

verses.raw: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.
verses.text: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.

verses.raw: But draw near hither, you sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.
verses.text: But draw near hither, you sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.

verses.raw: Against whom do you sport yourselves? against whom make you a wide mouth, and draw out the tongue? are you not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,
verses.text: Against whom do you sport yourselves? against whom make you a wide mouth, and draw out the tongue? are you not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,

verses.raw: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?
verses.text: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?

verses.raw: Among the smooth stones of the stream is your portion; they, they are your lot: even to them have you poured a drink offering, you have offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?
verses.text: Among the smooth stones of the stream is your portion; they, they are your lot: even to them have you poured a drink offering, you have offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?

verses.raw: Upon a lofty and high mountain have you set your bed: even thither went you up to offer sacrifice.
verses.text: Upon a lofty and high mountain have you set your bed: even thither went you up to offer sacrifice.

verses.raw: Behind the doors also and the posts have you set up your remembrance: for you have discovered thyself to another than me, and are gone up; you have enlarged your bed, and made you a covenant with them; you lovedst their bed where you saw it.
verses.text: Behind the doors also and the posts have you set up your remembrance: for you have discovered thyself to another than me, and are gone up; you have enlarged your bed, and made you a covenant with them; you lovedst their bed where you saw it.

verses.raw: And you went to the king with ointment, and did increase your perfumes, and did send your messengers far off, and did debase thyself even unto hell.
verses.text: And you went to the king with ointment, and did increase your perfumes, and did send your messengers far off, and did debase thyself even unto hell.

verses.raw: You are wearied in the greatness of your way; yet saidst you not, There is no hope: you have found the life of your hand; therefore you were not grieved.
verses.text: You are wearied in the greatness of your way; yet saidst you not, There is no hope: you have found the life of your hand; therefore you were not grieved.

verses.raw: And of whom have you been afraid or feared, that you have lied, and have not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and you fearest me not?
verses.text: And of whom have you been afraid or feared, that you have lied, and have not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and you fearest me not?

verses.raw: I will declare your righteousness, and your works; for they shall not profit you.
verses.text: I will declare your righteousness, and your works; for they shall not profit you.

verses.raw: When you cry, let your companies deliver you; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take them: but he that puts his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;
verses.text: When you cry, let your companies deliver you; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take them: but he that puts his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;

verses.raw: And shall say, Cast you up, cast you up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.
verses.text: And shall say, Cast you up, cast you up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.

verses.raw: For thus says the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
verses.text: For thus says the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.

verses.raw: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.
verses.text: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.

verses.raw: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.
verses.text: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.

verses.raw: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
verses.text: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.

verses.raw: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, says Yahuah (LORD); and I will heal him.
verses.text: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, says Yahuah; and I will heal him.

verses.raw: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
verses.text: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.

verses.raw: There is no peace, says my Elohim (God), to the wicked.
verses.text: There is no peace, says my Elohim, to the wicked.

verses.raw: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up your voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.
verses.text: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up your voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.

verses.raw: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their Elohim (God): they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to Elohim (God).
verses.text: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their Elohim: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to Elohim.

verses.raw: Wherefore have we fasted, say they, and you see not? wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and you take no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast you find pleasure, and exact all your labours.
verses.text: Wherefore have we fasted, say they, and you see not? wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and you take no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast you find pleasure, and exact all your labours.

verses.raw: Behold, you fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: you shall not fast as you do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high.
verses.text: Behold, you fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: you shall not fast as you do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high.

verses.raw: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? will you call this a fast, and an acceptable day to Yahuah (LORD)?
verses.text: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? will you call this a fast, and an acceptable day to Yahuah?

verses.raw: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that you break every yoke?
verses.text: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that you break every yoke?

verses.raw: Is it not to deal your bread to the hungry, and that you bring the poor that are cast out to your house? when you see the naked, that you cover him; and that you hide not thyself from your own flesh?
verses.text: Is it not to deal your bread to the hungry, and that you bring the poor that are cast out to your house? when you see the naked, that you cover him; and that you hide not thyself from your own flesh?

verses.raw: Then shall your light break forth as the morning, and your health shall spring forth speedily: and your righteousness shall go before you; the glory of Yahuah (LORD) shall be your rereward.
verses.text: Then shall your light break forth as the morning, and your health shall spring forth speedily: and your righteousness shall go before you; the glory of Yahuah shall be your rereward.

verses.raw: Then shall you call, and Yahuah (LORD) shall answer; you shall cry, and he shall say, Here I am. If you take away from the midst of you the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;
verses.text: Then shall you call, and Yahuah shall answer; you shall cry, and he shall say, Here I am. If you take away from the midst of you the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;

verses.raw: And if you draw out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall your light rise in obscurity, and your darkness be as the noonday:
verses.text: And if you draw out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall your light rise in obscurity, and your darkness be as the noonday:

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall guide you continually, and satisfy your soul in drought, and make fat your bones: and you shall be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
verses.text: And Yahuah shall guide you continually, and satisfy your soul in drought, and make fat your bones: and you shall be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.

verses.raw: And they that shall be of you shall build the old waste places: you shall raise up the foundations of many generations; and you shall be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.
verses.text: And they that shall be of you shall build the old waste places: you shall raise up the foundations of many generations; and you shall be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.

verses.raw: If you turn away your foot from the sabbath, from doing your pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of Yahuah (LORD), honourable; and shall honour him, not doing your own ways, nor finding your own pleasure, nor speaking your own words:
verses.text: If you turn away your foot from the sabbath, from doing your pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of Yahuah, honourable; and shall honour him, not doing your own ways, nor finding your own pleasure, nor speaking your own words:

verses.raw: Then shall you delight thyself in Yahuah (LORD); and I will cause you to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father: for the mouth of Yahuah (LORD) has spoken it.
verses.text: Then shall you delight thyself in Yahuah; and I will cause you to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father: for the mouth of Yahuah has spoken it.

verses.raw: Behold, the LORD’S hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
verses.text: Behold, the LORD’S hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:

verses.raw: But your iniquities have separated between you and your Elohim (God), and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
verses.text: But your iniquities have separated between you and your Elohim, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.

verses.raw: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue has muttered perverseness.
verses.text: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue has muttered perverseness.

verses.raw: None calls for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.
verses.text: None calls for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.

verses.raw: They hatch cockatrice’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web: he that eats of their eggs dies, and that which is crushed breaks out into a viper.
verses.text: They hatch cockatrice’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web: he that eats of their eggs dies, and that which is crushed breaks out into a viper.

verses.raw: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.
verses.text: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.

verses.raw: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.
verses.text: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.

verses.raw: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goes therein shall not know peace.
verses.text: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goes therein shall not know peace.

verses.raw: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither does justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.
verses.text: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither does justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.

verses.raw: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.
verses.text: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.

verses.raw: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.
verses.text: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.

verses.raw: For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions are with us; and as for our iniquities, we know them;
verses.text: For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions are with us; and as for our iniquities, we know them;

verses.raw: In transgressing and lying against Yahuah (LORD), and departing away from our Elohim (God), speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
verses.text: In transgressing and lying against Yahuah, and departing away from our Elohim, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

verses.raw: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice stands afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.
verses.text: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice stands afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.

verses.raw: Yea, truth fails; and he that departs from evil makes himself a prey: and Yahuah (LORD) saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.
verses.text: Yea, truth fails; and he that departs from evil makes himself a prey: and Yahuah saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.

verses.raw: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.
verses.text: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.

verses.raw: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.
verses.text: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.

verses.raw: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.
verses.text: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.

verses.raw: So shall they fear the name of Yahuah (LORD) from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall lift up a standard against him.
verses.text: So shall they fear the name of Yahuah from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of Yahuah shall lift up a standard against him.

verses.raw: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: As for me, this is my covenant with them, says Yahuah (LORD); My spirit that is upon you, and my words which I have put in your mouth, shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your seed, nor out of the mouth of your seed’s seed, says Yahuah (LORD), from henceforth and for ever.
verses.text: As for me, this is my covenant with them, says Yahuah; My spirit that is upon you, and my words which I have put in your mouth, shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your seed, nor out of the mouth of your seed’s seed, says Yahuah, from henceforth and for ever.

verses.raw: Arise, shine; for your light is come, and the glory of Yahuah (LORD) is risen upon you.
verses.text: Arise, shine; for your light is come, and the glory of Yahuah is risen upon you.

verses.raw: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but Yahuah (LORD) shall arise upon you, and his glory shall be seen upon you.
verses.text: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but Yahuah shall arise upon you, and his glory shall be seen upon you.

verses.raw: And the Gentiles shall come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.
verses.text: And the Gentiles shall come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.

verses.raw: Lift up your eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to you: your sons shall come from far, and your daughters shall be nursed at your side.
verses.text: Lift up your eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to you: your sons shall come from far, and your daughters shall be nursed at your side.

verses.raw: Then you shall see, and flow together, and your heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto you, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto you.
verses.text: Then you shall see, and flow together, and your heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto you, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto you.

verses.raw: The multitude of camels shall cover you, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: The multitude of camels shall cover you, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of Yahuah.

verses.raw: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto you, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto you: they shall come up with acceptance on my altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.
verses.text: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto you, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto you: they shall come up with acceptance on my altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.

verses.raw: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
verses.text: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?

verses.raw: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and to the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), because he has glorified you.
verses.text: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of Yahuah Elohayka, and to the Holy One of Yashar'el, because he has glorified you.

verses.raw: And the sons of strangers shall build up your walls, and their kings shall minister unto you: for in my wrath I smote you, but in my favour have I had mercy on you.
verses.text: And the sons of strangers shall build up your walls, and their kings shall minister unto you: for in my wrath I smote you, but in my favour have I had mercy on you.

verses.raw: Therefore your gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto you the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.
verses.text: Therefore your gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto you the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.

verses.raw: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve you shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.
verses.text: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve you shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.

verses.raw: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto you, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
verses.text: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto you, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.

verses.raw: The sons also of them that afflicted you shall come bending unto you; and all they that despised you shall bow themselves down at the soles of your feet; and they shall call you, The city of Yahuah (LORD), The Zion of the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: The sons also of them that afflicted you shall come bending unto you; and all they that despised you shall bow themselves down at the soles of your feet; and they shall call you, The city of Yahuah, The Zion of the Holy One of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through you, I will make you an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.
verses.text: Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through you, I will make you an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.

verses.raw: You shall also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shall suck the breast of kings: and you shall know that I Yahuah (LORD) am your Saviour and your Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
verses.text: You shall also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shall suck the breast of kings: and you shall know that I Yahuah am your Saviour and your Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.

verses.raw: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make your officers peace, and your exactors righteousness.
verses.text: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make your officers peace, and your exactors righteousness.

verses.raw: Violence shall no more be heard in your land, wasting nor destruction within your borders; but you shall call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise.
verses.text: Violence shall no more be heard in your land, wasting nor destruction within your borders; but you shall call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise.

verses.raw: The sun shall be no more your light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto you: but Yahuah (LORD) shall be unto you an everlasting light, and your Elohim (God) your glory.
verses.text: The sun shall be no more your light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto you: but Yahuah shall be unto you an everlasting light, and your Elohim your glory.

verses.raw: Your sun shall no more go down; neither shall your moon withdraw itself: for Yahuah (LORD) shall be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning shall be ended.
verses.text: Your sun shall no more go down; neither shall your moon withdraw itself: for Yahuah shall be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning shall be ended.

verses.raw: Your people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
verses.text: Your people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.

verses.raw: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I Yahuah (LORD) will hasten it in his time.
verses.text: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I Yahuah will hasten it in his time.

verses.raw: The Spirit of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) is upon me; because Yahuah (LORD) has anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
verses.text: The Spirit of Adonai Yahuah is upon me; because Yahuah has anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;

verses.raw: To proclaim the acceptable year of Yahuah (LORD), and the day of vengeance of our Elohim (God); to comfort all that mourn;
verses.text: To proclaim the acceptable year of Yahuah, and the day of vengeance of our Elohim; to comfort all that mourn;

verses.raw: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of Yahuah (LORD), that he might be glorified.
verses.text: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of Yahuah, that he might be glorified.

verses.raw: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.
verses.text: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.

verses.raw: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.
verses.text: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.

verses.raw: But you shall be named the Priests of Yahuah (LORD): men shall call you the Ministers of our Elohim (God): you shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall you boast yourselves.
verses.text: But you shall be named the Priests of Yahuah: men shall call you the Ministers of our Elohim: you shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall you boast yourselves.

verses.raw: For your shame you shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.
verses.text: For your shame you shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.

verses.raw: For I Yahuah (LORD) love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
verses.text: For I Yahuah love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

verses.raw: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which Yahuah (LORD) has blessed.
verses.text: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which Yahuah has blessed.

verses.raw: I will greatly rejoice in Yahuah (LORD), my soul shall be joyful in my Elohim (God); for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation, he has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.
verses.text: I will greatly rejoice in Yahuah, my soul shall be joyful in my Elohim; for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation, he has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.

verses.raw: For as the earth brings forth her bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
verses.text: For as the earth brings forth her bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so Adonai Yahuah will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.

verses.raw: For Zion’s sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burns.
verses.text: For Zion’s sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burns.

verses.raw: And the Gentiles shall see your righteousness, and all kings your glory: and you shall be called by a new name, which the mouth of Yahuah (LORD) shall name.
