verses.text: And the Gentiles shall see your righteousness, and all kings your glory: and you shall be called by a new name, which the mouth of Yahuah shall name.

verses.raw: You shall also be a crown of glory in the hand of Yahuah (LORD), and a royal diadem in the hand of your Elohim (God).
verses.text: You shall also be a crown of glory in the hand of Yahuah, and a royal diadem in the hand of your Elohim.

verses.raw: You shall no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall your land any more be termed Desolate: but you shall be called Hephzi-bah, and your land Beulah: for Yahuah (LORD) delights in you, and your land shall be married.
verses.text: You shall no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall your land any more be termed Desolate: but you shall be called Hephzi-bah, and your land Beulah: for Yahuah delights in you, and your land shall be married.

verses.raw: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall your sons marry you: and as the bridegroom rejoices over the bride, so shall your Elohim (God) rejoice over you.
verses.text: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall your sons marry you: and as the bridegroom rejoices over the bride, so shall your Elohim rejoice over you.

verses.raw: I have set watchmen upon your walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: you that make mention of Yahuah (LORD), keep not silence,
verses.text: I have set watchmen upon your walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: you that make mention of Yahuah, keep not silence,

verses.raw: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
verses.text: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give your corn to be meat for your enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink your wine, for the which you have laboured:
verses.text: Yahuah has sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give your corn to be meat for your enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink your wine, for the which you have laboured:

verses.raw: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise Yahuah (LORD); and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.
verses.text: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise Yahuah; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.

verses.raw: Go through, go through the gates; prepare you the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.
verses.text: Go through, go through the gates; prepare you the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.

verses.raw: Behold, Yahuah (LORD) has proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say you to the daughter of Zion, Behold, your salvation comes; behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
verses.text: Behold, Yahuah has proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say you to the daughter of Zion, Behold, your salvation comes; behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.

verses.raw: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of Yahuah (LORD): and you shall be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.
verses.text: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of Yahuah: and you shall be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.

verses.raw: Who is this that comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.
verses.text: Who is this that comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.

verses.raw: Wherefore are you red in your apparel, and your garments like him that treads in the winefat?
verses.text: Wherefore are you red in your apparel, and your garments like him that treads in the winefat?

verses.raw: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in my anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.
verses.text: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in my anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.

verses.raw: For the day of vengeance is in my heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.
verses.text: For the day of vengeance is in my heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.

verses.raw: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore my own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.
verses.text: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore my own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.

verses.raw: And I will tread down the people in my anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.
verses.text: And I will tread down the people in my anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.

verses.raw: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of Yahuah (LORD), and the praises of Yahuah (LORD), according to all that Yahuah (LORD) has bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Yashar'el (Israel), which he has bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
verses.text: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of Yahuah, and the praises of Yahuah, according to all that Yahuah has bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Yashar'el, which he has bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.

verses.raw: For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.
verses.text: For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.

verses.raw: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
verses.text: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.

verses.raw: But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, and he fought against them.
verses.text: But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, and he fought against them.

verses.raw: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses, and his people, saying, Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him?
verses.text: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses, and his people, saying, Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him?

verses.raw: That led them by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
verses.text: That led them by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?

verses.raw: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, that they should not stumble?
verses.text: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, that they should not stumble?

verses.raw: As a beast goes down into the valley, the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) caused him to rest: so did you lead your people, to make thyself a glorious name.
verses.text: As a beast goes down into the valley, the Spirit of Yahuah caused him to rest: so did you lead your people, to make thyself a glorious name.

verses.raw: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of your holiness and of your glory: where is your zeal and your strength, the sounding of your bowels and of your mercies toward me? are they restrained?
verses.text: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of your holiness and of your glory: where is your zeal and your strength, the sounding of your bowels and of your mercies toward me? are they restrained?

verses.raw: Doubtless you are our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Yashar'el (Israel) acknowledge us not: you, O Yahuah (LORD), are our father, our redeemer; your name is from everlasting.
verses.text: Doubtless you are our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Yashar'el acknowledge us not: you, O Yahuah, are our father, our redeemer; your name is from everlasting.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), why have you made us to err from your ways, and hardened our heart from your fear? Return for your servants’ sake, the tribes of your inheritance.
verses.text: O Yahuah, why have you made us to err from your ways, and hardened our heart from your fear? Return for your servants’ sake, the tribes of your inheritance.

verses.raw: The people of your holiness have possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down your sanctuary.
verses.text: The people of your holiness have possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down your sanctuary.

verses.raw: We are yours: you never barest rule over them; they were not called by your name.
verses.text: We are yours: you never barest rule over them; they were not called by your name.

verses.raw: Oh that you would rend the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might flow down at your presence,
verses.text: Oh that you would rend the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might flow down at your presence,

verses.raw: As when the melting fire burns, the fire causes the waters to boil, to make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence!
verses.text: As when the melting fire burns, the fire causes the waters to boil, to make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence!

verses.raw: When you did terrible things which we looked not for, you came down, the mountains flowed down at your presence.
verses.text: When you did terrible things which we looked not for, you came down, the mountains flowed down at your presence.

verses.raw: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither has the eye seen, O Elohim (God), beside you, what he has prepared for him that waits for him.
verses.text: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither has the eye seen, O Elohim, beside you, what he has prepared for him that waits for him.

verses.raw: You meetest him that rejoices and works righteousness, those that remember you in your ways: behold, you are wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.
verses.text: You meetest him that rejoices and works righteousness, those that remember you in your ways: behold, you are wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.

verses.raw: But we are all as an unclean thing, and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.
verses.text: But we are all as an unclean thing, and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.

verses.raw: And there is none that calls upon your name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of you: for you have hid your face from us, and have consumed us, because of our iniquities.
verses.text: And there is none that calls upon your name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of you: for you have hid your face from us, and have consumed us, because of our iniquities.

verses.raw: But now, O Yahuah (LORD), you are our father; we are the clay, and you our potter; and we all are the work of your hand.
verses.text: But now, O Yahuah, you are our father; we are the clay, and you our potter; and we all are the work of your hand.

verses.raw: Be not wroth very sore, O Yahuah (LORD), neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech you, we are all your people.
verses.text: Be not wroth very sore, O Yahuah, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech you, we are all your people.

verses.raw: Your holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
verses.text: Your holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

verses.raw: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised you, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.
verses.text: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised you, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.

verses.raw: Will you refrain thyself for these things, O Yahuah (LORD)? will you hold your peace, and afflict us very sore?
verses.text: Will you refrain thyself for these things, O Yahuah? will you hold your peace, and afflict us very sore?

verses.raw: I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.
verses.text: I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.

verses.raw: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walks in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts;
verses.text: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walks in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts;

verses.raw: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burns incense upon altars of brick;
verses.text: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burns incense upon altars of brick;

verses.raw: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;
verses.text: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;

verses.raw: Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than you. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burns all the day.
verses.text: Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than you. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burns all the day.

verses.raw: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,
verses.text: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,

verses.raw: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, says Yahuah (LORD), which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.
verses.text: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, says Yahuah, which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one says, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants’ sakes, that I may not destroy them all.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one says, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants’ sakes, that I may not destroy them all.

verses.raw: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Yahudah (Judah) an inheritor of my mountains: and my elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.
verses.text: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Yahudah an inheritor of my mountains: and my elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.

verses.raw: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.
verses.text: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.

verses.raw: But you are they that forsake Yahuah (LORD), that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.
verses.text: But you are they that forsake Yahuah, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.

verses.raw: Therefore will I number you to the sword, and you shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, you did not answer; when I spake, you did not hear; but did evil before my eyes, and did choose that wherein I delighted not.
verses.text: Therefore will I number you to the sword, and you shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, you did not answer; when I spake, you did not hear; but did evil before my eyes, and did choose that wherein I delighted not.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), Behold, my servants shall eat, but you shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but you shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but you shall be ashamed:
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah, Behold, my servants shall eat, but you shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but you shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but you shall be ashamed:

verses.raw: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but you shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.
verses.text: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but you shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.

verses.raw: And you shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) shall slay you, and call his servants by another name:
verses.text: And you shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for Adonai Yahuah shall slay you, and call his servants by another name:

verses.raw: That he who blesses himself in the earth shall bless himself in the Elohim (God) of truth; and he that swears in the earth shall swear by the Elohim (God) of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from my eyes.
verses.text: That he who blesses himself in the earth shall bless himself in the Elohim of truth; and he that swears in the earth shall swear by the Elohim of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from my eyes.

verses.raw: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.
verses.text: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.

verses.raw: But be you glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.
verses.text: But be you glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.

verses.raw: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.
verses.text: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.

verses.raw: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that has not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed.
verses.text: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that has not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed.

verses.raw: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.text: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.

verses.raw: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people, and my elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.
verses.text: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people, and my elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.

verses.raw: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they are the seed of the blessed of Yahuah (LORD), and their offspring with them.
verses.text: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they are the seed of the blessed of Yahuah, and their offspring with them.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

verses.raw: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent’s meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent’s meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), The heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: where is the house that you build unto me? and where is the place of my rest?
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, The heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: where is the house that you build unto me? and where is the place of my rest?

verses.raw: For all those things has my hand made, and all those things have been, says Yahuah (LORD): but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembles at my word.
verses.text: For all those things has my hand made, and all those things have been, says Yahuah: but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembles at my word.

verses.raw: He that kills an ox is as if he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as if he cut off a dog’s neck; he that offers an oblation, as if he offered swine’s blood; he that burns incense, as if he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delights in their abominations.
verses.text: He that kills an ox is as if he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as if he cut off a dog’s neck; he that offers an oblation, as if he offered swine’s blood; he that burns incense, as if he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delights in their abominations.

verses.raw: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before my eyes, and chose that in which I delighted not.
verses.text: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before my eyes, and chose that in which I delighted not.

verses.raw: Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), you that tremble at his word; Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name’s sake, said, Let Yahuah (LORD) be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.
verses.text: Hear the word of Yahuah, you that tremble at his word; Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name’s sake, said, Let Yahuah be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.

verses.raw: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of Yahuah (LORD) that renders recompence to his enemies.
verses.text: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of Yahuah that renders recompence to his enemies.

verses.raw: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.
verses.text: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.

verses.raw: Who has heard such a thing? who has seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.
verses.text: Who has heard such a thing? who has seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.

verses.raw: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? says Yahuah (LORD): shall I cause to bring forth, and shut the womb? says your Elohim (God).
verses.text: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? says Yahuah: shall I cause to bring forth, and shut the womb? says your Elohim.

verses.raw: Rejoice you with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all you that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all you that mourn for her:
verses.text: Rejoice you with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all you that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all you that mourn for her:

verses.raw: That you may suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that you may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.
verses.text: That you may suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that you may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream: then shall you suck, you shall be borne upon her sides, and be dandled upon her knees.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah, Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream: then shall you suck, you shall be borne upon her sides, and be dandled upon her knees.

verses.raw: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and you shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
verses.text: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and you shall be comforted in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And when you see this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of Yahuah (LORD) shall be known toward his servants, and his indignation toward his enemies.
verses.text: And when you see this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of Yahuah shall be known toward his servants, and his indignation toward his enemies.

verses.raw: For, behold, Yahuah (LORD) will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
verses.text: For, behold, Yahuah will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

verses.raw: For by fire and by his sword will Yahuah (LORD) plead with all flesh: and the slain of Yahuah (LORD) shall be many.
verses.text: For by fire and by his sword will Yahuah plead with all flesh: and the slain of Yahuah shall be many.

verses.raw: They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst, eating swine’s flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst, eating swine’s flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: For I know their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.
verses.text: For I know their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.

verses.raw: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal, and Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.
verses.text: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal, and Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.

verses.raw: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto Yahuah (LORD) out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, says Yahuah (LORD), as the children of Yashar'el (Israel) bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto Yahuah out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, says Yahuah, as the children of Yashar'el bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, says Yahuah (LORD), so shall your seed and your name remain.
verses.text: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, says Yahuah, so shall your seed and your name remain.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.
verses.text: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.

verses.raw: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:
verses.text: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:

verses.raw: To whom the word of Yahuah (LORD) came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Yahudah (Judah), in the thirteenth year of his reign.
verses.text: To whom the word of Yahuah came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Yahudah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

verses.raw: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah), unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah), unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
verses.text: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Yahudah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

verses.raw: Then the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Then the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Before I formed you in the belly I knew you; and before you came forth out of the womb I sanctified you, and I ordained you a prophet unto the nations.
verses.text: Before I formed you in the belly I knew you; and before you came forth out of the womb I sanctified you, and I ordained you a prophet unto the nations.

verses.raw: Then said I, Ah, Adonai (Lord) GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.
verses.text: Then said I, Ah, Adonai GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.

verses.raw: But Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for you shall go to all that I shall send you, and whatsoever I command you you shall speak.
verses.text: But Yahuah said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for you shall go to all that I shall send you, and whatsoever I command you you shall speak.

verses.raw: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with you to deliver you, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with you to deliver you, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Then Yahuah (LORD) put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.
verses.text: Then Yahuah put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And Yahuah said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.

verses.raw: See, I have this day set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.
verses.text: See, I have this day set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.

verses.raw: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what see you? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.
verses.text: Moreover the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what see you? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.

verses.raw: Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto me, You have well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.
verses.text: Then said Yahuah unto me, You have well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me the second time, saying, What see you? And I said, I see a seething pot; and the face thereof is toward the north.
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto me the second time, saying, What see you? And I said, I see a seething pot; and the face thereof is toward the north.

verses.raw: Then Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.
verses.text: Then Yahuah said unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.

verses.raw: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, says Yahuah (LORD); and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, says Yahuah; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Yahudah.

verses.raw: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.
verses.text: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.

verses.raw: You therefore gird up your loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command you: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound you before them.
verses.text: You therefore gird up your loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command you: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound you before them.

verses.raw: For, behold, I have made you this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Yahudah (Judah), against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.
verses.text: For, behold, I have made you this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Yahudah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.

verses.raw: And they shall fight against you; but they shall not prevail against you; for I am with you, says Yahuah (LORD), to deliver you.
verses.text: And they shall fight against you; but they shall not prevail against you; for I am with you, says Yahuah, to deliver you.

verses.raw: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to me, saying,
verses.text: Moreover the word of Yahuah came to me, saying,

verses.raw: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); I remember you, the kindness of your youth, the love of your espousals, when you went after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.
verses.text: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus says Yahuah; I remember you, the kindness of your youth, the love of your espousals, when you went after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.

verses.raw: Yashar'el (Israel) was holiness unto Yahuah (LORD), and the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Yashar'el was holiness unto Yahuah, and the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Hear you the word of Yahuah (LORD), O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: Hear you the word of Yahuah, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Yashar'el:

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?

verses.raw: Neither said they, Where is Yahuah (LORD) that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?
verses.text: Neither said they, Where is Yahuah that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?

verses.raw: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when you entered, you defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination.
verses.text: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when you entered, you defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination.

verses.raw: The priests said not, Where is Yahuah (LORD)? and they that handle the law knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.
verses.text: The priests said not, Where is Yahuah? and they that handle the law knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.

verses.raw: Wherefore I will yet plead with you, says Yahuah (LORD), and with your children’s children will I plead.
verses.text: Wherefore I will yet plead with you, says Yahuah, and with your children’s children will I plead.

verses.raw: For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.
verses.text: For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.

verses.raw: Has a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which does not profit.
verses.text: Has a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which does not profit.

verses.raw: Be astonished, O you heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be you very desolate, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Be astonished, O you heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be you very desolate, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.
verses.text: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.

verses.raw: Is Yashar'el (Israel) a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?
verses.text: Is Yashar'el a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?

verses.raw: The young lions roared upon him, and yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.
verses.text: The young lions roared upon him, and yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.

verses.raw: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of your head.
verses.text: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of your head.

verses.raw: Have you not procured this unto thyself, in that you have forsaken Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), when he led you by the way?
verses.text: Have you not procured this unto thyself, in that you have forsaken Yahuah Elohayka, when he led you by the way?

verses.raw: And now what have you to do in the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what have you to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?
verses.text: And now what have you to do in the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what have you to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?

verses.raw: Your own wickedness shall correct you, and your backslidings shall reprove you: know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and bitter, that you have forsaken Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and that my fear is not in you, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts.
verses.text: Your own wickedness shall correct you, and your backslidings shall reprove you: know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and bitter, that you have forsaken Yahuah Elohayka, and that my fear is not in you, says Adonai Yahuah of hosts.

verses.raw: For of old time I have broken your yoke, and burst your bands; and you saidst, I will not transgress; when upon every high hill and under every green tree you wanderest, playing the harlot.
verses.text: For of old time I have broken your yoke, and burst your bands; and you saidst, I will not transgress; when upon every high hill and under every green tree you wanderest, playing the harlot.

verses.raw: Yet I had planted you a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then are you turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?
verses.text: Yet I had planted you a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then are you turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?

verses.raw: For though you wash you with nitre, and take you much soap, yet your iniquity is marked before me, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: For though you wash you with nitre, and take you much soap, yet your iniquity is marked before me, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: How can you say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see your way in the valley, know what you have done: you are a swift dromedary traversing her ways;
verses.text: How can you say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see your way in the valley, know what you have done: you are a swift dromedary traversing her ways;

verses.raw: A wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.
verses.text: A wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.

verses.raw: Withhold your foot from being unshod, and your throat from thirst: but you saidst, There is no hope: no; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.
verses.text: Withhold your foot from being unshod, and your throat from thirst: but you saidst, There is no hope: no; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.

verses.raw: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Yashar'el (Israel) ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets,
verses.text: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Yashar'el ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets,

verses.raw: Saying to a stock, You are my father; and to a stone, You have brought me forth: for they have turned their back unto me, and not their face: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.
verses.text: Saying to a stock, You are my father; and to a stone, You have brought me forth: for they have turned their back unto me, and not their face: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.

verses.raw: But where are your gods that you have made you? let them arise, if they can save you in the time of your trouble: for according to the number of your cities are your gods, O Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: But where are your gods that you have made you? let them arise, if they can save you in the time of your trouble: for according to the number of your cities are your gods, O Yahudah.

verses.raw: Wherefore will you plead with me? you all have transgressed against me, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Wherefore will you plead with me? you all have transgressed against me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword has devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.
verses.text: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword has devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

verses.raw: O generation, see you the word of Yahuah (LORD). Have I been a wilderness unto Yashar'el (Israel)? a land of darkness? wherefore say my people, We are lords; we will come no more unto you?
verses.text: O generation, see you the word of Yahuah. Have I been a wilderness unto Yashar'el? a land of darkness? wherefore say my people, We are lords; we will come no more unto you?

verses.raw: Can a maid forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.
verses.text: Can a maid forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.

verses.raw: Why trimmest you your way to seek love? therefore have you also taught the wicked ones your ways.
verses.text: Why trimmest you your way to seek love? therefore have you also taught the wicked ones your ways.

verses.raw: Also in your skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.
verses.text: Also in your skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.

verses.raw: Yet you say, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with you, because you say, I have not sinned.
verses.text: Yet you say, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with you, because you say, I have not sinned.

verses.raw: Why gaddest you about so much to change your way? you also shall be ashamed of Egypt, as you were ashamed of Assyria.
verses.text: Why gaddest you about so much to change your way? you also shall be ashamed of Egypt, as you were ashamed of Assyria.

verses.raw: Yea, you shall go forth from him, and your hands upon your head: for Yahuah (LORD) has rejected your confidences, and you shall not prosper in them.
verses.text: Yea, you shall go forth from him, and your hands upon your head: for Yahuah has rejected your confidences, and you shall not prosper in them.

verses.raw: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man’s, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but you have played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man’s, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but you have played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Lift up your eyes unto the high places, and see where you have not been lien with. In the ways have you sat for them, as the Arabian in the wilderness; and you have polluted the land with your whoredoms and with your wickedness.
verses.text: Lift up your eyes unto the high places, and see where you have not been lien with. In the ways have you sat for them, as the Arabian in the wilderness; and you have polluted the land with your whoredoms and with your wickedness.

verses.raw: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there has been no latter rain; and you had a whore’s forehead, you refusedst to be ashamed.
verses.text: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there has been no latter rain; and you had a whore’s forehead, you refusedst to be ashamed.

verses.raw: Will you not from this time cry unto me, My father, you are the guide of my youth?
verses.text: Will you not from this time cry unto me, My father, you are the guide of my youth?

verses.raw: Will he reserve his anger for ever? will he keep it to the end? Behold, you have spoken and done evil things as you could.
verses.text: Will he reserve his anger for ever? will he keep it to the end? Behold, you have spoken and done evil things as you could.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king, Have you seen that which backsliding Yashar'el (Israel) has done? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree, and there has played the harlot.
verses.text: Yahuah said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king, Have you seen that which backsliding Yashar'el has done? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree, and there has played the harlot.

verses.raw: And I said after she had done all these things, Turn you unto me. But she returned not. And her treacherous sister Yahudah (Judah) saw it.
verses.text: And I said after she had done all these things, Turn you unto me. But she returned not. And her treacherous sister Yahudah saw it.

verses.raw: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Yashar'el (Israel) committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Yahudah (Judah) feared not, but went and played the harlot also.
verses.text: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Yashar'el committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Yahudah feared not, but went and played the harlot also.

verses.raw: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.
verses.text: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.

verses.raw: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Yahudah (Judah) has not turned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Yahudah has not turned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, The backsliding Yashar'el (Israel) has justified herself more than treacherous Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto me, The backsliding Yashar'el has justified herself more than treacherous Yahudah.

verses.raw: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, you backsliding Yashar'el (Israel), says Yahuah (LORD); and I will not cause my anger to fall upon you: for I am merciful, says Yahuah (LORD), and I will not keep anger for ever.
verses.text: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, you backsliding Yashar'el, says Yahuah; and I will not cause my anger to fall upon you: for I am merciful, says Yahuah, and I will not keep anger for ever.

verses.raw: Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have transgressed against Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and have scattered your ways to the strangers under every green tree, and you have not obeyed my voice, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have transgressed against Yahuah Elohayka, and have scattered your ways to the strangers under every green tree, and you have not obeyed my voice, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Turn, O backsliding children, says Yahuah (LORD); for I am married unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion:
verses.text: Turn, O backsliding children, says Yahuah; for I am married unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion:

verses.raw: And I will give you pastors according to my heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
verses.text: And I will give you pastors according to my heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, when you be multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, says Yahuah (LORD), they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD): neither shall it come to mind: neither shall they remember it; neither shall they visit it; neither shall that be done any more.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, when you be multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, says Yahuah, they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of Yahuah: neither shall it come to mind: neither shall they remember it; neither shall they visit it; neither shall that be done any more.

verses.raw: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of Yahuah (LORD); and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of Yahuah (LORD), to Jerusalem: neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart.
verses.text: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of Yahuah; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of Yahuah, to Jerusalem: neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart.

verses.raw: In those days the house of Yahudah (Judah) shall walk with the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers.
verses.text: In those days the house of Yahudah shall walk with the house of Yashar'el, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers.

verses.raw: But I said, How shall I put you among the children, and give you a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations? and I said, You shall call me, My father; and shall not turn away from me.
verses.text: But I said, How shall I put you among the children, and give you a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations? and I said, You shall call me, My father; and shall not turn away from me.

verses.raw: Surely as a wife treacherously departs from her husband, so have you dealt treacherously with me, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Surely as a wife treacherously departs from her husband, so have you dealt treacherously with me, O house of Yashar'el, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: A voice was heard upon the high places, weeping and supplications of the children of Yashar'el (Israel): for they have perverted their way, and they have forgotten Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God).
verses.text: A voice was heard upon the high places, weeping and supplications of the children of Yashar'el: for they have perverted their way, and they have forgotten Yahuah their Elohim.

verses.raw: Return, you backsliding children, and I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come unto you; for you are Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
verses.text: Return, you backsliding children, and I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come unto you; for you are Yahuah Eloheinu.

verses.raw: Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills, and from the multitude of mountains: truly in Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) is the salvation of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills, and from the multitude of mountains: truly in Yahuah Eloheinu is the salvation of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: For shame has devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
verses.text: For shame has devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

verses.raw: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covers us: for we have sinned against Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day, and have not obeyed the voice of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
verses.text: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covers us: for we have sinned against Yahuah Eloheinu, we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day, and have not obeyed the voice of Yahuah Eloheinu.

verses.raw: If you will return, O Yashar'el (Israel), says Yahuah (LORD), return unto me: and if you will put away your abominations out of my sight, then shall you not remove.
verses.text: If you will return, O Yashar'el, says Yahuah, return unto me: and if you will put away your abominations out of my sight, then shall you not remove.

verses.raw: And you shall swear, Yahuah (LORD) lives, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.
verses.text: And you shall swear, Yahuah lives, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD) to the men of Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah to the men of Yahudah and Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.

verses.raw: Circumcise yourselves to Yahuah (LORD), and take away the foreskins of your heart, you men of Yahudah (Judah) and inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my fury come forth like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
verses.text: Circumcise yourselves to Yahuah, and take away the foreskins of your heart, you men of Yahudah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my fury come forth like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

verses.raw: Declare you in Yahudah (Judah), and publish in Jerusalem; and say, Blow you the trumpet in the land: cry, gather together, and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the defenced cities.
verses.text: Declare you in Yahudah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, Blow you the trumpet in the land: cry, gather together, and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the defenced cities.

verses.raw: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.
verses.text: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.

verses.raw: The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make your land desolate; and your cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.
verses.text: The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make your land desolate; and your cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.

verses.raw: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl: for the fierce anger of Yahuah (LORD) is not turned back from us.
verses.text: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl: for the fierce anger of Yahuah is not turned back from us.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass at that day, says Yahuah (LORD), that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass at that day, says Yahuah, that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.

verses.raw: Then said I, Ah, Adonai (Lord) GOD! surely you have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, You shall have peace; whereas the sword reaches unto the soul.
verses.text: Then said I, Ah, Adonai GOD! surely you have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, You shall have peace; whereas the sword reaches unto the soul.

verses.raw: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,
verses.text: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,

verses.raw: Even a full wind from those places shall come unto me: now also will I give sentence against them.
verses.text: Even a full wind from those places shall come unto me: now also will I give sentence against them.

verses.raw: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are spoiled.
verses.text: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are spoiled.

verses.raw: O Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long shall your vain thoughts lodge within you?
verses.text: O Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long shall your vain thoughts lodge within you?

verses.raw: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.
verses.text: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.

verses.raw: Make you mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, that watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: Make you mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, that watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Yahudah.

verses.raw: As keepers of a field, are they against her round about; because she has been rebellious against me, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: As keepers of a field, are they against her round about; because she has been rebellious against me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Your way and your doings have procured these things unto you; this is your wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reaches unto your heart.
verses.text: Your way and your doings have procured these things unto you; this is your wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reaches unto your heart.

verses.raw: My bowels, my bowels! I am pained at my very heart; my heart makes a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, because you have heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.
verses.text: My bowels, my bowels! I am pained at my very heart; my heart makes a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, because you have heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.

verses.raw: Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is spoiled: suddenly are my tents spoiled, and my curtains in a moment.
verses.text: Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is spoiled: suddenly are my tents spoiled, and my curtains in a moment.

verses.raw: How long shall I see the standard, and hear the sound of the trumpet?
verses.text: How long shall I see the standard, and hear the sound of the trumpet?

verses.raw: For my people is foolish, they have not known me; they are sottish children, and they have none understanding: they are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.
verses.text: For my people is foolish, they have not known me; they are sottish children, and they have none understanding: they are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.

verses.raw: I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was without form, and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.
verses.text: I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was without form, and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.

verses.raw: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.
verses.text: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.

verses.raw: I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.
verses.text: I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.

verses.raw: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of Yahuah (LORD), and by his fierce anger.
verses.text: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of Yahuah, and by his fierce anger.

verses.raw: For thus has Yahuah (LORD) said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.
verses.text: For thus has Yahuah said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.

verses.raw: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black: because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.
verses.text: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black: because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.

verses.raw: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they shall go into thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city shall be forsaken, and not a man dwell therein.
verses.text: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they shall go into thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city shall be forsaken, and not a man dwell therein.

verses.raw: And when you are spoiled, what will you do? Though you clothest thyself with crimson, though you deckest you with ornaments of gold, though you rentest your face with painting, in vain shall you make thyself fair; your lovers will despise you, they will seek your life.
verses.text: And when you are spoiled, what will you do? Though you clothest thyself with crimson, though you deckest you with ornaments of gold, though you rentest your face with painting, in vain shall you make thyself fair; your lovers will despise you, they will seek your life.

verses.raw: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, and the anguish as of her that brings forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, that bewaileth herself, that spreads her hands, saying, Woe is me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.
verses.text: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, and the anguish as of her that brings forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, that bewaileth herself, that spreads her hands, saying, Woe is me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.

verses.raw: Run you to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if you can find a man, if there be any that executeth judgment, that seeks the truth; and I will pardon it.
verses.text: Run you to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if you can find a man, if there be any that executeth judgment, that seeks the truth; and I will pardon it.

verses.raw: And though they say, Yahuah (LORD) lives; surely they swear falsely.
verses.text: And though they say, Yahuah lives; surely they swear falsely.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), are not your eyes upon the truth? you have stricken them, but they have not grieved; you have consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.
verses.text: O Yahuah, are not your eyes upon the truth? you have stricken them, but they have not grieved; you have consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.

verses.raw: Therefore I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of Yahuah (LORD), nor the judgment of their Elohim (God).
verses.text: Therefore I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of Yahuah, nor the judgment of their Elohim.

verses.raw: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they have known the way of Yahuah (LORD), and the judgment of their Elohim (God): but these have altogether broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.
verses.text: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they have known the way of Yahuah, and the judgment of their Elohim: but these have altogether broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.

verses.raw: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, and a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them, a leopard shall watch over their cities: every one that goes out thence shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions are many, and their backslidings are increased.
verses.text: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, and a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them, a leopard shall watch over their cities: every one that goes out thence shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions are many, and their backslidings are increased.

verses.raw: How shall I pardon you for this? your children have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no gods: when I had fed them to the full, they then committed adultery, and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots’ houses.
verses.text: How shall I pardon you for this? your children have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no gods: when I had fed them to the full, they then committed adultery, and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots’ houses.

verses.raw: They were as fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour’s wife.
verses.text: They were as fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour’s wife.

verses.raw: Shall I not visit for these things? says Yahuah (LORD): and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.text: Shall I not visit for these things? says Yahuah: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

verses.raw: Go you up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they are not the LORD’S.
verses.text: Go you up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they are not the LORD’S.

verses.raw: For the house of Yashar'el (Israel) and the house of Yahudah (Judah) have dealt very treacherously against me, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: For the house of Yashar'el and the house of Yahudah have dealt very treacherously against me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: They have belied Yahuah (LORD), and said, It is not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:
verses.text: They have belied Yahuah, and said, It is not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:

verses.raw: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.
verses.text: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.

verses.raw: Wherefore thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of hosts, Because you speak this word, behold, I will make my words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.
verses.text: Wherefore thus says Yahuah Elohim of hosts, Because you speak this word, behold, I will make my words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.

verses.raw: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), says Yahuah (LORD): it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language you know not, neither understand what they say.
verses.text: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Yashar'el, says Yahuah: it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language you know not, neither understand what they say.

verses.raw: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.
verses.text: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.

verses.raw: And they shall eat up your harvest, and your bread, which your sons and your daughters should eat: they shall eat up your flocks and your herds: they shall eat up your vines and your fig trees: they shall impoverish your fenced cities, wherein you trustedst, with the sword.
verses.text: And they shall eat up your harvest, and your bread, which your sons and your daughters should eat: they shall eat up your flocks and your herds: they shall eat up your vines and your fig trees: they shall impoverish your fenced cities, wherein you trustedst, with the sword.

verses.raw: Nevertheless in those days, says Yahuah (LORD), I will not make a full end with you.
verses.text: Nevertheless in those days, says Yahuah, I will not make a full end with you.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, when you shall say, Wherefore does Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) all these things unto us? then shall you answer them, Like as you have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall you serve strangers in a land that is not yours.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, when you shall say, Wherefore does Yahuah Eloheinu all these things unto us? then shall you answer them, Like as you have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall you serve strangers in a land that is not yours.

verses.raw: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Yahudah (Judah), saying,
verses.text: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Yahudah, saying,

verses.raw: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:
verses.text: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:

verses.raw: Fear you not me? says Yahuah (LORD): will you not tremble at my presence, which have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?
verses.text: Fear you not me? says Yahuah: will you not tremble at my presence, which have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?

verses.raw: But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.
verses.text: But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.

verses.raw: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), that gives rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.
verses.text: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear Yahuah Eloheinu, that gives rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.

verses.raw: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good things from you.
verses.text: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good things from you.

verses.raw: For among my people are found wicked men: they lay wait, as he that sets snares; they set a trap, they catch men.
verses.text: For among my people are found wicked men: they lay wait, as he that sets snares; they set a trap, they catch men.

verses.raw: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.
verses.text: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.

verses.raw: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.
verses.text: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.

verses.raw: Shall I not visit for these things? says Yahuah (LORD): shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.text: Shall I not visit for these things? says Yahuah: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

verses.raw: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;
verses.text: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;

verses.raw: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so: and what will you do in the end thereof?
verses.text: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so: and what will you do in the end thereof?

verses.raw: O you children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Beth-haccerem: for evil appears out of the north, and great destruction.
verses.text: O you children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Beth-haccerem: for evil appears out of the north, and great destruction.

verses.raw: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman.
verses.text: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman.

verses.raw: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.
verses.text: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.

verses.raw: Prepare you war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goes away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
verses.text: Prepare you war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goes away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
