verses.raw: Then took I the cup at the LORD’S hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom Yahuah (LORD) had sent me:
verses.text: Then took I the cup at the LORD’S hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom Yahuah had sent me:

verses.raw: To wit, Jerusalem, and the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, and a curse; as it is this day;
verses.text: To wit, Jerusalem, and the cities of Yahudah, and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, and a curse; as it is this day;

verses.raw: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;
verses.text: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;

verses.raw: And all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,
verses.text: And all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,

verses.raw: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,
verses.text: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,

verses.raw: And all the kings of Tyrus, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which are beyond the sea,
verses.text: And all the kings of Tyrus, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which are beyond the sea,

verses.raw: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all that are in the utmost corners,
verses.text: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all that are in the utmost corners,

verses.raw: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,
verses.text: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,

verses.raw: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,
verses.text: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,

verses.raw: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.
verses.text: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.

verses.raw: Therefore you shall say unto them, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Drink you, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.
verses.text: Therefore you shall say unto them, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Drink you, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.

verses.raw: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then shall you say unto them, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); You shall certainly drink.
verses.text: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then shall you say unto them, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; You shall certainly drink.

verses.raw: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should you be utterly unpunished? You shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should you be utterly unpunished? You shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: Therefore prophesy you against them all these words, and say unto them, Yahuah (LORD) shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.text: Therefore prophesy you against them all these words, and say unto them, Yahuah shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.

verses.raw: A noise shall come even to the ends of the earth; for Yahuah (LORD) has a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them that are wicked to the sword, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: A noise shall come even to the ends of the earth; for Yahuah has a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them that are wicked to the sword, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.

verses.raw: And the slain of Yahuah (LORD) shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.
verses.text: And the slain of Yahuah shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.

verses.raw: Howl, you shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, you principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and you shall fall like a pleasant vessel.
verses.text: Howl, you shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, you principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and you shall fall like a pleasant vessel.

verses.raw: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.
verses.text: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.

verses.raw: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for Yahuah (LORD) has spoiled their pasture.
verses.text: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for Yahuah has spoiled their pasture.

verses.raw: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of Yahuah.

verses.raw: He has forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.
verses.text: He has forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.

verses.raw: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah) came this word from Yahuah (LORD), saying,
verses.text: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah came this word from Yahuah, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Stand in the court of the LORD’S house, and speak unto all the cities of Yahudah (Judah), which come to worship in the LORD’S house, all the words that I command you to speak unto them; diminish not a word:
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; Stand in the court of the LORD’S house, and speak unto all the cities of Yahudah, which come to worship in the LORD’S house, all the words that I command you to speak unto them; diminish not a word:

verses.raw: If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.
verses.text: If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.

verses.raw: And you shall say unto them, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); If you will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,
verses.text: And you shall say unto them, Thus says Yahuah; If you will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,

verses.raw: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending them, but you have not hearkened;
verses.text: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending them, but you have not hearkened;

verses.raw: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.
verses.text: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.

verses.raw: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that Yahuah (LORD) had commanded him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, You shall surely die.
verses.text: Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that Yahuah had commanded him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, You shall surely die.

verses.raw: Why have you prophesied in the name of Yahuah (LORD), saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Why have you prophesied in the name of Yahuah, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: When the princes of Yahudah (Judah) heard these things, then they came up from the king’s house unto the house of Yahuah (LORD), and sat down in the entry of the new gate of the LORD’S house.
verses.text: When the princes of Yahudah heard these things, then they came up from the king’s house unto the house of Yahuah, and sat down in the entry of the new gate of the LORD’S house.

verses.raw: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy to die; for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.
verses.text: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy to die; for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.

verses.raw: Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, Yahuah (LORD) sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.
verses.text: Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, Yahuah sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.

verses.raw: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God); and Yahuah (LORD) will repent him of the evil that he has pronounced against you.
verses.text: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of Yahuah Elohaychem; and Yahuah will repent him of the evil that he has pronounced against you.

verses.raw: As for me, behold, I am in your hand: do with me as seems good and meet unto you.
verses.text: As for me, behold, I am in your hand: do with me as seems good and meet unto you.

verses.raw: But know you for certain, that if you put me to death, you shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth Yahuah (LORD) has sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.
verses.text: But know you for certain, that if you put me to death, you shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth Yahuah has sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.

verses.raw: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets; This man is not worthy to die: for he has spoken to us in the name of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
verses.text: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets; This man is not worthy to die: for he has spoken to us in the name of Yahuah Eloheinu.

verses.raw: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spake to all the assembly of the people, saying,
verses.text: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spake to all the assembly of the people, saying,

verses.raw: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), and spake to all the people of Yahudah (Judah), saying, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.
verses.text: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Yahudah, and spake to all the people of Yahudah, saying, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.

verses.raw: Did Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) and all Yahudah (Judah) put him at all to death? did he not fear Yahuah (LORD), and besought Yahuah (LORD), and Yahuah (LORD) repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls.
verses.text: Did Hezekiah king of Yahudah and all Yahudah put him at all to death? did he not fear Yahuah, and besought Yahuah, and Yahuah repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls.

verses.raw: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of Yahuah (LORD), Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjath-jearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:
verses.text: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of Yahuah, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjath-jearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:

verses.raw: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;
verses.text: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;

verses.raw: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, namely, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him into Egypt.
verses.text: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, namely, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him into Egypt.

verses.raw: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
verses.text: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.

verses.raw: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
verses.text: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.

verses.raw: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah) came this word unto Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), saying,
verses.text: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah came this word unto Jeremiah from Yahuah, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) to me; Make you bonds and yokes, and put them upon your neck,
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah to me; Make you bonds and yokes, and put them upon your neck,

verses.raw: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyrus, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah);
verses.text: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyrus, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Yahudah;

verses.raw: And command them to say unto their masters, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Thus shall you say unto your masters;
verses.text: And command them to say unto their masters, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Thus shall you say unto your masters;

verses.raw: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.
verses.text: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.

verses.raw: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.
verses.text: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.

verses.raw: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son’s son, until the very time of his land come: and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him.
verses.text: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son’s son, until the very time of his land come: and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, says Yahuah (LORD), with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, says Yahuah, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.

verses.raw: Therefore hearken not you to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, You shall not serve the king of Babylon:
verses.text: Therefore hearken not you to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, You shall not serve the king of Babylon:

verses.raw: For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and you should perish.
verses.text: For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and you should perish.

verses.raw: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those will I let remain still in their own land, says Yahuah (LORD); and they shall till it, and dwell therein.
verses.text: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those will I let remain still in their own land, says Yahuah; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.

verses.raw: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
verses.text: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Yahudah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.

verses.raw: Why will you die, you and your people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as Yahuah (LORD) has spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
verses.text: Why will you die, you and your people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as Yahuah has spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

verses.raw: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying, You shall not serve the king of Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
verses.text: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying, You shall not serve the king of Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.

verses.raw: For I have not sent them, says Yahuah (LORD), yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that you might perish, you, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.
verses.text: For I have not sent them, says Yahuah, yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that you might perish, you, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.

verses.raw: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the LORD’S house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
verses.text: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus says Yahuah; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the LORD’S house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.

verses.raw: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city be laid waste?
verses.text: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city be laid waste?

verses.raw: But if they be prophets, and if the word of Yahuah (LORD) be with them, let them now make intercession to Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that the vessels which are left in the house of Yahuah (LORD), and in the house of the king of Yahudah (Judah), and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.
verses.text: But if they be prophets, and if the word of Yahuah be with them, let them now make intercession to Yahuah Tseva'ot, that the vessels which are left in the house of Yahuah, and in the house of the king of Yahudah, and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city,
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city,

verses.raw: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Yahudah (Judah) from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem;
verses.text: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Yahudah from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Yahudah and Jerusalem;

verses.raw: Yea, thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), concerning the vessels that remain in the house of Yahuah (LORD), and in the house of the king of Yahudah (Judah) and of Jerusalem;
verses.text: Yea, thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el, concerning the vessels that remain in the house of Yahuah, and in the house of the king of Yahudah and of Jerusalem;

verses.raw: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be until the day that I visit them, says Yahuah (LORD); then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.
verses.text: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be until the day that I visit them, says Yahuah; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.

verses.raw: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), in the fourth year, and in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which was of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of Yahuah (LORD), in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
verses.text: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Yahudah, in the fourth year, and in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which was of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of Yahuah, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,

verses.raw: Thus speaks Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.text: Thus speaks Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

verses.raw: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD’S house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon:
verses.text: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD’S house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon:

verses.raw: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Yahudah (Judah), with all the captives of Yahudah (Judah), that went into Babylon, says Yahuah (LORD): for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.
verses.text: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Yahudah, with all the captives of Yahudah, that went into Babylon, says Yahuah: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

verses.raw: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of Yahuah (LORD),
verses.text: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of Yahuah,

verses.raw: Even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: Yahuah (LORD) do so: Yahuah (LORD) perform your words which you have prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD’S house, and all that is carried away captive, from Babylon into this place.
verses.text: Even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: Yahuah do so: Yahuah perform your words which you have prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD’S house, and all that is carried away captive, from Babylon into this place.

verses.raw: Nevertheless hear you now this word that I speak in your ears, and in the ears of all the people;
verses.text: Nevertheless hear you now this word that I speak in your ears, and in the ears of all the people;

verses.raw: The prophets that have been before me and before you of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.
verses.text: The prophets that have been before me and before you of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.

verses.raw: The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that Yahuah (LORD) has truly sent him.
verses.text: The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that Yahuah has truly sent him.

verses.raw: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and brake it.
verses.text: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and brake it.

verses.raw: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.
verses.text: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus says Yahuah; Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.

verses.raw: Then the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Jeremiah the prophet, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
verses.text: Then the word of Yahuah came unto Jeremiah the prophet, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

verses.raw: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); You have broken the yokes of wood; but you shall make for them yokes of iron.
verses.text: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus says Yahuah; You have broken the yokes of wood; but you shall make for them yokes of iron.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.

verses.raw: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; Yahuah (LORD) has not sent you; but you make this people to trust in a lie.
verses.text: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; Yahuah has not sent you; but you make this people to trust in a lie.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I will cast you from off the face of the earth: this year you shall die, because you have taught rebellion against Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah; Behold, I will cast you from off the face of the earth: this year you shall die, because you have taught rebellion against Yahuah.

verses.raw: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
verses.text: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.

verses.raw: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders which were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon;
verses.text: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders which were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon;

verses.raw: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)
verses.text: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Yahudah and Jerusalem, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)

verses.raw: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,
verses.text: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Yahudah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el, unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;

verses.raw: Build you houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;
verses.text: Build you houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;

verses.raw: Take you wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that you may be increased there, and not diminished.
verses.text: Take you wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that you may be increased there, and not diminished.

verses.raw: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto Yahuah (LORD) for it: for in the peace thereof shall you have peace.
verses.text: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto Yahuah for it: for in the peace thereof shall you have peace.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Let not your prophets and your diviners, that be in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which you cause to be dreamed.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Let not your prophets and your diviners, that be in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which you cause to be dreamed.

verses.raw: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD), That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah, That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.

verses.raw: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says Yahuah (LORD), thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
verses.text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says Yahuah, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

verses.raw: Then shall you call upon me, and you shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
verses.text: Then shall you call upon me, and you shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.

verses.raw: And you shall seek me, and find me, when you shall search for me with all your heart.
verses.text: And you shall seek me, and find me, when you shall search for me with all your heart.

verses.raw: And I will be found of you, says Yahuah (LORD): and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, says Yahuah (LORD); and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.
verses.text: And I will be found of you, says Yahuah: and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, says Yahuah; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.

verses.raw: Because you have said, Yahuah (LORD) has raised us up prophets in Babylon;
verses.text: Because you have said, Yahuah has raised us up prophets in Babylon;

verses.raw: Know that thus says Yahuah (LORD) of the king that sits upon the throne of David, and of all the people that dwells in this city, and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;
verses.text: Know that thus says Yahuah of the king that sits upon the throne of David, and of all the people that dwells in this city, and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.

verses.raw: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them:
verses.text: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them:

verses.raw: Because they have not hearkened to my words, says Yahuah (LORD), which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but you would not hear, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Because they have not hearkened to my words, says Yahuah, which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but you would not hear, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Hear you therefore the word of Yahuah (LORD), all you of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:
verses.text: Hear you therefore the word of Yahuah, all you of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el, of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;

verses.raw: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Yahudah (Judah) which are in Babylon, saying, Yahuah (LORD) make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;
verses.text: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Yahudah which are in Babylon, saying, Yahuah make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;

verses.raw: Because they have committed villany in Yashar'el (Israel), and have committed adultery with their neighbours’ wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and am a witness, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Because they have committed villany in Yashar'el, and have committed adultery with their neighbours’ wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and am a witness, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus shall you also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,
verses.text: Thus shall you also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,

verses.raw: Thus speaks Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Because you have sent letters in your name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
verses.text: Thus speaks Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el, saying, Because you have sent letters in your name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has made you priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that you should be officers in the house of Yahuah (LORD), for every man that is mad, and makes himself a prophet, that you should put him in prison, and in the stocks.
verses.text: Yahuah has made you priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that you should be officers in the house of Yahuah, for every man that is mad, and makes himself a prophet, that you should put him in prison, and in the stocks.

verses.raw: Now therefore why have you not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which makes himself a prophet to you?
verses.text: Now therefore why have you not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which makes himself a prophet to you?

verses.raw: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon, saying, This captivity is long: build you houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.text: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon, saying, This captivity is long: build you houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

verses.raw: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.text: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.

verses.raw: Then came the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.text: Then came the word of Yahuah unto Jeremiah, saying,

verses.raw: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD) concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because that Shemaiah has prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:
verses.text: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus says Yahuah concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because that Shemaiah has prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, says Yahuah (LORD); because he has taught rebellion against Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah; Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, says Yahuah; because he has taught rebellion against Yahuah.

verses.raw: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), saying,
verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahuah, saying,

verses.raw: Thus speaks Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Write you all the words that I have spoken unto you in a book.
verses.text: Thus speaks Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, saying, Write you all the words that I have spoken unto you in a book.

verses.raw: For, lo, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will bring again the captivity of my people Yashar'el (Israel) and Yahudah (Judah), says Yahuah (LORD): and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.
verses.text: For, lo, the days come, says Yahuah, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Yashar'el and Yahudah, says Yahuah: and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.

verses.raw: And these are the words that Yahuah (LORD) spake concerning Yashar'el (Israel) and concerning Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And these are the words that Yahuah spake concerning Yashar'el and concerning Yahudah.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD); We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.

verses.raw: Ask you now, and see whether a man does travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?
verses.text: Ask you now, and see whether a man does travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?

verses.raw: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.
verses.text: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.

verses.raw: For it shall come to pass in that day, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that I will break his yoke from off your neck, and will burst your bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:
verses.text: For it shall come to pass in that day, says Yahuah Tseva'ot, that I will break his yoke from off your neck, and will burst your bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:

verses.raw: But they shall serve Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.
verses.text: But they shall serve Yahuah their Elohim, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.

verses.raw: Therefore fear you not, O my servant Jacob, says Yahuah (LORD); neither be dismayed, O Yashar'el (Israel): for, lo, I will save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make him afraid.
verses.text: Therefore fear you not, O my servant Jacob, says Yahuah; neither be dismayed, O Yashar'el: for, lo, I will save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make him afraid.

verses.raw: For I am with you, says Yahuah (LORD), to save you: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered you, yet will I not make a full end of you: but I will correct you in measure, and will not leave you altogether unpunished.
verses.text: For I am with you, says Yahuah, to save you: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered you, yet will I not make a full end of you: but I will correct you in measure, and will not leave you altogether unpunished.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD), Your bruise is incurable, and your wound is grievous.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah, Your bruise is incurable, and your wound is grievous.

verses.raw: There is none to plead your cause, that you may be bound up: you have no healing medicines.
verses.text: There is none to plead your cause, that you may be bound up: you have no healing medicines.

verses.raw: All your lovers have forgotten you; they seek you not; for I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of your iniquity; because your sins were increased.
verses.text: All your lovers have forgotten you; they seek you not; for I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of your iniquity; because your sins were increased.

verses.raw: Why cry you for your affliction? your sorrow is incurable for the multitude of your iniquity: because your sins were increased, I have done these things unto you.
verses.text: Why cry you for your affliction? your sorrow is incurable for the multitude of your iniquity: because your sins were increased, I have done these things unto you.

verses.raw: Therefore all they that devour you shall be devoured; and all your adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil you shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon you will I give for a prey.
verses.text: Therefore all they that devour you shall be devoured; and all your adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil you shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon you will I give for a prey.

verses.raw: For I will restore health unto you, and I will heal you of your wounds, says Yahuah (LORD); because they called you an Outcast, saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeks after.
verses.text: For I will restore health unto you, and I will heal you of your wounds, says Yahuah; because they called you an Outcast, saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeks after.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.

verses.raw: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.
verses.text: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.

verses.raw: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.
verses.text: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.

verses.raw: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who is this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who is this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? says Yahuah.

verses.raw: And you shall be my people, and I will be your Elohim (God).
verses.text: And you shall be my people, and I will be your Elohim.

verses.raw: Behold, the whirlwind of Yahuah (LORD) goes forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.
verses.text: Behold, the whirlwind of Yahuah goes forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.

verses.raw: The fierce anger of Yahuah (LORD) shall not return, until he have done it, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days you shall consider it.
verses.text: The fierce anger of Yahuah shall not return, until he have done it, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days you shall consider it.

verses.raw: At the same time, says Yahuah (LORD), will I be the Elohim (God) of all the families of Yashar'el (Israel), and they shall be my people.
verses.text: At the same time, says Yahuah, will I be the Elohim of all the families of Yashar'el, and they shall be my people.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Yashar'el (Israel), when I went to cause him to rest.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Yashar'el, when I went to cause him to rest.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved you with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn you.
verses.text: Yahuah has appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved you with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn you.

verses.raw: Again I will build you, and you shall be built, O virgin of Yashar'el (Israel): you shall again be adorned with your tabrets, and shall go forth in the dances of them that make merry.
verses.text: Again I will build you, and you shall be built, O virgin of Yashar'el: you shall again be adorned with your tabrets, and shall go forth in the dances of them that make merry.

verses.raw: You shall yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.
verses.text: You shall yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.

verses.raw: For there shall be a day, that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise you, and let us go up to Zion unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
verses.text: For there shall be a day, that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise you, and let us go up to Zion unto Yahuah Eloheinu.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD); Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish you, praise you, and say, O Yahuah (LORD), save your people, the remnant of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish you, praise you, and say, O Yahuah, save your people, the remnant of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.
verses.text: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.

verses.raw: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Yashar'el (Israel), and Ephraim is my firstborn.
verses.text: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Yashar'el, and Ephraim is my firstborn.

verses.raw: Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), O you nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Yashar'el (Israel) will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd does his flock.
verses.text: Hear the word of Yahuah, O you nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Yashar'el will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd does his flock.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) has redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he.
verses.text: For Yahuah has redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he.

verses.raw: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of Yahuah (LORD), for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.
verses.text: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of Yahuah, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.

verses.raw: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
verses.text: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.

verses.raw: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, and bitter weeping; Rahel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they were not.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, and bitter weeping; Rahel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they were not.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Refrain your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears: for your work shall be rewarded, says Yahuah (LORD); and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; Refrain your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears: for your work shall be rewarded, says Yahuah; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.

verses.raw: And there is hope in your end, says Yahuah (LORD), that your children shall come again to their own border.
verses.text: And there is hope in your end, says Yahuah, that your children shall come again to their own border.

verses.raw: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus; You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke: turn you me, and I shall be turned; for you are Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God).
verses.text: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus; You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke: turn you me, and I shall be turned; for you are Yahuah Elohai.

verses.raw: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.
verses.text: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.

verses.raw: Is Ephraim my dear son? is he a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Is Ephraim my dear son? is he a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Set you up waymarks, make you high heaps: set your heart toward the highway, even the way which you went: turn again, O virgin of Yashar'el (Israel), turn again to these your cities.
verses.text: Set you up waymarks, make you high heaps: set your heart toward the highway, even the way which you went: turn again, O virgin of Yashar'el, turn again to these your cities.

verses.raw: How long will you go about, O you backsliding daughter? for Yahuah (LORD) has created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.
verses.text: How long will you go about, O you backsliding daughter? for Yahuah has created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Yahudah (Judah) and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity; Yahuah (LORD) bless you, O habitation of justice, and mountain of holiness.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Yahudah and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity; Yahuah bless you, O habitation of justice, and mountain of holiness.

verses.raw: And there shall dwell in Yahudah (Judah) itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they that go forth with flocks.
verses.text: And there shall dwell in Yahudah itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they that go forth with flocks.

verses.raw: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
verses.text: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.

verses.raw: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.
verses.text: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.

verses.raw: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will sow the house of Yashar'el (Israel) and the house of Yahudah (Judah) with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.
verses.text: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah, that I will sow the house of Yashar'el and the house of Yahudah with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.
verses.text: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.

verses.raw: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eats the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.
verses.text: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eats the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.

verses.raw: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will make a new covenant with the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and with the house of Yahudah (Judah):
verses.text: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Yashar'el, and with the house of Yahudah:

verses.raw: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, says Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, says Yahuah:

verses.raw: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel); After those days, says Yahuah (LORD), I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people.
verses.text: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el; After those days, says Yahuah, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their Elohim, and they shall be my people.

verses.raw: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know Yahuah (LORD): for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, says Yahuah (LORD): for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.
verses.text: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know Yahuah: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, says Yahuah: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), which gives the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divides the sea when the waves thereof roar; Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name:
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, which gives the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divides the sea when the waves thereof roar; Yahuah Tseva'ot is his name:

verses.raw: If those ordinances depart from before me, says Yahuah (LORD), then the seed of Yashar'el (Israel) also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.
verses.text: If those ordinances depart from before me, says Yahuah, then the seed of Yashar'el also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Yashar'el (Israel) for all that they have done, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Yashar'el for all that they have done, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that the city shall be built to Yahuah (LORD) from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner.
verses.text: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah, that the city shall be built to Yahuah from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner.

verses.raw: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.
verses.text: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.

verses.raw: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy unto Yahuah (LORD); it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.
verses.text: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy unto Yahuah; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.

verses.raw: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD) in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.
verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahuah in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Yahudah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.

verses.raw: For then the king of Babylon’s army besieged Jerusalem: and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which was in the king of Yahudah's (Judah’s) house.
verses.text: For then the king of Babylon’s army besieged Jerusalem: and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which was in the king of Yahudah's (Judah’s) house.

verses.raw: For Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) had shut him up, saying, Wherefore do you prophesy, and say, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;
verses.text: For Zedekiah king of Yahudah had shut him up, saying, Wherefore do you prophesy, and say, Thus says Yahuah, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;

verses.raw: And Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes;
verses.text: And Zedekiah king of Yahudah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes;

verses.raw: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall he be until I visit him, says Yahuah (LORD): though you fight with the Chaldeans, you shall not prosper.
verses.text: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall he be until I visit him, says Yahuah: though you fight with the Chaldeans, you shall not prosper.

verses.raw: And Jeremiah said, The word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And Jeremiah said, The word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum your uncle shall come unto you, saying, Buy you my field that is in Anathoth: for the right of redemption is yours to buy it.
verses.text: Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum your uncle shall come unto you, saying, Buy you my field that is in Anathoth: for the right of redemption is yours to buy it.

verses.raw: So Hanameel my uncle’s son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray you, that is in Anathoth, which is in the country of Benjamin: for the right of inheritance is yours, and the redemption is yours; buy it for thyself. Then I knew that this was the word of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: So Hanameel my uncle’s son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of Yahuah, and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray you, that is in Anathoth, which is in the country of Benjamin: for the right of inheritance is yours, and the redemption is yours; buy it for thyself. Then I knew that this was the word of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle’s son, that was in Anathoth, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.
verses.text: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle’s son, that was in Anathoth, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.

verses.raw: And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed it, and took witnesses, and weighed him the money in the balances.
verses.text: And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed it, and took witnesses, and weighed him the money in the balances.

verses.raw: So I took the evidence of the purchase, both that which was sealed according to the law and custom, and that which was open:
verses.text: So I took the evidence of the purchase, both that which was sealed according to the law and custom, and that which was open:

verses.raw: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel my uncle’s son, and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase, before all the Yahudim (Jews) that sat in the court of the prison.
verses.text: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel my uncle’s son, and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase, before all the Yahudim that sat in the court of the prison.

verses.raw: And I charged Baruch before them, saying,
verses.text: And I charged Baruch before them, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Take these evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may continue many days.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Take these evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may continue many days.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.

verses.raw: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed unto Yahuah (LORD), saying,
verses.text: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed unto Yahuah, saying,

verses.raw: Ah Adonai (Lord) GOD! behold, you have made the heaven and the earth by your great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for you:
verses.text: Ah Adonai GOD! behold, you have made the heaven and the earth by your great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for you:

verses.raw: You shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the Great, the Mighty Elohim (God), Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), is his name,
verses.text: You shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the Great, the Mighty Elohim, Yahuah Tseva'ot, is his name,

verses.raw: Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for your eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:
verses.text: Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for your eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:

verses.raw: Which have set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even unto this day, and in Yashar'el (Israel), and among other men; and have made you a name, as at this day;
verses.text: Which have set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even unto this day, and in Yashar'el, and among other men; and have made you a name, as at this day;

verses.raw: And have brought forth your people Yashar'el (Israel) out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror;
verses.text: And have brought forth your people Yashar'el out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror;

verses.raw: And have given them this land, which you did swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;
verses.text: And have given them this land, which you did swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;

verses.raw: And they came in, and possessed it; but they obeyed not your voice, neither walked in your law; they have done nothing of all that you commanded them to do: therefore you have caused all this evil to come upon them:
verses.text: And they came in, and possessed it; but they obeyed not your voice, neither walked in your law; they have done nothing of all that you commanded them to do: therefore you have caused all this evil to come upon them:

verses.raw: Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what you have spoken is come to pass; and, behold, you see it.
verses.text: Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what you have spoken is come to pass; and, behold, you see it.

verses.raw: And you have said unto me, O Adonai (Lord) GOD, Buy you the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.text: And you have said unto me, O Adonai GOD, Buy you the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

verses.raw: Then came the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.text: Then came the word of Yahuah unto Jeremiah, saying,

verses.raw: Behold, I am Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?
verses.text: Behold, I am Yahuah, the Elohim of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:

verses.raw: And the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and set fire on this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto other gods, to provoke me to anger.
verses.text: And the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and set fire on this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto other gods, to provoke me to anger.

verses.raw: For the children of Yashar'el (Israel) and the children of Yahudah (Judah) have only done evil before me from their youth: for the children of Yashar'el (Israel) have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: For the children of Yashar'el and the children of Yahudah have only done evil before me from their youth: for the children of Yashar'el have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: For this city has been to me as a provocation of my anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I should remove it from before my face,
verses.text: For this city has been to me as a provocation of my anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I should remove it from before my face,

verses.raw: Because of all the evil of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) and of the children of Yahudah (Judah), which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Yahudah (Judah), and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.text: Because of all the evil of the children of Yashar'el and of the children of Yahudah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Yahudah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.
verses.text: And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.

verses.raw: But they set their abominations in the house, which is called by my name, to defile it.
verses.text: But they set their abominations in the house, which is called by my name, to defile it.

verses.raw: And they built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Yahudah (Judah) to sin.
verses.text: And they built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Yahudah to sin.

verses.raw: And now therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), concerning this city, whereof you say, It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence;
verses.text: And now therefore thus says Yahuah, the Elohim of Yashar'el, concerning this city, whereof you say, It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence;

verses.raw: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in my anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:
verses.text: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in my anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:
