verses.raw: And they shall be my people, and I will be their Elohim (God):
verses.text: And they shall be my people, and I will be their Elohim:

verses.raw: And I will give them one heart, and one way, that they may fear me for ever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:
verses.text: And I will give them one heart, and one way, that they may fear me for ever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:

verses.raw: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.
verses.text: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.

verses.raw: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.
verses.text: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD); Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them.

verses.raw: And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof you say, It is desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.text: And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof you say, It is desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

verses.raw: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal them, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south: for I will cause their captivity to return, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal them, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Yahudah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south: for I will cause their captivity to return, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison, saying,
verses.text: Moreover the word of Yahuah came unto Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) the maker thereof, Yahuah (LORD) that formed it, to establish it; Yahuah (LORD) is his name;
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah the maker thereof, Yahuah that formed it, to establish it; Yahuah is his name;

verses.raw: Call unto me, and I will answer you, and shew you great and mighty things, which you know not.
verses.text: Call unto me, and I will answer you, and shew you great and mighty things, which you know not.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Yahudah (Judah), which are thrown down by the mounts, and by the sword;
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah, the Elohim of Yashar'el, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Yahudah, which are thrown down by the mounts, and by the sword;

verses.raw: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but it is to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in my anger and in my fury, and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.
verses.text: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but it is to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in my anger and in my fury, and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.

verses.raw: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them, and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.
verses.text: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them, and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.

verses.raw: And I will cause the captivity of Yahudah (Judah) and the captivity of Yashar'el (Israel) to return, and will build them, as at the first.
verses.text: And I will cause the captivity of Yahudah and the captivity of Yashar'el to return, and will build them, as at the first.

verses.raw: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, whereby they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned, and whereby they have transgressed against me.
verses.text: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, whereby they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned, and whereby they have transgressed against me.

verses.raw: And it shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do unto them: and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it.
verses.text: And it shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do unto them: and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Again there shall be heard in this place, which you say shall be desolate without man and without beast, even in the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast,
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; Again there shall be heard in this place, which you say shall be desolate without man and without beast, even in the cities of Yahudah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast,

verses.raw: The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of them that shall say, Praise Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): for Yahuah (LORD) is good; for his mercy endures for ever: and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of Yahuah (LORD). For I will cause to return the captivity of the land, as at the first, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of them that shall say, Praise Yahuah Tseva'ot: for Yahuah is good; for his mercy endures for ever: and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of Yahuah. For I will cause to return the captivity of the land, as at the first, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Again in this place, which is desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof, shall be an habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; Again in this place, which is desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof, shall be an habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.

verses.raw: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Yahudah (Judah), shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Yahudah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel) and to the house of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah, that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Yashar'el and to the house of Yahudah.

verses.raw: In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.
verses.text: In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.

verses.raw: In those days shall Yahudah (Judah) be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this is the name wherewith she shall be called, Yahuah (LORD) our righteousness.
verses.text: In those days shall Yahudah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this is the name wherewith she shall be called, Yahuah our righteousness.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD); David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Yashar'el (Israel);
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah; David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Yashar'el;

verses.raw: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle meat offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.
verses.text: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle meat offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto Jeremiah, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); If you can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season;
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; If you can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season;

verses.raw: Then may also my covenant be broken with David my servant, that he should not have a son to reign upon his throne; and with the Levites the priests, my ministers.
verses.text: Then may also my covenant be broken with David my servant, that he should not have a son to reign upon his throne; and with the Levites the priests, my ministers.

verses.raw: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured: so will I multiply the seed of David my servant, and the Levites that minister unto me.
verses.text: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured: so will I multiply the seed of David my servant, and the Levites that minister unto me.

verses.raw: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Jeremiah, saying,
verses.text: Moreover the word of Yahuah came to Jeremiah, saying,

verses.raw: Considerest you not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which Yahuah (LORD) has chosen, he has even cast them off? thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.
verses.text: Considerest you not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which Yahuah has chosen, he has even cast them off? thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;

verses.raw: Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob, and David my servant, so that I will not take any of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.
verses.text: Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob, and David my servant, so that I will not take any of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.

verses.raw: The word which came unto Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion, and all the people, fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities thereof, saying,
verses.text: The word which came unto Jeremiah from Yahuah, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion, and all the people, fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities thereof, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), and tell him, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire:
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Yahudah, and tell him, Thus says Yahuah; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire:

verses.raw: And you shall not escape out of his hand, but shall surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and your eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with you mouth to mouth, and you shall go to Babylon.
verses.text: And you shall not escape out of his hand, but shall surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and your eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with you mouth to mouth, and you shall go to Babylon.

verses.raw: Yet hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), O Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah); Thus says Yahuah (LORD) of you, You shall not die by the sword:
verses.text: Yet hear the word of Yahuah, O Zedekiah king of Yahudah; Thus says Yahuah of you, You shall not die by the sword:

verses.raw: But you shall die in peace: and with the burnings of your fathers, the former kings which were before you, so shall they burn odours for you; and they will lament you, saying, Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But you shall die in peace: and with the burnings of your fathers, the former kings which were before you, so shall they burn odours for you; and they will lament you, saying, Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) in Jerusalem,
verses.text: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Yahudah in Jerusalem,

verses.raw: When the king of Babylon’s army fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Yahudah (Judah) that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: When the king of Babylon’s army fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Yahudah that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Yahudah.

verses.raw: This is the word that came unto Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;
verses.text: This is the word that came unto Jeremiah from Yahuah, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;

verses.raw: That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, to wit, of a Yahudi (Jew) his brother.
verses.text: That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, to wit, of a Yahudi his brother.

verses.raw: Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered into the covenant, heard that every one should let his manservant, and every one his maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of them any more, then they obeyed, and let them go.
verses.text: Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered into the covenant, heard that every one should let his manservant, and every one his maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of them any more, then they obeyed, and let them go.

verses.raw: But afterward they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.
verses.text: But afterward they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.

verses.raw: Therefore the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), saying,
verses.text: Therefore the word of Yahuah came to Jeremiah from Yahuah, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondmen, saying,
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, the Elohim of Yashar'el; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondmen, saying,

verses.raw: At the end of seven years let you go every man his brother an Hebrew, which has been sold unto you; and when he has served you six years, you shall let him go free from you: but your fathers hearkened not unto me, neither inclined their ear.
verses.text: At the end of seven years let you go every man his brother an Hebrew, which has been sold unto you; and when he has served you six years, you shall let him go free from you: but your fathers hearkened not unto me, neither inclined their ear.

verses.raw: And you were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and you had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:
verses.text: And you were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and you had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:

verses.raw: But you turned and polluted my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom you had set at liberty at their pleasure, to return, and brought them into subjection, to be unto you for servants and for handmaids.
verses.text: But you turned and polluted my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom you had set at liberty at their pleasure, to return, and brought them into subjection, to be unto you for servants and for handmaids.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); You have not hearkened unto me, in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother, and every man to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, says Yahuah (LORD), to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah; You have not hearkened unto me, in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother, and every man to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, says Yahuah, to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.

verses.raw: And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, which have not performed the words of the covenant which they had made before me, when they cut the calf in twain, and passed between the parts thereof,
verses.text: And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, which have not performed the words of the covenant which they had made before me, when they cut the calf in twain, and passed between the parts thereof,

verses.raw: The princes of Yahudah (Judah), and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, which passed between the parts of the calf;
verses.text: The princes of Yahudah, and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, which passed between the parts of the calf;

verses.raw: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.
verses.text: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.

verses.raw: And Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon’s army, which are gone up from you.
verses.text: And Zedekiah king of Yahudah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon’s army, which are gone up from you.

verses.raw: Behold, I will command, says Yahuah (LORD), and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Yahudah (Judah) a desolation without an inhabitant.
verses.text: Behold, I will command, says Yahuah, and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Yahudah a desolation without an inhabitant.

verses.raw: The word which came unto Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD) in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah), saying,
verses.text: The word which came unto Jeremiah from Yahuah in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah, saying,

verses.raw: Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and speak unto them, and bring them into the house of Yahuah (LORD), into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.
verses.text: Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and speak unto them, and bring them into the house of Yahuah, into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.

verses.raw: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;
verses.text: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;

verses.raw: And I brought them into the house of Yahuah (LORD), into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, a man of Elohim (God), which was by the chamber of the princes, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door:
verses.text: And I brought them into the house of Yahuah, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, a man of Elohim, which was by the chamber of the princes, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door:

verses.raw: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink you wine.
verses.text: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink you wine.

verses.raw: But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, You shall drink no wine, neither you, nor your sons for ever:
verses.text: But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, You shall drink no wine, neither you, nor your sons for ever:

verses.raw: Neither shall you build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have any: but all your days you shall dwell in tents; that you may live many days in the land where you be strangers.
verses.text: Neither shall you build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have any: but all your days you shall dwell in tents; that you may live many days in the land where you be strangers.

verses.raw: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he has charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;
verses.text: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he has charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;

verses.raw: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:
verses.text: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:

verses.raw: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
verses.text: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

verses.raw: But it came to pass, when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians: so we dwell at Jerusalem.
verses.text: But it came to pass, when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians: so we dwell at Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Then came the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.text: Then came the word of Yahuah unto Jeremiah, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Go and tell the men of Yahudah (Judah) and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will you not receive instruction to hearken to my words? says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Go and tell the men of Yahudah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will you not receive instruction to hearken to my words? says Yahuah.

verses.raw: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but obey their father’s commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but you hearkened not unto me.
verses.text: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but obey their father’s commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but you hearkened not unto me.

verses.raw: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, Return you now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and go not after other gods to serve them, and you shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but you have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.
verses.text: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, Return you now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and go not after other gods to serve them, and you shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but you have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.

verses.raw: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them; but this people has not hearkened unto me:
verses.text: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them; but this people has not hearkened unto me:

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of hosts, the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will bring upon Yahudah (Judah) and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them: because I have spoken unto them, but they have not heard; and I have called unto them, but they have not answered.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah Elohim of hosts, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Behold, I will bring upon Yahudah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them: because I have spoken unto them, but they have not heard; and I have called unto them, but they have not answered.

verses.raw: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Because you have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according unto all that he has commanded you:
verses.text: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Because you have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according unto all that he has commanded you:

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah), that this word came unto Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), saying,
verses.text: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah, that this word came unto Jeremiah from Yahuah, saying,

verses.raw: Take you a roll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto you against Yashar'el (Israel), and against Yahudah (Judah), and against all the nations, from the day I spake unto you, from the days of Josiah, even unto this day.
verses.text: Take you a roll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto you against Yashar'el, and against Yahudah, and against all the nations, from the day I spake unto you, from the days of Josiah, even unto this day.

verses.raw: It may be that the house of Yahudah (Judah) will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them; that they may return every man from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.
verses.text: It may be that the house of Yahudah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them; that they may return every man from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.

verses.raw: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah: and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of Yahuah (LORD), which he had spoken unto him, upon a roll of a book.
verses.text: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah: and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of Yahuah, which he had spoken unto him, upon a roll of a book.

verses.raw: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I am shut up; I cannot go into the house of Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I am shut up; I cannot go into the house of Yahuah:

verses.raw: Therefore go you, and read in the roll, which you have written from my mouth, the words of Yahuah (LORD) in the ears of the people in the LORD’S house upon the fasting day: and also you shall read them in the ears of all Yahudah (Judah) that come out of their cities.
verses.text: Therefore go you, and read in the roll, which you have written from my mouth, the words of Yahuah in the ears of the people in the LORD’S house upon the fasting day: and also you shall read them in the ears of all Yahudah that come out of their cities.

verses.raw: It may be they will present their supplication before Yahuah (LORD), and will return every one from his evil way: for great is the anger and the fury that Yahuah (LORD) has pronounced against this people.
verses.text: It may be they will present their supplication before Yahuah, and will return every one from his evil way: for great is the anger and the fury that Yahuah has pronounced against this people.

verses.raw: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the words of Yahuah (LORD) in the LORD’S house.
verses.text: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the words of Yahuah in the LORD’S house.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah), in the ninth month, that they proclaimed a fast before Yahuah (LORD) to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people that came from the cities of Yahudah (Judah) unto Jerusalem.
verses.text: And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah, in the ninth month, that they proclaimed a fast before Yahuah to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people that came from the cities of Yahudah unto Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of Yahuah (LORD), in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the entry of the new gate of the LORD’S house, in the ears of all the people.
verses.text: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of Yahuah, in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the entry of the new gate of the LORD’S house, in the ears of all the people.

verses.raw: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of Yahuah (LORD),
verses.text: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of Yahuah,

verses.raw: Then he went down into the king’s house, into the scribe’s chamber: and, lo, all the princes sat there, even Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.
verses.text: Then he went down into the king’s house, into the scribe’s chamber: and, lo, all the princes sat there, even Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.

verses.raw: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.
verses.text: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.

verses.raw: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, unto Baruch, saying, Take in your hand the roll wherein you have read in the ears of the people, and come. So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand, and came unto them.
verses.text: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, unto Baruch, saying, Take in your hand the roll wherein you have read in the ears of the people, and come. So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand, and came unto them.

verses.raw: And they said unto him, Sit down now, and read it in our ears. So Baruch read it in their ears.
verses.text: And they said unto him, Sit down now, and read it in our ears. So Baruch read it in their ears.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass, when they had heard all the words, they were afraid both one and other, and said unto Baruch, We will surely tell the king of all these words.
verses.text: Now it came to pass, when they had heard all the words, they were afraid both one and other, and said unto Baruch, We will surely tell the king of all these words.

verses.raw: And they asked Baruch, saying, Tell us now, How did you write all these words at his mouth?
verses.text: And they asked Baruch, saying, Tell us now, How did you write all these words at his mouth?

verses.raw: Then Baruch answered them, He pronounced all these words unto me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.
verses.text: Then Baruch answered them, He pronounced all these words unto me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.

verses.raw: Then said the princes unto Baruch, Go, hide you, you and Jeremiah; and let no man know where you be.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD) of Jehoiakim king of Yahudah (Judah); He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David: and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.

verses.raw: And the Chaldeans shall come again, and fight against this city, and take it, and burn it with fire.

verses.raw: And when he was in the gate of Benjamin, a captain of the ward was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he took Jeremiah the prophet, saying, You fallest away to the Chaldeans.

verses.raw: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah, and smote him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe: for they had made that the prison.

verses.raw: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took him out: and the king asked him secretly in his house, and said, Is there any word from Yahuah (LORD)? And Jeremiah said, There is: for, said he, you shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.

verses.raw: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah, What have I offended against you, or against your servants, or against this people, that you have put me in prison?
verses.text: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah, What have I offended against you, or against your servants, or against this people, that you have put me in prison?

verses.raw: Where are now your prophets which prophesied unto you, saying, The king of Babylon shall not come against you, nor against this land?

verses.raw: Therefore hear now, I pray you, O my lord the king: let my supplication, I pray you, be accepted before you; that you cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.

verses.raw: Therefore the princes said unto the king, We beseech you, let this man be put to death: for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words unto them: for this man seeks not the welfare of this people, but the hurt.

verses.raw: Then Zedekiah the king said, Behold, he is in your hand: for the king is not he that can do any thing against you.
verses.text: Then Zedekiah the king said, Behold, he is in your hand: for the king is not he that can do any thing against you.

verses.raw: My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is: for there is no more bread in the city.
verses.text: My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is: for there is no more bread in the city.

verses.raw: Then the king commanded Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Take from hence thirty men with you, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he die.
verses.text: Then the king commanded Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Take from hence thirty men with you, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he die.

verses.raw: So Ebed-melech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.

verses.raw: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took Jeremiah the prophet unto him into the third entry that is in the house of Yahuah (LORD): and the king said unto Jeremiah, I will ask you a thing; hide nothing from me.

verses.text: Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah, If I declare it unto you, will you not surely put me to death? and if I give you counsel, will you not hearken unto me?

verses.raw: So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah, saying, As Yahuah (LORD) lives, that made us this soul, I will not put you to death, neither will I give you into the hand of these men that seek your life.
verses.text: So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah, saying, As Yahuah lives, that made us this soul, I will not put you to death, neither will I give you into the hand of these men that seek your life.

verses.text: Now the word of Yahuah came unto Jeremiah, while he was shut up in the court of the prison, saying,

verses.raw: Go and speak to Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will bring my words upon this city for evil, and not for good; and they shall be accomplished in that day before you.
verses.text: Go and speak to Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Behold, I will bring my words upon this city for evil, and not for good; and they shall be accomplished in that day before you.

verses.raw: But I will deliver you in that day, says Yahuah (LORD): and you shall not be given into the hand of the men of whom you are afraid.
verses.text: But I will deliver you in that day, says Yahuah: and you shall not be given into the hand of the men of whom you are afraid.

verses.raw: For I will surely deliver you, and you shall not fall by the sword, but your life shall be for a prey unto you: because you have put your trust in me, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: For I will surely deliver you, and you shall not fall by the sword, but your life shall be for a prey unto you: because you have put your trust in me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), after that Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Yahudah (Judah), which were carried away captive unto Babylon.
verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahuah, after that Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Yahudah, which were carried away captive unto Babylon.

verses.raw: And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said unto him, Yahuah Elohayka (The LORD thy God) has pronounced this evil upon this place.
verses.text: And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said unto him, Yahuah Elohayka (The LORD thy God) has pronounced this evil upon this place.

verses.raw: Now Yahuah (LORD) has brought it, and done according as he has said: because you have sinned against Yahuah (LORD), and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing is come upon you.
verses.text: Now Yahuah has brought it, and done according as he has said: because you have sinned against Yahuah, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing is come upon you.

verses.raw: And now, behold, I loose you this day from the chains which were upon your hand. If it seem good unto you to come with me into Babylon, come; and I will look well unto you: but if it seem ill unto you to come with me into Babylon, forbear: behold, all the land is before you: whither it seems good and convenient for you to go, thither go.
verses.text: And now, behold, I loose you this day from the chains which were upon your hand. If it seem good unto you to come with me into Babylon, come; and I will look well unto you: but if it seem ill unto you to come with me into Babylon, forbear: behold, all the land is before you: whither it seems good and convenient for you to go, thither go.

verses.raw: Now while he was not yet gone back, he said, Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has made governor over the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and dwell with him among the people: or go wheresoever it seems convenient unto you to go. So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward, and let him go.
verses.text: Now while he was not yet gone back, he said, Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has made governor over the cities of Yahudah, and dwell with him among the people: or go wheresoever it seems convenient unto you to go. So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward, and let him go.

verses.raw: Then went Jeremiah unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and dwelt with him among the people that were left in the land.
verses.text: Then went Jeremiah unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and dwelt with him among the people that were left in the land.

verses.raw: Now when all the captains of the forces which were in the fields, even they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land, and had committed unto him men, and women, and children, and of the poor of the land, of them that were not carried away captive to Babylon;
verses.text: Now when all the captains of the forces which were in the fields, even they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land, and had committed unto him men, and women, and children, and of the poor of the land, of them that were not carried away captive to Babylon;

verses.raw: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.
verses.text: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.

verses.raw: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men, saying, Fear not to serve the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.
verses.text: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men, saying, Fear not to serve the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.

verses.raw: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans, which will come unto us: but you, gather you wine, and summer fruits, and oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that you have taken.
verses.text: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans, which will come unto us: but you, gather you wine, and summer fruits, and oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that you have taken.

verses.raw: Likewise when all the Yahudim (Jews) that were in Moab, and among the Ammonites, and in Edom, and that were in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Yahudah (Judah), and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan;
verses.text: Likewise when all the Yahudim that were in Moab, and among the Ammonites, and in Edom, and that were in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Yahudah, and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan;

verses.raw: Even all the Yahudim (Jews) returned out of all places whither they were driven, and came to the land of Yahudah (Judah), to Gedaliah, unto Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruits very much.
verses.text: Even all the Yahudim returned out of all places whither they were driven, and came to the land of Yahudah, to Gedaliah, unto Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruits very much.

verses.raw: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,
verses.text: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,

verses.raw: And said unto him, Do you certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites has sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay you? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not.
verses.text: And said unto him, Do you certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites has sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay you? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not.

verses.raw: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spake to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, Let me go, I pray you, and I will slay Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man shall know it: wherefore should he slay you, that all the Yahudim (Jews) which are gathered unto you should be scattered, and the remnant in Yahudah (Judah) perish?
verses.text: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spake to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, Let me go, I pray you, and I will slay Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man shall know it: wherefore should he slay you, that all the Yahudim which are gathered unto you should be scattered, and the remnant in Yahudah perish?

verses.raw: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said unto Johanan the son of Kareah, You shall not do this thing: for you speak falsely of Ishmael.
verses.text: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said unto Johanan the son of Kareah, You shall not do this thing: for you speak falsely of Ishmael.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, and the princes of the king, even ten men with him, came unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they did eat bread together in Mizpah.
verses.text: Now it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, and the princes of the king, even ten men with him, came unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they did eat bread together in Mizpah.

verses.raw: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and the ten men that were with him, and smote Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword, and slew him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.
verses.text: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and the ten men that were with him, and smote Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword, and slew him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.

verses.raw: Ishmael also slew all the Yahudim (Jews) that were with him, even with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans that were found there, and the men of war.
verses.text: Ishmael also slew all the Yahudim that were with him, even with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans that were found there, and the men of war.

verses.raw: And it came to pass the second day after he had slain Gedaliah, and no man knew it,
verses.text: And it came to pass the second day after he had slain Gedaliah, and no man knew it,

verses.raw: That there came certain from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even fourscore men, having their beards shaven, and their clothes rent, and having cut themselves, with offerings and incense in their hand, to bring them to the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: That there came certain from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even fourscore men, having their beards shaven, and their clothes rent, and having cut themselves, with offerings and incense in their hand, to bring them to the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went: and it came to pass, as he met them, he said unto them, Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.
verses.text: And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went: and it came to pass, as he met them, he said unto them, Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.

verses.raw: And it was so, when they came into the midst of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah slew them, and cast them into the midst of the pit, he, and the men that were with him.
verses.text: And it was so, when they came into the midst of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah slew them, and cast them into the midst of the pit, he, and the men that were with him.

verses.raw: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael, Slay us not: for we have treasures in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he forbare, and slew them not among their brethren.
verses.text: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael, Slay us not: for we have treasures in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he forbare, and slew them not among their brethren.

verses.raw: Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men, whom he had slain because of Gedaliah, was it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Yashar'el (Israel): and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with them that were slain.
verses.text: Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men, whom he had slain because of Gedaliah, was it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Yashar'el: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with them that were slain.

verses.raw: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people that were in Mizpah, even the king’s daughters, and all the people that remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the Ammonites.
verses.text: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people that were in Mizpah, even the king’s daughters, and all the people that remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the Ammonites.

verses.raw: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,
verses.text: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,

verses.raw: Then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.
verses.text: Then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass, that when all the people which were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, then they were glad.
verses.text: Now it came to pass, that when all the people which were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, then they were glad.

verses.raw: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned, and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah.
verses.text: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned, and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah.

verses.raw: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the Ammonites.
verses.text: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the Ammonites.

verses.raw: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after that he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, even mighty men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought again from Gibeon:
verses.text: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after that he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, even mighty men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought again from Gibeon:

verses.raw: And they departed, and dwelt in the habitation of Chimham, which is by Beth-lehem, to go to enter into Egypt,
verses.text: And they departed, and dwelt in the habitation of Chimham, which is by Beth-lehem, to go to enter into Egypt,

verses.raw: Because of the Chaldeans: for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land.
verses.text: Because of the Chaldeans: for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land.

verses.raw: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even unto the greatest, came near,
verses.text: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even unto the greatest, came near,

verses.raw: And said unto Jeremiah the prophet, Let, we beseech you, our supplication be accepted before you, and pray for us unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), even for all this remnant; (for we are left but a few of many, as your eyes do behold us:)
verses.text: And said unto Jeremiah the prophet, Let, we beseech you, our supplication be accepted before you, and pray for us unto Yahuah Elohayka, even for all this remnant; (for we are left but a few of many, as your eyes do behold us:)

verses.raw: That Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) may shew us the way wherein we may walk, and the thing that we may do.
verses.text: That Yahuah Elohayka may shew us the way wherein we may walk, and the thing that we may do.

verses.raw: Then Jeremiah the prophet said unto them, I have heard you; behold, I will pray unto Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) according to your words; and it shall come to pass, that whatsoever thing Yahuah (LORD) shall answer you, I will declare it unto you; I will keep nothing back from you.
verses.text: Then Jeremiah the prophet said unto them, I have heard you; behold, I will pray unto Yahuah Elohaychem according to your words; and it shall come to pass, that whatsoever thing Yahuah shall answer you, I will declare it unto you; I will keep nothing back from you.

verses.raw: Then they said to Jeremiah, Yahuah (LORD) be a true and faithful witness between us, if we do not even according to all things for the which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall send you to us.
verses.text: Then they said to Jeremiah, Yahuah be a true and faithful witness between us, if we do not even according to all things for the which Yahuah Elohayka shall send you to us.

verses.raw: Whether it be good, or whether it be evil, we will obey the voice of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), to whom we send you; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
verses.text: Whether it be good, or whether it be evil, we will obey the voice of Yahuah Eloheinu, to whom we send you; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of Yahuah Eloheinu.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after ten days, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Jeremiah.
verses.text: And it came to pass after ten days, that the word of Yahuah came unto Jeremiah.

verses.raw: Then called he Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces which were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,
verses.text: Then called he Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces which were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,

verses.raw: And said unto them, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), unto whom you sent me to present your supplication before him;
verses.text: And said unto them, Thus says Yahuah, the Elohim of Yashar'el, unto whom you sent me to present your supplication before him;

verses.raw: If you will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up: for I repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.
verses.text: If you will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up: for I repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.

verses.raw: Be not afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid; be not afraid of him, says Yahuah (LORD): for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.
verses.text: Be not afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid; be not afraid of him, says Yahuah: for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.

verses.raw: And I will shew mercies unto you, that he may have mercy upon you, and cause you to return to your own land.
verses.text: And I will shew mercies unto you, that he may have mercy upon you, and cause you to return to your own land.

verses.raw: But if you say, We will not dwell in this land, neither obey the voice of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God),
verses.text: But if you say, We will not dwell in this land, neither obey the voice of Yahuah Elohaychem,

verses.raw: Saying, No; but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we shall see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there will we dwell:
verses.text: Saying, No; but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we shall see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there will we dwell:

verses.raw: And now therefore hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), you remnant of Yahudah (Judah); Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); If you wholly set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to sojourn there;
verses.text: And now therefore hear the word of Yahuah, you remnant of Yahudah; Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; If you wholly set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to sojourn there;

verses.raw: Then it shall come to pass, that the sword, which you feared, shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt, and the famine, whereof you were afraid, shall follow close after you there in Egypt; and there you shall die.
verses.text: Then it shall come to pass, that the sword, which you feared, shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt, and the famine, whereof you were afraid, shall follow close after you there in Egypt; and there you shall die.

verses.raw: So shall it be with all the men that set their faces to go into Egypt to sojourn there; they shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: and none of them shall remain or escape from the evil that I will bring upon them.
verses.text: So shall it be with all the men that set their faces to go into Egypt to sojourn there; they shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: and none of them shall remain or escape from the evil that I will bring upon them.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); As my anger and my fury has been poured forth upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem; so shall my fury be poured forth upon you, when you shall enter into Egypt: and you shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach; and you shall see this place no more.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; As my anger and my fury has been poured forth upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem; so shall my fury be poured forth upon you, when you shall enter into Egypt: and you shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach; and you shall see this place no more.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has said concerning you, O you remnant of Yahudah (Judah); Go you not into Egypt: know certainly that I have admonished you this day.
verses.text: Yahuah has said concerning you, O you remnant of Yahudah; Go you not into Egypt: know certainly that I have admonished you this day.

verses.raw: For you dissembled in your hearts, when you sent me unto Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), saying, Pray for us unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God); and according unto all that Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) shall say, so declare unto us, and we will do it.
verses.text: For you dissembled in your hearts, when you sent me unto Yahuah Elohaychem, saying, Pray for us unto Yahuah Eloheinu; and according unto all that Yahuah Eloheinu shall say, so declare unto us, and we will do it.

verses.raw: And now I have this day declared it to you; but you have not obeyed the voice of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), nor any thing for the which he has sent me unto you.
verses.text: And now I have this day declared it to you; but you have not obeyed the voice of Yahuah Elohaychem, nor any thing for the which he has sent me unto you.

verses.raw: Now therefore know certainly that you shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, in the place whither you desire to go and to sojourn.
verses.text: Now therefore know certainly that you shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, in the place whither you desire to go and to sojourn.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), for which Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God) had sent him to them, even all these words,
verses.text: And it came to pass, that when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of Yahuah their Elohim, for which Yahuah their Elohim had sent him to them, even all these words,

verses.raw: Then spake Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men, saying unto Jeremiah, You speak falsely: Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) has not sent you to say, Go not into Egypt to sojourn there:
verses.text: Then spake Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men, saying unto Jeremiah, You speak falsely: Yahuah Eloheinu has not sent you to say, Go not into Egypt to sojourn there:

verses.raw: But Baruch the son of Neriah sets you on against us, for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they might put us to death, and carry us away captives into Babylon.
verses.text: But Baruch the son of Neriah sets you on against us, for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they might put us to death, and carry us away captives into Babylon.

verses.raw: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, obeyed not the voice of Yahuah (LORD), to dwell in the land of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, obeyed not the voice of Yahuah, to dwell in the land of Yahudah.

verses.raw: But Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, took all the remnant of Yahudah (Judah), that were returned from all nations, whither they had been driven, to dwell in the land of Yahudah (Judah);
verses.text: But Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, took all the remnant of Yahudah, that were returned from all nations, whither they had been driven, to dwell in the land of Yahudah;

verses.raw: Even men, and women, and children, and the king’s daughters, and every person that Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.
verses.text: Even men, and women, and children, and the king’s daughters, and every person that Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.

verses.raw: So they came into the land of Egypt: for they obeyed not the voice of Yahuah (LORD): thus came they even to Tahpanhes.
verses.text: So they came into the land of Egypt: for they obeyed not the voice of Yahuah: thus came they even to Tahpanhes.

verses.raw: Then came the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,
verses.text: Then came the word of Yahuah unto Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,

verses.raw: Take great stones in your hand, and hide them in the clay in the brickkiln, which is at the entry of Pharaoh’s house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Yahudah (Judah);
verses.text: Take great stones in your hand, and hide them in the clay in the brickkiln, which is at the entry of Pharaoh’s house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Yahudah;

verses.raw: And say unto them, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them.
verses.text: And say unto them, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them.

verses.raw: And when he comes, he shall smite the land of Egypt, and deliver such as are for death to death; and such as are for captivity to captivity; and such as are for the sword to the sword.
verses.text: And when he comes, he shall smite the land of Egypt, and deliver such as are for death to death; and such as are for captivity to captivity; and such as are for the sword to the sword.

verses.raw: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt; and he shall burn them, and carry them away captives: and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd puts on his garment; and he shall go forth from thence in peace.
verses.text: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt; and he shall burn them, and carry them away captives: and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd puts on his garment; and he shall go forth from thence in peace.

verses.raw: He shall break also the images of Beth-shemesh, that is in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians shall he burn with fire.
verses.text: He shall break also the images of Beth-shemesh, that is in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians shall he burn with fire.

verses.raw: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Yahudim (Jews) which dwell in the land of Egypt, which dwell at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Noph, and in the country of Pathros, saying,
verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Yahudim which dwell in the land of Egypt, which dwell at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Noph, and in the country of Pathros, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); You have seen all the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, and upon all the cities of Yahudah (Judah); and, behold, this day they are a desolation, and no man dwells therein,
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; You have seen all the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, and upon all the cities of Yahudah; and, behold, this day they are a desolation, and no man dwells therein,

verses.raw: Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense, and to serve other gods, whom they knew not, neither they, you, nor your fathers.
verses.text: Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense, and to serve other gods, whom they knew not, neither they, you, nor your fathers.

verses.raw: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending them, saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.
verses.text: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending them, saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.

verses.raw: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense unto other gods.
verses.text: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense unto other gods.

verses.raw: Wherefore my fury and my anger was poured forth, and was kindled in the cities of Yahudah (Judah) and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted and desolate, as at this day.
verses.text: Wherefore my fury and my anger was poured forth, and was kindled in the cities of Yahudah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted and desolate, as at this day.

verses.raw: Therefore now thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of hosts, the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Wherefore commit you this great evil against your souls, to cut off from you man and woman, child and suckling, out of Yahudah (Judah), to leave you none to remain;
verses.text: Therefore now thus says Yahuah, the Elohim of hosts, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Wherefore commit you this great evil against your souls, to cut off from you man and woman, child and suckling, out of Yahudah, to leave you none to remain;

verses.raw: In that you provoke me unto wrath with the works of your hands, burning incense unto other gods in the land of Egypt, whither you be gone to dwell, that you might cut yourselves off, and that you might be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?
verses.text: In that you provoke me unto wrath with the works of your hands, burning incense unto other gods in the land of Egypt, whither you be gone to dwell, that you might cut yourselves off, and that you might be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?

verses.raw: Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, and the wickedness of the kings of Yahudah (Judah), and the wickedness of their wives, and your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives, which they have committed in the land of Yahudah (Judah), and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.text: Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, and the wickedness of the kings of Yahudah, and the wickedness of their wives, and your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives, which they have committed in the land of Yahudah, and in the streets of Jerusalem?

verses.raw: They are not humbled even unto this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.
verses.text: They are not humbled even unto this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, and to cut off all Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, and to cut off all Yahudah.

verses.raw: And I will take the remnant of Yahudah (Judah), that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, and they shall all be consumed, and fall in the land of Egypt; they shall even be consumed by the sword and by the famine: they shall die, from the least even unto the greatest, by the sword and by the famine: and they shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.
verses.text: And I will take the remnant of Yahudah, that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, and they shall all be consumed, and fall in the land of Egypt; they shall even be consumed by the sword and by the famine: they shall die, from the least even unto the greatest, by the sword and by the famine: and they shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.

verses.raw: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:
verses.text: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:

verses.raw: So that none of the remnant of Yahudah (Judah), which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall escape or remain, that they should return into the land of Yahudah (Judah), to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there: for none shall return but such as shall escape.
verses.text: So that none of the remnant of Yahudah, which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall escape or remain, that they should return into the land of Yahudah, to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there: for none shall return but such as shall escape.

verses.raw: Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods, and all the women that stood by, a great multitude, even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,
verses.text: Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods, and all the women that stood by, a great multitude, even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,

verses.raw: As for the word that you have spoken unto us in the name of Yahuah (LORD), we will not hearken unto you.
verses.text: As for the word that you have spoken unto us in the name of Yahuah, we will not hearken unto you.

verses.raw: But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goes forth out of our own mouth, to burn incense unto the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, as we have done, we, and our fathers, our kings, and our princes, in the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and in the streets of Jerusalem: for then had we plenty of victuals, and were well, and saw no evil.
verses.text: But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goes forth out of our own mouth, to burn incense unto the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, as we have done, we, and our fathers, our kings, and our princes, in the cities of Yahudah, and in the streets of Jerusalem: for then had we plenty of victuals, and were well, and saw no evil.

verses.raw: But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, we have wanted all things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.
verses.text: But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, we have wanted all things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.

verses.raw: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven, and poured out drink offerings unto her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings unto her, without our men?
verses.text: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven, and poured out drink offerings unto her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings unto her, without our men?

verses.raw: Then Jeremiah said unto all the people, to the men, and to the women, and to all the people which had given him that answer, saying,
verses.text: Then Jeremiah said unto all the people, to the men, and to the women, and to all the people which had given him that answer, saying,

verses.raw: The incense that you burned in the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and in the streets of Jerusalem, you, and your fathers, your kings, and your princes, and the people of the land, did not Yahuah (LORD) remember them, and came it not into his mind?
verses.text: The incense that you burned in the cities of Yahudah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, you, and your fathers, your kings, and your princes, and the people of the land, did not Yahuah remember them, and came it not into his mind?
