verses.raw: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: A sound of a cry comes from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:
verses.text: A sound of a cry comes from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:

verses.raw: Because Yahuah (LORD) has spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:
verses.text: Because Yahuah has spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:

verses.raw: Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of recompences shall surely requite.
verses.text: Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for Yahuah Elohim of recompences shall surely requite.

verses.raw: And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men, her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, says the King, whose name is Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men, her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, says the King, whose name is Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.

verses.raw: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Yahudah (Judah) into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And this Seraiah was a quiet prince.
verses.text: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Yahudah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And this Seraiah was a quiet prince.

verses.raw: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written against Babylon.
verses.text: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written against Babylon.

verses.raw: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When you come to Babylon, and shall see, and shall read all these words;
verses.text: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When you come to Babylon, and shall see, and shall read all these words;

verses.raw: Then shall you say, O Yahuah (LORD), you have spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.
verses.text: Then shall you say, O Yahuah, you have spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.

verses.raw: And it shall be, when you have made an end of reading this book, that you shall bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:
verses.text: And it shall be, when you have made an end of reading this book, that you shall bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:

verses.raw: And you shall say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
verses.text: And you shall say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.

verses.raw: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.text: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

verses.raw: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD), according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.text: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of Yahuah, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

verses.raw: For through the anger of Yahuah (LORD) it came to pass in Jerusalem and Yahudah (Judah), till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.text: For through the anger of Yahuah it came to pass in Jerusalem and Yahudah, till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.
verses.text: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.

verses.raw: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
verses.text: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

verses.raw: And in the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
verses.text: And in the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

verses.raw: Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden; (now the Chaldeans were by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.
verses.text: Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden; (now the Chaldeans were by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.

verses.raw: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
verses.text: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

verses.raw: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.
verses.text: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.

verses.raw: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Yahudah (Judah) in Riblah.
verses.text: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Yahudah in Riblah.

verses.raw: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.
verses.text: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.

verses.raw: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, which served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,
verses.text: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, which served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,

verses.raw: And burned the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great men, burned he with fire:
verses.text: And burned the house of Yahuah, and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great men, burned he with fire:

verses.raw: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.
verses.text: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.

verses.raw: Then Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive certain of the poor of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.
verses.text: Then Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive certain of the poor of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

verses.raw: But Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.
verses.text: But Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.

verses.raw: Also the pillars of brass that were in the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of Yahuah (LORD), the Chaldeans brake, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.
verses.text: Also the pillars of brass that were in the house of Yahuah, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of Yahuah, the Chaldeans brake, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.

verses.raw: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
verses.text: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

verses.raw: And the basons, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the cups; that which was of gold in gold, and that which was of silver in silver, took the captain of the guard away.
verses.text: And the basons, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the cups; that which was of gold in gold, and that which was of silver in silver, took the captain of the guard away.

verses.raw: The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of Yahuah (LORD): the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
verses.text: The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of Yahuah: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

verses.raw: And concerning the pillars, the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a fillet of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof was four fingers: it was hollow.
verses.text: And concerning the pillars, the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a fillet of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof was four fingers: it was hollow.

verses.raw: And a chapiter of brass was upon it; and the height of one chapiter was five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the chapiters round about, all of brass. The second pillar also and the pomegranates were like unto these.
verses.text: And a chapiter of brass was upon it; and the height of one chapiter was five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the chapiters round about, all of brass. The second pillar also and the pomegranates were like unto these.

verses.raw: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side; and all the pomegranates upon the network were an hundred round about.
verses.text: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side; and all the pomegranates upon the network were an hundred round about.

verses.raw: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:
verses.text: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

verses.raw: He took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king’s person, which were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.
verses.text: He took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king’s person, which were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.

verses.raw: So Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.
verses.text: So Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

verses.raw: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Yahudah (Judah) was carried away captive out of his own land.
verses.text: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Yahudah was carried away captive out of his own land.

verses.raw: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Yahudim (Jews) and three and twenty:
verses.text: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Yahudim and three and twenty:

verses.raw: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty and two persons:
verses.text: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty and two persons:

verses.raw: In the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Yahudim (Jews) seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.
verses.text: In the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Yahudim seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Yahudah (Judah), in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the first year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Yahudah (Judah), and brought him forth out of prison,
verses.text: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Yahudah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the first year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Yahudah, and brought him forth out of prison,

verses.raw: And spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon,
verses.text: And spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon,

verses.raw: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.
verses.text: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.

verses.raw: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
verses.text: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

verses.raw: How does the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!
verses.text: How does the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!

verses.raw: She weeps sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she has none to comfort her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.
verses.text: She weeps sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she has none to comfort her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.

verses.raw: Yahudah (Judah) is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwells among the heathen, she finds no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.
verses.text: Yahudah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwells among the heathen, she finds no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.

verses.raw: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she is in bitterness.
verses.text: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she is in bitterness.

verses.raw: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for Yahuah (LORD) has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.
verses.text: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for Yahuah has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.

verses.raw: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.
verses.text: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.

verses.raw: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, and did mock at her sabbaths.
verses.text: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, and did mock at her sabbaths.

verses.raw: Jerusalem has grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turns backward.
verses.text: Jerusalem has grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turns backward.

verses.raw: Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O Yahuah (LORD), behold my affliction: for the enemy has magnified himself.
verses.text: Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O Yahuah, behold my affliction: for the enemy has magnified himself.

verses.raw: The adversary has spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she has seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom you did command that they should not enter into your congregation.
verses.text: The adversary has spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she has seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom you did command that they should not enter into your congregation.

verses.raw: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: see, O Yahuah (LORD), and consider; for I am become vile.
verses.text: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: see, O Yahuah, and consider; for I am become vile.

verses.raw: Is it nothing to you, all you that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith Yahuah (LORD) has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
verses.text: Is it nothing to you, all you that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith Yahuah has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.

verses.raw: From above has he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he has spread a net for my feet, he has turned me back: he has made me desolate and faint all the day.
verses.text: From above has he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he has spread a net for my feet, he has turned me back: he has made me desolate and faint all the day.

verses.raw: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, and come up upon my neck: he has made my strength to fall, Adonai (Lord) has delivered me into their hands, from whom I am not able to rise up.
verses.text: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, and come up upon my neck: he has made my strength to fall, Adonai has delivered me into their hands, from whom I am not able to rise up.

verses.raw: Adonai (Lord) has trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: he has called an assembly against me to crush my young men: Adonai (Lord) has trodden the virgin, the daughter of Yahudah (Judah), as in a winepress.
verses.text: Adonai has trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: he has called an assembly against me to crush my young men: Adonai has trodden the virgin, the daughter of Yahudah, as in a winepress.

verses.raw: For these things I weep; my eye, my eye runs down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.
verses.text: For these things I weep; my eye, my eye runs down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.

verses.raw: Zion spreads forth her hands, and there is none to comfort her: Yahuah (LORD) has commanded concerning Jacob, that his adversaries should be round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.
verses.text: Zion spreads forth her hands, and there is none to comfort her: Yahuah has commanded concerning Jacob, that his adversaries should be round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.
verses.text: Yahuah is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.

verses.raw: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and my elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.
verses.text: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and my elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.

verses.raw: Behold, O Yahuah (LORD); for I am in distress: my bowels are troubled; my heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.
verses.text: Behold, O Yahuah; for I am in distress: my bowels are troubled; my heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.

verses.raw: They have heard that I sigh: there is none to comfort me: all my enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that you have done it: you will bring the day that you have called, and they shall be like unto me.
verses.text: They have heard that I sigh: there is none to comfort me: all my enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that you have done it: you will bring the day that you have called, and they shall be like unto me.

verses.raw: Let all their wickedness come before you; and do unto them, as you have done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
verses.text: Let all their wickedness come before you; and do unto them, as you have done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.

verses.raw: How has Adonai (Lord) covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Yashar'el (Israel), and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!
verses.text: How has Adonai covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Yashar'el, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!

verses.raw: Adonai (Lord) has swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and has not pitied: he has thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Yahudah (Judah); he has brought them down to the ground: he has polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.
verses.text: Adonai has swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and has not pitied: he has thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Yahudah; he has brought them down to the ground: he has polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.

verses.raw: He has cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Yashar'el (Israel): he has drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, which devours round about.
verses.text: He has cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Yashar'el: he has drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, which devours round about.

verses.raw: He has bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.
verses.text: He has bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.

verses.raw: Adonai (Lord) was as an enemy: he has swallowed up Yashar'el (Israel), he has swallowed up all her palaces: he has destroyed his strong holds, and has increased in the daughter of Yahudah (Judah) mourning and lamentation.
verses.text: Adonai was as an enemy: he has swallowed up Yashar'el, he has swallowed up all her palaces: he has destroyed his strong holds, and has increased in the daughter of Yahudah mourning and lamentation.

verses.raw: And he has violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he has destroyed his places of the assembly: Yahuah (LORD) has caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and has despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.
verses.text: And he has violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he has destroyed his places of the assembly: Yahuah has caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and has despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.

verses.raw: Adonai (Lord) has cast off his altar, he has abhorred his sanctuary, he has given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of Yahuah (LORD), as in the day of a solemn feast.
verses.text: Adonai has cast off his altar, he has abhorred his sanctuary, he has given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of Yahuah, as in the day of a solemn feast.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he has stretched out a line, he has not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.
verses.text: Yahuah has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he has stretched out a line, he has not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.

verses.raw: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he has destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes are among the Gentiles: the law is no more; her prophets also find no vision from Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he has destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes are among the Gentiles: the law is no more; her prophets also find no vision from Yahuah.

verses.raw: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
verses.text: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

verses.raw: My eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.
verses.text: My eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.

verses.raw: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers’ bosom.
verses.text: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers’ bosom.

verses.raw: What thing shall I take to witness for you? what thing shall I liken to you, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to you, that I may comfort you, O virgin daughter of Zion? for your breach is great like the sea: who can heal you?
verses.text: What thing shall I take to witness for you? what thing shall I liken to you, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to you, that I may comfort you, O virgin daughter of Zion? for your breach is great like the sea: who can heal you?

verses.raw: Your prophets have seen vain and foolish things for you: and they have not discovered your iniquity, to turn away your captivity; but have seen for you false burdens and causes of banishment.
verses.text: Your prophets have seen vain and foolish things for you: and they have not discovered your iniquity, to turn away your captivity; but have seen for you false burdens and causes of banishment.

verses.raw: All that pass by clap their hands at you; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?
verses.text: All that pass by clap their hands at you; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?

verses.raw: All your enemies have opened their mouth against you: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed her up: certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.
verses.text: All your enemies have opened their mouth against you: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed her up: certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has done that which he had devised; he has fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he has thrown down, and has not pitied: and he has caused your enemy to rejoice over you, he has set up the horn of your adversaries.
verses.text: Yahuah has done that which he had devised; he has fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he has thrown down, and has not pitied: and he has caused your enemy to rejoice over you, he has set up the horn of your adversaries.

verses.raw: Their heart cried unto Adonai (Lord), O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of your eye cease.
verses.text: Their heart cried unto Adonai, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of your eye cease.

verses.raw: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out your heart like water before the face of Adonai (Lord): lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.
verses.text: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out your heart like water before the face of Adonai: lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.

verses.raw: Behold, O Yahuah (LORD), and consider to whom you have done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of Adonai (Lord)?
verses.text: Behold, O Yahuah, and consider to whom you have done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of Adonai?

verses.raw: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; you have slain them in the day of your anger; you have killed, and not pitied.
verses.text: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; you have slain them in the day of your anger; you have killed, and not pitied.

verses.raw: You have called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the LORD’S anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up has my enemy consumed.
verses.text: You have called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the LORD’S anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up has my enemy consumed.

verses.raw: I am the man that has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
verses.text: I am the man that has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

verses.raw: He has led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.
verses.text: He has led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.

verses.raw: Surely against me is he turned; he turns his hand against me all the day.
verses.text: Surely against me is he turned; he turns his hand against me all the day.

verses.raw: My flesh and my skin has he made old; he has broken my bones.
verses.text: My flesh and my skin has he made old; he has broken my bones.

verses.raw: He has builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
verses.text: He has builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.

verses.raw: He has set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.
verses.text: He has set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.

verses.raw: He has hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he has made my chain heavy.
verses.text: He has hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he has made my chain heavy.

verses.raw: Also when I cry and shout, he shuts out my prayer.
verses.text: Also when I cry and shout, he shuts out my prayer.

verses.raw: He has inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he has made my paths crooked.
verses.text: He has inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he has made my paths crooked.

verses.raw: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.
verses.text: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.

verses.raw: He has turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he has made me desolate.
verses.text: He has turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he has made me desolate.

verses.raw: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
verses.text: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

verses.raw: He has caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
verses.text: He has caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.

verses.raw: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.
verses.text: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.

verses.raw: He has filled me with bitterness, he has made me drunken with wormwood.
verses.text: He has filled me with bitterness, he has made me drunken with wormwood.

verses.raw: He has also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he has covered me with ashes.
verses.text: He has also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he has covered me with ashes.

verses.raw: And you have removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.
verses.text: And you have removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.

verses.raw: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from Yahuah:

verses.raw: Remembering my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
verses.text: Remembering my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

verses.raw: My soul has them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.
verses.text: My soul has them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.

verses.raw: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.
verses.text: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.

verses.raw: It is of the LORD’S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
verses.text: It is of the LORD’S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

verses.raw: They are new every morning: great is your faithfulness.
verses.text: They are new every morning: great is your faithfulness.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is my portion, says my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
verses.text: Yahuah is my portion, says my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeks him.
verses.text: Yahuah is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeks him.

verses.raw: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahuah.

verses.raw: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
verses.text: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

verses.raw: He sits alone and keeps silence, because he has borne it upon him.
verses.text: He sits alone and keeps silence, because he has borne it upon him.

verses.raw: He puts his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
verses.text: He puts his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.

verses.raw: He gives his cheek to him that smites him: he is filled full with reproach.
verses.text: He gives his cheek to him that smites him: he is filled full with reproach.

verses.raw: For Adonai (Lord) will not cast off for ever:
verses.text: For Adonai will not cast off for ever:

verses.raw: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.text: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.

verses.raw: For he does not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.
verses.text: For he does not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.

verses.raw: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,
verses.text: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,

verses.raw: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the El Elyon (most High),
verses.text: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the El Elyon,

verses.raw: To subvert a man in his cause, Adonai (Lord) approveth not.
verses.text: To subvert a man in his cause, Adonai approveth not.

verses.raw: Who is he that says, and it comes to pass, when Adonai (Lord) commands it not?
verses.text: Who is he that says, and it comes to pass, when Adonai commands it not?

verses.raw: Out of the mouth of the El Elyon (most High) proceeds not evil and good?
verses.text: Out of the mouth of the El Elyon proceeds not evil and good?

verses.raw: Wherefore does a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
verses.text: Wherefore does a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

verses.raw: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahuah.

verses.raw: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto Elohim (God) in the heavens.
verses.text: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto Elohim in the heavens.

verses.raw: We have transgressed and have rebelled: you have not pardoned.
verses.text: We have transgressed and have rebelled: you have not pardoned.

verses.raw: You have covered with anger, and persecuted us: you have slain, you have not pitied.
verses.text: You have covered with anger, and persecuted us: you have slain, you have not pitied.

verses.raw: You have covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.
verses.text: You have covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.

verses.raw: You have made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
verses.text: You have made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.

verses.raw: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
verses.text: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.

verses.raw: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
verses.text: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.

verses.raw: My eye runs down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.text: My eye runs down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

verses.raw: My eye trickleth down, and ceases not, without any intermission,
verses.text: My eye trickleth down, and ceases not, without any intermission,

verses.raw: Till Yahuah (LORD) look down, and behold from heaven.
verses.text: Till Yahuah look down, and behold from heaven.

verses.raw: My eye affecteth my heart because of all the daughters of my city.
verses.text: My eye affecteth my heart because of all the daughters of my city.

verses.raw: My enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
verses.text: My enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.

verses.raw: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.
verses.text: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.

verses.raw: Waters flowed over my head; then I said, I am cut off.
verses.text: Waters flowed over my head; then I said, I am cut off.

verses.raw: I called upon your name, O Yahuah (LORD), out of the low dungeon.
verses.text: I called upon your name, O Yahuah, out of the low dungeon.

verses.raw: You have heard my voice: hide not your ear at my breathing, at my cry.
verses.text: You have heard my voice: hide not your ear at my breathing, at my cry.

verses.raw: You drewest near in the day that I called upon you: you saidst, Fear not.
verses.text: You drewest near in the day that I called upon you: you saidst, Fear not.

verses.raw: O Adonai (Lord), you have pleaded the causes of my soul; you have redeemed my life.
verses.text: O Adonai, you have pleaded the causes of my soul; you have redeemed my life.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), you have seen my wrong: judge you my cause.
verses.text: O Yahuah, you have seen my wrong: judge you my cause.

verses.raw: You have seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.
verses.text: You have seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.

verses.raw: You have heard their reproach, O Yahuah (LORD), and all their imaginations against me;
verses.text: You have heard their reproach, O Yahuah, and all their imaginations against me;

verses.raw: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
verses.text: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

verses.raw: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.
verses.text: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.

verses.raw: Render unto them a recompence, O Yahuah (LORD), according to the work of their hands.
verses.text: Render unto them a recompence, O Yahuah, according to the work of their hands.

verses.raw: Give them sorrow of heart, your curse unto them.
verses.text: Give them sorrow of heart, your curse unto them.

verses.raw: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of Yahuah.

verses.raw: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.
verses.text: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.

verses.raw: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
verses.text: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

verses.raw: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
verses.text: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

verses.raw: The tongue of the sucking child cleaves to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaks it unto them.
verses.text: The tongue of the sucking child cleaves to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaks it unto them.

verses.raw: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.
verses.text: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.

verses.raw: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.
verses.text: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.

verses.raw: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:
verses.text: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:

verses.raw: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaves to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.
verses.text: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaves to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.

verses.raw: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.
verses.text: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.

verses.raw: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.text: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has accomplished his fury; he has poured out his fierce anger, and has kindled a fire in Zion, and it has devoured the foundations thereof.
verses.text: Yahuah has accomplished his fury; he has poured out his fierce anger, and has kindled a fire in Zion, and it has devoured the foundations thereof.

verses.raw: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.text: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: For the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,
verses.text: For the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,

verses.raw: They have wandered as blind men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.
verses.text: They have wandered as blind men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.

verses.raw: They cried unto them, Depart you; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there.
verses.text: They cried unto them, Depart you; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there.

verses.raw: The anger of Yahuah (LORD) has divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.
verses.text: The anger of Yahuah has divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.

verses.raw: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.
verses.text: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.

verses.raw: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.
verses.text: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.

verses.raw: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.
verses.text: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.

verses.raw: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Yahuah (LORD), was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.
verses.text: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Yahuah, was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.

verses.raw: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwell in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto you: you shall be drunken, and shall make thyself naked.
verses.text: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwell in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto you: you shall be drunken, and shall make thyself naked.

verses.raw: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry you away into captivity: he will visit your iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover your sins.
verses.text: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry you away into captivity: he will visit your iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover your sins.

verses.raw: Remember, O Yahuah (LORD), what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.
verses.text: Remember, O Yahuah, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.

verses.raw: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
verses.text: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.

verses.raw: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.
verses.text: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.

verses.raw: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.
verses.text: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.

verses.raw: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.
verses.text: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.

verses.raw: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
verses.text: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

verses.raw: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.
verses.text: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.

verses.raw: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that does deliver us out of their hand.
verses.text: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that does deliver us out of their hand.

verses.raw: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.
verses.text: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.

verses.raw: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
verses.text: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.

verses.raw: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Yahudah.

verses.raw: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.
verses.text: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.

verses.raw: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.
verses.text: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.

verses.raw: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.
verses.text: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.

verses.raw: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
verses.text: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.

verses.raw: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!
verses.text: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!

verses.raw: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.
verses.text: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.

verses.raw: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.
verses.text: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.

verses.raw: You, O Yahuah (LORD), remainest for ever; your throne from generation to generation.
verses.text: You, O Yahuah, remainest for ever; your throne from generation to generation.

verses.raw: Wherefore do you forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?
verses.text: Wherefore do you forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?

verses.raw: Turn you us unto you, O Yahuah (LORD), and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
verses.text: Turn you us unto you, O Yahuah, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.

verses.raw: But you have utterly rejected us; you are very wroth against us.
verses.text: But you have utterly rejected us; you are very wroth against us.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of Elohim.

verses.raw: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin’s captivity,
verses.text: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin’s captivity,

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of Yahuah (LORD) was there upon him.
verses.text: The word of Yahuah came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of Yahuah was there upon him.

verses.raw: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.
verses.text: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.

verses.raw: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.
verses.text: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.

verses.raw: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.
verses.text: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.

verses.raw: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.
verses.text: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.

verses.raw: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.
verses.text: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.

verses.raw: Their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.
verses.text: Their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.

verses.raw: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.
verses.text: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.

verses.raw: Thus were their faces: and their wings were stretched upward; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.
verses.text: Thus were their faces: and their wings were stretched upward; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.

verses.raw: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; and they turned not when they went.
verses.text: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; and they turned not when they went.

verses.raw: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.
verses.text: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.

verses.raw: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
verses.text: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

verses.raw: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.
verses.text: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.

verses.raw: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
verses.text: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.

verses.raw: When they went, they went upon their four sides: and they turned not when they went.
verses.text: When they went, they went upon their four sides: and they turned not when they went.

verses.raw: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four.
verses.text: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four.

verses.raw: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
verses.text: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

verses.raw: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither was their spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
verses.text: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither was their spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

verses.raw: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
verses.text: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

verses.raw: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.
verses.text: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.

verses.raw: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.
verses.text: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.

verses.raw: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.
verses.text: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.

verses.raw: And there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads, when they stood, and had let down their wings.
verses.text: And there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads, when they stood, and had let down their wings.

verses.raw: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.
verses.text: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.

verses.raw: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.
verses.text: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.

verses.raw: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of Yahuah (LORD). And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.
verses.text: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of Yahuah. And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.

verses.raw: And he said unto me, Son of Adam, stand upon your feet, and I will speak unto you.
verses.text: And he said unto me, Son of Adam, stand upon your feet, and I will speak unto you.

verses.raw: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake unto me.
verses.text: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake unto me.

verses.raw: And he said unto me, Son of Adam, I send you to the children of Yashar'el (Israel), to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me, even unto this very day.
verses.text: And he said unto me, Son of Adam, I send you to the children of Yashar'el, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me, even unto this very day.

verses.raw: For they are impudent children and stiffhearted. I do send you unto them; and you shall say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: For they are impudent children and stiffhearted. I do send you unto them; and you shall say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they are a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there has been a prophet among them.
verses.text: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they are a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there has been a prophet among them.

verses.raw: And you, son of Adam, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns be with you, and you do dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.
verses.text: And you, son of Adam, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns be with you, and you do dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.

verses.raw: And you shall speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they are most rebellious.
verses.text: And you shall speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they are most rebellious.

verses.raw: But you, son of Adam, hear what I say unto you; Be not you rebellious like that rebellious house: open your mouth, and eat that I give you.
verses.text: But you, son of Adam, hear what I say unto you; Be not you rebellious like that rebellious house: open your mouth, and eat that I give you.

verses.raw: And when I looked, behold, an hand was sent unto me; and, lo, a roll of a book was therein;
verses.text: And when I looked, behold, an hand was sent unto me; and, lo, a roll of a book was therein;

verses.raw: And he spread it before me; and it was written within and without: and there was written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.
verses.text: And he spread it before me; and it was written within and without: and there was written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.

verses.raw: Moreover he said unto me, Son of Adam, eat that you find; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Moreover he said unto me, Son of Adam, eat that you find; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.
verses.text: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.

verses.raw: And he said unto me, Son of Adam, cause your belly to eat, and fill your bowels with this roll that I give you. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.
verses.text: And he said unto me, Son of Adam, cause your belly to eat, and fill your bowels with this roll that I give you. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.

verses.raw: And he said unto me, Son of Adam, go, get you unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and speak with my words unto them.
verses.text: And he said unto me, Son of Adam, go, get you unto the house of Yashar'el, and speak with my words unto them.

verses.raw: For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, but to the house of Yashar'el (Israel);
verses.text: For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, but to the house of Yashar'el;

verses.raw: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words you can not understand. Surely, had I sent you to them, they would have hearkened unto you.
verses.text: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words you can not understand. Surely, had I sent you to them, they would have hearkened unto you.

verses.raw: But the house of Yashar'el (Israel) will not hearken unto you; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Yashar'el (Israel) are impudent and hardhearted.
verses.text: But the house of Yashar'el will not hearken unto you; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Yashar'el are impudent and hardhearted.

verses.raw: Behold, I have made your face strong against their faces, and your forehead strong against their foreheads.
verses.text: Behold, I have made your face strong against their faces, and your forehead strong against their foreheads.

verses.raw: As an adamant harder than flint have I made your forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.
verses.text: As an adamant harder than flint have I made your forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.

verses.raw: Moreover he said unto me, Son of Adam, all my words that I shall speak unto you receive in your heart, and hear with your ears.
verses.text: Moreover he said unto me, Son of Adam, all my words that I shall speak unto you receive in your heart, and hear with your ears.

verses.raw: And go, get you to them of the captivity, unto the children of your people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.
verses.text: And go, get you to them of the captivity, unto the children of your people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.

verses.raw: Then the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing, saying, Blessed be the glory of Yahuah (LORD) from his place.
verses.text: Then the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing, saying, Blessed be the glory of Yahuah from his place.

verses.raw: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing.
verses.text: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing.

verses.raw: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of Yahuah (LORD) was strong upon me.
verses.text: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of Yahuah was strong upon me.

verses.raw: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel-abib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.
verses.text: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel-abib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.

verses.raw: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, I have made you a watchman unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel): therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.
verses.text: Son of Adam, I have made you a watchman unto the house of Yashar'el: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.

verses.raw: When I say unto the wicked, You shall surely die; and you give him not warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at your hand.
verses.text: When I say unto the wicked, You shall surely die; and you give him not warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at your hand.

verses.raw: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.
verses.text: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.

verses.raw: Again, When a righteous man does turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because you have not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he has done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at your hand.
verses.text: Again, When a righteous man does turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because you have not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he has done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at your hand.

verses.raw: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man, that the righteous sin not, and he does not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also you have delivered your soul.
verses.text: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man, that the righteous sin not, and he does not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also you have delivered your soul.

verses.raw: And the hand of Yahuah (LORD) was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with you.
verses.text: And the hand of Yahuah was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with you.

verses.raw: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of Yahuah (LORD) stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.
verses.text: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of Yahuah stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.

verses.raw: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within your house.
verses.text: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within your house.

verses.raw: But you, O son of Adam, behold, they shall put bands upon you, and shall bind you with them, and you shall not go out among them:
verses.text: But you, O son of Adam, behold, they shall put bands upon you, and shall bind you with them, and you shall not go out among them:

verses.raw: And I will make your tongue cleave to the roof of your mouth, that you shall be dumb, and shall not be to them a reprover: for they are a rebellious house.
verses.text: And I will make your tongue cleave to the roof of your mouth, that you shall be dumb, and shall not be to them a reprover: for they are a rebellious house.

verses.raw: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); He that hears, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.
verses.text: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; He that hears, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.

verses.raw: You also, son of Adam, take you a tile, and lay it before you, and pourtray upon it the city, even Jerusalem:
verses.text: You also, son of Adam, take you a tile, and lay it before you, and pourtray upon it the city, even Jerusalem:

verses.raw: And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mount against it; set the camp also against it, and set battering rams against it round about.
verses.text: And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mount against it; set the camp also against it, and set battering rams against it round about.

verses.raw: Moreover take you unto you an iron pan, and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city: and set your face against it, and it shall be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Moreover take you unto you an iron pan, and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city: and set your face against it, and it shall be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Yashar'el.
