verses.raw: Lie you also upon your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) upon it: according to the number of the days that you shall lie upon it you shall bear their iniquity.
verses.text: Lie you also upon your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Yashar'el upon it: according to the number of the days that you shall lie upon it you shall bear their iniquity.

verses.raw: For I have laid upon you the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days: so shall you bear the iniquity of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: For I have laid upon you the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days: so shall you bear the iniquity of the house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And when you have accomplished them, lie again on your right side, and you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Yahudah (Judah) forty days: I have appointed you each day for a year.
verses.text: And when you have accomplished them, lie again on your right side, and you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Yahudah forty days: I have appointed you each day for a year.

verses.raw: Therefore you shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and your arm shall be uncovered, and you shall prophesy against it.
verses.text: Therefore you shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and your arm shall be uncovered, and you shall prophesy against it.

verses.raw: And, behold, I will lay bands upon you, and you shall not turn you from one side to another, till you have ended the days of your siege.
verses.text: And, behold, I will lay bands upon you, and you shall not turn you from one side to another, till you have ended the days of your siege.

verses.raw: Take you also unto you wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and fitches, and put them in one vessel, and make you bread thereof, according to the number of the days that you shall lie upon your side, three hundred and ninety days shall you eat thereof.
verses.text: Take you also unto you wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and fitches, and put them in one vessel, and make you bread thereof, according to the number of the days that you shall lie upon your side, three hundred and ninety days shall you eat thereof.

verses.raw: And your meat which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shall you eat it.
verses.text: And your meat which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shall you eat it.

verses.raw: You shall drink also water by measure, the sixth part of an hin: from time to time shall you drink.
verses.text: You shall drink also water by measure, the sixth part of an hin: from time to time shall you drink.

verses.raw: And you shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it with dung that comes out of man, in their sight.
verses.text: And you shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it with dung that comes out of man, in their sight.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said, Even thus shall the children of Yashar'el (Israel) eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles, whither I will drive them.
verses.text: And Yahuah said, Even thus shall the children of Yashar'el eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles, whither I will drive them.

verses.raw: Then said I, Ah Adonai (Lord) GOD! behold, my soul has not been polluted: for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth.
verses.text: Then said I, Ah Adonai GOD! behold, my soul has not been polluted: for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth.

verses.raw: Then he said unto me, Lo, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread therewith.
verses.text: Then he said unto me, Lo, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread therewith.

verses.raw: Moreover he said unto me, Son of Adam, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem: and they shall eat bread by weight, and with care; and they shall drink water by measure, and with astonishment:
verses.text: Moreover he said unto me, Son of Adam, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem: and they shall eat bread by weight, and with care; and they shall drink water by measure, and with astonishment:

verses.raw: That they may want bread and water, and be astonied one with another, and consume away for their iniquity.
verses.text: That they may want bread and water, and be astonied one with another, and consume away for their iniquity.

verses.raw: And you, son of Adam, take you a sharp knife, take you a barber’s razor, and cause it to pass upon your head and upon your beard: then take you balances to weigh, and divide the hair.
verses.text: And you, son of Adam, take you a sharp knife, take you a barber’s razor, and cause it to pass upon your head and upon your beard: then take you balances to weigh, and divide the hair.

verses.raw: You shall burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled: and you shall take a third part, and smite about it with a knife: and a third part you shall scatter in the wind; and I will draw out a sword after them.
verses.text: You shall burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled: and you shall take a third part, and smite about it with a knife: and a third part you shall scatter in the wind; and I will draw out a sword after them.

verses.raw: You shall also take thereof a few in number, and bind them in your skirts.
verses.text: You shall also take thereof a few in number, and bind them in your skirts.

verses.raw: Then take of them again, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire; for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Then take of them again, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire; for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); This is Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries that are round about her.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; This is Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries that are round about her.

verses.raw: And she has changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that are round about her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked in them.
verses.text: And she has changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that are round about her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked in them.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because you multiplied more than the nations that are round about you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my judgments, neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you;
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Because you multiplied more than the nations that are round about you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my judgments, neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you;

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I, even I, am against you, and will execute judgments in the midst of you in the sight of the nations.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I, even I, am against you, and will execute judgments in the midst of you in the sight of the nations.

verses.raw: And I will do in you that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all your abominations.
verses.text: And I will do in you that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all your abominations.

verses.raw: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of you, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in you, and the whole remnant of you will I scatter into all the winds.
verses.text: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of you, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in you, and the whole remnant of you will I scatter into all the winds.

verses.raw: Wherefore, as I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things, and with all your abominations, therefore will I also diminish you; neither shall my eye spare, neither will I have any pity.
verses.text: Wherefore, as I live, says Adonai Yahuah; Surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things, and with all your abominations, therefore will I also diminish you; neither shall my eye spare, neither will I have any pity.

verses.raw: A third part of you shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of you: and a third part shall fall by the sword round about you; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.
verses.text: A third part of you shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of you: and a third part shall fall by the sword round about you; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.

verses.raw: Thus shall my anger be accomplished, and I will cause my fury to rest upon them, and I will be comforted: and they shall know that I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it in my zeal, when I have accomplished my fury in them.
verses.text: Thus shall my anger be accomplished, and I will cause my fury to rest upon them, and I will be comforted: and they shall know that I Yahuah have spoken it in my zeal, when I have accomplished my fury in them.

verses.raw: Moreover I will make you waste, and a reproach among the nations that are round about you, in the sight of all that pass by.
verses.text: Moreover I will make you waste, and a reproach among the nations that are round about you, in the sight of all that pass by.

verses.raw: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment unto the nations that are round about you, when I shall execute judgments in you in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it.
verses.text: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment unto the nations that are round about you, when I shall execute judgments in you in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I Yahuah have spoken it.

verses.raw: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for their destruction, and which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:
verses.text: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for their destruction, and which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:

verses.raw: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave you; and pestilence and blood shall pass through you; and I will bring the sword upon you. I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it.
verses.text: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave you; and pestilence and blood shall pass through you; and I will bring the sword upon you. I Yahuah have spoken it.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, set your face toward the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel), and prophesy against them,
verses.text: Son of Adam, set your face toward the mountains of Yashar'el, and prophesy against them,

verses.raw: And say, You mountains of Yashar'el (Israel), hear the word of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys; Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.
verses.text: And say, You mountains of Yashar'el, hear the word of Adonai Yahuah; Thus says Adonai Yahuah to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys; Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.

verses.raw: And your altars shall be desolate, and your images shall be broken: and I will cast down your slain men before your idols.
verses.text: And your altars shall be desolate, and your images shall be broken: and I will cast down your slain men before your idols.

verses.raw: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars.
verses.text: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Yashar'el before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars.

verses.raw: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your images may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.
verses.text: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your images may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.

verses.raw: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and you shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Yet will I leave a remnant, that you may have some that shall escape the sword among the nations, when you shall be scattered through the countries.
verses.text: Yet will I leave a remnant, that you may have some that shall escape the sword among the nations, when you shall be scattered through the countries.

verses.raw: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives, because I am broken with their whorish heart, which has departed from me, and with their eyes, which go a whoring after their idols: and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.
verses.text: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives, because I am broken with their whorish heart, which has departed from me, and with their eyes, which go a whoring after their idols: and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

verses.raw: And they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), and that I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them.
verses.text: And they shall know that I am Yahuah, and that I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Smite with your hand, and stamp with your foot, and say, Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)! for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Smite with your hand, and stamp with your foot, and say, Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Yashar'el! for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.

verses.raw: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remains and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my fury upon them.
verses.text: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remains and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my fury upon them.

verses.raw: Then shall you know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols.
verses.text: Then shall you know that I am Yahuah, when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols.

verses.raw: So will I stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate, yea, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath, in all their habitations: and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: So will I stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate, yea, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath, in all their habitations: and they shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Moreover the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Also, you son of Adam, thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) unto the land of Yashar'el (Israel); An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.
verses.text: Also, you son of Adam, thus says Adonai Yahuah unto the land of Yashar'el; An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.

verses.raw: Now is the end come upon you, and I will send my anger upon you, and will judge you according to your ways, and will recompense upon you all your abominations.
verses.text: Now is the end come upon you, and I will send my anger upon you, and will judge you according to your ways, and will recompense upon you all your abominations.

verses.raw: And my eye shall not spare you, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense your ways upon you, and your abominations shall be in the midst of you: and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And my eye shall not spare you, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense your ways upon you, and your abominations shall be in the midst of you: and you shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); An evil, an only evil, behold, is come.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; An evil, an only evil, behold, is come.

verses.raw: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for you; behold, it is come.
verses.text: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for you; behold, it is come.

verses.raw: The morning is come unto you, O you that dwell in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble is near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.
verses.text: The morning is come unto you, O you that dwell in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble is near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.

verses.raw: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon you, and accomplish my anger upon you: and I will judge you according to your ways, and will recompense you for all your abominations.
verses.text: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon you, and accomplish my anger upon you: and I will judge you according to your ways, and will recompense you for all your abominations.

verses.raw: And my eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense you according to your ways and your abominations that are in the midst of you; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD) that smites.
verses.text: And my eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense you according to your ways and your abominations that are in the midst of you; and you shall know that I am Yahuah that smites.

verses.raw: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod has blossomed, pride has budded.
verses.text: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod has blossomed, pride has budded.

verses.raw: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness: none of them shall remain, nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither shall there be wailing for them.
verses.text: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness: none of them shall remain, nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither shall there be wailing for them.

verses.raw: The time is come, the day draws near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
verses.text: The time is come, the day draws near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.

verses.raw: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof, which shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
verses.text: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof, which shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.

verses.raw: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goes to the battle: for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
verses.text: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goes to the battle: for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.

verses.raw: The sword is without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that is in the field shall die with the sword; and he that is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.
verses.text: The sword is without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that is in the field shall die with the sword; and he that is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.

verses.raw: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.
verses.text: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.

verses.raw: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.
verses.text: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.

verses.raw: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.
verses.text: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.

verses.raw: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of Yahuah (LORD): they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity.
verses.text: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of Yahuah: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity.

verses.raw: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them.
verses.text: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them.

verses.raw: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.
verses.text: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.

verses.raw: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret place: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.
verses.text: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret place: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.

verses.raw: Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
verses.text: Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.

verses.raw: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.
verses.text: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.

verses.raw: Destruction comes; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.
verses.text: Destruction comes; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.

verses.raw: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the ancients.
verses.text: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the ancients.

verses.raw: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Yahudah (Judah) sat before me, that the hand of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) fell there upon me.
verses.text: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Yahudah sat before me, that the hand of Adonai Yahuah fell there upon me.

verses.raw: Then I beheld, and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins even downward, fire; and from his loins even upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of amber.
verses.text: Then I beheld, and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins even downward, fire; and from his loins even upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of amber.

verses.raw: And he put forth the form of an hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of Elohim (God) to Jerusalem, to the door of the inner gate that looks toward the north; where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.
verses.text: And he put forth the form of an hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of Elohim to Jerusalem, to the door of the inner gate that looks toward the north; where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.

verses.raw: And, behold, the glory of the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) was there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.
verses.text: And, behold, the glory of the Elohim of Yashar'el was there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.

verses.raw: Then said he unto me, Son of Adam, lift up your eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up my eyes the way toward the north, and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.
verses.text: Then said he unto me, Son of Adam, lift up your eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up my eyes the way toward the north, and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.

verses.raw: He said furthermore unto me, Son of Adam, see you what they do? even the great abominations that the house of Yashar'el (Israel) commits here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn you yet again, and you shall see greater abominations.
verses.text: He said furthermore unto me, Son of Adam, see you what they do? even the great abominations that the house of Yashar'el commits here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn you yet again, and you shall see greater abominations.

verses.raw: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.
verses.text: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.

verses.raw: Then said he unto me, Son of Adam, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold a door.
verses.text: Then said he unto me, Son of Adam, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold a door.

verses.raw: And he said unto me, Go in, and behold the wicked abominations that they do here.
verses.text: And he said unto me, Go in, and behold the wicked abominations that they do here.

verses.raw: So I went in and saw; and behold every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), pourtrayed upon the wall round about.
verses.text: So I went in and saw; and behold every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Yashar'el, pourtrayed upon the wall round about.

verses.raw: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, with every man his censer in his hand; and a thick cloud of incense went up.
verses.text: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Yashar'el, and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, with every man his censer in his hand; and a thick cloud of incense went up.

verses.raw: Then said he unto me, Son of Adam, have you seen what the ancients of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, Yahuah (LORD) sees us not; Yahuah (LORD) has forsaken the earth.
verses.text: Then said he unto me, Son of Adam, have you seen what the ancients of the house of Yashar'el do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, Yahuah sees us not; Yahuah has forsaken the earth.

verses.raw: He said also unto me, Turn you yet again, and you shall see greater abominations that they do.
verses.text: He said also unto me, Turn you yet again, and you shall see greater abominations that they do.

verses.raw: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’S house which was toward the north; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.
verses.text: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’S house which was toward the north; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.

verses.raw: Then said he unto me, Have you seen this, O son of Adam? turn you yet again, and you shall see greater abominations than these.
verses.text: Then said he unto me, Have you seen this, O son of Adam? turn you yet again, and you shall see greater abominations than these.

verses.raw: And he brought me into the inner court of the LORD’S house, and, behold, at the door of the temple of Yahuah (LORD), between the porch and the altar, were about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of Yahuah (LORD), and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.
verses.text: And he brought me into the inner court of the LORD’S house, and, behold, at the door of the temple of Yahuah, between the porch and the altar, were about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of Yahuah, and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.

verses.raw: Then he said unto me, Have you seen this, O son of Adam? Is it a light thing to the house of Yahudah (Judah) that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have returned to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose.
verses.text: Then he said unto me, Have you seen this, O son of Adam? Is it a light thing to the house of Yahudah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have returned to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose.

verses.raw: Therefore will I also deal in fury: my eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: and though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, yet will I not hear them.
verses.text: Therefore will I also deal in fury: my eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: and though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, yet will I not hear them.

verses.raw: He cried also in my ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near, even every man with his destroying weapon in his hand.
verses.text: He cried also in my ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near, even every man with his destroying weapon in his hand.

verses.raw: And, behold, six men came from the way of the higher gate, which lies toward the north, and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand; and one man among them was clothed with linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side: and they went in, and stood beside the brasen altar.
verses.text: And, behold, six men came from the way of the higher gate, which lies toward the north, and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand; and one man among them was clothed with linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side: and they went in, and stood beside the brasen altar.

verses.raw: And the glory of the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed with linen, which had the writer’s inkhorn by his side;
verses.text: And the glory of the Elohim of Yashar'el was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed with linen, which had the writer’s inkhorn by his side;

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.

verses.raw: And to the others he said in my hearing, Go you after him through the city, and smite: let not your eye spare, neither have you pity:
verses.text: And to the others he said in my hearing, Go you after him through the city, and smite: let not your eye spare, neither have you pity:

verses.raw: Slay utterly old and young, both maids, and little children, and women: but come not near any man upon whom is the mark; and begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the ancient men which were before the house.
verses.text: Slay utterly old and young, both maids, and little children, and women: but come not near any man upon whom is the mark; and begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the ancient men which were before the house.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go you forth. And they went forth, and slew in the city.
verses.text: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go you forth. And they went forth, and slew in the city.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Adonai (Lord) GOD! will you destroy all the residue of Yashar'el (Israel) in your pouring out of your fury upon Jerusalem?
verses.text: And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Adonai GOD! will you destroy all the residue of Yashar'el in your pouring out of your fury upon Jerusalem?

verses.raw: Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) and Yahudah (Judah) is exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perverseness: for they say, Yahuah (LORD) has forsaken the earth, and Yahuah (LORD) sees not.
verses.text: Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Yashar'el and Yahudah is exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perverseness: for they say, Yahuah has forsaken the earth, and Yahuah sees not.

verses.raw: And as for me also, my eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, but I will recompense their way upon their head.
verses.text: And as for me also, my eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, but I will recompense their way upon their head.

verses.raw: And, behold, the man clothed with linen, which had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as you have commanded me.
verses.text: And, behold, the man clothed with linen, which had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as you have commanded me.

verses.raw: Then I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
verses.text: Then I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

verses.raw: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen, and said, Go in between the wheels, even under the cherub, and fill your hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims, and scatter them over the city. And he went in in my sight.
verses.text: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen, and said, Go in between the wheels, even under the cherub, and fill your hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims, and scatter them over the city. And he went in in my sight.

verses.raw: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
verses.text: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

verses.raw: Then the glory of Yahuah (LORD) went up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’S glory.
verses.text: Then the glory of Yahuah went up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’S glory.

verses.raw: And the sound of the cherubims’ wings was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of the El Shaddai (Almighty God) when he speaks.
verses.text: And the sound of the cherubims’ wings was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of the El Shaddai when he speaks.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubims; then he went in, and stood beside the wheels.
verses.text: And it came to pass, that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubims; then he went in, and stood beside the wheels.

verses.raw: And one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that was between the cherubims, and took thereof, and put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen: who took it, and went out.
verses.text: And one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that was between the cherubims, and took thereof, and put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen: who took it, and went out.

verses.raw: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man’s hand under their wings.
verses.text: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man’s hand under their wings.

verses.raw: And when I looked, behold the four wheels by the cherubims, one wheel by one cherub, and another wheel by another cherub: and the appearance of the wheels was as the colour of a beryl stone.
verses.text: And when I looked, behold the four wheels by the cherubims, one wheel by one cherub, and another wheel by another cherub: and the appearance of the wheels was as the colour of a beryl stone.

verses.raw: And as for their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.
verses.text: And as for their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.

verses.raw: When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.
verses.text: When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.

verses.raw: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes round about, even the wheels that they four had.
verses.text: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes round about, even the wheels that they four had.

verses.raw: As for the wheels, it was cried unto them in my hearing, O wheel.
verses.text: As for the wheels, it was cried unto them in my hearing, O wheel.

verses.raw: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of a cherub, and the second face was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
verses.text: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of a cherub, and the second face was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

verses.raw: And the cherubims were lifted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.
verses.text: And the cherubims were lifted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.

verses.raw: And when the cherubims went, the wheels went by them: and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.
verses.text: And when the cherubims went, the wheels went by them: and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.

verses.raw: When they stood, these stood; and when they were lifted up, these lifted up themselves also: for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
verses.text: When they stood, these stood; and when they were lifted up, these lifted up themselves also: for the spirit of the living creature was in them.

verses.raw: Then the glory of Yahuah (LORD) departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.
verses.text: Then the glory of Yahuah departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.

verses.raw: And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also were beside them, and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’S house; and the glory of the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) was over them above.
verses.text: And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also were beside them, and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’S house; and the glory of the Elohim of Yashar'el was over them above.

verses.raw: This is the living creature that I saw under the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they were the cherubims.
verses.text: This is the living creature that I saw under the Elohim of Yashar'el by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they were the cherubims.

verses.raw: Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
verses.text: Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.

verses.raw: And the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.
verses.text: And the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.

verses.raw: Moreover the spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the LORD’S house, which looks eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
verses.text: Moreover the spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the LORD’S house, which looks eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

verses.raw: Then said he unto me, Son of Adam, these are the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:
verses.text: Then said he unto me, Son of Adam, these are the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:

verses.raw: Which say, It is not near; let us build houses: this city is the caldron, and we be the flesh.
verses.text: Which say, It is not near; let us build houses: this city is the caldron, and we be the flesh.

verses.raw: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of Adam.
verses.text: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of Adam.

verses.raw: And the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) fell upon me, and said unto me, Speak; Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Thus have you said, O house of Yashar'el (Israel): for I know the things that come into your mind, every one of them.
verses.text: And the Spirit of Yahuah fell upon me, and said unto me, Speak; Thus says Yahuah; Thus have you said, O house of Yashar'el: for I know the things that come into your mind, every one of them.

verses.raw: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled the streets thereof with the slain.
verses.text: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled the streets thereof with the slain.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Your slain whom you have laid in the midst of it, they are the flesh, and this city is the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Your slain whom you have laid in the midst of it, they are the flesh, and this city is the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.

verses.raw: You have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: You have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.
verses.text: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

verses.raw: You shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Yashar'el (Israel); and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: You shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Yashar'el; and you shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: This city shall not be your caldron, neither shall you be the flesh in the midst thereof; but I will judge you in the border of Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: This city shall not be your caldron, neither shall you be the flesh in the midst thereof; but I will judge you in the border of Yashar'el:

verses.raw: And you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD): for you have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you.
verses.text: And you shall know that I am Yahuah: for you have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Adonai (Lord) GOD! will you make a full end of the remnant of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Adonai GOD! will you make a full end of the remnant of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: Again the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Again the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, your brethren, even your brethren, the men of your kindred, and all the house of Yashar'el (Israel) wholly, are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from Yahuah (LORD): unto us is this land given in possession.
verses.text: Son of Adam, your brethren, even your brethren, the men of your kindred, and all the house of Yashar'el wholly, are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from Yahuah: unto us is this land given in possession.

verses.raw: Therefore say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.
verses.text: Therefore say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.

verses.raw: Therefore say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Therefore say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.
verses.text: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.

verses.raw: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:
verses.text: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:

verses.raw: That they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their Elohim (God).
verses.text: That they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their Elohim.

verses.raw: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) was over them above.
verses.text: Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the Elohim of Yashar'el was over them above.

verses.raw: And the glory of Yahuah (LORD) went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
verses.text: And the glory of Yahuah went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.

verses.raw: Afterwards the spirit took me up, and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of Elohim (God) into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.
verses.text: Afterwards the spirit took me up, and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of Elohim into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.

verses.raw: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that Yahuah (LORD) had shewed me.
verses.text: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that Yahuah had shewed me.

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) also came unto me, saying,
verses.text: The word of Yahuah also came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, you dwell in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they are a rebellious house.
verses.text: Son of Adam, you dwell in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they are a rebellious house.

verses.raw: Therefore, you son of Adam, prepare you stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and you shall remove from your place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they be a rebellious house.
verses.text: Therefore, you son of Adam, prepare you stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and you shall remove from your place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they be a rebellious house.

verses.raw: Then shall you bring forth your stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: and you shall go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.
verses.text: Then shall you bring forth your stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: and you shall go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.

verses.raw: Dig you through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.
verses.text: Dig you through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.

verses.raw: In their sight shall you bear it upon your shoulders, and carry it forth in the twilight: you shall cover your face, that you see not the ground: for I have set you for a sign unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: In their sight shall you bear it upon your shoulders, and carry it forth in the twilight: you shall cover your face, that you see not the ground: for I have set you for a sign unto the house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with my hand; I brought it forth in the twilight, and I bare it upon my shoulder in their sight.
verses.text: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with my hand; I brought it forth in the twilight, and I bare it upon my shoulder in their sight.

verses.raw: And in the morning came the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto me, saying,
verses.text: And in the morning came the word of Yahuah unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, has not the house of Yashar'el (Israel), the rebellious house, said unto you, What do you?
verses.text: Son of Adam, has not the house of Yashar'el, the rebellious house, said unto you, What do you?

verses.raw: Say you unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); This burden concerneth the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Yashar'el (Israel) that are among them.
verses.text: Say you unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; This burden concerneth the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Yashar'el that are among them.

verses.raw: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove and go into captivity.
verses.text: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove and go into captivity.

verses.raw: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with his eyes.
verses.text: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with his eyes.

verses.raw: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
verses.text: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.

verses.raw: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.
verses.text: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.

verses.raw: And they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.
verses.text: And they shall know that I am Yahuah, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.

verses.raw: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to me, saying,
verses.text: Moreover the word of Yahuah came to me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with carefulness;
verses.text: Son of Adam, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with carefulness;

verses.raw: And say unto the people of the land, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and of the land of Yashar'el (Israel); They shall eat their bread with carefulness, and drink their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.
verses.text: And say unto the people of the land, Thus says Adonai Yahuah of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and of the land of Yashar'el; They shall eat their bread with carefulness, and drink their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.

verses.raw: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and you shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, what is that proverb that you have in the land of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision fails?
verses.text: Son of Adam, what is that proverb that you have in the land of Yashar'el, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision fails?

verses.raw: Tell them therefore, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Yashar'el (Israel); but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.
verses.text: Tell them therefore, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Yashar'el; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.

verses.raw: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: For I am Yahuah (LORD): I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: For I am Yahuah: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Again the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to me, saying,
verses.text: Again the word of Yahuah came to me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, behold, they of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) say, The vision that he sees is for many days to come, and he prophesieth of the times that are far off.
verses.text: Son of Adam, behold, they of the house of Yashar'el say, The vision that he sees is for many days to come, and he prophesieth of the times that are far off.

verses.raw: Therefore say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Therefore say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, prophesy against the prophets of Yashar'el (Israel) that prophesy, and say you unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear you the word of Yahuah (LORD);
verses.text: Son of Adam, prophesy against the prophets of Yashar'el that prophesy, and say you unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear you the word of Yahuah;

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!

verses.raw: O Yashar'el (Israel), your prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.
verses.text: O Yashar'el, your prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.

verses.raw: You have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Yashar'el (Israel) to stand in the battle in the day of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: You have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Yashar'el to stand in the battle in the day of Yahuah.

verses.raw: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, Yahuah (LORD) says: and Yahuah (LORD) has not sent them: and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word.
verses.text: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, Yahuah says: and Yahuah has not sent them: and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word.

verses.raw: Have you not seen a vain vision, and have you not spoken a lying divination, whereas you say, Yahuah (LORD) says it; albeit I have not spoken?
verses.text: Have you not seen a vain vision, and have you not spoken a lying divination, whereas you say, Yahuah says it; albeit I have not spoken?

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because you have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Because you have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: And my hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), neither shall they enter into the land of Yashar'el (Israel); and you shall know that I am Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: And my hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Yashar'el, neither shall they enter into the land of Yashar'el; and you shall know that I am Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered morter:
verses.text: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered morter:

verses.raw: Say unto them which daub it with untempered morter, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and you, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it.
verses.text: Say unto them which daub it with untempered morter, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and you, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it.

verses.raw: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where is the daubing wherewith you have daubed it?
verses.text: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where is the daubing wherewith you have daubed it?

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in my anger, and great hailstones in my fury to consume it.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in my anger, and great hailstones in my fury to consume it.

verses.raw: So will I break down the wall that you have daubed with untempered morter, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and you shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: So will I break down the wall that you have daubed with untempered morter, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and you shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and you shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered morter, and will say unto you, The wall is no more, neither they that daubed it;
verses.text: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered morter, and will say unto you, The wall is no more, neither they that daubed it;

verses.raw: To wit, the prophets of Yashar'el (Israel) which prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and which see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: To wit, the prophets of Yashar'el which prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and which see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Likewise, you son of Adam, set your face against the daughters of your people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy you against them,
verses.text: Likewise, you son of Adam, set your face against the daughters of your people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy you against them,

verses.raw: And say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people, and will you save the souls alive that come unto you?
verses.text: And say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people, and will you save the souls alive that come unto you?

verses.raw: And will you pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear your lies?
verses.text: And will you pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear your lies?

verses.raw: Wherefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith you there hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, even the souls that you hunt to make them fly.
verses.text: Wherefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith you there hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, even the souls that you hunt to make them fly.

verses.raw: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and you shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Because with lies you have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:
verses.text: Because with lies you have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:

verses.raw: Therefore you shall see no more vanity, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Therefore you shall see no more vanity, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: and you shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Then came certain of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel) unto me, and sat before me.
verses.text: Then came certain of the elders of Yashar'el unto me, and sat before me.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, these men have set up their idols in their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be enquired of at all by them?
verses.text: Son of Adam, these men have set up their idols in their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be enquired of at all by them?

verses.raw: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Every man of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) that sets up his idols in his heart, and puts the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet; I Yahuah (LORD) will answer him that comes according to the multitude of his idols;
verses.text: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Every man of the house of Yashar'el that sets up his idols in his heart, and puts the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet; I Yahuah will answer him that comes according to the multitude of his idols;

verses.raw: That I may take the house of Yashar'el (Israel) in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.
verses.text: That I may take the house of Yashar'el in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.

verses.raw: Therefore say unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel), Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
verses.text: Therefore say unto the house of Yashar'el, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.

verses.raw: For every one of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), or of the stranger that sojourns in Yashar'el (Israel), which separateth himself from me, and sets up his idols in his heart, and puts the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and comes to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I Yahuah (LORD) will answer him by myself:
verses.text: For every one of the house of Yashar'el, or of the stranger that sojourns in Yashar'el, which separateth himself from me, and sets up his idols in his heart, and puts the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and comes to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I Yahuah will answer him by myself:

verses.raw: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and you shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: And if the prophet be deceived when he has spoken a thing, I Yahuah (LORD) have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And if the prophet be deceived when he has spoken a thing, I Yahuah have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeks unto him;
verses.text: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeks unto him;

verses.raw: That the house of Yashar'el (Israel) may go no more astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their Elohim (God), says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: That the house of Yashar'el may go no more astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their Elohim, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came again to me, saying,
verses.text: The word of Yahuah came again to me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, when the land sins against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out my hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof, and will send famine upon it, and will cut off man and beast from it:
verses.text: Son of Adam, when the land sins against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out my hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof, and will send famine upon it, and will cut off man and beast from it:

verses.raw: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:
verses.text: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:

verses.raw: Though these three men were in it, as I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate.
verses.text: Though these three men were in it, as I live, says Adonai Yahuah, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate.

verses.raw: Or if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it:
verses.text: Or if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it:

verses.raw: Though these three men were in it, as I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.
verses.text: Though these three men were in it, as I live, says Adonai Yahuah, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.

verses.raw: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:
verses.text: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:

verses.raw: Though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.
verses.text: Though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live, says Adonai Yahuah, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.

verses.raw: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the noisome beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast?
verses.text: For thus says Adonai Yahuah; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the noisome beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast?

verses.raw: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and you shall see their way and their doings: and you shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it.
verses.text: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and you shall see their way and their doings: and you shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it.

verses.raw: And they shall comfort you, when you see their ways and their doings: and you shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: And they shall comfort you, when you see their ways and their doings: and you shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, What is the vine tree more than any tree, or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest?
verses.text: Son of Adam, What is the vine tree more than any tree, or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest?
