verses.raw: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?
verses.text: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?

verses.raw: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devours both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for any work?
verses.text: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devours both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for any work?

verses.raw: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for any work, when the fire has devoured it, and it is burned?
verses.text: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for any work, when the fire has devoured it, and it is burned?

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from one fire, and another fire shall devour them; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I set my face against them.
verses.text: And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from one fire, and another fire shall devour them; and you shall know that I am Yahuah, when I set my face against them.

verses.raw: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Again the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Again the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,
verses.text: Son of Adam, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,

verses.raw: And say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) unto Jerusalem; Your birth and your nativity is of the land of Canaan; your father was an Amorite, and your mother an Hittite.
verses.text: And say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah unto Jerusalem; Your birth and your nativity is of the land of Canaan; your father was an Amorite, and your mother an Hittite.

verses.raw: And as for your nativity, in the day you were born your navel was not cut, neither were you washed in water to supple you; you were not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.
verses.text: And as for your nativity, in the day you were born your navel was not cut, neither were you washed in water to supple you; you were not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.

verses.raw: None eye pitied you, to do any of these unto you, to have compassion upon you; but you were cast out in the open field, to the lothing of your person, in the day that you were born.
verses.text: None eye pitied you, to do any of these unto you, to have compassion upon you; but you were cast out in the open field, to the lothing of your person, in the day that you were born.

verses.raw: And when I passed by you, and saw you polluted in your own blood, I said unto you when you were in your blood, Live; yea, I said unto you when you were in your blood, Live.
verses.text: And when I passed by you, and saw you polluted in your own blood, I said unto you when you were in your blood, Live; yea, I said unto you when you were in your blood, Live.

verses.raw: I have caused you to multiply as the bud of the field, and you have increased and waxen great, and you are come to excellent ornaments: your breasts are fashioned, and your hair is grown, whereas you were naked and bare.
verses.text: I have caused you to multiply as the bud of the field, and you have increased and waxen great, and you are come to excellent ornaments: your breasts are fashioned, and your hair is grown, whereas you were naked and bare.

verses.raw: Now when I passed by you, and looked upon you, behold, your time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over you, and covered your nakedness: yea, I sware unto you, and entered into a covenant with you, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), and you becamest mine.
verses.text: Now when I passed by you, and looked upon you, behold, your time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over you, and covered your nakedness: yea, I sware unto you, and entered into a covenant with you, says Adonai Yahuah, and you becamest mine.

verses.raw: Then washed I you with water; yea, I throughly washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.
verses.text: Then washed I you with water; yea, I throughly washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.

verses.raw: I clothed you also with broidered work, and shod you with badgers’ skin, and I girded you about with fine linen, and I covered you with silk.
verses.text: I clothed you also with broidered work, and shod you with badgers’ skin, and I girded you about with fine linen, and I covered you with silk.

verses.raw: I decked you also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon your hands, and a chain on your neck.
verses.text: I decked you also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon your hands, and a chain on your neck.

verses.raw: And I put a jewel on your forehead, and earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown upon your head.
verses.text: And I put a jewel on your forehead, and earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown upon your head.

verses.raw: Thus were you decked with gold and silver; and your raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; you did eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and you were exceeding beautiful, and you did prosper into a kingdom.
verses.text: Thus were you decked with gold and silver; and your raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; you did eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and you were exceeding beautiful, and you did prosper into a kingdom.

verses.raw: And your renown went forth among the heathen for your beauty: for it was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon you, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: And your renown went forth among the heathen for your beauty: for it was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon you, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: But you did trust in your own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of your renown, and pouredst out your fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.
verses.text: But you did trust in your own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of your renown, and pouredst out your fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.

verses.raw: And of your garments you did take, and deckedst your high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: the like things shall not come, neither shall it be so.
verses.text: And of your garments you did take, and deckedst your high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: the like things shall not come, neither shall it be so.

verses.raw: You have also taken your fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made to thyself images of men, and did commit whoredom with them,
verses.text: You have also taken your fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made to thyself images of men, and did commit whoredom with them,

verses.raw: And tookest your broidered garments, and coveredst them: and you have set my oil and my incense before them.
verses.text: And tookest your broidered garments, and coveredst them: and you have set my oil and my incense before them.

verses.raw: My meat also which I gave you, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed you, you have even set it before them for a sweet savour: and thus it was, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: My meat also which I gave you, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed you, you have even set it before them for a sweet savour: and thus it was, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Moreover you have taken your sons and your daughters, whom you have borne unto me, and these have you sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Is this of your whoredoms a small matter,
verses.text: Moreover you have taken your sons and your daughters, whom you have borne unto me, and these have you sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Is this of your whoredoms a small matter,

verses.raw: That you have slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them?
verses.text: That you have slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them?

verses.raw: And in all your abominations and your whoredoms you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, and were polluted in your blood.
verses.text: And in all your abominations and your whoredoms you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, and were polluted in your blood.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after all your wickedness, (woe, woe unto you! says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD);)
verses.text: And it came to pass after all your wickedness, (woe, woe unto you! says Adonai Yahuah;)

verses.raw: That you have also built unto you an eminent place, and have made you an high place in every street.
verses.text: That you have also built unto you an eminent place, and have made you an high place in every street.

verses.raw: You have built your high place at every head of the way, and have made your beauty to be abhorred, and have opened your feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied your whoredoms.
verses.text: You have built your high place at every head of the way, and have made your beauty to be abhorred, and have opened your feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied your whoredoms.

verses.raw: You have also committed fornication with the Egyptians your neighbours, great of flesh; and have increased your whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.
verses.text: You have also committed fornication with the Egyptians your neighbours, great of flesh; and have increased your whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.

verses.raw: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your ordinary food, and delivered you unto the will of them that hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of your lewd way.
verses.text: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your ordinary food, and delivered you unto the will of them that hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of your lewd way.

verses.raw: You have played the whore also with the Assyrians, because you were unsatiable; yea, you have played the harlot with them, and yet could not be satisfied.
verses.text: You have played the whore also with the Assyrians, because you were unsatiable; yea, you have played the harlot with them, and yet could not be satisfied.

verses.raw: You have moreover multiplied your fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet you were not satisfied herewith.
verses.text: You have moreover multiplied your fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet you were not satisfied herewith.

verses.raw: How weak is your heart, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), seeing you do all these things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;
verses.text: How weak is your heart, says Adonai Yahuah, seeing you do all these things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;

verses.raw: In that you buildest your eminent place in the head of every way, and make your high place in every street; and have not been as an harlot, in that you scornest hire;
verses.text: In that you buildest your eminent place in the head of every way, and make your high place in every street; and have not been as an harlot, in that you scornest hire;

verses.raw: But as a wife that commits adultery, which takes strangers instead of her husband!
verses.text: But as a wife that commits adultery, which takes strangers instead of her husband!

verses.raw: They give gifts to all whores: but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto you on every side for your whoredom.
verses.text: They give gifts to all whores: but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto you on every side for your whoredom.

verses.raw: And the contrary is in you from other women in your whoredoms, whereas none follows you to commit whoredoms: and in that you give a reward, and no reward is given unto you, therefore you are contrary.
verses.text: And the contrary is in you from other women in your whoredoms, whereas none follows you to commit whoredoms: and in that you give a reward, and no reward is given unto you, therefore you are contrary.

verses.raw: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of Yahuah:

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because your filthiness was poured out, and your nakedness discovered through your whoredoms with your lovers, and with all the idols of your abominations, and by the blood of your children, which you did give unto them;
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Because your filthiness was poured out, and your nakedness discovered through your whoredoms with your lovers, and with all the idols of your abominations, and by the blood of your children, which you did give unto them;

verses.raw: Behold, therefore I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all them that you have loved, with all them that you have hated; I will even gather them round about against you, and will discover your nakedness unto them, that they may see all your nakedness.
verses.text: Behold, therefore I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all them that you have loved, with all them that you have hated; I will even gather them round about against you, and will discover your nakedness unto them, that they may see all your nakedness.

verses.raw: And I will judge you, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give you blood in fury and jealousy.
verses.text: And I will judge you, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give you blood in fury and jealousy.

verses.raw: And I will also give you into their hand, and they shall throw down your eminent place, and shall break down your high places: they shall strip you also of your clothes, and shall take your fair jewels, and leave you naked and bare.
verses.text: And I will also give you into their hand, and they shall throw down your eminent place, and shall break down your high places: they shall strip you also of your clothes, and shall take your fair jewels, and leave you naked and bare.

verses.raw: They shall also bring up a company against you, and they shall stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.
verses.text: They shall also bring up a company against you, and they shall stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.

verses.raw: And they shall burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments upon you in the sight of many women: and I will cause you to cease from playing the harlot, and you also shall give no hire any more.
verses.text: And they shall burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments upon you in the sight of many women: and I will cause you to cease from playing the harlot, and you also shall give no hire any more.

verses.raw: So will I make my fury toward you to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from you, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.
verses.text: So will I make my fury toward you to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from you, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.

verses.raw: Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have fretted me in all these things; behold, therefore I also will recompense your way upon your head, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD): and you shall not commit this lewdness above all your abominations.
verses.text: Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have fretted me in all these things; behold, therefore I also will recompense your way upon your head, says Adonai Yahuah: and you shall not commit this lewdness above all your abominations.

verses.raw: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against you, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.
verses.text: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against you, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.

verses.raw: You are your mother’s daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother was an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
verses.text: You are your mother’s daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother was an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

verses.raw: And your elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at your left hand: and your younger sister, that dwells at your right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.
verses.text: And your elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at your left hand: and your younger sister, that dwells at your right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.

verses.raw: Yet have you not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as if that were a very little thing, you were corrupted more than they in all your ways.
verses.text: Yet have you not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as if that were a very little thing, you were corrupted more than they in all your ways.

verses.raw: As I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.
verses.text: As I live, says Adonai Yahuah, Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.

verses.raw: Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
verses.text: Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

verses.raw: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw good.
verses.text: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw good.

verses.raw: Neither has Samaria committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters in all your abominations which you have done.
verses.text: Neither has Samaria committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters in all your abominations which you have done.

verses.raw: You also, which have judged your sisters, bear your own shame for your sins that you have committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than you: yea, be you confounded also, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.
verses.text: You also, which have judged your sisters, bear your own shame for your sins that you have committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than you: yea, be you confounded also, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.

verses.raw: When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then will I bring again the captivity of your captives in the midst of them:
verses.text: When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then will I bring again the captivity of your captives in the midst of them:

verses.raw: That you may bear your own shame, and may be confounded in all that you have done, in that you are a comfort unto them.
verses.text: That you may bear your own shame, and may be confounded in all that you have done, in that you are a comfort unto them.

verses.raw: When your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then you and your daughters shall return to your former estate.
verses.text: When your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then you and your daughters shall return to your former estate.

verses.raw: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,
verses.text: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,

verses.raw: Before your wickedness was discovered, as at the time of your reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise you round about.
verses.text: Before your wickedness was discovered, as at the time of your reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise you round about.

verses.raw: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will even deal with you as you have done, which have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
verses.text: For thus says Adonai Yahuah; I will even deal with you as you have done, which have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

verses.raw: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish unto you an everlasting covenant.
verses.text: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish unto you an everlasting covenant.

verses.raw: Then you shall remember your ways, and be ashamed, when you shall receive your sisters, your elder and your younger: and I will give them unto you for daughters, but not by your covenant.
verses.text: Then you shall remember your ways, and be ashamed, when you shall receive your sisters, your elder and your younger: and I will give them unto you for daughters, but not by your covenant.

verses.raw: And I will establish my covenant with you; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: And I will establish my covenant with you; and you shall know that I am Yahuah:

verses.raw: That you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more because of your shame, when I am pacified toward you for all that you have done, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: That you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more because of your shame, when I am pacified toward you for all that you have done, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel);
verses.text: Son of Adam, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Yashar'el;

verses.raw: And say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:
verses.text: And say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:

verses.raw: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.
verses.text: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.

verses.raw: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed it by great waters, and set it as a willow tree.
verses.text: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed it by great waters, and set it as a willow tree.

verses.raw: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.
verses.text: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.

verses.raw: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.
verses.text: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.

verses.raw: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.
verses.text: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.

verses.raw: Say you, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.
verses.text: Say you, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.

verses.raw: Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind touches it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.
verses.text: Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind touches it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.

verses.raw: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Moreover the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Say now to the rebellious house, Know you not what these things mean? tell them, Behold, the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem, and has taken the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and led them with him to Babylon;
verses.text: Say now to the rebellious house, Know you not what these things mean? tell them, Behold, the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem, and has taken the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and led them with him to Babylon;

verses.raw: And has taken of the king’s seed, and made a covenant with him, and has taken an oath of him: he has also taken the mighty of the land:
verses.text: And has taken of the king’s seed, and made a covenant with him, and has taken an oath of him: he has also taken the mighty of the land:

verses.raw: That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand.
verses.text: That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand.

verses.raw: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that does such things? or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?
verses.text: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that does such things? or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?

verses.raw: As I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), surely in the place where the king dwells that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.
verses.text: As I live, says Adonai Yahuah, surely in the place where the king dwells that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.

verses.raw: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, and building forts, to cut off many persons:
verses.text: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, and building forts, to cut off many persons:

verses.raw: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and has done all these things, he shall not escape.
verses.text: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and has done all these things, he shall not escape.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); As I live, surely my oath that he has despised, and my covenant that he has broken, even it will I recompense upon his own head.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; As I live, surely my oath that he has despised, and my covenant that he has broken, even it will I recompense upon his own head.

verses.raw: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me.
verses.text: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me.

verses.raw: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and you shall know that I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it.
verses.text: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and you shall know that I Yahuah have spoken it.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent:
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent:

verses.raw: In the mountain of the height of Yashar'el (Israel) will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.
verses.text: In the mountain of the height of Yashar'el will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.

verses.raw: And all the trees of the field shall know that I Yahuah (LORD) have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken and have done it.
verses.text: And all the trees of the field shall know that I Yahuah have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I Yahuah have spoken and have done it.

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me again, saying,
verses.text: The word of Yahuah came unto me again, saying,

verses.raw: What mean you, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge?
verses.text: What mean you, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Yashar'el, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge?

verses.raw: As I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), you shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: As I live, says Adonai Yahuah, you shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sins, it shall die.
verses.text: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sins, it shall die.

verses.raw: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,
verses.text: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,

verses.raw: And has not eaten upon the mountains, neither has lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), neither has defiled his neighbour’s wife, neither has come near to a menstruous woman,
verses.text: And has not eaten upon the mountains, neither has lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Yashar'el, neither has defiled his neighbour’s wife, neither has come near to a menstruous woman,

verses.raw: And has not oppressed any, but has restored to the debtor his pledge, has spoiled none by violence, has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;
verses.text: And has not oppressed any, but has restored to the debtor his pledge, has spoiled none by violence, has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;

verses.raw: He that has not given forth upon usury, neither has taken any increase, that has withdrawn his hand from iniquity, has executed true judgment between man and man,
verses.text: He that has not given forth upon usury, neither has taken any increase, that has withdrawn his hand from iniquity, has executed true judgment between man and man,

verses.raw: Has walked in my statutes, and has kept my judgments, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Has walked in my statutes, and has kept my judgments, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that does the like to any one of these things,
verses.text: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that does the like to any one of these things,

verses.raw: And that does not any of those duties, but even has eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour’s wife,
verses.text: And that does not any of those duties, but even has eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour’s wife,

verses.raw: Has oppressed the poor and needy, has spoiled by violence, has not restored the pledge, and has lifted up his eyes to the idols, has committed abomination,
verses.text: Has oppressed the poor and needy, has spoiled by violence, has not restored the pledge, and has lifted up his eyes to the idols, has committed abomination,

verses.raw: Has given forth upon usury, and has taken increase: shall he then live? he shall not live: he has done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.
verses.text: Has given forth upon usury, and has taken increase: shall he then live? he shall not live: he has done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.

verses.raw: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that sees all his father’s sins which he has done, and considereth, and does not such like,
verses.text: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that sees all his father’s sins which he has done, and considereth, and does not such like,

verses.raw: That has not eaten upon the mountains, neither has lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), has not defiled his neighbour’s wife,
verses.text: That has not eaten upon the mountains, neither has lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Yashar'el, has not defiled his neighbour’s wife,

verses.raw: Neither has oppressed any, has not withholden the pledge, neither has spoiled by violence, but has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment,
verses.text: Neither has oppressed any, has not withholden the pledge, neither has spoiled by violence, but has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment,

verses.raw: That has taken off his hand from the poor, that has not received usury nor increase, has executed my judgments, has walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.
verses.text: That has taken off his hand from the poor, that has not received usury nor increase, has executed my judgments, has walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.

verses.raw: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, spoiled his brother by violence, and did that which is not good among his people, lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.
verses.text: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, spoiled his brother by violence, and did that which is not good among his people, lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.

verses.raw: Yet say you, Why? does not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son has done that which is lawful and right, and has kept all my statutes, and has done them, he shall surely live.
verses.text: Yet say you, Why? does not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son has done that which is lawful and right, and has kept all my statutes, and has done them, he shall surely live.

verses.raw: The soul that sins, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.
verses.text: The soul that sins, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.

verses.raw: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he has committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verses.text: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he has committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

verses.raw: All his transgressions that he has committed, they shall not be mentioned unto him: in his righteousness that he has done he shall live.
verses.text: All his transgressions that he has committed, they shall not be mentioned unto him: in his righteousness that he has done he shall live.

verses.raw: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD): and not that he should return from his ways, and live?
verses.text: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? says Adonai Yahuah: and not that he should return from his ways, and live?

verses.raw: But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, shall he live? All his righteousness that he has done shall not be mentioned: in his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them shall he die.
verses.text: But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, shall he live? All his righteousness that he has done shall not be mentioned: in his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them shall he die.

verses.raw: Yet you say, The way of Adonai (Lord) is not equal. Hear now, O house of Yashar'el (Israel); Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?
verses.text: Yet you say, The way of Adonai is not equal. Hear now, O house of Yashar'el; Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?

verses.raw: When a righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies in them; for his iniquity that he has done shall he die.
verses.text: When a righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies in them; for his iniquity that he has done shall he die.

verses.raw: Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.
verses.text: Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.

verses.raw: Because he considereth, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verses.text: Because he considereth, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

verses.raw: Yet says the house of Yashar'el (Israel), The way of Adonai (Lord) is not equal. O house of Yashar'el (Israel), are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?
verses.text: Yet says the house of Yashar'el, The way of Adonai is not equal. O house of Yashar'el, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?

verses.raw: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), every one according to his ways, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD). Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.
verses.text: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Yashar'el, every one according to his ways, says Adonai Yahuah. Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.

verses.raw: Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby you have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will you die, O house of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby you have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will you die, O house of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dies, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD): wherefore turn yourselves, and live you.
verses.text: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dies, says Adonai Yahuah: wherefore turn yourselves, and live you.

verses.raw: Moreover take you up a lamentation for the princes of Yashar'el (Israel),
verses.text: Moreover take you up a lamentation for the princes of Yashar'el,

verses.raw: And say, What is your mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.
verses.text: And say, What is your mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.

verses.raw: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.
verses.text: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.

verses.raw: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt.
verses.text: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.
verses.text: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.

verses.raw: And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey, and devoured men.
verses.text: And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey, and devoured men.

verses.raw: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.
verses.text: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.

verses.raw: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.
verses.text: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.

verses.raw: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Your mother is like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
verses.text: Your mother is like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

verses.raw: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.
verses.text: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.

verses.raw: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.
verses.text: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.

verses.raw: And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.
verses.text: And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.

verses.raw: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, which has devoured her fruit, so that she has no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.
verses.text: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, which has devoured her fruit, so that she has no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel) came to enquire of Yahuah (LORD), and sat before me.
verses.text: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Yashar'el came to enquire of Yahuah, and sat before me.

verses.raw: Then came the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto me, saying,
verses.text: Then came the word of Yahuah unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, speak unto the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Are you come to enquire of me? As I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), I will not be enquired of by you.
verses.text: Son of Adam, speak unto the elders of Yashar'el, and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Are you come to enquire of me? As I live, says Adonai Yahuah, I will not be enquired of by you.

verses.raw: Will you judge them, son of Adam, will you judge them? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:
verses.text: Will you judge them, son of Adam, will you judge them? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:

verses.raw: And say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); In the day when I chose Yashar'el (Israel), and lifted up my hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up my hand unto them, saying, I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God);
verses.text: And say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; In the day when I chose Yashar'el, and lifted up my hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up my hand unto them, saying, I am Yahuah Elohaychem;

verses.raw: In the day that I lifted up my hand unto them, to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands:
verses.text: In the day that I lifted up my hand unto them, to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands:

verses.raw: Then said I unto them, Cast you away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: Then said I unto them, Cast you away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
verses.text: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text: But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.
verses.text: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.

verses.raw: And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them.
verses.text: And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them.

verses.raw: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am Yahuah (LORD) that sanctify them.
verses.text: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am Yahuah that sanctify them.

verses.raw: But the house of Yashar'el (Israel) rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.
verses.text: But the house of Yashar'el rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.

verses.raw: But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.
verses.text: But I wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.

verses.raw: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;
verses.text: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;

verses.raw: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.
verses.text: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.

verses.raw: Nevertheless my eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.
verses.text: Nevertheless my eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.

verses.raw: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk you not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:
verses.text: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk you not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:

verses.raw: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God); walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;
verses.text: I am Yahuah Elohaychem; walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;

verses.raw: And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; they polluted my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.
verses.text: Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; they polluted my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.

verses.raw: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand, and wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.
verses.text: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand, and wrought for my name’s sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.

verses.raw: I lifted up my hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;
verses.text: I lifted up my hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;

verses.raw: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers’ idols.
verses.text: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers’ idols.

verses.raw: Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good, and judgments whereby they should not live;
verses.text: Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good, and judgments whereby they should not live;

verses.raw: And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through the fire all that opens the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through the fire all that opens the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Therefore, son of Adam, speak unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.
verses.text: Therefore, son of Adam, speak unto the house of Yashar'el, and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.

verses.raw: For when I had brought them into the land, for the which I lifted up my hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.
verses.text: For when I had brought them into the land, for the which I lifted up my hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.

verses.raw: Then I said unto them, What is the high place whereunto you go? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.
verses.text: Then I said unto them, What is the high place whereunto you go? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.

verses.raw: Wherefore say unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel), Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Are you polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit you whoredom after their abominations?
verses.text: Wherefore say unto the house of Yashar'el, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Are you polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit you whoredom after their abominations?

verses.raw: For when you offer your gifts, when you make your sons to pass through the fire, you pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be enquired of by you, O house of Yashar'el (Israel)? As I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), I will not be enquired of by you.
verses.text: For when you offer your gifts, when you make your sons to pass through the fire, you pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be enquired of by you, O house of Yashar'el? As I live, says Adonai Yahuah, I will not be enquired of by you.

verses.raw: And that which comes into your mind shall not be at all, that you say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.
verses.text: And that which comes into your mind shall not be at all, that you say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.

verses.raw: As I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:
verses.text: As I live, says Adonai Yahuah, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:

verses.raw: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein you are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.
verses.text: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein you are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.

verses.raw: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.
verses.text: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.

verses.raw: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:
verses.text: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:

verses.raw: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Yashar'el (Israel): and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Yashar'el: and you shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: As for you, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Go you, serve you every one his idols, and hereafter also, if you will not hearken unto me: but pollute you my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.
verses.text: As for you, O house of Yashar'el, thus says Adonai Yahuah; Go you, serve you every one his idols, and hereafter also, if you will not hearken unto me: but pollute you my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.

verses.raw: For in my holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Yashar'el (Israel), says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), there shall all the house of Yashar'el (Israel), all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.
verses.text: For in my holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Yashar'el, says Adonai Yahuah, there shall all the house of Yashar'el, all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.

verses.raw: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein you have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.
verses.text: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein you have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.

verses.raw: And you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I shall bring you into the land of Yashar'el (Israel), into the country for the which I lifted up my hand to give it to your fathers.
verses.text: And you shall know that I am Yahuah, when I shall bring you into the land of Yashar'el, into the country for the which I lifted up my hand to give it to your fathers.

verses.raw: And there shall you remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein you have been defiled; and you shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that you have committed.
verses.text: And there shall you remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein you have been defiled; and you shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that you have committed.

verses.raw: And you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I have wrought with you for my name’s sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O you house of Yashar'el (Israel), says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: And you shall know that I am Yahuah, when I have wrought with you for my name’s sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O you house of Yashar'el, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Moreover the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, set your face toward the south, and drop your word toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;
verses.text: Son of Adam, set your face toward the south, and drop your word toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;

verses.raw: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD); Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it shall devour every green tree in you, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.
verses.text: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of Yahuah; Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it shall devour every green tree in you, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.

verses.raw: And all flesh shall see that I Yahuah (LORD) have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.
verses.text: And all flesh shall see that I Yahuah have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.

verses.raw: Then said I, Ah Adonai (Lord) GOD! they say of me, Does he not speak parables?
verses.text: Then said I, Ah Adonai GOD! they say of me, Does he not speak parables?

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, set your face toward Jerusalem, and drop your word toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Yashar'el (Israel),
verses.text: Son of Adam, set your face toward Jerusalem, and drop your word toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Yashar'el,

verses.raw: And say to the land of Yashar'el (Israel), Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I am against you, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.
verses.text: And say to the land of Yashar'el, Thus says Yahuah; Behold, I am against you, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.

verses.raw: Seeing then that I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:
verses.text: Seeing then that I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:

verses.raw: That all flesh may know that I Yahuah (LORD) have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.
verses.text: That all flesh may know that I Yahuah have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.

verses.raw: Sigh therefore, you son of Adam, with the breaking of your loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.
verses.text: Sigh therefore, you son of Adam, with the breaking of your loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.

verses.raw: And it shall be, when they say unto you, Wherefore sighest you? that you shall answer, For the tidings; because it comes: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it comes, and shall be brought to pass, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: And it shall be, when they say unto you, Wherefore sighest you? that you shall answer, For the tidings; because it comes: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it comes, and shall be brought to pass, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Again the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Again the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, prophesy, and say, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:
verses.text: Son of Adam, prophesy, and say, Thus says Yahuah; Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:

verses.raw: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son, as every tree.
verses.text: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son, as every tree.

verses.raw: And he has given it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.
verses.text: And he has given it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.

verses.raw: Cry and howl, son of Adam: for it shall be upon my people, it shall be upon all the princes of Yashar'el (Israel): terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon your thigh.
verses.text: Cry and howl, son of Adam: for it shall be upon my people, it shall be upon all the princes of Yashar'el: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon your thigh.

verses.raw: Because it is a trial, and what if the sword contemn even the rod? it shall be no more, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Because it is a trial, and what if the sword contemn even the rod? it shall be no more, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: You therefore, son of Adam, prophesy, and smite your hands together, and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it is the sword of the great men that are slain, which enters into their privy chambers.
verses.text: You therefore, son of Adam, prophesy, and smite your hands together, and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it is the sword of the great men that are slain, which enters into their privy chambers.

verses.raw: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that their heart may faint, and their ruins be multiplied: ah! it is made bright, it is wrapped up for the slaughter.
verses.text: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that their heart may faint, and their ruins be multiplied: ah! it is made bright, it is wrapped up for the slaughter.

verses.raw: Go you one way or other, either on the right hand, or on the left, whithersoever your face is set.
verses.text: Go you one way or other, either on the right hand, or on the left, whithersoever your face is set.

verses.raw: I will also smite my hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I Yahuah (LORD) have said it.
verses.text: I will also smite my hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I Yahuah have said it.

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me again, saying,
verses.text: The word of Yahuah came unto me again, saying,

verses.raw: Also, you son of Adam, appoint you two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both twain shall come forth out of one land: and choose you a place, choose it at the head of the way to the city.
verses.text: Also, you son of Adam, appoint you two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both twain shall come forth out of one land: and choose you a place, choose it at the head of the way to the city.

verses.raw: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbath of the Ammonites, and to Yahudah (Judah) in Jerusalem the defenced.
verses.text: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbath of the Ammonites, and to Yahudah in Jerusalem the defenced.

verses.raw: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made his arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.
verses.text: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made his arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.

verses.raw: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint battering rams against the gates, to cast a mount, and to build a fort.
verses.text: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint battering rams against the gates, to cast a mount, and to build a fort.

verses.raw: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.
verses.text: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because you have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because, I say, that you are come to remembrance, you shall be taken with the hand.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Because you have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because, I say, that you are come to remembrance, you shall be taken with the hand.

verses.raw: And you, profane wicked prince of Yashar'el (Israel), whose day is come, when iniquity shall have an end,
verses.text: And you, profane wicked prince of Yashar'el, whose day is come, when iniquity shall have an end,

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this shall not be the same: exalt him that is low, and abase him that is high.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this shall not be the same: exalt him that is low, and abase him that is high.

verses.raw: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him.
verses.text: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him.

verses.raw: And you, son of Adam, prophesy and say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their reproach; even say you, The sword, the sword is drawn: for the slaughter it is furbished, to consume because of the glittering:
verses.text: And you, son of Adam, prophesy and say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their reproach; even say you, The sword, the sword is drawn: for the slaughter it is furbished, to consume because of the glittering:

verses.raw: Whiles they see vanity unto you, whiles they divine a lie unto you, to bring you upon the necks of them that are slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity shall have an end.
verses.text: Whiles they see vanity unto you, whiles they divine a lie unto you, to bring you upon the necks of them that are slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity shall have an end.

verses.raw: Shall I cause it to return into his sheath? I will judge you in the place where you were created, in the land of your nativity.
verses.text: Shall I cause it to return into his sheath? I will judge you in the place where you were created, in the land of your nativity.

verses.raw: And I will pour out my indignation upon you, I will blow against you in the fire of my wrath, and deliver you into the hand of brutish men, and skilful to destroy.
verses.text: And I will pour out my indignation upon you, I will blow against you in the fire of my wrath, and deliver you into the hand of brutish men, and skilful to destroy.

verses.raw: You shall be for fuel to the fire; your blood shall be in the midst of the land; you shall be no more remembered: for I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it.
verses.text: You shall be for fuel to the fire; your blood shall be in the midst of the land; you shall be no more remembered: for I Yahuah have spoken it.

verses.raw: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Moreover the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Now, you son of Adam, will you judge, will you judge the bloody city? yea, you shall shew her all her abominations.
verses.text: Now, you son of Adam, will you judge, will you judge the bloody city? yea, you shall shew her all her abominations.

verses.raw: Then say you, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and makes idols against herself to defile herself.
verses.text: Then say you, Thus says Adonai Yahuah, The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and makes idols against herself to defile herself.

verses.raw: You are become guilty in your blood that you have shed; and have defiled thyself in your idols which you have made; and you have caused your days to draw near, and are come even unto your years: therefore have I made you a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.
verses.text: You are become guilty in your blood that you have shed; and have defiled thyself in your idols which you have made; and you have caused your days to draw near, and are come even unto your years: therefore have I made you a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.

verses.raw: Those that be near, and those that be far from you, shall mock you, which are infamous and much vexed.
verses.text: Those that be near, and those that be far from you, shall mock you, which are infamous and much vexed.

verses.raw: Behold, the princes of Yashar'el (Israel), every one were in you to their power to shed blood.
verses.text: Behold, the princes of Yashar'el, every one were in you to their power to shed blood.

verses.raw: In you have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of you have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in you have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.
verses.text: In you have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of you have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in you have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.

verses.raw: You have despised my holy things, and have profaned my sabbaths.
verses.text: You have despised my holy things, and have profaned my sabbaths.

verses.raw: In you are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in you they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of you they commit lewdness.
verses.text: In you are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in you they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of you they commit lewdness.

verses.raw: In you have they discovered their fathers’ nakedness: in you have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.
verses.text: In you have they discovered their fathers’ nakedness: in you have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.

verses.raw: And one has committed abomination with his neighbour’s wife; and another has lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in you has humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.
verses.text: And one has committed abomination with his neighbour’s wife; and another has lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in you has humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.

verses.raw: In you have they taken gifts to shed blood; you have taken usury and increase, and you have greedily gained of your neighbours by extortion, and have forgotten me, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: In you have they taken gifts to shed blood; you have taken usury and increase, and you have greedily gained of your neighbours by extortion, and have forgotten me, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Behold, therefore I have smitten my hand at your dishonest gain which you have made, and at your blood which has been in the midst of you.
verses.text: Behold, therefore I have smitten my hand at your dishonest gain which you have made, and at your blood which has been in the midst of you.

verses.raw: Can your heart endure, or can your hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with you? I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it, and will do it.
