verses.text: Can your heart endure, or can your hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with you? I Yahuah have spoken it, and will do it.

verses.raw: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and disperse you in the countries, and will consume your filthiness out of you.
verses.text: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and disperse you in the countries, and will consume your filthiness out of you.

verses.raw: And you shall take your inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And you shall take your inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and you shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, the house of Yashar'el (Israel) is to me become dross: all they are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.
verses.text: Son of Adam, the house of Yashar'el is to me become dross: all they are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because you are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Because you are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: As they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in my anger and in my fury, and I will leave you there, and melt you.
verses.text: As they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in my anger and in my fury, and I will leave you there, and melt you.

verses.raw: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and you shall be melted in the midst thereof.
verses.text: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and you shall be melted in the midst thereof.

verses.raw: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall you be melted in the midst thereof; and you shall know that I Yahuah (LORD) have poured out my fury upon you.
verses.text: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall you be melted in the midst thereof; and you shall know that I Yahuah have poured out my fury upon you.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, say unto her, You are the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.
verses.text: Son of Adam, say unto her, You are the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.

verses.raw: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.
verses.text: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.

verses.raw: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned my holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.
verses.text: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned my holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.

verses.raw: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.
verses.text: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.

verses.raw: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), when Yahuah (LORD) has not spoken.
verses.text: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus says Adonai Yahuah, when Yahuah has not spoken.

verses.raw: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.
verses.text: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.

verses.raw: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.
verses.text: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.

verses.raw: Therefore have I poured out my indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Therefore have I poured out my indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came again unto me, saying,
verses.text: The word of Yahuah came again unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:
verses.text: Son of Adam, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:

verses.raw: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.
verses.text: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.

verses.raw: And the names of them were Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus were their names; Samaria is Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.
verses.text: And the names of them were Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus were their names; Samaria is Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.

verses.raw: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbours,
verses.text: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbours,

verses.raw: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
verses.text: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.

verses.raw: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.
verses.text: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.

verses.raw: Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.
verses.text: Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.

verses.raw: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.
verses.text: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.

verses.raw: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.
verses.text: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.

verses.raw: And when her sister Aholibah saw this, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms.
verses.text: And when her sister Aholibah saw this, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms.

verses.raw: She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.
verses.text: She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.

verses.raw: Then I saw that she was defiled, that they took both one way,
verses.text: Then I saw that she was defiled, that they took both one way,

verses.raw: And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,
verses.text: And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,

verses.raw: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:
verses.text: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:

verses.raw: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.
verses.text: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.

verses.raw: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.
verses.text: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.

verses.raw: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.
verses.text: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.

verses.raw: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.
verses.text: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.
verses.text: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.

verses.raw: Thus you called to remembrance the lewdness of your youth, in bruising your teats by the Egyptians for the paps of your youth.
verses.text: Thus you called to remembrance the lewdness of your youth, in bruising your teats by the Egyptians for the paps of your youth.

verses.raw: Therefore, O Aholibah, thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will raise up your lovers against you, from whom your mind is alienated, and I will bring them against you on every side;
verses.text: Therefore, O Aholibah, thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I will raise up your lovers against you, from whom your mind is alienated, and I will bring them against you on every side;

verses.raw: The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.
verses.text: The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.

verses.raw: And they shall come against you with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people, which shall set against you buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge you according to their judgments.
verses.text: And they shall come against you with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people, which shall set against you buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge you according to their judgments.

verses.raw: And I will set my jealousy against you, and they shall deal furiously with you: they shall take away your nose and your ears; and your remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take your sons and your daughters; and your residue shall be devoured by the fire.
verses.text: And I will set my jealousy against you, and they shall deal furiously with you: they shall take away your nose and your ears; and your remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take your sons and your daughters; and your residue shall be devoured by the fire.

verses.raw: They shall also strip you out of your clothes, and take away your fair jewels.
verses.text: They shall also strip you out of your clothes, and take away your fair jewels.

verses.raw: Thus will I make your lewdness to cease from you, and your whoredom brought from the land of Egypt: so that you shall not lift up your eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.
verses.text: Thus will I make your lewdness to cease from you, and your whoredom brought from the land of Egypt: so that you shall not lift up your eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.

verses.raw: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will deliver you into the hand of them whom you hate, into the hand of them from whom your mind is alienated:
verses.text: For thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I will deliver you into the hand of them whom you hate, into the hand of them from whom your mind is alienated:

verses.raw: And they shall deal with you hatefully, and shall take away all your labour, and shall leave you naked and bare: and the nakedness of your whoredoms shall be discovered, both your lewdness and your whoredoms.
verses.text: And they shall deal with you hatefully, and shall take away all your labour, and shall leave you naked and bare: and the nakedness of your whoredoms shall be discovered, both your lewdness and your whoredoms.

verses.raw: I will do these things unto you, because you have gone a whoring after the heathen, and because you are polluted with their idols.
verses.text: I will do these things unto you, because you have gone a whoring after the heathen, and because you are polluted with their idols.

verses.raw: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore will I give her cup into your hand.
verses.text: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore will I give her cup into your hand.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); You shall drink of your sister’s cup deep and large: you shall be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; You shall drink of your sister’s cup deep and large: you shall be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.

verses.raw: You shall be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of your sister Samaria.
verses.text: You shall be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of your sister Samaria.

verses.raw: You shall even drink it and suck it out, and you shall break the sherds thereof, and pluck off your own breasts: for I have spoken it, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: You shall even drink it and suck it out, and you shall break the sherds thereof, and pluck off your own breasts: for I have spoken it, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because you have forgotten me, and cast me behind your back, therefore bear you also your lewdness and your whoredoms.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Because you have forgotten me, and cast me behind your back, therefore bear you also your lewdness and your whoredoms.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) said moreover unto me; Son of Adam, will you judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations;
verses.text: Yahuah said moreover unto me; Son of Adam, will you judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations;

verses.raw: That they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through the fire, to devour them.
verses.text: That they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through the fire, to devour them.

verses.raw: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.
verses.text: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.

verses.raw: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of my house.
verses.text: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of my house.

verses.raw: And furthermore, that you have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom you did wash thyself, paintedst your eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,
verses.text: And furthermore, that you have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom you did wash thyself, paintedst your eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,

verses.raw: And sat upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon you have set my incense and my oil.
verses.text: And sat upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon you have set my incense and my oil.

verses.raw: And a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.
verses.text: And a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.

verses.raw: Then said I unto her that was old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she with them?
verses.text: Then said I unto her that was old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she with them?

verses.raw: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.
verses.text: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.

verses.raw: And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
verses.text: And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.

verses.raw: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.
verses.text: For thus says Adonai Yahuah; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.

verses.raw: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
verses.text: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

verses.raw: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.
verses.text: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.

verses.raw: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and you shall bear the sins of your idols: and you shall know that I am Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and you shall bear the sins of your idols: and you shall know that I am Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, write you the name of the day, even of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.
verses.text: Son of Adam, write you the name of the day, even of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.

verses.raw: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Set on a pot, set it on, and also pour water into it:
verses.text: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Set on a pot, set it on, and also pour water into it:

verses.raw: Gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.
verses.text: Gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.

verses.raw: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.
verses.text: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.

verses.raw: Wherefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum is therein, and whose scum is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall upon it.
verses.text: Wherefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum is therein, and whose scum is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall upon it.

verses.raw: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;
verses.text: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;

verses.raw: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.
verses.text: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.

verses.raw: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.
verses.text: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.

verses.raw: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the scum of it may be consumed.
verses.text: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the scum of it may be consumed.

verses.raw: She has wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum shall be in the fire.
verses.text: She has wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum shall be in the fire.

verses.raw: In your filthiness is lewdness: because I have purged you, and you were not purged, you shall not be purged from your filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon you.
verses.text: In your filthiness is lewdness: because I have purged you, and you were not purged, you shall not be purged from your filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon you.

verses.raw: I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to your ways, and according to your doings, shall they judge you, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: I Yahuah have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to your ways, and according to your doings, shall they judge you, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Also the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Also the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, behold, I take away from you the desire of your eyes with a stroke: yet neither shall you mourn nor weep, neither shall your tears run down.
verses.text: Son of Adam, behold, I take away from you the desire of your eyes with a stroke: yet neither shall you mourn nor weep, neither shall your tears run down.

verses.raw: Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of your head upon you, and put on your shoes upon your feet, and cover not your lips, and eat not the bread of men.
verses.text: Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of your head upon you, and put on your shoes upon your feet, and cover not your lips, and eat not the bread of men.

verses.raw: So I spake unto the people in the morning: and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.
verses.text: So I spake unto the people in the morning: and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.

verses.raw: And the people said unto me, Will you not tell us what these things are to us, that you do so?
verses.text: And the people said unto me, Will you not tell us what these things are to us, that you do so?

verses.raw: Then I answered them, The word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Then I answered them, The word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel), Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left shall fall by the sword.
verses.text: Speak unto the house of Yashar'el, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left shall fall by the sword.

verses.raw: And you shall do as I have done: you shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.
verses.text: And you shall do as I have done: you shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.

verses.raw: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: you shall not mourn nor weep; but you shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.
verses.text: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: you shall not mourn nor weep; but you shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.

verses.raw: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign: according to all that he has done shall you do: and when this comes, you shall know that I am Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign: according to all that he has done shall you do: and when this comes, you shall know that I am Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Also, you son of Adam, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,
verses.text: Also, you son of Adam, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,

verses.raw: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto you, to cause you to hear it with your ears?
verses.text: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto you, to cause you to hear it with your ears?

verses.raw: In that day shall your mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and you shall speak, and be no more dumb: and you shall be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: In that day shall your mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and you shall speak, and be no more dumb: and you shall be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came again unto me, saying,
verses.text: The word of Yahuah came again unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, set your face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;
verses.text: Son of Adam, set your face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;

verses.raw: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because you saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Yashar'el (Israel), when it was desolate; and against the house of Yahudah (Judah), when they went into captivity;
verses.text: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of Adonai Yahuah; Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Because you saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Yashar'el, when it was desolate; and against the house of Yahudah, when they went into captivity;

verses.raw: Behold, therefore I will deliver you to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in you, and make their dwellings in you: they shall eat your fruit, and they shall drink your milk.
verses.text: Behold, therefore I will deliver you to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in you, and make their dwellings in you: they shall eat your fruit, and they shall drink your milk.

verses.raw: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks: and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks: and you shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because you have clapped your hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all your despite against the land of Yashar'el (Israel);
verses.text: For thus says Adonai Yahuah; Because you have clapped your hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all your despite against the land of Yashar'el;

verses.raw: Behold, therefore I will stretch out my hand upon you, and will deliver you for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut you off from the people, and I will cause you to perish out of the countries: I will destroy you; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Behold, therefore I will stretch out my hand upon you, and will deliver you for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut you off from the people, and I will cause you to perish out of the countries: I will destroy you; and you shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Yahudah (Judah) is like unto all the heathen;
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Yahudah is like unto all the heathen;

verses.raw: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,
verses.text: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,

verses.raw: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.
verses.text: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.

verses.raw: And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because that Edom has dealt against the house of Yahudah (Judah) by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Because that Edom has dealt against the house of Yahudah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will also stretch out my hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; I will also stretch out my hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.

verses.raw: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Yashar'el (Israel): and they shall do in Edom according to my anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Yashar'el: and they shall do in Edom according to my anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy it for the old hatred;
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy it for the old hatred;

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will stretch out my hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I will stretch out my hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.

verses.raw: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.
verses.text: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am Yahuah, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first day of the month, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first day of the month, that the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, because that Tyrus has said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken that was the gates of the people: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished, now she is laid waste:
verses.text: Son of Adam, because that Tyrus has said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken that was the gates of the people: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished, now she is laid waste:

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I am against you, O Tyrus, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes his waves to come up.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I am against you, O Tyrus, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes his waves to come up.

verses.raw: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.
verses.text: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.

verses.raw: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken it, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD): and it shall become a spoil to the nations.
verses.text: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken it, says Adonai Yahuah: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.

verses.raw: And her daughters which are in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And her daughters which are in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people.
verses.text: For thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people.

verses.raw: He shall slay with the sword your daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against you, and cast a mount against you, and lift up the buckler against you.
verses.text: He shall slay with the sword your daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against you, and cast a mount against you, and lift up the buckler against you.

verses.raw: And he shall set engines of war against your walls, and with his axes he shall break down your towers.
verses.text: And he shall set engines of war against your walls, and with his axes he shall break down your towers.

verses.raw: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover you: your walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into your gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.
verses.text: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover you: your walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into your gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.

verses.raw: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all your streets: he shall slay your people by the sword, and your strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.
verses.text: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all your streets: he shall slay your people by the sword, and your strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.

verses.raw: And they shall make a spoil of your riches, and make a prey of your merchandise: and they shall break down your walls, and destroy your pleasant houses: and they shall lay your stones and your timber and your dust in the midst of the water.
verses.text: And they shall make a spoil of your riches, and make a prey of your merchandise: and they shall break down your walls, and destroy your pleasant houses: and they shall lay your stones and your timber and your dust in the midst of the water.

verses.raw: And I will cause the noise of your songs to cease; and the sound of your harps shall be no more heard.
verses.text: And I will cause the noise of your songs to cease; and the sound of your harps shall be no more heard.

verses.raw: And I will make you like the top of a rock: you shall be a place to spread nets upon; you shall be built no more: for I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: And I will make you like the top of a rock: you shall be a place to spread nets upon; you shall be built no more: for I Yahuah have spoken it, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of you?
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of you?

verses.raw: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at every moment, and be astonished at you.
verses.text: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at every moment, and be astonished at you.

verses.raw: And they shall take up a lamentation for you, and say to you, How are you destroyed, that were inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which were strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it!
verses.text: And they shall take up a lamentation for you, and say to you, How are you destroyed, that were inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which were strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it!

verses.raw: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of your fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at your departure.
verses.text: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of your fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at your departure.

verses.raw: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); When I shall make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon you, and great waters shall cover you;
verses.text: For thus says Adonai Yahuah; When I shall make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon you, and great waters shall cover you;

verses.raw: When I shall bring you down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set you in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that you be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;
verses.text: When I shall bring you down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set you in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that you be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;

verses.raw: I will make you a terror, and you shall be no more: though you be sought for, yet shall you never be found again, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: I will make you a terror, and you shall be no more: though you be sought for, yet shall you never be found again, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came again unto me, saying,
verses.text: The word of Yahuah came again unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Now, you son of Adam, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;
verses.text: Now, you son of Adam, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;

verses.raw: And say unto Tyrus, O you that are situate at the entry of the sea, which are a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); O Tyrus, you have said, I am of perfect beauty.
verses.text: And say unto Tyrus, O you that are situate at the entry of the sea, which are a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; O Tyrus, you have said, I am of perfect beauty.

verses.raw: Your borders are in the midst of the seas, your builders have perfected your beauty.
verses.text: Your borders are in the midst of the seas, your builders have perfected your beauty.

verses.raw: They have made all your ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for you.
verses.text: They have made all your ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for you.

verses.raw: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made your oars; the company of the Ashurites have made your benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Chittim.
verses.text: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made your oars; the company of the Ashurites have made your benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Chittim.

verses.raw: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which you spreadest forth to be your sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered you.
verses.text: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which you spreadest forth to be your sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered you.

verses.raw: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were your mariners: your wise men, O Tyrus, that were in you, were your pilots.
verses.text: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were your mariners: your wise men, O Tyrus, that were in you, were your pilots.

verses.raw: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in you your calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in you to occupy your merchandise.
verses.text: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in you your calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in you to occupy your merchandise.

verses.raw: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in your army, your men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in you; they set forth your comeliness.
verses.text: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in your army, your men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in you; they set forth your comeliness.

verses.raw: The men of Arvad with your army were upon your walls round about, and the Gammadims were in your towers: they hanged their shields upon your walls round about; they have made your beauty perfect.
verses.text: The men of Arvad with your army were upon your walls round about, and the Gammadims were in your towers: they hanged their shields upon your walls round about; they have made your beauty perfect.

verses.raw: Tarshish was your merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in your fairs.
verses.text: Tarshish was your merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in your fairs.

verses.raw: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were your merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in your market.
verses.text: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were your merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in your market.

verses.raw: They of the house of Togarmah traded in your fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.
verses.text: They of the house of Togarmah traded in your fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.

verses.raw: The men of Dedan were your merchants; many isles were the merchandise of your hand: they brought you for a present horns of ivory and ebony.
verses.text: The men of Dedan were your merchants; many isles were the merchandise of your hand: they brought you for a present horns of ivory and ebony.

verses.raw: Syria was your merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of your making: they occupied in your fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.
verses.text: Syria was your merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of your making: they occupied in your fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.

verses.raw: Yahudah (Judah), and the land of Yashar'el (Israel), they were your merchants: they traded in your market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.
verses.text: Yahudah, and the land of Yashar'el, they were your merchants: they traded in your market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.

verses.raw: Damascus was your merchant in the multitude of the wares of your making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
verses.text: Damascus was your merchant in the multitude of the wares of your making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

verses.raw: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in your fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in your market.
verses.text: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in your fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in your market.

verses.raw: Dedan was your merchant in precious clothes for chariots.
verses.text: Dedan was your merchant in precious clothes for chariots.

verses.raw: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with you in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these were they your merchants.
verses.text: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with you in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these were they your merchants.

verses.raw: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they were your merchants: they occupied in your fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.
verses.text: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they were your merchants: they occupied in your fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.

verses.raw: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad, were your merchants.
verses.text: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad, were your merchants.

verses.raw: These were your merchants in all sorts of things, in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among your merchandise.
verses.text: These were your merchants in all sorts of things, in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among your merchandise.

verses.raw: The ships of Tarshish did sing of you in your market: and you were replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.
verses.text: The ships of Tarshish did sing of you in your market: and you were replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.

verses.raw: Your rowers have brought you into great waters: the east wind has broken you in the midst of the seas.
verses.text: Your rowers have brought you into great waters: the east wind has broken you in the midst of the seas.

verses.raw: Your riches, and your fairs, your merchandise, your mariners, and your pilots, your calkers, and the occupiers of your merchandise, and all your men of war, that are in you, and in all your company which is in the midst of you, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of your ruin.
verses.text: Your riches, and your fairs, your merchandise, your mariners, and your pilots, your calkers, and the occupiers of your merchandise, and all your men of war, that are in you, and in all your company which is in the midst of you, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of your ruin.

verses.raw: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of your pilots.
verses.text: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of your pilots.

verses.raw: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;
verses.text: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;

verses.raw: And shall cause their voice to be heard against you, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:
verses.text: And shall cause their voice to be heard against you, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:

verses.raw: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for you, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for you with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing.
verses.text: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for you, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for you with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing.

verses.raw: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for you, and lament over you, saying, What city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?
verses.text: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for you, and lament over you, saying, What city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?

verses.raw: When your wares went forth out of the seas, you filledst many people; you did enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of your riches and of your merchandise.
verses.text: When your wares went forth out of the seas, you filledst many people; you did enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of your riches and of your merchandise.

verses.raw: In the time when you shall be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters your merchandise and all your company in the midst of you shall fall.
verses.text: In the time when you shall be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters your merchandise and all your company in the midst of you shall fall.

verses.raw: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at you, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in their countenance.
verses.text: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at you, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in their countenance.

verses.raw: The merchants among the people shall hiss at you; you shall be a terror, and never shall be any more.
verses.text: The merchants among the people shall hiss at you; you shall be a terror, and never shall be any more.

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came again unto me, saying,
verses.text: The word of Yahuah came again unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, I am a Elohim (God), I sit in the seat of Elohim (God), in the midst of the seas; yet you are a man, and not Elohim (God), though you set your heart as the heart of Elohim (God):
verses.text: Son of Adam, say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, I am a Elohim, I sit in the seat of Elohim, in the midst of the seas; yet you are a man, and not Elohim, though you set your heart as the heart of Elohim:

verses.raw: Behold, you are wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from you:
verses.text: Behold, you are wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from you:

verses.raw: With your wisdom and with your understanding you have gotten you riches, and have gotten gold and silver into your treasures:
verses.text: With your wisdom and with your understanding you have gotten you riches, and have gotten gold and silver into your treasures:

verses.raw: By your great wisdom and by your traffick have you increased your riches, and your heart is lifted up because of your riches:
verses.text: By your great wisdom and by your traffick have you increased your riches, and your heart is lifted up because of your riches:

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because you have set your heart as the heart of Elohim (God);
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Because you have set your heart as the heart of Elohim;

verses.raw: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon you, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom, and they shall defile your brightness.
verses.text: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon you, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom, and they shall defile your brightness.

verses.raw: They shall bring you down to the pit, and you shall die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas.
verses.text: They shall bring you down to the pit, and you shall die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas.

verses.raw: Will you yet say before him that slayeth you, I am Elohim (God)? but you shall be a man, and no Elohim (God), in the hand of him that slayeth you.
verses.text: Will you yet say before him that slayeth you, I am Elohim? but you shall be a man, and no Elohim, in the hand of him that slayeth you.

verses.raw: You shall die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: You shall die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Moreover the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); You sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
verses.text: Son of Adam, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; You sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

verses.raw: You have been in Eden the garden of Elohim (God); every precious stone was your covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of your tabrets and of your pipes was prepared in you in the day that you were created.
verses.text: You have been in Eden the garden of Elohim; every precious stone was your covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of your tabrets and of your pipes was prepared in you in the day that you were created.

verses.raw: You are the anointed cherub that covers; and I have set you so: you were upon the holy mountain of Elohim (God); you have walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.text: You are the anointed cherub that covers; and I have set you so: you were upon the holy mountain of Elohim; you have walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.

verses.raw: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created, till iniquity was found in you.
verses.text: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created, till iniquity was found in you.

verses.raw: By the multitude of your merchandise they have filled the midst of you with violence, and you have sinned: therefore I will cast you as profane out of the mountain of Elohim (God): and I will destroy you, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.text: By the multitude of your merchandise they have filled the midst of you with violence, and you have sinned: therefore I will cast you as profane out of the mountain of Elohim: and I will destroy you, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.

verses.raw: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty, you have corrupted your wisdom by reason of your brightness: I will cast you to the ground, I will lay you before kings, that they may behold you.
verses.text: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty, you have corrupted your wisdom by reason of your brightness: I will cast you to the ground, I will lay you before kings, that they may behold you.

verses.raw: You have defiled your sanctuaries by the multitude of your iniquities, by the iniquity of your traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of you, it shall devour you, and I will bring you to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold you.
verses.text: You have defiled your sanctuaries by the multitude of your iniquities, by the iniquity of your traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of you, it shall devour you, and I will bring you to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold you.

verses.raw: All they that know you among the people shall be astonished at you: you shall be a terror, and never shall you be any more.
verses.text: All they that know you among the people shall be astonished at you: you shall be a terror, and never shall you be any more.

verses.raw: Again the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Again the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, set your face against Zidon, and prophesy against it,
verses.text: Son of Adam, set your face against Zidon, and prophesy against it,

verses.raw: And say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I am against you, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of you: and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.
verses.text: And say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I am against you, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of you: and they shall know that I am Yahuah, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.

verses.raw: For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel), nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I am Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Yashar'el, nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I am Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); When I shall have gathered the house of Yashar'el (Israel) from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; When I shall have gathered the house of Yashar'el from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.

verses.raw: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God).
verses.text: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am Yahuah their Elohim.

verses.raw: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, in the twelfth day of the month, the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, in the twelfth day of the month, the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt:
verses.text: Son of Adam, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt:

verses.raw: Speak, and say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lies in the midst of his rivers, which has said, My river is my own, and I have made it for myself.
verses.text: Speak, and say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lies in the midst of his rivers, which has said, My river is my own, and I have made it for myself.

verses.raw: But I will put hooks in your jaws, and I will cause the fish of your rivers to stick unto your scales, and I will bring you up out of the midst of your rivers, and all the fish of your rivers shall stick unto your scales.
verses.text: But I will put hooks in your jaws, and I will cause the fish of your rivers to stick unto your scales, and I will bring you up out of the midst of your rivers, and all the fish of your rivers shall stick unto your scales.

verses.raw: And I will leave you thrown into the wilderness, you and all the fish of your rivers: you shall fall upon the open fields; you shall not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given you for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven.
verses.text: And I will leave you thrown into the wilderness, you and all the fish of your rivers: you shall fall upon the open fields; you shall not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given you for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven.

verses.raw: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am Yahuah, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: When they took hold of you by your hand, you did break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon you, you brakest, and made all their loins to be at a stand.
verses.text: When they took hold of you by your hand, you did break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon you, you brakest, and made all their loins to be at a stand.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will bring a sword upon you, and cut off man and beast out of you.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I will bring a sword upon you, and cut off man and beast out of you.

verses.raw: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD): because he has said, The river is mine, and I have made it.
verses.text: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste; and they shall know that I am Yahuah: because he has said, The river is mine, and I have made it.

verses.raw: Behold, therefore I am against you, and against your rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia.
verses.text: Behold, therefore I am against you, and against your rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia.

verses.raw: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.
verses.text: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.

verses.raw: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
verses.text: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

verses.raw: Yet thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered:
verses.text: Yet thus says Adonai Yahuah; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered:

verses.raw: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.
verses.text: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.

verses.raw: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.
verses.text: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.

verses.raw: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), which brings their iniquity to remembrance, when they shall look after them: but they shall know that I am Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Yashar'el, which brings their iniquity to remembrance, when they shall look after them: but they shall know that I am Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyrus, for the service that he had served against it:
verses.text: Son of Adam, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyrus, for the service that he had served against it:

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall take her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall take her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.

verses.raw: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) to bud forth, and I will give you the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Yashar'el to bud forth, and I will give you the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came again unto me, saying,
verses.text: The word of Yahuah came again unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, prophesy and say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Howl you, Woe worth the day!
verses.text: Son of Adam, prophesy and say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Howl you, Woe worth the day!

verses.raw: For the day is near, even the day of Yahuah (LORD) is near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.
verses.text: For the day is near, even the day of Yahuah is near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.

verses.raw: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.
verses.text: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.

verses.raw: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.
verses.text: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.
verses.text: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.

verses.raw: And they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I have set a fire in Egypt, and when all her helpers shall be destroyed.
verses.text: And they shall know that I am Yahuah, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and when all her helpers shall be destroyed.

verses.raw: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid, and great pain shall come upon them, as in the day of Egypt: for, lo, it comes.
verses.text: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid, and great pain shall come upon them, as in the day of Egypt: for, lo, it comes.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.

verses.raw: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land: and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.
verses.text: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land: and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.

verses.raw: And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked: and I will make the land waste, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it.
verses.text: And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked: and I will make the land waste, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I Yahuah have spoken it.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause their images to cease out of Noph; and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause their images to cease out of Noph; and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments in No.
verses.text: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments in No.

verses.raw: And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.
verses.text: And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.

verses.raw: And I will set fire in Egypt: Sin shall have great pain, and No shall be rent asunder, and Noph shall have distresses daily.
verses.text: And I will set fire in Egypt: Sin shall have great pain, and No shall be rent asunder, and Noph shall have distresses daily.

verses.raw: The young men of Aven and of Pi-beseth shall fall by the sword: and these cities shall go into captivity.
verses.text: The young men of Aven and of Pi-beseth shall fall by the sword: and these cities shall go into captivity.

verses.raw: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt: and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.
verses.text: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt: and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.

verses.raw: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt: and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt: and they shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, that the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it shall not be bound up to be healed, to put a roller to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.
verses.text: Son of Adam, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it shall not be bound up to be healed, to put a roller to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

verses.raw: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
verses.text: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

verses.raw: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break Pharaoh’s arms, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man.
verses.text: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break Pharaoh’s arms, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man.
