verses.raw: But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.
verses.text: But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I am Yahuah, when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them among the countries; and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them among the countries; and they shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, that the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude; Whom are you like in your greatness?
verses.text: Son of Adam, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude; Whom are you like in your greatness?

verses.raw: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a shadowing shroud, and of an high stature; and his top was among the thick boughs.
verses.text: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a shadowing shroud, and of an high stature; and his top was among the thick boughs.

verses.raw: The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants, and sent out her little rivers unto all the trees of the field.
verses.text: The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants, and sent out her little rivers unto all the trees of the field.

verses.raw: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters, when he shot forth.
verses.text: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters, when he shot forth.

verses.raw: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.
verses.text: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.

verses.raw: Thus was he fair in his greatness, in the length of his branches: for his root was by great waters.
verses.text: Thus was he fair in his greatness, in the length of his branches: for his root was by great waters.

verses.raw: The cedars in the garden of Elohim (God) could not hide him: the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chesnut trees were not like his branches; nor any tree in the garden of Elohim (God) was like unto him in his beauty.
verses.text: The cedars in the garden of Elohim could not hide him: the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chesnut trees were not like his branches; nor any tree in the garden of Elohim was like unto him in his beauty.

verses.raw: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of Elohim (God), envied him.
verses.text: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of Elohim, envied him.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because you have lifted up thyself in height, and he has shot up his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Because you have lifted up thyself in height, and he has shot up his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;

verses.raw: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen; he shall surely deal with him: I have driven him out for his wickedness.
verses.text: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen; he shall surely deal with him: I have driven him out for his wickedness.

verses.raw: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.
verses.text: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.

verses.raw: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:
verses.text: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:

verses.raw: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height, neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs, neither their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.
verses.text: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height, neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs, neither their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the floods thereof, and the great waters were stayed: and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the floods thereof, and the great waters were stayed: and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

verses.raw: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth.
verses.text: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth.

verses.raw: They also went down into hell with him unto them that be slain with the sword; and they that were his arm, that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen.
verses.text: They also went down into hell with him unto them that be slain with the sword; and they that were his arm, that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen.

verses.raw: To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shall you be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: you shall lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shall you be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: you shall lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, that the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, You are like a young lion of the nations, and you are as a whale in the seas: and you came forth with your rivers, and troubledst the waters with your feet, and fouledst their rivers.
verses.text: Son of Adam, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, You are like a young lion of the nations, and you are as a whale in the seas: and you came forth with your rivers, and troubledst the waters with your feet, and fouledst their rivers.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will therefore spread out my net over you with a company of many people; and they shall bring you up in my net.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; I will therefore spread out my net over you with a company of many people; and they shall bring you up in my net.

verses.raw: Then will I leave you upon the land, I will cast you forth upon the open field, and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon you, and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with you.
verses.text: Then will I leave you upon the land, I will cast you forth upon the open field, and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon you, and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with you.

verses.raw: And I will lay your flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with your height.
verses.text: And I will lay your flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with your height.

verses.raw: I will also water with your blood the land wherein you swimmest, even to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of you.
verses.text: I will also water with your blood the land wherein you swimmest, even to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of you.

verses.raw: And when I shall put you out, I will cover the heaven, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.
verses.text: And when I shall put you out, I will cover the heaven, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.

verses.raw: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over you, and set darkness upon your land, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over you, and set darkness upon your land, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: I will also vex the hearts of many people, when I shall bring your destruction among the nations, into the countries which you have not known.
verses.text: I will also vex the hearts of many people, when I shall bring your destruction among the nations, into the countries which you have not known.

verses.raw: Yea, I will make many people amazed at you, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for you, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of your fall.
verses.text: Yea, I will make many people amazed at you, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for you, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of your fall.

verses.raw: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon you.
verses.text: For thus says Adonai Yahuah; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon you.

verses.raw: By the swords of the mighty will I cause your multitude to fall, the terrible of the nations, all of them: and they shall spoil the pomp of Egypt, and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.
verses.text: By the swords of the mighty will I cause your multitude to fall, the terrible of the nations, all of them: and they shall spoil the pomp of Egypt, and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.

verses.raw: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.
verses.text: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.

verses.raw: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate, and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate, and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: This is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament her: the daughters of the nations shall lament her: they shall lament for her, even for Egypt, and for all her multitude, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: This is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament her: the daughters of the nations shall lament her: they shall lament for her, even for Egypt, and for all her multitude, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, that the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.
verses.text: Son of Adam, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.

verses.raw: Whom do you pass in beauty? go down, and be you laid with the uncircumcised.
verses.text: Whom do you pass in beauty? go down, and be you laid with the uncircumcised.

verses.raw: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword: draw her and all her multitudes.
verses.text: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword: draw her and all her multitudes.

verses.raw: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie uncircumcised, slain by the sword.
verses.text: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie uncircumcised, slain by the sword.

verses.raw: Asshur is there and all her company: his graves are about him: all of them slain, fallen by the sword:
verses.text: Asshur is there and all her company: his graves are about him: all of them slain, fallen by the sword:

verses.raw: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit, and her company is round about her grave: all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which caused terror in the land of the living.
verses.text: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit, and her company is round about her grave: all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which caused terror in the land of the living.

verses.raw: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, which caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.
verses.text: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, which caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.

verses.raw: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword: though their terror was caused in the land of the living, yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of them that be slain.
verses.text: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword: though their terror was caused in the land of the living, yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of them that be slain.

verses.raw: There is Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though they caused their terror in the land of the living.
verses.text: There is Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though they caused their terror in the land of the living.

verses.raw: And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised, which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war: and they have laid their swords under their heads, but their iniquities shall be upon their bones, though they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.
verses.text: And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised, which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war: and they have laid their swords under their heads, but their iniquities shall be upon their bones, though they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.

verses.raw: Yea, you shall be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shall lie with them that are slain with the sword.
verses.text: Yea, you shall be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shall lie with them that are slain with the sword.

verses.raw: There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, which with their might are laid by them that were slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.
verses.text: There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, which with their might are laid by them that were slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.

verses.raw: There be the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, which are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.
verses.text: There be the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, which are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.

verses.raw: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living: and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living: and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Again the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Again the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, speak to the children of your people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, if the people of the land take a man of their coasts, and set him for their watchman:
verses.text: Son of Adam, speak to the children of your people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, if the people of the land take a man of their coasts, and set him for their watchman:

verses.raw: If when he sees the sword come upon the land, he blow the trumpet, and warn the people;
verses.text: If when he sees the sword come upon the land, he blow the trumpet, and warn the people;

verses.raw: Then whosoever hears the sound of the trumpet, and takes not warning; if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.
verses.text: Then whosoever hears the sound of the trumpet, and takes not warning; if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.

verses.raw: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him. But he that takes warning shall deliver his soul.
verses.text: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him. But he that takes warning shall deliver his soul.

verses.raw: But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned; if the sword come, and take any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman’s hand.
verses.text: But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned; if the sword come, and take any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman’s hand.

verses.raw: So you, O son of Adam, I have set you a watchman unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel); therefore you shall hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.
verses.text: So you, O son of Adam, I have set you a watchman unto the house of Yashar'el; therefore you shall hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.

verses.raw: When I say unto the wicked, O wicked man, you shall surely die; if you do not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at your hand.
verses.text: When I say unto the wicked, O wicked man, you shall surely die; if you do not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at your hand.

verses.raw: Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it; if he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.
verses.text: Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it; if he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.

verses.raw: Therefore, O you son of Adam, speak unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel); Thus you speak, saying, If our transgressions and our sins be upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?
verses.text: Therefore, O you son of Adam, speak unto the house of Yashar'el; Thus you speak, saying, If our transgressions and our sins be upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?

verses.raw: Say unto them, As I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn you, turn you from your evil ways; for why will you die, O house of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: Say unto them, As I live, says Adonai Yahuah, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn you, turn you from your evil ways; for why will you die, O house of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: Therefore, you son of Adam, say unto the children of your people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression: as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turns from his wickedness; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his righteousness in the day that he sins.
verses.text: Therefore, you son of Adam, say unto the children of your people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression: as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turns from his wickedness; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his righteousness in the day that he sins.

verses.raw: When I shall say to the righteous, that he shall surely live; if he trust to his own righteousness, and commit iniquity, all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered; but for his iniquity that he has committed, he shall die for it.
verses.text: When I shall say to the righteous, that he shall surely live; if he trust to his own righteousness, and commit iniquity, all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered; but for his iniquity that he has committed, he shall die for it.

verses.raw: Again, when I say unto the wicked, You shall surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;
verses.text: Again, when I say unto the wicked, You shall surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;

verses.raw: If the wicked restore the pledge, give again that he had robbed, walk in the statutes of life, without committing iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verses.text: If the wicked restore the pledge, give again that he had robbed, walk in the statutes of life, without committing iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.

verses.raw: None of his sins that he has committed shall be mentioned unto him: he has done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.
verses.text: None of his sins that he has committed shall be mentioned unto him: he has done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.

verses.raw: Yet the children of your people say, The way of Adonai (Lord) is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.
verses.text: Yet the children of your people say, The way of Adonai is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.

verses.raw: When the righteous turns from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, he shall even die thereby.
verses.text: When the righteous turns from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, he shall even die thereby.

verses.raw: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.
verses.text: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.

verses.raw: Yet you say, The way of Adonai (Lord) is not equal. O you house of Yashar'el (Israel), I will judge you every one after his ways.
verses.text: Yet you say, The way of Adonai is not equal. O you house of Yashar'el, I will judge you every one after his ways.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying, The city is smitten.
verses.text: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying, The city is smitten.

verses.raw: Now the hand of Yahuah (LORD) was upon me in the evening, afore he that was escaped came; and had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.
verses.text: Now the hand of Yahuah was upon me in the evening, afore he that was escaped came; and had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.

verses.raw: Then the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Then the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Yashar'el (Israel) speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we are many; the land is given us for inheritance.
verses.text: Son of Adam, they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Yashar'el speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we are many; the land is given us for inheritance.

verses.raw: Wherefore say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes toward your idols, and shed blood: and shall you possess the land?
verses.text: Wherefore say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes toward your idols, and shed blood: and shall you possess the land?

verses.raw: You stand upon your sword, you work abomination, and you defile every one his neighbour’s wife: and shall you possess the land?
verses.text: You stand upon your sword, you work abomination, and you defile every one his neighbour’s wife: and shall you possess the land?

verses.raw: Say you thus unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); As I live, surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by the sword, and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured, and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.
verses.text: Say you thus unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; As I live, surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by the sword, and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured, and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.

verses.raw: For I will lay the land most desolate, and the pomp of her strength shall cease; and the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel) shall be desolate, that none shall pass through.
verses.text: For I will lay the land most desolate, and the pomp of her strength shall cease; and the mountains of Yashar'el shall be desolate, that none shall pass through.

verses.raw: Then shall they know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed.
verses.text: Then shall they know that I am Yahuah, when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed.

verses.raw: Also, you son of Adam, the children of your people still are talking against you by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that comes forth from Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Also, you son of Adam, the children of your people still are talking against you by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that comes forth from Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they come unto you as the people comes, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love, but their heart goes after their covetousness.
verses.text: And they come unto you as the people comes, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love, but their heart goes after their covetousness.

verses.raw: And, lo, you are unto them as a very lovely song of one that has a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear your words, but they do them not.
verses.text: And, lo, you are unto them as a very lovely song of one that has a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear your words, but they do them not.

verses.raw: And when this comes to pass, (lo, it will come,) then shall they know that a prophet has been among them.
verses.text: And when this comes to pass, (lo, it will come,) then shall they know that a prophet has been among them.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, prophesy against the shepherds of Yashar'el (Israel), prophesy, and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) unto the shepherds; Woe be to the shepherds of Yashar'el (Israel) that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?
verses.text: Son of Adam, prophesy against the shepherds of Yashar'el, prophesy, and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah unto the shepherds; Woe be to the shepherds of Yashar'el that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?

verses.raw: You eat the fat, and you clothe you with the wool, you kill them that are fed: but you feed not the flock.
verses.text: You eat the fat, and you clothe you with the wool, you kill them that are fed: but you feed not the flock.

verses.raw: The diseased have you not strengthened, neither have you healed that which was sick, neither have you bound up that which was broken, neither have you brought again that which was driven away, neither have you sought that which was lost; but with force and with cruelty have you ruled them.
verses.text: The diseased have you not strengthened, neither have you healed that which was sick, neither have you bound up that which was broken, neither have you brought again that which was driven away, neither have you sought that which was lost; but with force and with cruelty have you ruled them.

verses.raw: And they were scattered, because there is no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.
verses.text: And they were scattered, because there is no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.

verses.raw: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth, and none did search or seek after them.
verses.text: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth, and none did search or seek after them.

verses.raw: Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of Yahuah (LORD);
verses.text: Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of Yahuah;

verses.raw: As I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), surely because my flock became a prey, and my flock became meat to every beast of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock;
verses.text: As I live, says Adonai Yahuah, surely because my flock became a prey, and my flock became meat to every beast of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock;

verses.raw: Therefore, O you shepherds, hear the word of Yahuah (LORD);
verses.text: Therefore, O you shepherds, hear the word of Yahuah;

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.

verses.raw: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.
verses.text: For thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.

verses.raw: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
verses.text: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

verses.raw: And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land, and feed them upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel) by the rivers, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
verses.text: And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land, and feed them upon the mountains of Yashar'el by the rivers, and in all the inhabited places of the country.

verses.raw: I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Yashar'el (Israel) shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Yashar'el shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.
verses.text: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.

verses.raw: And as for you, O my flock, thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats.
verses.text: And as for you, O my flock, thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats.

verses.raw: Seems it a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures? and to have drunk of the deep waters, but you must foul the residue with your feet?
verses.text: Seems it a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures? and to have drunk of the deep waters, but you must foul the residue with your feet?

verses.raw: And as for my flock, they eat that which you have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet.
verses.text: And as for my flock, they eat that which you have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) unto them; Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah unto them; Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle.

verses.raw: Because you have thrust with side and with shoulder, and pushed all the diseased with your horns, till you have scattered them abroad;
verses.text: Because you have thrust with side and with shoulder, and pushed all the diseased with your horns, till you have scattered them abroad;

verses.raw: Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.
verses.text: Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.

verses.raw: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.
verses.text: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.

verses.raw: And I Yahuah (LORD) will be their Elohim (God), and my servant David a prince among them; I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it.
verses.text: And I Yahuah will be their Elohim, and my servant David a prince among them; I Yahuah have spoken it.

verses.raw: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land: and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.
verses.text: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land: and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.

verses.raw: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.
verses.text: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.

verses.raw: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase, and they shall be safe in their land, and shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them.
verses.text: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase, and they shall be safe in their land, and shall know that I am Yahuah, when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them.

verses.raw: And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, neither shall the beast of the land devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.text: And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, neither shall the beast of the land devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and none shall make them afraid.

verses.raw: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the heathen any more.
verses.text: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the heathen any more.

verses.raw: Thus shall they know that I Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God) am with them, and that they, even the house of Yashar'el (Israel), are my people, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Thus shall they know that I Yahuah their Elohim am with them, and that they, even the house of Yashar'el, are my people, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: And you my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men, and I am your Elohim (God), says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: And you my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men, and I am your Elohim, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Moreover the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, set your face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
verses.text: Son of Adam, set your face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

verses.raw: And say unto it, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, O mount Seir, I am against you, and I will stretch out my hand against you, and I will make you most desolate.
verses.text: And say unto it, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, O mount Seir, I am against you, and I will stretch out my hand against you, and I will make you most desolate.

verses.raw: I will lay your cities waste, and you shall be desolate, and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I will lay your cities waste, and you shall be desolate, and you shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Because you have had a perpetual hatred, and have shed the blood of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end:
verses.text: Because you have had a perpetual hatred, and have shed the blood of the children of Yashar'el by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end:

verses.raw: Therefore, as I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), I will prepare you unto blood, and blood shall pursue you: sith you have not hated blood, even blood shall pursue you.
verses.text: Therefore, as I live, says Adonai Yahuah, I will prepare you unto blood, and blood shall pursue you: sith you have not hated blood, even blood shall pursue you.

verses.raw: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passes out and him that returns.
verses.text: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passes out and him that returns.

verses.raw: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in your hills, and in your valleys, and in all your rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.
verses.text: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in your hills, and in your valleys, and in all your rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.

verses.raw: I will make you perpetual desolations, and your cities shall not return: and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I will make you perpetual desolations, and your cities shall not return: and you shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Because you have said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas Yahuah (LORD) was there:
verses.text: Because you have said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas Yahuah was there:

verses.raw: Therefore, as I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), I will even do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have used out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged you.
verses.text: Therefore, as I live, says Adonai Yahuah, I will even do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have used out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged you.

verses.raw: And you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), and that I have heard all your blasphemies which you have spoken against the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.
verses.text: And you shall know that I am Yahuah, and that I have heard all your blasphemies which you have spoken against the mountains of Yashar'el, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.

verses.raw: Thus with your mouth you have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.
verses.text: Thus with your mouth you have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.

verses.raw: As you did rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), because it was desolate, so will I do unto you: you shall be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it: and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: As you did rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Yashar'el, because it was desolate, so will I do unto you: you shall be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it: and they shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Also, you son of Adam, prophesy unto the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel), and say, You mountains of Yashar'el (Israel), hear the word of Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: Also, you son of Adam, prophesy unto the mountains of Yashar'el, and say, You mountains of Yashar'el, hear the word of Yahuah:

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because the enemy has said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession:
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Because the enemy has said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession:

verses.raw: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that you might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and you are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy of the people:
verses.text: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that you might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and you are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy of the people:

verses.raw: Therefore, you mountains of Yashar'el (Israel), hear the word of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about;
verses.text: Therefore, you mountains of Yashar'el, hear the word of Adonai Yahuah; Thus says Adonai Yahuah to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about;

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.

verses.raw: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because you have borne the shame of the heathen:
verses.text: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Yashar'el, and say unto the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because you have borne the shame of the heathen:

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I have lifted up my hand, Surely the heathen that are about you, they shall bear their shame.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; I have lifted up my hand, Surely the heathen that are about you, they shall bear their shame.

verses.raw: But you, O mountains of Yashar'el (Israel), you shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Yashar'el (Israel); for they are at hand to come.
verses.text: But you, O mountains of Yashar'el, you shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Yashar'el; for they are at hand to come.

verses.raw: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and you shall be tilled and sown:
verses.text: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and you shall be tilled and sown:

verses.raw: And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Yashar'el (Israel), even all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be builded:
verses.text: And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Yashar'el, even all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be builded:

verses.raw: And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings: and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings: and you shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Yashar'el (Israel); and they shall possess you, and you shall be their inheritance, and you shall no more henceforth bereave them of men.
verses.text: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Yashar'el; and they shall possess you, and you shall be their inheritance, and you shall no more henceforth bereave them of men.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Because they say unto you, You land devourest up men, and have bereaved your nations;
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Because they say unto you, You land devourest up men, and have bereaved your nations;

verses.raw: Therefore you shall devour men no more, neither bereave your nations any more, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Therefore you shall devour men no more, neither bereave your nations any more, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Neither will I cause men to hear in you the shame of the heathen any more, neither shall you bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shall you cause your nations to fall any more, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Neither will I cause men to hear in you the shame of the heathen any more, neither shall you bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shall you cause your nations to fall any more, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Moreover the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, when the house of Yashar'el (Israel) dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.
verses.text: Son of Adam, when the house of Yashar'el dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.

verses.raw: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it:
verses.text: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it:

verses.raw: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.
verses.text: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.

verses.raw: And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of Yahuah (LORD), and are gone forth out of his land.
verses.text: And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of Yahuah, and are gone forth out of his land.

verses.raw: But I had pity for my holy name, which the house of Yashar'el (Israel) had profaned among the heathen, whither they went.
verses.text: But I had pity for my holy name, which the house of Yashar'el had profaned among the heathen, whither they went.

verses.raw: Therefore say unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel), Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I do not this for your sakes, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), but for my holy name’s sake, which you have profaned among the heathen, whither you went.
verses.text: Therefore say unto the house of Yashar'el, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; I do not this for your sakes, O house of Yashar'el, but for my holy name’s sake, which you have profaned among the heathen, whither you went.

verses.raw: And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which you have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.
verses.text: And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which you have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I am Yahuah, says Adonai Yahuah, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.

verses.raw: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.
verses.text: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.

verses.raw: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and you shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.
verses.text: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and you shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.

verses.raw: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.
verses.text: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.

verses.raw: And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and you shall keep my judgments, and do them.
verses.text: And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and you shall keep my judgments, and do them.

verses.raw: And you shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and you shall be my people, and I will be your Elohim (God).
verses.text: And you shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and you shall be my people, and I will be your Elohim.

verses.raw: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.
verses.text: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.

verses.raw: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that you shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.
verses.text: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that you shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.

verses.raw: Then shall you remember your own evil ways, and your doings that were not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
verses.text: Then shall you remember your own evil ways, and your doings that were not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

verses.raw: Not for your sakes do I this, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Not for your sakes do I this, says Adonai Yahuah, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.

verses.raw: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.
verses.text: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.

verses.raw: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced, and are inhabited.
verses.text: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced, and are inhabited.

verses.raw: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I Yahuah (LORD) build the ruined places, and plant that that was desolate: I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it, and I will do it.
verses.text: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I Yahuah build the ruined places, and plant that that was desolate: I Yahuah have spoken it, and I will do it.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Yashar'el (Israel), to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Yashar'el, to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.

verses.raw: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: The hand of Yahuah (LORD) was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of Yahuah (LORD), and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones,
verses.text: The hand of Yahuah was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of Yahuah, and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones,

verses.raw: And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.
verses.text: And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.

verses.raw: And he said unto me, Son of Adam, can these bones live? And I answered, O Adonai (Lord) GOD, you know.
verses.text: And he said unto me, Son of Adam, can these bones live? And I answered, O Adonai GOD, you know.

verses.raw: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O you dry bones, hear the word of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O you dry bones, hear the word of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you shall live:
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you shall live:

verses.raw: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you shall live; and you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you shall live; and you shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.
verses.text: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.

verses.raw: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but there was no breath in them.
verses.text: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but there was no breath in them.

verses.raw: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of Adam, and say to the wind, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.
verses.text: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of Adam, and say to the wind, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.

verses.raw: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.
verses.text: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.

verses.raw: Then he said unto me, Son of Adam, these bones are the whole house of Yashar'el (Israel): behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.
verses.text: Then he said unto me, Son of Adam, these bones are the whole house of Yashar'el: behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.

verses.raw: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And you shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,
verses.text: And you shall know that I am Yahuah, when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,

verses.raw: And shall put my spirit in you, and you shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall you know that I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken it, and performed it, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And shall put my spirit in you, and you shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall you know that I Yahuah have spoken it, and performed it, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came again unto me, saying,
verses.text: The word of Yahuah came again unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Moreover, you son of Adam, take you one stick, and write upon it, For Yahudah (Judah), and for the children of Yashar'el (Israel) his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Yashar'el (Israel) his companions:
verses.text: Moreover, you son of Adam, take you one stick, and write upon it, For Yahudah, and for the children of Yashar'el his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Yashar'el his companions:

verses.raw: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in your hand.
verses.text: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in your hand.

verses.raw: And when the children of your people shall speak unto you, saying, Will you not shew us what you meanest by these?
verses.text: And when the children of your people shall speak unto you, saying, Will you not shew us what you meanest by these?

verses.raw: Say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Yahudah (Judah), and make them one stick, and they shall be one in my hand.
verses.text: Say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Yashar'el his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Yahudah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in my hand.

verses.raw: And the sticks whereon you writest shall be in your hand before their eyes.
verses.text: And the sticks whereon you writest shall be in your hand before their eyes.

verses.raw: And say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:
verses.text: And say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

verses.raw: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:
verses.text: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

verses.raw: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their Elohim (God).
verses.text: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their Elohim.

verses.raw: And David my servant shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.
verses.text: And David my servant shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.

verses.raw: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers have dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, even they, and their children, and their children’s children for ever: and my servant David shall be their prince for ever.
verses.text: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers have dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, even they, and their children, and their children’s children for ever: and my servant David shall be their prince for ever.

verses.raw: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.
verses.text: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.

verses.raw: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people.
verses.text: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their Elohim, and they shall be my people.

verses.raw: And the heathen shall know that I Yahuah (LORD) do sanctify Yashar'el (Israel), when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.
verses.text: And the heathen shall know that I Yahuah do sanctify Yashar'el, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Son of Adam, set your face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
verses.text: Son of Adam, set your face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

verses.raw: And say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I am against you, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:
verses.text: And say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I am against you, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:

verses.raw: And I will turn you back, and put hooks into your jaws, and I will bring you forth, and all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts of armour, even a great company with bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords:
verses.text: And I will turn you back, and put hooks into your jaws, and I will bring you forth, and all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts of armour, even a great company with bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords:

verses.raw: Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet:
verses.text: Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet:

verses.raw: Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands: and many people with you.
verses.text: Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands: and many people with you.

verses.raw: Be you prepared, and prepare for thyself, you, and all your company that are assembled unto you, and be you a guard unto them.
verses.text: Be you prepared, and prepare for thyself, you, and all your company that are assembled unto you, and be you a guard unto them.

verses.raw: After many days you shall be visited: in the latter years you shall come into the land that is brought back from the sword, and is gathered out of many people, against the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel), which have been always waste: but it is brought forth out of the nations, and they shall dwell safely all of them.
verses.text: After many days you shall be visited: in the latter years you shall come into the land that is brought back from the sword, and is gathered out of many people, against the mountains of Yashar'el, which have been always waste: but it is brought forth out of the nations, and they shall dwell safely all of them.

verses.raw: You shall ascend and come like a storm, you shall be like a cloud to cover the land, you, and all your bands, and many people with you.
verses.text: You shall ascend and come like a storm, you shall be like a cloud to cover the land, you, and all your bands, and many people with you.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); It shall also come to pass, that at the same time shall things come into your mind, and you shall think an evil thought:
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; It shall also come to pass, that at the same time shall things come into your mind, and you shall think an evil thought:

verses.raw: And you shall say, I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will go to them that are at rest, that dwell safely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,
verses.text: And you shall say, I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will go to them that are at rest, that dwell safely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,

verses.raw: To take a spoil, and to take a prey; to turn your hand upon the desolate places that are now inhabited, and upon the people that are gathered out of the nations, which have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the midst of the land.
verses.text: To take a spoil, and to take a prey; to turn your hand upon the desolate places that are now inhabited, and upon the people that are gathered out of the nations, which have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the midst of the land.

verses.raw: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the young lions thereof, shall say unto you, Are you come to take a spoil? have you gathered your company to take a prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take a great spoil?
verses.text: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the young lions thereof, shall say unto you, Are you come to take a spoil? have you gathered your company to take a prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take a great spoil?

verses.raw: Therefore, son of Adam, prophesy and say unto Gog, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); In that day when my people of Yashar'el (Israel) dwells safely, shall you not know it?
verses.text: Therefore, son of Adam, prophesy and say unto Gog, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; In that day when my people of Yashar'el dwells safely, shall you not know it?

verses.raw: And you shall come from your place out of the north parts, you, and many people with you, all of them riding upon horses, a great company, and a mighty army:
verses.text: And you shall come from your place out of the north parts, you, and many people with you, all of them riding upon horses, a great company, and a mighty army:

verses.raw: And you shall come up against my people of Yashar'el (Israel), as a cloud to cover the land; it shall be in the latter days, and I will bring you against my land, that the heathen may know me, when I shall be sanctified in you, O Gog, before their eyes.
verses.text: And you shall come up against my people of Yashar'el, as a cloud to cover the land; it shall be in the latter days, and I will bring you against my land, that the heathen may know me, when I shall be sanctified in you, O Gog, before their eyes.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Are you he of whom I have spoken in old time by my servants the prophets of Yashar'el (Israel), which prophesied in those days many years that I would bring you against them?
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Are you he of whom I have spoken in old time by my servants the prophets of Yashar'el, which prophesied in those days many years that I would bring you against them?

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Yashar'el (Israel), says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), that my fury shall come up in my face.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Yashar'el, says Adonai Yahuah, that my fury shall come up in my face.

verses.raw: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Yashar'el (Israel);
verses.text: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Yashar'el;

verses.raw: So that the fishes of the sea, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things that creep upon the earth, and all the men that are upon the face of the earth, shall shake at my presence, and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.
verses.text: So that the fishes of the sea, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things that creep upon the earth, and all the men that are upon the face of the earth, shall shake at my presence, and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.

verses.raw: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD): every man’s sword shall be against his brother.
verses.text: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains, says Adonai Yahuah: every man’s sword shall be against his brother.

verses.raw: And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood; and I will rain upon him, and upon his bands, and upon the many people that are with him, an overflowing rain, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.
verses.text: And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood; and I will rain upon him, and upon his bands, and upon the many people that are with him, an overflowing rain, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.

verses.raw: Thus will I magnify myself, and sanctify myself; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
