verses.text: Thus will I magnify myself, and sanctify myself; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Therefore, you son of Adam, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I am against you, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:
verses.text: Therefore, you son of Adam, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, I am against you, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:

verses.raw: And I will turn you back, and leave but the sixth part of you, and will cause you to come up from the north parts, and will bring you upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: And I will turn you back, and leave but the sixth part of you, and will cause you to come up from the north parts, and will bring you upon the mountains of Yashar'el:

verses.raw: And I will smite your bow out of your left hand, and will cause your arrows to fall out of your right hand.
verses.text: And I will smite your bow out of your left hand, and will cause your arrows to fall out of your right hand.

verses.raw: You shall fall upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel), you, and all your bands, and the people that is with you: I will give you unto the ravenous birds of every sort, and to the beasts of the field to be devoured.
verses.text: You shall fall upon the mountains of Yashar'el, you, and all your bands, and the people that is with you: I will give you unto the ravenous birds of every sort, and to the beasts of the field to be devoured.

verses.raw: You shall fall upon the open field: for I have spoken it, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: You shall fall upon the open field: for I have spoken it, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles: and they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles: and they shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Yashar'el (Israel); and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more: and the heathen shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), the Holy One in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Yashar'el; and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more: and the heathen shall know that I am Yahuah, the Holy One in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Behold, it is come, and it is done, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); this is the day whereof I have spoken.
verses.text: Behold, it is come, and it is done, says Adonai Yahuah; this is the day whereof I have spoken.

verses.raw: And they that dwell in the cities of Yashar'el (Israel) shall go forth, and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the handstaves, and the spears, and they shall burn them with fire seven years:
verses.text: And they that dwell in the cities of Yashar'el shall go forth, and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the handstaves, and the spears, and they shall burn them with fire seven years:

verses.raw: So that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests; for they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: So that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests; for they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Yashar'el (Israel), the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea: and it shall stop the noses of the passengers: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude: and they shall call it The valley of Hamon-gog.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Yashar'el, the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea: and it shall stop the noses of the passengers: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude: and they shall call it The valley of Hamon-gog.

verses.raw: And seven months shall the house of Yashar'el (Israel) be burying of them, that they may cleanse the land.
verses.text: And seven months shall the house of Yashar'el be burying of them, that they may cleanse the land.

verses.raw: Yea, all the people of the land shall bury them; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Yea, all the people of the land shall bury them; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they shall sever out men of continual employment, passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall they search.
verses.text: And they shall sever out men of continual employment, passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall they search.

verses.raw: And the passengers that pass through the land, when any sees a man’s bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon-gog.
verses.text: And the passengers that pass through the land, when any sees a man’s bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon-gog.

verses.raw: And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah. Thus shall they cleanse the land.
verses.text: And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah. Thus shall they cleanse the land.

verses.raw: And, you son of Adam, thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Speak unto every feathered fowl, and to every beast of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel), that you may eat flesh, and drink blood.
verses.text: And, you son of Adam, thus says Adonai Yahuah; Speak unto every feathered fowl, and to every beast of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Yashar'el, that you may eat flesh, and drink blood.

verses.raw: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bullocks, all of them fatlings of Bashan.
verses.text: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bullocks, all of them fatlings of Bashan.

verses.raw: And you shall eat fat till you be full, and drink blood till you be drunken, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.
verses.text: And you shall eat fat till you be full, and drink blood till you be drunken, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.

verses.raw: Thus you shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Thus you shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: And I will set my glory among the heathen, and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid upon them.
verses.text: And I will set my glory among the heathen, and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid upon them.

verses.raw: So the house of Yashar'el (Israel) shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God) from that day and forward.
verses.text: So the house of Yashar'el shall know that I am Yahuah their Elohim from that day and forward.

verses.raw: And the heathen shall know that the house of Yashar'el (Israel) went into captivity for their iniquity: because they trespassed against me, therefore hid I my face from them, and gave them into the hand of their enemies: so fell they all by the sword.
verses.text: And the heathen shall know that the house of Yashar'el went into captivity for their iniquity: because they trespassed against me, therefore hid I my face from them, and gave them into the hand of their enemies: so fell they all by the sword.

verses.raw: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them, and hid my face from them.
verses.text: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them, and hid my face from them.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy upon the whole house of Yashar'el (Israel), and will be jealous for my holy name;
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy upon the whole house of Yashar'el, and will be jealous for my holy name;

verses.raw: After that they have borne their shame, and all their trespasses whereby they have trespassed against me, when they dwelt safely in their land, and none made them afraid.
verses.text: After that they have borne their shame, and all their trespasses whereby they have trespassed against me, when they dwelt safely in their land, and none made them afraid.

verses.raw: When I have brought them again from the people, and gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations;
verses.text: When I have brought them again from the people, and gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations;

verses.raw: Then shall they know that I am Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), which caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen: but I have gathered them unto their own land, and have left none of them any more there.
verses.text: Then shall they know that I am Yahuah their Elohim, which caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen: but I have gathered them unto their own land, and have left none of them any more there.

verses.raw: Neither will I hide my face any more from them: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Yashar'el (Israel), says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Neither will I hide my face any more from them: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Yashar'el, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in the selfsame day the hand of Yahuah (LORD) was upon me, and brought me thither.
verses.text: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in the selfsame day the hand of Yahuah was upon me, and brought me thither.

verses.raw: In the visions of Elohim (God) brought he me into the land of Yashar'el (Israel), and set me upon a very high mountain, by which was as the frame of a city on the south.
verses.text: In the visions of Elohim brought he me into the land of Yashar'el, and set me upon a very high mountain, by which was as the frame of a city on the south.

verses.raw: And he brought me thither, and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.
verses.text: And he brought me thither, and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.

verses.raw: And the man said unto me, Son of Adam, behold with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart upon all that I shall shew you; for to the intent that I might shew them unto you are you brought hither: declare all that you see to the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the man said unto me, Son of Adam, behold with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart upon all that I shall shew you; for to the intent that I might shew them unto you are you brought hither: declare all that you see to the house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed of six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth: so he measured the breadth of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.
verses.text: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed of six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth: so he measured the breadth of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

verses.raw: Then came he unto the gate which looks toward the east, and went up the stairs thereof, and measured the threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad; and the other threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad.
verses.text: Then came he unto the gate which looks toward the east, and went up the stairs thereof, and measured the threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad; and the other threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad.

verses.raw: And every little chamber was one reed long, and one reed broad; and between the little chambers were five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within was one reed.
verses.text: And every little chamber was one reed long, and one reed broad; and between the little chambers were five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within was one reed.

verses.raw: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.
verses.text: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.

verses.raw: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was inward.
verses.text: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was inward.

verses.raw: And the little chambers of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side; they three were of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.
verses.text: And the little chambers of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side; they three were of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.

verses.raw: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.
verses.text: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.

verses.raw: The space also before the little chambers was one cubit on this side, and the space was one cubit on that side: and the little chambers were six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
verses.text: The space also before the little chambers was one cubit on this side, and the space was one cubit on that side: and the little chambers were six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.

verses.raw: He measured then the gate from the roof of one little chamber to the roof of another: the breadth was five and twenty cubits, door against door.
verses.text: He measured then the gate from the roof of one little chamber to the roof of another: the breadth was five and twenty cubits, door against door.

verses.raw: He made also posts of threescore cubits, even unto the post of the court round about the gate.

verses.raw: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, shew them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof: and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.
verses.text: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, shew them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof: and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.

verses.raw: This is the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.
verses.text: This is the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.

verses.raw: And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom shall be a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span: and this shall be the higher place of the altar.
verses.text: And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom shall be a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span: and this shall be the higher place of the altar.

verses.raw: And from the bottom upon the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits, and the breadth one cubit.
verses.text: And from the bottom upon the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits, and the breadth one cubit.

verses.raw: So the altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns.
verses.text: So the altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns.

verses.raw: And the altar shall be twelve cubits long, twelve broad, square in the four squares thereof.
verses.text: And the altar shall be twelve cubits long, twelve broad, square in the four squares thereof.

verses.raw: And the settle shall be fourteen cubits long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and the bottom thereof shall be a cubit about; and his stairs shall look toward the east.
verses.text: And the settle shall be fourteen cubits long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and the bottom thereof shall be a cubit about; and his stairs shall look toward the east.

verses.raw: And he said unto me, Son of Adam, thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.
verses.text: And he said unto me, Son of Adam, thus says Adonai Yahuah; These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.

verses.raw: And you shall give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok, which approach unto me, to minister unto me, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), a young bullock for a sin offering.
verses.text: And you shall give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok, which approach unto me, to minister unto me, says Adonai Yahuah, a young bullock for a sin offering.

verses.raw: And you shall take of the blood thereof, and put it on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about: thus shall you cleanse and purge it.
verses.text: And you shall take of the blood thereof, and put it on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about: thus shall you cleanse and purge it.

verses.raw: You shall take the bullock also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.
verses.text: You shall take the bullock also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.

verses.raw: And on the second day you shall offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse it with the bullock.
verses.text: And on the second day you shall offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse it with the bullock.

verses.raw: When you have made an end of cleansing it, you shall offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.
verses.text: When you have made an end of cleansing it, you shall offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.

verses.raw: And you shall offer them before Yahuah (LORD), and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And you shall offer them before Yahuah, and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: Seven days shall you prepare every day a goat for a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.
verses.text: Seven days shall you prepare every day a goat for a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.

verses.raw: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.
verses.text: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.

verses.raw: And when these days are expired, it shall be, that upon the eighth day, and so forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: And when these days are expired, it shall be, that upon the eighth day, and so forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looks toward the east; and it was shut.
verses.text: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looks toward the east; and it was shut.

verses.raw: Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), has entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.
verses.text: Then said Yahuah unto me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because Yahuah, the Elohim of Yashar'el, has entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.

verses.raw: It is for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before Yahuah (LORD); he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.
verses.text: It is for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before Yahuah; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.

verses.raw: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of Yahuah (LORD) filled the house of Yahuah (LORD): and I fell upon my face.
verses.text: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of Yahuah filled the house of Yahuah: and I fell upon my face.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Son of Adam, mark well, and behold with your eyes, and hear with your ears all that I say unto you concerning all the ordinances of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto me, Son of Adam, mark well, and behold with your eyes, and hear with your ears all that I say unto you concerning all the ordinances of the house of Yahuah, and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.

verses.raw: And you shall say to the rebellious, even to the house of Yashar'el (Israel), Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); O you house of Yashar'el (Israel), let it suffice you of all your abominations,
verses.text: And you shall say to the rebellious, even to the house of Yashar'el, Thus says Adonai Yahuah; O you house of Yashar'el, let it suffice you of all your abominations,

verses.raw: In that you have brought into my sanctuary strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it, even my house, when you offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.
verses.text: In that you have brought into my sanctuary strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it, even my house, when you offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.

verses.raw: And you have not kept the charge of my holy things: but you have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.
verses.text: And you have not kept the charge of my holy things: but you have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that is among the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that is among the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And the Levites that are gone away far from me, when Yashar'el (Israel) went astray, which went astray away from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.
verses.text: And the Levites that are gone away far from me, when Yashar'el went astray, which went astray away from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.

verses.raw: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having charge at the gates of the house, and ministering to the house: they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.
verses.text: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having charge at the gates of the house, and ministering to the house: they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.

verses.raw: Because they ministered unto them before their idols, and caused the house of Yashar'el (Israel) to fall into iniquity; therefore have I lifted up my hand against them, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), and they shall bear their iniquity.
verses.text: Because they ministered unto them before their idols, and caused the house of Yashar'el to fall into iniquity; therefore have I lifted up my hand against them, says Adonai Yahuah, and they shall bear their iniquity.

verses.raw: And they shall not come near unto me, to do the office of a priest unto me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy place: but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.
verses.text: And they shall not come near unto me, to do the office of a priest unto me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy place: but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.

verses.raw: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.
verses.text: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.

verses.raw: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister unto me, and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD):
verses.text: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Yashar'el went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister unto me, and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood, says Adonai Yahuah:

verses.raw: They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister unto me, and they shall keep my charge.
verses.text: They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister unto me, and they shall keep my charge.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.

verses.raw: They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causes sweat.
verses.text: They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causes sweat.

verses.raw: And when they go forth into the utter court, even into the utter court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments.
verses.text: And when they go forth into the utter court, even into the utter court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments.

verses.raw: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.
verses.text: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.

verses.raw: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.
verses.text: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.

verses.raw: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away: but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), or a widow that had a priest before.
verses.text: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away: but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Yashar'el, or a widow that had a priest before.

verses.raw: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.
verses.text: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

verses.raw: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment; and they shall judge it according to my judgments: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all my assemblies; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.
verses.text: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment; and they shall judge it according to my judgments: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all my assemblies; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.

verses.raw: And they shall come at no dead person to defile themselves: but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that has had no husband, they may defile themselves.
verses.text: And they shall come at no dead person to defile themselves: but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that has had no husband, they may defile themselves.

verses.raw: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.
verses.text: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.

verses.raw: And in the day that he goes into the sanctuary, unto the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: And in the day that he goes into the sanctuary, unto the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: And it shall be unto them for an inheritance: I am their inheritance: and you shall give them no possession in Yashar'el (Israel): I am their possession.
verses.text: And it shall be unto them for an inheritance: I am their inheritance: and you shall give them no possession in Yashar'el: I am their possession.

verses.raw: They shall eat the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every dedicated thing in Yashar'el (Israel) shall be theirs.
verses.text: They shall eat the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every dedicated thing in Yashar'el shall be theirs.

verses.raw: And the first of all the firstfruits of all things, and every oblation of all, of every sort of your oblations, shall be the priest’s: you shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough, that he may cause the blessing to rest in your house.
verses.text: And the first of all the firstfruits of all things, and every oblation of all, of every sort of your oblations, shall be the priest’s: you shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough, that he may cause the blessing to rest in your house.

verses.raw: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself, or torn, whether it be fowl or beast.
verses.text: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself, or torn, whether it be fowl or beast.

verses.raw: Moreover, when you shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, you shall offer an oblation unto Yahuah (LORD), an holy portion of the land: the length shall be the length of five and twenty thousand reeds, and the breadth shall be ten thousand. This shall be holy in all the borders thereof round about.
verses.text: Moreover, when you shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, you shall offer an oblation unto Yahuah, an holy portion of the land: the length shall be the length of five and twenty thousand reeds, and the breadth shall be ten thousand. This shall be holy in all the borders thereof round about.

verses.raw: Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred in length, with five hundred in breadth, square round about; and fifty cubits round about for the suburbs thereof.
verses.text: Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred in length, with five hundred in breadth, square round about; and fifty cubits round about for the suburbs thereof.

verses.raw: And of this measure shall you measure the length of five and twenty thousand, and the breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary and the most holy place.
verses.text: And of this measure shall you measure the length of five and twenty thousand, and the breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary and the most holy place.

verses.raw: The holy portion of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary, which shall come near to minister unto Yahuah (LORD): and it shall be a place for their houses, and an holy place for the sanctuary.
verses.text: The holy portion of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary, which shall come near to minister unto Yahuah: and it shall be a place for their houses, and an holy place for the sanctuary.

verses.raw: And the five and twenty thousand of length, and the ten thousand of breadth, shall also the Levites, the ministers of the house, have for themselves, for a possession for twenty chambers.
verses.text: And the five and twenty thousand of length, and the ten thousand of breadth, shall also the Levites, the ministers of the house, have for themselves, for a possession for twenty chambers.

verses.raw: And you shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, over against the oblation of the holy portion: it shall be for the whole house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And you shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, over against the oblation of the holy portion: it shall be for the whole house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And a portion shall be for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy portion, and of the possession of the city, before the oblation of the holy portion, and before the possession of the city, from the west side westward, and from the east side eastward: and the length shall be over against one of the portions, from the west border unto the east border.
verses.text: And a portion shall be for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy portion, and of the possession of the city, before the oblation of the holy portion, and before the possession of the city, from the west side westward, and from the east side eastward: and the length shall be over against one of the portions, from the west border unto the east border.

verses.raw: In the land shall be his possession in Yashar'el (Israel): and my princes shall no more oppress my people; and the rest of the land shall they give to the house of Yashar'el (Israel) according to their tribes.
verses.text: In the land shall be his possession in Yashar'el: and my princes shall no more oppress my people; and the rest of the land shall they give to the house of Yashar'el according to their tribes.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Let it suffice you, O princes of Yashar'el (Israel): remove violence and spoil, and execute judgment and justice, take away your exactions from my people, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; Let it suffice you, O princes of Yashar'el: remove violence and spoil, and execute judgment and justice, take away your exactions from my people, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: You shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.
verses.text: You shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.

verses.raw: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer, and the ephah the tenth part of an homer: the measure thereof shall be after the homer.
verses.text: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer, and the ephah the tenth part of an homer: the measure thereof shall be after the homer.

verses.raw: And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.
verses.text: And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.

verses.raw: This is the oblation that you shall offer; the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat, and you shall give the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley:
verses.text: This is the oblation that you shall offer; the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat, and you shall give the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley:

verses.raw: Concerning the ordinance of oil, the bath of oil, you shall offer the tenth part of a bath out of the cor, which is an homer of ten baths; for ten baths are an homer:
verses.text: Concerning the ordinance of oil, the bath of oil, you shall offer the tenth part of a bath out of the cor, which is an homer of ten baths; for ten baths are an homer:

verses.raw: And one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the fat pastures of Yashar'el (Israel); for a meat offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make reconciliation for them, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: And one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the fat pastures of Yashar'el; for a meat offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make reconciliation for them, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And it shall be the prince’s part to give burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and drink offerings, in the feasts, and in the new moons, and in the sabbaths, in all solemnities of the house of Yashar'el (Israel): he shall prepare the sin offering, and the meat offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make reconciliation for the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And it shall be the prince’s part to give burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and drink offerings, in the feasts, and in the new moons, and in the sabbaths, in all solemnities of the house of Yashar'el: he shall prepare the sin offering, and the meat offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make reconciliation for the house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); In the first month, in the first day of the month, you shall take a young bullock without blemish, and cleanse the sanctuary:
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; In the first month, in the first day of the month, you shall take a young bullock without blemish, and cleanse the sanctuary:

verses.raw: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put it upon the posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the settle of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.
verses.text: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put it upon the posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the settle of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.

verses.raw: And so you shall do the seventh day of the month for every one that erreth, and for him that is simple: so shall you reconcile the house.
verses.text: And so you shall do the seventh day of the month for every one that erreth, and for him that is simple: so shall you reconcile the house.

verses.raw: In the first month, in the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
verses.text: In the first month, in the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

verses.raw: And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock for a sin offering.
verses.text: And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock for a sin offering.

verses.raw: And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to Yahuah (LORD), seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a kid of the goats daily for a sin offering.
verses.text: And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to Yahuah, seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a kid of the goats daily for a sin offering.

verses.raw: And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah.
verses.text: And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah.

verses.raw: In the seventh month, in the fifteenth day of the month, shall he do the like in the feast of the seven days, according to the sin offering, according to the burnt offering, and according to the meat offering, and according to the oil.
verses.text: In the seventh month, in the fifteenth day of the month, shall he do the like in the feast of the seven days, according to the sin offering, according to the burnt offering, and according to the meat offering, and according to the oil.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); The gate of the inner court that looks toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; The gate of the inner court that looks toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.

verses.raw: And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.
verses.text: And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

verses.raw: Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate before Yahuah (LORD) in the sabbaths and in the new moons.
verses.text: Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate before Yahuah in the sabbaths and in the new moons.

verses.raw: And the burnt offering that the prince shall offer unto Yahuah (LORD) in the sabbath day shall be six lambs without blemish, and a ram without blemish.
verses.text: And the burnt offering that the prince shall offer unto Yahuah in the sabbath day shall be six lambs without blemish, and a ram without blemish.

verses.raw: And the meat offering shall be an ephah for a ram, and the meat offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.text: And the meat offering shall be an ephah for a ram, and the meat offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

verses.raw: And in the day of the new moon it shall be a young bullock without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram: they shall be without blemish.
verses.text: And in the day of the new moon it shall be a young bullock without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram: they shall be without blemish.

verses.raw: And he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs according as his hand shall attain unto, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.text: And he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs according as his hand shall attain unto, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

verses.raw: And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of that gate, and he shall go forth by the way thereof.
verses.text: And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of that gate, and he shall go forth by the way thereof.

verses.raw: But when the people of the land shall come before Yahuah (LORD) in the solemn feasts, he that enters in by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he that enters by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate: he shall not return by the way of the gate whereby he came in, but shall go forth over against it.
verses.text: But when the people of the land shall come before Yahuah in the solemn feasts, he that enters in by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he that enters by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate: he shall not return by the way of the gate whereby he came in, but shall go forth over against it.

verses.raw: And the prince in the midst of them, when they go in, shall go in; and when they go forth, shall go forth.
verses.text: And the prince in the midst of them, when they go in, shall go in; and when they go forth, shall go forth.

verses.raw: And in the feasts and in the solemnities the meat offering shall be an ephah to a bullock, and an ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.text: And in the feasts and in the solemnities the meat offering shall be an ephah to a bullock, and an ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

verses.raw: Now when the prince shall prepare a voluntary burnt offering or peace offerings voluntarily unto Yahuah (LORD), one shall then open him the gate that looks toward the east, and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he did on the sabbath day: then he shall go forth; and after his going forth one shall shut the gate.
verses.text: Now when the prince shall prepare a voluntary burnt offering or peace offerings voluntarily unto Yahuah, one shall then open him the gate that looks toward the east, and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he did on the sabbath day: then he shall go forth; and after his going forth one shall shut the gate.

verses.raw: You shall daily prepare a burnt offering unto Yahuah (LORD) of a lamb of the first year without blemish: you shall prepare it every morning.
verses.text: You shall daily prepare a burnt offering unto Yahuah of a lamb of the first year without blemish: you shall prepare it every morning.

verses.raw: And you shall prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to temper with the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And you shall prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to temper with the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning for a continual burnt offering.
verses.text: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning for a continual burnt offering.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); If the prince give a gift unto any of his sons, the inheritance thereof shall be his sons’; it shall be their possession by inheritance.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; If the prince give a gift unto any of his sons, the inheritance thereof shall be his sons’; it shall be their possession by inheritance.

verses.raw: But if he give a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince: but his inheritance shall be his sons’ for them.
verses.text: But if he give a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince: but his inheritance shall be his sons’ for them.

verses.raw: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance by oppression, to thrust them out of their possession; but he shall give his sons inheritance out of his own possession: that my people be not scattered every man from his possession.
verses.text: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance by oppression, to thrust them out of their possession; but he shall give his sons inheritance out of his own possession: that my people be not scattered every man from his possession.

verses.raw: After he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north: and, behold, there was a place on the two sides westward.
verses.text: After he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north: and, behold, there was a place on the two sides westward.

verses.raw: Then said he unto me, This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, where they shall bake the meat offering; that they bear them not out into the utter court, to sanctify the people.
verses.text: Then said he unto me, This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, where they shall bake the meat offering; that they bear them not out into the utter court, to sanctify the people.

verses.raw: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and, behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.
verses.text: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and, behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.

verses.raw: In the four corners of the court there were courts joined of forty cubits long and thirty broad: these four corners were of one measure.
verses.text: In the four corners of the court there were courts joined of forty cubits long and thirty broad: these four corners were of one measure.

verses.raw: And there was a row of building round about in them, round about them four, and it was made with boiling places under the rows round about.
verses.text: And there was a row of building round about in them, round about them four, and it was made with boiling places under the rows round about.

verses.raw: Then said he unto me, These are the places of them that boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.
verses.text: Then said he unto me, These are the places of them that boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.

verses.raw: Afterward he brought me again unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward: for the forefront of the house stood toward the east, and the waters came down from under from the right side of the house, at the south side of the altar.
verses.text: Afterward he brought me again unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward: for the forefront of the house stood toward the east, and the waters came down from under from the right side of the house, at the south side of the altar.

verses.raw: Then brought he me out of the way of the gate northward, and led me about the way without unto the utter gate by the way that looks eastward; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.
verses.text: Then brought he me out of the way of the gate northward, and led me about the way without unto the utter gate by the way that looks eastward; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.

verses.raw: And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ankles.
verses.text: And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ankles.

verses.raw: Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters were to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters were to the loins.
verses.text: Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters were to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters were to the loins.

verses.raw: Afterward he measured a thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.
verses.text: Afterward he measured a thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.

verses.raw: And he said unto me, Son of Adam, have you seen this? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.
verses.text: And he said unto me, Son of Adam, have you seen this? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.

verses.raw: Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
verses.text: Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.

verses.raw: Then said he unto me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea: which being brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.
verses.text: Then said he unto me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea: which being brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that every thing that lives, which moves, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river comes.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that every thing that lives, which moves, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river comes.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that the fishers shall stand upon it from En-gedi even unto En-eglaim; they shall be a place to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that the fishers shall stand upon it from En-gedi even unto En-eglaim; they shall be a place to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.

verses.raw: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.
verses.text: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.

verses.raw: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.
verses.text: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.

verses.raw: Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); This shall be the border, whereby you shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel): Joseph shall have two portions.
verses.text: Thus says Adonai Yahuah; This shall be the border, whereby you shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Yashar'el: Joseph shall have two portions.

verses.raw: And you shall inherit it, one as well as another: concerning the which I lifted up my hand to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.
verses.text: And you shall inherit it, one as well as another: concerning the which I lifted up my hand to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.

verses.raw: And this shall be the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;
verses.text: And this shall be the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;

verses.raw: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazar-hatticon, which is by the coast of Hauran.
verses.text: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazar-hatticon, which is by the coast of Hauran.

verses.raw: And the border from the sea shall be Hazar-enan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And this is the north side.
verses.text: And the border from the sea shall be Hazar-enan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And this is the north side.

verses.raw: And the east side you shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Yashar'el (Israel) by Jordan, from the border unto the east sea. And this is the east side.
verses.text: And the east side you shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Yashar'el by Jordan, from the border unto the east sea. And this is the east side.

verses.raw: And the south side southward, from Tamar even to the waters of strife in Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And this is the south side southward.
verses.text: And the south side southward, from Tamar even to the waters of strife in Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And this is the south side southward.

verses.raw: The west side also shall be the great sea from the border, till a man come over against Hamath. This is the west side.
verses.text: The west side also shall be the great sea from the border, till a man come over against Hamath. This is the west side.

verses.raw: So shall you divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: So shall you divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that you shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, which shall beget children among you: and they shall be unto you as born in the country among the children of Yashar'el (Israel); they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that you shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, which shall beget children among you: and they shall be unto you as born in the country among the children of Yashar'el; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that in what tribe the stranger sojourns, there shall you give him his inheritance, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that in what tribe the stranger sojourns, there shall you give him his inheritance, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Now these are the names of the tribes. From the north end to the coast of the way of Hethlon, as one goes to Hamath, Hazar-enan, the border of Damascus northward, to the coast of Hamath; for these are his sides east and west; a portion for Dan.
verses.text: Now these are the names of the tribes. From the north end to the coast of the way of Hethlon, as one goes to Hamath, Hazar-enan, the border of Damascus northward, to the coast of Hamath; for these are his sides east and west; a portion for Dan.

verses.raw: And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Asher.
verses.text: And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Asher.

verses.raw: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Naphtali.
verses.text: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Naphtali.

verses.raw: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Manasseh.
verses.text: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Manasseh.

verses.raw: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Ephraim.
verses.text: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Ephraim.

verses.raw: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Reuben.
verses.text: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Reuben.

verses.raw: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Yahudah.

verses.raw: And by the border of Yahudah (Judah), from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which you shall offer of five and twenty thousand reeds in breadth, and in length as one of the other parts, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.
verses.text: And by the border of Yahudah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which you shall offer of five and twenty thousand reeds in breadth, and in length as one of the other parts, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.

verses.raw: The oblation that you shall offer unto Yahuah (LORD) shall be of five and twenty thousand in length, and of ten thousand in breadth.
verses.text: The oblation that you shall offer unto Yahuah shall be of five and twenty thousand in length, and of ten thousand in breadth.

verses.raw: And for them, even for the priests, shall be this holy oblation; toward the north five and twenty thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of Yahuah (LORD) shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.text: And for them, even for the priests, shall be this holy oblation; toward the north five and twenty thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of Yahuah shall be in the midst thereof.

verses.raw: It shall be for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok; which have kept my charge, which went not astray when the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went astray, as the Levites went astray.
verses.text: It shall be for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok; which have kept my charge, which went not astray when the children of Yashar'el went astray, as the Levites went astray.

verses.raw: And this oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.
verses.text: And this oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.

verses.raw: And over against the border of the priests the Levites shall have five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length shall be five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.
verses.text: And over against the border of the priests the Levites shall have five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length shall be five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.

verses.raw: And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for it is holy unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for it is holy unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the five thousand, that are left in the breadth over against the five and twenty thousand, shall be a profane place for the city, for dwelling, and for suburbs: and the city shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.text: And the five thousand, that are left in the breadth over against the five and twenty thousand, shall be a profane place for the city, for dwelling, and for suburbs: and the city shall be in the midst thereof.

verses.raw: And these shall be the measures thereof; the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.
verses.text: And these shall be the measures thereof; the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.

verses.raw: And the suburbs of the city shall be toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.
verses.text: And the suburbs of the city shall be toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.

verses.raw: And the residue in length over against the oblation of the holy portion shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward: and it shall be over against the oblation of the holy portion; and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that serve the city.
verses.text: And the residue in length over against the oblation of the holy portion shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward: and it shall be over against the oblation of the holy portion; and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that serve the city.

verses.raw: And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: All the oblation shall be five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: you shall offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.
verses.text: All the oblation shall be five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: you shall offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.

verses.raw: And the residue shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, and of the possession of the city, over against the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward over against the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, over against the portions for the prince: and it shall be the holy oblation; and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.text: And the residue shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, and of the possession of the city, over against the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward over against the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, over against the portions for the prince: and it shall be the holy oblation; and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the midst thereof.

verses.raw: Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the midst of that which is the prince’s, between the border of Yahudah (Judah) and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.
verses.text: Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the midst of that which is the prince’s, between the border of Yahudah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.

verses.raw: As for the rest of the tribes, from the east side unto the west side, Benjamin shall have a portion.
verses.text: As for the rest of the tribes, from the east side unto the west side, Benjamin shall have a portion.

verses.raw: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side unto the west side, Simeon shall have a portion.
verses.text: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side unto the west side, Simeon shall have a portion.

verses.raw: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side unto the west side, Issachar a portion.
verses.text: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side unto the west side, Issachar a portion.

verses.raw: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side unto the west side, Zebulun a portion.
verses.text: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side unto the west side, Zebulun a portion.

verses.raw: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto the west side, Gad a portion.
verses.text: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto the west side, Gad a portion.

verses.raw: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar unto the waters of strife in Kadesh, and to the river toward the great sea.
verses.text: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar unto the waters of strife in Kadesh, and to the river toward the great sea.

verses.raw: This is the land which you shall divide by lot unto the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) for inheritance, and these are their portions, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: This is the land which you shall divide by lot unto the tribes of Yashar'el for inheritance, and these are their portions, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: And these are the goings out of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.
verses.text: And these are the goings out of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.

verses.raw: And the gates of the city shall be after the names of the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel): three gates northward; one gate of Reuben, one gate of Yahudah (Judah), one gate of Levi.
verses.text: And the gates of the city shall be after the names of the tribes of Yashar'el: three gates northward; one gate of Reuben, one gate of Yahudah, one gate of Levi.

verses.raw: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred: and three gates; and one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.
verses.text: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred: and three gates; and one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.

verses.raw: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.
verses.text: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.

verses.raw: At the west side four thousand and five hundred, with their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.
verses.text: At the west side four thousand and five hundred, with their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.

verses.raw: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, Yahuah Shammah (The LORD is there).
verses.text: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, Yahuah Shammah.

verses.raw: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Yahudah (Judah) came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon unto Jerusalem, and besieged it.
verses.text: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Yahudah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon unto Jerusalem, and besieged it.

verses.raw: And Adonai (Lord) gave Jehoiakim king of Yahudah (Judah) into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of Elohim (God): which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.
verses.text: And Adonai gave Jehoiakim king of Yahudah into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of Elohim: which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.

verses.raw: And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring certain of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and of the king’s seed, and of the princes;
verses.text: And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring certain of the children of Yashar'el, and of the king’s seed, and of the princes;

verses.raw: Children in whom was no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science, and such as had ability in them to stand in the king’s palace, and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans.
verses.text: Children in whom was no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science, and such as had ability in them to stand in the king’s palace, and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans.

verses.raw: And the king appointed them a daily provision of the king’s meat, and of the wine which he drank: so nourishing them three years, that at the end thereof they might stand before the king.
verses.text: And the king appointed them a daily provision of the king’s meat, and of the wine which he drank: so nourishing them three years, that at the end thereof they might stand before the king.

verses.raw: Now among these were of the children of Yahudah (Judah), Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:
verses.text: Now among these were of the children of Yahudah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:

verses.raw: Unto whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names: for he gave unto Daniel the name of Belteshazzar; and to Hananiah, of Shadrach; and to Mishael, of Meshach; and to Azariah, of Abed-nego.
verses.text: Unto whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names: for he gave unto Daniel the name of Belteshazzar; and to Hananiah, of Shadrach; and to Mishael, of Meshach; and to Azariah, of Abed-nego.

verses.raw: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king’s meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
verses.text: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king’s meat, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

verses.raw: Now Elohim (God) had brought Daniel into favour and tender love with the prince of the eunuchs.
verses.text: Now Elohim had brought Daniel into favour and tender love with the prince of the eunuchs.

verses.raw: And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your meat and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which are of your sort? then shall you make me endanger my head to the king.
verses.text: And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your meat and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which are of your sort? then shall you make me endanger my head to the king.

verses.raw: Then said Daniel to Melzar, whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,
verses.text: Then said Daniel to Melzar, whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,

verses.raw: Prove your servants, I beseech you, ten days; and let them give us pulse to eat, and water to drink.
verses.text: Prove your servants, I beseech you, ten days; and let them give us pulse to eat, and water to drink.

verses.raw: Then let our countenances be looked upon before you, and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king’s meat: and as you see, deal with your servants.
