verses.text: Then let our countenances be looked upon before you, and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king’s meat: and as you see, deal with your servants.

verses.raw: So he consented to them in this matter, and proved them ten days.
verses.text: So he consented to them in this matter, and proved them ten days.

verses.raw: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king’s meat.
verses.text: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king’s meat.

verses.raw: Thus Melzar took away the portion of their meat, and the wine that they should drink; and gave them pulse.
verses.text: Thus Melzar took away the portion of their meat, and the wine that they should drink; and gave them pulse.

verses.raw: As for these four children, Elohim (God) gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom: and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.
verses.text: As for these four children, Elohim gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom: and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.

verses.raw: Now at the end of the days that the king had said he should bring them in, then the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.text: Now at the end of the days that the king had said he should bring them in, then the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.raw: And the king communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah: therefore stood they before the king.
verses.text: And the king communed with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah: therefore stood they before the king.

verses.raw: And in all matters of wisdom and understanding, that the king enquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers that were in all his realm.
verses.text: And in all matters of wisdom and understanding, that the king enquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers that were in all his realm.

verses.raw: And Daniel continued even unto the first year of king Cyrus.
verses.text: And Daniel continued even unto the first year of king Cyrus.

verses.raw: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, wherewith his spirit was troubled, and his sleep brake from him.
verses.text: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, wherewith his spirit was troubled, and his sleep brake from him.

verses.raw: Then the king commanded to call the magicians, and the astrologers, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, for to shew the king his dreams. So they came and stood before the king.
verses.text: Then the king commanded to call the magicians, and the astrologers, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, for to shew the king his dreams. So they came and stood before the king.

verses.raw: And the king said unto them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit was troubled to know the dream.
verses.text: And the king said unto them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit was troubled to know the dream.

verses.raw: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack, O king, live for ever: tell your servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation.
verses.text: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack, O king, live for ever: tell your servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation.

verses.raw: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The thing is gone from me: if you will not make known unto me the dream, with the interpretation thereof, you shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made a dunghill.
verses.text: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The thing is gone from me: if you will not make known unto me the dream, with the interpretation thereof, you shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made a dunghill.

verses.raw: But if you shew the dream, and the interpretation thereof, you shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour: therefore shew me the dream, and the interpretation thereof.
verses.text: But if you shew the dream, and the interpretation thereof, you shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour: therefore shew me the dream, and the interpretation thereof.

verses.raw: They answered again and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation of it.
verses.text: They answered again and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation of it.

verses.raw: The king answered and said, I know of certainty that you would gain the time, because you see the thing is gone from me.
verses.text: The king answered and said, I know of certainty that you would gain the time, because you see the thing is gone from me.

verses.raw: But if you will not make known unto me the dream, there is but one decree for you: for you have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, till the time be changed: therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that you can shew me the interpretation thereof.
verses.text: But if you will not make known unto me the dream, there is but one decree for you: for you have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, till the time be changed: therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that you can shew me the interpretation thereof.

verses.raw: The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, There is not a man upon the earth that can shew the king’s matter: therefore there is no king, lord, nor ruler, that asked such things at any magician, or astrologer, or Chaldean.
verses.text: The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, There is not a man upon the earth that can shew the king’s matter: therefore there is no king, lord, nor ruler, that asked such things at any magician, or astrologer, or Chaldean.

verses.raw: And it is a rare thing that the king requires, and there is none other that can shew it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.
verses.text: And it is a rare thing that the king requires, and there is none other that can shew it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.

verses.raw: For this cause the king was angry and very furious, and commanded to destroy all the wise men of Babylon.
verses.text: For this cause the king was angry and very furious, and commanded to destroy all the wise men of Babylon.

verses.raw: And the decree went forth that the wise men should be slain; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain.
verses.text: And the decree went forth that the wise men should be slain; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain.

verses.raw: Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king’s guard, which was gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon:
verses.text: Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king’s guard, which was gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon:

verses.raw: He answered and said to Arioch the king’s captain, Why is the decree so hasty from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.
verses.text: He answered and said to Arioch the king’s captain, Why is the decree so hasty from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.

verses.raw: Then Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would give him time, and that he would shew the king the interpretation.
verses.text: Then Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would give him time, and that he would shew the king the interpretation.

verses.raw: Then Daniel went to his house, and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:
verses.text: Then Daniel went to his house, and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:

verses.raw: That they would desire mercies of the Elohim (God) of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his fellows should not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.
verses.text: That they would desire mercies of the Elohim of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his fellows should not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.

verses.raw: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the Elohim (God) of heaven.
verses.text: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the Elohim of heaven.

verses.raw: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of Elohim (God) for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his:
verses.text: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of Elohim for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his:

verses.raw: And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and sets up kings: he gives wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:
verses.text: And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and sets up kings: he gives wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:

verses.raw: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.
verses.text: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.

verses.raw: I thank you, and praise you, O you Elohim (God) of my fathers, who have given me wisdom and might, and have made known unto me now what we desired of you: for you have now made known unto us the king’s matter.
verses.text: I thank you, and praise you, O you Elohim of my fathers, who have given me wisdom and might, and have made known unto me now what we desired of you: for you have now made known unto us the king’s matter.

verses.raw: Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch, whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise men of Babylon: he went and said thus unto him; Destroy not the wise men of Babylon: bring me in before the king, and I will shew unto the king the interpretation.
verses.text: Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch, whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise men of Babylon: he went and said thus unto him; Destroy not the wise men of Babylon: bring me in before the king, and I will shew unto the king the interpretation.

verses.raw: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said thus unto him, I have found a man of the captives of Yahudah (Judah), that will make known unto the king the interpretation.
verses.text: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said thus unto him, I have found a man of the captives of Yahudah, that will make known unto the king the interpretation.

verses.raw: The king answered and said to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, Are you able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen, and the interpretation thereof?
verses.text: The king answered and said to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, Are you able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen, and the interpretation thereof?

verses.raw: Daniel answered in the presence of the king, and said, The secret which the king has demanded cannot the wise men, the astrologers, the magicians, the soothsayers, shew unto the king;
verses.text: Daniel answered in the presence of the king, and said, The secret which the king has demanded cannot the wise men, the astrologers, the magicians, the soothsayers, shew unto the king;

verses.raw: But there is a Elohim (God) in heaven that revealeth secrets, and makes known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Your dream, and the visions of your head upon your bed, are these;
verses.text: But there is a Elohim in heaven that revealeth secrets, and makes known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Your dream, and the visions of your head upon your bed, are these;

verses.raw: As for you, O king, your thoughts came into your mind upon your bed, what should come to pass hereafter: and he that revealeth secrets makes known to you what shall come to pass.
verses.text: As for you, O king, your thoughts came into your mind upon your bed, what should come to pass hereafter: and he that revealeth secrets makes known to you what shall come to pass.

verses.raw: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but for their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king, and that you might know the thoughts of your heart.
verses.text: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but for their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king, and that you might know the thoughts of your heart.

verses.raw: You, O king, saw, and behold a great image. This great image, whose brightness was excellent, stood before you; and the form thereof was terrible.
verses.text: You, O king, saw, and behold a great image. This great image, whose brightness was excellent, stood before you; and the form thereof was terrible.

verses.raw: This image’s head was of fine gold, his breast and his arms of silver, his belly and his thighs of brass,
verses.text: This image’s head was of fine gold, his breast and his arms of silver, his belly and his thighs of brass,

verses.raw: His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of clay.
verses.text: His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of clay.

verses.raw: You saw till that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.
verses.text: You saw till that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.

verses.raw: Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken to pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them: and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.
verses.text: Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken to pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them: and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.

verses.raw: This is the dream; and we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king.
verses.text: This is the dream; and we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king.

verses.raw: You, O king, are a king of kings: for the Elohim (God) of heaven has given you a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory.
verses.text: You, O king, are a king of kings: for the Elohim of heaven has given you a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory.

verses.raw: And wheresoever the children of men dwell, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the heaven has he given into your hand, and has made you ruler over them all. You are this head of gold.
verses.text: And wheresoever the children of men dwell, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the heaven has he given into your hand, and has made you ruler over them all. You are this head of gold.

verses.raw: And after you shall arise another kingdom inferior to you, and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.
verses.text: And after you shall arise another kingdom inferior to you, and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.

verses.raw: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron: forasmuch as iron breaks in pieces and subdueth all things: and as iron that breaks all these, shall it break in pieces and bruise.
verses.text: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron: forasmuch as iron breaks in pieces and subdueth all things: and as iron that breaks all these, shall it break in pieces and bruise.

verses.raw: And whereas you saw the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron, forasmuch as you saw the iron mixed with miry clay.
verses.text: And whereas you saw the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron, forasmuch as you saw the iron mixed with miry clay.

verses.raw: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.
verses.text: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.

verses.raw: And whereas you saw iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men: but they shall not cleave one to another, even as iron is not mixed with clay.
verses.text: And whereas you saw iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men: but they shall not cleave one to another, even as iron is not mixed with clay.

verses.raw: And in the days of these kings shall the Elohim (God) of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.
verses.text: And in the days of these kings shall the Elohim of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.

verses.raw: Forasmuch as you saw that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it brake in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold; the great Elohim (God) has made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter: and the dream is certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.
verses.text: Forasmuch as you saw that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it brake in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold; the great Elohim has made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter: and the dream is certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.

verses.raw: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and worshipped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours unto him.
verses.text: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and worshipped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours unto him.

verses.raw: The king answered unto Daniel, and said, Of a truth it is, that your Elohim (God) is a Elohim (God) of gods, and a Yahuah (Lord) of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing you could reveal this secret.
verses.text: The king answered unto Daniel, and said, Of a truth it is, that your Elohim is a Elohim of gods, and a Yahuah of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing you could reveal this secret.

verses.raw: Then the king made Daniel a great man, and gave him many great gifts, and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon, and chief of the governors over all the wise men of Babylon.
verses.text: Then the king made Daniel a great man, and gave him many great gifts, and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon, and chief of the governors over all the wise men of Babylon.

verses.raw: Then Daniel requested of the king, and he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon: but Daniel sat in the gate of the king.
verses.text: Then Daniel requested of the king, and he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon: but Daniel sat in the gate of the king.

verses.raw: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.
verses.text: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.

verses.raw: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the princes, the governors, and the captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
verses.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the princes, the governors, and the captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

verses.raw: Then the princes, the governors, and captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, were gathered together unto the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
verses.text: Then the princes, the governors, and captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, were gathered together unto the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

verses.raw: Then an herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, O people, nations, and languages,
verses.text: Then an herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, O people, nations, and languages,

verses.raw: That at what time you hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, you fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king has set up:
verses.text: That at what time you hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, you fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king has set up:

verses.raw: And whoso falls not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.
verses.text: And whoso falls not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.

verses.raw: Therefore at that time, when all the people heard the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and all kinds of musick, all the people, the nations, and the languages, fell down and worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
verses.text: Therefore at that time, when all the people heard the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and all kinds of musick, all the people, the nations, and the languages, fell down and worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

verses.raw: Wherefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near, and accused the Yahudim (Jews).
verses.text: Wherefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near, and accused the Yahudim.

verses.raw: They spake and said to the king Nebuchadnezzar, O king, live for ever.
verses.text: They spake and said to the king Nebuchadnezzar, O king, live for ever.

verses.raw: You, O king, have made a decree, that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, shall fall down and worship the golden image:
verses.text: You, O king, have made a decree, that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, shall fall down and worship the golden image:

verses.raw: And whoso falls not down and worshippeth, that he should be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.
verses.text: And whoso falls not down and worshippeth, that he should be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.

verses.raw: There are certain Yahudim (Jews) whom you have set over the affairs of the province of Babylon, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego; these men, O king, have not regarded you: they serve not your gods, nor worship the golden image which you have set up.
verses.text: There are certain Yahudim whom you have set over the affairs of the province of Babylon, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego; these men, O king, have not regarded you: they serve not your gods, nor worship the golden image which you have set up.

verses.raw: Then Nebuchadnezzar in his rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego. Then they brought these men before the king.
verses.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar in his rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego. Then they brought these men before the king.

verses.raw: Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them, Is it true, O Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, do not you serve my gods, nor worship the golden image which I have set up?
verses.text: Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them, Is it true, O Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, do not you serve my gods, nor worship the golden image which I have set up?

verses.raw: Now if you be ready that at what time you hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, you fall down and worship the image which I have made; well: but if you worship not, you shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace; and who is that Elohim (God) that shall deliver you out of my hands?
verses.text: Now if you be ready that at what time you hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, you fall down and worship the image which I have made; well: but if you worship not, you shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace; and who is that Elohim that shall deliver you out of my hands?

verses.raw: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, answered and said to the king, O Nebuchadnezzar, we are not careful to answer you in this matter.
verses.text: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, answered and said to the king, O Nebuchadnezzar, we are not careful to answer you in this matter.

verses.raw: If it be so, our Elohim (God) whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king.
verses.text: If it be so, our Elohim whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king.

verses.raw: But if not, be it known unto you, O king, that we will not serve your gods, nor worship the golden image which you have set up.
verses.text: But if not, be it known unto you, O king, that we will not serve your gods, nor worship the golden image which you have set up.

verses.raw: Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, and the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego: therefore he spake, and commanded that they should heat the furnace one seven times more than it was wont to be heated.
verses.text: Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, and the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego: therefore he spake, and commanded that they should heat the furnace one seven times more than it was wont to be heated.

verses.raw: And he commanded the most mighty men that were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace.
verses.text: And he commanded the most mighty men that were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace.

verses.raw: Then these men were bound in their coats, their hosen, and their hats, and their other garments, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
verses.text: Then these men were bound in their coats, their hosen, and their hats, and their other garments, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

verses.raw: Therefore because the king’s commandment was urgent, and the furnace exceeding hot, the flame of the fire slew those men that took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego.
verses.text: Therefore because the king’s commandment was urgent, and the furnace exceeding hot, the flame of the fire slew those men that took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego.

verses.raw: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
verses.text: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

verses.raw: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonied, and rose up in haste, and spake, and said unto his counsellors, Did not we cast three men bound into the midst of the fire? They answered and said unto the king, True, O king.
verses.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonied, and rose up in haste, and spake, and said unto his counsellors, Did not we cast three men bound into the midst of the fire? They answered and said unto the king, True, O king.

verses.raw: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of Elohim (God).
verses.text: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of Elohim.

verses.raw: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace, and spake, and said, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, you servants of the El Elyon (most high God), come forth, and come hither. Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, came forth of the midst of the fire.
verses.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace, and spake, and said, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, you servants of the El Elyon (most high God), come forth, and come hither. Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, came forth of the midst of the fire.

verses.raw: And the princes, governors, and captains, and the king’s counsellors, being gathered together, saw these men, upon whose bodies the fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor the smell of fire had passed on them.
verses.text: And the princes, governors, and captains, and the king’s counsellors, being gathered together, saw these men, upon whose bodies the fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor the smell of fire had passed on them.

verses.raw: Then Nebuchadnezzar spake, and said, Blessed be the Elohim (God) of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, who has sent his angel, and delivered his servants that trusted in him, and have changed the king’s word, and yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own Elohim (God).
verses.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar spake, and said, Blessed be the Elohim of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, who has sent his angel, and delivered his servants that trusted in him, and have changed the king’s word, and yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own Elohim.

verses.raw: Therefore I make a decree, That every people, nation, and language, which speak any thing amiss against the Elohim (God) of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill: because there is no other Elohim (God) that can deliver after this sort.
verses.text: Therefore I make a decree, That every people, nation, and language, which speak any thing amiss against the Elohim of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill: because there is no other Elohim that can deliver after this sort.

verses.raw: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, in the province of Babylon.
verses.text: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, in the province of Babylon.

verses.raw: Nebuchadnezzar the king, unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.
verses.text: Nebuchadnezzar the king, unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.

verses.raw: I thought it good to shew the signs and wonders that the high Elohim (God) has wrought toward me.
verses.text: I thought it good to shew the signs and wonders that the high Elohim has wrought toward me.

verses.raw: How great are his signs! and how mighty are his wonders! his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and his dominion is from generation to generation.
verses.text: How great are his signs! and how mighty are his wonders! his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and his dominion is from generation to generation.

verses.raw: I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in my house, and flourishing in my palace:
verses.text: I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in my house, and flourishing in my palace:

verses.raw: I saw a dream which made me afraid, and the thoughts upon my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.
verses.text: I saw a dream which made me afraid, and the thoughts upon my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.

verses.raw: Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me, that they might make known unto me the interpretation of the dream.
verses.text: Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me, that they might make known unto me the interpretation of the dream.

verses.raw: Then came in the magicians, the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers: and I told the dream before them; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation thereof.
verses.text: Then came in the magicians, the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers: and I told the dream before them; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation thereof.

verses.raw: But at the last Daniel came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar, according to the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods: and before him I told the dream, saying,
verses.text: But at the last Daniel came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar, according to the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods: and before him I told the dream, saying,

verses.raw: O Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you, and no secret troubles you, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and the interpretation thereof.
verses.text: O Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you, and no secret troubles you, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and the interpretation thereof.

verses.raw: Thus were the visions of my head in my bed; I saw, and behold a tree in the midst of the earth, and the height thereof was great.
verses.text: Thus were the visions of my head in my bed; I saw, and behold a tree in the midst of the earth, and the height thereof was great.

verses.raw: The tree grew, and was strong, and the height thereof reached unto heaven, and the sight thereof to the end of all the earth:
verses.text: The tree grew, and was strong, and the height thereof reached unto heaven, and the sight thereof to the end of all the earth:

verses.raw: The leaves thereof were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it was meat for all: the beasts of the field had shadow under it, and the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the boughs thereof, and all flesh was fed of it.
verses.text: The leaves thereof were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it was meat for all: the beasts of the field had shadow under it, and the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the boughs thereof, and all flesh was fed of it.

verses.raw: I saw in the visions of my head upon my bed, and, behold, a watcher and an holy one came down from heaven;
verses.text: I saw in the visions of my head upon my bed, and, behold, a watcher and an holy one came down from heaven;

verses.raw: He cried aloud, and said thus, Hew down the tree, and cut off his branches, shake off his leaves, and scatter his fruit: let the beasts get away from under it, and the fowls from his branches:
verses.text: He cried aloud, and said thus, Hew down the tree, and cut off his branches, shake off his leaves, and scatter his fruit: let the beasts get away from under it, and the fowls from his branches:

verses.raw: Nevertheless leave the stump of his roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts in the grass of the earth:
verses.text: Nevertheless leave the stump of his roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts in the grass of the earth:

verses.raw: Let his heart be changed from man’s, and let a beast’s heart be given unto him; and let seven times pass over him.
verses.text: Let his heart be changed from man’s, and let a beast’s heart be given unto him; and let seven times pass over him.

verses.raw: This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the El Elyon (most High) rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomsoever he will, and sets up over it the basest of men.
verses.text: This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the El Elyon rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomsoever he will, and sets up over it the basest of men.

verses.raw: This dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen. Now you, O Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation thereof, forasmuch as all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation: but you are able; for the spirit of the holy gods is in you.
verses.text: This dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen. Now you, O Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation thereof, forasmuch as all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation: but you are able; for the spirit of the holy gods is in you.

verses.raw: Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was astonied for one hour, and his thoughts troubled him. The king spake, and said, Belteshazzar, let not the dream, or the interpretation thereof, trouble you. Belteshazzar answered and said, My lord, the dream be to them that hate you, and the interpretation thereof to your enemies.
verses.text: Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was astonied for one hour, and his thoughts troubled him. The king spake, and said, Belteshazzar, let not the dream, or the interpretation thereof, trouble you. Belteshazzar answered and said, My lord, the dream be to them that hate you, and the interpretation thereof to your enemies.

verses.raw: The tree that you saw, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached unto the heaven, and the sight thereof to all the earth;
verses.text: The tree that you saw, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached unto the heaven, and the sight thereof to all the earth;

verses.raw: Whose leaves were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it was meat for all; under which the beasts of the field dwelt, and upon whose branches the fowls of the heaven had their habitation:
verses.text: Whose leaves were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it was meat for all; under which the beasts of the field dwelt, and upon whose branches the fowls of the heaven had their habitation:

verses.raw: It is you, O king, that are grown and become strong: for your greatness is grown, and reaches unto heaven, and your dominion to the end of the earth.
verses.text: It is you, O king, that are grown and become strong: for your greatness is grown, and reaches unto heaven, and your dominion to the end of the earth.

verses.raw: And whereas the king saw a watcher and an holy one coming down from heaven, and saying, Hew the tree down, and destroy it; yet leave the stump of the roots thereof in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts of the field, till seven times pass over him;
verses.text: And whereas the king saw a watcher and an holy one coming down from heaven, and saying, Hew the tree down, and destroy it; yet leave the stump of the roots thereof in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts of the field, till seven times pass over him;

verses.raw: This is the interpretation, O king, and this is the decree of the El Elyon (most High), which is come upon my lord the king:
verses.text: This is the interpretation, O king, and this is the decree of the El Elyon, which is come upon my lord the king:

verses.raw: That they shall drive you from men, and your dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field, and they shall make you to eat grass as oxen, and they shall wet you with the dew of heaven, and seven times shall pass over you, till you know that the El Elyon (most High) rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomsoever he will.
verses.text: That they shall drive you from men, and your dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field, and they shall make you to eat grass as oxen, and they shall wet you with the dew of heaven, and seven times shall pass over you, till you know that the El Elyon rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomsoever he will.

verses.raw: And whereas they commanded to leave the stump of the tree roots; your kingdom shall be sure unto you, after that you shall have known that the heavens do rule.
verses.text: And whereas they commanded to leave the stump of the tree roots; your kingdom shall be sure unto you, after that you shall have known that the heavens do rule.

verses.raw: Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto you, and break off your sins by righteousness, and your iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of your tranquillity.
verses.text: Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto you, and break off your sins by righteousness, and your iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of your tranquillity.

verses.raw: All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.text: All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.raw: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon.
verses.text: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon.

verses.raw: The king spake, and said, Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?
verses.text: The king spake, and said, Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?

verses.raw: While the word was in the king’s mouth, there fell a voice from heaven, saying, O king Nebuchadnezzar, to you it is spoken; The kingdom is departed from you.
verses.text: While the word was in the king’s mouth, there fell a voice from heaven, saying, O king Nebuchadnezzar, to you it is spoken; The kingdom is departed from you.

verses.raw: And they shall drive you from men, and your dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field: they shall make you to eat grass as oxen, and seven times shall pass over you, until you know that the El Elyon (most High) rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomsoever he will.
verses.text: And they shall drive you from men, and your dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field: they shall make you to eat grass as oxen, and seven times shall pass over you, until you know that the El Elyon rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomsoever he will.

verses.raw: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar: and he was driven from men, and did eat grass as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven, till his hairs were grown like eagles’ feathers, and his nails like birds’ claws.
verses.text: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar: and he was driven from men, and did eat grass as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven, till his hairs were grown like eagles’ feathers, and his nails like birds’ claws.

verses.raw: And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up my eyes unto heaven, and my understanding returned unto me, and I blessed the El Elyon (most High), and I praised and honoured him that lives for ever, whose dominion is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom is from generation to generation:
verses.text: And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up my eyes unto heaven, and my understanding returned unto me, and I blessed the El Elyon, and I praised and honoured him that lives for ever, whose dominion is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom is from generation to generation:

verses.raw: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing: and he does according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth: and none can stay his hand, or say unto him, What do you?
verses.text: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing: and he does according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth: and none can stay his hand, or say unto him, What do you?

verses.raw: At the same time my reason returned unto me; and for the glory of my kingdom, my honour and brightness returned unto me; and my counsellors and my lords sought unto me; and I was established in my kingdom, and excellent majesty was added unto me.
verses.text: At the same time my reason returned unto me; and for the glory of my kingdom, my honour and brightness returned unto me; and my counsellors and my lords sought unto me; and I was established in my kingdom, and excellent majesty was added unto me.

verses.raw: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven, all whose works are truth, and his ways judgment: and those that walk in pride he is able to abase.
verses.text: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven, all whose works are truth, and his ways judgment: and those that walk in pride he is able to abase.

verses.raw: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.
verses.text: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.

verses.raw: Belshazzar, whiles he tasted the wine, commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem; that the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, might drink therein.
verses.text: Belshazzar, whiles he tasted the wine, commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem; that the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, might drink therein.

verses.raw: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of Elohim (God) which was at Jerusalem; and the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, drank in them.
verses.text: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of Elohim which was at Jerusalem; and the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, drank in them.

verses.raw: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of brass, of iron, of wood, and of stone.
verses.text: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of brass, of iron, of wood, and of stone.

verses.raw: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man’s hand, and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaister of the wall of the king’s palace: and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.
verses.text: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man’s hand, and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaister of the wall of the king’s palace: and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.

verses.raw: Then the king’s countenance was changed, and his thoughts troubled him, so that the joints of his loins were loosed, and his knees smote one against another.
verses.text: Then the king’s countenance was changed, and his thoughts troubled him, so that the joints of his loins were loosed, and his knees smote one against another.

verses.raw: The king cried aloud to bring in the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers. And the king spake, and said to the wise men of Babylon, Whosoever shall read this writing, and shew me the interpretation thereof, shall be clothed with scarlet, and have a chain of gold about his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.
verses.text: The king cried aloud to bring in the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers. And the king spake, and said to the wise men of Babylon, Whosoever shall read this writing, and shew me the interpretation thereof, shall be clothed with scarlet, and have a chain of gold about his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.

verses.raw: Then came in all the king’s wise men: but they could not read the writing, nor make known to the king the interpretation thereof.
verses.text: Then came in all the king’s wise men: but they could not read the writing, nor make known to the king the interpretation thereof.

verses.raw: Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled, and his countenance was changed in him, and his lords were astonied.
verses.text: Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled, and his countenance was changed in him, and his lords were astonied.

verses.raw: Now the queen, by reason of the words of the king and his lords, came into the banquet house: and the queen spake and said, O king, live for ever: let not your thoughts trouble you, nor let your countenance be changed:
verses.text: Now the queen, by reason of the words of the king and his lords, came into the banquet house: and the queen spake and said, O king, live for ever: let not your thoughts trouble you, nor let your countenance be changed:

verses.raw: There is a man in your kingdom, in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of your father light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, was found in him; whom the king Nebuchadnezzar your father, the king, I say, your father, made master of the magicians, astrologers, Chaldeans, and soothsayers;
verses.text: There is a man in your kingdom, in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of your father light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, was found in him; whom the king Nebuchadnezzar your father, the king, I say, your father, made master of the magicians, astrologers, Chaldeans, and soothsayers;

verses.raw: Forasmuch as an excellent spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, interpreting of dreams, and shewing of hard sentences, and dissolving of doubts, were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar: now let Daniel be called, and he will shew the interpretation.
verses.text: Forasmuch as an excellent spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, interpreting of dreams, and shewing of hard sentences, and dissolving of doubts, were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar: now let Daniel be called, and he will shew the interpretation.

verses.raw: Then was Daniel brought in before the king. And the king spake and said unto Daniel, Are you that Daniel, which are of the children of the captivity of Yahudah (Judah), whom the king my father brought out of Jewry?
verses.text: Then was Daniel brought in before the king. And the king spake and said unto Daniel, Are you that Daniel, which are of the children of the captivity of Yahudah, whom the king my father brought out of Jewry?

verses.raw: I have even heard of you, that the spirit of the gods is in you, and that light and understanding and excellent wisdom is found in you.
verses.text: I have even heard of you, that the spirit of the gods is in you, and that light and understanding and excellent wisdom is found in you.

verses.raw: And now the wise men, the astrologers, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known unto me the interpretation thereof: but they could not shew the interpretation of the thing:
verses.text: And now the wise men, the astrologers, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known unto me the interpretation thereof: but they could not shew the interpretation of the thing:

verses.raw: And I have heard of you, that you can make interpretations, and dissolve doubts: now if you can read the writing, and make known to me the interpretation thereof, you shall be clothed with scarlet, and have a chain of gold about your neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.
verses.text: And I have heard of you, that you can make interpretations, and dissolve doubts: now if you can read the writing, and make known to me the interpretation thereof, you shall be clothed with scarlet, and have a chain of gold about your neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.

verses.raw: Then Daniel answered and said before the king, Let your gifts be to thyself, and give your rewards to another; yet I will read the writing unto the king, and make known to him the interpretation.
verses.text: Then Daniel answered and said before the king, Let your gifts be to thyself, and give your rewards to another; yet I will read the writing unto the king, and make known to him the interpretation.

verses.raw: O you king, the El Elyon (most high God) gave Nebuchadnezzar your father a kingdom, and majesty, and glory, and honour:
verses.text: O you king, the El Elyon (most high God) gave Nebuchadnezzar your father a kingdom, and majesty, and glory, and honour:

verses.raw: And for the majesty that he gave him, all people, nations, and languages, trembled and feared before him: whom he would he slew; and whom he would he kept alive; and whom he would he set up; and whom he would he put down.
verses.text: And for the majesty that he gave him, all people, nations, and languages, trembled and feared before him: whom he would he slew; and whom he would he kept alive; and whom he would he set up; and whom he would he put down.

verses.raw: But when his heart was lifted up, and his mind hardened in pride, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him:
verses.text: But when his heart was lifted up, and his mind hardened in pride, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him:

verses.raw: And he was driven from the sons of men; and his heart was made like the beasts, and his dwelling was with the wild asses: they fed him with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven; till he knew that the El Elyon (most high God) ruled in the kingdom of men, and that he appoints over it whomsoever he will.
verses.text: And he was driven from the sons of men; and his heart was made like the beasts, and his dwelling was with the wild asses: they fed him with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven; till he knew that the El Elyon (most high God) ruled in the kingdom of men, and that he appoints over it whomsoever he will.

verses.raw: And you his son, O Belshazzar, have not humbled your heart, though you knew all this;
verses.text: And you his son, O Belshazzar, have not humbled your heart, though you knew all this;

verses.raw: But have lifted up thyself against Yahuah (Lord) of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before you, and you, and your lords, your wives, and your concubines, have drunk wine in them; and you have praised the gods of silver, and gold, of brass, iron, wood, and stone, which see not, nor hear, nor know: and the Elohim (God) in whose hand your breath is, and whose are all your ways, have you not glorified:
verses.text: But have lifted up thyself against Yahuah of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before you, and you, and your lords, your wives, and your concubines, have drunk wine in them; and you have praised the gods of silver, and gold, of brass, iron, wood, and stone, which see not, nor hear, nor know: and the Elohim in whose hand your breath is, and whose are all your ways, have you not glorified:

verses.raw: Then was the part of the hand sent from him; and this writing was written.
verses.text: Then was the part of the hand sent from him; and this writing was written.

verses.raw: And this is the writing that was written, MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.
verses.text: And this is the writing that was written, MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.

verses.raw: This is the interpretation of the thing: MENE; Elohim (God) has numbered your kingdom, and finished it.
verses.text: This is the interpretation of the thing: MENE; Elohim has numbered your kingdom, and finished it.

verses.raw: TEKEL; You are weighed in the balances, and are found wanting.
verses.text: TEKEL; You are weighed in the balances, and are found wanting.

verses.raw: PERES; Your kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.
verses.text: PERES; Your kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.

verses.raw: Then commanded Belshazzar, and they clothed Daniel with scarlet, and put a chain of gold about his neck, and made a proclamation concerning him, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.
verses.text: Then commanded Belshazzar, and they clothed Daniel with scarlet, and put a chain of gold about his neck, and made a proclamation concerning him, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.

verses.raw: In that night was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain.
verses.text: In that night was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain.

verses.raw: And Darius the Median took the kingdom, being about threescore and two years old.
verses.text: And Darius the Median took the kingdom, being about threescore and two years old.

verses.raw: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom an hundred and twenty princes, which should be over the whole kingdom;
verses.text: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom an hundred and twenty princes, which should be over the whole kingdom;

verses.raw: And over these three presidents; of whom Daniel was first: that the princes might give accounts unto them, and the king should have no damage.
verses.text: And over these three presidents; of whom Daniel was first: that the princes might give accounts unto them, and the king should have no damage.

verses.raw: Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.
verses.text: Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.

verses.raw: Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom; but they could find none occasion nor fault; forasmuch as he was faithful, neither was there any error or fault found in him.
verses.text: Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom; but they could find none occasion nor fault; forasmuch as he was faithful, neither was there any error or fault found in him.

verses.raw: Then said these men, We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel, except we find it against him concerning the law of his Elohim (God).
verses.text: Then said these men, We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel, except we find it against him concerning the law of his Elohim.

verses.raw: Then these presidents and princes assembled together to the king, and said thus unto him, King Darius, live for ever.
verses.text: Then these presidents and princes assembled together to the king, and said thus unto him, King Darius, live for ever.

verses.raw: All the presidents of the kingdom, the governors, and the princes, the counsellors, and the captains, have consulted together to establish a royal statute, and to make a firm decree, that whosoever shall ask a petition of any Elohim (God) or man for thirty days, save of you, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.
verses.text: All the presidents of the kingdom, the governors, and the princes, the counsellors, and the captains, have consulted together to establish a royal statute, and to make a firm decree, that whosoever shall ask a petition of any Elohim or man for thirty days, save of you, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.

verses.raw: Now, O king, establish the decree, and sign the writing, that it be not changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.
verses.text: Now, O king, establish the decree, and sign the writing, that it be not changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.

verses.raw: Wherefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree.
verses.text: Wherefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree.

verses.raw: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his Elohim (God), as he did aforetime.
verses.text: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his Elohim, as he did aforetime.

verses.raw: Then these men assembled, and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his Elohim (God).
verses.text: Then these men assembled, and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his Elohim.

verses.raw: Then they came near, and spake before the king concerning the king’s decree; Have you not signed a decree, that every man that shall ask a petition of any Elohim (God) or man within thirty days, save of you, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions? The king answered and said, The thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.
verses.text: Then they came near, and spake before the king concerning the king’s decree; Have you not signed a decree, that every man that shall ask a petition of any Elohim or man within thirty days, save of you, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions? The king answered and said, The thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.

verses.raw: Then answered they and said before the king, That Daniel, which is of the children of the captivity of Yahudah (Judah), regards not you, O king, nor the decree that you have signed, but makes his petition three times a day.
verses.text: Then answered they and said before the king, That Daniel, which is of the children of the captivity of Yahudah, regards not you, O king, nor the decree that you have signed, but makes his petition three times a day.

verses.raw: Then the king, when he heard these words, was sore displeased with himself, and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him: and he laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver him.
verses.text: Then the king, when he heard these words, was sore displeased with himself, and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him: and he laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver him.

verses.raw: Then these men assembled unto the king, and said unto the king, Know, O king, that the law of the Medes and Persians is, That no decree nor statute which the king establishes may be changed.
verses.text: Then these men assembled unto the king, and said unto the king, Know, O king, that the law of the Medes and Persians is, That no decree nor statute which the king establishes may be changed.

verses.raw: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions. Now the king spake and said unto Daniel, Your Elohim (God) whom you servest continually, he will deliver you.
verses.text: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions. Now the king spake and said unto Daniel, Your Elohim whom you servest continually, he will deliver you.

verses.raw: And a stone was brought, and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel.
verses.text: And a stone was brought, and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel.

verses.raw: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting: neither were instruments of musick brought before him: and his sleep went from him.
verses.text: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting: neither were instruments of musick brought before him: and his sleep went from him.

verses.raw: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste unto the den of lions.
verses.text: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste unto the den of lions.

verses.raw: And when he came to the den, he cried with a lamentable voice unto Daniel: and the king spake and said to Daniel, O Daniel, servant of the living Elohim (God), is your Elohim (God), whom you servest continually, able to deliver you from the lions?
verses.text: And when he came to the den, he cried with a lamentable voice unto Daniel: and the king spake and said to Daniel, O Daniel, servant of the living Elohim, is your Elohim, whom you servest continually, able to deliver you from the lions?

verses.raw: Then said Daniel unto the king, O king, live for ever.
verses.text: Then said Daniel unto the king, O king, live for ever.

verses.raw: My Elohim (God) has sent his angel, and has shut the lions’ mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before you, O king, have I done no hurt.
verses.text: My Elohim has sent his angel, and has shut the lions’ mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before you, O king, have I done no hurt.

verses.raw: Then was the king exceeding glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he believed in his Elohim (God).
verses.text: Then was the king exceeding glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he believed in his Elohim.

verses.raw: And the king commanded, and they brought those men which had accused Daniel, and they cast them into the den of lions, them, their children, and their wives; and the lions had the mastery of them, and brake all their bones in pieces or ever they came at the bottom of the den.
verses.text: And the king commanded, and they brought those men which had accused Daniel, and they cast them into the den of lions, them, their children, and their wives; and the lions had the mastery of them, and brake all their bones in pieces or ever they came at the bottom of the den.

verses.raw: Then king Darius wrote unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.
verses.text: Then king Darius wrote unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.

verses.raw: I make a decree, That in every dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the Elohim (God) of Daniel: for he is the living Elohim (God), and stedfast for ever, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed, and his dominion shall be even unto the end.
verses.text: I make a decree, That in every dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the Elohim of Daniel: for he is the living Elohim, and stedfast for ever, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed, and his dominion shall be even unto the end.

verses.raw: He delivers and rescueth, and he works signs and wonders in heaven and in earth, who has delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.
verses.text: He delivers and rescueth, and he works signs and wonders in heaven and in earth, who has delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.

verses.raw: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.
verses.text: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.

verses.raw: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed: then he wrote the dream, and told the sum of the matters.
verses.text: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed: then he wrote the dream, and told the sum of the matters.

verses.raw: Daniel spake and said, I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea.
verses.text: Daniel spake and said, I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea.

verses.raw: And four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse one from another.
verses.text: And four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse one from another.

verses.raw: The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings: I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth, and made stand upon the feet as a man, and a man’s heart was given to it.
verses.text: The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings: I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth, and made stand upon the feet as a man, and a man’s heart was given to it.

verses.raw: And behold another beast, a second, like to a bear, and it raised up itself on one side, and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it: and they said thus unto it, Arise, devour much flesh.
verses.text: And behold another beast, a second, like to a bear, and it raised up itself on one side, and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it: and they said thus unto it, Arise, devour much flesh.

verses.raw: After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.
verses.text: After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.

verses.raw: After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.
verses.text: After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.

verses.raw: I considered the horns, and, behold, there came up among them another little horn, before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots: and, behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of man, and a mouth speaking great things.
verses.text: I considered the horns, and, behold, there came up among them another little horn, before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots: and, behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of man, and a mouth speaking great things.

verses.raw: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.
verses.text: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.

verses.raw: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.
verses.text: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

verses.raw: I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake: I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.
verses.text: I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake: I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.

verses.raw: As concerning the rest of the beasts, they had their dominion taken away: yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time.
verses.text: As concerning the rest of the beasts, they had their dominion taken away: yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time.

verses.raw: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.
verses.text: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

verses.raw: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.
verses.text: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.

verses.raw: I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.
verses.text: I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.

verses.raw: I came near unto one of them that stood by, and asked him the truth of all this. So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things.
verses.text: I came near unto one of them that stood by, and asked him the truth of all this. So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things.

verses.raw: These great beasts, which are four, are four kings, which shall arise out of the earth.
verses.text: These great beasts, which are four, are four kings, which shall arise out of the earth.

verses.raw: But the saints of the El Elyon (most High) shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.
verses.text: But the saints of the El Elyon shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.

verses.raw: Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others, exceeding dreadful, whose teeth were of iron, and his nails of brass; which devoured, brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with his feet;
verses.text: Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others, exceeding dreadful, whose teeth were of iron, and his nails of brass; which devoured, brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with his feet;

verses.raw: And of the ten horns that were in his head, and of the other which came up, and before whom three fell; even of that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things, whose look was more stout than his fellows.
verses.text: And of the ten horns that were in his head, and of the other which came up, and before whom three fell; even of that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things, whose look was more stout than his fellows.

verses.raw: I beheld, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them;
verses.text: I beheld, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them;

verses.raw: Until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the El Elyon (most High); and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.
verses.text: Until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the El Elyon; and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.

verses.raw: Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.
verses.text: Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.

verses.raw: And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise: and another shall rise after them; and he shall be diverse from the first, and he shall subdue three kings.
verses.text: And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise: and another shall rise after them; and he shall be diverse from the first, and he shall subdue three kings.

verses.raw: And he shall speak great words against the El Elyon (most High), and shall wear out the saints of the El Elyon (most High), and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.
verses.text: And he shall speak great words against the El Elyon, and shall wear out the saints of the El Elyon, and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.

verses.raw: But the judgment shall sit, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it unto the end.
verses.text: But the judgment shall sit, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it unto the end.

verses.raw: And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the El Elyon (most High), whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.
verses.text: And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the El Elyon, whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.

verses.raw: Hitherto is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my cogitations much troubled me, and my countenance changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart.
verses.text: Hitherto is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my cogitations much troubled me, and my countenance changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart.

verses.raw: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me, even unto me Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.
verses.text: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me, even unto me Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.

verses.raw: And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I was at Shushan in the palace, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river of Ulai.
verses.text: And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I was at Shushan in the palace, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river of Ulai.
