verses.raw: I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies.
verses.text: I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies.

verses.raw: Though you offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings, I will not accept them: neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts.
verses.text: Though you offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings, I will not accept them: neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts.

verses.raw: Take you away from me the noise of your songs; for I will not hear the melody of your viols.
verses.text: Take you away from me the noise of your songs; for I will not hear the melody of your viols.

verses.raw: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.
verses.text: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.

verses.raw: Have you offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: Have you offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: But you have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which you made to yourselves.
verses.text: But you have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which you made to yourselves.

verses.raw: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, says Yahuah (LORD), whose name is The Elohim (God) of hosts.
verses.text: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, says Yahuah, whose name is The Elohim of hosts.

verses.raw: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Yashar'el (Israel) came!
verses.text: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Yashar'el came!

verses.raw: Pass you unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go you to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: be they better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?
verses.text: Pass you unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go you to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: be they better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?

verses.raw: You that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
verses.text: You that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;

verses.raw: That lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;
verses.text: That lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;

verses.raw: That chant to the sound of the viol, and invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David;
verses.text: That chant to the sound of the viol, and invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David;

verses.raw: That drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments: but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.
verses.text: That drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments: but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.

verses.raw: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.
verses.text: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.

verses.raw: Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) has sworn by himself, says Yahuah (LORD) the Elohim (God) of hosts, I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces: therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein.
verses.text: Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) has sworn by himself, says Yahuah the Elohim of hosts, I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces: therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.

verses.raw: And a man’s uncle shall take him up, and he that burns him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say unto him that is by the sides of the house, Is there yet any with you? and he shall say, No. Then shall he say, Hold your tongue: for we may not make mention of the name of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And a man’s uncle shall take him up, and he that burns him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say unto him that is by the sides of the house, Is there yet any with you? and he shall say, No. Then shall he say, Hold your tongue: for we may not make mention of the name of Yahuah.

verses.raw: For, behold, Yahuah (LORD) commands, and he will smite the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts.
verses.text: For, behold, Yahuah commands, and he will smite the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts.

verses.raw: Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plow there with oxen? for you have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock:
verses.text: Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plow there with oxen? for you have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock:

verses.raw: You which rejoice in a thing of nought, which say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?
verses.text: You which rejoice in a thing of nought, which say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?

verses.raw: But, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Yashar'el (Israel), says Yahuah (LORD) the Elohim (God) of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hemath unto the river of the wilderness.
verses.text: But, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Yashar'el, says Yahuah the Elohim of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hemath unto the river of the wilderness.

verses.raw: Thus has Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) shewed unto me; and, behold, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king’s mowings.
verses.text: Thus has Adonai Yahuah shewed unto me; and, behold, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king’s mowings.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, O Adonai (Lord) GOD, forgive, I beseech you: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
verses.text: And it came to pass, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, O Adonai GOD, forgive, I beseech you: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) repented for this: It shall not be, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Yahuah repented for this: It shall not be, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus has Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) shewed unto me: and, behold, Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) called to contend by fire, and it devoured the great deep, and did eat up a part.
verses.text: Thus has Adonai Yahuah shewed unto me: and, behold, Adonai Yahuah called to contend by fire, and it devoured the great deep, and did eat up a part.

verses.raw: Then said I, O Adonai (Lord) GOD, cease, I beseech you: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
verses.text: Then said I, O Adonai GOD, cease, I beseech you: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) repented for this: This also shall not be, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Yahuah repented for this: This also shall not be, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus he shewed me: and, behold, Adonai (Lord) stood upon a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.
verses.text: Thus he shewed me: and, behold, Adonai stood upon a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Amos, what see you? And I said, A plumbline. Then said Adonai (Lord), Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Yashar'el (Israel): I will not again pass by them any more:
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto me, Amos, what see you? And I said, A plumbline. Then said Adonai, Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Yashar'el: I will not again pass by them any more:

verses.raw: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Yashar'el (Israel) shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.
verses.text: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Yashar'el shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.

verses.raw: Then Amaziah the priest of Beth-el sent to Jeroboam king of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Amos has conspired against you in the midst of the house of Yashar'el (Israel): the land is not able to bear all his words.
verses.text: Then Amaziah the priest of Beth-el sent to Jeroboam king of Yashar'el, saying, Amos has conspired against you in the midst of the house of Yashar'el: the land is not able to bear all his words.

verses.raw: For thus Amos says, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Yashar'el (Israel) shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.
verses.text: For thus Amos says, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Yashar'el shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.

verses.raw: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O you seer, go, flee you away into the land of Yahudah (Judah), and there eat bread, and prophesy there:
verses.text: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O you seer, go, flee you away into the land of Yahudah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:

verses.raw: But prophesy not again any more at Beth-el: for it is the king’s chapel, and it is the king’s court.
verses.text: But prophesy not again any more at Beth-el: for it is the king’s chapel, and it is the king’s court.

verses.raw: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:
verses.text: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) took me as I followed the flock, and Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Yahuah took me as I followed the flock, and Yahuah said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Now therefore hear you the word of Yahuah (LORD): You say, Prophesy not against Yashar'el (Israel), and drop not your word against the house of Isaac.
verses.text: Now therefore hear you the word of Yahuah: You say, Prophesy not against Yashar'el, and drop not your word against the house of Isaac.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); Your wife shall be an harlot in the city, and your sons and your daughters shall fall by the sword, and your land shall be divided by line; and you shall die in a polluted land: and Yashar'el (Israel) shall surely go into captivity forth of his land.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah; Your wife shall be an harlot in the city, and your sons and your daughters shall fall by the sword, and your land shall be divided by line; and you shall die in a polluted land: and Yashar'el shall surely go into captivity forth of his land.

verses.raw: Thus has Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) shewed unto me: and behold a basket of summer fruit.
verses.text: Thus has Adonai Yahuah shewed unto me: and behold a basket of summer fruit.

verses.raw: And he said, Amos, what see you? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto me, The end is come upon my people of Yashar'el (Israel); I will not again pass by them any more.
verses.text: And he said, Amos, what see you? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then said Yahuah unto me, The end is come upon my people of Yashar'el; I will not again pass by them any more.

verses.raw: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD): there shall be many dead bodies in every place; they shall cast them forth with silence.
verses.text: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day, says Adonai Yahuah: there shall be many dead bodies in every place; they shall cast them forth with silence.

verses.raw: Hear this, O you that swallow up the needy, even to make the poor of the land to fail,
verses.text: Hear this, O you that swallow up the needy, even to make the poor of the land to fail,

verses.raw: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?
verses.text: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?

verses.raw: That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; yea, and sell the refuse of the wheat?
verses.text: That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; yea, and sell the refuse of the wheat?

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has sworn by the excellency of Jacob, Surely I will never forget any of their works.
verses.text: Yahuah has sworn by the excellency of Jacob, Surely I will never forget any of their works.

verses.raw: Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that dwells therein? and it shall rise up wholly as a flood; and it shall be cast out and drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.
verses.text: Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that dwells therein? and it shall rise up wholly as a flood; and it shall be cast out and drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day:
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, says Adonai Yahuah, that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day:

verses.raw: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins, and baldness upon every head; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son, and the end thereof as a bitter day.
verses.text: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins, and baldness upon every head; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son, and the end thereof as a bitter day.

verses.raw: Behold, the days come, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: Behold, the days come, says Adonai Yahuah, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of Yahuah:

verses.raw: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek the word of Yahuah (LORD), and shall not find it.
verses.text: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek the word of Yahuah, and shall not find it.

verses.raw: In that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst.
verses.text: In that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst.

verses.raw: They that swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, Your god, O Dan, lives; and, The manner of Beer-sheba lives; even they shall fall, and never rise up again.
verses.text: They that swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, Your god, O Dan, lives; and, The manner of Beer-sheba lives; even they shall fall, and never rise up again.

verses.raw: I saw Adonai (Lord) standing upon the altar: and he said, Smite the lintel of the door, that the posts may shake: and cut them in the head, all of them; and I will slay the last of them with the sword: he that fleeth of them shall not flee away, and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered.
verses.text: I saw Adonai standing upon the altar: and he said, Smite the lintel of the door, that the posts may shake: and cut them in the head, all of them; and I will slay the last of them with the sword: he that fleeth of them shall not flee away, and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered.

verses.raw: Though they dig into hell, thence shall my hand take them; though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down:
verses.text: Though they dig into hell, thence shall my hand take them; though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down:

verses.raw: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, thence will I command the serpent, and he shall bite them:
verses.text: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, thence will I command the serpent, and he shall bite them:

verses.raw: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, thence will I command the sword, and it shall slay them: and I will set my eyes upon them for evil, and not for good.
verses.text: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, thence will I command the sword, and it shall slay them: and I will set my eyes upon them for evil, and not for good.

verses.raw: And Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts is he that touches the land, and it shall melt, and all that dwell therein shall mourn: and it shall rise up wholly like a flood; and shall be drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.
verses.text: And Adonai Yahuah of hosts is he that touches the land, and it shall melt, and all that dwell therein shall mourn: and it shall rise up wholly like a flood; and shall be drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.

verses.raw: It is he that builds his stories in the heaven, and has founded his troop in the earth; he that calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out upon the face of the earth: Yahuah (LORD) is his name.
verses.text: It is he that builds his stories in the heaven, and has founded his troop in the earth; he that calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out upon the face of the earth: Yahuah is his name.

verses.raw: Are you not as children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Yashar'el (Israel)? says Yahuah (LORD). Have not I brought up Yashar'el (Israel) out of the land of Egypt? and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?
verses.text: Are you not as children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Yashar'el? says Yahuah. Have not I brought up Yashar'el out of the land of Egypt? and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?

verses.raw: Behold, the eyes of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth; saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Behold, the eyes of Adonai Yahuah are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth; saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Yashar'el (Israel) among all nations, like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.
verses.text: For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Yashar'el among all nations, like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.

verses.raw: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.
verses.text: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.

verses.raw: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:
verses.text: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:

verses.raw: That they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the heathen, which are called by my name, says Yahuah (LORD) that does this.
verses.text: That they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the heathen, which are called by my name, says Yahuah that does this.

verses.raw: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that sows seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.
verses.text: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that sows seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.

verses.raw: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Yashar'el (Israel), and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.text: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Yashar'el, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

verses.raw: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, says Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God).
verses.text: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, says Yahuah Elohayka.

verses.raw: The vision of Obadiah. Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from Yahuah (LORD), and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise you, and let us rise up against her in battle.
verses.text: The vision of Obadiah. Thus says Adonai Yahuah concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from Yahuah, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise you, and let us rise up against her in battle.

verses.raw: Behold, I have made you small among the heathen: you are greatly despised.
verses.text: Behold, I have made you small among the heathen: you are greatly despised.

verses.raw: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you that dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that says in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?
verses.text: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you that dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that says in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?

verses.raw: Though you exalt thyself as the eagle, and though you set your nest among the stars, thence will I bring you down, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Though you exalt thyself as the eagle, and though you set your nest among the stars, thence will I bring you down, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: If thieves came to you, if robbers by night, (how art you cut off!) would they not have stolen till they had enough? if the grapegatherers came to you, would they not leave some grapes?
verses.text: If thieves came to you, if robbers by night, (how art you cut off!) would they not have stolen till they had enough? if the grapegatherers came to you, would they not leave some grapes?

verses.raw: How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!
verses.text: How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!

verses.raw: All the men of your confederacy have brought you even to the border: the men that were at peace with you have deceived you, and prevailed against you; they that eat your bread have laid a wound under you: there is none understanding in him.
verses.text: All the men of your confederacy have brought you even to the border: the men that were at peace with you have deceived you, and prevailed against you; they that eat your bread have laid a wound under you: there is none understanding in him.

verses.raw: Shall I not in that day, says Yahuah (LORD), even destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?
verses.text: Shall I not in that day, says Yahuah, even destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?

verses.raw: And your mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.
verses.text: And your mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.

verses.raw: For your violence against your brother Jacob shame shall cover you, and you shall be cut off for ever.
verses.text: For your violence against your brother Jacob shame shall cover you, and you shall be cut off for ever.

verses.raw: In the day that you stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even you were as one of them.
verses.text: In the day that you stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even you were as one of them.

verses.raw: But you should not have looked on the day of your brother in the day that he became a stranger; neither should you have rejoiced over the children of Yahudah (Judah) in the day of their destruction; neither should you have spoken proudly in the day of distress.
verses.text: But you should not have looked on the day of your brother in the day that he became a stranger; neither should you have rejoiced over the children of Yahudah in the day of their destruction; neither should you have spoken proudly in the day of distress.

verses.raw: You should not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity; yea, you should not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity, nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity;
verses.text: You should not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity; yea, you should not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity, nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity;

verses.raw: Neither should you have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape; neither should you have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress.
verses.text: Neither should you have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape; neither should you have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress.

verses.raw: For the day of Yahuah (LORD) is near upon all the heathen: as you have done, it shall be done unto you: your reward shall return upon your own head.
verses.text: For the day of Yahuah is near upon all the heathen: as you have done, it shall be done unto you: your reward shall return upon your own head.

verses.raw: For as you have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the heathen drink continually, yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been.
verses.text: For as you have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the heathen drink continually, yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been.

verses.raw: But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.
verses.text: But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.

verses.raw: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for Yahuah (LORD) has spoken it.
verses.text: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for Yahuah has spoken it.

verses.raw: And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau; and they of the plain the Philistines: and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim, and the fields of Samaria: and Benjamin shall possess Gilead.
verses.text: And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau; and they of the plain the Philistines: and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim, and the fields of Samaria: and Benjamin shall possess Gilead.

verses.raw: And the captivity of this host of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall possess that of the Canaanites, even unto Zarephath; and the captivity of Jerusalem, which is in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south.
verses.text: And the captivity of this host of the children of Yashar'el shall possess that of the Canaanites, even unto Zarephath; and the captivity of Jerusalem, which is in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south.

verses.raw: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the LORD’S.
verses.text: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the LORD’S.

verses.raw: Now the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,
verses.text: Now the word of Yahuah came unto Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,

verses.raw: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.
verses.text: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.

verses.raw: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of Yahuah (LORD), and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of Yahuah, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of Yahuah.

verses.raw: But Yahuah (LORD) sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.
verses.text: But Yahuah sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.

verses.raw: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god, and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.
verses.text: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god, and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.

verses.raw: So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest you, O sleeper? arise, call upon your Elohim (God), if so be that Elohim (God) will think upon us, that we perish not.
verses.text: So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest you, O sleeper? arise, call upon your Elohim, if so be that Elohim will think upon us, that we perish not.

verses.raw: And they said every one to his fellow, Come, and let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us. So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah.
verses.text: And they said every one to his fellow, Come, and let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us. So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah.

verses.raw: Then said they unto him, Tell us, we pray you, for whose cause this evil is upon us; What is your occupation? and whence come you? what is your country? and of what people are you?
verses.text: Then said they unto him, Tell us, we pray you, for whose cause this evil is upon us; What is your occupation? and whence come you? what is your country? and of what people are you?

verses.raw: And he said unto them, I am an Hebrew; and I fear Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of heaven, which has made the sea and the dry land.
verses.text: And he said unto them, I am an Hebrew; and I fear Yahuah, the Elohim of heaven, which has made the sea and the dry land.

verses.raw: Then were the men exceedingly afraid, and said unto him, Why have you done this? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of Yahuah (LORD), because he had told them.
verses.text: Then were the men exceedingly afraid, and said unto him, Why have you done this? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of Yahuah, because he had told them.

verses.raw: Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto you, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous.
verses.text: Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto you, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.
verses.text: And he said unto them, Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.

verses.raw: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land; but they could not: for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous against them.
verses.text: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land; but they could not: for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous against them.

verses.raw: Wherefore they cried unto Yahuah (LORD), and said, We beseech you, O Yahuah (LORD), we beseech you, let us not perish for this man’s life, and lay not upon us innocent blood: for you, O Yahuah (LORD), have done as it pleased you.
verses.text: Wherefore they cried unto Yahuah, and said, We beseech you, O Yahuah, we beseech you, let us not perish for this man’s life, and lay not upon us innocent blood: for you, O Yahuah, have done as it pleased you.

verses.raw: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from her raging.
verses.text: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from her raging.

verses.raw: Then the men feared Yahuah (LORD) exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice unto Yahuah (LORD), and made vows.
verses.text: Then the men feared Yahuah exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice unto Yahuah, and made vows.

verses.raw: Now Yahuah (LORD) had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
verses.text: Now Yahuah had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

verses.raw: Then Jonah prayed unto Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God) out of the fish’s belly,
verses.text: Then Jonah prayed unto Yahuah Elohav out of the fish’s belly,

verses.raw: And said, I cried by reason of my affliction unto Yahuah (LORD), and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, and you heard my voice.
verses.text: And said, I cried by reason of my affliction unto Yahuah, and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, and you heard my voice.

verses.raw: For you had cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas; and the floods compassed me about: all your billows and your waves passed over me.
verses.text: For you had cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas; and the floods compassed me about: all your billows and your waves passed over me.

verses.raw: Then I said, I am cast out of your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.
verses.text: Then I said, I am cast out of your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.

verses.raw: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the weeds were wrapped about my head.
verses.text: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the weeds were wrapped about my head.

verses.raw: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; the earth with her bars was about me for ever: yet have you brought up my life from corruption, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God).
verses.text: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; the earth with her bars was about me for ever: yet have you brought up my life from corruption, O Yahuah my Elohim.

verses.raw: When my soul fainted within me I remembered Yahuah (LORD): and my prayer came in unto you, into your holy temple.
verses.text: When my soul fainted within me I remembered Yahuah: and my prayer came in unto you, into your holy temple.

verses.raw: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
verses.text: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.

verses.raw: But I will sacrifice unto you with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But I will sacrifice unto you with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Jonah the second time, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto Jonah the second time, saying,

verses.raw: Arise, go unto Nineveh, that great city, and preach unto it the preaching that I bid you.
verses.text: Arise, go unto Nineveh, that great city, and preach unto it the preaching that I bid you.

verses.raw: So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD). Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days’ journey.
verses.text: So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of Yahuah. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days’ journey.

verses.raw: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.
verses.text: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.

verses.raw: So the people of Nineveh believed Elohim (God), and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.
verses.text: So the people of Nineveh believed Elohim, and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.

verses.raw: For word came unto the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and he laid his robe from him, and covered him with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.
verses.text: For word came unto the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and he laid his robe from him, and covered him with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.

verses.raw: And he caused it to be proclaimed and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste any thing: let them not feed, nor drink water:
verses.text: And he caused it to be proclaimed and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste any thing: let them not feed, nor drink water:

verses.raw: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and cry mightily unto Elohim (God): yea, let them turn every one from his evil way, and from the violence that is in their hands.
verses.text: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and cry mightily unto Elohim: yea, let them turn every one from his evil way, and from the violence that is in their hands.

verses.raw: Who can tell if Elohim (God) will turn and repent, and turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?
verses.text: Who can tell if Elohim will turn and repent, and turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and Elohim (God) repented of the evil, that he had said that he would do unto them; and he did it not.
verses.text: And Elohim saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and Elohim repented of the evil, that he had said that he would do unto them; and he did it not.

verses.raw: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was very angry.
verses.text: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was very angry.

verses.raw: And he prayed unto Yahuah (LORD), and said, I pray you, O Yahuah (LORD), was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that you are a gracious Elohim (God), and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest you of the evil.
verses.text: And he prayed unto Yahuah, and said, I pray you, O Yahuah, was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that you are a gracious Elohim, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest you of the evil.

verses.raw: Therefore now, O Yahuah (LORD), take, I beseech you, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.
verses.text: Therefore now, O Yahuah, take, I beseech you, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.

verses.raw: Then said Yahuah (LORD), Do you well to be angry?
verses.text: Then said Yahuah, Do you well to be angry?

verses.raw: So Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shadow, till he might see what would become of the city.
verses.text: So Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shadow, till he might see what would become of the city.

verses.raw: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) prepared a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shadow over his head, to deliver him from his grief. So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd.
verses.text: And Yahuah Elohim prepared a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shadow over his head, to deliver him from his grief. So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd.

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.
verses.text: But Elohim prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that Elohim (God) prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that Elohim prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) said to Jonah, Do you well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.
verses.text: And Elohim said to Jonah, Do you well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.

verses.raw: Then said Yahuah (LORD), You have had pity on the gourd, for the which you have not laboured, neither made it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:
verses.text: Then said Yahuah, You have had pity on the gourd, for the which you have not laboured, neither made it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:

verses.raw: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?
verses.text: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Yahudah (Judah), which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
verses.text: The word of Yahuah that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Yahudah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Hear, all you people; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) be witness against you, Adonai (Lord) from his holy temple.
verses.text: Hear, all you people; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let Adonai Yahuah be witness against you, Adonai from his holy temple.

verses.raw: For, behold, Yahuah (LORD) comes forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
verses.text: For, behold, Yahuah comes forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.

verses.raw: And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place.
verses.text: And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place.

verses.raw: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Yashar'el (Israel). What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Yahudah (Judah)? are they not Jerusalem?
verses.text: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Yashar'el. What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Yahudah? are they not Jerusalem?

verses.raw: Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field, and as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will discover the foundations thereof.
verses.text: Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field, and as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will discover the foundations thereof.

verses.raw: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.
verses.text: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.

verses.raw: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.
verses.text: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.

verses.raw: For her wound is incurable; for it is come unto Yahudah (Judah); he is come unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
verses.text: For her wound is incurable; for it is come unto Yahudah; he is come unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Declare you it not at Gath, weep you not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.
verses.text: Declare you it not at Gath, weep you not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.

verses.raw: Pass you away, you inhabitant of Saphir, having your shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth-ezel; he shall receive of you his standing.
verses.text: Pass you away, you inhabitant of Saphir, having your shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth-ezel; he shall receive of you his standing.

verses.raw: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from Yahuah (LORD) unto the gate of Jerusalem.
verses.text: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from Yahuah unto the gate of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: O you inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: for the transgressions of Yashar'el (Israel) were found in you.
verses.text: O you inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: for the transgressions of Yashar'el were found in you.

verses.raw: Therefore shall you give presents to Moresheth-gath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Therefore shall you give presents to Moresheth-gath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Yet will I bring an heir unto you, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Yet will I bring an heir unto you, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Make you bald, and poll you for your delicate children; enlarge your baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from you.
verses.text: Make you bald, and poll you for your delicate children; enlarge your baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from you.

verses.raw: Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.
verses.text: Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.

verses.raw: And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
verses.text: And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which you shall not remove your necks; neither shall you go haughtily: for this time is evil.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which you shall not remove your necks; neither shall you go haughtily: for this time is evil.

verses.raw: In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, and say, We be utterly spoiled: he has changed the portion of my people: how has he removed it from me! turning away he has divided our fields.
verses.text: In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, and say, We be utterly spoiled: he has changed the portion of my people: how has he removed it from me! turning away he has divided our fields.

verses.raw: Therefore you shall have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Therefore you shall have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Prophesy you not, say they to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame.
verses.text: Prophesy you not, say they to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame.

verses.raw: O you that are named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) straitened? are these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walks uprightly?
verses.text: O you that are named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of Yahuah straitened? are these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walks uprightly?

verses.raw: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: you pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.
verses.text: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: you pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.

verses.raw: The women of my people have you cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have you taken away my glory for ever.
verses.text: The women of my people have you cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have you taken away my glory for ever.

verses.raw: Arise you, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.
verses.text: Arise you, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.

verses.raw: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto you of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.
verses.text: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto you of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.

verses.raw: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of you; I will surely gather the remnant of Yashar'el (Israel); I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men.
verses.text: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of you; I will surely gather the remnant of Yashar'el; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men.

verses.raw: The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and are gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and Yahuah (LORD) on the head of them.
verses.text: The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and are gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and Yahuah on the head of them.

verses.raw: And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and you princes of the house of Yashar'el (Israel); Is it not for you to know judgment?
verses.text: And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and you princes of the house of Yashar'el; Is it not for you to know judgment?

verses.raw: Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;
verses.text: Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;

verses.raw: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.
verses.text: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.

verses.raw: Then shall they cry unto Yahuah (LORD), but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.
verses.text: Then shall they cry unto Yahuah, but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that puts not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that puts not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.

verses.raw: Therefore night shall be unto you, that you shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that you shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.
verses.text: Therefore night shall be unto you, that you shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that you shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.

verses.raw: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of Elohim.

verses.raw: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of Yahuah (LORD), and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Yashar'el (Israel) his sin.
verses.text: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of Yahuah, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Yashar'el his sin.

verses.raw: Hear this, I pray you, you heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.
verses.text: Hear this, I pray you, you heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Yashar'el, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.

verses.raw: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
verses.text: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

verses.raw: The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon Yahuah (LORD), and say, Is not Yahuah (LORD) among us? none evil can come upon us.
verses.text: The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon Yahuah, and say, Is not Yahuah among us? none evil can come upon us.

verses.raw: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.
verses.text: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.

verses.raw: But in the last days it shall come to pass, that the mountain of the house of Yahuah (LORD) shall be established in the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and people shall flow unto it.
verses.text: But in the last days it shall come to pass, that the mountain of the house of Yahuah shall be established in the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and people shall flow unto it.

verses.raw: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of Yahuah (LORD), and to the house of the Elohim (God) of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of Yahuah (LORD) from Jerusalem.
verses.text: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of Yahuah, and to the house of the Elohim of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of Yahuah from Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.text: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

verses.raw: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has spoken it.
verses.text: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of Yahuah Tseva'ot has spoken it.

verses.raw: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk in the name of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) for ever and ever.
verses.text: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk in the name of Yahuah Eloheinu for ever and ever.

verses.raw: In that day, says Yahuah (LORD), will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;
verses.text: In that day, says Yahuah, will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;

verses.raw: And I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and Yahuah (LORD) shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.
verses.text: And I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and Yahuah shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.

verses.raw: And you, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of the daughter of Zion, unto you shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.text: And you, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of the daughter of Zion, unto you shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Now why do you cry out aloud? is there no king in you? is your counsellor perished? for pangs have taken you as a woman in travail.
verses.text: Now why do you cry out aloud? is there no king in you? is your counsellor perished? for pangs have taken you as a woman in travail.

verses.raw: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shall you go forth out of the city, and you shall dwell in the field, and you shall go even to Babylon; there shall you be delivered; there Yahuah (LORD) shall redeem you from the hand of your enemies.
verses.text: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shall you go forth out of the city, and you shall dwell in the field, and you shall go even to Babylon; there shall you be delivered; there Yahuah shall redeem you from the hand of your enemies.

verses.raw: Now also many nations are gathered against you, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.
verses.text: Now also many nations are gathered against you, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.

verses.raw: But they know not the thoughts of Yahuah (LORD), neither understand they his counsel: for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor.
verses.text: But they know not the thoughts of Yahuah, neither understand they his counsel: for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor.

verses.raw: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs brass: and you shall beat in pieces many people: and I will consecrate their gain unto Yahuah (LORD), and their substance unto Adonai (Lord) of the whole earth.
verses.text: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs brass: and you shall beat in pieces many people: and I will consecrate their gain unto Yahuah, and their substance unto Adonai of the whole earth.

verses.raw: Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: he has laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge of Yashar'el (Israel) with a rod upon the cheek.
verses.text: Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: he has laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge of Yashar'el with a rod upon the cheek.

verses.raw: But you, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though you be little among the thousands of Yahudah (Judah), yet out of you shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Yashar'el (Israel); whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
verses.text: But you, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though you be little among the thousands of Yahudah, yet out of you shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Yashar'el; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.

verses.raw: Therefore will he give them up, until the time that she which travaileth has brought forth: then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Therefore will he give them up, until the time that she which travaileth has brought forth: then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of Yahuah (LORD), in the majesty of the name of Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God); and they shall abide: for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.
verses.text: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of Yahuah, in the majesty of the name of Yahuah Elohav; and they shall abide: for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.

verses.raw: And this man shall be the peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land: and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.
verses.text: And this man shall be the peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land: and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.

verses.raw: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof: thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian, when he comes into our land, and when he treads within our borders.
verses.text: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof: thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian, when he comes into our land, and when he treads within our borders.

verses.raw: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from Yahuah (LORD), as the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waits for the sons of men.
verses.text: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from Yahuah, as the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waits for the sons of men.

verses.raw: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, if he go through, both treads down, and tears in pieces, and none can deliver.
verses.text: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, if he go through, both treads down, and tears in pieces, and none can deliver.

verses.raw: Your hand shall be lifted up upon your adversaries, and all your enemies shall be cut off.
verses.text: Your hand shall be lifted up upon your adversaries, and all your enemies shall be cut off.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will cut off your horses out of the midst of you, and I will destroy your chariots:
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, says Yahuah, that I will cut off your horses out of the midst of you, and I will destroy your chariots:

verses.raw: And I will cut off the cities of your land, and throw down all your strong holds:
verses.text: And I will cut off the cities of your land, and throw down all your strong holds:

verses.raw: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of your hand; and you shall have no more soothsayers:
verses.text: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of your hand; and you shall have no more soothsayers:

verses.raw: Your graven images also will I cut off, and your standing images out of the midst of you; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands.
verses.text: Your graven images also will I cut off, and your standing images out of the midst of you; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands.

verses.raw: And I will pluck up your groves out of the midst of you: so will I destroy your cities.
verses.text: And I will pluck up your groves out of the midst of you: so will I destroy your cities.

verses.raw: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.
verses.text: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.

verses.raw: Hear you now what Yahuah (LORD) says; Arise, contend you before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.
verses.text: Hear you now what Yahuah says; Arise, contend you before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.

verses.raw: Hear you, O mountains, the LORD’S controversy, and you strong foundations of the earth: for Yahuah (LORD) has a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Hear you, O mountains, the LORD’S controversy, and you strong foundations of the earth: for Yahuah has a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Yashar'el.

verses.raw: O my people, what have I done unto you? and wherein have I wearied you? testify against me.
verses.text: O my people, what have I done unto you? and wherein have I wearied you? testify against me.

verses.raw: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of servants; and I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
verses.text: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of servants; and I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

verses.raw: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that you may know the righteousness of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that you may know the righteousness of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Wherewith shall I come before Yahuah (LORD), and bow myself before the high Elohim (God)? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?
verses.text: Wherewith shall I come before Yahuah, and bow myself before the high Elohim? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?

verses.raw: Will Yahuah (LORD) be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
verses.text: Will Yahuah be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

verses.raw: He has shewed you, O man, what is good; and what does Yahuah (LORD) require of you, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your Elohim (God)?
verses.text: He has shewed you, O man, what is good; and what does Yahuah require of you, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your Elohim?

verses.raw: The LORD’S voice cries unto the city, and the man of wisdom shall see your name: hear you the rod, and who has appointed it.
verses.text: The LORD’S voice cries unto the city, and the man of wisdom shall see your name: hear you the rod, and who has appointed it.

verses.raw: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?
verses.text: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?

verses.raw: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?
verses.text: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?

verses.raw: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
verses.text: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.

verses.raw: Therefore also will I make you sick in smiting you, in making you desolate because of your sins.
verses.text: Therefore also will I make you sick in smiting you, in making you desolate because of your sins.

verses.raw: You shall eat, but not be satisfied; and your casting down shall be in the midst of you; and you shall take hold, but shall not deliver; and that which you deliverest will I give up to the sword.
verses.text: You shall eat, but not be satisfied; and your casting down shall be in the midst of you; and you shall take hold, but shall not deliver; and that which you deliverest will I give up to the sword.

verses.raw: You shall sow, but you shall not reap; you shall tread the olives, but you shall not anoint you with oil; and sweet wine, but shall not drink wine.
verses.text: You shall sow, but you shall not reap; you shall tread the olives, but you shall not anoint you with oil; and sweet wine, but shall not drink wine.

verses.raw: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and you walk in their counsels; that I should make you a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore you shall bear the reproach of my people.
verses.text: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and you walk in their counsels; that I should make you a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore you shall bear the reproach of my people.

verses.raw: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit.
verses.text: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit.

verses.raw: The good man is perished out of the earth: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.
verses.text: The good man is perished out of the earth: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.

verses.raw: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asks, and the judge asks for a reward; and the great man, he utters his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up.
verses.text: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asks, and the judge asks for a reward; and the great man, he utters his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up.

verses.raw: The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of your watchmen and your visitation comes; now shall be their perplexity.
verses.text: The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of your watchmen and your visitation comes; now shall be their perplexity.

verses.raw: Trust you not in a friend, put you not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of your mouth from her that lies in your bosom.
verses.text: Trust you not in a friend, put you not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of your mouth from her that lies in your bosom.

verses.raw: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.
verses.text: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.

verses.raw: Therefore I will look unto Yahuah (LORD); I will wait for the Elohim (God) of my salvation: my Elohim (God) will hear me.
verses.text: Therefore I will look unto Yahuah; I will wait for the Elohim of my salvation: my Elohim will hear me.

verses.raw: Rejoice not against me, O my enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, Yahuah (LORD) shall be a light unto me.
verses.text: Rejoice not against me, O my enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, Yahuah shall be a light unto me.

verses.raw: I will bear the indignation of Yahuah (LORD), because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, and I shall behold his righteousness.
verses.text: I will bear the indignation of Yahuah, because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, and I shall behold his righteousness.

verses.raw: Then she that is my enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God)? my eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.
verses.text: Then she that is my enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is Yahuah Elohayka? my eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.

verses.raw: In the day that your walls are to be built, in that day shall the decree be far removed.
verses.text: In the day that your walls are to be built, in that day shall the decree be far removed.

verses.raw: In that day also he shall come even to you from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.
verses.text: In that day also he shall come even to you from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
verses.text: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.

verses.raw: Feed your people with your rod, the flock of your heritage, which dwell solitarily in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
verses.text: Feed your people with your rod, the flock of your heritage, which dwell solitarily in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

verses.raw: According to the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things.
verses.text: According to the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things.

verses.raw: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.
verses.text: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.

verses.raw: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), and shall fear because of you.
verses.text: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of Yahuah Eloheinu, and shall fear because of you.

verses.raw: Who is a Elohim (God) like unto you, that pardoneth iniquity, and passes by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delights in mercy.
verses.text: Who is a Elohim like unto you, that pardoneth iniquity, and passes by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delights in mercy.
