verses.raw: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of Yahuah unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: Who are you, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel you shall become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.
verses.text: Who are you, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel you shall become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.

verses.raw: Moreover the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Moreover the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and you shall know that Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has sent me unto you.
verses.text: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and you shall know that Yahuah Tseva'ot has sent me unto you.

verses.raw: For who has despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of Yahuah (LORD), which run to and fro through the whole earth.
verses.text: For who has despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of Yahuah, which run to and fro through the whole earth.

verses.raw: Then answered I, and said unto him, What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?
verses.text: Then answered I, and said unto him, What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?

verses.raw: And I answered again, and said unto him, What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?
verses.text: And I answered again, and said unto him, What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?

verses.raw: And he answered me and said, Know you not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
verses.text: And he answered me and said, Know you not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.

verses.raw: Then said he, These are the two anointed ones, that stand by Adonai (Lord) of the whole earth.
verses.text: Then said he, These are the two anointed ones, that stand by Adonai of the whole earth.

verses.raw: Then I turned, and lifted up my eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll.
verses.text: Then I turned, and lifted up my eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll.

verses.raw: And he said unto me, What see you? And I answered, I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.
verses.text: And he said unto me, What see you? And I answered, I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.

verses.raw: Then said he unto me, This is the curse that goes forth over the face of the whole earth: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it; and every one that swears shall be cut off as on that side according to it.
verses.text: Then said he unto me, This is the curse that goes forth over the face of the whole earth: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it; and every one that swears shall be cut off as on that side according to it.

verses.raw: I will bring it forth, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that swears falsely by my name: and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.
verses.text: I will bring it forth, says Yahuah Tseva'ot, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that swears falsely by my name: and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.

verses.raw: Then the angel that talked with me went forth, and said unto me, Lift up now your eyes, and see what is this that goes forth.
verses.text: Then the angel that talked with me went forth, and said unto me, Lift up now your eyes, and see what is this that goes forth.

verses.raw: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is an ephah that goes forth. He said moreover, This is their resemblance through all the earth.
verses.text: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is an ephah that goes forth. He said moreover, This is their resemblance through all the earth.

verses.raw: And, behold, there was lifted up a talent of lead: and this is a woman that sits in the midst of the ephah.
verses.text: And, behold, there was lifted up a talent of lead: and this is a woman that sits in the midst of the ephah.

verses.raw: And he said, This is wickedness. And he cast it into the midst of the ephah; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.
verses.text: And he said, This is wickedness. And he cast it into the midst of the ephah; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.

verses.raw: Then lifted I up my eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came out two women, and the wind was in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.
verses.text: Then lifted I up my eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came out two women, and the wind was in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.

verses.raw: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?
verses.text: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?

verses.raw: And he said unto me, To build it an house in the land of Shinar: and it shall be established, and set there upon her own base.
verses.text: And he said unto me, To build it an house in the land of Shinar: and it shall be established, and set there upon her own base.

verses.raw: And I turned, and lifted up my eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.
verses.text: And I turned, and lifted up my eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.

verses.raw: In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;
verses.text: In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;

verses.raw: And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.
verses.text: And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.

verses.raw: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me, What are these, my lord?
verses.text: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me, What are these, my lord?

verses.raw: And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before Adonai (Lord) of all the earth.
verses.text: And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before Adonai of all the earth.

verses.raw: The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the grisled go forth toward the south country.
verses.text: The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the grisled go forth toward the south country.

verses.raw: And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.
verses.text: And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.

verses.raw: Then cried he upon me, and spake unto me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.
verses.text: Then cried he upon me, and spake unto me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, which are come from Babylon, and come you the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah;
verses.text: Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, which are come from Babylon, and come you the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah;

verses.raw: Then take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest;
verses.text: Then take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest;

verses.raw: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaks Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), saying, Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaks Yahuah Tseva'ot, saying, Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of Yahuah:

verses.raw: Even he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD); and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.
verses.text: Even he shall build the temple of Yahuah; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

verses.raw: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of Yahuah (LORD), and you shall know that Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has sent me unto you. And this shall come to pass, if you will diligently obey the voice of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of Yahuah, and you shall know that Yahuah Tseva'ot has sent me unto you. And this shall come to pass, if you will diligently obey the voice of Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu;
verses.text: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of Yahuah came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu;

verses.raw: When they had sent unto the house of Elohim (God) Sherezer and Regem-melech, and their men, to pray before Yahuah (LORD),
verses.text: When they had sent unto the house of Elohim Sherezer and Regem-melech, and their men, to pray before Yahuah,

verses.raw: And to speak unto the priests which were in the house of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?
verses.text: And to speak unto the priests which were in the house of Yahuah Tseva'ot, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?

verses.raw: Then came the word of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) unto me, saying,
verses.text: Then came the word of Yahuah Tseva'ot unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month, even those seventy years, did you at all fast unto me, even to me?
verses.text: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month, even those seventy years, did you at all fast unto me, even to me?

verses.raw: And when you did eat, and when you did drink, did not you eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?
verses.text: And when you did eat, and when you did drink, did not you eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?

verses.raw: Should you not hear the words which Yahuah (LORD) has cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, when men inhabited the south and the plain?
verses.text: Should you not hear the words which Yahuah has cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, when men inhabited the south and the plain?

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Zechariah, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto Zechariah, saying,

verses.raw: Thus speaks Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), saying, Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother:
verses.text: Thus speaks Yahuah Tseva'ot, saying, Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother:

verses.raw: And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.
verses.text: And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.

verses.raw: But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they should not hear.
verses.text: But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they should not hear.

verses.raw: Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has sent in his spirit by the former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which Yahuah Tseva'ot has sent in his spirit by the former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: Therefore it is come to pass, that as he cried, and they would not hear; so they cried, and I would not hear, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts):
verses.text: Therefore it is come to pass, that as he cried, and they would not hear; so they cried, and I would not hear, says Yahuah Tseva'ot:

verses.raw: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not. Thus the land was desolate after them, that no man passed through nor returned: for they laid the pleasant land desolate.
verses.text: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not. Thus the land was desolate after them, that no man passed through nor returned: for they laid the pleasant land desolate.

verses.raw: Again the word of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) came to me, saying,
verses.text: Again the word of Yahuah Tseva'ot came to me, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I was jealous for her with great fury.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I was jealous for her with great fury.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) the holy mountain.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of Yahuah Tseva'ot the holy mountain.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, and every man with his staff in his hand for very age.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, and every man with his staff in his hand for very age.

verses.raw: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.
verses.text: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be marvellous in my eyes? says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be marvellous in my eyes? says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;

verses.raw: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their Elohim (God), in truth and in righteousness.
verses.text: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their Elohim, in truth and in righteousness.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Let your hands be strong, you that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, which were in the day that the foundation of the house of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) was laid, that the temple might be built.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; Let your hands be strong, you that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, which were in the day that the foundation of the house of Yahuah Tseva'ot was laid, that the temple might be built.

verses.raw: For before these days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither was there any peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction: for I set all men every one against his neighbour.
verses.text: For before these days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither was there any peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction: for I set all men every one against his neighbour.

verses.raw: But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: For the seed shall be prosperous; the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.
verses.text: For the seed shall be prosperous; the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that as you were a curse among the heathen, O house of Yahudah (Judah), and house of Yashar'el (Israel); so will I save you, and you shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that as you were a curse among the heathen, O house of Yahudah, and house of Yashar'el; so will I save you, and you shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and I repented not:
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, says Yahuah Tseva'ot, and I repented not:

verses.raw: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Yahudah (Judah): fear you not.
verses.text: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Yahudah: fear you not.

verses.raw: These are the things that you shall do; Speak you every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:
verses.text: These are the things that you shall do; Speak you every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:

verses.raw: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah Tseva'ot came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); The fast of the fourth month, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Yahudah (Judah) joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts; therefore love the truth and peace.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; The fast of the fourth month, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Yahudah joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts; therefore love the truth and peace.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); It shall yet come to pass, that there shall come people, and the inhabitants of many cities:
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; It shall yet come to pass, that there shall come people, and the inhabitants of many cities:

verses.raw: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before Yahuah (LORD), and to seek Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): I will go also.
verses.text: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before Yahuah, and to seek Yahuah Tseva'ot: I will go also.

verses.raw: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) in Jerusalem, and to pray before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek Yahuah Tseva'ot in Jerusalem, and to pray before Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Yahudi (Jew), saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that Elohim (God) is with you.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Yahudi, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that Elohim is with you.

verses.raw: The burden of the word of Yahuah (LORD) in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), shall be toward Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: The burden of the word of Yahuah in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Yashar'el, shall be toward Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.
verses.text: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.

verses.raw: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.
verses.text: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.

verses.raw: Behold, Adonai (Lord) will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.
verses.text: Behold, Adonai will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.

verses.raw: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
verses.text: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.

verses.raw: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
verses.text: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

verses.raw: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remains, even he, shall be for our Elohim (God), and he shall be as a governor in Yahudah (Judah), and Ekron as a Jebusite.
verses.text: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remains, even he, shall be for our Elohim, and he shall be as a governor in Yahudah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.

verses.raw: And I will encamp about my house because of the army, because of him that passes by, and because of him that returns: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with my eyes.
verses.text: And I will encamp about my house because of the army, because of him that passes by, and because of him that returns: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with my eyes.

verses.raw: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, your King comes unto you: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.
verses.text: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, your King comes unto you: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.

verses.raw: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from the river even to the ends of the earth.
verses.text: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from the river even to the ends of the earth.

verses.raw: As for you also, by the blood of your covenant I have sent forth your prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.
verses.text: As for you also, by the blood of your covenant I have sent forth your prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.

verses.raw: Turn you to the strong hold, you prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto you;
verses.text: Turn you to the strong hold, you prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto you;

verses.raw: When I have bent Yahudah (Judah) for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up your sons, O Zion, against your sons, O Greece, and made you as the sword of a mighty man.
verses.text: When I have bent Yahudah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up your sons, O Zion, against your sons, O Greece, and made you as the sword of a mighty man.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.
verses.text: And Yahuah shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and Adonai Yahuah shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.

verses.raw: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar.
verses.text: Yahuah Tseva'ot shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God) shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.
verses.text: And Yahuah their Elohim shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.

verses.raw: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.
verses.text: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.

verses.raw: Ask you of Yahuah (LORD) rain in the time of the latter rain; so Yahuah (LORD) shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.
verses.text: Ask you of Yahuah rain in the time of the latter rain; so Yahuah shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.

verses.raw: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because there was no shepherd.
verses.text: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because there was no shepherd.

verses.raw: My anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has visited his flock the house of Yahudah (Judah), and has made them as his goodly horse in the battle.
verses.text: My anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for Yahuah Tseva'ot has visited his flock the house of Yahudah, and has made them as his goodly horse in the battle.

verses.raw: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.
verses.text: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.

verses.raw: And they shall be as mighty men, which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because Yahuah (LORD) is with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.
verses.text: And they shall be as mighty men, which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because Yahuah is with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.

verses.raw: And I will strengthen the house of Yahudah (Judah), and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I am Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), and will hear them.
verses.text: And I will strengthen the house of Yahudah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I am Yahuah their Elohim, and will hear them.

verses.raw: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see it, and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see it, and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in Yahuah.

verses.raw: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.
verses.text: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.

verses.raw: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.
verses.text: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.

verses.raw: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and place shall not be found for them.
verses.text: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and place shall not be found for them.

verses.raw: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction, and shall smite the waves in the sea, and all the deeps of the river shall dry up: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.
verses.text: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction, and shall smite the waves in the sea, and all the deeps of the river shall dry up: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.

verses.raw: And I will strengthen them in Yahuah (LORD); and they shall walk up and down in his name, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will strengthen them in Yahuah; and they shall walk up and down in his name, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Open your doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour your cedars.
verses.text: Open your doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour your cedars.

verses.raw: Howl, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are spoiled: howl, O you oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.
verses.text: Howl, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are spoiled: howl, O you oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.

verses.raw: There is a voice of the howling of the shepherds; for their glory is spoiled: a voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled.
verses.text: There is a voice of the howling of the shepherds; for their glory is spoiled: a voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God); Feed the flock of the slaughter;
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Elohai; Feed the flock of the slaughter;

verses.raw: Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: and they that sell them say, Blessed be Yahuah (LORD); for I am rich: and their own shepherds pity them not.
verses.text: Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: and they that sell them say, Blessed be Yahuah; for I am rich: and their own shepherds pity them not.

verses.raw: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, says Yahuah (LORD): but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour’s hand, and into the hand of his king: and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.
verses.text: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, says Yahuah: but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour’s hand, and into the hand of his king: and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.

verses.raw: And I will feed the flock of slaughter, even you, O poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.
verses.text: And I will feed the flock of slaughter, even you, O poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.

verses.raw: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.
verses.text: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.

verses.raw: Then said I, I will not feed you: that that dies, let it die; and that that is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another.
verses.text: Then said I, I will not feed you: that that dies, let it die; and that that is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another.

verses.raw: And I took my staff, even Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.
verses.text: And I took my staff, even Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.

verses.raw: And it was broken in that day: and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it was the word of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And it was broken in that day: and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it was the word of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And I said unto them, If you think good, give me my price; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver.
verses.text: And I said unto them, If you think good, give me my price; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Then I cut asunder my other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Yahudah (Judah) and Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Then I cut asunder my other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Yahudah and Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Take unto you yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto me, Take unto you yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.

verses.raw: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, which shall not visit those that be cut off, neither shall seek the young one, nor heal that that is broken, nor feed that that stands still: but he shall eat the flesh of the fat, and tear their claws in pieces.
verses.text: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, which shall not visit those that be cut off, neither shall seek the young one, nor heal that that is broken, nor feed that that stands still: but he shall eat the flesh of the fat, and tear their claws in pieces.

verses.raw: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.
verses.text: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.

verses.raw: The burden of the word of Yahuah (LORD) for Yashar'el (Israel), says Yahuah (LORD), which stretcheth forth the heavens, and lays the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him.
verses.text: The burden of the word of Yahuah for Yashar'el, says Yahuah, which stretcheth forth the heavens, and lays the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him.

verses.raw: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling unto all the people round about, when they shall be in the siege both against Yahudah (Judah) and against Jerusalem.
verses.text: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling unto all the people round about, when they shall be in the siege both against Yahudah and against Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces, though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.
verses.text: And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces, though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.

verses.raw: In that day, says Yahuah (LORD), I will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness: and I will open my eyes upon the house of Yahudah (Judah), and will smite every horse of the people with blindness.
verses.text: In that day, says Yahuah, I will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness: and I will open my eyes upon the house of Yahudah, and will smite every horse of the people with blindness.

verses.raw: And the governors of Yahudah (Judah) shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength in Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) their Elohim (God).
verses.text: And the governors of Yahudah shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength in Yahuah Tseva'ot their Elohim.

verses.raw: In that day will I make the governors of Yahudah (Judah) like an hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf; and they shall devour all the people round about, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, even in Jerusalem.
verses.text: In that day will I make the governors of Yahudah like an hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf; and they shall devour all the people round about, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, even in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) also shall save the tents of Yahudah (Judah) first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: Yahuah also shall save the tents of Yahudah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Yahudah.

verses.raw: In that day shall Yahuah (LORD) defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David shall be as Elohim (God), as the angel of Yahuah (LORD) before them.
verses.text: In that day shall Yahuah defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David shall be as Elohim, as the angel of Yahuah before them.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourns for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.
verses.text: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourns for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.

verses.raw: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.
verses.text: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.

verses.raw: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;
verses.text: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;

verses.raw: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;
verses.text: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;

verses.raw: All the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.
verses.text: All the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.

verses.raw: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.
verses.text: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, says Yahuah Tseva'ot, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, You shall not live; for you speak lies in the name of Yahuah (LORD): and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, You shall not live; for you speak lies in the name of Yahuah: and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he has prophesied; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive:
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he has prophesied; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive:

verses.raw: But he shall say, I am no prophet, I am an husbandman; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.
verses.text: But he shall say, I am no prophet, I am an husbandman; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.

verses.raw: And one shall say unto him, What are these wounds in your hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.
verses.text: And one shall say unto him, What are these wounds in your hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.

verses.raw: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn my hand upon the little ones.
verses.text: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, says Yahuah Tseva'ot: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn my hand upon the little ones.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, says Yahuah (LORD), two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, says Yahuah, two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein.

verses.raw: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, Yahuah (LORD) is my Elohim (God).
verses.text: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, Yahuah is my Elohim.

verses.raw: Behold, the day of Yahuah (LORD) comes, and your spoil shall be divided in the midst of you.
verses.text: Behold, the day of Yahuah comes, and your spoil shall be divided in the midst of you.

verses.raw: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city.
verses.text: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city.

verses.raw: Then shall Yahuah (LORD) go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.
verses.text: Then shall Yahuah go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.

verses.raw: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, and there shall be a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south.
verses.text: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, and there shall be a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

verses.raw: And you shall flee to the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: yea, you shall flee, like as you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Yahudah (Judah): and Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God) shall come, and all the saints with you.
verses.text: And you shall flee to the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: yea, you shall flee, like as you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Yahudah: and Yahuah Elohai shall come, and all the saints with you.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the light shall not be clear, nor dark:
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the light shall not be clear, nor dark:

verses.raw: But it shall be one day which shall be known to Yahuah (LORD), not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.
verses.text: But it shall be one day which shall be known to Yahuah, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.

verses.raw: And it shall be in that day, that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the former sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be.
verses.text: And it shall be in that day, that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the former sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one Yahuah (LORD), and his name one.
verses.text: And Yahuah shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one Yahuah, and his name one.

verses.raw: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem: and it shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin’s gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king’s winepresses.
verses.text: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem: and it shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin’s gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king’s winepresses.

verses.raw: And men shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.
verses.text: And men shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.

verses.raw: And this shall be the plague wherewith Yahuah (LORD) will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.
verses.text: And this shall be the plague wherewith Yahuah will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a great tumult from Yahuah (LORD) shall be among them; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a great tumult from Yahuah shall be among them; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) also shall fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together, gold, and silver, and apparel, in great abundance.
verses.text: And Yahudah also shall fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together, gold, and silver, and apparel, in great abundance.

verses.raw: And so shall be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents, as this plague.
verses.text: And so shall be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents, as this plague.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and to keep the feast of tabernacles.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, Yahuah Tseva'ot, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.

verses.raw: And it shall be, that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), even upon them shall be no rain.
verses.text: And it shall be, that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, Yahuah Tseva'ot, even upon them shall be no rain.

verses.raw: And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, that have no rain; there shall be the plague, wherewith Yahuah (LORD) will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
verses.text: And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, that have no rain; there shall be the plague, wherewith Yahuah will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.

verses.raw: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
verses.text: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.

verses.raw: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE Yahuah (LORD); and the pots in the LORD’S house shall be like the bowls before the altar.
verses.text: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE Yahuah; and the pots in the LORD’S house shall be like the bowls before the altar.

verses.raw: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Yahudah (Judah) shall be holiness unto Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein: and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Yahudah shall be holiness unto Yahuah Tseva'ot: and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein: and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: The burden of the word of Yahuah (LORD) to Yashar'el (Israel) by Malachi.
verses.text: The burden of the word of Yahuah to Yashar'el by Malachi.

verses.raw: I have loved you, says Yahuah (LORD). Yet you say, Wherein have you loved us? Was not Esau Jacob’s brother? says Yahuah (LORD): yet I loved Jacob,
verses.text: I have loved you, says Yahuah. Yet you say, Wherein have you loved us? Was not Esau Jacob’s brother? says Yahuah: yet I loved Jacob,

verses.raw: And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.
verses.text: And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.

verses.raw: Whereas Edom says, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom Yahuah (LORD) has indignation for ever.
verses.text: Whereas Edom says, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom Yahuah has indignation for ever.

verses.raw: And your eyes shall see, and you shall say, Yahuah (LORD) will be magnified from the border of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And your eyes shall see, and you shall say, Yahuah will be magnified from the border of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: A son honoureth his father, and a servant his master: if then I be a father, where is my honour? and if I be a master, where is my fear? says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) unto you, O priests, that despise my name. And you say, Wherein have we despised your name?
verses.text: A son honoureth his father, and a servant his master: if then I be a father, where is my honour? and if I be a master, where is my fear? says Yahuah Tseva'ot unto you, O priests, that despise my name. And you say, Wherein have we despised your name?

verses.raw: You offer polluted bread upon my altar; and you say, Wherein have we polluted you? In that you say, The table of Yahuah (LORD) is contemptible.
verses.text: You offer polluted bread upon my altar; and you say, Wherein have we polluted you? In that you say, The table of Yahuah is contemptible.

verses.raw: And if you offer the blind for sacrifice, is it not evil? and if you offer the lame and sick, is it not evil? offer it now unto your governor; will he be pleased with you, or accept your person? says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: And if you offer the blind for sacrifice, is it not evil? and if you offer the lame and sick, is it not evil? offer it now unto your governor; will he be pleased with you, or accept your person? says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: And now, I pray you, beseech Elohim (God) that he will be gracious unto us: this has been by your means: will he regard your persons? says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: And now, I pray you, beseech Elohim that he will be gracious unto us: this has been by your means: will he regard your persons? says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: Who is there even among you that would shut the doors for nought? neither do you kindle fire on my altar for nought. I have no pleasure in you, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), neither will I accept an offering at your hand.
verses.text: Who is there even among you that would shut the doors for nought? neither do you kindle fire on my altar for nought. I have no pleasure in you, says Yahuah Tseva'ot, neither will I accept an offering at your hand.

verses.raw: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name shall be great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name shall be great among the heathen, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name shall be great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name shall be great among the heathen, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: But you have profaned it, in that you say, The table of Yahuah (LORD) is polluted; and the fruit thereof, even his meat, is contemptible.
verses.text: But you have profaned it, in that you say, The table of Yahuah is polluted; and the fruit thereof, even his meat, is contemptible.

verses.raw: You said also, Behold, what a weariness is it! and you have snuffed at it, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); and you brought that which was torn, and the lame, and the sick; thus you brought an offering: should I accept this of your hand? says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: You said also, Behold, what a weariness is it! and you have snuffed at it, says Yahuah Tseva'ot; and you brought that which was torn, and the lame, and the sick; thus you brought an offering: should I accept this of your hand? says Yahuah.

verses.raw: But cursed be the deceiver, which has in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth unto Adonai (Lord) a corrupt thing: for I am a great King, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and my name is dreadful among the heathen.
verses.text: But cursed be the deceiver, which has in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth unto Adonai a corrupt thing: for I am a great King, says Yahuah Tseva'ot, and my name is dreadful among the heathen.

verses.raw: And now, O you priests, this commandment is for you.
verses.text: And now, O you priests, this commandment is for you.

verses.raw: If you will not hear, and if you will not lay it to heart, to give glory unto my name, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings: yea, I have cursed them already, because you do not lay it to heart.
verses.text: If you will not hear, and if you will not lay it to heart, to give glory unto my name, says Yahuah Tseva'ot, I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings: yea, I have cursed them already, because you do not lay it to heart.

verses.raw: Behold, I will corrupt your seed, and spread dung upon your faces, even the dung of your solemn feasts; and one shall take you away with it.
verses.text: Behold, I will corrupt your seed, and spread dung upon your faces, even the dung of your solemn feasts; and one shall take you away with it.

verses.raw: And you shall know that I have sent this commandment unto you, that my covenant might be with Levi, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: And you shall know that I have sent this commandment unto you, that my covenant might be with Levi, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him for the fear wherewith he feared me, and was afraid before my name.
verses.text: My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him for the fear wherewith he feared me, and was afraid before my name.

verses.raw: The law of truth was in his mouth, and iniquity was not found in his lips: he walked with me in peace and equity, and did turn many away from iniquity.
verses.text: The law of truth was in his mouth, and iniquity was not found in his lips: he walked with me in peace and equity, and did turn many away from iniquity.

verses.raw: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he is the messenger of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he is the messenger of Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: But you are departed out of the way; you have caused many to stumble at the law; you have corrupted the covenant of Levi, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: But you are departed out of the way; you have caused many to stumble at the law; you have corrupted the covenant of Levi, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people, according as you have not kept my ways, but have been partial in the law.
verses.text: Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people, according as you have not kept my ways, but have been partial in the law.

verses.raw: Have we not all one father? has not one Elohim (God) created us? why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, by profaning the covenant of our fathers?
verses.text: Have we not all one father? has not one Elohim created us? why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, by profaning the covenant of our fathers?

verses.raw: Yahudah (Judah) has dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Yashar'el (Israel) and in Jerusalem; for Yahudah (Judah) has profaned the holiness of Yahuah (LORD) which he loved, and has married the daughter of a strange god.
verses.text: Yahudah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Yashar'el and in Jerusalem; for Yahudah has profaned the holiness of Yahuah which he loved, and has married the daughter of a strange god.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) will cut off the man that does this, the master and the scholar, out of the tabernacles of Jacob, and him that offers an offering unto Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: Yahuah will cut off the man that does this, the master and the scholar, out of the tabernacles of Jacob, and him that offers an offering unto Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: And this have you done again, covering the altar of Yahuah (LORD) with tears, with weeping, and with crying out, insomuch that he regards not the offering any more, or receives it with good will at your hand.
verses.text: And this have you done again, covering the altar of Yahuah with tears, with weeping, and with crying out, insomuch that he regards not the offering any more, or receives it with good will at your hand.

verses.raw: Yet you say, Wherefore? Because Yahuah (LORD) has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously: yet is she your companion, and the wife of your covenant.
verses.text: Yet you say, Wherefore? Because Yahuah has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously: yet is she your companion, and the wife of your covenant.

verses.raw: And did not he make one? Yet had he the residue of the spirit. And wherefore one? That he might seek a godly seed. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.
verses.text: And did not he make one? Yet had he the residue of the spirit. And wherefore one? That he might seek a godly seed. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), says that he hates putting away: for one covers violence with his garment, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): therefore take heed to your spirit, that you deal not treacherously.
verses.text: For Yahuah, the Elohim of Yashar'el, says that he hates putting away: for one covers violence with his garment, says Yahuah Tseva'ot: therefore take heed to your spirit, that you deal not treacherously.

verses.raw: You have wearied Yahuah (LORD) with your words. Yet you say, Wherein have we wearied him? When you say, Every one that does evil is good in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and he delights in them; or, Where is the Elohim (God) of judgment?
verses.text: You have wearied Yahuah with your words. Yet you say, Wherein have we wearied him? When you say, Every one that does evil is good in the sight of Yahuah, and he delights in them; or, Where is the Elohim of judgment?

verses.raw: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and Adonai (Lord), whom you seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom you delight in: behold, he shall come, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and Adonai, whom you seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom you delight in: behold, he shall come, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appears? for he is like a refiner’s fire, and like fullers’ soap:
verses.text: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appears? for he is like a refiner’s fire, and like fullers’ soap:

verses.raw: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto Yahuah (LORD) an offering in righteousness.
verses.text: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto Yahuah an offering in righteousness.

verses.raw: Then shall the offering of Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem be pleasant unto Yahuah (LORD), as in the days of old, and as in former years.
verses.text: Then shall the offering of Yahudah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto Yahuah, as in the days of old, and as in former years.

verses.raw: And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers, and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger from his right, and fear not me, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers, and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger from his right, and fear not me, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: For I am Yahuah (LORD), I change not; therefore you sons of Jacob are not consumed.
verses.text: For I am Yahuah, I change not; therefore you sons of Jacob are not consumed.

verses.raw: Even from the days of your fathers you are gone away from my ordinances, and have not kept them. Return unto me, and I will return unto you, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts). But you said, Wherein shall we return?
verses.text: Even from the days of your fathers you are gone away from my ordinances, and have not kept them. Return unto me, and I will return unto you, says Yahuah Tseva'ot. But you said, Wherein shall we return?

verses.raw: Will a man rob Elohim (God)? Yet you have robbed me. But you say, Wherein have we robbed you? In tithes and offerings.
verses.text: Will a man rob Elohim? Yet you have robbed me. But you say, Wherein have we robbed you? In tithes and offerings.

verses.raw: You are cursed with a curse: for you have robbed me, even this whole nation.
verses.text: You are cursed with a curse: for you have robbed me, even this whole nation.

verses.raw: Bring you all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in my house, and prove me now herewith, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.
verses.text: Bring you all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in my house, and prove me now herewith, says Yahuah Tseva'ot, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.

verses.raw: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: And all nations shall call you blessed: for you shall be a delightsome land, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: And all nations shall call you blessed: for you shall be a delightsome land, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: Your words have been stout against me, says Yahuah (LORD). Yet you say, What have we spoken so much against you?
verses.text: Your words have been stout against me, says Yahuah. Yet you say, What have we spoken so much against you?

verses.raw: You have said, It is vain to serve Elohim (God): and what profit is it that we have kept his ordinance, and that we have walked mournfully before Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts)?
verses.text: You have said, It is vain to serve Elohim: and what profit is it that we have kept his ordinance, and that we have walked mournfully before Yahuah Tseva'ot?

verses.raw: And now we call the proud happy; yea, they that work wickedness are set up; yea, they that tempt Elohim (God) are even delivered.

verses.raw: Then they that feared Yahuah (LORD) spake often one to another: and Yahuah (LORD) hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared Yahuah (LORD), and that thought upon his name.

verses.raw: And they shall be mine, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), in that day when I make up my jewels; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serves him.

verses.raw: Then shall you return, and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serves Elohim (God) and him that serves him not.

verses.raw: For, behold, the day comes, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that comes shall burn them up, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.

verses.raw: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and you shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.

verses.raw: And you shall tread down the wicked; for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I shall do this, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).

verses.raw: Remember you the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Yashar'el (Israel), with the statutes and judgments.

verses.raw: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of Yahuah (LORD):

verses.raw: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.

verses.raw: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Messiah (Christ) are fourteen generations.

verses.raw: Now the birth of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
verses.text: Now the birth of Yahusha HaMashiach was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Ruach HaKodesh.

verses.raw: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.

verses.raw: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of Yahuah (Lord) appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, you son of David, fear not to take unto you Mary your wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).

verses.text: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,

verses.raw: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.text: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

verses.raw: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
verses.text: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.

verses.raw: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.text: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.

verses.raw: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
verses.text: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.

verses.raw: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
verses.text: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

verses.raw: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see Elohim (God).
verses.text: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see Elohim.

verses.raw: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of Elohim.

verses.raw: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness’ sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.text: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness’ sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

verses.raw: Blessed are you, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
verses.text: Blessed are you, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

verses.raw: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
verses.text: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.

verses.raw: You are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
verses.text: You are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.

verses.raw: You are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
verses.text: You are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

verses.raw: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it gives light unto all that are in the house.
verses.text: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it gives light unto all that are in the house.

verses.raw: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
verses.text: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

verses.raw: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
