verses.text: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.

verses.raw: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
verses.text: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.

verses.raw: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.text: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

verses.raw: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, you shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.text: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, you shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.

verses.raw: You have heard that it was said by them of old time, You shall not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
verses.text: You have heard that it was said by them of old time, You shall not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:

verses.raw: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, You fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
verses.text: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, You fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.

verses.raw: Therefore if you bring your gift to the altar, and there remember that your brother has ought against you;
verses.text: Therefore if you bring your gift to the altar, and there remember that your brother has ought against you;

verses.raw: Leave there your gift before the altar, and go your way; first be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.
verses.text: Leave there your gift before the altar, and go your way; first be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.

verses.raw: Agree with your adversary quickly, whiles you are in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.
verses.text: Agree with your adversary quickly, whiles you are in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.

verses.raw: Verily I say unto you, You shall by no means come out thence, till you have paid the uttermost farthing.
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, You shall by no means come out thence, till you have paid the uttermost farthing.

verses.raw: You have heard that it was said by them of old time, You shall not commit adultery:
verses.text: You have heard that it was said by them of old time, You shall not commit adultery:

verses.raw: But I say unto you, That whosoever looks on a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.
verses.text: But I say unto you, That whosoever looks on a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.

verses.raw: And if your right eye offend you, pluck it out, and cast it from you: for it is profitable for you that one of your members should perish, and not that your whole body should be cast into hell.
verses.text: And if your right eye offend you, pluck it out, and cast it from you: for it is profitable for you that one of your members should perish, and not that your whole body should be cast into hell.

verses.raw: And if your right hand offend you, cut it off, and cast it from you: for it is profitable for you that one of your members should perish, and not that your whole body should be cast into hell.
verses.text: And if your right hand offend you, cut it off, and cast it from you: for it is profitable for you that one of your members should perish, and not that your whole body should be cast into hell.

verses.raw: It has been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
verses.text: It has been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:

verses.raw: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causes her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced commits adultery.
verses.text: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causes her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced commits adultery.

verses.raw: Again, you have heard that it has been said by them of old time, You shall not forswear thyself, but shall perform unto Yahuah (Lord) your oaths:
verses.text: Again, you have heard that it has been said by them of old time, You shall not forswear thyself, but shall perform unto Yahuah your oaths:

verses.raw: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is Elohim's (God’s) throne:
verses.text: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is Elohim's (God’s) throne:

verses.raw: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
verses.text: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.

verses.raw: Neither shall you swear by your head, because you can not make one hair white or black.
verses.text: Neither shall you swear by your head, because you can not make one hair white or black.

verses.raw: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these comes of evil.
verses.text: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these comes of evil.

verses.raw: You have heard that it has been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
verses.text: You have heard that it has been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:

verses.raw: But I say unto you, That you resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
verses.text: But I say unto you, That you resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.

verses.raw: And if any man will sue you at the law, and take away your coat, let him have your cloke also.
verses.text: And if any man will sue you at the law, and take away your coat, let him have your cloke also.

verses.raw: And whosoever shall compel you to go a mile, go with him twain.
verses.text: And whosoever shall compel you to go a mile, go with him twain.

verses.raw: Give to him that asks you, and from him that would borrow of you turn not you away.
verses.text: Give to him that asks you, and from him that would borrow of you turn not you away.

verses.raw: You have heard that it has been said, You shall love your neighbour, and hate your enemy.
verses.text: You have heard that it has been said, You shall love your neighbour, and hate your enemy.

verses.raw: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
verses.text: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;

verses.raw: That you may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he makes his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sends rain on the just and on the unjust.
verses.text: That you may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he makes his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sends rain on the just and on the unjust.

verses.raw: For if you love them which love you, what reward have you? do not even the publicans the same?
verses.text: For if you love them which love you, what reward have you? do not even the publicans the same?

verses.raw: And if you salute your brethren only, what do you more than others? do not even the publicans so?
verses.text: And if you salute your brethren only, what do you more than others? do not even the publicans so?

verses.raw: Be you therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
verses.text: Be you therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.

verses.raw: Take heed that you do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise you have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
verses.text: Take heed that you do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise you have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.

verses.raw: Therefore when you do your alms, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.text: Therefore when you do your alms, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

verses.raw: But when you do alms, let not your left hand know what your right hand does:
verses.text: But when you do alms, let not your left hand know what your right hand does:

verses.raw: That your alms may be in secret: and your Father which sees in secret himself shall reward you openly.
verses.text: That your alms may be in secret: and your Father which sees in secret himself shall reward you openly.

verses.raw: And when you prayest, you shall not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.text: And when you prayest, you shall not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

verses.raw: But you, when you prayest, enter into your closet, and when you have shut your door, pray to your Father which is in secret; and your Father which sees in secret shall reward you openly.
verses.text: But you, when you prayest, enter into your closet, and when you have shut your door, pray to your Father which is in secret; and your Father which sees in secret shall reward you openly.

verses.raw: But when you pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
verses.text: But when you pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.

verses.raw: Be not you therefore like unto them: for your Father knows what things you have need of, before you ask him.
verses.text: Be not you therefore like unto them: for your Father knows what things you have need of, before you ask him.

verses.raw: After this manner therefore pray you: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be your name.
verses.text: After this manner therefore pray you: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be your name.

verses.raw: Your kingdom come. Your will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
verses.text: Your kingdom come. Your will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.

verses.raw: Give us this day our daily bread.
verses.text: Give us this day our daily bread.

verses.raw: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
verses.text: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.

verses.raw: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For yours is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
verses.text: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For yours is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.

verses.raw: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
verses.text: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:

verses.raw: But if you forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
verses.text: But if you forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

verses.raw: Moreover when you fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.text: Moreover when you fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

verses.raw: But you, when you fastest, anoint your head, and wash your face;
verses.text: But you, when you fastest, anoint your head, and wash your face;

verses.raw: That you appear not unto men to fast, but unto your Father which is in secret: and your Father, which sees in secret, shall reward you openly.
verses.text: That you appear not unto men to fast, but unto your Father which is in secret: and your Father, which sees in secret, shall reward you openly.

verses.raw: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust does corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
verses.text: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust does corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:

verses.raw: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust does corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
verses.text: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust does corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:

verses.raw: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
verses.text: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

verses.raw: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore your eye be single, your whole body shall be full of light.
verses.text: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore your eye be single, your whole body shall be full of light.

verses.raw: But if your eye be evil, your whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you be darkness, how great is that darkness!
verses.text: But if your eye be evil, your whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you be darkness, how great is that darkness!

verses.raw: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. You cannot serve Elohim (God) and mammon.
verses.text: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. You cannot serve Elohim and mammon.

verses.raw: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what you shall eat, or what you shall drink; nor yet for your body, what you shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
verses.text: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what you shall eat, or what you shall drink; nor yet for your body, what you shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?

verses.raw: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are you not much better than they?
verses.text: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are you not much better than they?

verses.raw: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
verses.text: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?

verses.raw: And why take you thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
verses.text: And why take you thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:

verses.raw: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.text: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

verses.raw: Wherefore, if Elohim (God) so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
verses.text: Wherefore, if Elohim so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?

verses.raw: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
verses.text: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?

verses.raw: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knows that you have need of all these things.
verses.text: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knows that you have need of all these things.

verses.raw: But seek you first the kingdom of Elohim (God), and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
verses.text: But seek you first the kingdom of Elohim, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

verses.raw: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
verses.text: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.

verses.raw: Judge not, that you be not judged.
verses.text: Judge not, that you be not judged.

verses.raw: For with what judgment you judge, you shall be judged: and with what measure you mete, it shall be measured to you again.
verses.text: For with what judgment you judge, you shall be judged: and with what measure you mete, it shall be measured to you again.

verses.raw: And why behold you the mote that is in your brother’s eye, but considerest not the beam that is in your own eye?
verses.text: And why behold you the mote that is in your brother’s eye, but considerest not the beam that is in your own eye?

verses.raw: Or how will you say to your brother, Let me pull out the mote out of your eye; and, behold, a beam is in your own eye?
verses.text: Or how will you say to your brother, Let me pull out the mote out of your eye; and, behold, a beam is in your own eye?

verses.raw: You hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of your own eye; and then shall you see clearly to cast out the mote out of your brother’s eye.
verses.text: You hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of your own eye; and then shall you see clearly to cast out the mote out of your brother’s eye.

verses.raw: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast you your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
verses.text: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast you your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.

verses.raw: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and you shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
verses.text: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and you shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:

verses.raw: For every one that asks receives; and he that seeks finds; and to him that knocks it shall be opened.
verses.text: For every one that asks receives; and he that seeks finds; and to him that knocks it shall be opened.

verses.raw: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
verses.text: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?

verses.raw: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
verses.text: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?

verses.raw: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
verses.text: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?

verses.raw: Therefore all things whatsoever you would that men should do to you, do you even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
verses.text: Therefore all things whatsoever you would that men should do to you, do you even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

verses.raw: Enter you in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leads to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
verses.text: Enter you in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leads to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:

verses.raw: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leads unto life, and few there be that find it.
verses.text: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leads unto life, and few there be that find it.

verses.raw: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
verses.text: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.

verses.raw: You shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
verses.text: You shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?

verses.raw: Even so every good tree brings forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree brings forth evil fruit.
verses.text: Even so every good tree brings forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree brings forth evil fruit.

verses.raw: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
verses.text: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

verses.raw: Every tree that brings not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.text: Every tree that brings not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

verses.raw: Wherefore by their fruits you shall know them.
verses.text: Wherefore by their fruits you shall know them.

verses.raw: Not every one that says unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that does the will of my Father which is in heaven.
verses.text: Not every one that says unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that does the will of my Father which is in heaven.

verses.raw: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in your name? and in your name have cast out devils? and in your name done many wonderful works?
verses.text: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in your name? and in your name have cast out devils? and in your name done many wonderful works?

verses.raw: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, you that work iniquity.
verses.text: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, you that work iniquity.

verses.raw: Therefore whosoever hears these sayings of mine, and does them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
verses.text: Therefore whosoever hears these sayings of mine, and does them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:

verses.raw: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
verses.text: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.

verses.raw: And every one that hears these sayings of mine, and does them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
verses.text: And every one that hears these sayings of mine, and does them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:

verses.raw: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
verses.text: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Yahusha (Jesus) had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Yahusha had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:

verses.raw: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.text: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.

verses.raw: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
verses.text: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

verses.raw: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if you will, you can make me clean.
verses.text: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if you will, you can make me clean.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be you clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
verses.text: And Yahusha put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be you clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, See you tell no man; but go your way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.text: And Yahusha says unto him, See you tell no man; but go your way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

verses.raw: And when Yahusha (Jesus) was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
verses.text: And when Yahusha was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,

verses.raw: And saying, Lord, my servant lies at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
verses.text: And saying, Lord, my servant lies at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, I will come and heal him.
verses.text: And Yahusha says unto him, I will come and heal him.

verses.raw: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that you should come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.text: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that you should come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.

verses.raw: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my servant, Do this, and he does it.
verses.text: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my servant, Do this, and he does it.

verses.raw: When Yahusha (Jesus) heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: When Yahusha heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.text: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.

verses.raw: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.text: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto the centurion, Go your way; and as you have believed, so be it done unto you. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.
verses.text: And Yahusha said unto the centurion, Go your way; and as you have believed, so be it done unto you. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.

verses.raw: And when Yahusha (Jesus) was come into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother laid, and sick of a fever.
verses.text: And when Yahusha was come into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother laid, and sick of a fever.

verses.raw: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.
verses.text: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.

verses.raw: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:
verses.text: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:

verses.raw: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.
verses.text: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.

verses.raw: Now when Yahusha (Jesus) saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
verses.text: Now when Yahusha saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.

verses.raw: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow you whithersoever you go.
verses.text: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow you whithersoever you go.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of Adam has not where to lay his head.
verses.text: And Yahusha says unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of Adam has not where to lay his head.

verses.raw: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
verses.text: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

verses.raw: But Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.
verses.text: But Yahusha said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.

verses.raw: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.
verses.text: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.

verses.raw: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
verses.text: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.

verses.raw: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.
verses.text: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.

verses.raw: And he says unto them, Why are you fearful, O you of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
verses.text: And he says unto them, Why are you fearful, O you of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.

verses.raw: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!
verses.text: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!

verses.raw: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
verses.text: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.

verses.raw: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with you, Yahusha (Jesus), you Son of Elohim (God)? are you come hither to torment us before the time?
verses.text: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with you, Yahusha, you Son of Elohim? are you come hither to torment us before the time?

verses.raw: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.
verses.text: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.

verses.raw: So the devils besought him, saying, If you cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
verses.text: So the devils besought him, saying, If you cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.
verses.text: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.

verses.raw: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
verses.text: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.

verses.raw: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Yahusha (Jesus): and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.
verses.text: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Yahusha: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.

verses.raw: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
verses.text: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.

verses.raw: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Yahusha (Jesus) seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; your sins be forgiven you.
verses.text: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Yahusha seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; your sins be forgiven you.

verses.raw: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
verses.text: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think you evil in your hearts?
verses.text: And Yahusha knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think you evil in your hearts?

verses.raw: For whether is easier, to say, Your sins be forgiven you; or to say, Arise, and walk?
verses.text: For whether is easier, to say, Your sins be forgiven you; or to say, Arise, and walk?

verses.raw: But that you may know that the Son of Adam has power on earth to forgive sins, (then says he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up your bed, and go unto your house.
verses.text: But that you may know that the Son of Adam has power on earth to forgive sins, (then says he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up your bed, and go unto your house.

verses.raw: And he arose, and departed to his house.
verses.text: And he arose, and departed to his house.

verses.raw: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified Elohim (God), which had given such power unto men.
verses.text: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified Elohim, which had given such power unto men.

verses.raw: And as Yahusha (Jesus) passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he says unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
verses.text: And as Yahusha passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he says unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as Yahusha (Jesus) sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as Yahusha sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.

verses.raw: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eats your Master with publicans and sinners?
verses.text: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eats your Master with publicans and sinners?

verses.raw: But when Yahusha (Jesus) heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
verses.text: But when Yahusha heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.

verses.raw: But go you and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.text: But go you and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

verses.raw: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but your disciples fast not?
verses.text: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but your disciples fast not?

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
verses.text: And Yahusha said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.

verses.raw: No man puts a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up takes from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
verses.text: No man puts a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up takes from the garment, and the rent is made worse.

verses.raw: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runs out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
verses.text: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runs out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.

verses.raw: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay your hand upon her, and she shall live.
verses.text: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay your hand upon her, and she shall live.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
verses.text: And Yahusha arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.

verses.raw: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:
verses.text: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:

verses.raw: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
verses.text: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.

verses.raw: But Yahusha (Jesus) turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; your faith has made you whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
verses.text: But Yahusha turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; your faith has made you whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.

verses.raw: And when Yahusha (Jesus) came into the ruler’s house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
verses.text: And when Yahusha came into the ruler’s house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,

verses.raw: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleeps. And they laughed him to scorn.
verses.text: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleeps. And they laughed him to scorn.

verses.raw: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
verses.text: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.

verses.raw: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
verses.text: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.

verses.raw: And when Yahusha (Jesus) departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, You Son of David, have mercy on us.
verses.text: And when Yahusha departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, You Son of David, have mercy on us.

verses.raw: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, Believe you that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
verses.text: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Yahusha says unto them, Believe you that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.

verses.raw: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
verses.text: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.

verses.raw: And their eyes were opened; and Yahusha (Jesus) straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
verses.text: And their eyes were opened; and Yahusha straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.

verses.raw: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
verses.text: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.

verses.raw: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
verses.text: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.

verses.raw: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: But the Pharisees said, He casts out devils through the prince of the devils.
verses.text: But the Pharisees said, He casts out devils through the prince of the devils.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
verses.text: And Yahusha went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.

verses.raw: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
verses.text: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.

verses.raw: Then says he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;
verses.text: Then says he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;

verses.raw: Pray you therefore Yahuah (Lord) of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
verses.text: Pray you therefore Yahuah of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.

verses.raw: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
verses.text: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.

verses.raw: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
verses.text: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;

verses.raw: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;
verses.text: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;

verses.raw: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
verses.text: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

verses.raw: These twelve Yahusha (Jesus) sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter you not:
verses.text: These twelve Yahusha sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter you not:

verses.raw: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And as you go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.text: And as you go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.

verses.raw: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely you have received, freely give.
verses.text: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely you have received, freely give.

verses.raw: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
verses.text: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,

verses.raw: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.
verses.text: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.

verses.raw: And into whatsoever city or town you shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till you go thence.
verses.text: And into whatsoever city or town you shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till you go thence.

verses.raw: And when you come into an house, salute it.
verses.text: And when you come into an house, salute it.

verses.raw: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
verses.text: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.

verses.raw: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when you depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
verses.text: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when you depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.

verses.raw: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

verses.raw: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be you therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
verses.text: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be you therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

verses.raw: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
verses.text: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;

verses.raw: And you shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
verses.text: And you shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.

verses.raw: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what you shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what you shall speak.
verses.text: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what you shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what you shall speak.

verses.raw: For it is not you that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaks in you.
verses.text: For it is not you that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaks in you.

verses.raw: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
verses.text: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.

verses.raw: And you shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endures to the end shall be saved.
verses.text: And you shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endures to the end shall be saved.

verses.raw: But when they persecute you in this city, flee you into another: for verily I say unto you, You shall not have gone over the cities of Yashar'el (Israel), till the Son of Adam be come.
verses.text: But when they persecute you in this city, flee you into another: for verily I say unto you, You shall not have gone over the cities of Yashar'el, till the Son of Adam be come.

verses.raw: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.
verses.text: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.

verses.raw: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
verses.text: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?

verses.raw: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
verses.text: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.

verses.raw: What I tell you in darkness, that speak you in light: and what you hear in the ear, that preach you upon the housetops.
verses.text: What I tell you in darkness, that speak you in light: and what you hear in the ear, that preach you upon the housetops.

verses.raw: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
verses.text: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.

verses.raw: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
verses.text: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.

verses.raw: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
verses.text: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

verses.raw: Fear you not therefore, you are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.text: Fear you not therefore, you are of more value than many sparrows.

verses.raw: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
verses.text: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.

verses.raw: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
verses.text: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.

verses.raw: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
verses.text: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.

verses.raw: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
verses.text: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

verses.raw: And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household.
verses.text: And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household.

verses.raw: He that loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loves son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
verses.text: He that loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loves son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.

verses.raw: And he that takes not his cross, and follows after me, is not worthy of me.
verses.text: And he that takes not his cross, and follows after me, is not worthy of me.

verses.raw: He that finds his life shall lose it: and he that loses his life for my sake shall find it.
verses.text: He that finds his life shall lose it: and he that loses his life for my sake shall find it.

verses.raw: He that receives you receives me, and he that receives me receives him that sent me.
verses.text: He that receives you receives me, and he that receives me receives him that sent me.

verses.raw: He that receives a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet’s reward; and he that receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man’s reward.
verses.text: He that receives a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet’s reward; and he that receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man’s reward.

verses.raw: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
verses.text: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Yahusha (Jesus) had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Yahusha had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.

verses.raw: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Messiah (Christ), he sent two of his disciples,
verses.text: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Messiah, he sent two of his disciples,

verses.raw: And said unto him, Are you he that should come, or do we look for another?
verses.text: And said unto him, Are you he that should come, or do we look for another?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which you do hear and see:
verses.text: Yahusha answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which you do hear and see:

verses.raw: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
verses.text: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.

verses.raw: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
verses.text: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

verses.raw: And as they departed, Yahusha (Jesus) began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went you out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
verses.text: And as they departed, Yahusha began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went you out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

verses.raw: But what went you out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.
verses.text: But what went you out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.

verses.raw: But what went you out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.
verses.text: But what went you out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.

verses.raw: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before your face, which shall prepare your way before you.
verses.text: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before your face, which shall prepare your way before you.

verses.raw: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there has not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there has not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

verses.raw: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.
verses.text: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.

verses.raw: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
verses.text: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

verses.raw: And if you will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.
verses.text: And if you will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.

verses.raw: He that has ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.text: He that has ears to hear, let him hear.

verses.raw: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,
verses.text: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,

verses.raw: And saying, We have piped unto you, and you have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and you have not lamented.
verses.text: And saying, We have piped unto you, and you have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and you have not lamented.

verses.raw: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He has a devil.
verses.text: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He has a devil.

verses.raw: The Son of Adam came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.
verses.text: The Son of Adam came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.

verses.raw: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
verses.text: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:

verses.raw: Woe unto you, Chorazin! woe unto you, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.text: Woe unto you, Chorazin! woe unto you, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

verses.raw: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.
verses.text: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.

verses.raw: And you, Capernaum, which are exalted unto heaven, shall be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in you, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
verses.text: And you, Capernaum, which are exalted unto heaven, shall be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in you, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.

verses.raw: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for you.
verses.text: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for you.

verses.raw: At that time Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said, I thank you, O Father, Yahuah (Lord) of heaven and earth, because you have hid these things from the wise and prudent, and have revealed them unto babes.
verses.text: At that time Yahusha answered and said, I thank you, O Father, Yahuah of heaven and earth, because you have hid these things from the wise and prudent, and have revealed them unto babes.

verses.raw: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in your sight.
verses.text: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in your sight.

verses.raw: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knows the Son, but the Father; neither knows any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.
verses.text: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knows the Son, but the Father; neither knows any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.

verses.raw: Come unto me, all you that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
verses.text: Come unto me, all you that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

verses.raw: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and you shall find rest unto your souls.
verses.text: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and you shall find rest unto your souls.

verses.raw: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
verses.text: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

verses.raw: At that time Yahusha (Jesus) went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
verses.text: At that time Yahusha went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.

verses.raw: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, your disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
verses.text: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, your disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.

verses.raw: But he said unto them, Have you not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
verses.text: But he said unto them, Have you not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;

verses.raw: How he entered into the house of Elohim (God), and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
verses.text: How he entered into the house of Elohim, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?

verses.raw: Or have you not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
verses.text: Or have you not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?

verses.raw: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
verses.text: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.

verses.raw: But if you had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, you would not have condemned the guiltless.
verses.text: But if you had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, you would not have condemned the guiltless.

verses.raw: For the Son of Adam is the Lord even of the sabbath day.
verses.text: For the Son of Adam is the Lord even of the sabbath day.

verses.raw: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
verses.text: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:

verses.raw: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
verses.text: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
verses.text: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?

verses.raw: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
verses.text: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.

verses.raw: Then says he to the man, Stretch forth your hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
verses.text: Then says he to the man, Stretch forth your hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.

verses.raw: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
verses.text: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.

verses.raw: But when Yahusha (Jesus) knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
verses.text: But when Yahusha knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;

verses.raw: And charged them that they should not make him known:
verses.text: And charged them that they should not make him known:

verses.raw: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
verses.text: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,

verses.raw: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
verses.text: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.

verses.raw: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
verses.text: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.

verses.raw: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
verses.text: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.

verses.raw: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
verses.text: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.

verses.raw: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
verses.text: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.

verses.raw: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
verses.text: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?

verses.raw: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow does not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
verses.text: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow does not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
verses.text: And Yahusha knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:

verses.raw: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
verses.text: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?

verses.raw: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
verses.text: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.

verses.raw: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of Elohim (God), then the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come unto you.
verses.text: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of Elohim, then the kingdom of Elohim is come unto you.

verses.raw: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
verses.text: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.

verses.raw: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathers not with me scatters abroad.
verses.text: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathers not with me scatters abroad.

verses.raw: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) shall not be forgiven unto men.
verses.text: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh shall not be forgiven unto men.

verses.raw: And whosoever speaks a word against the Son of Adam, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaks against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
verses.text: And whosoever speaks a word against the Son of Adam, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaks against the Ruach HaKodesh, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.

verses.raw: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
verses.text: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.

verses.raw: O generation of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.
verses.text: O generation of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.

verses.raw: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart brings forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure brings forth evil things.
verses.text: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart brings forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure brings forth evil things.

verses.raw: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
verses.text: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.

verses.raw: For by your words you shall be justified, and by your words you shall be condemned.
verses.text: For by your words you shall be justified, and by your words you shall be condemned.

verses.raw: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from you.
verses.text: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from you.

verses.raw: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
verses.text: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:

verses.raw: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of Adam be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
verses.text: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of Adam be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

verses.raw: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
verses.text: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

verses.raw: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
verses.text: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

verses.raw: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walks through dry places, seeking rest, and finds none.
verses.text: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walks through dry places, seeking rest, and finds none.

verses.raw: Then he says, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he finds it empty, swept, and garnished.
verses.text: Then he says, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he finds it empty, swept, and garnished.

verses.raw: Then goes he, and takes with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
verses.text: Then goes he, and takes with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.

verses.raw: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
verses.text: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.

verses.raw: Then one said unto him, Behold, your mother and your brethren stand without, desiring to speak with you.
verses.text: Then one said unto him, Behold, your mother and your brethren stand without, desiring to speak with you.

verses.raw: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
verses.text: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?

verses.raw: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
verses.text: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

verses.raw: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
verses.text: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.

verses.raw: The same day went Yahusha (Jesus) out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
verses.text: The same day went Yahusha out of the house, and sat by the sea side.

verses.raw: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
verses.text: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.

verses.raw: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
verses.text: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;

verses.raw: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
verses.text: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:

verses.raw: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
verses.text: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:

verses.raw: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
verses.text: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.

verses.raw: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
verses.text: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:

verses.raw: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
verses.text: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.

verses.raw: Who has ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.text: Who has ears to hear, let him hear.

verses.raw: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speak you unto them in parables?
verses.text: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speak you unto them in parables?

verses.raw: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
verses.text: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.

verses.raw: For whosoever has, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever has not, from him shall be taken away even that he has.
verses.text: For whosoever has, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever has not, from him shall be taken away even that he has.

verses.raw: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
verses.text: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.

verses.raw: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which says, By hearing you shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing you shall see, and shall not perceive:
verses.text: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which says, By hearing you shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing you shall see, and shall not perceive:
