verses.raw: For this people’s heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.text: For this people’s heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

verses.raw: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
verses.text: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.

verses.raw: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which you see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which you hear, and have not heard them.
verses.text: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which you see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which you hear, and have not heard them.

verses.raw: Hear you therefore the parable of the sower.
verses.text: Hear you therefore the parable of the sower.

verses.raw: When any one hears the word of the kingdom, and understands it not, then comes the wicked one, and catches away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
verses.text: When any one hears the word of the kingdom, and understands it not, then comes the wicked one, and catches away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.

verses.raw: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that hears the word, and anon with joy receives it;
verses.text: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that hears the word, and anon with joy receives it;

verses.raw: Yet has he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution arises because of the word, by and by he is offended.
verses.text: Yet has he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution arises because of the word, by and by he is offended.

verses.raw: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that hears the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.
verses.text: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that hears the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

verses.raw: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that hears the word, and understands it; which also bears fruit, and brings forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
verses.text: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that hears the word, and understands it; which also bears fruit, and brings forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.

verses.raw: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
verses.text: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:

verses.raw: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
verses.text: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.

verses.raw: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
verses.text: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.

verses.raw: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, did not you sow good seed in your field? from whence then has it tares?
verses.text: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, did not you sow good seed in your field? from whence then has it tares?

verses.raw: He said unto them, An enemy has done this. The servants said unto him, Will you then that we go and gather them up?
verses.text: He said unto them, An enemy has done this. The servants said unto him, Will you then that we go and gather them up?

verses.raw: But he said, Nay; lest while you gather up the tares, you root up also the wheat with them.
verses.text: But he said, Nay; lest while you gather up the tares, you root up also the wheat with them.

verses.raw: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather you together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
verses.text: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather you together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.

verses.raw: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
verses.text: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:

verses.raw: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
verses.text: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.

verses.raw: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
verses.text: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

verses.raw: All these things spake Yahusha (Jesus) unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
verses.text: All these things spake Yahusha unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:

verses.raw: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
verses.text: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.

verses.raw: Then Yahusha (Jesus) sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
verses.text: Then Yahusha sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.

verses.raw: He answered and said unto them, He that sows the good seed is the Son of Adam;
verses.text: He answered and said unto them, He that sows the good seed is the Son of Adam;

verses.raw: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
verses.text: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;

verses.raw: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
verses.text: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.

verses.raw: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
verses.text: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.

verses.raw: The Son of Adam shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
verses.text: The Son of Adam shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;

verses.raw: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.text: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

verses.raw: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who has ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.text: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who has ears to hear, let him hear.

verses.raw: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man has found, he hides, and for joy thereof goes and selleth all that he has, and buyeth that field.
verses.text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man has found, he hides, and for joy thereof goes and selleth all that he has, and buyeth that field.

verses.raw: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
verses.text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:

verses.raw: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
verses.text: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

verses.raw: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
verses.text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:

verses.raw: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
verses.text: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.

verses.raw: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
verses.text: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,

verses.raw: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.text: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, Have you understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto them, Have you understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.

verses.raw: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which brings forth out of his treasure things new and old.
verses.text: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which brings forth out of his treasure things new and old.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that when Yahusha (Jesus) had finished these parables, he departed thence.
verses.text: And it came to pass, that when Yahusha had finished these parables, he departed thence.

verses.raw: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence has this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
verses.text: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence has this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?

verses.raw: Is not this the carpenter’s son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
verses.text: Is not this the carpenter’s son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?

verses.raw: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then has this man all these things?
verses.text: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then has this man all these things?

verses.raw: And they were offended in him. But Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
verses.text: And they were offended in him. But Yahusha said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.

verses.raw: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
verses.text: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

verses.raw: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Yahusha (Jesus),
verses.text: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Yahusha,

verses.raw: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
verses.text: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

verses.raw: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife.
verses.text: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife.

verses.raw: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for you to have her.
verses.text: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for you to have her.

verses.raw: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
verses.text: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

verses.raw: But when Herod’s birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
verses.text: But when Herod’s birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.

verses.raw: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
verses.text: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.

verses.raw: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist’s head in a charger.
verses.text: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist’s head in a charger.

verses.raw: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath’s sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.
verses.text: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath’s sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.

verses.raw: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
verses.text: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.

verses.raw: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
verses.text: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.

verses.raw: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Yahusha.

verses.raw: When Yahusha (Jesus) heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
verses.text: When Yahusha heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
verses.text: And Yahusha went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.

verses.raw: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
verses.text: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.

verses.raw: But Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, They need not depart; give you them to eat.
verses.text: But Yahusha said unto them, They need not depart; give you them to eat.

verses.raw: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
verses.text: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.

verses.raw: He said, Bring them hither to me.
verses.text: He said, Bring them hither to me.

verses.raw: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
verses.text: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

verses.raw: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
verses.text: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.

verses.raw: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
verses.text: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.

verses.raw: And straightway Yahusha (Jesus) constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
verses.text: And straightway Yahusha constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

verses.raw: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
verses.text: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.

verses.raw: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
verses.text: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.

verses.raw: And in the fourth watch of the night Yahusha (Jesus) went unto them, walking on the sea.
verses.text: And in the fourth watch of the night Yahusha went unto them, walking on the sea.

verses.raw: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
verses.text: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.

verses.raw: But straightway Yahusha (Jesus) spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
verses.text: But straightway Yahusha spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.

verses.raw: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be you, bid me come unto you on the water.
verses.text: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be you, bid me come unto you on the water.

verses.raw: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Yahusha.

verses.raw: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
verses.text: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.

verses.raw: And immediately Yahusha (Jesus) stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O you of little faith, wherefore did you doubt?
verses.text: And immediately Yahusha stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O you of little faith, wherefore did you doubt?

verses.raw: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
verses.text: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.

verses.raw: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth you are the Son of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth you are the Son of Elohim.

verses.raw: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.
verses.text: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.

verses.raw: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
verses.text: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;

verses.raw: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
verses.text: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.

verses.raw: Then came to Yahusha (Jesus) scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,
verses.text: Then came to Yahusha scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,

verses.raw: Why do your disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
verses.text: Why do your disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.

verses.raw: But he answered and said unto them, Why do you also transgress the commandment of Elohim (God) by your tradition?
verses.text: But he answered and said unto them, Why do you also transgress the commandment of Elohim by your tradition?

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) commanded, saying, Honour your father and mother: and, He that curses father or mother, let him die the death.
verses.text: For Elohim commanded, saying, Honour your father and mother: and, He that curses father or mother, let him die the death.

verses.raw: But you say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever you might be profited by me;
verses.text: But you say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever you might be profited by me;

verses.raw: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have you made the commandment of Elohim (God) of none effect by your tradition.
verses.text: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have you made the commandment of Elohim of none effect by your tradition.

verses.raw: You hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,
verses.text: You hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,

verses.raw: This people draws nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
verses.text: This people draws nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

verses.raw: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
verses.text: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.

verses.raw: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:
verses.text: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:

verses.raw: Not that which goes into the mouth defiles a man; but that which comes out of the mouth, this defiles a man.
verses.text: Not that which goes into the mouth defiles a man; but that which comes out of the mouth, this defiles a man.

verses.raw: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Know you that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?
verses.text: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Know you that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?

verses.raw: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father has not planted, shall be rooted up.
verses.text: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father has not planted, shall be rooted up.

verses.raw: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.
verses.text: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.

verses.raw: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.
verses.text: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) said, Are you also yet without understanding?
verses.text: And Yahusha said, Are you also yet without understanding?

verses.raw: Do not you yet understand, that whatsoever enters in at the mouth goes into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
verses.text: Do not you yet understand, that whatsoever enters in at the mouth goes into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?

verses.raw: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.
verses.text: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.

verses.raw: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:
verses.text: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:

verses.raw: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defiles not a man.
verses.text: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defiles not a man.

verses.raw: Then Yahusha (Jesus) went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
verses.text: Then Yahusha went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.

verses.raw: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, you Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
verses.text: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, you Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.

verses.raw: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she cries after us.
verses.text: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she cries after us.

verses.raw: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.
verses.text: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.

verses.raw: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.
verses.text: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it to dogs.

verses.raw: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.
verses.text: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.

verses.raw: Then Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto her, O woman, great is your faith: be it unto you even as you will. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
verses.text: Then Yahusha answered and said unto her, O woman, great is your faith: be it unto you even as you will. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.
verses.text: And Yahusha departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.

verses.raw: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Yahusha's (Jesus’) feet; and he healed them:
verses.text: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Yahusha's (Jesus’) feet; and he healed them:

verses.raw: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Then Yahusha (Jesus) called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
verses.text: Then Yahusha called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.

verses.raw: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?
verses.text: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, How many loaves have you? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.
verses.text: And Yahusha says unto them, How many loaves have you? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.

verses.raw: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
verses.text: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.

verses.raw: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
verses.text: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

verses.raw: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.
verses.text: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.

verses.raw: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.
verses.text: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.

verses.raw: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.
verses.text: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.

verses.raw: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
verses.text: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.

verses.raw: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, you say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.
verses.text: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, you say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.

verses.raw: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O you hypocrites, you can discern the face of the sky; but can you not discern the signs of the times?
verses.text: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O you hypocrites, you can discern the face of the sky; but can you not discern the signs of the times?

verses.raw: A wicked and adulterous generation seeks after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.
verses.text: A wicked and adulterous generation seeks after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.

verses.raw: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
verses.text: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.

verses.raw: Then Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
verses.text: Then Yahusha said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

verses.raw: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.
verses.text: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.

verses.raw: Which when Yahusha (Jesus) perceived, he said unto them, O you of little faith, why reason you among yourselves, because you have brought no bread?
verses.text: Which when Yahusha perceived, he said unto them, O you of little faith, why reason you among yourselves, because you have brought no bread?

verses.raw: Do you not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up?
verses.text: Do you not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

verses.raw: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?
verses.text: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

verses.raw: How is it that you do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that you should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?
verses.text: How is it that you do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that you should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?

verses.raw: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
verses.text: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

verses.raw: When Yahusha (Jesus) came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of Adam am?
verses.text: When Yahusha came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of Adam am?

verses.raw: And they said, Some say that you are John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.
verses.text: And they said, Some say that you are John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.

verses.raw: He says unto them, But whom say you that I am?
verses.text: He says unto them, But whom say you that I am?

verses.raw: And Simon Peter answered and said, You are the Messiah (Christ), the Son of the living Elohim (God).
verses.text: And Simon Peter answered and said, You are the Messiah, the Son of the living Elohim.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, Blessed are you, Simon Bar-jona: for flesh and blood has not revealed it unto you, but my Father which is in heaven.
verses.text: And Yahusha answered and said unto him, Blessed are you, Simon Bar-jona: for flesh and blood has not revealed it unto you, but my Father which is in heaven.

verses.raw: And I say also unto you, That you are Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
verses.text: And I say also unto you, That you are Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

verses.raw: And I will give unto you the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever you shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever you shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
verses.text: And I will give unto you the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever you shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever you shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

verses.raw: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Yahusha (Jesus) the Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Yahusha the Messiah.

verses.raw: From that time forth began Yahusha (Jesus) to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
verses.text: From that time forth began Yahusha to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.

verses.raw: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from you, Lord: this shall not be unto you.
verses.text: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from you, Lord: this shall not be unto you.

verses.raw: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get you behind me, Satan: you are an offence unto me: for you savourest not the things that be of Elohim (God), but those that be of men.
verses.text: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get you behind me, Satan: you are an offence unto me: for you savourest not the things that be of Elohim, but those that be of men.

verses.raw: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.text: Then said Yahusha unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

verses.raw: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
verses.text: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.

verses.raw: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
verses.text: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

verses.raw: For the Son of Adam shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
verses.text: For the Son of Adam shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.

verses.raw: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of Adam coming in his kingdom.
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of Adam coming in his kingdom.

verses.raw: And after six days Yahusha (Jesus) takes Peter, James, and John his brother, and brings them up into an high mountain apart,
verses.text: And after six days Yahusha takes Peter, James, and John his brother, and brings them up into an high mountain apart,

verses.raw: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
verses.text: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.

verses.raw: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.
verses.text: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.

verses.raw: Then answered Peter, and said unto Yahusha (Jesus), Lord, it is good for us to be here: if you will, let us make here three tabernacles; one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
verses.text: Then answered Peter, and said unto Yahusha, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if you will, let us make here three tabernacles; one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

verses.raw: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear you him.
verses.text: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear you him.

verses.raw: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
verses.text: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
verses.text: And Yahusha came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.

verses.raw: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Yahusha (Jesus) only.
verses.text: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Yahusha only.

verses.raw: And as they came down from the mountain, Yahusha (Jesus) charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of Adam be risen again from the dead.
verses.text: And as they came down from the mountain, Yahusha charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of Adam be risen again from the dead.

verses.raw: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?
verses.text: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.
verses.text: And Yahusha answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.

verses.raw: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of Adam suffer of them.
verses.text: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of Adam suffer of them.

verses.raw: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
verses.text: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.

verses.raw: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
verses.text: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,

verses.raw: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falls into the fire, and oft into the water.
verses.text: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falls into the fire, and oft into the water.

verses.raw: And I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.
verses.text: And I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.

verses.raw: Then Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.
verses.text: Then Yahusha answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
verses.text: And Yahusha rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.

verses.raw: Then came the disciples to Yahusha (Jesus) apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?
verses.text: Then came the disciples to Yahusha apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
verses.text: And Yahusha said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

verses.raw: Howbeit this kind goes not out but by prayer and fasting.
verses.text: Howbeit this kind goes not out but by prayer and fasting.

verses.raw: And while they abode in Galilee, Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, The Son of Adam shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
verses.text: And while they abode in Galilee, Yahusha said unto them, The Son of Adam shall be betrayed into the hands of men:

verses.raw: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.
verses.text: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.

verses.raw: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Does not your master pay tribute?
verses.text: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Does not your master pay tribute?

verses.raw: He says, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Yahusha (Jesus) prevented him, saying, What thinkest you, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
verses.text: He says, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Yahusha prevented him, saying, What thinkest you, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?

verses.raw: Peter says unto him, Of strangers. Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, Then are the children free.
verses.text: Peter says unto him, Of strangers. Yahusha says unto him, Then are the children free.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go you to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first comes up; and when you have opened his mouth, you shall find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and you.
verses.text: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go you to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first comes up; and when you have opened his mouth, you shall find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and you.

verses.raw: At the same time came the disciples unto Yahusha (Jesus), saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
verses.text: At the same time came the disciples unto Yahusha, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
verses.text: And Yahusha called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,

verses.raw: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except you be converted, and become as little children, you shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.text: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except you be converted, and become as little children, you shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.

verses.raw: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.text: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

verses.raw: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receives me.
verses.text: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receives me.

verses.raw: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
verses.text: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.

verses.raw: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence comes!
verses.text: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence comes!

verses.raw: Wherefore if your hand or your foot offend you, cut them off, and cast them from you: it is better for you to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.
verses.text: Wherefore if your hand or your foot offend you, cut them off, and cast them from you: it is better for you to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.

verses.raw: And if your eye offend you, pluck it out, and cast it from you: it is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
verses.text: And if your eye offend you, pluck it out, and cast it from you: it is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.

verses.raw: Take heed that you despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.
verses.text: Take heed that you despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.

verses.raw: For the Son of Adam is come to save that which was lost.
verses.text: For the Son of Adam is come to save that which was lost.

verses.raw: How think you? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, does he not leave the ninety and nine, and goes into the mountains, and seeks that which is gone astray?
verses.text: How think you? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, does he not leave the ninety and nine, and goes into the mountains, and seeks that which is gone astray?

verses.raw: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoices more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
verses.text: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoices more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.

verses.raw: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
verses.text: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.

verses.raw: Moreover if your brother shall trespass against you, go and tell him his fault between you and him alone: if he shall hear you, you have gained your brother.
verses.text: Moreover if your brother shall trespass against you, go and tell him his fault between you and him alone: if he shall hear you, you have gained your brother.

verses.raw: But if he will not hear you, then take with you one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
verses.text: But if he will not hear you, then take with you one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

verses.raw: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto you as an heathen man and a publican.
verses.text: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto you as an heathen man and a publican.

verses.raw: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever you shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever you shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever you shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever you shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

verses.raw: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
verses.text: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.

verses.raw: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
verses.text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

verses.raw: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
verses.text: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, I say not unto you, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto him, I say not unto you, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.

verses.raw: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
verses.text: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.

verses.raw: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.
verses.text: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.

verses.raw: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
verses.text: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

verses.raw: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay you all.
verses.text: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay you all.

verses.raw: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
verses.text: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.

verses.raw: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that you owest.
verses.text: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that you owest.

verses.raw: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay you all.
verses.text: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay you all.

verses.raw: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
verses.text: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.

verses.raw: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
verses.text: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.

verses.raw: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O you wicked servant, I forgave you all that debt, because you desiredst me:
verses.text: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O you wicked servant, I forgave you all that debt, because you desiredst me:

verses.raw: Should not you also have had compassion on your fellowservant, even as I had pity on you?
verses.text: Should not you also have had compassion on your fellowservant, even as I had pity on you?

verses.raw: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
verses.text: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.

verses.raw: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if you from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
verses.text: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if you from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that when Yahusha (Jesus) had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
verses.text: And it came to pass, that when Yahusha had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;

verses.raw: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
verses.text: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.

verses.text: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

verses.text: And he answered and said unto them, Have you not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,

verses.text: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?

verses.raw: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore Elohim (God) has joined together, let not man put asunder.
verses.text: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore Elohim has joined together, let not man put asunder.

verses.raw: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
verses.text: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?

verses.raw: He says unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
verses.text: He says unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.

verses.raw: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, commits adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away does commit adultery.
verses.text: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, commits adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away does commit adultery.

verses.raw: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
verses.text: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.

verses.raw: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
verses.text: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.

verses.raw: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother’s womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
verses.text: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother’s womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.

verses.raw: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
verses.text: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.

verses.raw: But Yahusha (Jesus) said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.text: But Yahusha said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

verses.raw: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
verses.text: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.

verses.raw: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
verses.text: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?

verses.raw: And he said unto him, Why callest you me good? there is none good but one, that is, Elohim (God): but if you will enter into life, keep the commandments.
verses.text: And he said unto him, Why callest you me good? there is none good but one, that is, Elohim: but if you will enter into life, keep the commandments.

verses.text: He says unto him, Which? Yahusha said, You shall do no murder, You shall not commit adultery, You shall not steal, You shall not bear false witness,

verses.raw: Honour your father and your mother: and, You shall love your neighbour as thyself.
verses.text: Honour your father and your mother: and, You shall love your neighbour as thyself.

verses.text: The young man says unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?

verses.text: Yahusha said unto him, If you will be perfect, go and sell that you have, and give to the poor, and you shall have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.

verses.text: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of Elohim.

verses.text: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?

verses.text: But Yahusha beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with Elohim all things are possible.

verses.text: And every one that has forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.

verses.raw: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.

verses.raw: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
verses.text: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
