verses.raw: And you shall love Yahuah Elohayka (the Lord thy God) with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength: this is the first commandment.
verses.text: And you shall love Yahuah Elohayka with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength: this is the first commandment.

verses.raw: And the second is like, namely this, You shall love your neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
verses.text: And the second is like, namely this, You shall love your neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.

verses.raw: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, you have said the truth: for there is one Elohim (God); and there is none other but he:
verses.text: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, you have said the truth: for there is one Elohim; and there is none other but he:

verses.raw: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
verses.text: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

verses.raw: And when Yahusha (Jesus) saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, You are not far from the kingdom of Elohim (God). And no man after that durst ask him any question.
verses.text: And when Yahusha saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, You are not far from the kingdom of Elohim. And no man after that durst ask him any question.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Messiah (Christ) is the Son of David?
verses.text: And Yahusha answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Messiah is the Son of David?

verses.raw: For David himself said by the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), Yahuah (LORD) said to my Lord, Sit you on my right hand, till I make your enemies your footstool.
verses.text: For David himself said by the Ruach HaKodesh, Yahuah said to my Lord, Sit you on my right hand, till I make your enemies your footstool.

verses.raw: David therefore himself calls him the Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
verses.text: David therefore himself calls him the Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.

verses.raw: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
verses.text: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,

verses.raw: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
verses.text: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:

verses.raw: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
verses.text: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
verses.text: And Yahusha sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.

verses.raw: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.
verses.text: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.

verses.raw: And he called unto him his disciples, and says unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow has cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
verses.text: And he called unto him his disciples, and says unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow has cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:

verses.raw: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
verses.text: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.

verses.raw: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples says unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!
verses.text: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples says unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering said unto him, See you these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.text: And Yahusha answering said unto him, See you these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

verses.raw: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
verses.text: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,

verses.raw: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
verses.text: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:
verses.text: And Yahusha answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:

verses.raw: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Messiah (Christ); and shall deceive many.
verses.text: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Messiah; and shall deceive many.

verses.raw: And when you shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be you not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
verses.text: And when you shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be you not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.

verses.raw: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.
verses.text: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.

verses.raw: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues you shall be beaten: and you shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.
verses.text: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues you shall be beaten: and you shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.

verses.raw: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.
verses.text: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.

verses.raw: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what you shall speak, neither do you premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak you: for it is not you that speak, but the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
verses.text: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what you shall speak, neither do you premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak you: for it is not you that speak, but the Ruach HaKodesh.

verses.raw: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
verses.text: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.

verses.raw: And you shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.text: And you shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

verses.raw: But when you shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judæa flee to the mountains:
verses.text: But when you shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judæa flee to the mountains:

verses.raw: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:
verses.text: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:

verses.raw: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.
verses.text: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.

verses.raw: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
verses.text: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

verses.raw: And pray you that your flight be not in the winter.
verses.text: And pray you that your flight be not in the winter.

verses.raw: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which Elohim (God) created unto this time, neither shall be.
verses.text: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which Elohim created unto this time, neither shall be.

verses.raw: And except that Yahuah (Lord) had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect’s sake, whom he has chosen, he has shortened the days.
verses.text: And except that Yahuah had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect’s sake, whom he has chosen, he has shortened the days.

verses.raw: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Messiah (Christ); or, lo, he is there; believe him not:
verses.text: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Messiah; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:

verses.raw: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.
verses.text: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.

verses.raw: But take you heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
verses.text: But take you heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.

verses.raw: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
verses.text: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,

verses.raw: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
verses.text: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.

verses.raw: And then shall they see the Son of Adam coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
verses.text: And then shall they see the Son of Adam coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

verses.raw: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
verses.text: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.

verses.raw: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and puts forth leaves, you know that summer is near:
verses.text: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and puts forth leaves, you know that summer is near:

verses.raw: So you in like manner, when you shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.
verses.text: So you in like manner, when you shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.

verses.raw: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.

verses.raw: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.text: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

verses.raw: But of that day and that hour knows no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
verses.text: But of that day and that hour knows no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.

verses.raw: Take you heed, watch and pray: for you know not when the time is.
verses.text: Take you heed, watch and pray: for you know not when the time is.

verses.raw: For the Son of Adam is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.
verses.text: For the Son of Adam is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.

verses.raw: Watch you therefore: for you know not when the master of the house comes, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:
verses.text: Watch you therefore: for you know not when the master of the house comes, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:

verses.raw: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
verses.text: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.

verses.raw: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
verses.text: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.

verses.raw: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.
verses.text: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.

verses.raw: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.
verses.text: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.

verses.raw: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.
verses.text: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.

verses.raw: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?
verses.text: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

verses.raw: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
verses.text: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) said, Let her alone; why trouble you her? she has wrought a good work on me.
verses.text: And Yahusha said, Let her alone; why trouble you her? she has wrought a good work on me.

verses.raw: For you have the poor with you always, and whensoever you will you may do them good: but me you have not always.
verses.text: For you have the poor with you always, and whensoever you will you may do them good: but me you have not always.

verses.raw: She has done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.
verses.text: She has done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.

verses.raw: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she has done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she has done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.

verses.raw: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.
verses.text: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.

verses.raw: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
verses.text: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.

verses.raw: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where will you that we go and prepare that you may eat the passover?
verses.text: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where will you that we go and prepare that you may eat the passover?

verses.raw: And he sends forth two of his disciples, and says unto them, Go you into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.
verses.text: And he sends forth two of his disciples, and says unto them, Go you into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.

verses.raw: And wheresoever he shall go in, say you to the goodman of the house, The Master says, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
verses.text: And wheresoever he shall go in, say you to the goodman of the house, The Master says, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

verses.raw: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.
verses.text: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.

verses.raw: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
verses.text: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

verses.raw: And in the evening he comes with the twelve.
verses.text: And in the evening he comes with the twelve.

verses.raw: And as they sat and did eat, Yahusha (Jesus) said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eats with me shall betray me.
verses.text: And as they sat and did eat, Yahusha said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eats with me shall betray me.

verses.raw: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?
verses.text: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?

verses.raw: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
verses.text: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.

verses.raw: The Son of Adam indeed goes, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of Adam is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.
verses.text: The Son of Adam indeed goes, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of Adam is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.

verses.raw: And as they did eat, Yahusha (Jesus) took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
verses.text: And as they did eat, Yahusha took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.

verses.raw: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.
verses.text: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.
verses.text: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.

verses.raw: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of Elohim.

verses.raw: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
verses.text: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, All you shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.
verses.text: And Yahusha says unto them, All you shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.

verses.raw: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.text: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.

verses.raw: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
verses.text: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, Verily I say unto you, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, you shall deny me thrice.
verses.text: And Yahusha says unto him, Verily I say unto you, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, you shall deny me thrice.

verses.raw: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with you, I will not deny you in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
verses.text: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with you, I will not deny you in any wise. Likewise also said they all.

verses.raw: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he says to his disciples, Sit you here, while I shall pray.
verses.text: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he says to his disciples, Sit you here, while I shall pray.

verses.raw: And he takes with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;
verses.text: And he takes with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;

verses.raw: And says unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry you here, and watch.
verses.text: And says unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry you here, and watch.

verses.raw: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
verses.text: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.

verses.raw: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto you; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what you will.
verses.text: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto you; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what you will.

verses.raw: And he comes, and finds them sleeping, and says unto Peter, Simon, sleepest you? could not you watch one hour?
verses.text: And he comes, and finds them sleeping, and says unto Peter, Simon, sleepest you? could not you watch one hour?

verses.raw: Watch you and pray, lest you enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
verses.text: Watch you and pray, lest you enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.

verses.raw: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.
verses.text: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.

verses.raw: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.
verses.text: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.

verses.raw: And he comes the third time, and says unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of Adam is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.text: And he comes the third time, and says unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of Adam is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

verses.raw: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
verses.text: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.

verses.raw: And immediately, while he yet spake, comes Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
verses.text: And immediately, while he yet spake, comes Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.

verses.raw: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
verses.text: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.

verses.raw: And as soon as he was come, he goes straightway to him, and says, Master, master; and kissed him.
verses.text: And as soon as he was come, he goes straightway to him, and says, Master, master; and kissed him.

verses.raw: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
verses.text: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.

verses.raw: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
verses.text: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, Are you come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?
verses.text: And Yahusha answered and said unto them, Are you come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?

verses.raw: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.
verses.text: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.

verses.raw: And they all forsook him, and fled.
verses.text: And they all forsook him, and fled.

verses.raw: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:
verses.text: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:

verses.raw: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
verses.text: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.

verses.raw: And they led Yahusha (Jesus) away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
verses.text: And they led Yahusha away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.

verses.raw: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.
verses.text: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.

verses.raw: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Yahusha (Jesus) to put him to death; and found none.
verses.text: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Yahusha to put him to death; and found none.

verses.raw: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.
verses.text: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.

verses.raw: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
verses.text: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,

verses.raw: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.
verses.text: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.

verses.raw: But neither so did their witness agree together.
verses.text: But neither so did their witness agree together.

verses.raw: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Yahusha (Jesus), saying, Answerest you nothing? what is it which these witness against you?
verses.text: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Yahusha, saying, Answerest you nothing? what is it which these witness against you?

verses.raw: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Are you the Messiah (Christ), the Son of the Blessed?
verses.text: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Are you the Messiah, the Son of the Blessed?

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) said, I am: and you shall see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
verses.text: And Yahusha said, I am: and you shall see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

verses.raw: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and says, What need we any further witnesses?

verses.raw: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.

verses.text: And the devil said unto him, If you be the Son of Elohim, command this stone that it be made bread.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And Yahusha answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of Elohim.

verses.raw: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
verses.text: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

verses.raw: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give you, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
verses.text: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give you, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.

verses.raw: If you therefore will worship me, all shall be yours.
verses.text: If you therefore will worship me, all shall be yours.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, Get you behind me, Satan: for it is written, You shall worship Yahuah Elohayka (the Lord thy God), and him only shall you serve.
verses.text: And Yahusha answered and said unto him, Get you behind me, Satan: for it is written, You shall worship Yahuah Elohayka, and him only shall you serve.

verses.raw: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If you be the Son of Elohim (God), cast thyself down from hence:

verses.raw: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over you, to keep you:
verses.text: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over you, to keep you:

verses.raw: And in their hands they shall bear you up, lest at any time you dash your foot against a stone.
verses.text: And in their hands they shall bear you up, lest at any time you dash your foot against a stone.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering said unto him, It is said, You shall not tempt Yahuah Elohayka (the Lord thy God).
verses.text: And Yahusha answering said unto him, It is said, You shall not tempt Yahuah Elohayka.

verses.raw: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
verses.text: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.
verses.text: And Yahusha returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.

verses.raw: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
verses.text: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.

verses.raw: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
verses.text: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.

verses.raw: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,

verses.raw: The Spirit of Yahuah (Lord) is upon me, because he has anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he has sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,

verses.text: To preach the acceptable year of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.
verses.text: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.

verses.raw: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.
verses.text: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.

verses.raw: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph’s son?
verses.text: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph’s son?

verses.raw: And he said unto them, You will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in your country.
verses.text: And he said unto them, You will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in your country.

verses.raw: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
verses.text: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.

verses.raw: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Yashar'el (Israel) in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;

verses.raw: And many lepers were in Yashar'el (Israel) in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.

verses.raw: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.

verses.raw: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.
verses.text: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.

verses.raw: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.
verses.text: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.

verses.raw: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,

verses.raw: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with you, you Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth? are you come to destroy us? I know you who you are; the Holy One of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with you, you Yahusha of Nazareth? are you come to destroy us? I know you who you are; the Holy One of Elohim.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) rebuked him, saying, Hold your peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
verses.text: And Yahusha rebuked him, saying, Hold your peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.

verses.raw: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out.
verses.text: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out.

verses.raw: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.
verses.text: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.

verses.raw: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon’s house. And Simon’s wife’s mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
verses.text: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon’s house. And Simon’s wife’s mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.

verses.raw: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.
verses.text: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.

verses.raw: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
verses.text: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

verses.raw: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, You are Messiah (Christ) the Son of Elohim (God). And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, You are Messiah the Son of Elohim. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Messiah.

verses.raw: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
verses.text: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of Elohim (God) to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.
verses.text: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of Elohim to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.

verses.raw: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
verses.text: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.

verses.raw: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
verses.text: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

verses.raw: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon’s, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.
verses.text: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon’s, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.

verses.raw: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
verses.text: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

verses.raw: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at your word I will let down the net.
verses.text: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at your word I will let down the net.

verses.raw: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.
verses.text: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.

verses.raw: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.

verses.text: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Yahusha's (Jesus’) knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.

verses.raw: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:

verses.raw: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth you shall catch men.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Yahusha (Jesus) fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if you will, you can make me clean.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Yahusha fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if you will, you can make me clean.

verses.raw: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be you clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
verses.text: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be you clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.

verses.raw: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.text: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

verses.raw: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
verses.text: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

verses.raw: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.
verses.text: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.

verses.raw: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judæa, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
verses.text: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judæa, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.

verses.raw: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.
verses.text: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.

verses.raw: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Yahusha.

verses.raw: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, your sins are forgiven you.
verses.text: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, your sins are forgiven you.

verses.raw: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but Elohim (God) alone?
verses.text: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but Elohim alone?

verses.raw: But when Yahusha (Jesus) perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason you in your hearts?
verses.text: But when Yahusha perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason you in your hearts?

verses.raw: Whether is easier, to say, Your sins be forgiven you; or to say, Rise up and walk?
verses.text: Whether is easier, to say, Your sins be forgiven you; or to say, Rise up and walk?

verses.raw: But that you may know that the Son of Adam has power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto you, Arise, and take up your couch, and go into your house.
verses.text: But that you may know that the Son of Adam has power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto you, Arise, and take up your couch, and go into your house.

verses.raw: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying Elohim (God).
verses.text: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying Elohim.

verses.raw: And they were all amazed, and they glorified Elohim (God), and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
verses.text: And they were all amazed, and they glorified Elohim, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.

verses.raw: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.
verses.text: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.

verses.raw: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.
verses.text: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.

verses.raw: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.
verses.text: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.

verses.raw: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do you eat and drink with publicans and sinners?
verses.text: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do you eat and drink with publicans and sinners?

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.
verses.text: And Yahusha answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.

verses.raw: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.text: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

verses.raw: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but your eat and drink?
verses.text: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but your eat and drink?

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Can you make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
verses.text: And he said unto them, Can you make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?

verses.raw: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
verses.text: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

verses.raw: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man puts a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new makes a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.
verses.text: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man puts a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new makes a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.

verses.raw: And no man puts new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.
verses.text: And no man puts new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.

verses.raw: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.
verses.text: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.

verses.raw: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desires new: for he says, The old is better.
verses.text: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desires new: for he says, The old is better.

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.

verses.raw: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do you that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
