verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering them said, Have you not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;
verses.text: And Yahusha answering them said, Have you not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;

verses.raw: How he went into the house of Elohim (God), and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
verses.text: How he went into the house of Elohim, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?

verses.raw: And he said unto them, That the Son of Adam is the Lord also of the sabbath.
verses.text: And he said unto them, That the Son of Adam is the Lord also of the sabbath.

verses.raw: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
verses.text: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.

verses.raw: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
verses.text: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.

verses.raw: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
verses.text: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.

verses.raw: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?
verses.text: Then said Yahusha unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?

verses.raw: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth your hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
verses.text: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth your hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

verses.raw: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Yahusha.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to Elohim (God).
verses.text: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to Elohim.

verses.raw: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
verses.text: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;

verses.raw: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
verses.text: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,

verses.raw: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphæus, and Simon called Zelotes,
verses.text: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphæus, and Simon called Zelotes,

verses.raw: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
verses.text: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.

verses.raw: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judæa and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
verses.text: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judæa and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;

verses.raw: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
verses.text: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.

verses.raw: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
verses.text: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.

verses.raw: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be you poor: for yours is the kingdom of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be you poor: for yours is the kingdom of Elohim.

verses.raw: Blessed are you that hunger now: for you shall be filled. Blessed are you that weep now: for you shall laugh.
verses.text: Blessed are you that hunger now: for you shall be filled. Blessed are you that weep now: for you shall laugh.

verses.raw: Blessed are you, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of Adam’s sake.
verses.text: Blessed are you, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of Adam’s sake.

verses.raw: Rejoice you in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
verses.text: Rejoice you in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.

verses.raw: But woe unto you that are rich! for you have received your consolation.
verses.text: But woe unto you that are rich! for you have received your consolation.

verses.raw: Woe unto you that are full! for you shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for you shall mourn and weep.
verses.text: Woe unto you that are full! for you shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for you shall mourn and weep.

verses.raw: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
verses.text: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.

verses.raw: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
verses.text: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,

verses.raw: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
verses.text: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.

verses.raw: And unto him that smites you on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that takes away your cloke forbid not to take your coat also.
verses.text: And unto him that smites you on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that takes away your cloke forbid not to take your coat also.

verses.raw: Give to every man that asks of you; and of him that takes away your goods ask them not again.
verses.text: Give to every man that asks of you; and of him that takes away your goods ask them not again.

verses.raw: And as you would that men should do to you, do you also to them likewise.
verses.text: And as you would that men should do to you, do you also to them likewise.

verses.raw: For if you love them which love you, what thank have you? for sinners also love those that love them.
verses.text: For if you love them which love you, what thank have you? for sinners also love those that love them.

verses.raw: And if you do good to them which do good to you, what thank have you? for sinners also do even the same.
verses.text: And if you do good to them which do good to you, what thank have you? for sinners also do even the same.

verses.raw: And if you lend to them of whom you hope to receive, what thank have you? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
verses.text: And if you lend to them of whom you hope to receive, what thank have you? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.

verses.raw: But love you your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and you shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
verses.text: But love you your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and you shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.

verses.raw: Be you therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
verses.text: Be you therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

verses.raw: Judge not, and you shall not be judged: condemn not, and you shall not be condemned: forgive, and you shall be forgiven:
verses.text: Judge not, and you shall not be judged: condemn not, and you shall not be condemned: forgive, and you shall be forgiven:

verses.raw: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that you mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
verses.text: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that you mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

verses.raw: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
verses.text: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?

verses.raw: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
verses.text: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.

verses.raw: And why behold you the mote that is in your brother’s eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in your own eye?
verses.text: And why behold you the mote that is in your brother’s eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in your own eye?

verses.raw: Either how can you say to your brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in your eye, when you thyself behold not the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of your own eye, and then shall you see clearly to pull out the mote that is in your brother’s eye.
verses.text: Either how can you say to your brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in your eye, when you thyself behold not the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of your own eye, and then shall you see clearly to pull out the mote that is in your brother’s eye.

verses.raw: For a good tree brings not forth corrupt fruit; neither does a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
verses.text: For a good tree brings not forth corrupt fruit; neither does a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

verses.raw: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
verses.text: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.

verses.raw: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaks.
verses.text: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaks.

verses.raw: And why call you me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
verses.text: And why call you me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?

verses.raw: Whosoever comes to me, and hears my sayings, and does them, I will shew you to whom he is like:
verses.text: Whosoever comes to me, and hears my sayings, and does them, I will shew you to whom he is like:

verses.raw: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
verses.text: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.

verses.raw: But he that hears, and does not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
verses.text: But he that hears, and does not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.

verses.raw: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
verses.text: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

verses.raw: And a certain centurion’s servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
verses.text: And a certain centurion’s servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.

verses.raw: And when he heard of Yahusha (Jesus), he sent unto him the elders of the Yahudim (Jews), beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
verses.text: And when he heard of Yahusha, he sent unto him the elders of the Yahudim, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.

verses.raw: And when they came to Yahusha (Jesus), they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
verses.text: And when they came to Yahusha, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:

verses.raw: For he loves our nation, and he has built us a synagogue.
verses.text: For he loves our nation, and he has built us a synagogue.

verses.raw: Then Yahusha (Jesus) went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that you should enter under my roof:
verses.text: Then Yahusha went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that you should enter under my roof:

verses.raw: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto you: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.text: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto you: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.

verses.raw: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my servant, Do this, and he does it.
verses.text: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my servant, Do this, and he does it.

verses.raw: When Yahusha (Jesus) heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: When Yahusha heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
verses.text: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.

verses.raw: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
verses.text: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.

verses.raw: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
verses.text: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.

verses.raw: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
verses.text: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.

verses.raw: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto you, Arise.
verses.text: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto you, Arise.

verses.raw: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
verses.text: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.

verses.raw: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified Elohim (God), saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That Elohim (God) has visited his people.
verses.text: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified Elohim, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That Elohim has visited his people.

verses.raw: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judæa, and throughout all the region round about.
verses.text: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judæa, and throughout all the region round about.

verses.raw: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
verses.text: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.

verses.raw: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Yahusha (Jesus), saying, Are you he that should come? or look we for another?
verses.text: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Yahusha, saying, Are you he that should come? or look we for another?

verses.raw: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist has sent us unto you, saying, Are you he that should come? or look we for another?
verses.text: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist has sent us unto you, saying, Are you he that should come? or look we for another?

verses.raw: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.
verses.text: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.

verses.raw: Then Yahusha (Jesus) answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things you have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
verses.text: Then Yahusha answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things you have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.

verses.raw: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
verses.text: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

verses.raw: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went you out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
verses.text: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went you out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

verses.raw: But what went you out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.
verses.text: But what went you out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.

verses.raw: But what went you out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
verses.text: But what went you out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.

verses.raw: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before your face, which shall prepare your way before you.
verses.text: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before your face, which shall prepare your way before you.

verses.raw: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of Elohim (God) is greater than he.
verses.text: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of Elohim is greater than he.

verses.raw: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified Elohim (God), being baptized with the baptism of John.
verses.text: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified Elohim, being baptized with the baptism of John.

verses.raw: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of Elohim (God) against themselves, being not baptized of him.
verses.text: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of Elohim against themselves, being not baptized of him.

verses.raw: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
verses.text: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?

verses.raw: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and you have not danced; we have mourned to you, and you have not wept.
verses.text: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and you have not danced; we have mourned to you, and you have not wept.

verses.raw: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and you say, He has a devil.
verses.text: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and you say, He has a devil.

verses.raw: The Son of Adam is come eating and drinking; and you say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
verses.text: The Son of Adam is come eating and drinking; and you say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!

verses.raw: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
verses.text: But wisdom is justified of all her children.

verses.raw: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee’s house, and sat down to meat.
verses.text: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee’s house, and sat down to meat.

verses.raw: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Yahusha (Jesus) sat at meat in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
verses.text: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Yahusha sat at meat in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,

verses.raw: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
verses.text: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

verses.raw: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that touches him: for she is a sinner.
verses.text: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that touches him: for she is a sinner.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto you. And he says, Master, say on.
verses.text: And Yahusha answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto you. And he says, Master, say on.

verses.raw: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
verses.text: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.

verses.raw: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
verses.text: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?

verses.raw: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, You have rightly judged.
verses.text: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, You have rightly judged.

verses.raw: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, See you this woman? I entered into your house, you gave me no water for my feet: but she has washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
verses.text: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, See you this woman? I entered into your house, you gave me no water for my feet: but she has washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.

verses.raw: You gave me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in has not ceased to kiss my feet.
verses.text: You gave me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in has not ceased to kiss my feet.

verses.raw: My head with oil you did not anoint: but this woman has anointed my feet with ointment.
verses.text: My head with oil you did not anoint: but this woman has anointed my feet with ointment.

verses.raw: Wherefore I say unto you, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loves little.
verses.text: Wherefore I say unto you, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loves little.

verses.raw: And he said unto her, Your sins are forgiven.
verses.text: And he said unto her, Your sins are forgiven.

verses.raw: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
verses.text: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?

verses.raw: And he said to the woman, Your faith has saved you; go in peace.
verses.text: And he said to the woman, Your faith has saved you; go in peace.

verses.raw: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of Elohim (God): and the twelve were with him,
verses.text: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of Elohim: and the twelve were with him,

verses.raw: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
verses.text: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,

verses.raw: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
verses.text: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.

verses.raw: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:
verses.text: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:

verses.raw: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
verses.text: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.

verses.raw: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
verses.text: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.

verses.raw: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
verses.text: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.

verses.raw: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that has ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.text: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that has ears to hear, let him hear.

verses.raw: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
verses.text: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?

verses.raw: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of Elohim (God): but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
verses.text: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of Elohim: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.

verses.raw: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of Elohim.

verses.raw: Those by the way side are they that hear; then comes the devil, and takes away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
verses.text: Those by the way side are they that hear; then comes the devil, and takes away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.

verses.raw: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
verses.text: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.

verses.raw: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
verses.text: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.

verses.raw: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
verses.text: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.

verses.raw: No man, when he has lighted a candle, covers it with a vessel, or puts it under a bed; but sets it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
verses.text: No man, when he has lighted a candle, covers it with a vessel, or puts it under a bed; but sets it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.

verses.raw: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
verses.text: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.

verses.raw: Take heed therefore how you hear: for whosoever has, to him shall be given; and whosoever has not, from him shall be taken even that which he seems to have.
verses.text: Take heed therefore how you hear: for whosoever has, to him shall be given; and whosoever has not, from him shall be taken even that which he seems to have.

verses.raw: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
verses.text: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.

verses.raw: And it was told him by certain which said, Your mother and your brethren stand without, desiring to see you.
verses.text: And it was told him by certain which said, Your mother and your brethren stand without, desiring to see you.

verses.raw: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of Elohim (God), and do it.
verses.text: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of Elohim, and do it.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
verses.text: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.

verses.raw: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.
verses.text: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.

verses.raw: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
verses.text: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commands even the winds and water, and they obey him.
verses.text: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commands even the winds and water, and they obey him.

verses.raw: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.
verses.text: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.

verses.raw: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.
verses.text: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.

verses.raw: When he saw Yahusha (Jesus), he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with you, Yahusha (Jesus), you Son of Elohim (God) most high? I beseech you, torment me not.
verses.text: When he saw Yahusha, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with you, Yahusha, you Son of Elohim most high? I beseech you, torment me not.

verses.raw: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)
verses.text: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) asked him, saying, What is your name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.
verses.text: And Yahusha asked him, saying, What is your name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.

verses.raw: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
verses.text: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.

verses.raw: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.
verses.text: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.

verses.raw: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
verses.text: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.

verses.raw: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.
verses.text: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.

verses.raw: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Yahusha (Jesus), and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Yahusha (Jesus), clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
verses.text: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Yahusha, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Yahusha, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

verses.raw: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.
verses.text: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.

verses.raw: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.

verses.raw: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Yahusha (Jesus) sent him away, saying,

verses.raw: Return to your own house, and shew how great things Elohim (God) has done unto you. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Yahusha (Jesus) had done unto him.
verses.text: Return to your own house, and shew how great things Elohim has done unto you. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Yahusha had done unto him.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that, when Yahusha (Jesus) was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.
verses.text: And it came to pass, that, when Yahusha was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.

verses.raw: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Yahusha's (Jesus’) feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:

verses.raw: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.
verses.text: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.

verses.raw: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,
verses.text: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,

verses.text: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng you and press you, and say you, Who touched me?
verses.text: And Yahusha said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng you and press you, and say you, Who touched me?

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) said, Somebody has touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.
verses.text: And Yahusha said, Somebody has touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.

verses.raw: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
verses.text: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

verses.raw: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: your faith has made you whole; go in peace.
verses.text: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: your faith has made you whole; go in peace.

verses.raw: While he yet spake, there comes one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house, saying to him, Your daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.
verses.text: While he yet spake, there comes one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house, saying to him, Your daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.

verses.raw: But when Yahusha (Jesus) heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.
verses.text: But when Yahusha heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.

verses.raw: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.
verses.text: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.

verses.raw: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleeps.
verses.text: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleeps.

verses.raw: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
verses.text: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.

verses.raw: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.
verses.text: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.

verses.raw: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.
verses.text: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.

verses.raw: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.
verses.text: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.

verses.raw: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.
verses.text: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.

verses.raw: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of Elohim (God), and to heal the sick.
verses.text: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of Elohim, and to heal the sick.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.
verses.text: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.

verses.raw: And whatsoever house you enter into, there abide, and thence depart.
verses.text: And whatsoever house you enter into, there abide, and thence depart.

verses.raw: And whosoever will not receive you, when you go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.
verses.text: And whosoever will not receive you, when you go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.

verses.raw: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.
verses.text: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.

verses.raw: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;
verses.text: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;

verses.raw: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.
verses.text: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.

verses.raw: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.
verses.text: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.

verses.raw: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.
verses.text: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.

verses.raw: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of Elohim (God), and healed them that had need of healing.
verses.text: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of Elohim, and healed them that had need of healing.

verses.raw: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.
verses.text: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.

verses.raw: But he said unto them, Give you them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.
verses.text: But he said unto them, Give you them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.

verses.raw: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.
verses.text: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.

verses.raw: And they did so, and made them all sit down.
verses.text: And they did so, and made them all sit down.

verses.raw: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.
verses.text: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.

verses.raw: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.
verses.text: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?
verses.text: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?

verses.raw: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
verses.text: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.

verses.raw: He said unto them, But whom say you that I am? Peter answering said, The Messiah (Christ) of Elohim (God).
verses.text: He said unto them, But whom say you that I am? Peter answering said, The Messiah of Elohim.

verses.raw: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;
verses.text: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;

verses.raw: Saying, The Son of Adam must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.
verses.text: Saying, The Son of Adam must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.

verses.raw: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
verses.text: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

verses.raw: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
verses.text: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.

verses.raw: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?
verses.text: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?

verses.raw: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of Adam be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father’s, and of the holy angels.
verses.text: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of Adam be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father’s, and of the holy angels.

verses.raw: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of Elohim (God).
verses.text: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of Elohim.

verses.raw: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.
verses.text: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.

verses.text: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.

verses.text: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.

verses.text: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.
