verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And Yahusha said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of Elohim.

verses.raw: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
verses.text: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.

verses.raw: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray you therefore Yahuah (Lord) of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.
verses.text: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray you therefore Yahuah of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

verses.raw: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
verses.text: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.

verses.raw: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.
verses.text: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.

verses.raw: And into whatsoever house you enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
verses.text: And into whatsoever house you enter, first say, Peace be to this house.

verses.raw: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
verses.text: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.

verses.raw: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.
verses.text: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.

verses.raw: And into whatsoever city you enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:
verses.text: And into whatsoever city you enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:

verses.raw: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of Elohim (God) is come nigh unto you.
verses.text: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of Elohim is come nigh unto you.

verses.raw: But into whatsoever city you enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,
verses.text: But into whatsoever city you enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,

verses.raw: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaves on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be you sure of this, that the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come nigh unto you.
verses.text: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaves on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be you sure of this, that the kingdom of Elohim is come nigh unto you.

verses.raw: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.
verses.text: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.

verses.raw: Woe unto you, Chorazin! woe unto you, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.text: Woe unto you, Chorazin! woe unto you, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

verses.raw: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.
verses.text: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.

verses.raw: And you, Capernaum, which are exalted to heaven, shall be thrust down to hell.
verses.text: And you, Capernaum, which are exalted to heaven, shall be thrust down to hell.

verses.raw: He that hears you hears me; and he that despises you despises me; and he that despises me despises him that sent me.
verses.text: He that hears you hears me; and he that despises you despises me; and he that despises me despises him that sent me.

verses.raw: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through your name.
verses.text: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through your name.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.
verses.text: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.

verses.raw: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
verses.text: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
verses.text: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.

verses.raw: In that hour Yahusha (Jesus) rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank you, O Father, the Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hid these things from the wise and prudent, and have revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in your sight.
verses.text: In that hour Yahusha rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank you, O Father, the Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hid these things from the wise and prudent, and have revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in your sight.

verses.raw: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knows who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.
verses.text: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knows who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.

verses.raw: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see:
verses.text: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see:

verses.raw: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which you see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which you hear, and have not heard them.
verses.text: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which you see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which you hear, and have not heard them.

verses.raw: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
verses.text: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

verses.raw: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest you?
verses.text: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest you?

verses.raw: And he answering said, You shall love Yahuah Elohayka (the Lord thy God) with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbour as thyself.
verses.text: And he answering said, You shall love Yahuah Elohayka with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbour as thyself.

verses.raw: And he said unto him, You have answered right: this do, and you shall live.
verses.text: And he said unto him, You have answered right: this do, and you shall live.

verses.raw: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Yahusha (Jesus), And who is my neighbour?
verses.text: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Yahusha, And who is my neighbour?

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
verses.text: And Yahusha answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

verses.raw: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
verses.text: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

verses.raw: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.
verses.text: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.

verses.raw: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,
verses.text: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,

verses.raw: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
verses.text: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

verses.raw: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever you spendest more, when I come again, I will repay you.
verses.text: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever you spendest more, when I come again, I will repay you.

verses.raw: Which now of these three, thinkest you, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?
verses.text: Which now of these three, thinkest you, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?

verses.raw: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto him, Go, and do you likewise.
verses.text: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Yahusha unto him, Go, and do you likewise.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
verses.text: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

verses.raw: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Yahusha's (Jesus’) feet, and heard his word.
verses.text: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Yahusha's (Jesus’) feet, and heard his word.

verses.raw: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, do you not care that my sister has left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
verses.text: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, do you not care that my sister has left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, you are careful and troubled about many things:
verses.text: And Yahusha answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, you are careful and troubled about many things:

verses.raw: But one thing is needful: and Mary has chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
verses.text: But one thing is needful: and Mary has chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
verses.text: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, When you pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be your name. Your kingdom come. Your will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.
verses.text: And he said unto them, When you pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be your name. Your kingdom come. Your will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.

verses.raw: Give us day by day our daily bread.
verses.text: Give us day by day our daily bread.

verses.raw: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.
verses.text: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
verses.text: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;

verses.raw: For a friend of my in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?
verses.text: For a friend of my in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?

verses.raw: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give you.
verses.text: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give you.

verses.raw: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.
verses.text: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.

verses.raw: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and you shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
verses.text: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and you shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

verses.raw: For every one that asks receives; and he that seeks finds; and to him that knocks it shall be opened.
verses.text: For every one that asks receives; and he that seeks finds; and to him that knocks it shall be opened.

verses.raw: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?
verses.text: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?

verses.raw: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
verses.text: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?

verses.raw: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) to them that ask him?
verses.text: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Ruach HaKodesh to them that ask him?

verses.raw: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.
verses.text: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.

verses.raw: But some of them said, He casts out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.
verses.text: But some of them said, He casts out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.

verses.raw: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.
verses.text: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.

verses.raw: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falls.
verses.text: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falls.

verses.raw: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because you say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.
verses.text: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because you say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.

verses.raw: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
verses.text: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.

verses.raw: But if I with the finger of Elohim (God) cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come upon you.
verses.text: But if I with the finger of Elohim cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of Elohim is come upon you.

verses.raw: When a strong man armed keeps his palace, his goods are in peace:
verses.text: When a strong man armed keeps his palace, his goods are in peace:

verses.raw: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he takes from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divides his spoils.
verses.text: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he takes from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divides his spoils.

verses.raw: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathers not with me scatters.
verses.text: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathers not with me scatters.

verses.raw: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walks through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, I will return unto my house whence I came out.
verses.text: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walks through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, I will return unto my house whence I came out.

verses.raw: And when he comes, he finds it swept and garnished.
verses.text: And when he comes, he finds it swept and garnished.

verses.raw: Then goes he, and takes to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.
verses.text: Then goes he, and takes to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare you, and the paps which you have sucked.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare you, and the paps which you have sucked.

verses.raw: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of Elohim (God), and keep it.
verses.text: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of Elohim, and keep it.

verses.raw: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.
verses.text: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.

verses.raw: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of Adam be to this generation.
verses.text: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of Adam be to this generation.

verses.raw: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
verses.text: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

verses.raw: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
verses.text: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

verses.raw: No man, when he has lighted a candle, puts it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.
verses.text: No man, when he has lighted a candle, puts it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.

verses.raw: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when your eye is single, your whole body also is full of light; but when your eye is evil, your body also is full of darkness.
verses.text: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when your eye is single, your whole body also is full of light; but when your eye is evil, your body also is full of darkness.

verses.raw: Take heed therefore that the light which is in you be not darkness.
verses.text: Take heed therefore that the light which is in you be not darkness.

verses.raw: If your whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle does give you light.
verses.text: If your whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle does give you light.

verses.raw: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
verses.text: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.

verses.raw: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.
verses.text: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.

verses.raw: And the Lord said unto him, Now do you Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
verses.text: And the Lord said unto him, Now do you Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.

verses.raw: You fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?
verses.text: You fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?

verses.raw: But rather give alms of such things as you have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.
verses.text: But rather give alms of such things as you have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.

verses.raw: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for you tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of Elohim (God): these ought you to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
verses.text: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for you tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of Elohim: these ought you to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

verses.raw: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for you love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.
verses.text: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for you love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.

verses.raw: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.
verses.text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.

verses.raw: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying you reproachest us also.
verses.text: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying you reproachest us also.

verses.raw: And he said, Woe unto you also, you lawyers! for you lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and you yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
verses.text: And he said, Woe unto you also, you lawyers! for you lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and you yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.

verses.raw: Woe unto you! for you build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
verses.text: Woe unto you! for you build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

verses.raw: Truly you bear witness that you allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and you build their sepulchres.
verses.text: Truly you bear witness that you allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and you build their sepulchres.

verses.raw: Therefore also said the wisdom of Elohim (God), I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:
verses.text: Therefore also said the wisdom of Elohim, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:

verses.raw: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
verses.text: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

verses.raw: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.
verses.text: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.

verses.raw: Woe unto you, lawyers! for you have taken away the key of knowledge: you entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in you hindered.
verses.text: Woe unto you, lawyers! for you have taken away the key of knowledge: you entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in you hindered.

verses.raw: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
verses.text: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:

verses.raw: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.
verses.text: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.

verses.raw: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware you of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
verses.text: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware you of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

verses.raw: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.
verses.text: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.

verses.raw: Therefore whatsoever you have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which you have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.
verses.text: Therefore whatsoever you have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which you have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.

verses.raw: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
verses.text: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

verses.raw: But I will forewarn you whom you shall fear: Fear him, which after he has killed has power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
verses.text: But I will forewarn you whom you shall fear: Fear him, which after he has killed has power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.

verses.raw: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before Elohim (God)?
verses.text: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before Elohim?

verses.raw: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: you are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.text: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: you are of more value than many sparrows.

verses.raw: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of Adam also confess before the angels of Elohim (God):
verses.text: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of Adam also confess before the angels of Elohim:

verses.raw: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of Elohim (God).
verses.text: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of Elohim.

verses.raw: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of Adam, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) it shall not be forgiven.
verses.text: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of Adam, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Ruach HaKodesh it shall not be forgiven.

verses.raw: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take you no thought how or what thing you shall answer, or what you shall say:
verses.text: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take you no thought how or what thing you shall answer, or what you shall say:

verses.raw: For the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) shall teach you in the same hour what you ought to say.
verses.text: For the Ruach HaKodesh shall teach you in the same hour what you ought to say.

verses.raw: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.
verses.text: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.

verses.raw: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?
verses.text: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man’s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
verses.text: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man’s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.

verses.raw: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
verses.text: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:

verses.raw: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?
verses.text: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?

verses.raw: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.
verses.text: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.

verses.raw: And I will say to my soul, Soul, you have much goods laid up for many years; take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.
verses.text: And I will say to my soul, Soul, you have much goods laid up for many years; take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) said unto him, You fool, this night your soul shall be required of you: then whose shall those things be, which you have provided?
verses.text: But Elohim said unto him, You fool, this night your soul shall be required of you: then whose shall those things be, which you have provided?

verses.raw: So is he that lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward Elohim (God).
verses.text: So is he that lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward Elohim.

verses.raw: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what you shall eat; neither for the body, what you shall put on.
verses.text: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what you shall eat; neither for the body, what you shall put on.

verses.raw: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.
verses.text: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.

verses.raw: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and Elohim (God) feedeth them: how much more are you better than the fowls?
verses.text: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and Elohim feedeth them: how much more are you better than the fowls?

verses.raw: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?
verses.text: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?

verses.raw: If you then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take you thought for the rest?
verses.text: If you then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take you thought for the rest?

verses.raw: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.text: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

verses.raw: If then Elohim (God) so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?
verses.text: If then Elohim so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?

verses.raw: And seek not you what you shall eat, or what you shall drink, neither be you of doubtful mind.
verses.text: And seek not you what you shall eat, or what you shall drink, neither be you of doubtful mind.

verses.raw: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knows that you have need of these things.
verses.text: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knows that you have need of these things.

verses.raw: But rather seek you the kingdom of Elohim (God); and all these things shall be added unto you.
verses.text: But rather seek you the kingdom of Elohim; and all these things shall be added unto you.

verses.raw: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
verses.text: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

verses.raw: Sell that you have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that fails not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.
verses.text: Sell that you have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that fails not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.

verses.raw: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
verses.text: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

verses.raw: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;
verses.text: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;

verses.raw: And you yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he comes and knocks, they may open unto him immediately.
verses.text: And you yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he comes and knocks, they may open unto him immediately.

verses.raw: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he comes shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.
verses.text: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he comes shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.

verses.raw: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.
verses.text: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.

verses.raw: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.
verses.text: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.

verses.raw: Be you therefore ready also: for the Son of Adam comes at an hour when you think not.
verses.text: Be you therefore ready also: for the Son of Adam comes at an hour when you think not.

verses.raw: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speak you this parable unto us, or even to all?
verses.text: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speak you this parable unto us, or even to all?

verses.raw: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?
verses.text: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?

verses.raw: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he comes shall find so doing.
verses.text: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he comes shall find so doing.

verses.raw: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he has.
verses.text: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he has.

verses.raw: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;
verses.text: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;

verses.raw: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looks not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
verses.text: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looks not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.

verses.raw: And that servant, which knew his lord’s will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.
verses.text: And that servant, which knew his lord’s will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.

verses.raw: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
verses.text: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.

verses.raw: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?
verses.text: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?

verses.raw: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!
verses.text: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!

verses.raw: Suppose you that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:
verses.text: Suppose you that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:

verses.raw: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
verses.text: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

verses.raw: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
verses.text: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

verses.raw: And he said also to the people, When you see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway you say, There comes a shower; and so it is.
verses.text: And he said also to the people, When you see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway you say, There comes a shower; and so it is.

verses.raw: And when you see the south wind blow, you say, There will be heat; and it comes to pass.
verses.text: And when you see the south wind blow, you say, There will be heat; and it comes to pass.

verses.raw: You hypocrites, you can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that you do not discern this time?
verses.text: You hypocrites, you can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that you do not discern this time?

verses.raw: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge you not what is right?
verses.text: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge you not what is right?

verses.raw: When you go with your adversary to the magistrate, as you are in the way, give diligence that you may be delivered from him; lest he hale you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer cast you into prison.
verses.text: When you go with your adversary to the magistrate, as you are in the way, give diligence that you may be delivered from him; lest he hale you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer cast you into prison.

verses.raw: I tell you, you shall not depart thence, till you have paid the very last mite.
verses.text: I tell you, you shall not depart thence, till you have paid the very last mite.

verses.raw: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilæans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
verses.text: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilæans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering said unto them, Suppose you that these Galilæans were sinners above all the Galilæans, because they suffered such things?
verses.text: And Yahusha answering said unto them, Suppose you that these Galilæans were sinners above all the Galilæans, because they suffered such things?

verses.raw: I tell you, Nay: but, except you repent, you shall all likewise perish.
verses.text: I tell you, Nay: but, except you repent, you shall all likewise perish.

verses.raw: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think you that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?
verses.text: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think you that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?

verses.raw: I tell you, Nay: but, except you repent, you shall all likewise perish.
verses.text: I tell you, Nay: but, except you repent, you shall all likewise perish.

verses.raw: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.
verses.text: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.

verses.raw: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?
verses.text: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?

verses.raw: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:
verses.text: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:

verses.raw: And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that you shall cut it down.
verses.text: And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that you shall cut it down.

verses.raw: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.
verses.text: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.

verses.raw: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.
verses.text: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.

verses.raw: And when Yahusha (Jesus) saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, you are loosed from your infirmity.
verses.text: And when Yahusha saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, you are loosed from your infirmity.

verses.raw: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified Elohim (God).
verses.text: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified Elohim.

verses.raw: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Yahusha (Jesus) had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.
verses.text: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Yahusha had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.

verses.raw: The Lord then answered him, and said, You hypocrite, does not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?
verses.text: The Lord then answered him, and said, You hypocrite, does not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?

verses.raw: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?
verses.text: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?

verses.raw: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
verses.text: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

verses.raw: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of Elohim (God) like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?
verses.text: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of Elohim like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?

verses.raw: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.
verses.text: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.

verses.raw: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of Elohim (God)?
verses.text: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of Elohim?

verses.raw: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
verses.text: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

verses.raw: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.
verses.text: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,
verses.text: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,

verses.raw: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.
verses.text: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.

verses.raw: When once the master of the house is risen up, and has shut to the door, and you begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence you are:
verses.text: When once the master of the house is risen up, and has shut to the door, and you begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence you are:

verses.raw: Then shall you begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in your presence, and you have taught in our streets.
verses.text: Then shall you begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in your presence, and you have taught in our streets.

verses.raw: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence you are; depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.
verses.text: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence you are; depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.

verses.raw: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when you shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of Elohim (God), and you yourselves thrust out.
verses.text: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when you shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of Elohim, and you yourselves thrust out.

verses.raw: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of Elohim.

verses.raw: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.
verses.text: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.

verses.raw: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get you out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill you.
verses.text: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get you out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill you.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Go you, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.
verses.text: And he said unto them, Go you, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.

verses.raw: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.
verses.text: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto you; how often would I have gathered your children together, as a hen does gather her brood under her wings, and you would not!
verses.text: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto you; how often would I have gathered your children together, as a hen does gather her brood under her wings, and you would not!

verses.raw: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, You shall not see me, until the time come when you shall say, Blessed is he that comes in the name of the Lord.
verses.text: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, You shall not see me, until the time come when you shall say, Blessed is he that comes in the name of the Lord.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.

verses.raw: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.
verses.text: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?
verses.text: And Yahusha answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?

verses.raw: And they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go;
verses.text: And they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go;

verses.raw: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?
verses.text: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?

verses.raw: And they could not answer him again to these things.
verses.text: And they could not answer him again to these things.

verses.raw: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them,
verses.text: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them,

verses.raw: When you are bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than you be bidden of him;
verses.text: When you are bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than you be bidden of him;

verses.raw: And he that bade you and him come and say to you, Give this man place; and you begin with shame to take the lowest room.
verses.text: And he that bade you and him come and say to you, Give this man place; and you begin with shame to take the lowest room.

verses.raw: But when you are bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade you comes, he may say unto you, Friend, go up higher: then shall you have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with you.
verses.text: But when you are bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade you comes, he may say unto you, Friend, go up higher: then shall you have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with you.

verses.raw: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
verses.text: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

verses.raw: Then said he also to him that bade him, When you make a dinner or a supper, call not your friends, nor your brethren, neither your kinsmen, nor your rich neighbours; lest they also bid you again, and a recompence be made you.
verses.text: Then said he also to him that bade him, When you make a dinner or a supper, call not your friends, nor your brethren, neither your kinsmen, nor your rich neighbours; lest they also bid you again, and a recompence be made you.

verses.raw: But when you make a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:
verses.text: But when you make a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:

verses.raw: And you shall be blessed; for they cannot recompense you: for you shall be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.
verses.text: And you shall be blessed; for they cannot recompense you: for you shall be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.

verses.raw: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of Elohim.

verses.raw: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:
verses.text: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:

verses.raw: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.
verses.text: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.

verses.raw: And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray you have me excused.
verses.text: And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray you have me excused.

verses.raw: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray you have me excused.
verses.text: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray you have me excused.

verses.raw: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.
verses.text: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.

verses.raw: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.
verses.text: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.

verses.raw: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as you have commanded, and yet there is room.
verses.text: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as you have commanded, and yet there is room.

verses.raw: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
verses.text: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

verses.raw: For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper.

verses.text: And whosoever does not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.

verses.raw: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sits not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?
verses.text: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sits not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?

verses.text: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, does not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?

verses.raw: And when he has found it, he lays it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

verses.raw: And when he comes home, he calls together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.
verses.text: And when he comes home, he calls together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.

verses.raw: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

verses.raw: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, does not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?

verses.raw: And when she has found it, she calls her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.
verses.text: And when she has found it, she calls her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.

verses.raw: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of Elohim (God) over one sinner that repenteth.

verses.text: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord takes away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.

verses.text: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take your bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.

verses.raw: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of my adversary.
verses.text: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of my adversary.

verses.raw: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not Elohim (God), nor regard man;
verses.text: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not Elohim, nor regard man;

verses.raw: Yet because this widow troubles me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.
verses.text: Yet because this widow troubles me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.

verses.raw: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge says.
verses.text: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge says.

verses.raw: And shall not Elohim (God) avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?
verses.text: And shall not Elohim avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?

verses.raw: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of Adam comes, shall he find faith on the earth?
verses.text: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of Adam comes, shall he find faith on the earth?

verses.raw: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:
verses.text: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:

verses.raw: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.
verses.text: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.

verses.raw: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, Elohim (God), I thank you, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
verses.text: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, Elohim, I thank you, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.

verses.raw: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.
verses.text: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

verses.raw: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, Elohim (God) be merciful to me a sinner.
verses.text: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, Elohim be merciful to me a sinner.

verses.raw: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

verses.raw: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

verses.raw: But Yahusha (Jesus) called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of Elohim (God).
verses.text: But Yahusha called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of Elohim.

verses.raw: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of Elohim (God) as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of Elohim as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.

verses.raw: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
verses.text: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, Why callest you me good? none is good, save one, that is, Elohim (God).
verses.text: And Yahusha said unto him, Why callest you me good? none is good, save one, that is, Elohim.

verses.raw: You know the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour your father and your mother.
verses.text: You know the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour your father and your mother.

verses.raw: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.
verses.text: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.

verses.raw: Now when Yahusha (Jesus) heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest you one thing: sell all that you have, and distribute unto the poor, and you shall have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
verses.text: Now when Yahusha heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest you one thing: sell all that you have, and distribute unto the poor, and you shall have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.

verses.raw: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.

verses.raw: And when Yahusha (Jesus) saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God)!
verses.text: And when Yahusha saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of Elohim!

verses.raw: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God).
verses.text: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of Elohim.

verses.raw: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?

verses.text: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with Elohim.

verses.text: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed you.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:

verses.text: And they told him, that Yahusha of Nazareth passes by.

verses.text: And he cried, saying, Yahusha, you Son of David, have mercy on me.

verses.text: Saying, What will you that I shall do unto you? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

verses.text: And Yahusha said unto him, Receive your sight: your faith has saved you.

verses.raw: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying Elohim (God): and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto Elohim (God).
verses.text: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying Elohim: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto Elohim.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) entered and passed through Jericho.
verses.text: And Yahusha entered and passed through Jericho.

verses.raw: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchæus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
verses.text: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchæus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.

verses.raw: And he sought to see Yahusha (Jesus) who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.
verses.text: And he sought to see Yahusha who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.

verses.raw: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.

verses.raw: And when Yahusha (Jesus) came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchæus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at your house.
verses.text: And when Yahusha came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchæus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at your house.

verses.raw: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
verses.text: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.

verses.raw: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
verses.text: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.

verses.raw: And Zacchæus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
verses.text: And Zacchæus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
verses.text: And Yahusha said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.

verses.raw: For the Son of Adam is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
verses.text: For the Son of Adam is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

verses.raw: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of Elohim (God) should immediately appear.
verses.text: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of Elohim should immediately appear.

verses.raw: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
verses.text: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

verses.text: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.

verses.raw: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.
verses.text: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.
verses.text: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.

verses.text: Then came the first, saying, Lord, your pound has gained ten pounds.

verses.raw: And he said unto him, Well, you good servant: because you have been faithful in a very little, have you authority over ten cities.
verses.text: And he said unto him, Well, you good servant: because you have been faithful in a very little, have you authority over ten cities.

verses.text: For I feared you, because you are an austere man: you take up that you layedst not down, and reapest that you did not sow.

verses.text: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that has ten pounds.

verses.text: For I say unto you, That unto every one which has shall be given; and from him that has not, even that he has shall be taken away from him.

verses.text: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

verses.raw: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man’s brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

verses.raw: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.
verses.text: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.

verses.raw: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.

verses.text: Last of all the woman died also.

verses.text: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:
verses.text: And Yahusha answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:

verses.raw: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:
verses.text: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:

verses.raw: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of Elohim (God), being the children of the resurrection.
verses.text: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of Elohim, being the children of the resurrection.

verses.raw: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calls Yahuah (Lord) the Elohim (God) of Abraham, and the Elohim (God) of Isaac, and the Elohim (God) of Jacob.
verses.text: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calls Yahuah the Elohim of Abraham, and the Elohim of Isaac, and the Elohim of Jacob.

verses.raw: For he is not a Elohim (God) of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.

verses.text: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of Elohim: but she of her penury has cast in all the living that she had.

verses.raw: And he said, Take heed that you be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Messiah (Christ); and the time draws near: go you not therefore after them.

verses.raw: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.

verses.raw: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draws nigh.
verses.text: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draws nigh.

verses.text: When they now shoot forth, you see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.

verses.raw: So likewise you, when you see these things come to pass, know you that the kingdom of Elohim (God) is nigh at hand.
verses.text: So likewise you, when you see these things come to pass, know you that the kingdom of Elohim is nigh at hand.

verses.raw: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.

verses.raw: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.text: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

verses.raw: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.
verses.text: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.

verses.text: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.

verses.text: Watch you therefore, and pray always, that you may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of Adam.

verses.text: And if I also ask you, you will not answer me, nor let me go.

verses.text: Hereafter shall the Son of Adam sit on the right hand of the power of Elohim.

verses.raw: Then said they all, Are you then the Son of Elohim (God)? And he said unto them, You say that I am.
verses.text: Then said they all, Are you then the Son of Elohim? And he said unto them, You say that I am.

verses.raw: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.
verses.text: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.

verses.raw: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
verses.text: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.

verses.raw: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Cæsar, saying that he himself is Messiah (Christ) a King.
verses.text: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Cæsar, saying that he himself is Messiah a King.

verses.raw: And Pilate asked him, saying, Are you the King of the Yahudim (Jews)? And he answered him and said, You say it.
verses.text: And Pilate asked him, saying, Are you the King of the Yahudim? And he answered him and said, You say it.

verses.raw: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.
verses.text: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.

verses.raw: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.

verses.raw: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.

verses.raw: And when Herod saw Yahusha (Jesus), he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.

verses.raw: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
verses.text: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.

verses.raw: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
verses.text: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.

verses.text: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of Elohim, even to them that believe on his name:

verses.raw: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of Elohim.

verses.raw: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
verses.text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
