verses.raw: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that comes after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
verses.text: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that comes after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.

verses.raw: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
verses.text: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.

verses.raw: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: No man has seen Elohim (God) at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he has declared him.
verses.text: No man has seen Elohim at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he has declared him.

verses.raw: And this is the record of John, when the Yahudim (Jews) sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who are you?
verses.text: And this is the record of John, when the Yahudim sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who are you?

verses.raw: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Messiah.

verses.raw: And they asked him, What then? Are you Elias? And he says, I am not. Are you that prophet? And he answered, No.
verses.text: And they asked him, What then? Are you Elias? And he says, I am not. Are you that prophet? And he answered, No.

verses.raw: Then said they unto him, Who are you? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What say you of thyself?
verses.text: Then said they unto him, Who are you? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What say you of thyself?

verses.raw: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of Yahuah (Lord), as said the prophet Esaias.
verses.text: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of Yahuah, as said the prophet Esaias.

verses.raw: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
verses.text: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.

verses.raw: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest you then, if you be not that Messiah (Christ), nor Elias, neither that prophet?
verses.text: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest you then, if you be not that Messiah, nor Elias, neither that prophet?

verses.raw: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there stands one among you, whom you know not;
verses.text: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there stands one among you, whom you know not;

verses.raw: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe’s latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
verses.text: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe’s latchet I am not worthy to unloose.

verses.raw: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.text: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.

verses.raw: The next day John sees Yahusha (Jesus) coming unto him, and says, Behold the Lamb of Elohim (God), which takes away the sin of the world.
verses.text: The next day John sees Yahusha coming unto him, and says, Behold the Lamb of Elohim, which takes away the sin of the world.

verses.raw: This is he of whom I said, After me comes a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
verses.text: This is he of whom I said, After me comes a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.

verses.raw: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Yashar'el (Israel), therefore am I come baptizing with water.
verses.text: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Yashar'el, therefore am I come baptizing with water.

verses.raw: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
verses.text: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.

verses.raw: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom you shall see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
verses.text: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom you shall see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Ruach HaKodesh.

verses.raw: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of Elohim.

verses.raw: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
verses.text: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;

verses.raw: And looking upon Yahusha (Jesus) as he walked, he says, Behold the Lamb of Elohim (God)!
verses.text: And looking upon Yahusha as he walked, he says, Behold the Lamb of Elohim!

verses.raw: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Yahusha.

verses.raw: Then Yahusha (Jesus) turned, and saw them following, and says unto them, What seek you? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwell you?
verses.text: Then Yahusha turned, and saw them following, and says unto them, What seek you? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwell you?

verses.raw: He says unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
verses.text: He says unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.

verses.raw: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
verses.text: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

verses.raw: He first finds his own brother Simon, and says unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: He first finds his own brother Simon, and says unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Messiah.

verses.raw: And he brought him to Yahusha (Jesus). And when Yahusha (Jesus) beheld him, he said, You are Simon the son of Jona: you shall be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
verses.text: And he brought him to Yahusha. And when Yahusha beheld him, he said, You are Simon the son of Jona: you shall be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.

verses.raw: The day following Yahusha (Jesus) would go forth into Galilee, and finds Philip, and says unto him, Follow me.
verses.text: The day following Yahusha would go forth into Galilee, and finds Philip, and says unto him, Follow me.

verses.raw: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.text: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

verses.raw: Philip finds Nathanael, and says unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
verses.text: Philip finds Nathanael, and says unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Yahusha of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

verses.raw: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip says unto him, Come and see.
verses.text: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip says unto him, Come and see.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) saw Nathanael coming to him, and says of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
verses.text: Yahusha saw Nathanael coming to him, and says of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

verses.raw: Nathanael says unto him, Whence know you me? Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.
verses.text: Nathanael says unto him, Whence know you me? Yahusha answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.

verses.raw: Nathanael answered and says unto him, Rabbi, you are the Son of Elohim (God); you are the King of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Nathanael answered and says unto him, Rabbi, you are the Son of Elohim; you are the King of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, Because I said unto you, I saw you under the fig tree, believe you? you shall see greater things than these.
verses.text: Yahusha answered and said unto him, Because I said unto you, I saw you under the fig tree, believe you? you shall see greater things than these.

verses.raw: And he says unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter you shall see heaven open, and the angels of Elohim (God) ascending and descending upon the Son of Adam.
verses.text: And he says unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter you shall see heaven open, and the angels of Elohim ascending and descending upon the Son of Adam.

verses.raw: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Yahusha (Jesus) was there:
verses.text: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Yahusha was there:

verses.raw: And both Yahusha (Jesus) was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
verses.text: And both Yahusha was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.

verses.raw: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, They have no wine.
verses.text: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Yahusha says unto him, They have no wine.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto her, Woman, what have I to do with you? my hour is not yet come.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto her, Woman, what have I to do with you? my hour is not yet come.

verses.raw: His mother says unto the servants, Whatsoever he says unto you, do it.
verses.text: His mother says unto the servants, Whatsoever he says unto you, do it.

verses.raw: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Yahudim (Jews), containing two or three firkins apiece.
verses.text: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Yahudim, containing two or three firkins apiece.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.

verses.raw: And he says unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.
verses.text: And he says unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.

verses.raw: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,
verses.text: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,

verses.raw: And says unto him, Every man at the beginning does set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but you have kept the good wine until now.
verses.text: And says unto him, Every man at the beginning does set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but you have kept the good wine until now.

verses.raw: This beginning of miracles did Yahusha (Jesus) in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
verses.text: This beginning of miracles did Yahusha in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

verses.raw: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.
verses.text: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.

verses.raw: And the Yahudim's (Jews’) passover was at hand, and Yahusha (Jesus) went up to Jerusalem,
verses.text: And the Yahudim's (Jews’) passover was at hand, and Yahusha went up to Jerusalem,

verses.raw: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
verses.text: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:

verses.raw: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew the tables;
verses.text: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew the tables;

verses.raw: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father’s house an house of merchandise.
verses.text: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father’s house an house of merchandise.

verses.raw: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of your house has eaten me up.
verses.text: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of your house has eaten me up.

verses.raw: Then answered the Yahudim (Jews) and said unto him, What sign shewest you unto us, seeing that you do these things?
verses.text: Then answered the Yahudim and said unto him, What sign shewest you unto us, seeing that you do these things?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
verses.text: Yahusha answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

verses.raw: Then said the Yahudim (Jews), Forty and six years was this temple in building, and will you rear it up in three days?
verses.text: Then said the Yahudim, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and will you rear it up in three days?

verses.raw: But he spake of the temple of his body.
verses.text: But he spake of the temple of his body.

verses.raw: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Yahusha (Jesus) had said.
verses.text: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Yahusha had said.

verses.raw: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.
verses.text: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.

verses.raw: But Yahusha (Jesus) did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,
verses.text: But Yahusha did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,

verses.raw: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.
verses.text: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.

verses.raw: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Yahudim (Jews):
verses.text: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Yahudim:

verses.raw: The same came to Yahusha (Jesus) by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from Elohim (God): for no man can do these miracles that you do, except Elohim (God) be with him.
verses.text: The same came to Yahusha by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from Elohim: for no man can do these miracles that you do, except Elohim be with him.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Yahusha answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of Elohim.

verses.raw: Nicodemus says unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?
verses.text: Nicodemus says unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Yahusha answered, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of Elohim.

verses.raw: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.text: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

verses.raw: Marvel not that I said unto you, You must be born again.
verses.text: Marvel not that I said unto you, You must be born again.

verses.raw: The wind blows where it listeth, and you hear the sound thereof, but can not tell whence it comes, and whither it goes: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
verses.text: The wind blows where it listeth, and you hear the sound thereof, but can not tell whence it comes, and whither it goes: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

verses.raw: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
verses.text: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, Are you a master of Yashar'el (Israel), and know not these things?
verses.text: Yahusha answered and said unto him, Are you a master of Yashar'el, and know not these things?

verses.raw: Verily, verily, I say unto you, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and you receive not our witness.
verses.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and you receive not our witness.

verses.raw: If I have told you earthly things, and you believe not, how shall you believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
verses.text: If I have told you earthly things, and you believe not, how shall you believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

verses.raw: And no man has ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of Adam which is in heaven.
verses.text: And no man has ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of Adam which is in heaven.

verses.raw: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Adam be lifted up:
verses.text: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Adam be lifted up:

verses.raw: That whosoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.text: That whosoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believes in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
verses.text: For Elohim so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believes in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
verses.text: For Elohim sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

verses.raw: He that believes on him is not condemned: but he that believes not is condemned already, because he has not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of Elohim (God).
verses.text: He that believes on him is not condemned: but he that believes not is condemned already, because he has not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of Elohim.

verses.raw: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
verses.text: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.

verses.raw: For every one that does evil hates the light, neither comes to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
verses.text: For every one that does evil hates the light, neither comes to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.

verses.raw: But he that does truth comes to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in Elohim (God).
verses.text: But he that does truth comes to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in Elohim.

verses.raw: After these things came Yahusha (Jesus) and his disciples into the land of Judæa; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
verses.text: After these things came Yahusha and his disciples into the land of Judæa; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.

verses.raw: And John also was baptizing in Ænon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
verses.text: And John also was baptizing in Ænon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.

verses.raw: For John was not yet cast into prison.
verses.text: For John was not yet cast into prison.

verses.raw: Then there arose a question between some of John’s disciples and the Yahudim (Jews) about purifying.
verses.text: Then there arose a question between some of John’s disciples and the Yahudim about purifying.

verses.raw: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with you beyond Jordan, to whom you barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
verses.text: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with you beyond Jordan, to whom you barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.

verses.raw: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
verses.text: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.

verses.raw: You yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Messiah (Christ), but that I am sent before him.
verses.text: You yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Messiah, but that I am sent before him.

verses.raw: He that has the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
verses.text: He that has the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

verses.raw: He must increase, but I must decrease.
verses.text: He must increase, but I must decrease.

verses.raw: He that comes from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaks of the earth: he that comes from heaven is above all.
verses.text: He that comes from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaks of the earth: he that comes from heaven is above all.

verses.raw: And what he has seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receives his testimony.
verses.text: And what he has seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receives his testimony.

verses.raw: He that has received his testimony has set to his seal that Elohim (God) is true.
verses.text: He that has received his testimony has set to his seal that Elohim is true.

verses.raw: For he whom Elohim (God) has sent speaks the words of Elohim (God): for Elohim (God) gives not the Spirit by measure unto him.
verses.text: For he whom Elohim has sent speaks the words of Elohim: for Elohim gives not the Spirit by measure unto him.

verses.raw: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
verses.text: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

verses.raw: He that believes on the Son has everlasting life: and he that believes not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of Elohim (God) abides on him.
verses.text: He that believes on the Son has everlasting life: and he that believes not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of Elohim abides on him.

verses.raw: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Yahusha (Jesus) made and baptized more disciples than John,
verses.text: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Yahusha made and baptized more disciples than John,

verses.raw: (Though Yahusha (Jesus) himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
verses.text: (Though Yahusha himself baptized not, but his disciples,)

verses.raw: He left Judæa, and departed again into Galilee.
verses.text: He left Judæa, and departed again into Galilee.

verses.raw: And he must needs go through Samaria.
verses.text: And he must needs go through Samaria.

verses.raw: Then comes he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
verses.text: Then comes he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

verses.raw: Now Jacob’s well was there. Yahusha (Jesus) therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
verses.text: Now Jacob’s well was there. Yahusha therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.

verses.raw: There comes a woman of Samaria to draw water: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto her, Give me to drink.
verses.text: There comes a woman of Samaria to draw water: Yahusha says unto her, Give me to drink.

verses.raw: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
verses.text: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)

verses.raw: Then says the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that you, being a Yahudi (Jew), ask drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Yahudim (Jews) have no dealings with the Samaritans.
verses.text: Then says the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that you, being a Yahudi, ask drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Yahudim have no dealings with the Samaritans.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto her, If you knew the gift of Elohim (God), and who it is that says to you, Give me to drink; you would have asked of him, and he would have given you living water.
verses.text: Yahusha answered and said unto her, If you knew the gift of Elohim, and who it is that says to you, Give me to drink; you would have asked of him, and he would have given you living water.

verses.raw: The woman says unto him, Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then have you that living water?
verses.text: The woman says unto him, Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then have you that living water?

verses.raw: Are you greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
verses.text: Are you greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinks of this water shall thirst again:
verses.text: Yahusha answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinks of this water shall thirst again:

verses.raw: But whosoever drinks of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
verses.text: But whosoever drinks of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

verses.raw: The woman says unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
verses.text: The woman says unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto her, Go, call your husband, and come hither.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto her, Go, call your husband, and come hither.

verses.raw: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Yahusha (Jesus) said unto her, You have well said, I have no husband:
verses.text: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Yahusha said unto her, You have well said, I have no husband:

verses.raw: For you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband: in that saidst you truly.
verses.text: For you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband: in that saidst you truly.

verses.raw: The woman says unto him, Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.
verses.text: The woman says unto him, Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

verses.raw: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and you say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
verses.text: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and you say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour comes, when you shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour comes, when you shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.

verses.raw: You worship you know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Yahudim (Jews).
verses.text: You worship you know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Yahudim.

verses.raw: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeks such to worship him.
verses.text: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeks such to worship him.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
verses.text: Elohim is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

verses.raw: The woman says unto him, I know that Messias comes, which is called Messiah (Christ): when he is come, he will tell us all things.
verses.text: The woman says unto him, I know that Messias comes, which is called Messiah: when he is come, he will tell us all things.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto her, I that speak unto you am he.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto her, I that speak unto you am he.

verses.raw: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seek you? or, Why talkest you with her?
verses.text: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seek you? or, Why talkest you with her?

verses.raw: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and says to the men,
verses.text: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and says to the men,

verses.raw: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Messiah (Christ)?
verses.text: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Messiah?

verses.raw: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
verses.text: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.

verses.raw: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
verses.text: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.

verses.raw: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that you know not of.
verses.text: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that you know not of.

verses.raw: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Has any man brought him ought to eat?
verses.text: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Has any man brought him ought to eat?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.

verses.raw: Say not you, There are yet four months, and then comes harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
verses.text: Say not you, There are yet four months, and then comes harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.

verses.raw: And he that reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit unto life eternal: that both he that sows and he that reaps may rejoice together.
verses.text: And he that reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit unto life eternal: that both he that sows and he that reaps may rejoice together.

verses.raw: And herein is that saying true, One sows, and another reaps.
verses.text: And herein is that saying true, One sows, and another reaps.

verses.raw: I sent you to reap that whereon you bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and you are entered into their labours.
verses.text: I sent you to reap that whereon you bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and you are entered into their labours.

verses.raw: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
verses.text: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.

verses.raw: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
verses.text: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.

verses.raw: And many more believed because of his own word;
verses.text: And many more believed because of his own word;

verses.raw: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of your saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Messiah (Christ), the Saviour of the world.
verses.text: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of your saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Messiah, the Saviour of the world.

verses.raw: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
verses.text: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.

verses.raw: For Yahusha (Jesus) himself testified, that a prophet has no honour in his own country.
verses.text: For Yahusha himself testified, that a prophet has no honour in his own country.

verses.raw: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilæans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
verses.text: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilæans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.

verses.raw: So Yahusha (Jesus) came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
verses.text: So Yahusha came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.

verses.raw: When he heard that Yahusha (Jesus) was come out of Judæa into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
verses.text: When he heard that Yahusha was come out of Judæa into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.

verses.raw: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto him, Except you see signs and wonders, you will not believe.
verses.text: Then said Yahusha unto him, Except you see signs and wonders, you will not believe.

verses.raw: The nobleman says unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
verses.text: The nobleman says unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, Go your way; your son lives. And the man believed the word that Yahusha (Jesus) had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto him, Go your way; your son lives. And the man believed the word that Yahusha had spoken unto him, and he went his way.

verses.raw: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Your son lives.
verses.text: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Your son lives.

verses.raw: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
verses.text: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.

verses.raw: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, Your son lives: and himself believed, and his whole house.
verses.text: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Yahusha said unto him, Your son lives: and himself believed, and his whole house.

verses.raw: This is again the second miracle that Yahusha (Jesus) did, when he was come out of Judæa into Galilee.
verses.text: This is again the second miracle that Yahusha did, when he was come out of Judæa into Galilee.

verses.raw: After this there was a feast of the Yahudim (Jews); and Yahusha (Jesus) went up to Jerusalem.
verses.text: After this there was a feast of the Yahudim; and Yahusha went up to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
verses.text: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

verses.raw: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
verses.text: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.

verses.raw: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.
verses.text: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.

verses.raw: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
verses.text: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.

verses.raw: When Yahusha (Jesus) saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he says unto him, Will you be made whole?
verses.text: When Yahusha saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he says unto him, Will you be made whole?

verses.raw: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
verses.text: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, Rise, take up your bed, and walk.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto him, Rise, take up your bed, and walk.

verses.raw: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
verses.text: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.

verses.raw: The Yahudim (Jews) therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for you to carry your bed.
verses.text: The Yahudim therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for you to carry your bed.

verses.raw: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up your bed, and walk.
verses.text: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up your bed, and walk.

verses.raw: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto you, Take up your bed, and walk?
verses.text: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto you, Take up your bed, and walk?

verses.raw: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Yahusha (Jesus) had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
verses.text: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Yahusha had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.

verses.raw: Afterward Yahusha (Jesus) finds him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, you are made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto you.
verses.text: Afterward Yahusha finds him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, you are made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto you.

verses.raw: The man departed, and told the Yahudim (Jews) that it was Yahusha (Jesus), which had made him whole.
verses.text: The man departed, and told the Yahudim that it was Yahusha, which had made him whole.

verses.raw: And therefore did the Yahudim (Jews) persecute Yahusha (Jesus), and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
verses.text: And therefore did the Yahudim persecute Yahusha, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.

verses.raw: But Yahusha (Jesus) answered them, My Father works hitherto, and I work.
verses.text: But Yahusha answered them, My Father works hitherto, and I work.

verses.raw: Therefore the Yahudim (Jews) sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that Elohim (God) was his Father, making himself equal with Elohim (God).
verses.text: Therefore the Yahudim sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that Elohim was his Father, making himself equal with Elohim.

verses.raw: Then answered Yahusha (Jesus) and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father do: for what things soever he does, these also does the Son likewise.
verses.text: Then answered Yahusha and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father do: for what things soever he does, these also does the Son likewise.

verses.raw: For the Father loves the Son, and shows him all things that himself does: and he will shew him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
verses.text: For the Father loves the Son, and shows him all things that himself does: and he will shew him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

verses.raw: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickens them; even so the Son quickens whom he will.
verses.text: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickens them; even so the Son quickens whom he will.

verses.raw: For the Father judges no man, but has committed all judgment unto the Son:
verses.text: For the Father judges no man, but has committed all judgment unto the Son:

verses.raw: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which has sent him.
verses.text: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which has sent him.

verses.raw: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that hears my word, and believes on him that sent me, has everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
verses.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that hears my word, and believes on him that sent me, has everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

verses.raw: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of Elohim (God): and they that hear shall live.
verses.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of Elohim: and they that hear shall live.

verses.raw: For as the Father has life in himself; so has he given to the Son to have life in himself;
verses.text: For as the Father has life in himself; so has he given to the Son to have life in himself;

verses.raw: And has given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of Adam.
verses.text: And has given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of Adam.

verses.raw: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
verses.text: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

verses.raw: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
verses.text: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.

verses.raw: I can of my own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not my own will, but the will of the Father which has sent me.
verses.text: I can of my own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not my own will, but the will of the Father which has sent me.

verses.raw: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
verses.text: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.

verses.raw: There is another that bears witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
verses.text: There is another that bears witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.

verses.raw: You sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
verses.text: You sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.

verses.raw: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that you might be saved.
verses.text: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that you might be saved.

verses.raw: He was a burning and a shining light: and you were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
verses.text: He was a burning and a shining light: and you were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.

verses.raw: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father has given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father has sent me.
verses.text: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father has given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father has sent me.

verses.raw: And the Father himself, which has sent me, has borne witness of me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
verses.text: And the Father himself, which has sent me, has borne witness of me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.

verses.raw: And you have not his word abiding in you: for whom he has sent, him you believe not.
verses.text: And you have not his word abiding in you: for whom he has sent, him you believe not.

verses.raw: Search the scriptures; for in them you think you have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
verses.text: Search the scriptures; for in them you think you have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.

verses.raw: And you will not come to me, that you might have life.
verses.text: And you will not come to me, that you might have life.

verses.raw: I receive not honour from men.
verses.text: I receive not honour from men.

verses.raw: But I know you, that you have not the love of Elohim (God) in you.
verses.text: But I know you, that you have not the love of Elohim in you.

verses.raw: I am come in my Father’s name, and you receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him you will receive.
verses.text: I am come in my Father’s name, and you receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him you will receive.

verses.raw: How can you believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that comes from Elohim (God) only?
verses.text: How can you believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that comes from Elohim only?

verses.raw: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom you trust.
verses.text: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom you trust.

verses.raw: For had you believed Moses, you would have believed me: for he wrote of me.
verses.text: For had you believed Moses, you would have believed me: for he wrote of me.

verses.raw: But if you believe not his writings, how shall you believe my words?
verses.text: But if you believe not his writings, how shall you believe my words?

verses.raw: After these things Yahusha (Jesus) went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
verses.text: After these things Yahusha went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.

verses.raw: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
verses.text: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
verses.text: And Yahusha went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.

verses.raw: And the passover, a feast of the Yahudim (Jews), was nigh.
verses.text: And the passover, a feast of the Yahudim, was nigh.

verses.raw: When Yahusha (Jesus) then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he says unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
verses.text: When Yahusha then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he says unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

verses.raw: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
verses.text: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.

verses.raw: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
verses.text: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.

verses.raw: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, says unto him,
verses.text: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, says unto him,

verses.raw: There is a lad here, which has five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
verses.text: There is a lad here, which has five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
verses.text: And Yahusha said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
verses.text: And Yahusha took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

verses.raw: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
verses.text: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.

verses.raw: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
verses.text: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.

verses.raw: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Yahusha (Jesus) did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
verses.text: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Yahusha did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.

verses.raw: When Yahusha (Jesus) therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
verses.text: When Yahusha therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.

verses.raw: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
verses.text: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,

verses.raw: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Yahusha (Jesus) was not come to them.
verses.text: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Yahusha was not come to them.

verses.raw: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
verses.text: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.

verses.raw: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Yahusha (Jesus) walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
verses.text: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Yahusha walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.

verses.raw: But he says unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
verses.text: But he says unto them, It is I; be not afraid.

verses.raw: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
verses.text: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.

verses.raw: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Yahusha (Jesus) went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
verses.text: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Yahusha went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;

verses.raw: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
verses.text: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)

verses.raw: When the people therefore saw that Yahusha (Jesus) was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: When the people therefore saw that Yahusha was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Yahusha.

verses.raw: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when came you hither?
verses.text: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when came you hither?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, You seek me, not because you saw the miracles, but because you did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
verses.text: Yahusha answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, You seek me, not because you saw the miracles, but because you did eat of the loaves, and were filled.

verses.raw: Labour not for the meat which perishes, but for that meat which endures unto everlasting life, which the Son of Adam shall give unto you: for him has Elohim (God) the Father sealed.
verses.text: Labour not for the meat which perishes, but for that meat which endures unto everlasting life, which the Son of Adam shall give unto you: for him has Elohim the Father sealed.

verses.raw: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of Elohim (God)?
verses.text: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of Elohim?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, This is the work of Elohim (God), that you believe on him whom he has sent.
verses.text: Yahusha answered and said unto them, This is the work of Elohim, that you believe on him whom he has sent.

verses.raw: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest you then, that we may see, and believe you? what do you work?
verses.text: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest you then, that we may see, and believe you? what do you work?

verses.raw: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
verses.text: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

verses.raw: Then Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father gives you the true bread from heaven.
verses.text: Then Yahusha said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father gives you the true bread from heaven.

verses.raw: For the bread of Elohim (God) is he which comes down from heaven, and gives life unto the world.
verses.text: For the bread of Elohim is he which comes down from heaven, and gives life unto the world.

verses.raw: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
verses.text: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that comes to me shall never hunger; and he that believes on me shall never thirst.
verses.text: And Yahusha said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that comes to me shall never hunger; and he that believes on me shall never thirst.

verses.raw: But I said unto you, That you also have seen me, and believe not.
verses.text: But I said unto you, That you also have seen me, and believe not.

verses.raw: All that the Father gives me shall come to me; and him that comes to me I will in no wise cast out.
verses.text: All that the Father gives me shall come to me; and him that comes to me I will in no wise cast out.

verses.raw: For I came down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him that sent me.
verses.text: For I came down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him that sent me.

verses.raw: And this is the Father’s will which has sent me, that of all which he has given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
verses.text: And this is the Father’s will which has sent me, that of all which he has given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

verses.raw: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which sees the Son, and believes on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.text: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which sees the Son, and believes on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.

verses.raw: The Yahudim (Jews) then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
verses.text: The Yahudim then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.

verses.raw: And they said, Is not this Yahusha (Jesus), the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he says, I came down from heaven?
verses.text: And they said, Is not this Yahusha, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he says, I came down from heaven?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
verses.text: Yahusha therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.

verses.raw: No man can come to me, except the Father which has sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.text: No man can come to me, except the Father which has sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.

verses.raw: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of Elohim (God). Every man therefore that has heard, and has learned of the Father, comes unto me.
verses.text: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of Elohim. Every man therefore that has heard, and has learned of the Father, comes unto me.

verses.raw: Not that any man has seen the Father, save he which is of Elohim (God), he has seen the Father.
verses.text: Not that any man has seen the Father, save he which is of Elohim, he has seen the Father.

verses.raw: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believes on me has everlasting life.
verses.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believes on me has everlasting life.

verses.raw: I am that bread of life.
verses.text: I am that bread of life.

verses.raw: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
verses.text: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.

verses.raw: This is the bread which comes down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
verses.text: This is the bread which comes down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.

verses.raw: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
verses.text: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

verses.raw: The Yahudim (Jews) therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
verses.text: The Yahudim therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?

verses.raw: Then Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except you eat the flesh of the Son of Adam, and drink his blood, you have no life in you.
verses.text: Then Yahusha said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except you eat the flesh of the Son of Adam, and drink his blood, you have no life in you.

verses.raw: Whoso eats my flesh, and drinks my blood, has eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.text: Whoso eats my flesh, and drinks my blood, has eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

verses.raw: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
verses.text: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

verses.raw: He that eats my flesh, and drinks my blood, dwells in me, and I in him.
verses.text: He that eats my flesh, and drinks my blood, dwells in me, and I in him.

verses.raw: As the living Father has sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eats me, even he shall live by me.
verses.text: As the living Father has sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eats me, even he shall live by me.

verses.raw: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eats of this bread shall live for ever.
verses.text: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eats of this bread shall live for ever.

verses.raw: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
verses.text: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

verses.raw: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
verses.text: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?

verses.raw: When Yahusha (Jesus) knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Does this offend you?
verses.text: When Yahusha knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Does this offend you?

verses.raw: What and if you shall see the Son of Adam ascend up where he was before?
verses.text: What and if you shall see the Son of Adam ascend up where he was before?

verses.raw: It is the spirit that quickens; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
verses.text: It is the spirit that quickens; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.

verses.raw: But there are some of you that believe not. For Yahusha (Jesus) knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
verses.text: But there are some of you that believe not. For Yahusha knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.

verses.raw: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
verses.text: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.

verses.raw: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
verses.text: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

verses.raw: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto the twelve, Will you also go away?
verses.text: Then said Yahusha unto the twelve, Will you also go away?

verses.raw: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? you have the words of eternal life.
verses.text: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? you have the words of eternal life.

verses.raw: And we believe and are sure that you are that Messiah (Christ), the Son of the living Elohim (God).
verses.text: And we believe and are sure that you are that Messiah, the Son of the living Elohim.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
verses.text: Yahusha answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?

verses.raw: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
verses.text: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.

verses.raw: After these things Yahusha (Jesus) walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Yahudim (Jews) sought to kill him.
verses.text: After these things Yahusha walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Yahudim sought to kill him.

verses.raw: Now the Yahudim's (Jews’) feast of tabernacles was at hand.
verses.text: Now the Yahudim's (Jews’) feast of tabernacles was at hand.

verses.raw: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judæa, that your disciples also may see the works that you do.
verses.text: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judæa, that your disciples also may see the works that you do.

verses.raw: For there is no man that does any thing in secret, and he himself seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, shew thyself to the world.
verses.text: For there is no man that does any thing in secret, and he himself seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, shew thyself to the world.

verses.raw: For neither did his brethren believe in him.
verses.text: For neither did his brethren believe in him.

verses.raw: Then Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.
verses.text: Then Yahusha said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.

verses.raw: The world cannot hate you; but me it hates, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.
verses.text: The world cannot hate you; but me it hates, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.

verses.raw: Go you up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.
verses.text: Go you up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.

verses.raw: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.
verses.text: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.

verses.raw: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
verses.text: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.

verses.raw: Then the Yahudim (Jews) sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
verses.text: Then the Yahudim sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

verses.raw: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
verses.text: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.

verses.raw: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Yahudim (Jews).
verses.text: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Yahudim.

verses.raw: Now about the midst of the feast Yahusha (Jesus) went up into the temple, and taught.
verses.text: Now about the midst of the feast Yahusha went up into the temple, and taught.

verses.raw: And the Yahudim (Jews) marvelled, saying, How knows this man letters, having never learned?
verses.text: And the Yahudim marvelled, saying, How knows this man letters, having never learned?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
verses.text: Yahusha answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

verses.raw: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of Elohim (God), or whether I speak of myself.
verses.text: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of Elohim, or whether I speak of myself.

verses.raw: He that speaks of himself seeks his own glory: but he that seeks his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
verses.text: He that speaks of himself seeks his own glory: but he that seeks his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

verses.raw: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why go you about to kill me?
verses.text: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why go you about to kill me?

verses.raw: The people answered and said, You have a devil: who goes about to kill you?
verses.text: The people answered and said, You have a devil: who goes about to kill you?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and you all marvel.
verses.text: Yahusha answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and you all marvel.

verses.raw: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and you on the sabbath day circumcise a man.
verses.text: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and you on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

verses.raw: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are you angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?
verses.text: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are you angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

verses.raw: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
verses.text: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

verses.raw: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
verses.text: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?

verses.raw: But, lo, he speaks boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Messiah (Christ)?
verses.text: But, lo, he speaks boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Messiah?

verses.raw: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Messiah (Christ) comes, no man knows whence he is.
verses.text: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Messiah comes, no man knows whence he is.

verses.raw: Then cried Yahusha (Jesus) in the temple as he taught, saying, You both know me, and you know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom you know not.
verses.text: Then cried Yahusha in the temple as he taught, saying, You both know me, and you know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom you know not.

verses.raw: But I know him: for I am from him, and he has sent me.
verses.text: But I know him: for I am from him, and he has sent me.

verses.raw: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
verses.text: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.

verses.raw: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Messiah (Christ) comes, will he do more miracles than these which this man has done?
verses.text: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Messiah comes, will he do more miracles than these which this man has done?

verses.raw: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.
verses.text: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.

verses.raw: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.
verses.text: Then said Yahusha unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.

verses.raw: You shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither you cannot come.
verses.text: You shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither you cannot come.

verses.raw: Then said the Yahudim (Jews) among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?
verses.text: Then said the Yahudim among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?

verses.raw: What manner of saying is this that he said, You shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither you cannot come?
verses.text: What manner of saying is this that he said, You shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither you cannot come?

verses.raw: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Yahusha (Jesus) stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
verses.text: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Yahusha stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

verses.raw: He that believes on me, as the scripture has said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
verses.text: He that believes on me, as the scripture has said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

verses.raw: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) was not yet given; because that Yahusha (Jesus) was not yet glorified.)
verses.text: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Ruach HaKodesh was not yet given; because that Yahusha was not yet glorified.)

verses.raw: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.
verses.text: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.

verses.raw: Others said, This is the Messiah (Christ). But some said, Shall Messiah (Christ) come out of Galilee?
verses.text: Others said, This is the Messiah. But some said, Shall Messiah come out of Galilee?

verses.raw: Has not the scripture said, That Messiah (Christ) comes of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?
verses.text: Has not the scripture said, That Messiah comes of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?

verses.raw: So there was a division among the people because of him.
verses.text: So there was a division among the people because of him.

verses.raw: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
verses.text: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.

verses.raw: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have you not brought him?
verses.text: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have you not brought him?

verses.raw: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
verses.text: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.

verses.raw: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are you also deceived?
verses.text: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are you also deceived?

verses.raw: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?
verses.text: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?

verses.raw: But this people who knows not the law are cursed.
verses.text: But this people who knows not the law are cursed.

verses.raw: Nicodemus says unto them, (he that came to Yahusha (Jesus) by night, being one of them,)
verses.text: Nicodemus says unto them, (he that came to Yahusha by night, being one of them,)

verses.raw: Does our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he does?
verses.text: Does our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he does?

verses.raw: They answered and said unto him, Are you also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee arises no prophet.
verses.text: They answered and said unto him, Are you also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee arises no prophet.

verses.raw: And every man went unto his own house.
verses.text: And every man went unto his own house.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) went unto the mount of Olives.
verses.text: Yahusha went unto the mount of Olives.

verses.raw: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
verses.text: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.

verses.raw: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
verses.text: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,

verses.raw: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
verses.text: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.

verses.raw: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what say you?
verses.text: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what say you?
