verses.raw: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Yahusha (Jesus) stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.
verses.text: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Yahusha stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.

verses.raw: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
verses.text: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.

verses.raw: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
verses.text: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.

verses.raw: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Yahusha (Jesus) was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
verses.text: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Yahusha was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

verses.raw: When Yahusha (Jesus) had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those your accusers? has no man condemned you?
verses.text: When Yahusha had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those your accusers? has no man condemned you?

verses.raw: She said, No man, Lord. And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto her, Neither do I condemn you: go, and sin no more.
verses.text: She said, No man, Lord. And Yahusha said unto her, Neither do I condemn you: go, and sin no more.

verses.raw: Then spake Yahusha (Jesus) again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that follows me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
verses.text: Then spake Yahusha again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that follows me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

verses.raw: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, You bear record of thyself; your record is not true.
verses.text: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, You bear record of thyself; your record is not true.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but you cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
verses.text: Yahusha answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but you cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

verses.raw: You judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
verses.text: You judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

verses.raw: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
verses.text: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

verses.raw: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
verses.text: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.

verses.raw: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me bears witness of me.
verses.text: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me bears witness of me.

verses.raw: Then said they unto him, Where is your Father? Yahusha (Jesus) answered, You neither know me, nor my Father: if you had known me, you should have known my Father also.
verses.text: Then said they unto him, Where is your Father? Yahusha answered, You neither know me, nor my Father: if you had known me, you should have known my Father also.

verses.raw: These words spake Yahusha (Jesus) in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
verses.text: These words spake Yahusha in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.

verses.raw: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) again unto them, I go my way, and you shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, you cannot come.
verses.text: Then said Yahusha again unto them, I go my way, and you shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, you cannot come.

verses.raw: Then said the Yahudim (Jews), Will he kill himself? because he says, Whither I go, you cannot come.
verses.text: Then said the Yahudim, Will he kill himself? because he says, Whither I go, you cannot come.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, You are from beneath; I am from above: you are of this world; I am not of this world.
verses.text: And he said unto them, You are from beneath; I am from above: you are of this world; I am not of this world.

verses.raw: I said therefore unto you, that you shall die in your sins: for if you believe not that I am he, you shall die in your sins.
verses.text: I said therefore unto you, that you shall die in your sins: for if you believe not that I am he, you shall die in your sins.

verses.raw: Then said they unto him, Who are you? And Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.
verses.text: Then said they unto him, Who are you? And Yahusha says unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

verses.raw: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
verses.text: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

verses.raw: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
verses.text: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.

verses.raw: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto them, When you have lifted up the Son of Adam, then shall you know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father has taught me, I speak these things.
verses.text: Then said Yahusha unto them, When you have lifted up the Son of Adam, then shall you know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father has taught me, I speak these things.

verses.raw: And he that sent me is with me: the Father has not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
verses.text: And he that sent me is with me: the Father has not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

verses.raw: As he spake these words, many believed on him.
verses.text: As he spake these words, many believed on him.

verses.raw: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) to those Yahudim (Jews) which believed on him, If you continue in my word, then are you my disciples indeed;
verses.text: Then said Yahusha to those Yahudim which believed on him, If you continue in my word, then are you my disciples indeed;

verses.raw: And you shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
verses.text: And you shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

verses.raw: They answered him, We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how say you, You shall be made free?
verses.text: They answered him, We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how say you, You shall be made free?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever commits sin is the servant of sin.
verses.text: Yahusha answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever commits sin is the servant of sin.

verses.raw: And the servant abides not in the house for ever: but the Son abides ever.
verses.text: And the servant abides not in the house for ever: but the Son abides ever.

verses.raw: If the Son therefore shall make you free, you shall be free indeed.
verses.text: If the Son therefore shall make you free, you shall be free indeed.

verses.raw: I know that you are Abraham’s seed; but you seek to kill me, because my word has no place in you.
verses.text: I know that you are Abraham’s seed; but you seek to kill me, because my word has no place in you.

verses.raw: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and you do that which you have seen with your father.
verses.text: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and you do that which you have seen with your father.

verses.raw: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.
verses.text: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Yahusha says unto them, If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.

verses.raw: But now you seek to kill me, a man that has told you the truth, which I have heard of Elohim (God): this did not Abraham.
verses.text: But now you seek to kill me, a man that has told you the truth, which I have heard of Elohim: this did not Abraham.

verses.raw: You do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even Elohim (God).
verses.text: You do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even Elohim.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, If Elohim (God) were your Father, you would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from Elohim (God); neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
verses.text: Yahusha said unto them, If Elohim were your Father, you would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from Elohim; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

verses.raw: Why do you not understand my speech? even because you cannot hear my word.
verses.text: Why do you not understand my speech? even because you cannot hear my word.

verses.raw: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
verses.text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

verses.raw: And because I tell you the truth, you believe me not.
verses.text: And because I tell you the truth, you believe me not.

verses.raw: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do you not believe me?
verses.text: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do you not believe me?

verses.raw: He that is of Elohim (God) hears Elohim's (God’s) words: you therefore hear them not, because you are not of Elohim (God).
verses.text: He that is of Elohim hears Elohim's (God’s) words: you therefore hear them not, because you are not of Elohim.

verses.raw: Then answered the Yahudim (Jews), and said unto him, Say we not well that you are a Samaritan, and have a devil?
verses.text: Then answered the Yahudim, and said unto him, Say we not well that you are a Samaritan, and have a devil?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and you do dishonour me.
verses.text: Yahusha answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and you do dishonour me.

verses.raw: And I seek not my own glory: there is one that seeks and judges.
verses.text: And I seek not my own glory: there is one that seeks and judges.

verses.raw: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
verses.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.

verses.raw: Then said the Yahudim (Jews) unto him, Now we know that you have a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and you say, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
verses.text: Then said the Yahudim unto him, Now we know that you have a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and you say, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

verses.raw: Are you greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom make you thyself?
verses.text: Are you greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom make you thyself?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom you say, that he is your Elohim (God):
verses.text: Yahusha answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom you say, that he is your Elohim:

verses.raw: Yet you have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
verses.text: Yet you have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

verses.raw: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
verses.text: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.

verses.raw: Then said the Yahudim (Jews) unto him, You are not yet fifty years old, and have you seen Abraham?
verses.text: Then said the Yahudim unto him, You are not yet fifty years old, and have you seen Abraham?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
verses.text: Yahusha said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

verses.raw: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Yahusha (Jesus) hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
verses.text: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Yahusha hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.

verses.raw: And as Yahusha (Jesus) passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
verses.text: And as Yahusha passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.

verses.raw: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
verses.text: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered, Neither has this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of Elohim (God) should be made manifest in him.
verses.text: Yahusha answered, Neither has this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of Elohim should be made manifest in him.

verses.raw: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night comes, when no man can work.
verses.text: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night comes, when no man can work.

verses.raw: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
verses.text: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

verses.raw: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,
verses.text: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,

verses.raw: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
verses.text: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.

verses.raw: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
verses.text: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?

verses.raw: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.
verses.text: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.

verses.raw: Therefore said they unto him, How were your eyes opened?
verses.text: Therefore said they unto him, How were your eyes opened?

verses.raw: He answered and said, A man that is called Yahusha (Jesus) made clay, and anointed my eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.
verses.text: He answered and said, A man that is called Yahusha made clay, and anointed my eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.

verses.raw: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
verses.text: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.

verses.raw: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
verses.text: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.

verses.raw: And it was the sabbath day when Yahusha (Jesus) made the clay, and opened his eyes.
verses.text: And it was the sabbath day when Yahusha made the clay, and opened his eyes.

verses.raw: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon my eyes, and I washed, and do see.
verses.text: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon my eyes, and I washed, and do see.

verses.raw: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of Elohim (God), because he keeps not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.
verses.text: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of Elohim, because he keeps not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.

verses.raw: They say unto the blind man again, What say you of him, that he has opened your eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
verses.text: They say unto the blind man again, What say you of him, that he has opened your eyes? He said, He is a prophet.

verses.raw: But the Yahudim (Jews) did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.
verses.text: But the Yahudim did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.

verses.raw: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who you say was born blind? how then does he now see?
verses.text: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who you say was born blind? how then does he now see?

verses.raw: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
verses.text: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:

verses.raw: But by what means he now sees, we know not; or who has opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.
verses.text: But by what means he now sees, we know not; or who has opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.

verses.raw: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Yahudim (Jews): for the Yahudim (Jews) had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Messiah (Christ), he should be put out of the synagogue.
verses.text: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Yahudim: for the Yahudim had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Messiah, he should be put out of the synagogue.

verses.raw: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
verses.text: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.

verses.raw: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give Elohim (God) the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
verses.text: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give Elohim the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

verses.raw: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
verses.text: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

verses.raw: Then said they to him again, What did he to you? how opened he your eyes?
verses.text: Then said they to him again, What did he to you? how opened he your eyes?

verses.raw: He answered them, I have told you already, and you did not hear: wherefore would you hear it again? will you also be his disciples?
verses.text: He answered them, I have told you already, and you did not hear: wherefore would you hear it again? will you also be his disciples?

verses.raw: Then they reviled him, and said, You are his disciple; but we are Moses’ disciples.
verses.text: Then they reviled him, and said, You are his disciple; but we are Moses’ disciples.

verses.raw: We know that Elohim (God) spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.
verses.text: We know that Elohim spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.

verses.raw: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that you know not from whence he is, and yet he has opened my eyes.
verses.text: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that you know not from whence he is, and yet he has opened my eyes.

verses.raw: Now we know that Elohim (God) hears not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of Elohim (God), and does his will, him he hears.
verses.text: Now we know that Elohim hears not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of Elohim, and does his will, him he hears.

verses.raw: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.
verses.text: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.

verses.raw: If this man were not of Elohim (God), he could do nothing.
verses.text: If this man were not of Elohim, he could do nothing.

verses.raw: They answered and said unto him, You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us? And they cast him out.
verses.text: They answered and said unto him, You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us? And they cast him out.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Do you believe on the Son of Elohim (God)?
verses.text: Yahusha heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Do you believe on the Son of Elohim?

verses.raw: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?
verses.text: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, You have both seen him, and it is he that talks with you.
verses.text: And Yahusha said unto him, You have both seen him, and it is he that talks with you.

verses.raw: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.
verses.text: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.
verses.text: And Yahusha said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.

verses.raw: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?
verses.text: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, If you were blind, you should have no sin: but now you say, We see; therefore your sin remains.
verses.text: Yahusha said unto them, If you were blind, you should have no sin: but now you say, We see; therefore your sin remains.

verses.raw: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that enters not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbs up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
verses.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that enters not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbs up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

verses.raw: But he that enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
verses.text: But he that enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

verses.raw: To him the porter opens; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calls his own sheep by name, and leads them out.
verses.text: To him the porter opens; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calls his own sheep by name, and leads them out.

verses.raw: And when he puts forth his own sheep, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.
verses.text: And when he puts forth his own sheep, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

verses.raw: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
verses.text: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.

verses.raw: This parable spake Yahusha (Jesus) unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
verses.text: This parable spake Yahusha unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.

verses.raw: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
verses.text: Then said Yahusha unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

verses.raw: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
verses.text: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

verses.raw: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
verses.text: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

verses.raw: The thief comes not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
verses.text: The thief comes not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

verses.raw: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd gives his life for the sheep.
verses.text: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd gives his life for the sheep.

verses.raw: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, sees the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catches them, and scatters the sheep.
verses.text: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, sees the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catches them, and scatters the sheep.

verses.raw: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
verses.text: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

verses.raw: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.
verses.text: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.

verses.raw: As the Father knows me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.
verses.text: As the Father knows me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.

verses.raw: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.
verses.text: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

verses.raw: Therefore does my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.
verses.text: Therefore does my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.

verses.raw: No man takes it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.
verses.text: No man takes it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.

verses.raw: There was a division therefore again among the Yahudim (Jews) for these sayings.
verses.text: There was a division therefore again among the Yahudim for these sayings.

verses.raw: And many of them said, He has a devil, and is mad; why hear you him?
verses.text: And many of them said, He has a devil, and is mad; why hear you him?

verses.raw: Others said, These are not the words of him that has a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
verses.text: Others said, These are not the words of him that has a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?

verses.raw: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
verses.text: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) walked in the temple in Solomon’s porch.
verses.text: And Yahusha walked in the temple in Solomon’s porch.

verses.raw: Then came the Yahudim (Jews) round about him, and said unto him, How long do you make us to doubt? If you be the Messiah (Christ), tell us plainly.
verses.text: Then came the Yahudim round about him, and said unto him, How long do you make us to doubt? If you be the Messiah, tell us plainly.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered them, I told you, and you believed not: the works that I do in my Father’s name, they bear witness of me.
verses.text: Yahusha answered them, I told you, and you believed not: the works that I do in my Father’s name, they bear witness of me.

verses.raw: But you believe not, because you are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.
verses.text: But you believe not, because you are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.

verses.raw: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
verses.text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

verses.raw: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
verses.text: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

verses.raw: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.
verses.text: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.

verses.raw: I and my Father are one.
verses.text: I and my Father are one.

verses.raw: Then the Yahudim (Jews) took up stones again to stone him.
verses.text: Then the Yahudim took up stones again to stone him.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do you stone me?
verses.text: Yahusha answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do you stone me?

verses.raw: The Yahudim (Jews) answered him, saying, For a good work we stone you not; but for blasphemy; and because that you, being a man, make thyself Elohim (God).
verses.text: The Yahudim answered him, saying, For a good work we stone you not; but for blasphemy; and because that you, being a man, make thyself Elohim.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, You are gods?
verses.text: Yahusha answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, You are gods?

verses.raw: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of Elohim (God) came, and the scripture cannot be broken;
verses.text: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of Elohim came, and the scripture cannot be broken;

verses.raw: Say you of him, whom the Father has sanctified, and sent into the world, You blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of Elohim (God)?
verses.text: Say you of him, whom the Father has sanctified, and sent into the world, You blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of Elohim?

verses.raw: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
verses.text: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

verses.raw: But if I do, though you believe not me, believe the works: that you may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.
verses.text: But if I do, though you believe not me, believe the works: that you may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.

verses.raw: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
verses.text: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,

verses.raw: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.
verses.text: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.

verses.raw: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.
verses.text: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.

verses.raw: And many believed on him there.
verses.text: And many believed on him there.

verses.raw: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
verses.text: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

verses.raw: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
verses.text: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

verses.raw: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom you love is sick.
verses.text: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom you love is sick.

verses.raw: When Yahusha (Jesus) heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of Elohim (God), that the Son of Elohim (God) might be glorified thereby.
verses.text: When Yahusha heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of Elohim, that the Son of Elohim might be glorified thereby.

verses.raw: Now Yahusha (Jesus) loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
verses.text: Now Yahusha loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

verses.raw: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.
verses.text: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.

verses.raw: Then after that says he to his disciples, Let us go into Judæa again.
verses.text: Then after that says he to his disciples, Let us go into Judæa again.

verses.raw: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Yahudim (Jews) of late sought to stone you; and go you thither again?
verses.text: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Yahudim of late sought to stone you; and go you thither again?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he sees the light of this world.
verses.text: Yahusha answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he sees the light of this world.

verses.raw: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
verses.text: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.

verses.raw: These things said he: and after that he says unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleeps; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
verses.text: These things said he: and after that he says unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleeps; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.

verses.raw: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
verses.text: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.

verses.raw: Howbeit Yahusha (Jesus) spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
verses.text: Howbeit Yahusha spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.

verses.raw: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
verses.text: Then said Yahusha unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.

verses.raw: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent you may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
verses.text: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent you may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.

verses.raw: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
verses.text: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.

verses.raw: Then when Yahusha (Jesus) came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.
verses.text: Then when Yahusha came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.

verses.raw: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
verses.text: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:

verses.raw: And many of the Yahudim (Jews) came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
verses.text: And many of the Yahudim came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.

verses.raw: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Yahusha (Jesus) was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.
verses.text: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Yahusha was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.

verses.raw: Then said Martha unto Yahusha (Jesus), Lord, if you had been here, my brother had not died.
verses.text: Then said Martha unto Yahusha, Lord, if you had been here, my brother had not died.

verses.raw: But I know, that even now, whatsoever you will ask of Elohim (God), Elohim (God) will give it you.
verses.text: But I know, that even now, whatsoever you will ask of Elohim, Elohim will give it you.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto her, Your brother shall rise again.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto her, Your brother shall rise again.

verses.raw: Martha says unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
verses.text: Martha says unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believes in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
verses.text: Yahusha said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believes in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

verses.raw: And whosoever lives and believes in me shall never die. Believe you this?
verses.text: And whosoever lives and believes in me shall never die. Believe you this?

verses.raw: She says unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that you are the Messiah (Christ), the Son of Elohim (God), which should come into the world.
verses.text: She says unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that you are the Messiah, the Son of Elohim, which should come into the world.

verses.raw: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calls for you.
verses.text: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calls for you.

verses.raw: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.
verses.text: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.

verses.raw: Now Yahusha (Jesus) was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.
verses.text: Now Yahusha was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.

verses.raw: The Yahudim (Jews) then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goes unto the grave to weep there.
verses.text: The Yahudim then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goes unto the grave to weep there.

verses.raw: Then when Mary was come where Yahusha (Jesus) was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if you had been here, my brother had not died.
verses.text: Then when Mary was come where Yahusha was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if you had been here, my brother had not died.

verses.raw: When Yahusha (Jesus) therefore saw her weeping, and the Yahudim (Jews) also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
verses.text: When Yahusha therefore saw her weeping, and the Yahudim also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,

verses.raw: And said, Where have you laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
verses.text: And said, Where have you laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) wept.
verses.text: Yahusha wept.

verses.raw: Then said the Yahudim (Jews), Behold how he loved him!
verses.text: Then said the Yahudim, Behold how he loved him!

verses.raw: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
verses.text: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) therefore again groaning in himself comes to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
verses.text: Yahusha therefore again groaning in himself comes to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) said, Take you away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, says unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he has been dead four days.
verses.text: Yahusha said, Take you away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, says unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he has been dead four days.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto her, Said I not unto you, that, if you would believe, you should see the glory of Elohim (God)?
verses.text: Yahusha says unto her, Said I not unto you, that, if you would believe, you should see the glory of Elohim?

verses.raw: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Yahusha (Jesus) lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank you that you have heard me.
verses.text: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Yahusha lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank you that you have heard me.

verses.raw: And I knew that you hear me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that you have sent me.
verses.text: And I knew that you hear me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that you have sent me.

verses.raw: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
verses.text: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.

verses.raw: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
verses.text: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Yahusha says unto them, Loose him, and let him go.

verses.raw: Then many of the Yahudim (Jews) which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Yahusha (Jesus) did, believed on him.
verses.text: Then many of the Yahudim which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Yahusha did, believed on him.

verses.raw: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Yahusha (Jesus) had done.
verses.text: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Yahusha had done.

verses.raw: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man does many miracles.
verses.text: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man does many miracles.

verses.raw: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.
verses.text: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.

verses.raw: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, You know nothing at all,
verses.text: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, You know nothing at all,

verses.raw: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
verses.text: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.

verses.raw: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Yahusha (Jesus) should die for that nation;
verses.text: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Yahusha should die for that nation;

verses.raw: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of Elohim (God) that were scattered abroad.
verses.text: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of Elohim that were scattered abroad.

verses.raw: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.
verses.text: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) therefore walked no more openly among the Yahudim (Jews); but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
verses.text: Yahusha therefore walked no more openly among the Yahudim; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.

verses.raw: And the Yahudim's (Jews’) passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
verses.text: And the Yahudim's (Jews’) passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.

verses.raw: Then sought they for Yahusha (Jesus), and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think you, that he will not come to the feast?
verses.text: Then sought they for Yahusha, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think you, that he will not come to the feast?

verses.raw: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.
verses.text: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.

verses.raw: Then Yahusha (Jesus) six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
verses.text: Then Yahusha six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

verses.raw: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.
verses.text: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.

verses.raw: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Yahusha (Jesus), and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.
verses.text: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Yahusha, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.

verses.raw: Then says one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, which should betray him,
verses.text: Then says one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, which should betray him,

verses.raw: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
verses.text: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?

verses.raw: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.
verses.text: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.

verses.raw: Then said Yahusha (Jesus), Let her alone: against the day of my burying has she kept this.
verses.text: Then said Yahusha, Let her alone: against the day of my burying has she kept this.

verses.raw: For the poor always you have with you; but me you have not always.
verses.text: For the poor always you have with you; but me you have not always.

verses.raw: Much people of the Yahudim (Jews) therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Yahusha's (Jesus’) sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
verses.text: Much people of the Yahudim therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Yahusha's (Jesus’) sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

verses.raw: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;
verses.text: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;

verses.raw: Because that by reason of him many of the Yahudim (Jews) went away, and believed on Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: Because that by reason of him many of the Yahudim went away, and believed on Yahusha.

verses.raw: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Yahusha (Jesus) was coming to Jerusalem,
verses.text: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Yahusha was coming to Jerusalem,

verses.raw: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Yashar'el (Israel) that comes in the name of Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Yashar'el that comes in the name of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus), when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
verses.text: And Yahusha, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,

verses.raw: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, your King comes, sitting on an ass’s colt.
verses.text: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, your King comes, sitting on an ass’s colt.

verses.raw: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Yahusha (Jesus) was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
verses.text: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Yahusha was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.

verses.raw: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.
verses.text: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.

verses.raw: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
verses.text: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.

verses.raw: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive you how you prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
verses.text: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive you how you prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.

verses.raw: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
verses.text: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:

verses.raw: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Yahusha.

verses.raw: Philip comes and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: Philip comes and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Yahusha.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of Adam should be glorified.
verses.text: And Yahusha answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of Adam should be glorified.

verses.raw: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abides alone: but if it die, it brings forth much fruit.
verses.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abides alone: but if it die, it brings forth much fruit.

verses.raw: He that loves his life shall lose it; and he that hates his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
verses.text: He that loves his life shall lose it; and he that hates his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

verses.raw: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
verses.text: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.

verses.raw: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
verses.text: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.

verses.raw: Father, glorify your name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
verses.text: Father, glorify your name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.

verses.raw: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.
verses.text: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
verses.text: Yahusha answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.

verses.raw: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
verses.text: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

verses.raw: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
verses.text: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.

verses.raw: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
verses.text: This he said, signifying what death he should die.

verses.raw: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Messiah (Christ) abides for ever: and how say you, The Son of Adam must be lifted up? who is this Son of Adam?
verses.text: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Messiah abides for ever: and how say you, The Son of Adam must be lifted up? who is this Son of Adam?

verses.raw: Then Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while you have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walks in darkness knows not whither he goes.
verses.text: Then Yahusha said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while you have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walks in darkness knows not whither he goes.

verses.raw: While you have light, believe in the light, that you may be the children of light. These things spake Yahusha (Jesus), and departed, and did hide himself from them.
verses.text: While you have light, believe in the light, that you may be the children of light. These things spake Yahusha, and departed, and did hide himself from them.

verses.raw: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
verses.text: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:

verses.raw: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Yahuah (Lord), who has believed our report? and to whom has the arm of Yahuah (Lord) been revealed?
verses.text: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Yahuah, who has believed our report? and to whom has the arm of Yahuah been revealed?

verses.raw: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,
verses.text: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,

verses.raw: He has blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.text: He has blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

verses.raw: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.
verses.text: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.

verses.raw: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
verses.text: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:

verses.raw: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of Elohim (God).
verses.text: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of Elohim.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) cried and said, He that believes on me, believes not on me, but on him that sent me.
verses.text: Yahusha cried and said, He that believes on me, believes not on me, but on him that sent me.

verses.raw: And he that sees me sees him that sent me.
verses.text: And he that sees me sees him that sent me.

verses.raw: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believes on me should not abide in darkness.
verses.text: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believes on me should not abide in darkness.

verses.raw: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
verses.text: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

verses.raw: He that rejecteth me, and receives not my words, has one that judges him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
verses.text: He that rejecteth me, and receives not my words, has one that judges him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

verses.raw: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
verses.text: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

verses.raw: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
verses.text: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.

verses.raw: Now before the feast of the passover, when Yahusha (Jesus) knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
verses.text: Now before the feast of the passover, when Yahusha knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.

verses.raw: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him;
verses.text: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him;

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from Elohim (God), and went to Elohim (God);
verses.text: Yahusha knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from Elohim, and went to Elohim;

verses.raw: He rises from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
verses.text: He rises from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.

verses.raw: After that he pours water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
verses.text: After that he pours water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.

verses.raw: Then comes he to Simon Peter: and Peter says unto him, Lord, do you wash my feet?
verses.text: Then comes he to Simon Peter: and Peter says unto him, Lord, do you wash my feet?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, What I do you know not now; but you shall know hereafter.
verses.text: Yahusha answered and said unto him, What I do you know not now; but you shall know hereafter.

verses.raw: Peter says unto him, You shall never wash my feet. Yahusha (Jesus) answered him, If I wash you not, you have no part with me.
verses.text: Peter says unto him, You shall never wash my feet. Yahusha answered him, If I wash you not, you have no part with me.

verses.raw: Simon Peter says unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
verses.text: Simon Peter says unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and you are clean, but not all.
verses.text: Yahusha says to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and you are clean, but not all.

verses.raw: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, You are not all clean.
verses.text: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, You are not all clean.

verses.raw: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know you what I have done to you?
verses.text: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know you what I have done to you?

verses.raw: You call me Master and the Lord: and you say well; for so I am.
verses.text: You call me Master and the Lord: and you say well; for so I am.

verses.raw: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
verses.text: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; you also ought to wash one another’s feet.

verses.raw: For I have given you an example, that you should do as I have done to you.
verses.text: For I have given you an example, that you should do as I have done to you.

verses.raw: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.
verses.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.

verses.raw: If you know these things, happy are you if you do them.
verses.text: If you know these things, happy are you if you do them.

verses.raw: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.
verses.text: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.

verses.raw: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, you may believe that I am he.
verses.text: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, you may believe that I am he.

verses.raw: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receives whomsoever I send receives me; and he that receives me receives him that sent me.
verses.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receives whomsoever I send receives me; and he that receives me receives him that sent me.

verses.raw: When Yahusha (Jesus) had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
verses.text: When Yahusha had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

verses.raw: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
verses.text: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.

verses.raw: Now there was leaning on Yahusha's (Jesus’) bosom one of his disciples, whom Yahusha (Jesus) loved.
verses.text: Now there was leaning on Yahusha's (Jesus’) bosom one of his disciples, whom Yahusha loved.

verses.raw: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.
verses.text: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.

verses.raw: He then lying on Yahusha's (Jesus’) breast says unto him, Lord, who is it?
verses.text: He then lying on Yahusha's (Jesus’) breast says unto him, Lord, who is it?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.
verses.text: Yahusha answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

verses.raw: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto him, That you do, do quickly.
verses.text: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Yahusha unto him, That you do, do quickly.

verses.raw: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
verses.text: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.

verses.raw: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Yahusha (Jesus) had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
verses.text: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Yahusha had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

verses.raw: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
verses.text: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.

verses.raw: Therefore, when he was gone out, Yahusha (Jesus) said, Now is the Son of Adam glorified, and Elohim (God) is glorified in him.
verses.text: Therefore, when he was gone out, Yahusha said, Now is the Son of Adam glorified, and Elohim is glorified in him.

verses.raw: If Elohim (God) be glorified in him, Elohim (God) shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
verses.text: If Elohim be glorified in him, Elohim shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.

verses.raw: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. You shall seek me: and as I said unto the Yahudim (Jews), Whither I go, you cannot come; so now I say to you.
verses.text: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. You shall seek me: and as I said unto the Yahudim, Whither I go, you cannot come; so now I say to you.

verses.raw: A new commandment I give unto you, That you love one another; as I have loved you, that you also love one another.
verses.text: A new commandment I give unto you, That you love one another; as I have loved you, that you also love one another.

verses.raw: By this shall all men know that you are my disciples, if you have love one to another.
verses.text: By this shall all men know that you are my disciples, if you have love one to another.

verses.raw: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither go you? Yahusha (Jesus) answered him, Whither I go, you can not follow me now; but you shall follow me afterwards.
verses.text: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither go you? Yahusha answered him, Whither I go, you can not follow me now; but you shall follow me afterwards.

verses.raw: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow you now? I will lay down my life for your sake.
verses.text: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow you now? I will lay down my life for your sake.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered him, Will you lay down your life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto you, The cock shall not crow, till you have denied me thrice.
verses.text: Yahusha answered him, Will you lay down your life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto you, The cock shall not crow, till you have denied me thrice.

verses.raw: Let not your heart be troubled: you believe in Elohim (God), believe also in me.
verses.text: Let not your heart be troubled: you believe in Elohim, believe also in me.

verses.raw: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
verses.text: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

verses.raw: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there you may be also.
verses.text: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there you may be also.

verses.raw: And whither I go you know, and the way you know.
verses.text: And whither I go you know, and the way you know.

verses.raw: Thomas says unto him, Lord, we know not whither you go; and how can we know the way?
verses.text: Thomas says unto him, Lord, we know not whither you go; and how can we know the way?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man comes unto the Father, but by me.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man comes unto the Father, but by me.

verses.raw: If you had known me, you should have known my Father also: and from henceforth you know him, and have seen him.
verses.text: If you had known me, you should have known my Father also: and from henceforth you know him, and have seen him.

verses.raw: Philip says unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
verses.text: Philip says unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet have you not known me, Philip? he that has seen me has seen the Father; and how say you then, Shew us the Father?
verses.text: Yahusha says unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet have you not known me, Philip? he that has seen me has seen the Father; and how say you then, Shew us the Father?

verses.raw: Believe you not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwells in me, he does the works.
verses.text: Believe you not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwells in me, he does the works.

verses.raw: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
verses.text: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

verses.raw: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believes on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
verses.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believes on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.

verses.raw: And whatsoever you shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.text: And whatsoever you shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

verses.raw: If you shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
verses.text: If you shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.

verses.raw: If you love me, keep my commandments.
verses.text: If you love me, keep my commandments.

verses.raw: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
verses.text: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;

verses.raw: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it sees him not, neither knows him: but you know him; for he dwells with you, and shall be in you.
verses.text: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it sees him not, neither knows him: but you know him; for he dwells with you, and shall be in you.

verses.raw: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
verses.text: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

verses.raw: Yet a little while, and the world sees me no more; but you see me: because I live, you shall live also.
verses.text: Yet a little while, and the world sees me no more; but you see me: because I live, you shall live also.

verses.raw: At that day you shall know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
verses.text: At that day you shall know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

verses.raw: He that has my commandments, and keeps them, he it is that loves me: and he that loves me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
verses.text: He that has my commandments, and keeps them, he it is that loves me: and he that loves me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

verses.raw: Judas says unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that you will manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
verses.text: Judas says unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that you will manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
verses.text: Yahusha answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

verses.raw: He that loves me not keeps not my sayings: and the word which you hear is not mine, but the Father’s which sent me.
verses.text: He that loves me not keeps not my sayings: and the word which you hear is not mine, but the Father’s which sent me.

verses.raw: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
verses.text: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.

verses.raw: But the Comforter, which is the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
verses.text: But the Comforter, which is the Ruach HaKodesh, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

verses.raw: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world gives, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
verses.text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world gives, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

verses.raw: You have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If you loved me, you would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
verses.text: You have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If you loved me, you would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.

verses.raw: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, you might believe.
verses.text: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, you might believe.

verses.raw: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world comes, and has nothing in me.
verses.text: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world comes, and has nothing in me.

verses.raw: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
verses.text: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.

verses.raw: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
verses.text: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

verses.raw: Every branch in me that bears not fruit he takes away: and every branch that bears fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
verses.text: Every branch in me that bears not fruit he takes away: and every branch that bears fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

verses.raw: Now you are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
verses.text: Now you are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.

verses.raw: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can you, except you abide in me.
verses.text: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can you, except you abide in me.

verses.raw: I am the vine, you are the branches: He that abides in me, and I in him, the same brings forth much fruit: for without me you can do nothing.
verses.text: I am the vine, you are the branches: He that abides in me, and I in him, the same brings forth much fruit: for without me you can do nothing.

verses.raw: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
verses.text: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

verses.raw: If you abide in me, and my words abide in you, you shall ask what you will, and it shall be done unto you.
verses.text: If you abide in me, and my words abide in you, you shall ask what you will, and it shall be done unto you.

verses.raw: Herein is my Father glorified, that you bear much fruit; so shall you be my disciples.
verses.text: Herein is my Father glorified, that you bear much fruit; so shall you be my disciples.

verses.raw: As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you: continue you in my love.
verses.text: As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you: continue you in my love.

verses.raw: If you keep my commandments, you shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.
verses.text: If you keep my commandments, you shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.

verses.raw: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
