verses.text: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

verses.raw: This is my commandment, That you love one another, as I have loved you.
verses.text: This is my commandment, That you love one another, as I have loved you.

verses.raw: Greater love has no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
verses.text: Greater love has no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

verses.raw: You are my friends, if you do whatsoever I command you.
verses.text: You are my friends, if you do whatsoever I command you.

verses.raw: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knows not what his lord does: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
verses.text: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knows not what his lord does: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

verses.raw: You have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that you should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever you shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
verses.text: You have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that you should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever you shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

verses.raw: These things I command you, that you love one another.
verses.text: These things I command you, that you love one another.

verses.raw: If the world hate you, you know that it hated me before it hated you.
verses.text: If the world hate you, you know that it hated me before it hated you.

verses.raw: If you were of the world, the world would love his own: but because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
verses.text: If you were of the world, the world would love his own: but because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

verses.raw: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
verses.text: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.

verses.raw: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.
verses.text: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.

verses.raw: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.
verses.text: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.

verses.raw: He that hates me hates my Father also.
verses.text: He that hates me hates my Father also.

verses.raw: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
verses.text: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

verses.raw: But this comes to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
verses.text: But this comes to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

verses.raw: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceeds from the Father, he shall testify of me:
verses.text: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceeds from the Father, he shall testify of me:

verses.raw: And you also shall bear witness, because you have been with me from the beginning.
verses.text: And you also shall bear witness, because you have been with me from the beginning.

verses.raw: These things have I spoken unto you, that you should not be offended.
verses.text: These things have I spoken unto you, that you should not be offended.

verses.raw: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time comes, that whosoever kills you will think that he does Elohim (God) service.
verses.text: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time comes, that whosoever kills you will think that he does Elohim service.

verses.raw: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
verses.text: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

verses.raw: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, you may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
verses.text: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, you may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.

verses.raw: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asks me, Whither go you?
verses.text: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asks me, Whither go you?

verses.raw: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow has filled your heart.
verses.text: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow has filled your heart.

verses.raw: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
verses.text: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.

verses.raw: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
verses.text: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

verses.raw: Of sin, because they believe not on me;
verses.text: Of sin, because they believe not on me;

verses.raw: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and you see me no more;
verses.text: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and you see me no more;

verses.raw: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
verses.text: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

verses.raw: I have yet many things to say unto you, but you cannot bear them now.
verses.text: I have yet many things to say unto you, but you cannot bear them now.

verses.raw: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
verses.text: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

verses.raw: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
verses.text: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

verses.raw: All things that the Father has are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
verses.text: All things that the Father has are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

verses.raw: A little while, and you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and you shall see me, because I go to the Father.
verses.text: A little while, and you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and you shall see me, because I go to the Father.

verses.raw: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he says unto us, A little while, and you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and you shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
verses.text: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he says unto us, A little while, and you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and you shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

verses.raw: They said therefore, What is this that he says, A little while? we cannot tell what he says.
verses.text: They said therefore, What is this that he says, A little while? we cannot tell what he says.

verses.raw: Now Yahusha (Jesus) knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do you enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and you shall see me?
verses.text: Now Yahusha knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do you enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and you shall see me?

verses.raw: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That you shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and you shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
verses.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That you shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and you shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

verses.raw: A woman when she is in travail has sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
verses.text: A woman when she is in travail has sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.

verses.raw: And you now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man takes from you.
verses.text: And you now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man takes from you.

verses.raw: And in that day you shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever you shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
verses.text: And in that day you shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever you shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.

verses.raw: Hitherto have you asked nothing in my name: ask, and you shall receive, that your joy may be full.
verses.text: Hitherto have you asked nothing in my name: ask, and you shall receive, that your joy may be full.

verses.raw: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time comes, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.
verses.text: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time comes, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.

verses.raw: At that day you shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
verses.text: At that day you shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:

verses.raw: For the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came out from Elohim (God).
verses.text: For the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came out from Elohim.

verses.raw: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
verses.text: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.

verses.raw: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speak you plainly, and speak no proverb.
verses.text: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speak you plainly, and speak no proverb.

verses.raw: Now are we sure that you know all things, and needest not that any man should ask you: by this we believe that you came forth from Elohim (God).
verses.text: Now are we sure that you know all things, and needest not that any man should ask you: by this we believe that you came forth from Elohim.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered them, Do you now believe?
verses.text: Yahusha answered them, Do you now believe?

verses.raw: Behold, the hour comes, yea, is now come, that you shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
verses.text: Behold, the hour comes, yea, is now come, that you shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

verses.raw: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me you might have peace. In the world you shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
verses.text: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me you might have peace. In the world you shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

verses.raw: These words spake Yahusha (Jesus), and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify your Son, that your Son also may glorify you:
verses.text: These words spake Yahusha, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify your Son, that your Son also may glorify you:

verses.raw: As you have given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as you have given him.
verses.text: As you have given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as you have given him.

verses.raw: And this is life eternal, that they might know you the only true Elohim (God), and Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), whom you have sent.
verses.text: And this is life eternal, that they might know you the only true Elohim, and Yahusha HaMashiach, whom you have sent.

verses.raw: I have glorified you on the earth: I have finished the work which you gave me to do.
verses.text: I have glorified you on the earth: I have finished the work which you gave me to do.

verses.raw: And now, O Father, glorify you me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world was.
verses.text: And now, O Father, glorify you me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world was.

verses.raw: I have manifested your name unto the men which you gave me out of the world: yours they were, and you gave them me; and they have kept your word.
verses.text: I have manifested your name unto the men which you gave me out of the world: yours they were, and you gave them me; and they have kept your word.

verses.raw: Now they have known that all things whatsoever you have given me are of you.
verses.text: Now they have known that all things whatsoever you have given me are of you.

verses.raw: For I have given unto them the words which you gave me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from you, and they have believed that you did send me.
verses.text: For I have given unto them the words which you gave me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from you, and they have believed that you did send me.

verses.raw: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which you have given me; for they are yours.
verses.text: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which you have given me; for they are yours.

verses.raw: And all my are yours, and yours are mine; and I am glorified in them.
verses.text: And all my are yours, and yours are mine; and I am glorified in them.

verses.raw: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to you. Holy Father, keep through your own name those whom you have given me, that they may be one, as we are.
verses.text: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to you. Holy Father, keep through your own name those whom you have given me, that they may be one, as we are.

verses.raw: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name: those that you gave me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
verses.text: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name: those that you gave me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

verses.raw: And now come I to you; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
verses.text: And now come I to you; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.

verses.raw: I have given them your word; and the world has hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.text: I have given them your word; and the world has hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

verses.raw: I pray not that you should take them out of the world, but that you should keep them from the evil.
verses.text: I pray not that you should take them out of the world, but that you should keep them from the evil.

verses.raw: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.text: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

verses.raw: Sanctify them through your truth: your word is truth.
verses.text: Sanctify them through your truth: your word is truth.

verses.raw: As you have sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
verses.text: As you have sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.

verses.raw: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.
verses.text: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.

verses.raw: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
verses.text: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;

verses.raw: That they all may be one; as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that you have sent me.
verses.text: That they all may be one; as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that you have sent me.

verses.raw: And the glory which you gave me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
verses.text: And the glory which you gave me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:

verses.raw: I in them, and you in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that you have sent me, and have loved them, as you have loved me.
verses.text: I in them, and you in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that you have sent me, and have loved them, as you have loved me.

verses.raw: Father, I will that they also, whom you have given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which you have given me: for you lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
verses.text: Father, I will that they also, whom you have given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which you have given me: for you lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

verses.raw: O righteous Father, the world has not known you: but I have known you, and these have known that you have sent me.
verses.text: O righteous Father, the world has not known you: but I have known you, and these have known that you have sent me.

verses.raw: And I have declared unto them your name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith you have loved me may be in them, and I in them.
verses.text: And I have declared unto them your name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith you have loved me may be in them, and I in them.

verses.raw: When Yahusha (Jesus) had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
verses.text: When Yahusha had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.

verses.raw: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Yahusha (Jesus) ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
verses.text: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Yahusha ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.

verses.raw: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, comes thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
verses.text: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, comes thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek you?
verses.text: Yahusha therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek you?

verses.raw: They answered him, Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth. Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
verses.text: They answered him, Yahusha of Nazareth. Yahusha says unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.

verses.raw: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
verses.text: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.

verses.raw: Then asked he them again, Whom seek you? And they said, Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth.
verses.text: Then asked he them again, Whom seek you? And they said, Yahusha of Nazareth.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore you seek me, let these go their way:
verses.text: Yahusha answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore you seek me, let these go their way:

verses.raw: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which you gave me have I lost none.
verses.text: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which you gave me have I lost none.

verses.raw: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
verses.text: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

verses.raw: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto Peter, Put up your sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father has given me, shall I not drink it?
verses.text: Then said Yahusha unto Peter, Put up your sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father has given me, shall I not drink it?

verses.raw: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Yahudim (Jews) took Yahusha (Jesus), and bound him,
verses.text: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Yahudim took Yahusha, and bound him,

verses.raw: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
verses.text: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.

verses.raw: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Yahudim (Jews), that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
verses.text: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Yahudim, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.

verses.raw: And Simon Peter followed Yahusha (Jesus), and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Yahusha (Jesus) into the palace of the high priest.
verses.text: And Simon Peter followed Yahusha, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Yahusha into the palace of the high priest.

verses.raw: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
verses.text: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.

verses.raw: Then says the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Are not you also one of this man’s disciples? He says, I am not.
verses.text: Then says the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Are not you also one of this man’s disciples? He says, I am not.

verses.raw: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
verses.text: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.

verses.raw: The high priest then asked Yahusha (Jesus) of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
verses.text: The high priest then asked Yahusha of his disciples, and of his doctrine.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Yahudim (Jews) always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
verses.text: Yahusha answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Yahudim always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.

verses.raw: Why ask you me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
verses.text: Why ask you me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.

verses.raw: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Yahusha (Jesus) with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest you the high priest so?
verses.text: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Yahusha with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest you the high priest so?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest you me?
verses.text: Yahusha answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest you me?

verses.raw: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
verses.text: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.

verses.raw: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Are not you also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
verses.text: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Are not you also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.

verses.raw: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, says, Did not I see you in the garden with him?
verses.text: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, says, Did not I see you in the garden with him?

verses.raw: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
verses.text: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.

verses.raw: Then led they Yahusha (Jesus) from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
verses.text: Then led they Yahusha from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.

verses.raw: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring you against this man?
verses.text: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring you against this man?

verses.raw: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto you.
verses.text: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto you.

verses.raw: Then said Pilate unto them, Take you him, and judge him according to your law. The Yahudim (Jews) therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
verses.text: Then said Pilate unto them, Take you him, and judge him according to your law. The Yahudim therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:

verses.raw: That the saying of Yahusha (Jesus) might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
verses.text: That the saying of Yahusha might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.

verses.raw: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Yahusha (Jesus), and said unto him, Are you the King of the Yahudim (Jews)?
verses.text: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Yahusha, and said unto him, Are you the King of the Yahudim?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered him, Say you this thing of thyself, or did others tell it you of me?
verses.text: Yahusha answered him, Say you this thing of thyself, or did others tell it you of me?

verses.raw: Pilate answered, Am I a Yahudi (Jew)? Your own nation and the chief priests have delivered you unto me: what have you done?
verses.text: Pilate answered, Am I a Yahudi? Your own nation and the chief priests have delivered you unto me: what have you done?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Yahudim (Jews): but now is my kingdom not from hence.
verses.text: Yahusha answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Yahudim: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

verses.raw: Pilate therefore said unto him, Are you a king then? Yahusha (Jesus) answered, You say that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth hears my voice.
verses.text: Pilate therefore said unto him, Are you a king then? Yahusha answered, You say that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth hears my voice.

verses.raw: Pilate says unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Yahudim (Jews), and says unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
verses.text: Pilate says unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Yahudim, and says unto them, I find in him no fault at all.

verses.raw: But you have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will you therefore that I release unto you the King of the Yahudim (Jews)?
verses.text: But you have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will you therefore that I release unto you the King of the Yahudim?

verses.raw: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
verses.text: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.

verses.raw: Then Pilate therefore took Yahusha (Jesus), and scourged him.
verses.text: Then Pilate therefore took Yahusha, and scourged him.

verses.raw: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
verses.text: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,

verses.raw: And said, Hail, King of the Yahudim (Jews)! and they smote him with their hands.
verses.text: And said, Hail, King of the Yahudim! and they smote him with their hands.

verses.raw: Pilate therefore went forth again, and says unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that you may know that I find no fault in him.
verses.text: Pilate therefore went forth again, and says unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that you may know that I find no fault in him.

verses.raw: Then came Yahusha (Jesus) forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate says unto them, Behold the man!
verses.text: Then came Yahusha forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate says unto them, Behold the man!

verses.raw: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate says unto them, Take you him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.
verses.text: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate says unto them, Take you him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.

verses.raw: The Yahudim (Jews) answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of Elohim (God).
verses.text: The Yahudim answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of Elohim.

verses.raw: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;
verses.text: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;

verses.raw: And went again into the judgment hall, and says unto Yahusha (Jesus), Whence are you? But Yahusha (Jesus) gave him no answer.
verses.text: And went again into the judgment hall, and says unto Yahusha, Whence are you? But Yahusha gave him no answer.

verses.raw: Then says Pilate unto him, Speak you not unto me? know you not that I have power to crucify you, and have power to release you?
verses.text: Then says Pilate unto him, Speak you not unto me? know you not that I have power to crucify you, and have power to release you?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) answered, You could have no power at all against me, except it were given you from above: therefore he that delivered me unto you has the greater sin.
verses.text: Yahusha answered, You could have no power at all against me, except it were given you from above: therefore he that delivered me unto you has the greater sin.

verses.raw: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Yahudim (Jews) cried out, saying, If you let this man go, you are not Cæsar’s friend: whosoever makes himself a king speaks against Cæsar.
verses.text: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Yahudim cried out, saying, If you let this man go, you are not Cæsar’s friend: whosoever makes himself a king speaks against Cæsar.

verses.raw: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Yahusha (Jesus) forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
verses.text: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Yahusha forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.

verses.raw: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he says unto the Yahudim (Jews), Behold your King!
verses.text: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he says unto the Yahudim, Behold your King!

verses.raw: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate says unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cæsar.
verses.text: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate says unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cæsar.

verses.raw: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Yahusha (Jesus), and led him away.
verses.text: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Yahusha, and led him away.

verses.raw: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
verses.text: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:

verses.raw: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Yahusha (Jesus) in the midst.
verses.text: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Yahusha in the midst.

verses.raw: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, Yahusha (JESUS) OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.text: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, Yahusha OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.

verses.raw: This title then read many of the Yahudim (Jews): for the place where Yahusha (Jesus) was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
verses.text: This title then read many of the Yahudim: for the place where Yahusha was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.

verses.raw: Then said the chief priests of the Yahudim (Jews) to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Yahudim (Jews); but that he said, I am King of the Yahudim (Jews).
verses.text: Then said the chief priests of the Yahudim to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Yahudim; but that he said, I am King of the Yahudim.

verses.raw: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.
verses.text: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.

verses.raw: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Yahusha (Jesus), took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
verses.text: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Yahusha, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

verses.raw: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which says, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.
verses.text: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which says, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.

verses.raw: Now there stood by the cross of Yahusha (Jesus) his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
verses.text: Now there stood by the cross of Yahusha his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

verses.raw: When Yahusha (Jesus) therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he says unto his mother, Woman, behold your son!
verses.text: When Yahusha therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he says unto his mother, Woman, behold your son!

verses.raw: Then says he to the disciple, Behold your mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
verses.text: Then says he to the disciple, Behold your mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.

verses.raw: After this, Yahusha (Jesus) knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, says, I thirst.
verses.text: After this, Yahusha knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, says, I thirst.

verses.raw: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.
verses.text: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.

verses.raw: When Yahusha (Jesus) therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
verses.text: When Yahusha therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

verses.raw: The Yahudim (Jews) therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
verses.text: The Yahudim therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

verses.raw: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.
verses.text: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.

verses.raw: But when they came to Yahusha (Jesus), and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
verses.text: But when they came to Yahusha, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:

verses.raw: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.
verses.text: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.

verses.raw: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knows that he says true, that you might believe.
verses.text: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knows that he says true, that you might believe.

verses.raw: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
verses.text: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.

verses.raw: And again another scripture says, They shall look on him whom they pierced.
verses.text: And again another scripture says, They shall look on him whom they pierced.

verses.raw: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Yahusha (Jesus), but secretly for fear of the Yahudim (Jews), besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Yahusha (Jesus): and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Yahusha, but secretly for fear of the Yahudim, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Yahusha: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Yahusha.

verses.raw: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Yahusha (Jesus) by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.
verses.text: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Yahusha by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.

verses.raw: Then took they the body of Yahusha (Jesus), and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Yahudim (Jews) is to bury.
verses.text: Then took they the body of Yahusha, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Yahudim is to bury.

verses.raw: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.
verses.text: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.

verses.raw: There laid they Yahusha (Jesus) therefore because of the Yahudim's (Jews’) preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
verses.text: There laid they Yahusha therefore because of the Yahudim's (Jews’) preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.

verses.raw: The first day of the week comes Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and sees the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
verses.text: The first day of the week comes Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and sees the stone taken away from the sepulchre.

verses.raw: Then she runs, and comes to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Yahusha (Jesus) loved, and says unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.
verses.text: Then she runs, and comes to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Yahusha loved, and says unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.

verses.raw: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.
verses.text: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.

verses.raw: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
verses.text: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.

verses.raw: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
verses.text: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.

verses.raw: Then comes Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and sees the linen clothes lie,
verses.text: Then comes Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and sees the linen clothes lie,

verses.raw: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
verses.text: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.

verses.raw: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.
verses.text: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.

verses.raw: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
verses.text: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.

verses.raw: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.
verses.text: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.

verses.raw: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,
verses.text: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,

verses.raw: And sees two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Yahusha (Jesus) had lain.
verses.text: And sees two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Yahusha had lain.

verses.raw: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest you? She says unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.
verses.text: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest you? She says unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.

verses.raw: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Yahusha (Jesus) standing, and knew not that it was Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Yahusha standing, and knew not that it was Yahusha.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto her, Woman, why weepest you? whom seek you? She, supposing him to be the gardener, says unto him, Sir, if you have borne him hence, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto her, Woman, why weepest you? whom seek you? She, supposing him to be the gardener, says unto him, Sir, if you have borne him hence, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and says unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and says unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my Elohim (God), and your Elohim (God).
verses.text: Yahusha says unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my Elohim, and your Elohim.

verses.raw: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.
verses.text: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.

verses.raw: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Yahudim (Jews), came Yahusha (Jesus) and stood in the midst, and says unto them, Peace be unto you.
verses.text: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Yahudim, came Yahusha and stood in the midst, and says unto them, Peace be unto you.

verses.raw: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
verses.text: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.

verses.raw: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father has sent me, even so send I you.
verses.text: Then said Yahusha to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father has sent me, even so send I you.

verses.raw: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and says unto them, Receive you the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit):
verses.text: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and says unto them, Receive you the Ruach HaKodesh:

verses.raw: Whose soever sins you remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins you retain, they are retained.
verses.text: Whose soever sins you remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins you retain, they are retained.

verses.raw: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Yahusha (Jesus) came.
verses.text: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Yahusha came.

verses.raw: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
verses.text: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.

verses.raw: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Yahusha (Jesus), the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.
verses.text: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Yahusha, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.

verses.raw: Then says he to Thomas, Reach hither your finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither your hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
verses.text: Then says he to Thomas, Reach hither your finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither your hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.

verses.raw: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my Elohim (God).
verses.text: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my Elohim.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, Thomas, because you have seen me, you have believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto him, Thomas, because you have seen me, you have believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

verses.raw: And many other signs truly did Yahusha (Jesus) in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
verses.text: And many other signs truly did Yahusha in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:

verses.raw: But these are written, that you might believe that Yahusha (Jesus) is the Messiah (Christ), the Son of Elohim (God); and that believing you might have life through his name.
verses.text: But these are written, that you might believe that Yahusha is the Messiah, the Son of Elohim; and that believing you might have life through his name.

verses.raw: After these things Yahusha (Jesus) shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.
verses.text: After these things Yahusha shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.

verses.raw: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
verses.text: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.

verses.raw: Simon Peter says unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with you. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.
verses.text: Simon Peter says unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with you. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.

verses.raw: But when the morning was now come, Yahusha (Jesus) stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: But when the morning was now come, Yahusha stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Yahusha.

verses.raw: Then Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, Children, have you any meat? They answered him, No.
verses.text: Then Yahusha says unto them, Children, have you any meat? They answered him, No.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and you shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
verses.text: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and you shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.

verses.raw: Therefore that disciple whom Yahusha (Jesus) loved says unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher’s coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
verses.text: Therefore that disciple whom Yahusha loved says unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher’s coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.

verses.raw: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
verses.text: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.

verses.raw: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
verses.text: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, Bring of the fish which you have now caught.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto them, Bring of the fish which you have now caught.

verses.raw: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
verses.text: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who are you? knowing that it was the Lord.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who are you? knowing that it was the Lord.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) then comes, and takes bread, and gives them, and fish likewise.
verses.text: Yahusha then comes, and takes bread, and gives them, and fish likewise.

verses.raw: This is now the third time that Yahusha (Jesus) shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
verses.text: This is now the third time that Yahusha shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.

verses.raw: So when they had dined, Yahusha (Jesus) says to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, love you me more than these? He says unto him, Yea, Lord; you know that I love you. He says unto him, Feed my lambs.
verses.text: So when they had dined, Yahusha says to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, love you me more than these? He says unto him, Yea, Lord; you know that I love you. He says unto him, Feed my lambs.

verses.raw: He says to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, love you me? He says unto him, Yea, Lord; you know that I love you. He says unto him, Feed my sheep.
verses.text: He says to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, love you me? He says unto him, Yea, Lord; you know that I love you. He says unto him, Feed my sheep.

verses.raw: He says unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, love you me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Love you me? And he said unto him, Lord, you know all things; you know that I love you. Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, Feed my sheep.
verses.text: He says unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, love you me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Love you me? And he said unto him, Lord, you know all things; you know that I love you. Yahusha says unto him, Feed my sheep.

verses.raw: Verily, verily, I say unto you, When you were young, you girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither you would: but when you shall be old, you shall stretch forth your hands, and another shall gird you, and carry you whither you would not.
verses.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, When you were young, you girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither you would: but when you shall be old, you shall stretch forth your hands, and another shall gird you, and carry you whither you would not.

verses.raw: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify Elohim (God). And when he had spoken this, he says unto him, Follow me.
verses.text: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify Elohim. And when he had spoken this, he says unto him, Follow me.

verses.raw: Then Peter, turning about, sees the disciple whom Yahusha (Jesus) loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth you?
verses.text: Then Peter, turning about, sees the disciple whom Yahusha loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth you?

verses.raw: Peter seeing him says to Yahusha (Jesus), Lord, and what shall this man do?
verses.text: Peter seeing him says to Yahusha, Lord, and what shall this man do?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to you? follow you me.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to you? follow you me.

verses.raw: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Yahusha (Jesus) said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to you?
verses.text: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Yahusha said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to you?

verses.raw: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
verses.text: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.

verses.raw: And there are also many other things which Yahusha (Jesus) did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
verses.text: And there are also many other things which Yahusha did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.

verses.raw: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Yahusha (Jesus) began both to do and teach,
verses.text: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Yahusha began both to do and teach,

verses.raw: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:
verses.text: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Ruach HaKodesh had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:

verses.raw: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of Elohim (God):
verses.text: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of Elohim:

verses.raw: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, says he, you have heard of me.
verses.text: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, says he, you have heard of me.

verses.raw: For John truly baptized with water; but you shall be baptized with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) not many days hence.
verses.text: For John truly baptized with water; but you shall be baptized with the Ruach HaKodesh not many days hence.

verses.raw: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, will you at this time restore again the kingdom to Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, will you at this time restore again the kingdom to Yashar'el?

verses.raw: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father has put in his own power.
verses.text: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father has put in his own power.

verses.raw: But you shall receive power, after that the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) is come upon you: and you shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
verses.text: But you shall receive power, after that the Ruach HaKodesh is come upon you: and you shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

verses.raw: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
verses.text: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.

verses.raw: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;
verses.text: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;

verses.raw: Which also said, You men of Galilee, why stand you gazing up into heaven? this same Yahusha (Jesus), which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as you have seen him go into heaven.
verses.text: Which also said, You men of Galilee, why stand you gazing up into heaven? this same Yahusha, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as you have seen him go into heaven.

verses.raw: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day’s journey.
verses.text: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day’s journey.

verses.raw: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.
verses.text: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.

verses.raw: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Yahusha (Jesus), and with his brethren.
verses.text: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Yahusha, and with his brethren.

verses.raw: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)
verses.text: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)

verses.raw: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Ruach HaKodesh by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Yahusha.

verses.raw: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.
verses.text: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.

verses.raw: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
verses.text: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.

verses.raw: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.
verses.text: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.

verses.raw: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.
verses.text: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.

verses.raw: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that Lord Yahusha (Jesus) went in and out among us,
verses.text: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that Lord Yahusha went in and out among us,

verses.raw: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.
verses.text: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.

verses.raw: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
verses.text: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.

verses.raw: And they prayed, and said, You, Lord, which know the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two you have chosen,
verses.text: And they prayed, and said, You, Lord, which know the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two you have chosen,

verses.raw: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.
verses.text: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.

verses.text: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of Elohim, you have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:

verses.text: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Messiah, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.

verses.text: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Yahusha HaMashiach for the remission of sins, and you shall receive the gift of the Ruach HaKodesh.

verses.text: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;

verses.text: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.

verses.text: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.

verses.raw: The Elohim (God) of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the Elohim (God) of our fathers, has glorified his Son Yahusha (Jesus); whom you delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.

verses.text: And laid them down at the apostles’ feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.

verses.raw: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,
verses.text: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,

verses.raw: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.text: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

verses.text: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

verses.raw: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
verses.text: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

verses.raw: But Peter said, Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), and to keep back part of the price of the land?
verses.text: But Peter said, Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Ruach HaKodesh, and to keep back part of the price of the land?

verses.raw: Whiles it remained, was it not your own? and after it was sold, was it not in your own power? why have you conceived this thing in your heart? you have not lied unto men, but unto Elohim (God).
verses.text: Whiles it remained, was it not your own? and after it was sold, was it not in your own power? why have you conceived this thing in your heart? you have not lied unto men, but unto Elohim.

verses.raw: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.
verses.text: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.

verses.raw: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.
verses.text: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.

verses.raw: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.
verses.text: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.

verses.raw: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether you sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.
verses.text: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether you sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.

verses.raw: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of Yahuah (Lord)? behold, the feet of them which have buried your husband are at the door, and shall carry you out.
verses.text: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of Yahuah? behold, the feet of them which have buried your husband are at the door, and shall carry you out.

verses.raw: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.
verses.text: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.

verses.raw: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.
verses.text: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.

verses.text: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.

verses.raw: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.
verses.text: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.

verses.text: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)

verses.raw: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.

verses.text: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.

verses.raw: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,

verses.raw: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.
verses.text: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.
