verses.text: But the angel of Yahuah by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,

verses.raw: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.
verses.text: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.

verses.raw: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and sent to the prison to have them brought.
verses.text: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Yashar'el, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

verses.raw: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,
verses.text: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,

verses.raw: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
verses.text: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.

verses.raw: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.
verses.text: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.

verses.raw: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom you put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.
verses.text: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom you put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.

verses.raw: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.
verses.text: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.

verses.raw: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,
verses.text: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,

verses.raw: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that you should not teach in this name? and, behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man’s blood upon us.
verses.text: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that you should not teach in this name? and, behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man’s blood upon us.

verses.raw: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey Elohim (God) rather than men.
verses.text: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey Elohim rather than men.

verses.raw: The Elohim (God) of our fathers raised up Yahusha (Jesus), whom you slew and hanged on a tree.
verses.text: The Elohim of our fathers raised up Yahusha, whom you slew and hanged on a tree.

verses.raw: Him has Elohim (God) exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Yashar'el (Israel), and forgiveness of sins.
verses.text: Him has Elohim exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Yashar'el, and forgiveness of sins.

verses.raw: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), whom Elohim (God) has given to them that obey him.
verses.text: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Ruach HaKodesh, whom Elohim has given to them that obey him.

verses.raw: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.
verses.text: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.

verses.raw: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;
verses.text: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;

verses.raw: And said unto them, You men of Yashar'el (Israel), take heed to yourselves what you intend to do as touching these men.
verses.text: And said unto them, You men of Yashar'el, take heed to yourselves what you intend to do as touching these men.

verses.raw: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.
verses.text: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.

verses.raw: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.
verses.text: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.

verses.raw: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:
verses.text: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:

verses.raw: But if it be of Elohim (God), you can not overthrow it; lest haply you be found even to fight against Elohim (God).
verses.text: But if it be of Elohim, you can not overthrow it; lest haply you be found even to fight against Elohim.

verses.raw: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Yahusha (Jesus), and let them go.
verses.text: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Yahusha, and let them go.

verses.raw: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
verses.text: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.

verses.raw: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
verses.text: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.

verses.raw: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of Elohim (God), and serve tables.
verses.text: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of Elohim, and serve tables.

verses.raw: Wherefore, brethren, look you out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
verses.text: Wherefore, brethren, look you out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Ruach HaKodesh and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

verses.raw: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.
verses.text: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.

verses.raw: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:
verses.text: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Ruach HaKodesh, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:

verses.text: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

verses.raw: And the word of Elohim (God) increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
verses.text: And the word of Elohim increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

verses.raw: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.
verses.text: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.

verses.text: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.

verses.raw: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.
verses.text: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.

verses.text: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against Elohim.

verses.raw: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,
verses.text: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,

verses.raw: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceases not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:
verses.text: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceases not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:

verses.raw: For we have heard him say, that this Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.
verses.text: For we have heard him say, that this Yahusha of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.

verses.raw: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.
verses.text: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.

verses.raw: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
verses.text: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?

verses.text: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The Elohim of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,

verses.raw: And said unto him, Get you out of your country, and from your kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew you.
verses.text: And said unto him, Get you out of your country, and from your kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew you.

verses.raw: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldæans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein you now dwell.
verses.text: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldæans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein you now dwell.

verses.raw: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
verses.text: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.
verses.text: And Elohim spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.

verses.raw: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said Elohim (God): and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
verses.text: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said Elohim: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.

verses.raw: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
verses.text: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

verses.text: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.

verses.raw: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
verses.text: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.

verses.raw: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph’s kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
verses.text: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph’s kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.

verses.raw: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
verses.text: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,

verses.text: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.

verses.raw: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.
verses.text: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.

verses.text: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.

verses.text: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.

verses.text: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Yashar'el.

verses.text: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:

verses.text: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that Elohim by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.

verses.text: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, you are brethren; why do you wrong one to another?

verses.text: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?

verses.text: Will you kill me, as you diddest the Egyptian yesterday?

verses.raw: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of Yahuah (Lord) in a flame of fire in a bush.

verses.raw: Saying, I am the Elohim (God) of your fathers, the Elohim (God) of Abraham, and the Elohim (God) of Isaac, and the Elohim (God) of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
verses.text: Saying, I am the Elohim of your fathers, the Elohim of Abraham, and the Elohim of Isaac, and the Elohim of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.

verses.text: Then said Yahuah to him, Put off your shoes from your feet: for the place where you stand is holy ground.

verses.text: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send you into Egypt.

verses.raw: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made you a ruler and a judge? the same did Elohim (God) send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
verses.text: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made you a ruler and a judge? the same did Elohim send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.

verses.raw: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
verses.text: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.

verses.raw: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), A prophet shall Yahuah Elohaychem (the Lord your God) raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall you hear.
verses.text: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Yashar'el, A prophet shall Yahuah Elohaychem raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall you hear.

verses.text: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

verses.text: Then Elohim turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O you house of Yashar'el, have you offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?

verses.text: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.

verses.raw: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
verses.text: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:

verses.raw: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
verses.text: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,

verses.raw: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
verses.text: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:

verses.raw: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
verses.text: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

verses.raw: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.
verses.text: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.

verses.raw: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.
verses.text: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.

verses.raw: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What Elohim (God) has cleansed, that call not you common.
verses.text: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What Elohim has cleansed, that call not you common.

verses.raw: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.
verses.text: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.

verses.raw: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon’s house, and stood before the gate,
verses.text: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon’s house, and stood before the gate,

verses.raw: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.
verses.text: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.

verses.raw: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek you.
verses.text: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek you.

verses.raw: Arise therefore, and get you down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.
verses.text: Arise therefore, and get you down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.

verses.raw: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom you seek: what is the cause wherefore you are come?
verses.text: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom you seek: what is the cause wherefore you are come?

verses.raw: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that fears Elohim (God), and of good report among all the nation of the Yahudim (Jews), was warned from Elohim (God) by an holy angel to send for you into his house, and to hear words of you.
verses.text: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that fears Elohim, and of good report among all the nation of the Yahudim, was warned from Elohim by an holy angel to send for you into his house, and to hear words of you.

verses.raw: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
verses.text: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.

verses.raw: And the morrow after they entered into Cæsarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
verses.text: And the morrow after they entered into Cæsarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.

verses.raw: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.
verses.text: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.

verses.raw: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.
verses.text: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.

verses.raw: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.
verses.text: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, You know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Yahudi (Jew) to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but Elohim (God) has shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.
verses.text: And he said unto them, You know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Yahudi to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but Elohim has shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.

verses.raw: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent you have sent for me?
verses.text: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent you have sent for me?

verses.raw: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
verses.text: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,

verses.raw: And said, Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your alms are had in remembrance in the sight of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And said, Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your alms are had in remembrance in the sight of Elohim.

verses.raw: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he comes, shall speak unto you.
verses.text: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he comes, shall speak unto you.

verses.raw: Immediately therefore I sent to you; and you have well done that you are come. Now therefore are we all here present before Elohim (God), to hear all things that are commanded you of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Immediately therefore I sent to you; and you have well done that you are come. Now therefore are we all here present before Elohim, to hear all things that are commanded you of Elohim.

verses.raw: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that Elohim (God) is no respecter of persons:
verses.text: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that Elohim is no respecter of persons:

verses.raw: But in every nation he that fears him, and works righteousness, is accepted with him.
verses.text: But in every nation he that fears him, and works righteousness, is accepted with him.

verses.raw: The word which Elohim (God) sent unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), preaching peace by Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ): (he is the Lord of all:)
verses.text: The word which Elohim sent unto the children of Yashar'el, preaching peace by Yahusha HaMashiach: (he is the Lord of all:)

verses.raw: That word, I say, you know, which was published throughout all Judæa, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
verses.text: That word, I say, you know, which was published throughout all Judæa, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

verses.raw: How Elohim (God) anointed Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for Elohim (God) was with him.
verses.text: How Elohim anointed Yahusha of Nazareth with the Ruach HaKodesh and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for Elohim was with him.

verses.raw: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Yahudim (Jews), and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:
verses.text: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Yahudim, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:

verses.raw: Him Elohim (God) raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;
verses.text: Him Elohim raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;

verses.raw: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of Elohim (God), even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
verses.text: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of Elohim, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.

verses.raw: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of Elohim (God) to be the Judge of quick and dead.
verses.text: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of Elohim to be the Judge of quick and dead.

verses.raw: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believes in him shall receive remission of sins.
verses.text: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believes in him shall receive remission of sins.

verses.raw: While Peter yet spake these words, the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) fell on all them which heard the word.
verses.text: While Peter yet spake these words, the Ruach HaKodesh fell on all them which heard the word.

verses.raw: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
verses.text: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Ruach HaKodesh.

verses.raw: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify Elohim (God). Then answered Peter,
verses.text: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify Elohim. Then answered Peter,

verses.raw: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) as well as we?
verses.text: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Ruach HaKodesh as well as we?

verses.raw: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
verses.text: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.

verses.raw: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judæa heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judæa heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of Elohim.

verses.raw: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
verses.text: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,

verses.raw: Saying, You went in to men uncircumcised, and did eat with them.
verses.text: Saying, You went in to men uncircumcised, and did eat with them.

verses.raw: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,
verses.text: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,

verses.raw: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:
verses.text: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:

verses.raw: Upon the which when I had fastened my eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
verses.text: Upon the which when I had fastened my eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

verses.raw: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.
verses.text: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.

verses.raw: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean has at any time entered into my mouth.
verses.text: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean has at any time entered into my mouth.

verses.raw: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What Elohim (God) has cleansed, that call not you common.
verses.text: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What Elohim has cleansed, that call not you common.

verses.raw: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
verses.text: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.

verses.raw: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Cæsarea unto me.
verses.text: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Cæsarea unto me.

verses.raw: And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house:
verses.text: And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house:

verses.raw: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;
verses.text: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;

verses.raw: Who shall tell you words, whereby you and all your house shall be saved.
verses.text: Who shall tell you words, whereby you and all your house shall be saved.

verses.raw: And as I began to speak, the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) fell on them, as on us at the beginning.
verses.text: And as I began to speak, the Ruach HaKodesh fell on them, as on us at the beginning.

verses.raw: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but you shall be baptized with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
verses.text: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but you shall be baptized with the Ruach HaKodesh.

verses.raw: Forasmuch then as Elohim (God) gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ); what was I, that I could withstand Elohim (God)?
verses.text: Forasmuch then as Elohim gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on Lord Yahusha HaMashiach; what was I, that I could withstand Elohim?

verses.raw: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified Elohim (God), saying, Then has Elohim (God) also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.
verses.text: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified Elohim, saying, Then has Elohim also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.

verses.raw: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Yahudim (Jews) only.
verses.text: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Yahudim only.

verses.raw: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching Lord Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching Lord Yahusha.

verses.raw: And the hand of Yahuah (Lord) was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: And the hand of Yahuah was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.
verses.text: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.

verses.raw: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of Elohim (God), was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
verses.text: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of Elohim, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.

verses.raw: For he was a good man, and full of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.
verses.text: For he was a good man, and full of the Ruach HaKodesh and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.

verses.raw: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
verses.text: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:

verses.raw: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
verses.text: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.

verses.raw: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.
verses.text: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.

verses.raw: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Cæsar.
verses.text: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Cæsar.

verses.raw: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judæa:
verses.text: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judæa:

verses.raw: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
verses.text: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

verses.raw: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.
verses.text: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.

verses.raw: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.
verses.text: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.

verses.raw: And because he saw it pleased the Yahudim (Jews), he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)
verses.text: And because he saw it pleased the Yahudim, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)

verses.raw: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.
verses.text: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.

verses.raw: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto Elohim (God) for him.
verses.text: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto Elohim for him.

verses.raw: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.
verses.text: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.

verses.raw: And, behold, the angel of Yahuah (Lord) came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.
verses.text: And, behold, the angel of Yahuah came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.

verses.raw: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on your sandals. And so he did. And he says unto him, Cast your garment about you, and follow me.
verses.text: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on your sandals. And so he did. And he says unto him, Cast your garment about you, and follow me.

verses.raw: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.
verses.text: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.

verses.raw: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leads unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.
verses.text: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leads unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.

verses.raw: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that Yahuah (Lord) has sent his angel, and has delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Yahudim (Jews).
verses.text: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that Yahuah has sent his angel, and has delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Yahudim.

verses.raw: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.
verses.text: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.

verses.raw: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.
verses.text: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.

verses.text: And when she knew Peter’s voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.

verses.raw: And they said unto her, You are mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.
verses.text: And they said unto her, You are mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.

verses.raw: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.

verses.raw: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.
verses.text: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.

verses.raw: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.

verses.raw: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judæa to Cæsarea, and there abode.
verses.text: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judæa to Cæsarea, and there abode.

verses.raw: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king’s chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king’s country.
verses.text: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king’s chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king’s country.

verses.text: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.

verses.raw: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.
verses.text: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.

verses.raw: And immediately the angel of Yahuah (Lord) smote him, because he gave not Elohim (God) the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.
verses.text: And immediately the angel of Yahuah smote him, because he gave not Elohim the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.

verses.raw: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

verses.text: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Ruach HaKodesh said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.

verses.text: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
