verses.raw: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.
verses.text: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.

verses.raw: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), set his eyes on him,
verses.text: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Ruach HaKodesh, set his eyes on him,

verses.raw: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, you child of the devil, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
verses.text: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, you child of the devil, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

verses.raw: And now, behold, the hand of Yahuah (Lord) is upon you, and you shall be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.
verses.text: And now, behold, the hand of Yahuah is upon you, and you shall be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.

verses.raw: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.
verses.text: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.

verses.raw: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
verses.text: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
verses.text: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.

verses.raw: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, You men and brethren, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.
verses.text: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, You men and brethren, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.

verses.raw: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Yashar'el (Israel), and you that fear Elohim (God), give audience.
verses.text: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Yashar'el, and you that fear Elohim, give audience.

verses.raw: The Elohim (God) of this people of Yashar'el (Israel) chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.
verses.text: The Elohim of this people of Yashar'el chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.

verses.raw: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.
verses.text: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.

verses.raw: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
verses.text: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.

verses.raw: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
verses.text: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.

verses.raw: And afterward they desired a king: and Elohim (God) gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.
verses.text: And afterward they desired a king: and Elohim gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.

verses.raw: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
verses.text: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.

verses.raw: Of this man’s seed has Elohim (God) according to his promise raised unto Yashar'el (Israel) a Saviour, Yahusha (Jesus):
verses.text: Of this man’s seed has Elohim according to his promise raised unto Yashar'el a Saviour, Yahusha:

verses.raw: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think you that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there comes one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.
verses.text: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think you that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there comes one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.

verses.raw: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you fears Elohim (God), to you is the word of this salvation sent.
verses.text: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you fears Elohim, to you is the word of this salvation sent.

verses.raw: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.
verses.text: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.

verses.raw: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.
verses.text: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.

verses.raw: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.
verses.text: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) raised him from the dead:
verses.text: But Elohim raised him from the dead:

verses.raw: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.
verses.text: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.

verses.raw: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,
verses.text: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,

verses.raw: Elohim (God) has fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he has raised up Yahusha (Jesus) again; as it is also written in the second psalm, You are my Son, this day have I begotten you.
verses.text: Elohim has fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he has raised up Yahusha again; as it is also written in the second psalm, You are my Son, this day have I begotten you.

verses.raw: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.
verses.text: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.

verses.raw: Wherefore he says also in another psalm, You shall not suffer your Holy One to see corruption.
verses.text: Wherefore he says also in another psalm, You shall not suffer your Holy One to see corruption.

verses.raw: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of Elohim (God), fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:
verses.text: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of Elohim, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:

verses.raw: But he, whom Elohim (God) raised again, saw no corruption.
verses.text: But he, whom Elohim raised again, saw no corruption.

verses.raw: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:
verses.text: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:

verses.raw: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.
verses.text: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.

verses.raw: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;
verses.text: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;

verses.raw: Behold, you despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which you shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.
verses.text: Behold, you despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which you shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.

verses.raw: And when the Yahudim (Jews) were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.
verses.text: And when the Yahudim were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.

verses.raw: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Yahudim (Jews) and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Yahudim and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of Elohim.

verses.raw: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of Elohim.

verses.raw: But when the Yahudim (Jews) saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
verses.text: But when the Yahudim saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.

verses.raw: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of Elohim (God) should first have been spoken to you: but seeing you put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
verses.text: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of Elohim should first have been spoken to you: but seeing you put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.

verses.raw: For so has Yahuah (Lord) commanded us, saying, I have set you to be a light of the Gentiles, that you should be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
verses.text: For so has Yahuah commanded us, saying, I have set you to be a light of the Gentiles, that you should be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.

verses.raw: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.
verses.text: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.

verses.raw: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.
verses.text: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.

verses.raw: But the Yahudim (Jews) stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.
verses.text: But the Yahudim stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.

verses.raw: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.
verses.text: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.

verses.raw: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
verses.text: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Ruach HaKodesh.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Yahudim (Jews), and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Yahudim (Jews) and also of the Greeks believed.
verses.text: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Yahudim, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Yahudim and also of the Greeks believed.

verses.raw: But the unbelieving Yahudim (Jews) stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
verses.text: But the unbelieving Yahudim stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.

verses.raw: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
verses.text: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

verses.raw: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Yahudim (Jews), and part with the apostles.
verses.text: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Yahudim, and part with the apostles.

verses.raw: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Yahudim (Jews) with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,
verses.text: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Yahudim with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,

verses.raw: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lies round about:
verses.text: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lies round about:

verses.raw: And there they preached the gospel.
verses.text: And there they preached the gospel.

verses.raw: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked:
verses.text: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked:

verses.raw: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,
verses.text: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,

verses.raw: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on your feet. And he leaped and walked.
verses.text: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on your feet. And he leaped and walked.

verses.raw: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.
verses.text: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.

verses.raw: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
verses.text: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.

verses.raw: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.
verses.text: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.

verses.raw: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,
verses.text: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,

verses.raw: And saying, Sirs, why do you these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that you should turn from these vanities unto the living Elohim (God), which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:
verses.text: And saying, Sirs, why do you these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that you should turn from these vanities unto the living Elohim, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:

verses.raw: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.
verses.text: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.

verses.raw: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
verses.text: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.

verses.raw: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.
verses.text: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.

verses.raw: And there came thither certain Yahudim (Jews) from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.
verses.text: And there came thither certain Yahudim from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.

verses.raw: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
verses.text: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.

verses.raw: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
verses.text: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,

verses.raw: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of Elohim.

verses.raw: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.
verses.text: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.

verses.raw: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
verses.text: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.

verses.raw: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:
verses.text: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:

verses.raw: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of Elohim (God) for the work which they fulfilled.
verses.text: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of Elohim for the work which they fulfilled.

verses.raw: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that Elohim (God) had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.
verses.text: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that Elohim had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.

verses.raw: And there they abode long time with the disciples.
verses.text: And there they abode long time with the disciples.

verses.raw: And certain men which came down from Judæa taught the brethren, and said, Except you be circumcised after the manner of Moses, you cannot be saved.
verses.text: And certain men which came down from Judæa taught the brethren, and said, Except you be circumcised after the manner of Moses, you cannot be saved.

verses.raw: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
verses.text: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.

verses.raw: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.
verses.text: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.

verses.raw: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that Elohim (God) had done with them.
verses.text: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that Elohim had done with them.

verses.raw: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.
verses.text: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.

verses.raw: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.
verses.text: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.

verses.raw: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, you know how that a good while ago Elohim (God) made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
verses.text: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, you know how that a good while ago Elohim made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God), which knows the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), even as he did unto us;
verses.text: And Elohim, which knows the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Ruach HaKodesh, even as he did unto us;

verses.raw: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
verses.text: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.

verses.raw: Now therefore why tempt you Elohim (God), to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
verses.text: Now therefore why tempt you Elohim, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

verses.raw: But we believe that through the grace of Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) we shall be saved, even as they.
verses.text: But we believe that through the grace of Lord Yahusha HaMashiach we shall be saved, even as they.

verses.raw: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders Elohim (God) had wrought among the Gentiles by them.
verses.text: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders Elohim had wrought among the Gentiles by them.

verses.raw: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:
verses.text: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:

verses.raw: Simeon has declared how Elohim (God) at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
verses.text: Simeon has declared how Elohim at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.

verses.raw: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
verses.text: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,

verses.raw: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:
verses.text: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:

verses.raw: That the residue of men might seek after Yahuah (Lord), and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, says Yahuah (Lord), who does all these things.
verses.text: That the residue of men might seek after Yahuah, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, says Yahuah, who does all these things.

verses.raw: Known unto Elohim (God) are all his works from the beginning of the world.
verses.text: Known unto Elohim are all his works from the beginning of the world.

verses.raw: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to Elohim (God):
verses.text: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to Elohim:

verses.raw: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.
verses.text: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.

verses.raw: For Moses of old time has in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.
verses.text: For Moses of old time has in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.

verses.raw: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:
verses.text: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:

verses.raw: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:
verses.text: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:

verses.raw: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, You must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:
verses.text: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, You must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:

verses.raw: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
verses.text: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

verses.raw: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.
verses.text: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.

verses.raw: For it seemed good to the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;
verses.text: For it seemed good to the Ruach HaKodesh, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;

verses.raw: That you abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if you keep yourselves, you shall do well. Fare you well.
verses.text: That you abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if you keep yourselves, you shall do well. Fare you well.

verses.raw: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:
verses.text: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:

verses.raw: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.
verses.text: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.

verses.raw: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.
verses.text: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.

verses.raw: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.
verses.text: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.
verses.text: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.

verses.raw: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
verses.text: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

verses.raw: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.
verses.text: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.

verses.raw: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.
verses.text: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.

verses.raw: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.
verses.text: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.

verses.raw: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;
verses.text: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;

verses.raw: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of Elohim.

verses.raw: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.
verses.text: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.

verses.raw: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:
verses.text: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:

verses.raw: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.
verses.text: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.

verses.raw: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Yahudim (Jews) which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.
verses.text: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Yahudim which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.

verses.raw: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.
verses.text: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.
verses.text: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.

verses.raw: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) to preach the word in Asia,
verses.text: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Ruach HaKodesh to preach the word in Asia,

verses.raw: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.
verses.text: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.

verses.raw: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.
verses.text: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.

verses.raw: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
verses.text: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.

verses.raw: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.
verses.text: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.

verses.raw: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;
verses.text: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;

verses.raw: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.
verses.text: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.

verses.raw: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.
verses.text: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.

verses.raw: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped Elohim (God), heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.
verses.text: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped Elohim, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.

verses.raw: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.
verses.text: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:
verses.text: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:

verses.raw: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the El Elyon (most high God), which shew unto us the way of salvation.
verses.text: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the El Elyon (most high God), which shew unto us the way of salvation.

verses.raw: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command you in the name of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.
verses.text: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command you in the name of Yahusha HaMashiach to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.

verses.raw: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,
verses.text: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,

verses.raw: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Yahudim (Jews), do exceedingly trouble our city,
verses.text: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Yahudim, do exceedingly trouble our city,

verses.raw: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.
verses.text: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.

verses.raw: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.
verses.text: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.

verses.raw: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:
verses.text: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:

verses.raw: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.
verses.text: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.

verses.raw: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto Elohim (God): and the prisoners heard them.
verses.text: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto Elohim: and the prisoners heard them.

verses.raw: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one’s bands were loosed.
verses.text: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one’s bands were loosed.

verses.raw: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.
verses.text: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.

verses.raw: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.
verses.text: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.

verses.raw: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,
verses.text: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,

verses.raw: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?
verses.text: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?

verses.raw: And they said, Believe on Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), and you shall be saved, and your house.
verses.text: And they said, Believe on Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, and you shall be saved, and your house.

verses.raw: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.
verses.text: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.

verses.raw: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.
verses.text: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.

verses.raw: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in Elohim (God) with all his house.
verses.text: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in Elohim with all his house.

verses.raw: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.
verses.text: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.

verses.raw: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.
verses.text: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.

verses.raw: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.
verses.text: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.

verses.raw: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.
verses.text: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.

verses.raw: And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.
verses.text: And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.

verses.raw: And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.
verses.text: And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.

verses.raw: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Yahudim (Jews):
verses.text: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Yahudim:

verses.raw: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,
verses.text: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,

verses.raw: Opening and alleging, that Messiah (Christ) must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Yahusha (Jesus), whom I preach unto you, is Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: Opening and alleging, that Messiah must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Yahusha, whom I preach unto you, is Messiah.

verses.raw: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.
verses.text: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.

verses.raw: But the Yahudim (Jews) which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.
verses.text: But the Yahudim which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.

verses.raw: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;
verses.text: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;

verses.raw: Whom Jason has received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Cæsar, saying that there is another king, one Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: Whom Jason has received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Cæsar, saying that there is another king, one Yahusha.

verses.raw: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.
verses.text: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.

verses.raw: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.
verses.text: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.

verses.raw: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Yahudim (Jews).
verses.text: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Yahudim.

verses.raw: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.
verses.text: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.

verses.raw: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.
verses.text: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.

verses.raw: But when the Yahudim (Jews) of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of Elohim (God) was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.
verses.text: But when the Yahudim of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of Elohim was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.

verses.raw: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.
verses.text: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.

verses.raw: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.
verses.text: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.

verses.raw: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.
verses.text: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.

verses.raw: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Yahudim (Jews), and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.
verses.text: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Yahudim, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.

verses.raw: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seems to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Yahusha (Jesus), and the resurrection.
verses.text: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seems to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Yahusha, and the resurrection.

verses.raw: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof you speak, is?
verses.text: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof you speak, is?

verses.raw: For you bring certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.
verses.text: For you bring certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.

verses.raw: (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)
verses.text: (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)

verses.raw: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars’ hill, and said, You men of Athens, I perceive that in all things you are too superstitious.
verses.text: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars’ hill, and said, You men of Athens, I perceive that in all things you are too superstitious.

verses.raw: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore you ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.
verses.text: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore you ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is the Lord of heaven and earth, dwells not in temples made with hands;
verses.text: Elohim that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is the Lord of heaven and earth, dwells not in temples made with hands;

verses.raw: Neither is worshipped with men’s hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he gives to all life, and breath, and all things;
verses.text: Neither is worshipped with men’s hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he gives to all life, and breath, and all things;

verses.raw: And has made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and has determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;
verses.text: And has made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and has determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;

verses.raw: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:
verses.text: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:

verses.raw: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
verses.text: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.

verses.raw: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of Elohim (God), we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by are and man’s device.
verses.text: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of Elohim, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by are and man’s device.

verses.raw: And the times of this ignorance Elohim (God) winked at; but now commands all men every where to repent:
verses.text: And the times of this ignorance Elohim winked at; but now commands all men every where to repent:

verses.raw: Because he has appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he has ordained; whereof he has given assurance unto all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.
verses.text: Because he has appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he has ordained; whereof he has given assurance unto all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.

verses.raw: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear you again of this matter.
verses.text: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear you again of this matter.

verses.raw: So Paul departed from among them.
verses.text: So Paul departed from among them.

verses.raw: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
verses.text: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

verses.raw: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;
verses.text: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;

verses.raw: And found a certain Yahudi (Jew) named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Yahudim (Jews) to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.
verses.text: And found a certain Yahudi named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Yahudim to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.

verses.raw: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.
verses.text: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.

verses.raw: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Yahudim (Jews) and the Greeks.
verses.text: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Yahudim and the Greeks.

verses.raw: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Yahudim (Jews) that Yahusha (Jesus) was Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Yahudim that Yahusha was Messiah.

verses.raw: And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed, he shook his raiment, and said unto them, Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean: from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.
verses.text: And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed, he shook his raiment, and said unto them, Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean: from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.

verses.raw: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man’s house, named Justus, one that worshipped Elohim (God), whose house joined hard to the synagogue.
verses.text: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man’s house, named Justus, one that worshipped Elohim, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.

verses.raw: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.
verses.text: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.

verses.raw: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not your peace:
verses.text: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not your peace:

verses.raw: For I am with you, and no man shall set on you to hurt you: for I have much people in this city.
verses.text: For I am with you, and no man shall set on you to hurt you: for I have much people in this city.

verses.raw: And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of Elohim (God) among them.
verses.text: And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of Elohim among them.

verses.raw: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Yahudim (Jews) made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,
verses.text: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Yahudim made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,

verses.raw: Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship Elohim (God) contrary to the law.
verses.text: Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship Elohim contrary to the law.

verses.raw: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Yahudim (Jews), If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O you Yahudim (Jews), reason would that I should bear with you:
verses.text: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Yahudim, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O you Yahudim, reason would that I should bear with you:

verses.raw: But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look you to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.
verses.text: But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look you to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.

verses.raw: And he drave them from the judgment seat.
verses.text: And he drave them from the judgment seat.

verses.raw: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.
verses.text: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.

verses.raw: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.
verses.text: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.

verses.raw: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Yahudim (Jews).
verses.text: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Yahudim.

verses.raw: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;
verses.text: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;

verses.raw: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that comes in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if Elohim (God) will. And he sailed from Ephesus.
verses.text: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that comes in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if Elohim will. And he sailed from Ephesus.

verses.raw: And when he had landed at Cæsarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.
verses.text: And when he had landed at Cæsarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.

verses.raw: And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.
verses.text: And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.

verses.text: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, you ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.

verses.text: And when they heard it, they glorified the Lord, and said unto him, You see, brother, how many thousands of Yahudim there are which believe; and they are all zealous of the law:

verses.raw: And they are informed of you, that you teach all the Yahudim (Jews) which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.
verses.text: And they are informed of you, that you teach all the Yahudim which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.

verses.raw: What is it therefore? the multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that you are come.
verses.text: What is it therefore? the multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that you are come.

verses.raw: Do therefore this that we say to you: We have four men which have a vow on them;
verses.text: Do therefore this that we say to you: We have four men which have a vow on them;

verses.raw: Them take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges with them, that they may shave their heads: and all may know that those things, whereof they were informed concerning you, are nothing; but that you thyself also walk orderly, and keepest the law.

verses.raw: As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.

verses.raw: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification, until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.

verses.raw: And when the seven days were almost ended, the Yahudim (Jews) which were of Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the people, and laid hands on him,

verses.raw: Crying out, Men of Yashar'el (Israel), help: This is the man, that teaches all men every where against the people, and the law, and this place: and further brought Greeks also into the temple, and has polluted this holy place.
verses.text: Crying out, Men of Yashar'el, help: This is the man, that teaches all men every where against the people, and the law, and this place: and further brought Greeks also into the temple, and has polluted this holy place.

verses.raw: (For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)

verses.raw: And all the city was moved, and the people ran together: and they took Paul, and drew him out of the temple: and forthwith the doors were shut.
verses.text: And all the city was moved, and the people ran together: and they took Paul, and drew him out of the temple: and forthwith the doors were shut.

verses.raw: And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
verses.text: And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

verses.raw: Then the chief captain came near, and took him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and demanded who he was, and what he had done.
verses.text: Then the chief captain came near, and took him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and demanded who he was, and what he had done.

verses.raw: And some cried one thing, some another, among the multitude: and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult, he commanded him to be carried into the castle.
verses.text: And some cried one thing, some another, among the multitude: and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult, he commanded him to be carried into the castle.

verses.raw: And when he came upon the stairs, so it was, that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people.
verses.text: And when he came upon the stairs, so it was, that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people.

verses.raw: For the multitude of the people followed after, crying, Away with him.
verses.text: For the multitude of the people followed after, crying, Away with him.

verses.raw: And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto you? Who said, Can you speak Greek?
verses.text: And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto you? Who said, Can you speak Greek?

verses.raw: Are not you that Egyptian, which before these days made an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?
verses.text: Are not you that Egyptian, which before these days made an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?

verses.raw: But Paul said, I am a man which am a Yahudi (Jew) of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech you, suffer me to speak unto the people.
verses.text: But Paul said, I am a man which am a Yahudi of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech you, suffer me to speak unto the people.

verses.raw: And when he had given him licence, Paul stood on the stairs, and beckoned with the hand unto the people. And when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue, saying,

verses.raw: Men, brethren, and fathers, hear you my defence which I make now unto you.
verses.text: Men, brethren, and fathers, hear you my defence which I make now unto you.

verses.raw: (And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them, they kept the more silence: and he says,)
verses.text: (And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them, they kept the more silence: and he says,)

verses.raw: I am verily a man which am a Yahudi (Jew), born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward Elohim (God), as you all are this day.

verses.raw: And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.
verses.text: And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.

verses.raw: As also the high priest does bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem, for to be punished.
verses.text: As also the high priest does bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem, for to be punished.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.
verses.text: And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.

verses.raw: And I fell unto the ground, and heard a voice saying unto me, Saul, Saul, why persecute you me?
verses.text: And I fell unto the ground, and heard a voice saying unto me, Saul, Saul, why persecute you me?

verses.raw: And I answered, Who are you, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth, whom you persecute.
verses.text: And I answered, Who are you, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Yahusha of Nazareth, whom you persecute.

verses.raw: And they that were with me saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.
verses.text: And they that were with me saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.

verses.raw: And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told you of all things which are appointed for you to do.
verses.text: And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told you of all things which are appointed for you to do.

verses.raw: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.
verses.text: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.

verses.raw: And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Yahudim (Jews) which dwelt there,
verses.text: And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Yahudim which dwelt there,

verses.raw: Came unto me, and stood, and said unto me, Brother Saul, receive your sight. And the same hour I looked up upon him.
verses.text: Came unto me, and stood, and said unto me, Brother Saul, receive your sight. And the same hour I looked up upon him.

verses.raw: And he said, The Elohim (God) of our fathers has chosen you, that you should know his will, and see that Just One, and should hear the voice of his mouth.
verses.text: And he said, The Elohim of our fathers has chosen you, that you should know his will, and see that Just One, and should hear the voice of his mouth.

verses.raw: For you shall be his witness unto all men of what you have seen and heard.
verses.text: For you shall be his witness unto all men of what you have seen and heard.

verses.raw: And now why tarriest you? arise, and be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.
verses.text: And now why tarriest you? arise, and be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that, when I was come again to Jerusalem, even while I prayed in the temple, I was in a trance;
verses.text: And it came to pass, that, when I was come again to Jerusalem, even while I prayed in the temple, I was in a trance;

verses.raw: And saw him saying unto me, Make haste, and get you quickly out of Jerusalem: for they will not receive your testimony concerning me.
verses.text: And saw him saying unto me, Make haste, and get you quickly out of Jerusalem: for they will not receive your testimony concerning me.

verses.raw: And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on you:
verses.text: And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on you:

verses.raw: And when the blood of your martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.
verses.text: And when the blood of your martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.

verses.raw: And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send you far hence unto the Gentiles.
verses.text: And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send you far hence unto the Gentiles.

verses.raw: And they gave him audience unto this word, and then lifted up their voices, and said, Away with such a fellow from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.
verses.text: And they gave him audience unto this word, and then lifted up their voices, and said, Away with such a fellow from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.
