verses.text: For I have received of Yahusha (the Lord) that which also I delivered unto you, That Yahusha (the Lord Jesus) the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:

verses.raw: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.
verses.text: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.

verses.raw: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new covenant in my blood: this do you, as oft as you drink it, in remembrance of me.
verses.text: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new covenant in my blood: this do you, as oft as you drink it, in remembrance of me.

verses.raw: For as often as you eat this bread, and drink this cup, you do shew the death of Yahusha (the Lord) till he come.
verses.text: For as often as you eat this bread, and drink this cup, you do shew the death of Yahusha (the Lord) till he come.

verses.raw: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of Yahusha (the Lord), unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of Yahusha (the Lord).
verses.text: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of Yahusha (the Lord), unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of Yahusha (the Lord).

verses.raw: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.
verses.text: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.

verses.raw: For he that eats and drinks unworthily, eats and drinks judgment to himself, not discerning the body of Yahusha (the Lord).
verses.text: For he that eats and drinks unworthily, eats and drinks judgment to himself, not discerning the body of Yahusha (the Lord).

verses.raw: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.
verses.text: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.

verses.raw: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.
verses.text: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.

verses.raw: But when we are judged, we are chastened of Yahuah (the Lord), that we should not be condemned with the world.
verses.text: But when we are judged, we are chastened of Yahuah (the Lord), that we should not be condemned with the world.

verses.raw: Wherefore, my brethren, when you come together to eat, tarry one for another.
verses.text: Wherefore, my brethren, when you come together to eat, tarry one for another.

verses.raw: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that you come not together unto judgment. And the rest will I set in order when I come.
verses.text: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that you come not together unto judgment. And the rest will I set in order when I come.

verses.raw: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.
verses.text: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.

verses.raw: You know that you were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as you were led.
verses.text: You know that you were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as you were led.

verses.raw: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of Elohim (God) calls Yahusha (Jesus) accursed: and that no man can say that Yahusha (Jesus) is Yahuah (Lord), but by the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
verses.text: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of Elohim calls Yahusha accursed: and that no man can say that Yahusha is Yahuah, but by the Ruach HaKodesh.

verses.raw: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.
verses.text: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.

verses.raw: And there are differences of administrations, but the same the Lord.
verses.text: And there are differences of administrations, but the same the Lord.

verses.raw: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same Elohim (God) which works all in all.
verses.text: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same Elohim which works all in all.

verses.raw: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.
verses.text: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.

verses.raw: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;
verses.text: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;

verses.raw: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;
verses.text: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;

verses.raw: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:
verses.text: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:

verses.raw: But all these works that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.
verses.text: But all these works that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.

verses.raw: For as the body is one, and has many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: For as the body is one, and has many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Messiah.

verses.raw: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Yahudim (Jews) or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.
verses.text: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Yahudim or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.

verses.raw: For the body is not one member, but many.
verses.text: For the body is not one member, but many.

verses.raw: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
verses.text: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

verses.raw: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
verses.text: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

verses.raw: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?
verses.text: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?

verses.raw: But now has Elohim (God) set the members every one of them in the body, as it has pleased him.
verses.text: But now has Elohim set the members every one of them in the body, as it has pleased him.

verses.raw: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
verses.text: And if they were all one member, where were the body?

verses.raw: But now are they many members, yet but one body.
verses.text: But now are they many members, yet but one body.

verses.raw: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of you: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
verses.text: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of you: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.

verses.raw: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:
verses.text: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:

verses.raw: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.
verses.text: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.

verses.raw: For our comely parts have no need: but Elohim (God) has tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:
verses.text: For our comely parts have no need: but Elohim has tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:

verses.raw: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.
verses.text: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.

verses.raw: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.
verses.text: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.

verses.raw: Now you are the body of Messiah (Christ), and members in particular.
verses.text: Now you are the body of Messiah, and members in particular.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) has set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.
verses.text: And Elohim has set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.

verses.raw: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?
verses.text: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?

verses.raw: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
verses.text: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?

verses.raw: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
verses.text: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.

verses.raw: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
verses.text: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.

verses.raw: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
verses.text: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.

verses.raw: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
verses.text: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.

verses.raw: Charity suffers long, and is kind; charity envies not; charity vaunts not itself, is not puffed up,
verses.text: Charity suffers long, and is kind; charity envies not; charity vaunts not itself, is not puffed up,

verses.raw: Does not behave itself unseemly, seeks not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
verses.text: Does not behave itself unseemly, seeks not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;

verses.raw: Rejoices not in iniquity, but rejoices in the truth;
verses.text: Rejoices not in iniquity, but rejoices in the truth;

verses.raw: Bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
verses.text: Bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

verses.raw: Charity never fails: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
verses.text: Charity never fails: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.

verses.raw: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
verses.text: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.

verses.raw: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.
verses.text: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.

verses.raw: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
verses.text: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.

verses.raw: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
verses.text: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.

verses.raw: And now abides faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
verses.text: And now abides faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.

verses.raw: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that you may prophesy.
verses.text: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that you may prophesy.

verses.raw: For he that speaks in an unknown tongue speaks not unto men, but unto Elohim (God): for no man understands him; howbeit in the spirit he speaks mysteries.
verses.text: For he that speaks in an unknown tongue speaks not unto men, but unto Elohim: for no man understands him; howbeit in the spirit he speaks mysteries.

verses.raw: But he that prophesieth speaks unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.
verses.text: But he that prophesieth speaks unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.

verses.raw: He that speaks in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.
verses.text: He that speaks in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.

verses.raw: I would that you all spake with tongues, but rather that you prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaks with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
verses.text: I would that you all spake with tongues, but rather that you prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaks with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.

verses.raw: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
verses.text: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?

verses.raw: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
verses.text: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?

verses.raw: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
verses.text: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?

verses.raw: So likewise you, except you utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for you shall speak into the air.
verses.text: So likewise you, except you utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for you shall speak into the air.

verses.raw: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.
verses.text: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.

verses.raw: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaks a barbarian, and he that speaks shall be a barbarian unto me.
verses.text: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaks a barbarian, and he that speaks shall be a barbarian unto me.

verses.raw: Even so you, forasmuch as you are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that you may excel to the edifying of the church.
verses.text: Even so you, forasmuch as you are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that you may excel to the edifying of the church.

verses.raw: Wherefore let him that speaks in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.
verses.text: Wherefore let him that speaks in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.

verses.raw: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
verses.text: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.

verses.raw: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
verses.text: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

verses.raw: Else when you shall bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at your giving of thanks, seeing he understands not what you say?
verses.text: Else when you shall bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at your giving of thanks, seeing he understands not what you say?

verses.raw: For you verily give thanks well, but the other is not edified.
verses.text: For you verily give thanks well, but the other is not edified.

verses.raw: I thank my Elohim (God), I speak with tongues more than you all:
verses.text: I thank my Elohim, I speak with tongues more than you all:

verses.raw: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
verses.text: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.

verses.raw: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be you children, but in understanding be men.
verses.text: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be you children, but in understanding be men.

verses.raw: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, says Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serves not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.
verses.text: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serves not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.

verses.raw: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that you are mad?
verses.text: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that you are mad?

verses.raw: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believes not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
verses.text: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believes not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:

verses.raw: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship Elohim (God), and report that Elohim (God) is in you of a truth.
verses.text: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship Elohim, and report that Elohim is in you of a truth.

verses.raw: How is it then, brethren? when you come together, every one of you has a psalm, has a doctrine, has a tongue, has a revelation, has an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.
verses.text: How is it then, brethren? when you come together, every one of you has a psalm, has a doctrine, has a tongue, has a revelation, has an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.

verses.raw: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.
verses.text: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.

verses.raw: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to Elohim (God).
verses.text: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to Elohim.

verses.raw: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.
verses.text: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.

verses.raw: If any thing be revealed to another that sits by, let the first hold his peace.
verses.text: If any thing be revealed to another that sits by, let the first hold his peace.

verses.raw: For you may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.
verses.text: For you may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.

verses.raw: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.
verses.text: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
verses.text: For Elohim is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.

verses.raw: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also says the law.
verses.text: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also says the law.

verses.raw: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.
verses.text: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.

verses.raw: What? came the word of Elohim (God) out from you? or came it unto you only?
verses.text: What? came the word of Elohim out from you? or came it unto you only?

verses.raw: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.
verses.text: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.

verses.raw: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
verses.text: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.

verses.raw: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
verses.text: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.

verses.raw: Let all things be done decently and in order.
verses.text: Let all things be done decently and in order.

verses.raw: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also you have received, and wherein you stand;
verses.text: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also you have received, and wherein you stand;

verses.raw: By which also you are saved, if you keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless you have believed in vain.
verses.text: By which also you are saved, if you keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless you have believed in vain.

verses.raw: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Messiah (Christ) died for our sins according to the scriptures;
verses.text: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Messiah died for our sins according to the scriptures;

verses.raw: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
verses.text: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:

verses.raw: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:
verses.text: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:

verses.raw: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.
verses.text: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.

verses.raw: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
verses.text: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.

verses.raw: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.
verses.text: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.

verses.raw: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of Elohim (God).
verses.text: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of Elohim.

verses.raw: But by the grace of Elohim (God) I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of Elohim (God) which was with me.
verses.text: But by the grace of Elohim I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of Elohim which was with me.

verses.raw: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.
verses.text: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

verses.raw: Now if Messiah (Christ) be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
verses.text: Now if Messiah be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?

verses.raw: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Messiah (Christ) not risen:
verses.text: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Messiah not risen:

verses.raw: And if Messiah (Christ) be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
verses.text: And if Messiah be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.

verses.raw: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of Elohim (God); because we have testified of Elohim (God) that he raised up Messiah (Christ): whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
verses.text: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of Elohim; because we have testified of Elohim that he raised up Messiah: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.

verses.raw: For if the dead rise not, then is not Messiah (Christ) raised:
verses.text: For if the dead rise not, then is not Messiah raised:

verses.raw: And if Messiah (Christ) be not raised, your faith is vain; you are yet in your sins.
verses.text: And if Messiah be not raised, your faith is vain; you are yet in your sins.

verses.raw: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Messiah (Christ) are perished.
verses.text: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Messiah are perished.

verses.raw: If in this life only we have hope in Messiah (Christ), we are of all men most miserable.
verses.text: If in this life only we have hope in Messiah, we are of all men most miserable.

verses.raw: But now is Messiah (Christ) risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
verses.text: But now is Messiah risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.

verses.raw: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
verses.text: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.

verses.raw: For as in Adam all die, even so in Messiah (Christ) shall all be made alive.
verses.text: For as in Adam all die, even so in Messiah shall all be made alive.

verses.raw: But every man in his own order: Messiah (Christ) the firstfruits; afterward they that are Messiah's (Christ’s) at his coming.
verses.text: But every man in his own order: Messiah the firstfruits; afterward they that are Messiah's (Christ’s) at his coming.

verses.raw: Then comes the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to Elohim (God), even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
verses.text: Then comes the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to Elohim, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.

verses.raw: For he must reign, till he has put all enemies under his feet.
verses.text: For he must reign, till he has put all enemies under his feet.

verses.raw: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
verses.text: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.

verses.raw: For he has put all things under his feet. But when he says all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
verses.text: For he has put all things under his feet. But when he says all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.

verses.raw: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that Elohim (God) may be all in all.
verses.text: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that Elohim may be all in all.

verses.raw: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
verses.text: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?

verses.raw: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
verses.text: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?

verses.raw: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) our Lord, I die daily.
verses.text: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in HaMashiach Yahusha our Lord, I die daily.

verses.raw: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.
verses.text: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.

verses.raw: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
verses.text: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.

verses.raw: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of Elohim (God): I speak this to your shame.
verses.text: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of Elohim: I speak this to your shame.

verses.raw: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
verses.text: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?

verses.raw: You fool, that which you sowest is not quickened, except it die:
verses.text: You fool, that which you sowest is not quickened, except it die:

verses.raw: And that which you sowest, you sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:
verses.text: And that which you sowest, you sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) gives it a body as it has pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
verses.text: But Elohim gives it a body as it has pleased him, and to every seed his own body.

verses.raw: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.
verses.text: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.

verses.raw: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
verses.text: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.

verses.raw: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.
verses.text: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.

verses.raw: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
verses.text: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:

verses.raw: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
verses.text: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:

verses.raw: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
verses.text: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.

verses.raw: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
verses.text: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.

verses.raw: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
verses.text: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.

verses.raw: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.
verses.text: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.

verses.raw: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
verses.text: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

verses.raw: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
verses.text: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.

verses.raw: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of Elohim (God); neither does corruption inherit incorruption.
verses.text: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of Elohim; neither does corruption inherit incorruption.

verses.raw: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
verses.text: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,

verses.raw: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
verses.text: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.

verses.raw: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
verses.text: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.

verses.raw: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
verses.text: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.

verses.raw: O death, where is your sting? O grave, where is your victory?
verses.text: O death, where is your sting? O grave, where is your victory?

verses.raw: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
verses.text: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.

verses.raw: But thanks be to Elohim (God), which gives us the victory through our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: But thanks be to Elohim, which gives us the victory through our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be you stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as you know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
verses.text: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be you stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as you know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

verses.raw: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do you.
verses.text: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do you.

verses.raw: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as Elohim (God) has prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.
verses.text: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as Elohim has prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.

verses.raw: And when I come, whomsoever you shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.
verses.text: And when I come, whomsoever you shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
verses.text: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.

verses.raw: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
verses.text: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.

verses.raw: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that you may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.
verses.text: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that you may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.

verses.raw: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
verses.text: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.

verses.raw: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
verses.text: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.

verses.raw: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
verses.text: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.

verses.raw: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he works the work of the Lord, as I also do.
verses.text: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he works the work of the Lord, as I also do.

verses.raw: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
verses.text: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.

verses.raw: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
verses.text: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.

verses.raw: Watch you, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
verses.text: Watch you, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.

verses.raw: Let all your things be done with charity.
verses.text: Let all your things be done with charity.

verses.raw: I beseech you, brethren, (you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
verses.text: I beseech you, brethren, (you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)

verses.raw: That you submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helps with us, and laboureth.
verses.text: That you submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helps with us, and laboureth.

verses.raw: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
verses.text: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.

verses.raw: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge you them that are such.
verses.text: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge you them that are such.

verses.raw: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
verses.text: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.

verses.raw: All the brethren greet you. Greet you one another with an holy kiss.
verses.text: All the brethren greet you. Greet you one another with an holy kiss.

verses.raw: The salutation of me Paul with my own hand.
verses.text: The salutation of me Paul with my own hand.

verses.raw: If any man love not Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), let him be Anathema Maranatha.
verses.text: If any man love not Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, let him be Anathema Maranatha.

verses.raw: The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you.
verses.text: The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach be with you.

verses.raw: My love be with you all in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus). Amen. The first epistle to the Corinthians was written from Philippi by Stephanas, and Fortunatus, and Achaicus, and Timotheus.
verses.text: My love be with you all in HaMashiach Yahusha. Amen. The first epistle to the Corinthians was written from Philippi by Stephanas, and Fortunatus, and Achaicus, and Timotheus.

verses.raw: Paul, an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) by the will of Elohim (God), and Timothy our brother, unto the church of Elohim (God) which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:
verses.text: Paul, an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach by the will of Elohim, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of Elohim which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:

verses.raw: Grace be to you and peace from Elohim (God) our Father, and from Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: Grace be to you and peace from Elohim our Father, and from Lord Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: Blessed be Elohim (God), even the Father of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), the Father of mercies, and the Elohim (God) of all comfort;
verses.text: Blessed be Elohim, even the Father of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, the Father of mercies, and the Elohim of all comfort;

verses.raw: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of Elohim.

verses.raw: For as the sufferings of Messiah (Christ) abound in us, so our consolation also abounds by Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: For as the sufferings of Messiah abound in us, so our consolation also abounds by Messiah.

verses.raw: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.
verses.text: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.

verses.raw: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as you are partakers of the sufferings, so shall you be also of the consolation.
verses.text: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as you are partakers of the sufferings, so shall you be also of the consolation.

verses.raw: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
verses.text: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:

verses.raw: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in Elohim (God) which raiseth the dead:
verses.text: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in Elohim which raiseth the dead:

verses.raw: Who delivered us from so great a death, and does deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;
verses.text: Who delivered us from so great a death, and does deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;

verses.raw: You also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.
verses.text: You also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.

verses.raw: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of Elohim (God), we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
verses.text: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of Elohim, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.

verses.raw: For we write none other things unto you, than what you read or acknowledge; and I trust you shall acknowledge even to the end;
verses.text: For we write none other things unto you, than what you read or acknowledge; and I trust you shall acknowledge even to the end;

verses.raw: As also you have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as you also are ours in the day of Lord Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: As also you have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as you also are ours in the day of Lord Yahusha.

verses.raw: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that you might have a second benefit;
verses.text: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that you might have a second benefit;

verses.raw: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.
verses.text: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.

verses.raw: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?
verses.text: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?

verses.raw: But as Elohim (God) is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.
verses.text: But as Elohim is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.

verses.raw: For the Son of Elohim (God), Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.
verses.text: For the Son of Elohim, Yahusha HaMashiach, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.

verses.raw: For all the promises of Elohim (God) in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of Elohim (God) by us.
verses.text: For all the promises of Elohim in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of Elohim by us.

verses.raw: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Messiah (Christ), and has anointed us, is Elohim (God);
verses.text: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Messiah, and has anointed us, is Elohim;

verses.raw: Who has also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
verses.text: Who has also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.

verses.raw: Moreover I call Elohim (God) for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.
verses.text: Moreover I call Elohim for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.

verses.raw: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith you stand.
verses.text: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith you stand.

verses.raw: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.
verses.text: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.

verses.raw: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that makes me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?
verses.text: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that makes me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?

verses.raw: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.
verses.text: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.

verses.raw: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that you should be grieved, but that you might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.
verses.text: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that you should be grieved, but that you might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.

verses.raw: But if any have caused grief, he has not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.
verses.text: But if any have caused grief, he has not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.

verses.raw: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.
verses.text: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.

verses.raw: So that contrariwise you ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.
verses.text: So that contrariwise you ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.

verses.raw: Wherefore I beseech you that you would confirm your love toward him.
verses.text: Wherefore I beseech you that you would confirm your love toward him.

verses.raw: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether you be obedient in all things.
verses.text: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether you be obedient in all things.

verses.raw: To whom you forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Messiah (Christ);
verses.text: To whom you forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Messiah;

verses.raw: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
verses.text: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.

verses.raw: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Messiah's (Christ’s) gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,
verses.text: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Messiah's (Christ’s) gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,

verses.raw: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.
verses.text: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.

verses.raw: Now thanks be unto Elohim (God), which always causes us to triumph in Messiah (Christ), and makes manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
verses.text: Now thanks be unto Elohim, which always causes us to triumph in Messiah, and makes manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.

verses.raw: For we are unto Elohim (God) a sweet savour of Messiah (Christ), in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
verses.text: For we are unto Elohim a sweet savour of Messiah, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:

verses.raw: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
verses.text: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?

verses.raw: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of Elohim (God): but as of sincerity, but as of Elohim (God), in the sight of Elohim (God) speak we in Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of Elohim: but as of sincerity, but as of Elohim, in the sight of Elohim speak we in Messiah.

verses.raw: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?
verses.text: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?

verses.raw: You are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
verses.text: You are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:

verses.raw: Forasmuch as you are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Messiah (Christ) ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living Elohim (God); not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.
verses.text: Forasmuch as you are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Messiah ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living Elohim; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.

verses.raw: And such trust have we through Messiah (Christ) to Elohim (God)-ward:
verses.text: And such trust have we through Messiah to Elohim-ward:

verses.raw: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of Elohim (God);
verses.text: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of Elohim;

verses.raw: Who also has made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter kills, but the spirit gives life.
verses.text: Who also has made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter kills, but the spirit gives life.

verses.raw: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Yashar'el (Israel) could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:
verses.text: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Yashar'el could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:

verses.raw: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?
verses.text: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?

verses.raw: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more does the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
verses.text: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more does the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.

verses.raw: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.
verses.text: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.

verses.raw: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remains is glorious.
verses.text: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remains is glorious.

verses.raw: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:
verses.text: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:

verses.raw: And not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Yashar'el (Israel) could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:
verses.text: And not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Yashar'el could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:

verses.raw: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remains the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remains the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Messiah.

verses.raw: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.
verses.text: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.

verses.raw: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.
verses.text: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.

verses.raw: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
verses.text: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

verses.raw: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
verses.text: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.

verses.raw: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
verses.text: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;

verses.raw: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of Elohim (God) deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of Elohim (God).
verses.text: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of Elohim deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of Elohim.

verses.raw: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:
verses.text: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:

verses.raw: In whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Messiah (Christ), who is the image of Elohim (God), should shine unto them.
verses.text: In whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Messiah, who is the image of Elohim, should shine unto them.

verses.raw: For we preach not ourselves, but HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Yahusha's (Jesus’) sake.
verses.text: For we preach not ourselves, but HaMashiach Yahusha the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Yahusha's (Jesus’) sake.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God), who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, has shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of Elohim (God) in the face of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: For Elohim, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, has shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of Elohim in the face of Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of Elohim (God), and not of us.
verses.text: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of Elohim, and not of us.

verses.raw: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
verses.text: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;

verses.raw: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
verses.text: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;

verses.raw: Always bearing about in the body the dying of Lord Yahusha (Jesus), that the life also of Yahusha (Jesus) might be made manifest in our body.
verses.text: Always bearing about in the body the dying of Lord Yahusha, that the life also of Yahusha might be made manifest in our body.

verses.raw: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Yahusha's (Jesus’) sake, that the life also of Yahusha (Jesus) might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
verses.text: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Yahusha's (Jesus’) sake, that the life also of Yahusha might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.

verses.raw: So then death works in us, but life in you.
verses.text: So then death works in us, but life in you.

verses.raw: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;
verses.text: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;

verses.raw: Knowing that he which raised up Lord Yahusha (Jesus) shall raise up us also by Yahusha (Jesus), and shall present us with you.
verses.text: Knowing that he which raised up Lord Yahusha shall raise up us also by Yahusha, and shall present us with you.

verses.raw: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of Elohim (God).
verses.text: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of Elohim.

verses.raw: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
verses.text: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.

verses.raw: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, works for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
verses.text: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, works for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;

verses.raw: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
verses.text: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

verses.raw: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of Elohim (God), an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
verses.text: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of Elohim, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

verses.raw: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:
verses.text: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:

verses.raw: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
verses.text: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.

verses.raw: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
verses.text: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.

verses.raw: Now he that has wrought us for the selfsame thing is Elohim (God), who also has given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
verses.text: Now he that has wrought us for the selfsame thing is Elohim, who also has given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.

verses.raw: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
verses.text: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:

verses.raw: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
verses.text: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)

verses.raw: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
verses.text: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.

verses.raw: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
verses.text: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.

verses.raw: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Messiah (Christ); that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he has done, whether it be good or bad.
verses.text: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Messiah; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he has done, whether it be good or bad.

verses.raw: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto Elohim (God); and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
verses.text: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto Elohim; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.

verses.raw: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that you may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.
verses.text: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that you may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.

verses.raw: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to Elohim (God): or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.
verses.text: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to Elohim: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.

verses.raw: For the love of Messiah (Christ) constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
verses.text: For the love of Messiah constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:

verses.raw: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.
verses.text: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.

verses.raw: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Messiah (Christ) after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.
verses.text: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Messiah after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.

verses.raw: Therefore if any man be in Messiah (Christ), he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
verses.text: Therefore if any man be in Messiah, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

verses.raw: And all things are of Elohim (God), who has reconciled us to himself by Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), and has given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
verses.text: And all things are of Elohim, who has reconciled us to himself by Yahusha HaMashiach, and has given to us the ministry of reconciliation;

verses.raw: To wit, that Elohim (God) was in Messiah (Christ), reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and has committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
verses.text: To wit, that Elohim was in Messiah, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and has committed unto us the word of reconciliation.

verses.raw: Now then we are ambassadors for Messiah (Christ), as though Elohim (God) did beseech you by us: we pray you in Messiah's (Christ’s) stead, be you reconciled to Elohim (God).
verses.text: Now then we are ambassadors for Messiah, as though Elohim did beseech you by us: we pray you in Messiah's (Christ’s) stead, be you reconciled to Elohim.

verses.raw: For he has made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of Elohim (God) in him.
verses.text: For he has made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of Elohim in him.

verses.raw: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that you receive not the grace of Elohim (God) in vain.
verses.text: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that you receive not the grace of Elohim in vain.

verses.raw: (For he says, I have heard you in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured you: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)
verses.text: (For he says, I have heard you in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured you: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)

verses.raw: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
verses.text: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:

verses.raw: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of Elohim (God), in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
verses.text: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of Elohim, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,

verses.raw: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
verses.text: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;

verses.raw: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), by love unfeigned,
verses.text: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Ruach HaKodesh, by love unfeigned,

verses.raw: By the word of truth, by the power of Elohim (God), by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
verses.text: By the word of truth, by the power of Elohim, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

verses.raw: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
verses.text: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;

verses.raw: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
verses.text: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;

verses.raw: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
verses.text: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.

verses.raw: O you Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
verses.text: O you Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.

verses.raw: You are not straitened in us, but you are straitened in your own bowels.
verses.text: You are not straitened in us, but you are straitened in your own bowels.

verses.raw: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be you also enlarged.
verses.text: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be you also enlarged.

verses.raw: Be you not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship has righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion has light with darkness?
verses.text: Be you not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship has righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion has light with darkness?

verses.raw: And what concord has Messiah (Christ) with Belial? or what part has he that believes with an infidel?
verses.text: And what concord has Messiah with Belial? or what part has he that believes with an infidel?

verses.raw: And what agreement has the temple of Elohim (God) with idols? for you are the temple of the living Elohim (God); as Elohim (God) has said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people.
verses.text: And what agreement has the temple of Elohim with idols? for you are the temple of the living Elohim; as Elohim has said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their Elohim, and they shall be my people.

verses.raw: Wherefore come out from among them, and be you separate, says Yahuah (Lord), and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,
verses.text: Wherefore come out from among them, and be you separate, says Yahuah, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,

verses.raw: And will be a Father unto you, and you shall be my sons and daughters, says Yahuah (Lord) Almighty.
verses.text: And will be a Father unto you, and you shall be my sons and daughters, says Yahuah Almighty.

verses.raw: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of Elohim.

verses.raw: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.
verses.text: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.

verses.raw: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that you are in our hearts to die and live with you.
verses.text: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that you are in our hearts to die and live with you.

verses.raw: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.
verses.text: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.

verses.raw: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.
verses.text: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.

verses.raw: Nevertheless Elohim (God), that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
verses.text: Nevertheless Elohim, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;

verses.raw: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.
verses.text: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.

verses.raw: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle has made you sorry, though it were but for a season.
verses.text: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle has made you sorry, though it were but for a season.

verses.raw: Now I rejoice, not that you were made sorry, but that you sorrowed to repentance: for you were made sorry after a godly manner, that you might receive damage by us in nothing.
verses.text: Now I rejoice, not that you were made sorry, but that you sorrowed to repentance: for you were made sorry after a godly manner, that you might receive damage by us in nothing.

verses.raw: For godly sorrow works repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world works death.
verses.text: For godly sorrow works repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world works death.

verses.raw: For behold this selfsame thing, that you sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things you have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.
verses.text: For behold this selfsame thing, that you sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things you have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.

verses.raw: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of Elohim (God) might appear unto you.
verses.text: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of Elohim might appear unto you.

verses.raw: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.
verses.text: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.

verses.raw: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.
verses.text: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.
