verses.raw: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer every man.
verses.text: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer every man.

verses.raw: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:
verses.text: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:

verses.raw: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;
verses.text: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;

verses.raw: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.
verses.text: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.

verses.raw: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister’s son to Barnabas, (touching whom you received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)
verses.text: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister’s son to Barnabas, (touching whom you received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus), which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of Elohim (God), which have been a comfort unto me.
verses.text: And Yahusha, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of Elohim, which have been a comfort unto me.

verses.raw: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Messiah (Christ), saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Messiah, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of Elohim.

verses.raw: For I bear him record, that he has a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.
verses.text: For I bear him record, that he has a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.

verses.raw: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
verses.text: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.

verses.raw: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
verses.text: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.

verses.raw: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that you likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
verses.text: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that you likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.

verses.raw: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfil it.
verses.text: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfil it.

verses.raw: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen. Written from Rome to the Colossians by Tychicus and Onesimus.
verses.text: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen. Written from Rome to the Colossians by Tychicus and Onesimus.

verses.raw: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in Elohim (God) the Father and in Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ): Grace be unto you, and peace, from Elohim (God) our Father, and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in Elohim the Father and in Lord Yahusha HaMashiach: Grace be unto you, and peace, from Elohim our Father, and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: We give thanks to Elohim (God) always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
verses.text: We give thanks to Elohim always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;

verses.raw: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), in the sight of Elohim (God) and our Father;
verses.text: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, in the sight of Elohim and our Father;

verses.raw: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of Elohim.

verses.raw: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), and in much assurance; as you know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
verses.text: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Ruach HaKodesh, and in much assurance; as you know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.

verses.raw: And you became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit):
verses.text: And you became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Ruach HaKodesh:

verses.raw: So that you were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
verses.text: So that you were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.

verses.raw: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to Elohim (God)-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
verses.text: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to Elohim-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.

verses.raw: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how you turned to Elohim (God) from idols to serve the living and true Elohim (God);
verses.text: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how you turned to Elohim from idols to serve the living and true Elohim;

verses.raw: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Yahusha (Jesus), which delivered us from the wrath to come.
verses.text: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Yahusha, which delivered us from the wrath to come.

verses.raw: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:
verses.text: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:

verses.raw: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as you know, at Philippi, we were bold in our Elohim (God) to speak unto you the gospel of Elohim (God) with much contention.
verses.text: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as you know, at Philippi, we were bold in our Elohim to speak unto you the gospel of Elohim with much contention.

verses.raw: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:
verses.text: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:

verses.raw: But as we were allowed of Elohim (God) to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but Elohim (God), which trieth our hearts.
verses.text: But as we were allowed of Elohim to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but Elohim, which trieth our hearts.

verses.raw: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as you know, nor a cloke of covetousness; Elohim (God) is witness:
verses.text: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as you know, nor a cloke of covetousness; Elohim is witness:

verses.raw: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Messiah.

verses.raw: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:
verses.text: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:

verses.raw: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of Elohim (God) only, but also our own souls, because you were dear unto us.
verses.text: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of Elohim only, but also our own souls, because you were dear unto us.

verses.raw: For you remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of Elohim (God).
verses.text: For you remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of Elohim.

verses.raw: You are witnesses, and Elohim (God) also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:
verses.text: You are witnesses, and Elohim also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:

verses.raw: As you know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father does his children,
verses.text: As you know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father does his children,

verses.raw: That you would walk worthy of Elohim (God), who has called you unto his kingdom and glory.
verses.text: That you would walk worthy of Elohim, who has called you unto his kingdom and glory.

verses.raw: For this cause also thank we Elohim (God) without ceasing, because, when you received the word of Elohim (God) which you heard of us, you received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of Elohim (God), which effectually works also in you that believe.
verses.text: For this cause also thank we Elohim without ceasing, because, when you received the word of Elohim which you heard of us, you received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of Elohim, which effectually works also in you that believe.

verses.raw: For you, brethren, became followers of the churches of Elohim (God) which in Judaea are in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus): for you also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Yahudim (Jews):
verses.text: For you, brethren, became followers of the churches of Elohim which in Judaea are in HaMashiach Yahusha: for you also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Yahudim:

verses.raw: Who both killed Lord Yahusha (Jesus), and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not Elohim (God), and are contrary to all men:
verses.text: Who both killed Lord Yahusha, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not Elohim, and are contrary to all men:

verses.raw: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.
verses.text: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.

verses.raw: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.
verses.text: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.

verses.raw: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.
verses.text: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.

verses.raw: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even you in the presence of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) at his coming?
verses.text: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even you in the presence of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach at his coming?

verses.raw: For you are our glory and joy.
verses.text: For you are our glory and joy.

verses.raw: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;
verses.text: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;

verses.raw: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of Elohim (God), and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Messiah (Christ), to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:
verses.text: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of Elohim, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Messiah, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:

verses.raw: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.
verses.text: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.

verses.raw: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and you know.
verses.text: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and you know.

verses.raw: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.
verses.text: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.

verses.raw: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that you have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:
verses.text: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that you have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:

verses.raw: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:
verses.text: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:

verses.raw: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.
verses.text: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

verses.raw: For what thanks can we render to Elohim (God) again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our Elohim (God);
verses.text: For what thanks can we render to Elohim again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our Elohim;

verses.raw: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
verses.text: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

verses.raw: Now Elohim (God) himself and our Father, and our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), direct our way unto you.
verses.text: Now Elohim himself and our Father, and our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, direct our way unto you.

verses.raw: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:
verses.text: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:

verses.raw: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before Elohim (God), even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) with all his saints.
verses.text: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before Elohim, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach with all his saints.

verses.raw: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by Lord Yahusha (Jesus), that as you have received of us how you ought to walk and to please Elohim (God), so you would abound more and more.
verses.text: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by Lord Yahusha, that as you have received of us how you ought to walk and to please Elohim, so you would abound more and more.

verses.raw: For you know what commandments we gave you by Lord Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: For you know what commandments we gave you by Lord Yahusha.

verses.raw: For this is the will of Elohim (God), even your sanctification, that you should abstain from fornication:
verses.text: For this is the will of Elohim, even your sanctification, that you should abstain from fornication:

verses.raw: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;
verses.text: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;

verses.raw: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not Elohim (God):
verses.text: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not Elohim:

verses.raw: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that Yahuah (Lord) is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.
verses.text: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that Yahuah is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) has not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.
verses.text: For Elohim has not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.

verses.raw: He therefore that despises, despises not man, but Elohim (God), who has also given unto us his holy Spirit.
verses.text: He therefore that despises, despises not man, but Elohim, who has also given unto us his holy Spirit.

verses.raw: But as touching brotherly love you need not that I write unto you: for you yourselves are taught of Elohim (God) to love one another.
verses.text: But as touching brotherly love you need not that I write unto you: for you yourselves are taught of Elohim to love one another.

verses.raw: And indeed you do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that you increase more and more;
verses.text: And indeed you do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that you increase more and more;

verses.raw: And that you study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
verses.text: And that you study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;

verses.raw: That you may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that you may have lack of nothing.
verses.text: That you may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that you may have lack of nothing.

verses.raw: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that you sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
verses.text: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that you sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.

verses.raw: For if we believe that Yahusha (Jesus) died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Yahusha (Jesus) will Elohim (God) bring with him.
verses.text: For if we believe that Yahusha died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Yahusha will Elohim bring with him.

verses.raw: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.
verses.text: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.

verses.raw: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of Elohim (God): and the dead in Messiah (Christ) shall rise first:
verses.text: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of Elohim: and the dead in Messiah shall rise first:

verses.raw: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
verses.text: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

verses.raw: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.
verses.text: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.

verses.raw: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, you have no need that I write unto you.
verses.text: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, you have no need that I write unto you.

verses.raw: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of Yahuah (Lord) so comes as a thief in the night.
verses.text: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of Yahuah so comes as a thief in the night.

verses.raw: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction comes upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.
verses.text: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction comes upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.

verses.raw: But you, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
verses.text: But you, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.

verses.raw: You are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.
verses.text: You are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.

verses.raw: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.
verses.text: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.

verses.raw: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.
verses.text: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.

verses.raw: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
verses.text: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) has not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ),
verses.text: For Elohim has not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach,

verses.raw: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
verses.text: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

verses.raw: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also you do.
verses.text: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also you do.

verses.raw: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
verses.text: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;

verses.raw: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake. And be at peace among yourselves.
verses.text: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake. And be at peace among yourselves.

verses.raw: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
verses.text: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.

verses.raw: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.
verses.text: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.

verses.raw: Rejoice evermore.
verses.text: Rejoice evermore.

verses.raw: Pray without ceasing.
verses.text: Pray without ceasing.

verses.raw: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of Elohim (God) in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) concerning you.
verses.text: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of Elohim in HaMashiach Yahusha concerning you.

verses.raw: Quench not the Spirit.
verses.text: Quench not the Spirit.

verses.raw: Despise not prophesyings.
verses.text: Despise not prophesyings.

verses.raw: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.
verses.text: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

verses.raw: Abstain from all appearance of evil.
verses.text: Abstain from all appearance of evil.

verses.raw: And the very Elohim (God) of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray Elohim (God) your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: And the very Elohim of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray Elohim your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: Faithful is he that calls you, who also will do it.
verses.text: Faithful is he that calls you, who also will do it.

verses.raw: Brethren, pray for us.
verses.text: Brethren, pray for us.

verses.raw: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.
verses.text: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.

verses.raw: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.
verses.text: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.

verses.raw: The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen. The first epistle unto the Thessalonians was written from Athens.
verses.text: The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach be with you. Amen. The first epistle unto the Thessalonians was written from Athens.

verses.raw: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in Elohim (God) our Father and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ):
verses.text: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in Elohim our Father and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach:

verses.raw: Grace unto you, and peace, from Elohim (God) our Father and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: Grace unto you, and peace, from Elohim our Father and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: We are bound to thank Elohim (God) always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith grows exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other abounds;
verses.text: We are bound to thank Elohim always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith grows exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other abounds;

verses.raw: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of Elohim (God) for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that you endure:
verses.text: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of Elohim for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that you endure:

verses.raw: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of Elohim (God), that you may be counted worthy of the kingdom of Elohim (God), for which you also suffer:
verses.text: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of Elohim, that you may be counted worthy of the kingdom of Elohim, for which you also suffer:

verses.raw: Seeing it is a righteous thing with Elohim (God) to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;
verses.text: Seeing it is a righteous thing with Elohim to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;

verses.raw: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when Lord Yahusha (Jesus) shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
verses.text: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when Lord Yahusha shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,

verses.raw: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not Elohim (God), and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ):
verses.text: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not Elohim, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach:

verses.raw: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
verses.text: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;

verses.raw: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
verses.text: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.

verses.raw: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our Elohim (God) would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:
verses.text: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our Elohim would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:

verses.raw: That the name of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our Elohim (God) and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: That the name of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our Elohim and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), and by our gathering together unto him,
verses.text: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, and by our gathering together unto him,

verses.raw: That you be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Messiah (Christ) is at hand.
verses.text: That you be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Messiah is at hand.

verses.raw: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
verses.text: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;

verses.raw: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called Elohim (God), or that is worshipped; so that he as Elohim (God) sits in the temple of Elohim (God), shewing himself that he is Elohim (God).
verses.text: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called Elohim, or that is worshipped; so that he as Elohim sits in the temple of Elohim, shewing himself that he is Elohim.

verses.raw: Remember you not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
verses.text: Remember you not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?

verses.raw: And now you know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.
verses.text: And now you know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.

verses.raw: For the mystery of iniquity does already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
verses.text: For the mystery of iniquity does already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.

verses.raw: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
verses.text: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

verses.raw: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
verses.text: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

verses.raw: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
verses.text: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

verses.raw: And for this cause Elohim (God) shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:
verses.text: And for this cause Elohim shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:

verses.raw: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
verses.text: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

verses.raw: But we are bound to give thanks alway to Elohim (God) for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because Elohim (God) has from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
verses.text: But we are bound to give thanks alway to Elohim for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because Elohim has from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:

verses.raw: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which you have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.
verses.text: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which you have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.

verses.raw: Now our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) himself, and Elohim (God), even our Father, which has loved us, and has given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
verses.text: Now our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach himself, and Elohim, even our Father, which has loved us, and has given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

verses.raw: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.
verses.text: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.

verses.raw: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:
verses.text: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:

verses.raw: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.
verses.text: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.

verses.raw: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
verses.text: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

verses.raw: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that you both do and will do the things which we command you.
verses.text: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that you both do and will do the things which we command you.

verses.raw: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of Elohim (God), and into the patient waiting for Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of Elohim, and into the patient waiting for Messiah.

verses.raw: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), that you withdraw yourselves from every brother that walks disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
verses.text: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother that walks disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.

verses.raw: For yourselves know how you ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
verses.text: For yourselves know how you ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;

verses.raw: Neither did we eat any man’s bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
verses.text: Neither did we eat any man’s bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:

verses.raw: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.
verses.text: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.

verses.raw: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.
verses.text: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.

verses.raw: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
verses.text: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.

verses.raw: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
verses.text: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

verses.raw: But you, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
verses.text: But you, brethren, be not weary in well doing.

verses.raw: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
verses.text: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.

verses.raw: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
verses.text: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

verses.raw: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
verses.text: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.

verses.raw: The salutation of Paul with my own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
verses.text: The salutation of Paul with my own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.

verses.raw: The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you all. Amen. The second epistle to the Thessalonians was written from Athens.
verses.text: The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach be with you all. Amen. The second epistle to the Thessalonians was written from Athens.

verses.raw: Paul, an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) by the commandment of Elohim (God) our Saviour, and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), which is our hope;
verses.text: Paul, an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach by the commandment of Elohim our Saviour, and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, which is our hope;

verses.raw: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from Elohim (God) our Father and Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) our Lord.
verses.text: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from Elohim our Father and Yahusha HaMashiach our Lord.

verses.raw: As I besought you to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that you might charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
verses.text: As I besought you to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that you might charge some that they teach no other doctrine,

verses.raw: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.
verses.text: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.

verses.raw: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:
verses.text: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:

verses.raw: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;
verses.text: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;

verses.raw: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.
verses.text: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.

verses.raw: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;
verses.text: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;

verses.raw: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
verses.text: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

verses.raw: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
verses.text: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;

verses.raw: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed Elohim (God), which was committed to my trust.
verses.text: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed Elohim, which was committed to my trust.

verses.raw: And I thank HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) our Lord, who has enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
verses.text: And I thank HaMashiach Yahusha our Lord, who has enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;

verses.raw: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
verses.text: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

verses.raw: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus).
verses.text: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in HaMashiach Yahusha.

verses.raw: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
verses.text: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that HaMashiach Yahusha came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

verses.raw: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
verses.text: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Yahusha HaMashiach might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.

verses.raw: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise Elohim (God), be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.text: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise Elohim, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.raw: This charge I commit unto you, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on you, that you by them might war a good warfare;
verses.text: This charge I commit unto you, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on you, that you by them might war a good warfare;

verses.raw: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
verses.text: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:

verses.raw: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
verses.text: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.

verses.raw: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
verses.text: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;

verses.raw: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
verses.text: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

verses.raw: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of Elohim (God) our Saviour;
verses.text: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of Elohim our Saviour;

verses.raw: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.
verses.text: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.

verses.raw: For there is one Elohim (God), and one mediator between Elohim (God) and men, the man HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus);
verses.text: For there is one Elohim, and one mediator between Elohim and men, the man HaMashiach Yahusha;

verses.raw: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
verses.text: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.

verses.raw: Where unto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Messiah (Christ), and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
verses.text: Where unto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Messiah, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.

verses.raw: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
verses.text: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.

verses.raw: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
verses.text: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;

verses.raw: But (which becomes women professing godliness) with good works.
verses.text: But (which becomes women professing godliness) with good works.

verses.raw: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
verses.text: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.

verses.raw: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
verses.text: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.

verses.raw: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
verses.text: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.

verses.raw: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
verses.text: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
verses.text: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.

verses.raw: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desires a good work.
verses.text: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desires a good work.

verses.raw: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
verses.text: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;

verses.raw: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
verses.text: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;

verses.raw: One that rules well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
verses.text: One that rules well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;

verses.raw: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of Elohim (God)?)
verses.text: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of Elohim?)

verses.raw: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
verses.text: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.

verses.raw: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
verses.text: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.

verses.raw: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
verses.text: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;

verses.raw: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
verses.text: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

verses.raw: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
verses.text: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.

verses.raw: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
verses.text: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.

verses.raw: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
verses.text: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

verses.raw: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus).
verses.text: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in HaMashiach Yahusha.

verses.raw: These things write I unto you, hoping to come unto you shortly:
verses.text: These things write I unto you, hoping to come unto you shortly:

verses.raw: But if I tarry long, that you may know how you oughtest to behave thyself in the house of Elohim (God), which is the church of the living Elohim (God), the pillar and ground of the truth.
verses.text: But if I tarry long, that you may know how you oughtest to behave thyself in the house of Elohim, which is the church of the living Elohim, the pillar and ground of the truth.

verses.raw: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: Elohim (God) was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
verses.text: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: Elohim was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.

verses.raw: Now the Spirit speaks expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
verses.text: Now the Spirit speaks expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;

verses.raw: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
verses.text: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;

verses.raw: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which Elohim (God) has created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
verses.text: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which Elohim has created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.

verses.raw: For every creature of Elohim (God) is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
verses.text: For every creature of Elohim is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:

verses.raw: For it is sanctified by the word of Elohim (God) and prayer.
verses.text: For it is sanctified by the word of Elohim and prayer.

verses.raw: If you put the brethren in remembrance of these things, you shall be a good minister of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto you have attained.
verses.text: If you put the brethren in remembrance of these things, you shall be a good minister of Yahusha HaMashiach, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto you have attained.

verses.raw: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.
verses.text: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.

verses.raw: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
verses.text: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

verses.raw: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
verses.text: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.

verses.raw: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living Elohim (God), who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
verses.text: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living Elohim, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.

verses.raw: These things command and teach.
verses.text: These things command and teach.

verses.raw: Let no man despise your youth; but be you an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
verses.text: Let no man despise your youth; but be you an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

verses.raw: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
verses.text: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.

verses.raw: Neglect not the gift that is in you, which was given you by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
verses.text: Neglect not the gift that is in you, which was given you by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.

verses.raw: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that your profiting may appear to all.
verses.text: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that your profiting may appear to all.

verses.raw: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this you shall both save thyself, and them that hear you.
verses.text: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this you shall both save thyself, and them that hear you.

verses.raw: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;
verses.text: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;

verses.raw: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
verses.text: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.

verses.raw: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
verses.text: Honour widows that are widows indeed.

verses.raw: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before Elohim (God).
verses.text: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before Elohim.

verses.raw: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusts in Elohim (God), and continues in supplications and prayers night and day.
verses.text: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusts in Elohim, and continues in supplications and prayers night and day.

verses.raw: But she that lives in pleasure is dead while she lives.
verses.text: But she that lives in pleasure is dead while she lives.

verses.raw: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
verses.text: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.

verses.raw: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he has denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
verses.text: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he has denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.

verses.raw: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,
verses.text: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,

verses.raw: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints’ feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
verses.text: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints’ feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.

verses.raw: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Messiah (Christ), they will marry;
verses.text: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Messiah, they will marry;

verses.raw: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
verses.text: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.

verses.raw: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
verses.text: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.

verses.raw: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.
verses.text: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.

verses.raw: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
verses.text: For some are already turned aside after Satan.

verses.raw: If any man or woman that believes have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
verses.text: If any man or woman that believes have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.

verses.raw: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
verses.text: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.

verses.raw: For the scripture says, You shall not muzzle the ox that treads out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
verses.text: For the scripture says, You shall not muzzle the ox that treads out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.

verses.raw: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.
verses.text: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.

verses.raw: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
verses.text: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.

verses.raw: I charge you before Elohim (God), and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), and the elect angels, that you observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.
verses.text: I charge you before Elohim, and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, and the elect angels, that you observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.

verses.raw: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men’s sins: keep thyself pure.
verses.text: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men’s sins: keep thyself pure.

verses.raw: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your often infirmities.
verses.text: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your often infirmities.

verses.raw: Some men’s sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
verses.text: Some men’s sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.

verses.raw: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise can not be hid.
verses.text: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise can not be hid.

verses.raw: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of Elohim (God) and his doctrine be not blasphemed.
verses.text: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of Elohim and his doctrine be not blasphemed.

verses.raw: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
verses.text: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.

verses.raw: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
verses.text: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;

verses.raw: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof comes envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,
verses.text: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof comes envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,

verses.raw: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.
verses.text: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.

verses.raw: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
verses.text: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

verses.raw: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
verses.text: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.

verses.raw: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
verses.text: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.

verses.raw: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.
verses.text: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.

verses.raw: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
verses.text: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

verses.raw: But you, O man of Elohim (God), flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
verses.text: But you, O man of Elohim, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.

verses.raw: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, where unto you are also called, and have professed a good profession before many witnesses.
verses.text: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, where unto you are also called, and have professed a good profession before many witnesses.

verses.raw: I give you charge in the sight of Elohim (God), who quickens all things, and before HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus), who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;
verses.text: I give you charge in the sight of Elohim, who quickens all things, and before HaMashiach Yahusha, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;

verses.raw: That you keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ):
verses.text: That you keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach:

verses.raw: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and the Lord of lords;
verses.text: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and the Lord of lords;

verses.raw: Who only has immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man has seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.
verses.text: Who only has immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man has seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.

verses.raw: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living Elohim (God), who gives us richly all things to enjoy;
verses.text: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living Elohim, who gives us richly all things to enjoy;

verses.raw: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;
verses.text: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;

verses.raw: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
verses.text: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.

verses.raw: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to your trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:
verses.text: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to your trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:

verses.raw: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with you. Amen. The first to Timothy was written from Laodicea, which is the chiefest city of Phrygia Pacatiana.
verses.text: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with you. Amen. The first to Timothy was written from Laodicea, which is the chiefest city of Phrygia Pacatiana.

verses.raw: Paul, an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) by the will of Elohim (God), according to the promise of life which is in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus),
verses.text: Paul, an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach by the will of Elohim, according to the promise of life which is in HaMashiach Yahusha,

verses.raw: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from Elohim (God) the Father and HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) our Lord.
verses.text: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from Elohim the Father and HaMashiach Yahusha our Lord.

verses.raw: I thank Elohim (God), whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of you in my prayers night and day;
verses.text: I thank Elohim, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of you in my prayers night and day;

verses.raw: Greatly desiring to see you, being mindful of your tears, that I may be filled with joy;
verses.text: Greatly desiring to see you, being mindful of your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

verses.raw: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in you, which dwelt first in your grandmother Lois, and your mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in you also.
verses.text: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in you, which dwelt first in your grandmother Lois, and your mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in you also.

verses.raw: Wherefore I put you in remembrance that you stir up the gift of Elohim (God), which is in you by the putting on of my hands.
verses.text: Wherefore I put you in remembrance that you stir up the gift of Elohim, which is in you by the putting on of my hands.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) has not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
verses.text: For Elohim has not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

verses.raw: Be not you therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be you partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of Elohim (God);
verses.text: Be not you therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be you partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of Elohim;

verses.raw: Who has saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) before the world began,
verses.text: Who has saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in HaMashiach Yahusha before the world began,

verses.raw: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), who has abolished death, and has brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
verses.text: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Yahusha HaMashiach, who has abolished death, and has brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:

verses.raw: Where unto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
verses.text: Where unto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

verses.raw: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
verses.text: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.

verses.raw: Hold fast the form of sound words, which you have heard of me, in faith and love which is in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus).
verses.text: Hold fast the form of sound words, which you have heard of me, in faith and love which is in HaMashiach Yahusha.

verses.raw: That good thing which was committed unto you keep by the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) which dwells in us.
verses.text: That good thing which was committed unto you keep by the Ruach HaKodesh which dwells in us.

verses.raw: This you know, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
verses.text: This you know, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

verses.raw: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
verses.text: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:

verses.raw: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.
verses.text: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.

verses.raw: Yahuah (Lord) grant unto him that he may find mercy of Yahuah (Lord) in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, you know very well.
verses.text: Yahuah grant unto him that he may find mercy of Yahuah in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, you know very well.

verses.raw: You therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus).
verses.text: You therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in HaMashiach Yahusha.

verses.raw: And the things that you have heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit you to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
verses.text: And the things that you have heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit you to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

verses.raw: You therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: You therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who has chosen him to be a soldier.
verses.text: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who has chosen him to be a soldier.

verses.raw: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
verses.text: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.

verses.raw: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.
verses.text: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.

verses.raw: Consider what I say; and the Lord give you understanding in all things.
verses.text: Consider what I say; and the Lord give you understanding in all things.

verses.raw: Remember that Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
verses.text: Remember that Yahusha HaMashiach of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:

verses.raw: Where in I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of Elohim (God) is not bound.
verses.text: Where in I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of Elohim is not bound.

verses.raw: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) with eternal glory.
verses.text: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in HaMashiach Yahusha with eternal glory.

verses.raw: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:
verses.text: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:

verses.raw: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:
verses.text: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:

verses.raw: If we believe not, yet he abides faithful: he can not deny himself.
verses.text: If we believe not, yet he abides faithful: he can not deny himself.

verses.raw: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
verses.text: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.

verses.raw: Study to shew thyself approved unto Elohim (God), a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
verses.text: Study to shew thyself approved unto Elohim, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

verses.raw: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
verses.text: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.

verses.raw: And their word will eat as does a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;
verses.text: And their word will eat as does a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;

verses.raw: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
verses.text: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.

verses.raw: Nevertheless the foundation of Elohim (God) stands sure, having this seal, Yahuah (Lord) knows them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Messiah (Christ) depart from iniquity.
verses.text: Nevertheless the foundation of Elohim stands sure, having this seal, Yahuah knows them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Messiah depart from iniquity.

verses.raw: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
verses.text: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.

verses.raw: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.
verses.text: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.

verses.raw: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
verses.text: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

verses.raw: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
verses.text: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.

verses.raw: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
verses.text: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,

verses.raw: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if Elohim (God) peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
verses.text: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if Elohim peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

verses.raw: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.
verses.text: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.

verses.raw: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
