verses.text: I know your works, and your labour, and your patience, and how you can not bear them which are evil: and you have tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and have found them liars:

verses.raw: And have borne, and have patience, and for my name’s sake have laboured, and have not fainted.
verses.text: And have borne, and have patience, and for my name’s sake have laboured, and have not fainted.

verses.raw: Nevertheless I have somewhat against you, because you have left your first love.
verses.text: Nevertheless I have somewhat against you, because you have left your first love.

verses.raw: Remember therefore from whence you are fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto you quickly, and will remove your candlestick out of his place, except you repent.
verses.text: Remember therefore from whence you are fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto you quickly, and will remove your candlestick out of his place, except you repent.

verses.raw: But this you have, that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
verses.text: But this you have, that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

verses.raw: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches; To him that overcomes will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of Elohim (God).
verses.text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches; To him that overcomes will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of Elohim.

verses.raw: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things says the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;
verses.text: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things says the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;

verses.raw: I know your works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but you are rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Yahudim (Jews), and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.
verses.text: I know your works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but you are rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Yahudim, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.

verses.raw: Fear none of those things which you shall suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that you may be tried; and you shall have tribulation ten days: be you faithful unto death, and I will give you a crown of life.
verses.text: Fear none of those things which you shall suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that you may be tried; and you shall have tribulation ten days: be you faithful unto death, and I will give you a crown of life.

verses.raw: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches; He that overcomes shall not be hurt of the second death.
verses.text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches; He that overcomes shall not be hurt of the second death.

verses.raw: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things says he which has the sharp sword with two edges;
verses.text: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things says he which has the sharp sword with two edges;

verses.raw: I know your works, and where you dwell, even where Satan’s seat is: and you hold fast my name, and have not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwells.
verses.text: I know your works, and where you dwell, even where Satan’s seat is: and you hold fast my name, and have not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwells.

verses.raw: But I have a few things against you, because you have there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Yashar'el (Israel), to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.
verses.text: But I have a few things against you, because you have there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Yashar'el, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.

verses.raw: So have you also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.
verses.text: So have you also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.

verses.raw: Repent; or else I will come unto you quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
verses.text: Repent; or else I will come unto you quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.

verses.raw: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches; To him that overcomes will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knows saving he that receives it.
verses.text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches; To him that overcomes will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knows saving he that receives it.

verses.raw: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things says the Son of Elohim (God), who has his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;
verses.text: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things says the Son of Elohim, who has his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;

verses.raw: I know your works, and charity, and service, and faith, and your patience, and your works; and the last to be more than the first.
verses.text: I know your works, and charity, and service, and faith, and your patience, and your works; and the last to be more than the first.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding I have a few things against you, because you sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calls herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.
verses.text: Notwithstanding I have a few things against you, because you sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calls herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.

verses.raw: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.
verses.text: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.

verses.raw: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.
verses.text: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.

verses.raw: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.
verses.text: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.

verses.raw: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.
verses.text: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.

verses.raw: But that which you have already hold fast till I come.
verses.text: But that which you have already hold fast till I come.

verses.raw: And he that overcomes, and keeps my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:
verses.text: And he that overcomes, and keeps my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:

verses.raw: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.
verses.text: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.

verses.raw: And I will give him the morning star.
verses.text: And I will give him the morning star.

verses.raw: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches.
verses.text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches.

verses.raw: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things says he that has the seven Spirits of Elohim (God), and the seven stars; I know your works, that you have a name that you livest, and are dead.
verses.text: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things says he that has the seven Spirits of Elohim, and the seven stars; I know your works, that you have a name that you livest, and are dead.

verses.raw: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found your works perfect before Elohim (God).
verses.text: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found your works perfect before Elohim.

verses.raw: Remember therefore how you have received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore you shall not watch, I will come on you as a thief, and you shall not know what hour I will come upon you.
verses.text: Remember therefore how you have received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore you shall not watch, I will come on you as a thief, and you shall not know what hour I will come upon you.

verses.raw: You have a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.
verses.text: You have a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.

verses.raw: He that overcomes, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
verses.text: He that overcomes, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

verses.raw: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches.
verses.text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches.

verses.raw: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things says he that is holy, he that is true, he that has the key of David, he that opens, and no man shuts; and shuts, and no man opens;
verses.text: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things says he that is holy, he that is true, he that has the key of David, he that opens, and no man shuts; and shuts, and no man opens;

verses.raw: I know your works: behold, I have set before you an open door, and no man can shut it: for you have a little strength, and have kept my word, and have not denied my name.
verses.text: I know your works: behold, I have set before you an open door, and no man can shut it: for you have a little strength, and have kept my word, and have not denied my name.

verses.raw: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Yahudim (Jews), and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.
verses.text: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Yahudim, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.

verses.raw: Because you have kept the word of my patience, I also will keep you from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.
verses.text: Because you have kept the word of my patience, I also will keep you from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.

verses.raw: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which you have, that no man take your crown.
verses.text: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which you have, that no man take your crown.

verses.raw: Him that overcomes will I make a pillar in the temple of my Elohim (God), and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my Elohim (God), and the name of the city of my Elohim (God), which is new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my Elohim (God): and I will write upon him my new name.
verses.text: Him that overcomes will I make a pillar in the temple of my Elohim, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my Elohim, and the name of the city of my Elohim, which is new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my Elohim: and I will write upon him my new name.

verses.raw: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches.
verses.text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches.

verses.raw: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things says the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of Elohim (God);
verses.text: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things says the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of Elohim;

verses.raw: I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot: I would you were cold or hot.
verses.text: I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot: I would you were cold or hot.

verses.raw: So then because you are lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue you out of my mouth.
verses.text: So then because you are lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue you out of my mouth.

verses.raw: Because you say, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and know not that you are wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:
verses.text: Because you say, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and know not that you are wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:

verses.raw: I counsel you to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that you may be rich; and white raiment, that you may be clothed, and that the shame of your nakedness do not appear; and anoint your eyes with eyesalve, that you may see.
verses.text: I counsel you to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that you may be rich; and white raiment, that you may be clothed, and that the shame of your nakedness do not appear; and anoint your eyes with eyesalve, that you may see.

verses.raw: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
verses.text: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.

verses.raw: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
verses.text: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

verses.raw: To him that overcomes will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.
verses.text: To him that overcomes will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.

verses.raw: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches.
verses.text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches.

verses.raw: After this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew you things which must be hereafter.
verses.text: After this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew you things which must be hereafter.

verses.raw: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.
verses.text: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.

verses.raw: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.
verses.text: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.

verses.raw: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.
verses.text: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.

verses.raw: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of Elohim.

verses.raw: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.
verses.text: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.

verses.raw: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.
verses.text: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.

verses.raw: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
verses.text: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Yahuah Elohim Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.

verses.raw: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who lives for ever and ever,
verses.text: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who lives for ever and ever,

verses.raw: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that lives for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
verses.text: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that lives for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,

verses.raw: You are worthy, O Yahuah (Lord), to receive glory and honour and power: for you have created all things, and for your pleasure they are and were created.
verses.text: You are worthy, O Yahuah, to receive glory and honour and power: for you have created all things, and for your pleasure they are and were created.

verses.raw: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.
verses.text: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.

verses.raw: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?
verses.text: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?

verses.raw: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.
verses.text: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.

verses.raw: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.
verses.text: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.

verses.raw: And one of the elders says unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, has prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.
verses.text: And one of the elders says unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, has prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.

verses.raw: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of Elohim (God) sent forth into all the earth.
verses.text: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of Elohim sent forth into all the earth.

verses.raw: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.
verses.text: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.

verses.raw: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.
verses.text: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.

verses.raw: And they sung a new song, saying, You are worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for you were slain, and have redeemed us to Elohim (God) by your blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
verses.text: And they sung a new song, saying, You are worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for you were slain, and have redeemed us to Elohim by your blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;

verses.raw: And have made us unto our Elohim (God) kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.
verses.text: And have made us unto our Elohim kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.

verses.raw: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
verses.text: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;

verses.raw: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.
verses.text: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.

verses.raw: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sits upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.
verses.text: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sits upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.

verses.raw: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that lives for ever and ever.
verses.text: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that lives for ever and ever.

verses.raw: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.
verses.text: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.

verses.raw: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.
verses.text: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.

verses.raw: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.
verses.text: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.

verses.raw: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.
verses.text: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.

verses.raw: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.
verses.text: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.

verses.raw: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see you hurt not the oil and the wine.
verses.text: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see you hurt not the oil and the wine.

verses.raw: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.
verses.text: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.

verses.raw: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.
verses.text: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.

verses.raw: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of Elohim (God), and for the testimony which they held:
verses.text: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of Elohim, and for the testimony which they held:

verses.raw: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Yahuah (Lord), holy and true, do you not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?
verses.text: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Yahuah, holy and true, do you not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?

verses.raw: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.
verses.text: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.

verses.raw: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;
verses.text: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;

verses.raw: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casts her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.
verses.text: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casts her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.

verses.raw: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
verses.text: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

verses.raw: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;
verses.text: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;

verses.raw: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:
verses.text: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:

verses.raw: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?
verses.text: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?

verses.raw: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.
verses.text: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.

verses.raw: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living Elohim (God): and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,
verses.text: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living Elohim: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,

verses.raw: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our Elohim (God) in their foreheads.
verses.text: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our Elohim in their foreheads.

verses.raw: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Of the tribe of Juda were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad were sealed twelve thousand.
verses.text: Of the tribe of Juda were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad were sealed twelve thousand.

verses.raw: Of the tribe of Aser were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nepthalim were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses were sealed twelve thousand.
verses.text: Of the tribe of Aser were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nepthalim were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses were sealed twelve thousand.

verses.raw: Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar were sealed twelve thousand.
verses.text: Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar were sealed twelve thousand.

verses.raw: Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.
verses.text: Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.

verses.raw: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;
verses.text: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;

verses.raw: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our Elohim (God) which sits upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.
verses.text: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our Elohim which sits upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.

verses.raw: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped Elohim (God),
verses.text: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped Elohim,

verses.raw: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our Elohim (God) for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.text: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our Elohim for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.raw: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?
verses.text: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?

verses.raw: And I said unto him, Sir, you know. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
verses.text: And I said unto him, Sir, you know. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

verses.raw: Therefore are they before the throne of Elohim (God), and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sits on the throne shall dwell among them.
verses.text: Therefore are they before the throne of Elohim, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sits on the throne shall dwell among them.

verses.raw: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.
verses.text: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.

verses.raw: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and Elohim (God) shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
verses.text: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and Elohim shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.

verses.raw: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.
verses.text: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.

verses.raw: And I saw the seven angels which stood before Elohim (God); and to them were given seven trumpets.
verses.text: And I saw the seven angels which stood before Elohim; and to them were given seven trumpets.

verses.raw: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.
verses.text: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

verses.raw: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before Elohim (God) out of the angel’s hand.
verses.text: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before Elohim out of the angel’s hand.

verses.raw: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.
verses.text: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.

verses.raw: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
verses.text: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

verses.raw: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.
verses.text: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

verses.raw: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;
verses.text: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;

verses.raw: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.
verses.text: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.

verses.raw: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;
verses.text: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;

verses.raw: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.
verses.text: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.

verses.raw: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.
verses.text: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.

verses.raw: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!
verses.text: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!

verses.raw: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.
verses.text: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.

verses.raw: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.
verses.text: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.

verses.raw: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
verses.text: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

verses.raw: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of Elohim (God) in their foreheads.
verses.text: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of Elohim in their foreheads.

verses.raw: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.
verses.text: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.

verses.raw: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.
verses.text: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.

verses.raw: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.
verses.text: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.

verses.raw: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.
verses.text: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.

verses.raw: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.
verses.text: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.

verses.raw: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.
verses.text: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.

verses.raw: And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue has his name Apollyon.
verses.text: And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue has his name Apollyon.

verses.raw: One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.
verses.text: One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.

verses.raw: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before Elohim (God),
verses.text: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before Elohim,

verses.raw: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.
verses.text: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.

verses.raw: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.
verses.text: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.

verses.raw: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.
verses.text: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.

verses.raw: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.
verses.text: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.

verses.raw: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.
verses.text: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.

verses.raw: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.
verses.text: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.

verses.raw: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:
verses.text: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:

verses.raw: Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.
verses.text: Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.

verses.raw: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:
verses.text: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:

verses.raw: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,
verses.text: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,

verses.raw: And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.
verses.text: And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.

verses.raw: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.
verses.text: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.

verses.raw: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,
verses.text: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,

verses.raw: And sware by him that lives for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer:
verses.text: And sware by him that lives for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer:

verses.raw: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of Elohim (God) should be finished, as he has declared to his servants the prophets.
verses.text: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of Elohim should be finished, as he has declared to his servants the prophets.

verses.raw: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which stands upon the sea and upon the earth.
verses.text: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which stands upon the sea and upon the earth.

verses.raw: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make your belly bitter, but it shall be in your mouth sweet as honey.
verses.text: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make your belly bitter, but it shall be in your mouth sweet as honey.

verses.raw: And I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.
verses.text: And I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.

verses.raw: And he said unto me, You must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.
verses.text: And he said unto me, You must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.

verses.raw: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of Elohim (God), and the altar, and them that worship therein.
verses.text: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of Elohim, and the altar, and them that worship therein.

verses.raw: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.
verses.text: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.

verses.raw: And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.
verses.text: And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.

verses.raw: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the Elohim (God) of the earth.
verses.text: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the Elohim of the earth.

verses.raw: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceeds out of their mouth, and devours their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.
verses.text: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceeds out of their mouth, and devours their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.

verses.raw: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.
verses.text: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.

verses.raw: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascends out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.
verses.text: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascends out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.

verses.raw: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.
verses.text: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.

verses.raw: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half, and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.
verses.text: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half, and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.

verses.raw: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth.
verses.text: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth.

verses.raw: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from Elohim (God) entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.
verses.text: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from Elohim entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.

verses.raw: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.
verses.text: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.

verses.raw: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the Elohim (God) of heaven.
verses.text: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the Elohim of heaven.

verses.raw: The second woe is past; and, behold, the third woe comes quickly.
verses.text: The second woe is past; and, behold, the third woe comes quickly.

verses.raw: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Messiah (Christ); and he shall reign for ever and ever.
verses.text: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Messiah; and he shall reign for ever and ever.

verses.raw: And the four and twenty elders, which sat before Elohim (God) on their seats, fell upon their faces, and worshipped Elohim (God),
verses.text: And the four and twenty elders, which sat before Elohim on their seats, fell upon their faces, and worshipped Elohim,

verses.raw: Saying, We give you thanks, O Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) Almighty, which are, and were, and are to come; because you have taken to you your great power, and have reigned.
verses.text: Saying, We give you thanks, O Yahuah Elohim Almighty, which are, and were, and are to come; because you have taken to you your great power, and have reigned.

verses.raw: And the nations were angry, and your wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that you should give reward unto your servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear your name, small and great; and should destroy them which destroy the earth.
verses.text: And the nations were angry, and your wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that you should give reward unto your servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear your name, small and great; and should destroy them which destroy the earth.

verses.raw: And the temple of Elohim (God) was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.
verses.text: And the temple of Elohim was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.

verses.raw: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:
verses.text: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:

verses.raw: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.
verses.text: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.

verses.raw: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.
verses.text: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.

verses.raw: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.
verses.text: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.

verses.raw: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto Elohim (God), and to his throne.
verses.text: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto Elohim, and to his throne.

verses.raw: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared of Elohim (God), that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.
verses.text: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared of Elohim, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.

verses.raw: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,
verses.text: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,

verses.raw: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.
verses.text: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.

verses.raw: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.
verses.text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

verses.raw: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our Elohim (God), and the power of his Messiah (Christ): for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our Elohim (God) day and night.
verses.text: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our Elohim, and the power of his Messiah: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our Elohim day and night.

verses.raw: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.
verses.text: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.

verses.raw: Therefore rejoice, you heavens, and you that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knows that he has but a short time.
verses.text: Therefore rejoice, you heavens, and you that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knows that he has but a short time.

verses.raw: And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man child.
verses.text: And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man child.

verses.raw: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
verses.text: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

verses.raw: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.
verses.text: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.

verses.raw: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.
verses.text: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.

verses.raw: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of Elohim (God), and have the testimony of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of Elohim, and have the testimony of Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.
verses.text: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.

verses.raw: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.
verses.text: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.

verses.raw: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.
verses.text: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.

verses.raw: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?
verses.text: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?

verses.raw: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months.
verses.text: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months.

verses.raw: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against Elohim (God), to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.
verses.text: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against Elohim, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.

verses.raw: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.
verses.text: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.

verses.raw: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.
verses.text: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.

verses.raw: If any man have an ear, let him hear.
verses.text: If any man have an ear, let him hear.

verses.raw: He that leads into captivity shall go into captivity: he that kills with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.
verses.text: He that leads into captivity shall go into captivity: he that kills with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.

verses.raw: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.
verses.text: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.

verses.raw: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causes the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.
verses.text: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causes the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.

verses.raw: And he does great wonders, so that he makes fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men,
verses.text: And he does great wonders, so that he makes fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men,

verses.raw: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.
verses.text: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.

verses.raw: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.
verses.text: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.

verses.raw: And he causes all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:
verses.text: And he causes all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:

verses.raw: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.
verses.text: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.

verses.raw: Here is wisdom. Let him that has understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six.
verses.text: Here is wisdom. Let him that has understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six.

verses.raw: And I looked, and, lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty and four thousand, having his Father’s name written in their foreheads.
verses.text: And I looked, and, lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty and four thousand, having his Father’s name written in their foreheads.

verses.raw: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps:
verses.text: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps:

verses.raw: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders: and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand, which were redeemed from the earth.
verses.text: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders: and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand, which were redeemed from the earth.

verses.raw: These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goes. These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto Elohim (God) and to the Lamb.
verses.text: These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goes. These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto Elohim and to the Lamb.

verses.raw: And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of Elohim.

verses.raw: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people,
verses.text: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people,

verses.raw: Saying with a loud voice, Fear Elohim (God), and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.
verses.text: Saying with a loud voice, Fear Elohim, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.

verses.raw: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.
verses.text: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.

verses.raw: And the third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any man worship the beast and his image, and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand,
verses.text: And the third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any man worship the beast and his image, and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand,

verses.raw: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of Elohim (God), which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:
verses.text: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of Elohim, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:

verses.raw: And the smoke of their torment ascends up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whosoever receives the mark of his name.
verses.text: And the smoke of their torment ascends up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whosoever receives the mark of his name.

verses.raw: Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of Elohim (God), and the faith of Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of Elohim, and the faith of Yahusha.

verses.raw: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, says the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.
verses.text: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, says the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.

verses.raw: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of Adam, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
verses.text: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of Adam, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

verses.raw: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud, Thrust in your sickle, and reap: for the time is come for you to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.
verses.text: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud, Thrust in your sickle, and reap: for the time is come for you to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.

verses.raw: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth; and the earth was reaped.
verses.text: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth; and the earth was reaped.

verses.raw: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.
verses.text: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.

verses.raw: And another angel came out from the altar, which had power over fire; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Thrust in your sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.
verses.text: And another angel came out from the altar, which had power over fire; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Thrust in your sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.

verses.raw: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of Elohim.

verses.raw: And the winepress was trodden without the city, and blood came out of the winepress, even unto the horse bridles, by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs.
verses.text: And the winepress was trodden without the city, and blood came out of the winepress, even unto the horse bridles, by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs.

verses.raw: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of Elohim.

verses.raw: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of Elohim.

verses.raw: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of Elohim (God), and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are your works, Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) Almighty; just and true are your ways, you King of saints.
verses.text: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of Elohim, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are your works, Yahuah Elohim Almighty; just and true are your ways, you King of saints.

verses.raw: Who shall not fear you, O Yahuah (Lord), and glorify your name? for you only are holy: for all nations shall come and worship before you; for your judgments are made manifest.
verses.text: Who shall not fear you, O Yahuah, and glorify your name? for you only are holy: for all nations shall come and worship before you; for your judgments are made manifest.

verses.raw: And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:
verses.text: And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:

verses.raw: And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden girdles.
verses.text: And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden girdles.

verses.raw: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of Elohim (God), who lives for ever and ever.
verses.text: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of Elohim, who lives for ever and ever.

verses.raw: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of Elohim (God), and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.
verses.text: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of Elohim, and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.

verses.raw: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of Elohim (God) upon the earth.
verses.text: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of Elohim upon the earth.
